// onActivityResult dispatches on the first matching `when` branch, so two equal
// request codes silently route one picker's result into another handler (the
// backlog export once landed in the model-weight import this way).
const bodyOf=(source,signature)=>{
 const start=source.indexOf(signature);
 if(start<0)return null;
 const open=source.indexOf('{',start);
 let depth=0;
 for(let i=open;i<source.length;i++){
  if(source[i]==='{')depth++;
  else if(source[i]==='}'&&--depth===0)return source.slice(open,i+1);
 }
 return null;
};

  'showWebLearningInboxDialog','offerResearchResume','reportNeuralPracticeEnabled'];
 // drops the argument list of every onLearningIo( ... ) call (string literals skipped while matching)
 const withoutIo=body=>{
  let out='',i=0;
  while(i<body.length){
   const at=body.indexOf('onLearningIo(',i);
   if(at<0){out+=body.slice(i);break;}
   out+=body.slice(i,at);
   let depth=0,j=at+'onLearningIo'.length,inString=false;
   for(;j<body.length;j++){
    const c=body[j];
    if(inString){if(c==='\\')j++;else if(c==='"')inString=false;continue;}
    if(c==='"')inString=true;
    else if(c==='(')depth++;
    else if(c===')'&&--depth===0)break;
   }
   i=j+1;
  }
  return out;
 };

import crypto from "node:crypto";

const SKILL_CURRICULUM = {
  "instruction-decomposition":"Welche Methoden und Benchmarks verbessern die Zerlegung komplexer Benutzeraufträge in überprüfbare Teilziele?",
  "research":"Welche Methoden verbessern autonome Informationssuche, Quellenabdeckung und Rechercheeffizienz bei KI-Agenten?",
  "source-critique":"Welche Verfahren bewerten Quellenqualität, Widersprüche, Unabhängigkeit und Evidenzstärke robust?",
  "synthesis":"Welche Verfahren erzeugen aus mehreren Quellen präzise, widerspruchsbewusste und zitierbare Synthesen?",
  "communication":"Welche Verfahren verbessern adaptive, verständliche und nutzerorientierte Kommunikation persönlicher KI-Assistenten?",
  "dialogue-pragmatics":"Welche empirisch robusten Verfahren lernen Dialogpragmatik, Gesprächskontext und implizite Benutzerabsichten?",
  "affect-understanding":"Welche empirisch robusten Verfahren erkennen emotionale und soziale Signale in Textdialogen ohne sie zu überinterpretieren?",
  "planning":"Welche Verfahren verbessern hierarchische Planung, Aufgabenzerlegung, Selbstüberwachung und Zielauswahl bei KI-Agenten?",
  "memory-retrieval":"Welche Gedächtnisarchitekturen verbessern episodischen und semantischen Abruf, Relevanzranking und Langzeitkonsistenz bei KI-Agenten?",
  "self-check":"Welche Evaluator-, Verifier- und Self-Check-Verfahren erkennen Fehler und Regressionen bei autonomen KI-Agenten?"
};

const SKILLS = [
  "instruction-decomposition",
  "research",
  "source-critique",
  "synthesis",
  "communication",
  "dialogue-pragmatics",
  "affect-understanding",
  "planning",
  "memory-retrieval",
  "self-check"
];

export function createBabyState(now = Date.now()) {
  return {
    schemaVersion: 3,
    createdAt: now,
    updatedAt: now,
    beliefs: [],
    quarantinedBeliefs: [],
    goals: [],
    episodes: [],
    skills: Object.fromEntries(SKILLS.map(id => [id, {
      id, trials: 0, rewardSum: 0, successCount: 0, lastReward: null, lastAt: null
    }])),
    counters: { observations: 0, plans: 0, contradictions: 0 },
    interactionProfile: {
      total:0, meanLength:0, meanUrgency:0,
      speechActs:{}, affects:{}, constraints:{}
    },
    ownerRules: [],
    memoryRewardVersion:2
  };
}

export function migrateBabyState(value, now = Date.now()) {
  if (!value) return createBabyState(now);
  const state = structuredClone(value);
  if(state.schemaVersion===1){
    state.schemaVersion=2;
    state.beliefs=(Array.isArray(state.beliefs)?state.beliefs:[]).map(b=>{
      if(Number.isFinite(b.supportCount))return b;
      const confidence=Math.min(.55,Number(b.confidence??.4));
      return {...b,confidence,uncertainty:1-confidence,status:"PROVISIONAL",
        supportCount:Array.isArray(b.citationUrls)?Math.min(3,b.citationUrls.length):0,
        sourceDiversity:0};
    });
    state.interactionProfile={total:0,meanLength:0,meanUrgency:0,speechActs:{},affects:{},constraints:{}};
    state.ownerRules=[];
  }
  if(state.schemaVersion===2){
    state.schemaVersion=3;
    state.memoryRewardVersion=2;
    if(state.skills?.["memory-retrieval"]){
      state.skills["memory-retrieval"]={
        id:"memory-retrieval",trials:0,rewardSum:0,successCount:0,lastReward:null,lastAt:null
      };
    }
  }
  if(state.schemaVersion!==3)return createBabyState(now);
  if(state.memoryRewardVersion!==2){
    state.memoryRewardVersion=2;
    if(state.skills?.["memory-retrieval"]){
      state.skills["memory-retrieval"]={
        id:"memory-retrieval",trials:0,rewardSum:0,successCount:0,lastReward:null,lastAt:null
      };
    }
  }
  // Re-audit old evidence on every load. Quarantined material is retained for review,
  // not silently converted into trusted knowledge or dropped without an audit trail.
  state.quarantinedBeliefs = Array.isArray(state.quarantinedBeliefs)
    ? state.quarantinedBeliefs.slice(-64) : [];
  const reviewed = [];
  for (const belief of consolidateBeliefs(Array.isArray(state.beliefs) ? state.beliefs : [])) {
    const rejection = beliefQualityReason(belief.query, belief.text);
    if (rejection) {
      state.quarantinedBeliefs = quarantineBelief(state.quarantinedBeliefs, belief, rejection, now);
      continue;
    }
    // Older confidence scores were based on source counts, not on an explicit claim
    // citation. Recalibrate once; repeated migrations must be idempotent.
    if (belief.status === "GROUNDED_OBSERVATION" && belief.evidenceMode !== "EXPLICIT_CITATION") {
      belief.status = "PROVISIONAL";
      belief.confidence = Math.min(Number(belief.confidence ?? .4), .62);
      belief.uncertainty = 1 - belief.confidence;
      belief.evidenceMode = "LEGACY_UNVERIFIED";
    }
    reviewed.push(belief);
  }
  state.beliefs = reviewed.slice(-256);
  state.goals = Array.isArray(state.goals) ? state.goals.slice(-128) : [];
  state.episodes = Array.isArray(state.episodes) ? state.episodes.slice(-128) : [];
  state.skills = state.skills && typeof state.skills === "object" ? state.skills : {};
  for (const id of SKILLS) {
    if (!state.skills[id]) state.skills[id] = {
      id, trials: 0, rewardSum: 0, successCount: 0, lastReward: null, lastAt: null
    };
  }
  state.counters = state.counters ?? { observations: 0, plans: 0, contradictions: 0 };
  state.interactionProfile=state.interactionProfile??{total:0,meanLength:0,meanUrgency:0,speechActs:{},affects:{},constraints:{}};
  state.ownerRules=Array.isArray(state.ownerRules)?state.ownerRules.slice(-32):[];
  return state;
}

export function observeInteraction(babyInput,text,now=Date.now()){
  const baby=migrateBabyState(babyInput,now);
  const analysis=analyzeInstruction(text);
  const p=baby.interactionProfile;
  const n=p.total;
  p.total=n+1;
  p.meanLength=(p.meanLength*n+String(text).length)/(n+1);
  p.meanUrgency=(p.meanUrgency*n+analysis.urgency)/(n+1);
  p.speechActs[analysis.speechAct]=(p.speechActs[analysis.speechAct]??0)+1;
  p.affects[analysis.affect]=(p.affects[analysis.affect]??0)+1;
  for(const constraint of analysis.constraints){
    const key=clean(constraint.toLocaleLowerCase("de-DE"),80);
    p.constraints[key]=(p.constraints[key]??0)+1;
  }
  baby.updatedAt=now;
  return {baby,analysis};
}

export function addOwnerRule(babyInput,text,now=Date.now()){
  const baby=migrateBabyState(babyInput,now);
  const cleaned=clean(text,600);
  if(cleaned.length<5)return {baby,rule:null};
  const id="rule-"+sha256(cleaned.toLocaleLowerCase("de-DE")).slice(0,20);
  let rule=baby.ownerRules.find(x=>x.id===id);
  if(!rule){
    rule={id,text:cleaned,createdAt:now,provenance:"USER_EXPLICIT",active:true};
    baby.ownerRules.push(rule);
    baby.ownerRules=baby.ownerRules.slice(-32);
  }
  baby.updatedAt=now;
  return {baby,rule};
}

export function analyzeInstruction(text) {
  const cleaned = clean(text, 1600);
  const lower = cleaned.toLocaleLowerCase("de-DE");
  const speechAct = /^\s*(wer|was|wie|wo|wann|warum|wieso|welche|kann|könnt|ist|sind|hat|haben)\b/.test(lower) || /\?$/.test(cleaned)
    ? "QUESTION"
    : /\b(mach|baue|erstelle|suche|prüfe|recherchiere|entwickle|zeige|erkläre|analysiere|finde|lerne)\b/.test(lower)
      ? "REQUEST"
      : /\b(gut|super|richtig|falsch|nein|ja|besser|schlechter|feedback)\b/.test(lower)
        ? "FEEDBACK"
        : "STATEMENT";
  const affect = /\b(wütend|ärger|schei|verdammt|frustriert|genervt)\b/.test(lower)
    ? "FRUSTRATED"
    : /\b(super|freu|gut|stark|toll|perfekt)\b/.test(lower)
      ? "POSITIVE"
      : /\b(dringend|sofort|jetzt|unbedingt|schnell)\b/.test(lower)
        ? "URGENT"
        : "NEUTRAL";
  const urgency = /\b(sofort|jetzt|dringend|unbedingt|gleich)\b/.test(lower) ? 0.9 : 0.35;
  const constraints = [];
  for (const pattern of [
    /\bohne\s+[^,.!?;]{2,100}/gi,
    /\bkeine?n?\s+[^,.!?;]{2,100}/gi,
    /\bmuss\s+[^,.!?;]{2,100}/gi,
    /\bdarf\s+nicht\s+[^,.!?;]{2,100}/gi,
    /\bnur\s+[^,.!?;]{2,100}/gi
  ]) {
    for (const match of cleaned.matchAll(pattern)) constraints.push(clean(match[0], 120));
  }
  const clauses = cleaned.split(/(?:[.;!?]|\bund\s+dann\b|\bdanach\b|\baußerdem\b)/i)
    .map(x => clean(x, 260)).filter(x => x.length >= 8).slice(0, 8);
  return {
    speechAct, affect, urgency,
    constraints: [...new Set(constraints)].slice(0, 8),
    clauses,
    complexity: Math.min(1, (clauses.length + constraints.length * 1.5 + cleaned.length / 220) / 10)
  };
}

export function buildDeepResearchPlan(question) {
  const q = clean(question, 600);
  const lower=q.toLocaleLowerCase("de-DE");
  const plan=[
    {
      id:"mechanism",
      question:q + " — Welche Mechanismen und Architekturen funktionieren nachweislich?",
      searchQuery:"personal AI assistant continual learning architecture adaptive memory online learning",
      skill:"research"
    },
    {
      id:"evidence",
      question:q + " — Welche starken empirischen Ergebnisse und Benchmarks gibt es?",
      searchQuery:"AI agent continual adaptation benchmark retention generalization calibration evaluation",
      skill:"source-critique"
    },
    {
      id:"failure",
      question:q + " — Welche Grenzen, Fehlschläge, Gegenbeispiele und offenen Probleme sind bekannt?",
      searchQuery:"adaptive AI agent failure modes regression negative results benchmark continual learning",
      skill:"source-critique"
    },
    {
      id:"implementation",
      question:q + " — Welche konkreten Implementierungsbausteine lassen sich daraus ableiten?",
      searchQuery:"personal AI assistant architecture memory active learning planner verifier implementation",
      skill:"instruction-decomposition"
    }
  ];
  if(/sprache|dialog|emotion|benutzer|kommunik|grammar|language|conversation/.test(lower)){
    plan.push({
      id:"interaction",
      question:q+" — Welche Methoden für Dialogpragmatik, Benutzerfeedback, Emotionssignale und natürliche Interaktion sind empirisch belastbar?",
      searchQuery:"dialogue pragmatics affective computing conversational agents user modeling user feedback preference learning emotion recognition benchmark",
      skill:"dialogue-pragmatics"
    });
  }
  if(/plan|denken|zerleg|reason|selbst|ziel|entscheidung|gedächtnis|memory|unsicher/.test(lower)){
    plan.push({
      id:"metacognition",
      question:q+" — Welche Methoden für Aufgabenzerlegung, Selbstüberwachung, Planung, Memory-Retrieval und Wahl des nächsten Lernziels sind empirisch belastbar?",
      searchQuery:"LLM agents hierarchical planning task decomposition metacognitive monitoring memory retrieval uncertainty calibration goal selection benchmark",
      skill:"planning"
    });
  }
  return plan.slice(0,6);
}

export function ingestEvidence(babyInput, {
  query, answer, citations = [], uncertainty = null, nextQuestions = [], now = Date.now()
}) {
  const baby = migrateBabyState(babyInput, now);
  const sourceDiversity = new Set(citations.map(x => domainOf(x.url)).filter(Boolean)).size;
  const evidenceFactor = Math.min(0.52, citations.length * 0.055 + sourceDiversity * 0.045);
  const inferredUncertainty = uncertainty == null
    ? Math.max(0.12, 0.72 - evidenceFactor)
    : clamp(Number(uncertainty), 0.05, 0.95);
  const sentences = splitClaims(answer).slice(0, 10);
  const added = [];
  for (const sentence of sentences) {
    const quality = beliefQualityReason(query, sentence);
    if (quality) {
      baby.quarantinedBeliefs = quarantineBelief(baby.quarantinedBeliefs, {
        id: "belief-" + sha256(sentence.toLocaleLowerCase("de-DE")).slice(0, 20),
        text: sentence, query
      }, quality, now);
      continue;
    }
    const normalized = sentence.toLocaleLowerCase("de-DE");
    const id = "belief-" + sha256(normalized).slice(0, 20);
    const existing=baby.beliefs.find(x=>x.id===id);
    const refIndices=[...sentence.matchAll(/\[(\d{1,2})\]/g)]
      .map(m=>Number(m[1])-1).filter(i=>i>=0&&i<citations.length);
    const supported=refIndices.length
      ? [...new Set(refIndices)].map(i=>citations[i]).filter(x=>isValidCitationUrl(x?.url))
      : citations.slice(0,Math.min(3,citations.length)).filter(x=>isValidCitationUrl(x?.url));
    const contradictionIds = baby.beliefs
      .filter(old => looksContradictory(old.text, sentence))
      .map(x => x.id).slice(0, 6);
    const diversity=new Set(supported.map(x=>domainOf(x.url)).filter(Boolean)).size;
    const meanRelevance=supported.length
      ? supported.reduce((n,x)=>n+Math.min(6,Number(x.relevance??2)),0)/supported.length : 0;
    const markerPenalty=refIndices.length?0:0.16;
    const supportGain=Math.min(.28,supported.length*.055+diversity*.04+meanRelevance*.018);
    const confidence = clamp(.56 + supportGain - inferredUncertainty*.34 - markerPenalty -
      contradictionIds.length * 0.08, 0.08, 0.92);
    const candidate={
      id,
      text: sentence.replace(/^#+\s*/,""),
      query: clean(query, 400),
      confidence,
      uncertainty: 1 - confidence,
      status: confidence >= 0.68 && supported.length>0 && refIndices.length>0
        ? "GROUNDED_OBSERVATION" : "PROVISIONAL",
      evidenceMode: refIndices.length && supported.length>0 ? "EXPLICIT_CITATION" : "ATTRIBUTED_UNVERIFIED",
      citationUrls: supported.map(x => x.url).slice(0, 8),
      supportCount:supported.length,
      sourceDiversity:diversity,
      contradictionIds,
      createdAt: existing?.createdAt??now,
      lastValidatedAt: now
    };
    if(existing){
      const mergedUrls=[...new Set([...(existing.citationUrls??[]),...candidate.citationUrls])].slice(0,8);
      Object.assign(existing,candidate,{
        confidence:Math.max(Number(existing.confidence??0),candidate.confidence),
        uncertainty:1-Math.max(Number(existing.confidence??0),candidate.confidence),
        status:(existing.evidenceMode==="EXPLICIT_CITATION"&&existing.status==="GROUNDED_OBSERVATION")||
          candidate.status==="GROUNDED_OBSERVATION" ? "GROUNDED_OBSERVATION":"PROVISIONAL",
        evidenceMode:candidate.evidenceMode==="EXPLICIT_CITATION"||existing.evidenceMode==="EXPLICIT_CITATION"
          ? "EXPLICIT_CITATION":"ATTRIBUTED_UNVERIFIED",
        citationUrls:mergedUrls,
        supportCount:Math.max(Number(existing.supportCount??0),candidate.supportCount),
        sourceDiversity:Math.max(Number(existing.sourceDiversity??0),candidate.sourceDiversity)
      });
    }else{
      baby.beliefs.push(candidate);
      added.push(id);
    }
    baby.counters.contradictions += contradictionIds.length;
  }
  baby.counters.observations += 1;
  const goals = [];
  for (const question of nextQuestions) {
    const goal = addGoal(baby, question, "EVIDENCE_GAP", inferredUncertainty + 0.3, now);
    if (goal) goals.push(goal.id);
  }
  if (citations.length < 2) {
    const goal = addGoal(baby, "Finde unabhängige Gegen- oder Bestätigungsquellen für: " + clean(query, 280),
      "SOURCE_DIVERSITY", 0.9, now);
    if (goal) goals.push(goal.id);
  }
  if (baby.counters.contradictions > 0) {
    const goal = addGoal(baby, "Prüfe erkannte widersprüchliche Aussagen rund um: " + clean(query, 280),
      "CONTRADICTION", 1.0, now);
    if (goal) goals.push(goal.id);
  }
  baby.beliefs = baby.beliefs.slice(-256);
  baby.goals = baby.goals.slice(-128);
  baby.updatedAt = now;
  return { baby, addedBeliefIds: added, addedGoalIds: goals };
}

export function addGoal(babyInput, text, origin = "USER", priority = 0.6, now = Date.now()) {
  const baby = babyInput;
  const cleaned = clean(text, 500);
  if (cleaned.length < 8) return null;
  const id = "goal-" + sha256(cleaned.toLocaleLowerCase("de-DE")).slice(0, 20);
  const existing = baby.goals.find(x => x.id === id);
  if (existing) {
    existing.priority = Math.max(existing.priority, clamp(priority, 0, 1.5));
    return existing;
  }
  const goal = {
    id, text: cleaned, origin,
    priority: clamp(priority, 0, 1.5),
    attempts: 0,
    rewardSum: 0,
    status: "OPEN",
    createdAt: now,
    lastTriedAt: null
  };
  baby.goals.push(goal);
  return goal;
}

export function refreshSkillCurriculum(babyInput,now=Date.now()){
  const baby=migrateBabyState(babyInput,now);
  for(const [skillId,question] of Object.entries(SKILL_CURRICULUM)){
    const skill=baby.skills[skillId];
    const mean=skill?.trials ? skill.rewardSum/skill.trials : null;
    const origin="SKILL_CURRICULUM:"+skillId;
    const existing=baby.goals.find(g=>g.origin===origin);
    const competent=(skill?.trials??0)>=2 && mean!==null && mean>=7.5;
    if(competent){
      if(existing)existing.status="SATISFIED";
      continue;
    }
    const priority=(skill?.trials??0)===0 ? 1.45 :
      (skill?.trials??0)<2 ? 1.2 :
      mean!==null&&mean<6.5 ? 1.35 : .95;
    if(existing){
      existing.status="OPEN";
      existing.priority=Math.max(existing.priority,priority);
    }else{
      addGoal(baby,question,origin,priority,now);
    }
  }
  baby.updatedAt=now;
  return baby;
}

export function evaluateMemoryRetrieval(rows){
  if(!Array.isArray(rows)||!rows.length)return 2;
  const top=rows.slice(0,5);
  const meanScore=top.reduce((n,x)=>n+Math.min(3,Number(x.score??0)),0)/top.length;
  const kinds=new Set(top.map(x=>x.kind)).size;
  const grounded=top.filter(x=>x.kind==="BELIEF"&&x.status==="GROUNDED_OBSERVATION").length;
  const provisional=top.filter(x=>x.kind==="BELIEF"&&x.status==="PROVISIONAL").length;
  return clamp(3+meanScore*.9+kinds*.45+grounded*.3-provisional*.12,2,9);
}

export function retrieveMemory(babyInput,query,limit=6){
  const baby=migrateBabyState(babyInput);
  const q=tokens(query);
  const scoreText=(text)=>{
    const t=tokens(text);
    if(!q.size||!t.size)return 0;
    const overlap=[...q].filter(x=>t.has(x)).length;
    return overlap/q.size;
  };
  const rows=[];
  for(const rule of baby.ownerRules.filter(x=>x.active)){
    rows.push({kind:"OWNER_RULE",id:rule.id,text:rule.text,score:.75+scoreText(rule.text)*1.8,confidence:1});
  }
  for(const belief of baby.beliefs){
    const overlap=scoreText(belief.text);
    if(overlap<=0)continue;
    rows.push({
      kind:"BELIEF",id:belief.id,text:belief.text,
      score:overlap*2+Number(belief.confidence??.3)*.65+(belief.status==="GROUNDED_OBSERVATION"?.25:0),
      confidence:Number(belief.confidence??.3),status:belief.status
    });
  }
  for(const episode of baby.episodes){
    const overlap=scoreText(episode.reflection);
    if(overlap<=0)continue;
    rows.push({
      kind:"EPISODE",id:episode.id,text:episode.reflection,
      score:overlap*1.6+Number(episode.reward??0)/20,
      confidence:null,status:episode.success?"SUCCESS":"FAILURE"
    });
  }
  for(const goal of baby.goals.filter(x=>x.status==="OPEN")){
    const overlap=scoreText(goal.text);
    if(overlap<=0)continue;
    rows.push({kind:"OPEN_GOAL",id:goal.id,text:goal.text,score:overlap*1.7+goal.priority*.25,confidence:null,status:goal.status});
  }
  return rows.sort((a,b)=>b.score-a.score||a.id.localeCompare(b.id)).slice(0,Math.max(1,Math.min(12,limit)));
}

export function selectGoal(babyInput, now = Date.now()) {
  const baby = migrateBabyState(babyInput, now);
  return baby.goals.filter(x => x.status === "OPEN").map(goal => {
    const age = goal.lastTriedAt ? Math.min(1, (now - goal.lastTriedAt) / 86400000) : 1;
    const mean = goal.attempts ? goal.rewardSum / goal.attempts : 0;
    const exploration = goal.attempts ? Math.sqrt(2 * Math.log(2 + baby.counters.plans) / goal.attempts) : 2;
    return { goal, score: goal.priority + age * 0.35 + mean * 0.18 + exploration * 0.22 };
  }).sort((a,b) => b.score - a.score || a.goal.id.localeCompare(b.goal.id))[0]?.goal ?? null;
}

export function recordOutcome(babyInput, {
  goalId = null, skills = [], success = false, reward = 0, reflection = "", now = Date.now()
}) {
  const baby = migrateBabyState(babyInput, now);
  const boundedReward = clamp(Number(reward), 0, 10);
  if (goalId) {
    const goal = baby.goals.find(x => x.id === goalId);
    if (goal) {
      goal.attempts += 1;
      goal.rewardSum += boundedReward;
      goal.lastTriedAt = now;
      if (success && boundedReward >= 6.5) goal.status = "SATISFIED";
    }
  }
  for (const id of skills) {
    const skill = baby.skills[id] ?? (baby.skills[id] = {
      id, trials: 0, rewardSum: 0, successCount: 0, lastReward: null, lastAt: null
    });
    skill.trials += 1;
    skill.rewardSum += boundedReward;
    skill.successCount += success ? 1 : 0;
    skill.lastReward = boundedReward;
    skill.lastAt = now;
  }
  baby.counters.plans += 1;
  baby.episodes.push({
    id:"episode-" + sha256([String(now),goalId ?? "",reflection].join("\0")).slice(0,20),
    goalId,
    success:Boolean(success),
    reward:boundedReward,
    reflection:clean(reflection, 800),
    createdAt:now
  });
  baby.episodes = baby.episodes.slice(-128);
  baby.updatedAt = now;
  return baby;
}

export function babyStatus(babyInput) {
  const baby = migrateBabyState(babyInput);
  return {
    beliefs:baby.beliefs.length,
    quarantinedBeliefs:baby.quarantinedBeliefs.length,
    explicitlyCited:baby.beliefs.filter(x=>x.evidenceMode==="EXPLICIT_CITATION").length,
    unattributedOrLegacy:baby.beliefs.filter(x=>x.evidenceMode!=="EXPLICIT_CITATION").length,
    grounded:baby.beliefs.filter(x=>x.status==="GROUNDED_OBSERVATION").length,
    provisional:baby.beliefs.filter(x=>x.status==="PROVISIONAL").length,
    contradictions:baby.counters.contradictions,
    openGoals:baby.goals.filter(x=>x.status==="OPEN").length,
    satisfiedGoals:baby.goals.filter(x=>x.status==="SATISFIED").length,
    episodes:baby.episodes.length,
    skills:Object.values(baby.skills).map(s=>({
      id:s.id,
      trials:s.trials,
      meanReward:s.trials ? s.rewardSum/s.trials : null,
      successRate:s.trials ? s.successCount/s.trials : null
    })),
    interactionProfile:baby.interactionProfile,
    ownerRules:baby.ownerRules.filter(x=>x.active).length,
    curriculumOpen:baby.goals.filter(x=>x.status==="OPEN"&&String(x.origin).startsWith("SKILL_CURRICULUM:")).length
  };
}

const TOPIC_STOPWORDS = new Set([
  "welche","welcher","welches","methoden","method","methods","empirisch","empirical",
  "sollte","sollen","können","könnte","unter","diese","dieser","wurde","werden",
  "einen","einer","eine","nicht","durch","gegen","ohne","dabei","between",
  "which","should","could","would","their","about","there","using","with",
  "from","does","have","that","these","those","robust","evidence","based",
  "improve","improves","improving","vergleichen","verbessern","mehreren",
  "systemen","system","systems","approach","approaches","starke","strong"
]);

function topicTokens(value) {
  const words = String(value??"").toLocaleLowerCase("de-DE")
    .normalize("NFKC").split(/[^\p{L}\p{N}]+/u)
    .filter(x => x.length >= 5 && !TOPIC_STOPWORDS.has(x));
  return new Set(words.map(x => {
    if (/^(lern|learning|learner|trainier|training)/.test(x)) return "learning";
    if (/^(gedächtn|memory|retriev|erinner)/.test(x)) return "memory";
    if (/^(agent|assistent|assistant)/.test(x)) return "assistant";
    if (/^(dialog|gespräch|conversation)/.test(x)) return "dialogue";
    if (/^(forsch|research|recherch)/.test(x)) return "research";
    if (/^(vergess|forget)/.test(x)) return "forgetting";
    if (/^(unsicher|uncertaint)/.test(x)) return "uncertainty";
    if (/^(plan|planung)/.test(x)) return "planning";
    return x;
  }));
}

function beliefQualityReason(query,text) {
  if (!sanitizeBeliefText(text)) return "NON_CLAIM_OR_NAVIGATION";
  const q = topicTokens(query);
  // A missing legacy query must not cause irreversible removal.
  if (q.size < 2) return null;
  const claim = topicTokens(text);
  if (![...q].some(token => claim.has(token))) return "OFF_TOPIC";
  return null;
}

function quarantineBelief(previous, belief, reason, now) {
  const items = Array.isArray(previous) ? previous.slice(-64) : [];
  const id = String(belief.id ?? "belief-" + sha256(String(belief.text))).slice(0,80);
  if (!items.some(item=>item.id===id && item.reason===reason)) {
    items.push({
      id, reason, query:clean(belief.query,240), text:clean(belief.text,500),
      citationUrls:Array.isArray(belief.citationUrls)?belief.citationUrls.slice(0,6):[],
      auditedAt:now
    });
  }
  return items.slice(-64);
}

function isValidCitationUrl(value) {
  try {
    const url = new URL(String(value??""));
    return ["http:","https:"].includes(url.protocol) && !url.username && !url.password;
  } catch { return false; }
}

function consolidateBeliefs(values){
  const byKey=new Map();
  for(const raw of values){
    const text=sanitizeBeliefText(raw?.text);
    if(!text)continue;
    const key=text.toLocaleLowerCase("de-DE").replace(/[^\p{L}\p{N}]+/gu," ").trim();
    if(!key)continue;
    const candidate={...raw,text};
    const existing=byKey.get(key);
    if(!existing){
      byKey.set(key,candidate);
      continue;
    }
    const existingConfidence=Number(existing.confidence??0);
    const candidateConfidence=Number(candidate.confidence??0);
    const strongest=candidateConfidence>existingConfidence?candidate:existing;
    const weaker=strongest===candidate?existing:candidate;
    strongest.citationUrls=[...new Set([...(strongest.citationUrls??[]),...(weaker.citationUrls??[])])].slice(0,8);
    strongest.supportCount=Math.max(Number(strongest.supportCount??0),Number(weaker.supportCount??0));
    strongest.sourceDiversity=Math.max(Number(strongest.sourceDiversity??0),Number(weaker.sourceDiversity??0));
    strongest.contradictionIds=[...new Set([...(strongest.contradictionIds??[]),...(weaker.contradictionIds??[])])].slice(0,8);
    if(existing.status==="GROUNDED_OBSERVATION"||candidate.status==="GROUNDED_OBSERVATION")
      strongest.status="GROUNDED_OBSERVATION";
    strongest.createdAt=Math.min(Number(existing.createdAt??Infinity),Number(candidate.createdAt??Infinity));
    strongest.lastValidatedAt=Math.max(Number(existing.lastValidatedAt??0),Number(candidate.lastValidatedAt??0));
    byKey.set(key,strongest);
  }
  return [...byKey.values()].sort((a,b)=>(a.createdAt??0)-(b.createdAt??0));
}

function sanitizeBeliefText(value){
  const text=String(value??"")
    .replace(/^\s*\[\d{1,2}\]\s*/,"")
    .replace(/^\s*#+\s*(mechanism|evidence|failure|implementation|interaction|metacognition)\s*/i,"")
    .replace(/\s+/g," ").trim();
  if(!text)return null;
  if(/skip to main|main navigation|site footer|open menu|current archives|privacy statement|register login|home\s*\/\s*archives/i.test(text))return null;
  const words=text.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
  const predicate=/\b(is|are|can|may|improves?|reduces?|shows?|finds?|allows?|requires?|learns?|prevents?|causes?|ist|sind|kann|können|zeigt|verbessert|reduziert|ermöglicht|verhindert|verursacht|lernt)\b/i.test(text);
  if(words.length<12&&!predicate)return null;
  return text.slice(0,650);
}

function splitClaims(text) {
  return String(text).split(/(?<=[.!?])\s+/)
    .map(x=>clean(x,500))
    .filter(x=>x.length>=45 && x.length<=500)
    .filter(x=>x.split(/\s+/).length>=7)
    .filter(x=>!/^#+\s*[^.!?]+$/.test(x))
    .filter((x,i,a)=>a.indexOf(x)===i);
}

function looksContradictory(a,b) {
  const A=tokens(a), B=tokens(b);
  const union=new Set([...A,...B]);
  const inter=[...A].filter(x=>B.has(x)).length;
  const similarity=union.size ? inter/union.size : 0;
  if(similarity<0.45)return false;
  return hasNegation(a)!==hasNegation(b);
}
function hasNegation(text){return /\b(nicht|kein|keine|never|no|not|cannot|can't|fails?|unmöglich)\b/i.test(text);}
function tokens(text){return new Set(String(text).toLocaleLowerCase("de-DE").split(/[^\p{L}\p{N}]+/u).filter(x=>x.length>=4));}
function domainOf(url){try{return new URL(url).hostname;}catch{return "";}}
function sha256(value){return crypto.createHash("sha256").update(String(value)).digest("hex");}
function clean(value,max){return String(value??"").replace(/[\u0000-\u001f\u007f]/g," ").replace(/\s+/g," ").trim().slice(0,max);}
function clamp(v,min,max){return Math.min(max,Math.max(min,Number.isFinite(v)?v:min));}

import test from "node:test";
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import {createBabyState,migrateBabyState,analyzeInstruction,observeInteraction,addOwnerRule,ingestEvidence,addGoal,refreshSkillCurriculum,retrieveMemory,evaluateMemoryRetrieval,selectGoal,recordOutcome,babyStatus,buildDeepResearchPlan} from "./baby-core.mjs";
import {isBlockedAddress,extractPage} from "./public-web.mjs";

test("baby extracts interaction structure and constraints",()=>{
  const x=analyzeInstruction("Baue jetzt eine Recherchefunktion, aber ohne kostenpflichtige APIs und prüfe danach die Ergebnisse.");
  assert.equal(x.speechAct,"REQUEST");
  assert.ok(x.urgency>=0.8);
  assert.ok(x.constraints.some(v=>v.toLowerCase().includes("ohne")));
  assert.ok(x.clauses.length>=2);
});

test("baby turns evidence into bounded beliefs and epistemic goals",()=>{
  const state=createBabyState(100);
  const result=ingestEvidence(state,{
    query:"continual learning",
    answer:"Experience replay can reduce catastrophic forgetting in continual learning systems. Independent evaluations still show trade-offs between stability and plasticity.",
    citations:[
      {url:"https://example.org/a",source:"PaperA"},
      {url:"https://example.net/b",source:"PaperB"},
      {url:"https://example.com/c",source:"PaperC"}
    ],
    nextQuestions:["Which held-out benchmark best detects stability-plasticity regressions?"],
    now:200
  });
  const status=babyStatus(result.baby);
  assert.ok(status.beliefs>=1);
  assert.ok(status.openGoals>=1);
  assert.equal(result.baby.beliefs[0].citationUrls.length,3);
});

test("goal policy balances priority reward and exploration",()=>{
  let state=createBabyState(100);
  const a=addGoal(state,"Find independent evidence for replay retention","EVIDENCE_GAP",1,100);
  const b=addGoal(state,"Test a low priority formatting idea","OTHER",0.1,100);
  assert.equal(selectGoal(state,200).id,a.id);
  state=recordOutcome(state,{goalId:a.id,skills:["research"],success:true,reward:9,reflection:"Strong independent sources",now:300});
  assert.equal(state.skills.research.trials,1);
  assert.ok(buildDeepResearchPlan("How should memory work?").length>=4);
  assert.ok(b);
});

test("public web guard blocks local and reserved addresses",()=>{
  for(const ip of ["127.0.0.1","10.0.0.8","192.168.1.10","169.254.1.1","::1","fc00::1","2001:db8::1"])assert.equal(isBlockedAddress(ip),true);
  assert.equal(isBlockedAddress("8.8.8.8"),false);
  assert.equal(isBlockedAddress("1.1.1.1"),false);
});

test("html extraction strips active content and preserves public links",()=>{
  const page=extractPage('<html><head><title>Agent Memory</title><style>x{}</style></head><body><script>alert(1)</script><p>Persistent memory helps an agent learn from experience.</p><a href="/paper">Paper</a></body></html>',
    "https://example.org/start","text/html");
  assert.equal(page.title,"Agent Memory");
  assert.ok(page.text.includes("Persistent memory"));
  assert.ok(!page.text.includes("alert(1)"));
  assert.deepEqual(page.links,["https://example.org/paper"]);
});


test("legacy overconfident beliefs are downgraded until revalidated",()=>{
  const legacy=createBabyState(100);
  legacy.schemaVersion=1;
  legacy.beliefs=[{id:"belief-old",text:"Experience replay can reduce catastrophic forgetting but this claim still lacks sufficient independent support.",confidence:.92,uncertainty:.08,status:"GROUNDED_OBSERVATION",citationUrls:["https://example.org/a"],createdAt:50,lastValidatedAt:50}];
  const migrated=migrateBabyState(legacy,200);
  assert.equal(migrated.schemaVersion,3);
  assert.equal(migrated.beliefs[0].status,"PROVISIONAL");
  assert.ok(migrated.beliefs[0].confidence<=.55);
});

test("interaction profile and explicit owner rules learn without becoming web beliefs",()=>{
  let state=createBabyState(100);
  const observed=observeInteraction(state,"Bitte recherchiere das jetzt dringend, aber ohne kostenpflichtige APIs.",200);
  state=observed.baby;
  assert.equal(state.interactionProfile.total,1);
  assert.equal(observed.analysis.affect,"URGENT");
  const ruled=addOwnerRule(state,"Antworte auf Deutsch und nenne messbare Fortschritte.",300);
  assert.equal(ruled.baby.ownerRules.length,1);
  assert.equal(ruled.baby.beliefs.length,0);
});


test("weak skills autonomously create curriculum goals and competent skills close them",()=>{
  let state=createBabyState(100);
  state=refreshSkillCurriculum(state,110);
  assert.ok(state.goals.some(g=>g.origin==="SKILL_CURRICULUM:affect-understanding"&&g.status==="OPEN"));
  const goal=state.goals.find(g=>g.origin==="SKILL_CURRICULUM:affect-understanding");
  state=recordOutcome(state,{goalId:goal.id,skills:["affect-understanding"],success:true,reward:8,reflection:"first",now:120});
  state=recordOutcome(state,{goalId:goal.id,skills:["affect-understanding"],success:true,reward:9,reflection:"second",now:130});
  state=refreshSkillCurriculum(state,140);
  assert.equal(state.goals.find(g=>g.origin==="SKILL_CURRICULUM:affect-understanding").status,"SATISFIED");
});

test("memory retrieval ranks explicit owner rules and grounded beliefs without treating episodes as facts",()=>{
  let state=createBabyState(100);
  state=addOwnerRule(state,"Antworte bei technischen Fragen mit messbaren Testergebnissen.",110).baby;
  state=ingestEvidence(state,{
    query:"continual learning replay",
    answer:"Experience replay can reduce catastrophic forgetting during continual learning when older examples are rehearsed [1].",
    citations:[{title:"Replay",url:"https://example.org/replay",source:"paper"}],
    uncertainty:.15,now:120
  }).baby;
  state=recordOutcome(state,{skills:["research"],success:true,reward:8,reflection:"Replay research found useful retention evidence",now:130});
  const rows=retrieveMemory(state,"technischen Testergebnissen replay learning",8);
  assert.ok(rows.some(x=>x.kind==="OWNER_RULE"));
  assert.ok(rows.some(x=>x.kind==="BELIEF"));
  assert.ok(rows.some(x=>x.kind==="EPISODE"));
});


test("deep research plan uses distinct focused search queries for interaction and metacognition",()=>{
  const plan=buildDeepResearchPlan("Wie lernt ein Assistent Sprache, Emotion, Planung und Gedächtnis?");
  const interaction=plan.find(x=>x.id==="interaction");
  const meta=plan.find(x=>x.id==="metacognition");
  assert.ok(interaction.searchQuery.includes("affective computing"));
  assert.ok(interaction.searchQuery.includes("dialogue pragmatics"));
  assert.ok(meta.searchQuery.includes("hierarchical planning"));
  assert.ok(meta.searchQuery.includes("memory retrieval"));
});

test("html extraction removes navigation chrome before learning",()=>{
  const page=extractPage('<html><head><title>Agent Paper</title></head><body><nav>Skip to main content Register Login</nav><header>Open Menu</header><main><p>Dialogue agents can adapt from explicit user feedback and calibrated uncertainty.</p></main><footer>Privacy Statement</footer></body></html>',
    "https://example.org/paper","text/html");
  assert.ok(page.text.includes("Dialogue agents"));
  assert.ok(!page.text.includes("Register Login"));
  assert.ok(!page.text.includes("Privacy Statement"));
});


test("baby memory migration removes navigation noise and merges citation-marker duplicates",()=>{
  const legacy=createBabyState(100);
  legacy.schemaVersion=2;
  legacy.beliefs=[
    {id:"a",text:"[1] Experience replay can reduce catastrophic forgetting during continual learning when older examples are rehearsed.",confidence:.7,status:"GROUNDED_OBSERVATION",citationUrls:["https://a.example/p"],supportCount:1,sourceDiversity:1,contradictionIds:[],createdAt:100,lastValidatedAt:100},
    {id:"b",text:"[2] Experience replay can reduce catastrophic forgetting during continual learning when older examples are rehearsed.",confidence:.75,status:"GROUNDED_OBSERVATION",citationUrls:["https://b.example/p"],supportCount:1,sourceDiversity:1,contradictionIds:[],createdAt:110,lastValidatedAt:110},
    {id:"noise",text:"Skip to main content Open Menu Current Archives Register Login Privacy Statement",confidence:.9,status:"GROUNDED_OBSERVATION",citationUrls:["https://noise.example"],supportCount:1,sourceDiversity:1,contradictionIds:[],createdAt:120,lastValidatedAt:120}
  ];
  legacy.skills["memory-retrieval"]={id:"memory-retrieval",trials:2,rewardSum:18,successCount:2,lastReward:9,lastAt:120};
  const migrated=migrateBabyState(legacy,200);
  assert.equal(migrated.schemaVersion,3);
  assert.equal(migrated.beliefs.length,1);
  assert.equal(migrated.beliefs[0].citationUrls.length,2);
  assert.equal(migrated.skills["memory-retrieval"].trials,0);
});

test("memory retrieval reward depends on relevance quality rather than raw hit count",()=>{
  const good=[
    {kind:"OWNER_RULE",score:2.5,confidence:1},
    {kind:"BELIEF",score:2.4,status:"GROUNDED_OBSERVATION",confidence:.8},
    {kind:"EPISODE",score:1.8,status:"SUCCESS"}
  ];
  const weak=Array.from({length:10},(_,i)=>({kind:"BELIEF",score:.15,status:"PROVISIONAL",confidence:.2,id:String(i)}));
  assert.ok(evaluateMemoryRetrieval(good)>evaluateMemoryRetrieval(weak));
  assert.ok(evaluateMemoryRetrieval([])<5);
});

test("retrospective audit quarantines unrelated historical research without destroying provenance",()=>{
  const state=createBabyState(100);
  state.beliefs=[
    {id:"physics-off-topic",text:"Rudolf Clausius formulated important thermodynamic statements about the nature of heat and entropy.",
      query:"How does an AI assistant improve continual learning and memory retrieval?",
      status:"GROUNDED_OBSERVATION",confidence:.92,citationUrls:["https://example.org/heat"],createdAt:110},
    {id:"replay-on-topic",text:"Experience replay can reduce forgetting during continual learning by reusing older training examples.",
      query:"How does an AI assistant improve continual learning and memory retrieval?",
      status:"GROUNDED_OBSERVATION",confidence:.91,citationUrls:["https://example.org/replay"],createdAt:115}
  ];
  const migrated=migrateBabyState(state,200);
  assert.deepEqual(migrated.beliefs.map(x=>x.id),["replay-on-topic"]);
  assert.equal(migrated.beliefs[0].status,"PROVISIONAL");
  assert.equal(migrated.quarantinedBeliefs[0].reason,"OFF_TOPIC");
  assert.equal(migrated.quarantinedBeliefs[0].citationUrls[0],"https://example.org/heat");
  assert.deepEqual(migrateBabyState(migrated,210).quarantinedBeliefs,migrated.quarantinedBeliefs);
});

test("new off-topic content stays quarantined even with several citation markers",()=>{
  const state=createBabyState(100);
  const result=ingestEvidence(state,{
    query:"continual learning memory replay in artificial intelligence",
    answer:"Rudolf Clausius developed theoretical work on classical heat engines and thermodynamic entropy [1].",
    citations:[{url:"https://example.org/heat",title:"Heat studies",source:"Paper"}],now:200
  });
  assert.equal(result.baby.beliefs.length,0);
  assert.equal(result.baby.quarantinedBeliefs.length,1);
  assert.equal(babyStatus(result.baby).quarantinedBeliefs,1);
});

test("uncited attribution and invalid evidence URLs cannot promote a claim",()=>{
  const citations=[
    {url:"https://research.example/one",source:"OpenAlex"},
    {url:"https://other.example/two",source:"OpenAlex"},
    {url:"javascript:alert(1)",source:"Unknown"}
  ];
  const r=ingestEvidence(createBabyState(100),{
    query:"continual learning catastrophic forgetting",
    answer:"Continual learning methods can reduce catastrophic forgetting by replaying carefully selected older examples.",
    citations,uncertainty:.05,now:200
  });
  assert.equal(r.baby.beliefs.length,1);
  assert.equal(r.baby.beliefs[0].status,"PROVISIONAL");
  assert.equal(r.baby.beliefs[0].sourceDiversity,2);
  assert.equal(r.baby.beliefs[0].citationUrls.length,2);
  assert.equal(r.baby.beliefs[0].evidenceMode,"ATTRIBUTED_UNVERIFIED");
});

import fs from 'node:fs';
import os from 'node:os';
import path from 'node:path';
import * as B from './development-backlog.mjs';
import {analyzeRepository} from './code-analyzer.mjs';
import {syncBacklogOps} from './development-planner.mjs';
import {git,createWorktree,removeWorktree,runChain,CHAINS} from './repair-loop.mjs';

/**
 * `developer-agent.mjs backlog <command> --file <backlog.json> ...`: the CLI for
 * humans and agents. Every change is an operation of development-backlog.mjs
 * (same rules as the Android app); test evidence is only ever produced by
 * `verify`, which runs a fixed check chain on the submitted patch itself.
 *
 *   show [--json]                       plan [--limit 12]
 *   accept|reject|abort|retry --id <id> [--reason <text>]
 *   priority --id <id> --priority <0..1000>
 *   claim [--id <id>] [--kinds A,B] [--owner <name>] [--lease-minutes 60]
 *   renew --id <id> --token <t> [--lease-minutes 60]
 *   submit --id <id> --token <t> --patch <file>
 *   verify --id <id> --base <commit> --chain node|android|jvm --patch <file>
 *   fail --id <id> --token <t> --code <CODE> [--message <text>]
 *   expire                              apply --ops <file> [--lenient]
 */
const SAFE_FILE=/^[\w./@-]{1,240}$/;
function safePath(value,name){
  if(typeof value!=='string'||!SAFE_FILE.test(value)||value.split('/').includes('..'))throw Error(`--${name} must be a plain path without ".."`);
  return path.resolve(value);
}
const leaseOf=o=>Math.round(Number(o['lease-minutes']??60)*60_000);
const ok=r=>r.ok?(r.duplicate?'duplicate (already applied)':'ok'):`${r.code}: ${r.message}`;

export function formatBacklog(doc){
  const rows=doc.tasks.map(t=>`${t.state.padEnd(11)} ${String(t.priority).padStart(4)}  ${t.kind.padEnd(11)} ${String(t.attempts)}/${t.maxAttempts}  ${t.id.padEnd(24)} ${t.title}`+
    (t.error?`\n${' '.repeat(36)}last error ${t.error.code}: ${t.error.message}`:''));
  return [`backlog revision ${doc.revision} · ${doc.tasks.length} task(s) · updated by ${doc.updatedBy}`,...rows].join('\n');
}

function report(log,result){
  if(result.recovered)log(`[backlog] RECOVERED from ${result.recovered.from}: ${result.recovered.reason}`+(result.recovered.quarantined?` (corrupt file kept as ${result.recovered.quarantined})`:''));
  if(result.migratedFrom)log(`[backlog] migrated from schema ${result.migratedFrom}`);
  for(const r of result.results??[])log(`[backlog] op ${r.index}: ${ok(r)}`+(r.id?` (${r.id})`:'')+(r.expired?.length?` expired ${r.expired.join(',')}`:''));
  log(`[backlog] revision ${result.doc.revision}${result.written?'':' (unchanged)'}`);
}

export async function backlogCommand(sub,o,{root=process.cwd(),log=console.log,now=Date.now}={}){
  const actor=o.actor??process.env.CONTINUUM_ACTOR??'cli';
  const store=new B.BacklogStore(safePath(o.file,'file'),{actor});
  const apply=(ops,opts)=>{const r=store.apply(ops,opts);report(log,r);return r;};
  const at=now();
  switch(sub){
    case 'show':{
      const r=store.read();
      if(r.recovered)log(`[backlog] would recover from ${r.recovered.from}: ${r.recovered.reason}`);
      if(r.migratedFrom)log(`[backlog] schema ${r.migratedFrom} file, migrated in memory (written on the next change)`);
      log(o.json?B.canonical(r.doc):formatBacklog(r.doc));
      return r;
    }
    case 'plan':{
      const {index,...analysis}=analyzeRepository(root);
      let results=[];
      const r=store.update(doc=>{
        const out=B.applyOps(doc,syncBacklogOps(doc,analysis,{at,limit:Number(o.limit??12)}),{stopOnError:false});
        results=out.results;return out.doc;
      });
      report(log,{...r,results});
      return {...r,results};
    }
    case 'accept':case 'reject':case 'abort':case 'retry':
      return apply([{op:sub,actor,at,id:o.id,...(o.reason?{reason:o.reason}:{})}]);
    case 'priority':
      return apply([{op:'setPriority',actor,at,id:o.id,priority:Number(o.priority)}]);
    case 'claim':{
      const token=B.newToken();
      const base={actor,at,owner:o.owner??actor,token,leaseMs:leaseOf(o)};
      const r=apply([o.id?{op:'claim',id:o.id,...base}:{op:'claimNext',...base,...(o.kinds?{kinds:o.kinds.split(',')}:{})}]);
      log(`[backlog] claimed ${r.results[0].id} with token ${token} (keep it: submit/renew/fail need it)`);
      return {...r,token};
    }
    case 'renew':
      return apply([{op:'renew',actor,at,id:o.id,token:o.token,leaseMs:leaseOf(o)}]);
    case 'submit':{
      const patch=fs.readFileSync(safePath(o.patch,'patch'));
      return apply([{op:'submit',actor,at,id:o.id,token:o.token,artifact:{type:'PATCH',sha256:B.sha256Hex(patch)}}]);
    }
    case 'fail':
      return apply([{op:'fail',actor,at,id:o.id,token:o.token,error:{code:o.code,message:B.singleLine(o.message??'',400)}}]);
    case 'expire':
      return apply([{op:'expire',actor,at}]);
    case 'apply':{
      const ops=B.parseStrict(fs.readFileSync(safePath(o.ops,'ops'),'utf8'));
      if(!Array.isArray(ops)||ops.length>1000)throw Error('--ops must hold a JSON array of at most 1000 operations');
      return apply(ops,{stopOnError:o.lenient!=='true'});
    }
    case 'verify':{
      // The only producer of test evidence: the submitted patch itself, applied
      // to the given base in an isolated worktree, checked by a fixed chain.
      if(!/^[0-9a-f]{40}$/.test(o.base??''))throw Error('--base must be a full commit hash');
      if(!CHAINS[o.chain])throw Error('--chain must be one of '+Object.keys(CHAINS).join(', '));
      const patchFile=safePath(o.patch,'patch');
      const patch=fs.readFileSync(patchFile);
      const task=store.read().doc.tasks.find(t=>t.id===o.id);
      if(!task)throw Error('Unknown task '+o.id);
      if(task.state!=='VERIFYING')throw Error(`${task.id} is ${task.state}; only a submitted task can be verified`);
      const sha=B.sha256Hex(patch);
      if(sha!==task.submission.artifact.sha256)throw Error('The patch is not the submitted artifact (SHA-256 differs)');
      const wt=createWorktree(root,o.base);
      const out=fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(),'backlog-verify-'));
      let check;
      try{
        const applied=git(wt,['apply','--whitespace=nowarn',patchFile],{allowFailure:true});
        if(applied.status!==0)throw Error('The patch does not apply to '+o.base+': '+applied.stderr.slice(-300));
        check=runChain(o.chain,wt,out);
      }finally{removeWorktree(root,wt);fs.rmSync(out,{recursive:true,force:true});}
      const evidence={type:'TEST_RUN',taskId:task.id,submissionToken:task.submission.token,artifactSha256:sha,chain:o.chain,commit:o.base,
        profiles:check.results.map(r=>({profile:r.profile,passed:r.passed,executed:r.tests.executed,failed:r.tests.failed,skipped:r.tests.skipped})),
        repair:null,at:now(),by:actor};
      for(const p of evidence.profiles)log(`[verify] ${p.profile}: ${p.passed?'passed':'FAILED'} · ${p.executed} executed, ${p.failed} failed, ${p.skipped} skipped`);
      const op=check.passed
        ?{op:'complete',actor,at:evidence.at,id:task.id,evidence}
        :{op:'fail',actor,at:evidence.at,id:task.id,token:task.submission.token,evidence,
          error:{code:'CHECKS_FAILED',message:B.singleLine(evidence.profiles.filter(p=>!p.passed).map(p=>p.profile).join(', ')+' failed',400)}};
      // complete still enforces the evidence rules (e.g. executed tests > 0)
      return apply([op],{stopOnError:false});
    }
    default:
      throw Error('Unknown backlog command '+sub+' (show|plan|accept|reject|abort|retry|priority|claim|renew|submit|verify|fail|expire|apply)');
  }
}

FILE 5/375: .github/continuum/backlog-cli.test.mjs
SHA-256: 4c3b5b143c231c3d13933583675a6310305fb994b2e03635429a41af00d271a0

import test from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import os from 'node:os';
import path from 'node:path';
import {spawnSync} from 'node:child_process';
import {backlogCommand} from './backlog-cli.mjs';
import {loadBacklogFromBranch,saveBacklogToBranch,STATE_BRANCH} from './repair-publish.mjs';
import * as B from './development-backlog.mjs';

const nested=process.env.CONTINUUM_REPAIR_DEPTH?'skipped inside a repair session (no nested check chains)':false;

function repo(){
  const dir=fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(),'backlog-cli-'));
  const g=(...a)=>{const r=spawnSync('git',a,{cwd:dir,encoding:'utf8'});if(r.status!==0)throw Error(r.stderr);return r.stdout.trim();};
  fs.mkdirSync(path.join(dir,'.github/continuum'),{recursive:true});
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir,'.github/continuum/math.mjs'),"export const square=x=>x+x;\n");
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir,'.github/continuum/math.test.mjs'),"import test from 'node:test';\nimport assert from 'node:assert/strict';\nimport {square} from './math.mjs';\ntest('square',()=>assert.equal(square(3),9));\n");
  g('init','-q');g('-c','user.name=t','-c','user.email=t@t','add','.');g('-c','user.name=t','-c','user.email=t@t','commit','-qm','base');
  return {dir,g,base:g('rev-parse','HEAD')};
}
const silent=()=>{};

test('backlog CLI: a human task is DONE only after verify ran the fixed checks on the submitted patch',{skip:nested},async()=>{
  const {dir,g,base}=repo();
  const file=path.join(dir,'state','backlog.json');
  const opsFile=path.join(dir,'ops.json');
  try{
    fs.writeFileSync(opsFile,JSON.stringify([{op:'propose',actor:'heinz',at:1,task:{id:'task-square',title:'square() korrigieren',kind:'REPAIR',source:'cli'}}]));
    await backlogCommand('apply',{file,ops:opsFile},{root:dir,log:silent});
    await backlogCommand('accept',{file,id:'task-square'},{root:dir,log:silent});
    const {token}=await backlogCommand('claim',{file,owner:'claude'},{root:dir,log:silent});
    // the work: a patch, written next to the checkout
    fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir,'.github/continuum/math.mjs'),"export const square=x=>x*x;\n");
    const patch=path.join(dir,'fix.patch');
    fs.writeFileSync(patch,g('diff','--binary')+'\n');
    g('checkout','--','.');
    await backlogCommand('submit',{file,id:'task-square',token,patch},{root:dir,log:silent});
    // a different file is not the submitted artifact
    const other=path.join(dir,'other.patch');fs.writeFileSync(other,'diff --git a/x b/x\n');
    await assert.rejects(backlogCommand('verify',{file,id:'task-square',base,chain:'node',patch:other},{root:dir,log:silent}),/not the submitted artifact/);
    const lines=[];
    const r=await backlogCommand('verify',{file,id:'task-square',base,chain:'node',patch},{root:dir,log:m=>lines.push(m)});
    assert.equal(r.results[0].ok,true,lines.join('\n'));
    const task=r.doc.tasks[0];
    assert.equal(task.state,'DONE');
    assert.deepEqual(task.evidence[0].profiles.map(p=>[p.profile,p.passed,p.executed,p.failed]),[['node-continuum',true,1,0]]);
    assert.equal(task.evidence[0].artifactSha256,B.sha256Hex(fs.readFileSync(patch)));
    assert.match(fs.readFileSync(path.join(dir,'.github/continuum/math.mjs'),'utf8'),/x\+x/,'the checkout itself is never modified');
    assert.equal(g('worktree','list','--porcelain').split('\n').filter(l=>l.startsWith('worktree ')).length,1,'no leftover worktree');
  }finally{fs.rmSync(dir,{recursive:true,force:true});}
});

test('backlog CLI: a patch that fails the checks records failing evidence and returns the task',{skip:nested},async()=>{
  const {dir,g,base}=repo();
  const file=path.join(dir,'backlog.json');
  try{
    await backlogCommand('apply',{file,ops:(fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir,'ops.json'),JSON.stringify([
      {op:'propose',actor:'heinz',at:1,task:{id:'task-square',title:'square',kind:'REPAIR',source:'cli'}},{op:'accept',actor:'heinz',at:2,id:'task-square'}])),path.join(dir,'ops.json'))},{root:dir,log:silent});
    const {token}=await backlogCommand('claim',{file,id:'task-square',owner:'claude'},{root:dir,log:silent});
    fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir,'.github/continuum/math.mjs'),"export const square=x=>x*4;\n");
    const patch=path.join(dir,'wrong.patch');fs.writeFileSync(patch,g('diff','--binary')+'\n');g('checkout','--','.');
    await backlogCommand('submit',{file,id:'task-square',token,patch},{root:dir,log:silent});
    const r=await backlogCommand('verify',{file,id:'task-square',base,chain:'node',patch},{root:dir,log:silent});
    const task=r.doc.tasks[0];
    assert.deepEqual([task.state,task.error.code,task.evidence[0].profiles[0].failed],['READY','CHECKS_FAILED',1]);
  }finally{fs.rmSync(dir,{recursive:true,force:true});}
});

  await assert.rejects(backlogCommand('nope',{file:path.join(os.tmpdir(),'never-created-backlog.json')}),/Unknown backlog command/);

test('state branch: backlog is saved with compare-and-swap, reloaded, and unreadable state fails closed',()=>{
  const originDir=fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(),'backlog-origin-'));
  const {dir,g}=repo();
  try{
    spawnSync('git',['init','-q','--bare',originDir]);
    g('remote','add','origin',originDir);
    assert.deepEqual(loadBacklogFromBranch(dir),{doc:null,remoteHead:null},'a missing state branch is empty state');
    const propose={op:'propose',actor:'continuum-agent',at:1,task:{id:'task-one',title:'Eins',kind:'TEST',source:'cli'}};
    const saved=saveBacklogToBranch(dir,STATE_BRANCH,doc=>({doc:B.applyOp(doc,propose).doc,results:[]}));
    assert.deepEqual([saved.status,saved.revision],['SAVED',1]);
    const again=saveBacklogToBranch(dir,STATE_BRANCH,doc=>({doc,results:[]}));
    assert.equal(again.status,'UNCHANGED');
    const loaded=loadBacklogFromBranch(dir);
    assert.equal(loaded.doc.tasks[0].id,'task-one');
    const files=spawnSync('git',['ls-tree','--name-only',loaded.remoteHead],{cwd:dir,encoding:'utf8'}).stdout.trim().split('\n').sort();
    assert.deepEqual(files,['README.md','development-backlog.json']);
    assert.throws(()=>saveBacklogToBranch(dir,'main',d=>({doc:d})),/must be continuum-agent-state/);
    g('remote','set-url','origin',path.join(originDir,'does-not-exist'));
    assert.throws(()=>loadBacklogFromBranch(dir),/Cannot read state branch/,'unreachable state is an error, not "empty"');
  }finally{fs.rmSync(dir,{recursive:true,force:true});fs.rmSync(originDir,{recursive:true,force:true});}
});

/** Run a case with this implementation; returns per-step outcomes and the final document. */
export function runCase(c){
  let doc=B.emptyDocument(c.start.at,c.start.actor);
  const outcomes=c.steps.map(s=>{
    try{doc=B.applyOp(doc,s.op).doc;return 'ok';}
    catch(e){if(e instanceof B.BacklogError)return e.code;throw e;}
  });
  return {outcomes,doc};
}

export function conformance(){
  const cases=[lifecycle(),budgetAndInput(),boundedHistory(),boundedEvidence(),idempotentOps()].map(c=>{
    const {outcomes,doc}=runCase(c);
    outcomes.forEach((o,k)=>{if(o!==c.steps[k].expect)throw Error(`${c.name} step ${k}: expected ${c.steps[k].expect}, got ${o}`);});
    return {...c,final:{revision:doc.revision,integrity:B.integrityOf(doc),
      states:Object.fromEntries(doc.tasks.map(t=>[t.id,t.state]))}};
  });
  return {name:'continuum-development-backlog conformance',schemaVersion:B.SCHEMA_VERSION,cases};
}

const canonicalWithIntegrity=doc=>{const {integrity,...rest}=doc;return Buffer.from(B.canonical({...rest,integrity:B.integrityOf(rest)})+'\n','utf8');};

/** All fixture files as {name: Buffer}; `write` stores them, the tests compare. */
export function fixtureFiles(){
  const files={};
  const conf=conformance();
  files['conformance.json']=Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(conf,null,1)+'\n','utf8');
  const valid=runCase(lifecycle()).doc;
  files['valid-v2.json']=B.encodeDocument(valid);
  const unknown=structuredClone(valid);
  unknown.futureFeature={flags:[1,'x',true,null],nested:{k:'v'}};
  unknown.tasks.find(t=>t.id==='task-gamma').note='bleibt erhalten';
  files['unknown-fields.json']=B.encodeDocument(unknown);
  const v1=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(FIXTURE_DIR,'v1-planner.json'),'utf8'));
  files['v1-migrated.json']=B.encodeDocument(B.migrateV1(v1,{at:1700000000000,actor:'migration'}));
  const text=files['valid-v2.json'].toString('utf8');
  const invalid=[];
  const add=(name,bytes,code)=>{files[name]=Buffer.isBuffer(bytes)?bytes:Buffer.from(bytes,'utf8');invalid.push({file:name,code});};
  add('invalid-duplicate-key.json',text.replace('{"integrity"','{"revision":1,"integrity"'),'CORRUPT');
  add('invalid-float.json',text.replace('"priority":900','"priority":900.5'),'CORRUPT');
  add('invalid-integrity.json',text.replace('Integrationstest','Integrationstext'),'INTEGRITY_MISMATCH');
  add('invalid-utf8.json',Buffer.concat([Buffer.from(text.slice(0,40),'utf8'),Buffer.from([0xc3,0x28]),Buffer.from(text.slice(40),'utf8')]),'CORRUPT');
  add('invalid-bom.json',Buffer.concat([Buffer.from([0xef,0xbb,0xbf]),files['valid-v2.json']]),'CORRUPT');
  add('invalid-trailing.json',text.trimEnd()+'x\n','CORRUPT');
  add('invalid-lone-surrogate.json',text.replace('Viele','\\ud800').replace('Integrationstest','Integr\\ud800tionstest'),'CORRUPT');
  const mutated=(change)=>{const d=structuredClone(valid);change(d);return canonicalWithIntegrity(d);};
  add('invalid-future-version.json',mutated(d=>{d.schemaVersion=3;}),'UNSUPPORTED_VERSION');
  add('invalid-state.json',mutated(d=>{d.tasks[1].state='WORKING';}),'CORRUPT');
  add('invalid-done-without-evidence.json',mutated(d=>{const t=d.tasks[1];t.state='DONE';t.submission={token:T(4),by:'x',at:1,artifact:{type:'PATCH',sha256:S('d')}};}),'CORRUPT');
  add('invalid-forged-evidence.json',mutated(d=>{d.tasks[0].evidence=d.tasks[0].evidence.map(e=>({...e,profiles:[{...e.profiles[0],executed:0}]}));}),'CORRUPT');
  add('invalid-cycle.json',mutated(d=>{d.tasks[0].dependsOn=['task-beta'];}),'CORRUPT');
  add('invalid-unsorted.json',mutated(d=>{d.tasks.reverse();}),'CORRUPT');
  add('invalid-claim-outside-progress.json',mutated(d=>{d.tasks[1].claim={owner:'x',token:T(1),at:1,leaseUntil:2};}),'CORRUPT');
  add('invalid-not-backlog.json','{"schema":"something-else","schemaVersion":2}\n','CORRUPT');
  files['invalid.json']=Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(invalid,null,1)+'\n','utf8');
  files['roundtrip.json']=Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(roundtripKotlinPlan(),null,1)+'\n','utf8');
  const tmp=fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(),'backlog-fixture-'));
  try{
    const prepared=roundtripPrepare(tmp);
    files['roundtrip-node.json']=fs.readFileSync(path.join(tmp,'backlog.json'));
    files['roundtrip-node-state.json']=Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(prepared.state)+'\n','utf8');
  }finally{fs.rmSync(tmp,{recursive:true,force:true});}
  return files;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Cross-runtime round trip: Node prepares, Kotlin changes, Node verifies.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
export const ROUNDTRIP={nodeActor:'node-roundtrip',kotlinActor:'android-roundtrip'};

export function roundtripPrepare(dir){
  fs.mkdirSync(dir,{recursive:true});
  const file=path.join(dir,'backlog.json');
  for(const f of fs.readdirSync(dir))if(f.startsWith('backlog.json'))fs.rmSync(path.join(dir,f));
  const store=new B.BacklogStore(file,{actor:ROUNDTRIP.nodeActor,clock:()=>1_800_000_000_000});
  const at=1_800_000_000_000;
  const r=store.apply([
    {op:'propose',actor:'node-roundtrip',at,task:{id:'rt-repair',title:'Rundreise: Reparatur – Ünïcödé ✓ 𝄞',kind:'REPAIR',source:'repair-loop',priority:900}},
    {op:'propose',actor:'node-roundtrip',at,task:{id:'rt-follow',title:'Rundreise: Folgeaufgabe',kind:'IMPLEMENT',source:'cli',dependsOn:['rt-repair']}},
    {op:'propose',actor:'node-roundtrip',at,task:{id:'rt-investigate',title:'Rundreise: Befund prüfen',kind:'INVESTIGATE',source:'code-analyzer',priority:230,
      subject:{file:'app/src/main/java/a/B.kt',symbol:'a.B',confidence:'medium'}}},
    {op:'accept',actor:'heinz',at:at+1,id:'rt-repair'},
    {op:'accept',actor:'heinz',at:at+1,id:'rt-follow'},
    {op:'claim',actor:'node-roundtrip',at:at+2,id:'rt-repair',owner:'node-roundtrip',token:T(0xabc),leaseMs:3_600_000},
    {op:'submit',actor:'node-roundtrip',at:at+3,id:'rt-repair',token:T(0xabc),artifact:{type:'PATCH',sha256:S('1')}}
  ]);
  // an unknown field written by a newer Node version must survive the Kotlin rewrite
  const withUnknown=store.update(doc=>({...doc,revision:doc.revision+1,roundtripMarker:{writtenBy:'node',items:[1,2,3]}}));
  const state={revision:withUnknown.doc.revision,integrity:withUnknown.doc.integrity};
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir,'node-state.json'),JSON.stringify(state)+'\n');
  return {state,results:r.results};
}

/**
 * What the Kotlin side does (DevelopmentBacklogRoundtripTest.kt reads this from
 * roundtrip.json): `ops` through DevelopmentBacklogStore, then it writes `opLog`
 * with its own canonical writer to kotlin-ops.json for Node to apply.
 */
export function roundtripKotlinPlan(){
  const at=1_800_000_100_000;
  return {
    ops:[
      {op:'complete',actor:ROUNDTRIP.kotlinActor,at,id:'rt-repair',evidence:{...evidence('rt-repair',T(0xabc),S('1'),{at,executed:412,profile:'android-unit'}),chain:'android'}},
      {op:'claim',actor:ROUNDTRIP.kotlinActor,at:at+1,id:'rt-follow',owner:ROUNDTRIP.kotlinActor,token:T(0xdef),leaseMs:3_600_000},

/** JavaScript stand-in for the Kotlin side, used to test the verifier itself. */
export function roundtripSimulateKotlin(dir){

}

export function roundtripVerify(dir){
  const file=path.join(dir,'backlog.json');
  const node=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(dir,'node-state.json'),'utf8'));
  const kotlin=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(dir,'kotlin-state.json'),'utf8'));
  const bytes=fs.readFileSync(file);
  const {doc}=B.decodeDocument(bytes);
  const problems=[];
  const expect=(ok,message)=>{if(!ok)problems.push(message);};
  expect(B.encodeDocument(doc).equals(bytes),'Kotlin output is not byte-identical to the canonical Node encoding');
  expect(doc.integrity===kotlin.integrity,'integrity differs from what Kotlin reported');
  expect(doc.revision===node.revision+KOTLIN_EXPECTED.revisionDelta,`revision ${doc.revision}, expected ${node.revision}+${KOTLIN_EXPECTED.revisionDelta}`);
  for(const [id,state] of Object.entries(KOTLIN_EXPECTED.states))expect(doc.tasks.find(t=>t.id===id)?.state===state,`${id} should be ${state}`);
  expect(doc.roundtripMarker?.writtenBy==='node'&&JSON.stringify(doc.roundtripMarker.items)==='[1,2,3]','unknown field lost');
  expect(doc.tasks.find(t=>t.id==='rt-repair')?.title==='Rundreise: Reparatur – Ünïcödé ✓ 𝄞','UTF-8 title changed');
  expect(doc.tasks.find(t=>t.id==='rt-android')?.title==='Vom Gerät: Größenprüfung 📱','Kotlin UTF-8 title changed');
  expect(!fs.existsSync(file+'.lock'),'lock file left behind');
  expect(!fs.readdirSync(dir).some(f=>f.includes('.tmp-')),'temporary file left behind');
  // operations recorded by Kotlin are applied with the same rules here
  const ops=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(dir,'kotlin-ops.json'),'utf8'));
  const store=new B.BacklogStore(file,{actor:ROUNDTRIP.nodeActor});
  const applied=store.apply(ops,{stopOnError:false});
  const codes=applied.results.map(r=>r.ok?'ok':r.code);
  expect(JSON.stringify(codes)===JSON.stringify(['ok','INVALID_TRANSITION','ok']),'Kotlin op log results '+JSON.stringify(codes));
  expect(applied.doc.tasks.find(t=>t.id==='rt-android')?.state==='READY','op log did not accept rt-android');
  expect(applied.doc.revision===doc.revision+2,'op log revision');
  return {problems,revision:applied.doc.revision};
}

  if(cmd==='write'){

  }else{console.error('usage: backlog-fixtures.mjs write | roundtrip-prepare <dir> | roundtrip-verify <dir>');process.exitCode=2;}
}
