import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import {tokenize} from './kotlin-tokenizer.mjs';

/**
 * Read-only structural Kotlin analysis (no execution of repository code).
 *
 * Builds a symbol index from a real lexer (comments and string text are not
 * references; ${...} templates are), resolves type names through package,
 * explicit/star imports and default imports, links each reference to its
 * enclosing declaration and computes reachability from Android entry points
 * declared in AndroidManifest.xml (production) and from test classes.
 *
 * Name resolution is NOT type inference: member calls (`x.foo()`) resolve by
 * name to every member called `foo`. That over-approximates reachability, so
 * an UNREFERENCED/TEST_ONLY finding is evidence, never proof.
 */
const MAX_FILES=3000, MAX_BYTES=400000;
const DECL_KW=new Set(['class','interface','object','fun','val','var','typealias']);
const MODIFIERS=new Set(['private','protected','internal','public','override','open','abstract','final','data','enum',
 'sealed','inner','companion','inline','suspend','operator','infix','tailrec','external','const','lateinit','annotation',
 'value','expect','actual','vararg','crossinline','noinline','reified','fun']);

function declarationName(tokens,k){
  // tokens[k] is the declaration keyword; skip generics and receivers to the name.
  const kw=tokens[k].text;let j=k+1;
  if(tokens[j]?.text==='<'){let d=0;for(;j<tokens.length;j++){if(tokens[j].text==='<')d++;else if(tokens[j].text==='>'){d--;if(d===0){j++;break;}}}}
  if(kw==='val'||kw==='var'){
    if(tokens[j]?.text==='(')return null; // destructuring
  }
  if(kw==='fun'||kw==='val'||kw==='var'){
    // receiver: Type. or Type<..>. before the name
    let last=j;
    for(let m=j;m<tokens.length&&m<j+40;m++){
      const t=tokens[m];
      if(t.type==='id'&&tokens[m+1]?.text==='.'){last=m+2;continue;}
      if(t.text==='<'){let d=0;for(;m<tokens.length;m++){if(tokens[m].text==='<')d++;else if(tokens[m].text==='>'){d--;if(d===0)break;}}if(tokens[m+1]?.text==='.'){last=m+2;continue;}break;}
      if(t.text==='?'&&tokens[m+1]?.text==='.'){last=m+2;continue;}
      break;
    }
    j=last;
  }
  const t=tokens[j];
  return t&&t.type==='id'?{name:t.text,index:j}:null;
}

/** Parse one Kotlin file into package, imports, declarations and references. */
export function indexFile(file){
  const tokens=tokenize(file.content);
  let pkg='';const imports=[];const declarations=[];const references=[];
  const scope=[];// {decl, depth}
  let depth=0,paren=0;let pendingDecl=null;const declNameIdx=new Set();
  for(let k=0;k<tokens.length;k++){
    const t=tokens[k];
    if(t.type==='kw'&&t.text==='package'&&depth===0){
      const parts=[];let j=k+1;
      for(;tokens[j]&&tokens[j].line===t.line;j++)if(tokens[j].type==='id'||tokens[j].type==='kw')parts.push(tokens[j].text);
      pkg=parts.join('.');k=j-1;continue;
    }
    if(t.type==='kw'&&t.text==='import'&&depth===0){
      const parts=[];let star=false,alias=null;let j=k+1;
      for(;tokens[j]&&tokens[j].line===t.line;j++){
        const x=tokens[j];
        if(x.text==='as'&&tokens[j+1]?.type==='id'){alias=tokens[j+1].text;j++;continue;}
        if(x.text==='*')star=true;
        else if(x.type==='id'||x.type==='kw')parts.push(x.text);
      }
      imports.push({path:parts.join('.'),star,alias,line:t.line});k=j-1;continue;
    }
    if(t.type==='op'&&t.text==='('){paren++;continue;}
    if(t.type==='op'&&t.text===')'){paren=Math.max(0,paren-1);continue;}
    if(t.type==='op'&&t.text==='{'){
      depth++;
      // braces inside a header's parentheses are default-value lambdas, not the body
      if(pendingDecl&&paren===pendingDecl.paren){scope.push({decl:pendingDecl,depth});pendingDecl=null;}
      continue;
    }
    if(t.type==='op'&&t.text==='}'){
      if(scope.length&&scope[scope.length-1].depth===depth)scope.pop();
      depth=Math.max(0,depth-1);if(pendingDecl&&paren===pendingDecl.paren)pendingDecl=null;continue;
    }
    if(t.type==='kw'&&DECL_KW.has(t.text)){
      // `fun interface X`, `companion object` without name, `object :` expressions
      if(t.text==='fun'&&tokens[k+1]?.text==='interface')continue;
      const found=declarationName(tokens,k);
      if(t.text==='object'&&(!found||tokens[k+1]?.text===':'||tokens[k+1]?.text==='{'))continue;
      if(!found)continue;
      // a property at the header's nesting level ends a body-less class/fun header
      if((t.text==='val'||t.text==='var')&&pendingDecl&&paren===pendingDecl.paren)pendingDecl=null;
      const mods=new Set();for(let m=k-1;m>=0&&m>=k-8;m--){if((tokens[m].type==='kw'||tokens[m].type==='id')&&MODIFIERS.has(tokens[m].text))mods.add(tokens[m].text);else if(tokens[m].type==='annotation'){mods.add('@'+tokens[m].text);}else break;}
      // constructor properties belong to the class whose header is still open
      const header=pendingDecl&&['class','enum'].includes(pendingDecl.kind)&&paren>pendingDecl.paren?pendingDecl:null;
      const container=header??(scope.length?scope[scope.length-1].decl:null);
      // locals inside function bodies are not part of the API graph
      if(container&&container.kind==='fun'&&t.text!=='class'&&t.text!=='object'&&t.text!=='interface')continue;
      const kind=t.text==='typealias'?'typealias':t.text;
      const decl={name:found.name,kind:mods.has('enum')?'enum':kind,file:file.path,package:pkg,line:t.line,
        container:container?container.qualified:null,qualified:(container?container.qualified:(pkg?pkg+'.':''))+(container?'.':'')+found.name,
        override:mods.has('override'),visibility:mods.has('private')?'private':mods.has('internal')?'internal':'public',
        annotations:[...mods].filter(x=>x.startsWith('@')).map(x=>x.slice(1)),test:/(^|\/)test\//.test(file.path)};
      declarations.push(decl);declNameIdx.add(found.index);
      if(['class','interface','object','enum','fun'].includes(decl.kind)){pendingDecl=decl;decl.paren=paren;}
      continue;
    }
    if(t.type==='op'&&(t.text==='='||t.text===';')&&pendingDecl&&pendingDecl.kind==='fun'&&paren===pendingDecl.paren){
      // expression-bodied function: treat the rest of the line as its body
      const decl=pendingDecl;pendingDecl=null;const lineNo=t.line;
      for(let m=k+1;m<tokens.length&&tokens[m].line===lineNo;m++){
        if(tokens[m].type==='id')references.push({name:tokens[m].text,line:tokens[m].line,col:tokens[m].col,from:decl.qualified,qualifier:tokens[m-1]?.text==='.'||tokens[m-1]?.text==='::'?tokens[m-2]?.text:null});
      }
    }
    if(t.type==='id'&&!declNameIdx.has(k)){
      const owner=scope.length?scope[scope.length-1].decl.qualified:null;
      references.push({name:t.text,line:t.line,col:t.col,from:owner,qualifier:tokens[k-1]?.text==='.'||tokens[k-1]?.text==='::'?tokens[k-2]?.text:null});
    }
    if(t.type==='annotation'){
      references.push({name:t.text,line:t.line,col:t.col,from:scope.length?scope[scope.length-1].decl.qualified:null,qualifier:null});
    }
  }
  return {path:file.path,package:pkg,imports,declarations,references};
}

const DEFAULT_IMPORT_PREFIXES=['kotlin','kotlin.collections','kotlin.io','kotlin.text','kotlin.ranges','kotlin.sequences','java.lang'];

/** Index all files and resolve references to declarations. */
export function buildIndex(files){
  if(files.length>MAX_FILES)throw Error('Too many source files');
  const parsed=[];
  for(const file of files){
    if(!file.path.endsWith('.kt')||file.content.length>MAX_BYTES)continue;
    parsed.push(indexFile(file));
  }
  const byName=new Map();const byQualified=new Map();
  for(const f of parsed)for(const d of f.declarations){
    if(!byName.has(d.name))byName.set(d.name,[]);
    byName.get(d.name).push(d);byQualified.set(d.qualified,d);
  }
  const edges=new Map();// from qualified (or file:<path>) -> Set(qualified)
  const incoming=new Map();
  const addEdge=(from,to)=>{if(from===to)return;if(!edges.has(from))edges.set(from,new Set());edges.get(from).add(to);
    if(!incoming.has(to))incoming.set(to,new Set());incoming.get(to).add(from);};
  for(const f of parsed){
    const explicit=new Map();const stars=[];
    for(const imp of f.imports){
      if(imp.star)stars.push(imp.path);
      else explicit.set(imp.alias??imp.path.split('.').pop(),imp.path);
    }
    for(const ref of f.references){
      const candidates=byName.get(ref.name);if(!candidates)continue;
      const from=ref.from??('file:'+f.path);
      const imported=explicit.get(ref.name);
      let targets;
      if(imported)targets=candidates.filter(d=>d.qualified===imported||d.qualified.startsWith(imported+'.'));
      else{
        targets=candidates.filter(d=>{
          if(d.container)return true; // member or nested: name-based over-approximation
          if(d.package===f.package)return true;
          if(stars.includes(d.package))return true;
          return false;
        });
        // a reference qualified by a known type name narrows to that container
        if(ref.qualifier){const narrowed=targets.filter(d=>d.container&&d.container.split('.').pop()===ref.qualifier);if(narrowed.length)targets=narrowed;}
      }
      if(targets.length===0&&!imported){
        // fully qualified usage such as at.heinz.deviceai.learning.Foo(...)
        targets=candidates.filter(d=>!d.container&&ref.qualifier&&d.package.split('.').pop()===ref.qualifier);
      }
      for(const d of targets)addEdge(from,d.qualified);
    }
  }
  // Structural edges: a container keeps its overrides (called by framework or
  // interface dispatch), constructors' init blocks, and its companion members.
  for(const f of parsed)for(const d of f.declarations){
    if(d.container&&(d.override||d.kind==='object'))addEdge(d.container,d.qualified);
    if(d.container&&d.annotations.includes('Test'))addEdge(d.container,d.qualified);
    if(d.container)addEdge(d.qualified,d.container); // using a member needs its owner
  }
  return {files:parsed,byName,byQualified,edges,incoming};
}

/** AndroidManifest components (activities, services, providers, receivers). */
export function manifestRoots(xml,namespace){
  const roots=[];
  for(const m of xml.matchAll(/<(activity|service|provider|receiver)\b[^>]*?android:name="([^"]+)"/g)){
    const name=m[2].startsWith('.')?namespace+m[2]:m[2];
    roots.push({component:m[1],name});
  }
  return roots;
}

export function reachable(index,roots){
  const seen=new Set();const queue=[];
  for(const r of roots)if(index.byQualified.has(r)||r.startsWith('file:')){seen.add(r);queue.push(r);}
  while(queue.length){
    const cur=queue.shift();
    for(const next of index.edges.get(cur)??[])if(!seen.has(next)){seen.add(next);queue.push(next);}
  }
  return seen;
}

/** Shortest reference chain between two declarations (qualified or simple names). */
export function callChain(index,from,to,{maxDepth=24}={}){
  const resolve=name=>index.byQualified.has(name)?[name]:(index.byName.get(name.split('.').pop())??[])
    .filter(d=>d.qualified.endsWith(name)).map(d=>d.qualified);
  const sources=resolve(from),targets=new Set(resolve(to));
  if(!sources.length||!targets.size)return null;
  const prev=new Map();const queue=sources.map(s=>[s,0]);sources.forEach(s=>prev.set(s,null));
  while(queue.length){
    const [cur,d]=queue.shift();
    if(targets.has(cur)){const chain=[];for(let x=cur;x!==null;x=prev.get(x))chain.unshift(x);
      return chain.map(q=>{const decl=index.byQualified.get(q);return {symbol:q,file:decl?.file,line:decl?.line};});}
    if(d>=maxDepth)continue;
    for(const next of index.edges.get(cur)??[])if(!prev.has(next)){prev.set(next,cur);queue.push([next,d+1]);}
  }
  return null;
}

/**
 * Integration findings. Production roots: manifest components plus `fun main`
 * research tools. Test roots: declarations in /test/ sources.
 *   UNREFERENCED  no reference from anywhere (high confidence)
 *   TEST_ONLY     only reachable from tests, not from any app entry point (medium)
 *   DEAD_CLUSTER  referenced, but only from other unreachable code (medium)
 */
export function integrationFindings(index,{productionRoots=[]}={}){
  const all=[...index.byQualified.values()];
  const fileRoots=index.files.filter(f=>/(^|\/)test\//.test(f.path)).map(f=>'file:'+f.path);
  const testRoots=[...all.filter(d=>d.test).map(d=>d.qualified),...fileRoots];
  const mains=all.filter(d=>d.kind==='fun'&&d.name==='main'&&!d.container&&!d.test).map(d=>d.qualified);
  const prod=reachable(index,[...productionRoots,...mains]);
  const tests=reachable(index,testRoots);
  const findings=[];
  for(const d of all){
    if(d.test||d.container||prod.has(d.qualified))continue; // top-level production declarations only
    const refs=[...(index.incoming.get(d.qualified)??[])].filter(x=>x!==d.qualified);
    const kind=refs.length===0?'UNREFERENCED':tests.has(d.qualified)?'TEST_ONLY':'DEAD_CLUSTER';
    findings.push({kind,symbol:d.qualified,declaration:d.kind,file:d.file,line:d.line,
      confidence:kind==='UNREFERENCED'?'high':'medium',referencedBy:refs.slice(0,6),
      note:'Static name resolution; reflection, manifests outside this scan and dynamic class names are not modeled.'});
  }
  findings.sort((a,b)=>a.kind.localeCompare(b.kind)||a.file.localeCompare(b.file)||a.line-b.line);
  return {productionReachable:prod.size,testReachable:tests.size,findings};
}

/** Backwards-compatible entry used by the existing workflow and tests. */
export function analyzeSources(files,{productionRoots=null}={}){
  if(files.length>MAX_FILES)throw Error('Too many source files');
  const index=buildIndex(files);
  const declarations=[...index.byQualified.values()];
  let findings;
  if(productionRoots){
    findings=integrationFindings(index,{productionRoots}).findings;
  }else{
    // Without entry points only "no references at all" is meaningful.
    findings=declarations.filter(d=>!d.test&&!d.container&&!(index.incoming.get(d.qualified)?.size))
      .map(d=>({kind:'POSSIBLY_UNUSED',symbol:d.name,qualified:d.qualified,definedIn:[d.file],line:d.line,confidence:'low',
        note:'No references found; reflection, DI, manifests and resources may still use this declaration.'}));
  }
  return {schemaVersion:2,filesAnalyzed:index.files.length,declarations:declarations.length,findings:findings.slice(0,400)};
}

export function collectKotlin(root){
  const files=[],stack=[root];
  while(stack.length){
    const dir=stack.pop();
    for(const entry of fs.readdirSync(dir,{withFileTypes:true})){
      if(entry.isSymbolicLink())continue;
      const full=path.join(dir,entry.name);
      if(entry.isDirectory()){if(entry.name!=='build'&&!entry.name.startsWith('.'))stack.push(full);}
      else if(entry.isFile()&&entry.name.endsWith('.kt')){
        if(files.length>=MAX_FILES)throw Error('Source file limit exceeded');
        if(fs.statSync(full).size<=MAX_BYTES)
          files.push({path:path.relative(root,full).replaceAll(path.sep,'/'),content:fs.readFileSync(full,'utf8')});
      }
    }
  }
  return files.sort((a,b)=>a.path.localeCompare(b.path));
}

export function analyzeRepository(root){
  const src=path.join(root,'app/src');
  const files=collectKotlin(src);
  const manifestFile=path.join(src,'main/AndroidManifest.xml');
  const gradle=fs.existsSync(path.join(root,'app/build.gradle.kts'))?fs.readFileSync(path.join(root,'app/build.gradle.kts'),'utf8'):'';
  const namespace=(gradle.match(/namespace\s*=\s*"([^"]+)"/)??[])[1]??'';
  const roots=fs.existsSync(manifestFile)?manifestRoots(fs.readFileSync(manifestFile,'utf8'),namespace):[];
  const index=buildIndex(files);
  const integration=integrationFindings(index,{productionRoots:roots.map(r=>r.name)});
  return {schemaVersion:2,filesAnalyzed:index.files.length,declarations:index.byQualified.size,
    entryPoints:roots,...integration,index};
}

if(process.argv[1]&&import.meta.url===new URL('file://'+process.argv[1]).href){
  const args=process.argv.slice(2);
  const chainAt=args.indexOf('--chain');
  // the two symbols after --chain are not the repository path (without --chain every positional argument may be)
  const chainArgs=chainAt>=0?[chainAt+1,chainAt+2]:[];
  const root=path.resolve(args.find((a,i)=>!a.startsWith('--')&&!chainArgs.includes(i))??'.');

  }

test('finds candidate orphan but not referenced class',()=>{

// Only the GitHub account owning this repository can issue state-changing
// console instructions. Web pages, issues and third-party comments have no authority.
export function isOwnerComment(repository, login) {
  if (typeof repository !== "string" || typeof login !== "string") return false;
  const parts=repository.split("/");
  if (parts.length!==2 || !parts[0] || !parts[1]) return false;
  const name=login.trim();
  return name.length>0 && name.toLowerCase()===parts[0].toLowerCase();
}

  assert.equal(isOwnerComment("Ullmann27/device-ai","ullmann27"),true);

    assert.equal(isOwnerComment("Ullmann27/device-ai",login),false);

test("evidence quality counters distinguish raw source attribution from explicit citations",()=>{
  let state=createBabyState(100);
  state=ingestEvidence(state,{
    query:"continual learning experience replay",
    answer:"Continual learning systems can use experience replay to rehearse stored examples across sequential tasks.",
    citations:[{url:"https://example.org/replay"}],uncertainty:.1,now:200
  }).baby;
  let status=babyStatus(state);
  assert.equal(status.explicitlyCited,0);
  assert.equal(status.unattributedOrLegacy,1);
  state=ingestEvidence(state,{
    query:"continual learning replay",
    answer:"Continual learning can use replay to reduce forgetting during sequential adaptation [1].",
    citations:[{url:"https://example.org/replay",title:"Learning replay"}],uncertainty:.05,now:210
  }).baby;
  status=babyStatus(state);
  assert.equal(status.beliefs,2);
  assert.equal(status.explicitlyCited,1);
  assert.equal(status.unattributedOrLegacy,1);
  assert.equal(migrateBabyState(state,300).beliefs.length,2);
});

// Pure fail-closed experimental gate. NEVER writes model weights or approves rollout.
import fs from 'node:fs';
export function assessContrastiveCandidate(generalization,retention){
 const reasons=[];
 const reject=why=>({status:'REJECTED',reasons:[why],automaticPromotion:false});
 if(generalization?.schema!==1||retention?.schema!==1||
    !Array.isArray(generalization.cases)||!Array.isArray(retention.cases))
    return reject('INVALID_EVIDENCE');
 const cases=generalization.cases,skills=retention.cases;
 const seeds=new Set(),domains=new Set(),drops=new Set(),seen=new Set();
 const deltas=[];
 for(const item of cases){
   if(!Number.isInteger(item.modelSeed)||typeof item.domain!=='string'||
      !Number.isFinite(item.drop)||
      ![item.beforeMRR,item.afterMRR,item.deltaMRR].every(Number.isFinite)||
      item.beforeMRR<=0||item.beforeMRR>1||item.afterMRR<=0||item.afterMRR>1||
      Math.abs(item.afterMRR-item.beforeMRR-item.deltaMRR)>1e-8)
      return reject('INVALID_RETRIEVAL_DATA');
   const id=[item.modelSeed,item.domain,item.drop].join(':');
   if(seen.has(id))return reject('DUPLICATE_CASE');
   seen.add(id);seeds.add(item.modelSeed);domains.add(item.domain);drops.add(item.drop);
   deltas.push(item.afterMRR-item.beforeMRR);
 }
 if(seeds.size<3||domains.size<3||drops.size<2||
   cases.length!==seeds.size*domains.size*drops.size)
   reasons.push('INSUFFICIENT_GENERALIZATION_COVERAGE');
 const mean=deltas.length?deltas.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)/deltas.length:0;
 if(mean<0.03)reasons.push('HOLDOUT_GAIN_INSUFFICIENT');
 if(deltas.some(d=>d< -0.01))reasons.push('HOLDOUT_REGRESSION');
 if(deltas.filter(d=>d>=0.01).length<Math.ceil(deltas.length*0.6))
   reasons.push('HOLDOUT_GAIN_NOT_CONSISTENT');
 for(const domain of domains){
   const ds=cases.filter(c=>c.domain===domain).map(c=>c.afterMRR-c.beforeMRR);
   if(!ds.length||ds.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)/ds.length<0.01){
     reasons.push('DOMAIN_GAIN_INSUFFICIENT:'+domain);
   }
 }
 const skillSeeds=new Set();
 for(const item of skills){
   if(!Number.isInteger(item.modelSeed)){reasons.push('INVALID_SKILL_DATA');break;}
   skillSeeds.add(item.modelSeed);
   for(const kind of ['intent','semantic']){
     const s=item[kind];
     if(!s || !Number.isInteger(s.total)||s.total<1 ||
       !Number.isInteger(s.beforeCorrect)||!Number.isInteger(s.afterCorrect)||
       s.beforeCorrect<0||s.afterCorrect<0||s.beforeCorrect>s.total||s.afterCorrect>s.total||
       !Number.isFinite(s.beforeLoss)||!Number.isFinite(s.afterLoss)||
       s.beforeLoss<0||s.afterLoss<0){
       reasons.push('INVALID_SKILL_DATA');break;
     }
     if(s.afterCorrect<s.beforeCorrect)reasons.push('SKILL_ACCURACY_REGRESSION');
     if(s.afterLoss>s.beforeLoss+0.015)reasons.push('SKILL_LOSS_REGRESSION');
   }
 }
 if(skillSeeds.size!==seeds.size||[...seeds].some(s=>!skillSeeds.has(s)) ||
    skills.length!==seeds.size)reasons.push('INCOMPLETE_RETENTION_EVIDENCE');
 // Eligibility is NEVER automatic promotion; an owner-controlled integration
 // must independently validate provenance and current model revision.
 return {
   status:reasons.length?'REJECTED':'REVIEW_REQUIRED',
   reasons:[...new Set(reasons)],
   automaticPromotion:false,
   meanHoldoutDelta:Number(mean.toFixed(12)),
   evaluatedRetrievalCases:cases.length,
   evaluatedSkillSeeds:skills.length
 };
}
if(process.argv[1]?.endsWith('contrastive-gate.mjs')){
 if(process.argv.length!==5)throw Error('Usage: gate GENERALIZATION_JSON RETENTION_JSON OUT_JSON');
 const general=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(process.argv[2],'utf8'));
 const retained=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(process.argv[3],'utf8'));
 const decision=assessContrastiveCandidate(general,retained);
 fs.writeFileSync(process.argv[4],JSON.stringify(decision,null,2)+'\n');
 console.log(JSON.stringify(decision,null,2));
}

// Fixed synthetic-corpus, multiple-seed generalization audit.
// Does not promote weights, download data or claim real-world improvement.
import fs from 'node:fs';
import {SubwordEncoder} from './portable-subword.mjs';
import {trainContrastiveCandidate,evaluateViews} from './contrastive-views.mjs';
export const TRAIN=[
 'sonnenlicht verwandelt pflanzen in chemische energie',
 'das getriebe uebertraegt drehmoment vom motor',
 'klavier noten rhythmen bilden eine melodie',
 'wolken kondensieren wasserdampf zu regen',
 'galaxien enthalten sterne staub und gas',
 'backen mischt mehl wasser und hefe',
 'metalle dehnen sich bei temperaturerhoehung aus',
 'mathematische gleichungen verbinden variablen'
];
export const HOLDOUTS={
 ecology:[
  'wurzel zieht naehrstoffe aus dem erdboden',
  'baeume produzieren sauerstoff durch photosynthese',
  'insekten bestaeuben pflanzen und blueten',
  'pilze zersetzen abgestorbene organische stoffe',
  'voegel bauen nester fuer ihren nachwuchs'
 ],
 communication:[
  'postbote verteilt briefe an wohnadressen',
  'funkwellen transportieren digitale nachrichten',
  'bibliotheken stellen geschriebene buecher bereit',
  'untertitel machen gesprochene worte lesbar',
  'telefongespraeche verbinden menschen auf distanz'
 ],
 geometry:[
  'dreiecke besitzen drei ecken und seiten',
  'kreisradius misst die distanz zum mittelpunkt',
  'quader besitzen sechs rechteckige flaechen',
  'winkel beschreiben die oeffnung zweier linien',
  'spiegelung erzeugt ein symmetrisches bild'
 ]
};
export const SEEDS=[11,73,191,337,557];
export const DROPS=[0.45,0.65,0.8];
const rounded=x=>Number(x.toFixed(12));
const summarize=xs=>({mean:rounded(xs.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)/xs.length),
  min:rounded(Math.min(...xs)),max:rounded(Math.max(...xs))});
export function auditGeneralization(){
 const cases=[],training=[];
 for(const modelSeed of SEEDS){
  const baseline=new SubwordEncoder(modelSeed),beforeBytes=baseline.save();
  // The selected validation corpus has no label or training overlap.
  const trained=trainContrastiveCandidate(baseline,TRAIN,HOLDOUTS.ecology,
    {steps:280,seed:modelSeed*101+4,drop:0.65,rate:0.08});
  if(trained.interrupted||trained.steps!==280)throw Error('Incomplete training');
  if(!baseline.save().equals(beforeBytes))throw Error('Baseline model mutated');
  training.push(rounded(trained.trainingAfter.reciprocalRank-trained.trainingBefore.reciprocalRank));
  for(const [name,items] of Object.entries(HOLDOUTS))for(const drop of DROPS){
   const viewSeed=131+Math.round(drop*100)+modelSeed*7;
   const before=evaluateViews(baseline,items,{seed:viewSeed,drop});
   const after=evaluateViews(trained.candidate,items,{seed:viewSeed,drop});
   cases.push({modelSeed,domain:name,drop,
     beforeMRR:rounded(before.reciprocalRank),
     afterMRR:rounded(after.reciprocalRank),
     deltaMRR:rounded(after.reciprocalRank-before.reciprocalRank),
     beforeTop1:before.top1,afterTop1:after.top1,total:after.total});
  }
 }
 const held=cases.map(c=>c.deltaMRR);
 return {
  schema:1,method:'synthetic-multiseed-masked-retrieval',
  modelSeeds:SEEDS,dropRates:DROPS,
  cases,summary:{caseCount:cases.length,
    trainingMrrChange:summarize(training),holdoutMrrChange:summarize(held),
    improved:cases.filter(c=>c.deltaMRR>0).length,
    unchanged:cases.filter(c=>c.deltaMRR===0).length,
    regressed:cases.filter(c=>c.deltaMRR<0).length},
  recommendation:'NOT_APPROVED_FOR_AUTOMATIC_PROMOTION',
  limitations:'Synthetic data and small holdouts; no real-world retrieval or knowledge improvement proved.'
 };
}
if(process.argv[1]?.endsWith('contrastive-generalization.mjs')){
 const result=auditGeneralization();
 console.log(JSON.stringify(result.summary,null,2));
 if(process.argv[2])fs.writeFileSync(process.argv[2],JSON.stringify(result,null,2)+'\n');
}

// Deterministic synthetic Node -> Kotlin -> Node trained-SWB1 parity protocol.
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import {SubwordEncoder} from './portable-subword.mjs';
import {trainContrastiveCandidate} from './contrastive-views.mjs';

const train=[
  'sonnenlicht bringt der pflanze energie',
  'motor getriebe bewegen das fahrzeug',
  'klavier gitarre und musik instrumente',
  'regen wolken feuchtigkeit wetter',
  'stern mond galaxie planeten',
  'backofen brot rezept und mehl'
];
const holdout=[
  'fluss wasser fließt durch ein tal',
  'arzt medizin hilft bei gesundheitsfragen',
  'computer tastatur monitor und bildschirm',
  'katze hund tiere auf dem bauernhof'
];
const EPS=1e-8;
const run=()=>trainContrastiveCandidate(
  new SubwordEncoder(91),train,holdout,{steps:350,seed:43,drop:0.65,rate:0.10}
);
const vals=r=>{
  const out={steps:r.steps,interrupted:String(r.interrupted)};
  for(const tag of ['trainingBefore','trainingAfter','validationBefore','validationAfter'])
    for(const metric of ['top1','total','reciprocalRank'])
      out[tag+'.'+metric]=r[tag][metric];
  return out;
};
const parse=file=>Object.fromEntries(fs.readFileSync(file,'utf8').trim().split('\n')
  .map(row=>{const i=row.indexOf('=');if(i<1)throw Error('Invalid metric');return [row.slice(0,i),row.slice(i+1)]}));
const file=(dir,name)=>path.join(dir,name);
export function main(command,dir){
  if(!dir||!['prepare','verify'].includes(command))throw Error('Usage: prepare|verify DIRECTORY');
  const r=run(),metrics=vals(r);
  if(command==='prepare'){
    fs.mkdirSync(dir,{recursive:true});
    fs.writeFileSync(file(dir,'node-candidate.swb1'),r.candidate.save());
    fs.writeFileSync(file(dir,'node-metrics.tsv'),
      Object.entries(metrics).map(([k,v])=>k+'='+v).join('\n')+'\n');
    console.log('Train MRR:',r.trainingBefore.reciprocalRank,'->',r.trainingAfter.reciprocalRank,
      'Holdout MRR:',r.validationBefore.reciprocalRank,'->',r.validationAfter.reciprocalRank);
    return;
  }
  const check=parse(file(dir,'kotlin-metrics.tsv'));
  if(Object.keys(check).length!==Object.keys(metrics).length)throw Error('Metric count mismatch');
  for(const [k,v] of Object.entries(metrics)){
    if(!(k in check))throw Error('Missing '+k);
    const good=typeof v==='number'?Number.isFinite(Number(check[k]))&&Math.abs(Number(check[k])-v)<=EPS:check[k]===v;
    if(!good)throw Error('Metric discrepancy '+k+': '+check[k]+' vs '+v);
  }
  const a=SubwordEncoder.restore(r.candidate.save());
  const b=SubwordEncoder.restore(fs.readFileSync(file(dir,'kotlin-candidate.swb1')));
  if(a.seed!==b.seed||a.updates!==b.updates)throw Error('Model provenance mismatch');
  let max=0;
  for(const key of ['embeddings','head']){
    if(a[key].length!==b[key].length)throw Error('Dimensions mismatch');
    for(let i=0;i<a[key].length;i++){
      const difference=Math.abs(a[key][i]-b[key][i]);
      if(!(difference<=EPS))throw Error('Weight mismatch '+key+'['+i+']');
      max=Math.max(max,difference);
    }
  }
  console.log('Cross-runtime parity verified:',a.embeddings.length+a.head.length,'weights, max error',max);
}
if(process.argv[1]?.endsWith('contrastive-parity.mjs'))main(process.argv[2],process.argv[3]);

 {text:'hallo guten morgen',label:0},
 {text:'servus bis bald',label:0},
 {text:'vielen dank auf wiedersehen',label:0}

 {left:'katze tier schnurrt',right:'eine katze ist ein tier',similar:true},
 {left:'regen wolke wasser',right:'wolken bringen regen',similar:true},
 {left:'musik klavier ton',right:'klavier erzeugt musik',similar:true},

const rnd=x=>Number(x.toFixed(12));
const details=(before,after)=>({
 beforeLoss:rnd(before.loss),afterLoss:rnd(after.loss),
 deltaLoss:rnd(after.loss-before.loss),
 beforeCorrect:before.correct,afterCorrect:after.correct,total:before.total
});
export function auditRetention(){
 const cases=[];
 for(const modelSeed of SEEDS){
   const baseline=new SubwordEncoder(modelSeed);
   // Represents previously trained skills before learning a new retrieval task.
   for(let step=0;step<240;step++)baseline.updateIntent(INTENTS[step%INTENTS.length],0.10);
   for(let step=0;step<240;step++)baseline.updateSemantic(SEMANTICS[step%SEMANTICS.length],0.08);
   const snapshot=baseline.save();
   const beforeIntent=baseline.evaluate(INTENTS);
   const beforeSemantic=baseline.evaluate(SEMANTICS);
   const trained=trainContrastiveCandidate(baseline,TRAIN,HOLDOUTS.ecology,
     {steps:280,seed:modelSeed*101+4,drop:0.65,rate:0.08});
   if(trained.interrupted || trained.steps!==280)throw Error('Incomplete contrastive adaptation');
   if(!baseline.save().equals(snapshot))throw Error('Pretrained baseline mutated');
   const afterIntent=trained.candidate.evaluate(INTENTS);
   const afterSemantic=trained.candidate.evaluate(SEMANTICS);
   cases.push({modelSeed,
     intent:details(beforeIntent,afterIntent),
     semantic:details(beforeSemantic,afterSemantic)});
 }
 const all=cases.flatMap(c=>[c.intent,c.semantic]);
 return {
  schema:1,method:'synthetic-pretrained-skills-retention',
  cases,summary:{
   seeds:SEEDS.length,
   evaluations:all.length,
   accuracyRegressions:all.filter(x=>x.afterCorrect<x.beforeCorrect).length,
   lossRegressions:all.filter(x=>x.deltaLoss>0.015).length,
   worstLossIncrease:rnd(Math.max(...all.map(x=>x.deltaLoss))),
   meanLossChange:rnd(all.reduce((a,x)=>a+x.deltaLoss,0)/all.length)
  },
  recommendation:'REQUIRE_RETENTION_GATE_BEFORE_PROMOTION',
  limitations:'Tiny synthetic old skills; behavior on owner memories is unmeasured.'
 };
}
if(process.argv[1]?.endsWith('contrastive-retention.mjs')){
 const report=auditRetention();
 console.log(JSON.stringify(report.summary,null,2));
 if(process.argv[2])fs.writeFileSync(process.argv[2],JSON.stringify(report,null,2)+'\n');
}

// Reproducible masked-view retrieval over the existing portable SWB1 encoder.
// Kotlin counterpart: ContinuumContrastiveViews.kt. No external model or network.
import {SubwordEncoder} from './portable-subword.mjs';

class Rng {
  constructor(seed) { this.state = Number(BigInt(seed) & 0xffffffffn) >>> 0; }
  next() {
    this.state = (Math.imul(this.state, 1664525) + 1013904223) >>> 0;
    return this.state / 4294967296;
  }
}
function words(text) {
  if (typeof text !== 'string' || text.length < 1 || text.length > 2048)
    throw Error('Invalid memory');
  const normalized = text.toLowerCase().replace(/[^\p{L}\p{N}]+/gu,' ').trim().slice(0,512);
  if (!normalized) throw Error('Empty memory');
  return normalized.split(' ').filter(Boolean);
}
function validate(memories) {
  if (!Array.isArray(memories) || memories.length < 2 || memories.length > 24)
    throw Error('Expected 2..24 memories');
  const normalized = memories.map(m => words(m).join(' '));
  if (new Set(normalized).size !== memories.length) throw Error('Duplicate memories');
}
function view(tokens,rng,drop) {
  const kept = tokens.filter(() => rng.next() >= drop);
  return (kept.length ? kept : [tokens[Math.min(tokens.length-1,Math.floor(rng.next()*tokens.length))]]).join(' ');
}
export function evaluateViews(model,memories,{seed=17,drop=0.65}={}) {
  if (!(model instanceof SubwordEncoder)) throw Error('Expected SWB1 encoder');
  validate(memories);
  if (!Number.isFinite(drop) || drop < 0 || drop > 0.95) throw Error('Invalid dropout');
  const rng = new Rng(seed);
  let top1 = 0, reciprocalRank = 0;
  for (let i=0;i<memories.length;i++) {
    const query = view(words(memories[i]),rng,drop);
    const scores = memories.map((m,j) => ({j,score:model.similarity(query,m)}));
    scores.sort((a,b) => b.score-a.score || a.j-b.j);
    const rank = scores.findIndex(x => x.j===i)+1;
    top1 += Number(rank===1);
    reciprocalRank += 1/rank;
  }
  return {reciprocalRank:reciprocalRank/memories.length,top1,total:memories.length};
}
/**
 * Positive: independently masked view and its original.
 * Negative: the same view and a different memory.
 * Does not mutate baseline or promote model weights. The caller must apply
 * task and frozen-holdout acceptance rules before persisting the candidate.
 */
export function trainContrastiveCandidate(
  baseline, memories, validation,
  {steps=240,seed=43,drop=0.65,rate=0.10,cancelled=()=>false}={}
) {
  if (!(baseline instanceof SubwordEncoder)) throw Error('Expected SWB1 encoder');
  validate(memories);validate(validation);
  if (!Number.isInteger(steps) || steps < 1 || steps > 500 ||
      !Number.isFinite(drop) || drop < 0 || drop > 0.95 ||
      !Number.isFinite(rate) || rate < 0.0001 || rate > 0.12 ||
      typeof cancelled !== 'function') throw Error('Invalid training limits');
  const trainKeys = new Set(memories.map(m => words(m).join(' ')));
  if (validation.some(m => trainKeys.has(words(m).join(' ')))) throw Error('Train/validation overlap');
  const candidate = SubwordEncoder.restore(baseline.save());
  const trainingBefore = evaluateViews(candidate,memories,{seed:17,drop});
  const validationBefore = evaluateViews(candidate,validation,{seed:29,drop});
  const tokenized = memories.map(words), rng = new Rng(seed);
  let completed = 0;
  for (;completed < steps && !cancelled();completed++) {
    const i = Math.min(memories.length-1,Math.floor(rng.next()*memories.length));
    const j = (i+1+Math.floor(rng.next()*(memories.length-1)))%memories.length;
    const noisy = view(tokenized[i],rng,drop);
    const pairs = [
      {left:noisy,right:memories[i],similar:true},
      {left:noisy,right:memories[j],similar:false}
    ];
    for (let k=0;k<2;k++) {
      if (cancelled()) return {
        candidate,steps:completed,interrupted:true,
        trainingBefore,trainingAfter:evaluateViews(candidate,memories,{seed:17,drop}),
        validationBefore,validationAfter:evaluateViews(candidate,validation,{seed:29,drop})
      };
      // Kotlin trainSemantic selects (updates+step)%2.
      const pair = pairs[candidate.updates%2];
      candidate.updateSemantic(pair,rate);
    }
  }
  return {
    candidate,steps:completed,interrupted:completed < steps,
    trainingBefore,trainingAfter:evaluateViews(candidate,memories,{seed:17,drop}),
    validationBefore,validationAfter:evaluateViews(candidate,validation,{seed:29,drop})
  };
}

import test from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import {SubwordEncoder} from './portable-subword.mjs';
import {evaluateViews,trainContrastiveCandidate} from './contrastive-views.mjs';

const train = [
  'sonnenlicht bringt der pflanze energie',
  'motor getriebe bewegen das fahrzeug',
  'klavier gitarre und musik instrumente',
  'regen wolken feuchtigkeit wetter',
  'stern mond galaxie planeten',
  'backofen brot rezept und mehl'
];
const holdout = [
  'fluss wasser fließt durch ein tal',
  'arzt medizin hilft bei gesundheitsfragen',
  'computer tastatur monitor und bildschirm',
  'katze hund tiere auf dem bauernhof'
];

test('contrastive view scores are deterministic, bounded and do not need network', () => {
  const model = new SubwordEncoder(73);
  assert.deepEqual(evaluateViews(model,train),evaluateViews(model,train));
  const s=evaluateViews(model,train);
  assert.ok(s.reciprocalRank>=1/train.length && s.reciprocalRank<=1);
  assert.ok(s.top1>=0 && s.top1<=train.length);
  assert.throws(()=>evaluateViews(model,['same text','SAME TEXT']));
  assert.throws(()=>evaluateViews(model,train,{drop:1}));
});

test('train uses the existing encoder and does not mutate baseline', () => {
  const baseline = new SubwordEncoder(91);
  const saved=baseline.save();
  const result=trainContrastiveCandidate(baseline,train,holdout,{steps:350});
  assert.equal(result.steps,350);
  assert.equal(result.interrupted,false);
  assert.equal(result.candidate.updates,700);
  assert.deepEqual(baseline.save(),saved);
  assert.notDeepEqual(result.candidate.save(),saved);
  assert.ok(result.trainingAfter.reciprocalRank>=1/train.length);
  assert.ok(Number.isFinite(result.validationAfter.reciprocalRank));
  const repeat=trainContrastiveCandidate(baseline,train,holdout,{steps:350});
  assert.deepEqual(repeat.candidate.save(),result.candidate.save());
});

test('cancellation and invalid training settings fail safely', () => {
  const baseline=new SubwordEncoder(11),saved=baseline.save();
  let count=0;
  const result=trainContrastiveCandidate(baseline,train,holdout,
    {steps:100,cancelled:()=>++count>7});
  assert.equal(result.interrupted,true);
  assert.ok(result.steps<100);
  assert.deepEqual(baseline.save(),saved);
  assert.throws(()=>trainContrastiveCandidate(baseline,train,train));
  assert.throws(()=>trainContrastiveCandidate(baseline,train,
    [train[0].toUpperCase(),holdout[0]]));
  assert.throws(()=>trainContrastiveCandidate(baseline,train,holdout,{steps:2000}));
});

import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';

/** Deterministic, no-LLM developer agent.
 * `triage` reads CI metadata only. The repair commands reproduce failures with
 * fixed check profiles, never execute log text, change sources only inside an
 * isolated git worktree and publish only to continuum-agent/* branches as
 * draft pull requests. They never push to development or default branches.
 */
export function triageRun(run, jobs=[]) {
  const id=Number(run.id);
  if(!Number.isSafeInteger(id)||id<=0)throw Error('Invalid run ID');
  const failed=jobs.flatMap(job=>(job.steps??[])
    .filter(step=>step.conclusion==='failure')
    .map(step=>({job:String(job.name??'').slice(0,80),step:String(step.name??'').slice(0,100)})));
  const conclusion=String(run.conclusion??'pending');
  const category=failed.some(x=>/test/i.test(x.step))?'TEST_FAILURE':
    failed.some(x=>/build|compile|gradle/i.test(x.step))?'BUILD_FAILURE':
    conclusion==='failure'?'WORKFLOW_FAILURE':conclusion==='success'?'PASS':'PENDING';
  return {runId:id,headSha:String(run.head_sha??'').slice(0,40),
    workflow:String(run.name??'').slice(0,120),conclusion,category,
    failedSteps:failed.slice(0,12),url:String(run.html_url??'').slice(0,300)};
}
export function summarize(runs,jobsByRun={}) {
  const items=runs.slice(0,30).map(r=>triageRun(r,jobsByRun[String(r.id)]??[]));
  return {schemaVersion:1,createdAt:new Date().toISOString(),
    failures:items.filter(x=>x.category.endsWith('FAILURE')),
    successes:items.filter(x=>x.category==='PASS').length,
    pending:items.filter(x=>x.category==='PENDING').length};
}
async function main() {
  const token=process.env.GITHUB_TOKEN;
  const repository=process.env.GITHUB_REPOSITORY;
  if(!token||!repository||!/^[-\w.]+\/[-\w.]+$/.test(repository))throw Error('GitHub environment required');
  const headers={Authorization:'Bearer '+token,Accept:'application/vnd.github+json','X-GitHub-Api-Version':'2022-11-28'};
  async function api(path) {
    const response=await fetch('https://api.github.com/repos/'+repository+path,{headers,signal:AbortSignal.timeout(12000)});
    if(!response.ok)throw Error('GitHub API HTTP '+response.status);
    return response.json();
  }
  const branch='copilot/pr-12-working-first-vertical-slice';
  const data=await api('/actions/runs?branch='+encodeURIComponent(branch)+'&per_page=12');
  const runs=(data.workflow_runs??[]).filter(x=>x.name!=='Continuum Developer Agent').slice(0,12);
  const jobs={};
  for(const run of runs.filter(x=>x.conclusion==='failure').slice(0,5)){
    jobs[String(run.id)]=(await api('/actions/runs/'+run.id+'/jobs?per_page=30')).jobs??[];
  }
  const report=summarize(runs,jobs);
  fs.mkdirSync('developer-agent-report',{recursive:true});
  fs.writeFileSync('developer-agent-report/triage.json',JSON.stringify(report,null,2)+'\n');
  const lines=['# Continuum Developer Agent','',`Analyzed ${runs.length} CI runs; ${report.failures.length} failures, ${report.successes} successes, ${report.pending} pending.`,''];
  for(const item of report.failures)lines.push(`- [${item.category}] ${item.workflow} run ${item.runId}: ${item.failedSteps.map(x=>x.step).join(', ')||'Unknown step'} (${item.url})`);
  if(!report.failures.length)lines.push('No failed runs found in this window.');
  fs.writeFileSync('developer-agent-report/summary.md',lines.join('\n')+'\n');
  console.log(lines.join('\n'));
}


// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Repair commands. `triage` (above) only reads CI metadata; the commands below
// drive the verified repair loop. Build execution and publishing are separate
// commands so CI can run them in jobs with different token permissions.
//   repair     --chain android|node|jvm --base <sha> --out <dir> [--trigger t]
//   benchmark  --chains node=node,kotlin=android --out <dir> [--faults a,b]
//   publish    --out <dir> --target-branch <branch>            (write token)
//   publish-demo --out <dir> --fault <id> --run <id>           (write token)
//   ledger-save --out <dir> [--branch continuum-agent-state]   (write token)
//   backlog <command> --file <backlog.json> ...  (see backlog-cli.mjs)
//   backlog-save [--plan] [--repairs <dir,...>] [--branch continuum-agent-state] (write token)
//   watch --branch <dev branch> [--state-branch continuum-agent-state]
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function options(argv){
  const o={_:[]};
  for(let i=0;i<argv.length;i++){
    if(argv[i].startsWith('--')){const k=argv[i].slice(2);const v=argv[i+1]&&!argv[i+1].startsWith('--')?argv[++i]:'true';o[k]=v;}
    else o._.push(argv[i]);
  }
  return o;
}
const SAFE_OUT=/^[\w./-]{1,200}$/;
// Relative to the invoking checkout, but returned absolute: check commands run
// with the isolated worktree as cwd and must not resolve report paths there.
function outDir(o){if(!SAFE_OUT.test(o.out??'')||o.out.includes('..'))throw Error('--out must be a relative directory');
  const dir=path.resolve(o.out);fs.mkdirSync(dir,{recursive:true});return dir;}

    for(const dirent of fs.readdirSync(out,{withFileTypes:true})){
      const file=dirent.isDirectory()?path.join(out,dirent.name,'report.json'):dirent.name==='report.json'?path.join(out,'report.json'):null;
      if(file&&fs.existsSync(file)){const report=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(file,'utf8'));
        const pub=path.join(path.dirname(file),'publish.json');
        reports.push({report,meta:{trigger:report.trigger??(dirent.isDirectory()?'benchmark':null),
          ...(fs.existsSync(pub)?(({branch,commit,pullRequest})=>({branch,proposalCommit:commit,pullRequest:pullRequest?.url??pullRequest?.compare??null}))(JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(pub,'utf8'))):{})}});}
    }
    const result=publish.saveLedgerToBranch(root,o.branch??'continuum-agent-state',reports);
    log('[ledger] '+JSON.stringify(result));
    return result;
  }
  if(cmd==='watch'){
    // Cheap scheduled check: API calls only. Requests a repair job only when the
    // development head has a failed Android build that neither the ledger nor
    // the backlog on the state branch knows. State is read through the API
    // (this job has no git credentials); unreadable state fails the job instead
    // of looking empty, which would repeat repairs every hour.
    const branch=o.branch??'copilot/pr-12-working-first-vertical-slice';
    const stateBranch=o['state-branch']??publish.STATE_BRANCH;
    if(!/^[\w./-]{1,120}$/.test(branch)||!/^[\w.-]{1,80}$/.test(stateBranch))throw Error('Invalid --branch or --state-branch');
    const headers={Authorization:'Bearer '+token,'X-GitHub-Api-Version':'2022-11-28'};
    const api=async p=>{const r=await fetch('https://api.github.com/repos/'+repository+p,{signal:AbortSignal.timeout(12000),
      headers:{...headers,Accept:'application/vnd.github+json'}});
      if(!r.ok)throw Error('GitHub API HTTP '+r.status);return r.json();};
    const stateFile=async name=>{const r=await fetch(`https://api.github.com/repos/${repository}/contents/${name}?ref=${encodeURIComponent(stateBranch)}`,
      {signal:AbortSignal.timeout(12000),headers:{...headers,Accept:'application/vnd.github.raw+json'}});
      if(r.status===404)return null;
      if(!r.ok)throw Error('GitHub API HTTP '+r.status+' reading '+name);
      return Buffer.from(await r.arrayBuffer());};
    const ledgerBytes=await stateFile('repair-ledger.json');
    const state=ledgerBytes?ledgerMod.verifyLedger(JSON.parse(ledgerBytes.toString('utf8'))):ledgerMod.emptyLedger();
    const backlogBytes=await stateFile(publish.BACKLOG_FILE);
    const B=await import('./development-backlog.mjs');
    const backlog=backlogBytes?B.decodeDocument(backlogBytes,{migrate:{at:Date.now(),actor:'continuum-agent'}}).doc:null;
    const head=(await api('/branches/'+encodeURIComponent(branch))).commit.sha;
    const runs=(await api('/actions/runs?head_sha='+head+'&per_page=30')).workflow_runs??[];
    const build=runs.find(r=>r.path==='.github/workflows/android.yml');
    const repairs=(backlog?.tasks??[]).filter(t=>t.kind==='REPAIR');
    const known=repairs.find(t=>t.subject?.base===head)??null;
    const running=repairs.find(t=>t.state==='IN_PROGRESS'&&t.claim.leaseUntil>Date.now())??null;
    const attempted=state.sessions.some(x=>x.base===head)||Boolean(known);
    const decision={branch,head,buildConclusion:build?.conclusion??build?.status??'NOT_RUN',alreadyAttempted:attempted,
      backlogTask:known?.id??null,backlogTaskState:known?.state??null,runningRepair:running?.id??null,
      needsRepair:build?.conclusion==='failure'&&!attempted&&!running};
    log('[watch] '+JSON.stringify(decision));
    if(env.GITHUB_OUTPUT)fs.appendFileSync(env.GITHUB_OUTPUT,`needs_repair=${decision.needsRepair}\nbase=${head}\nbranch=${branch}\n`);
    return decision;
  }
  throw Error('Unknown command '+cmd);
}

import {command} from './developer-agent.mjs';

// watch reads the state branch through the API: a stub stands in for GitHub.
async function watchWith(files,{status={}}={}){
  const head='b'.repeat(40);
  const original=globalThis.fetch;
  globalThis.fetch=async url=>{
    const u=String(url);
    const json=body=>({ok:true,status:200,json:async()=>body,arrayBuffer:async()=>new ArrayBuffer(0)});
    if(u.includes('/contents/')){
      const name=decodeURIComponent(u.split('/contents/')[1].split('?')[0]);
      if(status[name])return {ok:false,status:status[name]};
      if(!files[name])return {ok:false,status:404};
      const bytes=Buffer.from(files[name]);
      return {ok:true,status:200,arrayBuffer:async()=>bytes.buffer.slice(bytes.byteOffset,bytes.byteOffset+bytes.length)};
    }
    if(u.includes('/branches/'))return json({commit:{sha:head}});
    if(u.includes('/actions/runs'))return json({workflow_runs:[{path:'.github/workflows/android.yml',conclusion:'failure'}]});
    throw Error('unexpected '+u);
  };
  try{return await command(['watch','--branch','dev'],{env:{GITHUB_TOKEN:'t',GITHUB_REPOSITORY:'o/r'},log:()=>{}});}
  finally{globalThis.fetch=original;}
}
