import crypto from 'node:crypto';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import os from 'node:os';
import path from 'node:path';

/**
 * Persistent development backlog shared by the Node agent, the CLI and the
 * Android app. app/src/main/java/at/heinz/deviceai/cognitive/DevelopmentBacklog.kt
 * implements the SAME document format and state rules; both run the shared
 * conformance vectors in app/src/test/resources/continuum/backlog/.
 *
 * Document: canonical JSON (sorted keys, no whitespace, integers only, UTF-8)
 * plus "integrity" = SHA-256 of the canonical document without that field.
 * The hash detects corruption; it is not a signature and proves no authorship.
 *
 * State changes happen only through operations (applyOp). Invariants checked
 * on every load and after every operation: a task is DONE only with test
 * evidence that names the task, the submitted artifact and its submission
 * token, with every check passed and tests really executed.
 */
export const SCHEMA='continuum-development-backlog';
export const SCHEMA_VERSION=2;
export const STATES=Object.freeze(['PROPOSED','READY','IN_PROGRESS','VERIFYING','BLOCKED','DONE','FAILED','ABORTED','REJECTED']);
export const OPS=Object.freeze(['propose','accept','reject','claim','claimNext','renew','submit','complete','fail','expire','abort','retry','setPriority']);
export const ARTIFACT_TYPES=Object.freeze(['PATCH','PROPOSAL','REPORT']);
export const TEST_PROFILES=Object.freeze(['node-continuum','android-unit','jvm-harness']);
export const LIMITS=Object.freeze({tasks:500,history:40,evidence:8,dependsOn:16,profiles:8,title:200,text:400,
  subjectKeys:12,subjectValue:300,fileBytes:4_000_000,maxAttempts:20,attempts:1000,priority:1000,
  leaseMin:60_000,leaseMax:86_400_000,depth:16,count:10_000_000,recentOps:256});
const TERMINAL=new Set(['DONE','ABORTED','REJECTED']);
const DEPENDENCY_FAILED=new Set(['FAILED','ABORTED','REJECTED']);
const HISTORY_OPS=new Set([...OPS,'reconcile','migrate']);
const MAX_SAFE=Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER;

const ID_RE=/^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{2,63}$/;
const ACTOR_RE=/^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._@:-]{0,63}$/;
const KIND_RE=/^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{1,31}$/;
const SOURCE_RE=/^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{1,31}$/;
const PROFILE_RE=/^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{1,47}$/;
const CODE_RE=/^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{1,47}$/;
const STRATEGY_RE=/^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_:]{1,79}$/;
const SUBJECT_KEY_RE=/^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9]{0,31}$/;
const TOKEN_RE=/^[0-9a-f]{32}$/;
const SHA_RE=/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/;
const HEX16_RE=/^[0-9a-f]{16}$/;
const COMMIT_RE=/^[0-9a-f]{40}$/;
const OP_ID_RE=/^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._:-]{7,79}$/;
const CONTROL_RE=/[\u0000-\u001f\u007f]/;
const CONTROL_ALL=/[\u0000-\u001f\u007f]/g;
const LONE_SURROGATE=/[\uD800-\uDBFF](?![\uDC00-\uDFFF])|(?<![\uD800-\uDBFF])[\uDC00-\uDFFF]/;

export class BacklogError extends Error{
  constructor(code,message){super(code+': '+message);this.code=code;this.detail=message;}
}
const fail=(code,message)=>{throw new BacklogError(code,message);};

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Canonical JSON and strict parsing (mirrors learning/StrictJson.kt)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
const isObject=v=>v!==null&&typeof v==='object'&&!Array.isArray(v);

/** Truncate to at most n UTF-16 units without splitting a surrogate pair. */
export function clip(value,n){
  const r=String(value).slice(0,n);
  return /[\uD800-\uDBFF]$/.test(r)?r.slice(0,-1):r;
}
/** Single-line text: control characters become spaces, then clip. */
export const singleLine=(value,n)=>clip(String(value).replace(CONTROL_ALL,' '),n);

export function canonical(value,depth=0){
  if(depth>64)fail('INVALID_FIELD','nesting too deep');
  if(value===null)return 'null';
  if(value===true)return 'true';
  if(value===false)return 'false';
  if(typeof value==='number'){
    if(!Number.isSafeInteger(value))fail('INVALID_FIELD','only integers within ±2^53-1 are allowed');
    return String(value);
  }
  if(typeof value==='string'){
    if(LONE_SURROGATE.test(value))fail('INVALID_FIELD','lone surrogate in string');
    return JSON.stringify(value);
  }
  if(Array.isArray(value))return '['+value.map(v=>canonical(v,depth+1)).join(',')+']';
  if(isObject(value)){
    const keys=Object.keys(value).sort();
    return '{'+keys.map(k=>{
      if(value[k]===undefined)fail('INVALID_FIELD','undefined value for '+k);
      return canonical(k,depth+1)+':'+canonical(value[k],depth+1);
    }).join(',')+'}';
  }
  fail('INVALID_FIELD','unsupported value type '+typeof value);
}

export const sha256Hex=data=>crypto.createHash('sha256').update(data).digest('hex');

/** RFC 8259 reader: duplicate keys, non-integers, lone surrogates and trailing data are rejected. */
export function parseStrict(text){
  let i=0;
  const err=m=>fail('CORRUPT',m+' (offset '+i+')');
  const ws=()=>{while(i<text.length&&(text[i]===' '||text[i]==='\n'||text[i]==='\r'||text[i]==='\t'))i++;};
  const literal=(word,result)=>{if(!text.startsWith(word,i))err('invalid literal');i+=word.length;return result;};
  function value(depth){
    if(depth>LIMITS.depth)err('JSON nesting too deep');
    if(i>=text.length)err('unexpected end');
    const c=text[i];
    if(c==='{')return object(depth+1);
    if(c==='[')return array(depth+1);
    if(c==='"')return string();
    if(c==='t')return literal('true',true);
    if(c==='f')return literal('false',false);
    if(c==='n')return literal('null',null);
    return number();
  }
  function object(depth){
    i++;const out={};let n=0;ws();
    if(text[i]==='}'){i++;return out;}
    for(;;){
      ws();if(text[i]!=='"')err('object key expected');
      const key=string();
      if(Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(out,key))err('duplicate key '+JSON.stringify(key.slice(0,40)));
      ws();if(text[i]!==':')err("':' expected");i++;ws();
      Object.defineProperty(out,key,{value:value(depth),enumerable:true,writable:true,configurable:true});
      if(++n>4096)err('object too large');
      ws();
      if(text[i]===','){i++;continue;}
      if(text[i]==='}'){i++;return out;}
      err("',' or '}' expected");
    }
  }
  function array(depth){
    i++;const out=[];ws();
    if(text[i]===']'){i++;return out;}
    for(;;){
      ws();out.push(value(depth));
      if(out.length>4096)err('array too large');
      ws();
      if(text[i]===','){i++;continue;}
      if(text[i]===']'){i++;return out;}
      err("',' or ']' expected");
    }
  }
  function string(){
    i++;let out='';
    for(;;){
      if(i>=text.length)err('unterminated string');
      const c=text[i++];
      if(c==='"')break;
      if(c==='\\'){
        if(i>=text.length)err('unterminated escape');
        const e=text[i++];
        if(e==='"'||e==='\\'||e==='/')out+=e;
        else if(e==='b')out+='\b';else if(e==='f')out+='\f';else if(e==='n')out+='\n';
        else if(e==='r')out+='\r';else if(e==='t')out+='\t';
        else if(e==='u'){
          const hex=text.slice(i,i+4);if(!/^[0-9a-fA-F]{4}$/.test(hex))err('invalid unicode escape');
          out+=String.fromCharCode(parseInt(hex,16));i+=4;
        }else err('invalid escape');
      }else if(c<' ')err('control character in string');
      else out+=c;
    }
    if(LONE_SURROGATE.test(out))err('lone surrogate');
    return out;
  }
  function number(){
    const start=i;
    if(text[i]==='-')i++;
    if(!(text[i]>='0'&&text[i]<='9'))err('invalid JSON value');
    if(text[i]==='0'){i++;if(text[i]>='0'&&text[i]<='9')err('leading zero');}
    else while(text[i]>='0'&&text[i]<='9')i++;
    if(text[i]==='.'||text[i]==='e'||text[i]==='E')err('only integers are allowed');
    const literalText=text.slice(start,i);
    if(literalText.length>64)err('number too long');
    const n=Number(literalText);
    if(!Number.isSafeInteger(n))err('integer outside ±2^53-1');
    return n===0?0:n;
  }
  ws();const result=value(0);ws();
  if(i!==text.length)err('trailing content after JSON value');
  return result;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Validation
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
const int=(v,min,max)=>Number.isSafeInteger(v)&&v>=min&&v<=max;
const text=(v,max,allowEmpty=false)=>typeof v==='string'&&v.length<=max&&(allowEmpty||v.length>0)&&!CONTROL_RE.test(v);
function check(ok,code,message){if(!ok)fail(code,message);}
function validSubject(s){
  if(s===null)return true;
  if(!isObject(s)||Object.keys(s).length>LIMITS.subjectKeys)return false;
  return Object.entries(s).every(([k,v])=>SUBJECT_KEY_RE.test(k)&&(typeof v==='boolean'||int(v,-MAX_SAFE,MAX_SAFE)||text(v,LIMITS.subjectValue,true)));
}

export function validateEvidence(e,code='INVALID_FIELD'){
  check(isObject(e),code,'evidence must be an object');
  check(e.type==='TEST_RUN',code,'evidence type must be TEST_RUN');
  check(typeof e.taskId==='string'&&ID_RE.test(e.taskId),code,'evidence taskId invalid');
  check(typeof e.submissionToken==='string'&&TOKEN_RE.test(e.submissionToken),code,'evidence submissionToken invalid');
  check(typeof e.artifactSha256==='string'&&SHA_RE.test(e.artifactSha256),code,'evidence artifactSha256 invalid');
  check(typeof e.chain==='string'&&SOURCE_RE.test(e.chain),code,'evidence chain invalid');
  check(typeof e.commit==='string'&&COMMIT_RE.test(e.commit),code,'evidence commit invalid');
  check(int(e.at,0,MAX_SAFE),code,'evidence at invalid');
  check(typeof e.by==='string'&&ACTOR_RE.test(e.by),code,'evidence by invalid');
  check(Array.isArray(e.profiles)&&e.profiles.length>=1&&e.profiles.length<=LIMITS.profiles,code,'evidence needs 1..8 profiles');
  for(const p of e.profiles){
    check(isObject(p)&&typeof p.profile==='string'&&PROFILE_RE.test(p.profile)&&typeof p.passed==='boolean'&&
      int(p.executed,0,LIMITS.count)&&int(p.failed,0,LIMITS.count)&&int(p.skipped,0,LIMITS.count),code,'evidence profile invalid');
  }
  if(e.repair!==null){
    const r=e.repair;
    check(isObject(r)&&typeof r.diagnostic==='string'&&HEX16_RE.test(r.diagnostic)&&typeof r.candidate==='string'&&HEX16_RE.test(r.candidate)&&
      typeof r.strategy==='string'&&STRATEGY_RE.test(r.strategy)&&typeof r.patchSha256==='string'&&SHA_RE.test(r.patchSha256),code,'evidence repair reference invalid');
  }
  return e;
}

/** Why `e` does not prove `task` done (empty = sufficient). */
export function evidenceProblems(task,e){
  const problems=[];
  if(e.taskId!==task.id)problems.push('evidence belongs to another task');
  const s=task.submission;
  if(!s)problems.push('task has no submission');
  else{
    if(e.submissionToken!==s.token)problems.push('evidence does not match the submission');
    if(e.artifactSha256!==s.artifact.sha256)problems.push('evidence tested a different artifact');
    if(e.at<s.at)problems.push('evidence predates the submission');
  }
  if(e.profiles.some(p=>!p.passed||p.failed>0))problems.push('a check failed');
  if(e.profiles.some(p=>TEST_PROFILES.includes(p.profile)&&p.executed<=0))problems.push('test profile without executed tests');
  if(e.profiles.reduce((a,p)=>a+p.executed,0)<=0)problems.push('no executed tests');
  return problems;
}

function validateTask(t){
  const c='CORRUPT';
  check(isObject(t),c,'task must be an object');
  check(typeof t.id==='string'&&ID_RE.test(t.id),c,'task id invalid');
  const where=' (task '+t.id+')';
  check(text(t.title,LIMITS.title),c,'title invalid'+where);
  check(typeof t.kind==='string'&&KIND_RE.test(t.kind),c,'kind invalid'+where);
  check(typeof t.source==='string'&&SOURCE_RE.test(t.source),c,'source invalid'+where);
  check(STATES.includes(t.state),c,'state invalid'+where);
  check(int(t.priority,0,LIMITS.priority),c,'priority invalid'+where);
  check(Array.isArray(t.dependsOn)&&t.dependsOn.length<=LIMITS.dependsOn,c,'dependsOn invalid'+where);
  t.dependsOn.forEach((d,k)=>check(typeof d==='string'&&ID_RE.test(d)&&d!==t.id&&(k===0||t.dependsOn[k-1]<d),c,'dependsOn must be sorted, unique task ids'+where));
  check(int(t.attempts,0,LIMITS.attempts)&&int(t.maxAttempts,1,LIMITS.maxAttempts),c,'attempt budget invalid'+where);
  if(t.claim!==null){
    const k=t.claim;
    check(isObject(k)&&typeof k.owner==='string'&&ACTOR_RE.test(k.owner)&&typeof k.token==='string'&&TOKEN_RE.test(k.token)&&
      int(k.at,0,MAX_SAFE)&&int(k.leaseUntil,0,MAX_SAFE)&&k.leaseUntil>k.at,c,'claim invalid'+where);
  }
  check((t.state==='IN_PROGRESS')===(t.claim!==null),c,'claim must exist exactly while IN_PROGRESS'+where);
  if(t.submission!==null){
    const s=t.submission;
    check(isObject(s)&&typeof s.token==='string'&&TOKEN_RE.test(s.token)&&typeof s.by==='string'&&ACTOR_RE.test(s.by)&&int(s.at,0,MAX_SAFE)&&
      isObject(s.artifact)&&ARTIFACT_TYPES.includes(s.artifact.type)&&typeof s.artifact.sha256==='string'&&SHA_RE.test(s.artifact.sha256),c,'submission invalid'+where);
  }
  check((t.state==='VERIFYING'||t.state==='DONE')===(t.submission!==null),c,'submission must exist exactly while VERIFYING or DONE'+where);
  check(Array.isArray(t.evidence)&&t.evidence.length<=LIMITS.evidence,c,'evidence list invalid'+where);
  t.evidence.forEach(e=>validateEvidence(e,c));
  if(t.state==='DONE')check(t.evidence.some(e=>evidenceProblems(t,e).length===0),c,'DONE without matching test evidence'+where);
  check(Array.isArray(t.history)&&t.history.length<=LIMITS.history,c,'history invalid'+where);
  for(const h of t.history){
    check(isObject(h)&&int(h.at,0,MAX_SAFE)&&typeof h.by==='string'&&ACTOR_RE.test(h.by)&&HISTORY_OPS.has(h.op)&&
      (h.from===null||STATES.includes(h.from))&&STATES.includes(h.to)&&text(h.reason,LIMITS.text,true),c,'history entry invalid'+where);
  }
  check(int(t.historyDropped,0,MAX_SAFE)&&int(t.evidenceDropped,0,MAX_SAFE),c,'dropped counters invalid'+where);
  if(t.error!==null){
    const e=t.error;
    check(isObject(e)&&typeof e.code==='string'&&CODE_RE.test(e.code)&&text(e.message,LIMITS.text,true)&&int(e.at,0,MAX_SAFE),c,'error invalid'+where);
  }
  check(int(t.createdAt,0,MAX_SAFE)&&int(t.updatedAt,t.createdAt,MAX_SAFE),c,'timestamps invalid'+where);
  check(validSubject(t.subject),c,'subject invalid'+where);
}

export function validateDocument(doc){
  const c='CORRUPT';
  check(isObject(doc),c,'document must be an object');
  check(doc.schema===SCHEMA,c,'not a development backlog');
  if(Number.isSafeInteger(doc.schemaVersion)&&doc.schemaVersion>SCHEMA_VERSION)fail('UNSUPPORTED_VERSION','schemaVersion '+doc.schemaVersion+' is newer than '+SCHEMA_VERSION);
  check(doc.schemaVersion===SCHEMA_VERSION,c,'schemaVersion must be '+SCHEMA_VERSION);
  check(int(doc.revision,0,MAX_SAFE),c,'revision invalid');
  check(int(doc.updatedAt,0,MAX_SAFE),c,'updatedAt invalid');
  check(typeof doc.updatedBy==='string'&&ACTOR_RE.test(doc.updatedBy),c,'updatedBy invalid');
  check(!('integrity' in doc)||(typeof doc.integrity==='string'&&SHA_RE.test(doc.integrity)),c,'integrity invalid');
  if('recentOpIds' in doc){
    const r=doc.recentOpIds;
    check(Array.isArray(r)&&r.length<=LIMITS.recentOps&&r.every(x=>typeof x==='string'&&OP_ID_RE.test(x))&&new Set(r).size===r.length,c,'recentOpIds invalid');
  }
  check(Array.isArray(doc.tasks)&&doc.tasks.length<=LIMITS.tasks,c,'tasks invalid');
  doc.tasks.forEach((t,k)=>{validateTask(t);check(k===0||doc.tasks[k-1].id<t.id,c,'tasks must be sorted by id and unique');});
  const byId=new Map(doc.tasks.map(t=>[t.id,t]));
  for(const t of doc.tasks)for(const d of t.dependsOn)check(byId.has(d),c,'unknown dependency '+d+' of '+t.id);
  // dependency cycles (iterative DFS, deterministic order)
  const color=new Map();
  for(const start of doc.tasks){
    if(color.get(start.id))continue;
    const stack=[[start.id,0]];color.set(start.id,1);
    while(stack.length){
      const top=stack[stack.length-1],deps=byId.get(top[0]).dependsOn;
      if(top[1]<deps.length){
        const next=deps[top[1]++],state=color.get(next);
        if(state===1)fail(c,'dependency cycle through '+next);
        if(!state){color.set(next,1);stack.push([next,0]);}
      }else{color.set(top[0],2);stack.pop();}
    }
  }
  canonical(doc);
  return doc;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Encoding, integrity, migration
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
const withoutIntegrity=doc=>{const {integrity,...rest}=doc;return rest;};
export const integrityOf=doc=>sha256Hex(Buffer.from(canonical(withoutIntegrity(doc)),'utf8'));

export function emptyDocument(at,actor){
  return {schema:SCHEMA,schemaVersion:SCHEMA_VERSION,revision:0,updatedAt:at,updatedBy:actor,tasks:[]};
}

/** Canonical bytes of a validated document including its integrity hash. */
export function encodeDocument(doc){
  validateDocument(doc);
  const body=withoutIntegrity(doc);
  return Buffer.from(canonical({...body,integrity:integrityOf(body)})+'\n','utf8');
}

const decoder=new TextDecoder('utf-8',{fatal:true,ignoreBOM:true});

/**
 * Bytes -> verified document. Schema version 1 (development-planner output)
 * is migrated in memory when allowed; the result says so explicitly.
 */
export function decodeDocument(bytes,{migrate=null}={}){
  if(bytes.length>LIMITS.fileBytes)fail('CORRUPT','backlog larger than '+LIMITS.fileBytes+' bytes');
  let textValue;
  try{textValue=decoder.decode(bytes);}catch{fail('CORRUPT','invalid UTF-8');}
  const doc=parseStrict(textValue);
  if(isObject(doc)&&doc.schema===undefined&&doc.schemaVersion===1){
    if(!migrate)fail('UNSUPPORTED_VERSION','schemaVersion 1 requires migration');
    return {doc:migrateV1(doc,migrate),migratedFrom:1};
  }
  validateDocument(doc);
  check(typeof doc.integrity==='string',"CORRUPT",'integrity missing');
  if(integrityOf(doc)!==doc.integrity)fail('INTEGRITY_MISMATCH','content does not match its integrity hash');
  return {doc,migratedFrom:null};
}

// Maps, not object literals: a finding kind like "constructor" must not hit Object.prototype.
const CONFIDENCE_BONUS=new Map([['high',30],['medium',20],['low',10]]);
const FINDING_SCORE=new Map([['DEAD_CLUSTER',3],['TEST_ONLY',2],['UNREFERENCED',1]]);
/** Planner paths are relative to app/src; backlog paths are repository-relative. */
export const repoPath=file=>/^(main|test|androidTest)\//.test(file)?'app/src/'+file:file;
export const findingTaskId=(kind,file,symbol)=>'inv-'+sha256Hex(kind+'\u0000'+file+'\u0000'+symbol).slice(0,16);
export function findingPriority(kind,confidence){
  return Math.min(LIMITS.priority,(FINDING_SCORE.get(kind)??0)*100+(CONFIDENCE_BONUS.get(confidence)??0));
}
export function findingTask(f){
  const file=singleLine(repoPath(String(f.file??'')),LIMITS.subjectValue),symbol=singleLine(f.symbol??'',LIMITS.subjectValue);
  const shortName=symbol.split('.').pop()||symbol;
  const subject={finding:singleLine(f.kind,40),symbol,file,confidence:singleLine(f.confidence??'unknown',40)};
  return {id:findingTaskId(String(f.kind),file,symbol),title:singleLine(`${f.kind}: ${shortName} (${file})`,LIMITS.title),
    kind:'INVESTIGATE',source:'code-analyzer',priority:findingPriority(f.kind,f.confidence),dependsOn:[],maxAttempts:3,subject};
}

/** schemaVersion 1 (development-planner) -> 2; nothing of the input is dropped. */
export function migrateV1(v1,{at,actor}){
  check(Array.isArray(v1.tasks)&&v1.tasks.length<=LIMITS.tasks,'CORRUPT','v1 tasks invalid');
  let doc=emptyDocument(at,actor);
  const extra={};
  for(const [k,v] of Object.entries(v1))if(k!=='tasks'&&k!=='schemaVersion'){
    check(typeof v==='string'||int(v,-MAX_SAFE,MAX_SAFE)||typeof v==='boolean','CORRUPT','v1 field '+k+' cannot be migrated');
    check(SUBJECT_KEY_RE.test(k),'CORRUPT','v1 field name '+k+' cannot be migrated');extra[k]=v;
  }
  let duplicates=0;
  for(const raw of v1.tasks){
    check(isObject(raw)&&typeof raw.kind==='string'&&typeof raw.symbol==='string'&&typeof raw.file==='string'&&
      (raw.confidence==null||typeof raw.confidence==='string'||typeof raw.confidence==='boolean'||int(raw.confidence,-MAX_SAFE,MAX_SAFE)),'CORRUPT','v1 task invalid');
    const task=findingTask(raw);
    for(const [k,v] of Object.entries(raw))if(!['kind','symbol','file','confidence'].includes(k)){
      check((typeof v==='string'&&text(v,LIMITS.subjectValue,true))||int(v,-MAX_SAFE,MAX_SAFE)||typeof v==='boolean','CORRUPT','v1 task field '+k+' cannot be migrated');
      check(SUBJECT_KEY_RE.test(k),'CORRUPT','v1 task field name '+k+' cannot be migrated');
      task.subject[k]=v;
    }
    if(doc.tasks.some(t=>t.id===task.id)){duplicates++;continue;}
    doc=applyOp(doc,{op:'propose',actor,at,task,reason:'migrated from schemaVersion 1'}).doc;
    const t=doc.tasks.find(x=>x.id===task.id);t.history[t.history.length-1].op='migrate';
  }
  return {...doc,migratedFrom:{schemaVersion:1,...extra,duplicateTasks:duplicates}};
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Operations: the only way to change state (same rules in DevelopmentBacklog.kt)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function requireTask(doc,id){
  check(typeof id==='string'&&ID_RE.test(id),'INVALID_FIELD','task id invalid');
  const t=doc.tasks.find(x=>x.id===id);
  if(!t)fail('NOT_FOUND','task '+id);
  return t;
}
function record(task,op,to,reason){
  task.history.push({at:op.at,by:op.actor,op:op.op,from:task.state,to,reason:singleLine(reason,LIMITS.text)});
  while(task.history.length>LIMITS.history){task.history.shift();task.historyDropped++;}
  task.state=to;task.updatedAt=Math.max(task.updatedAt,op.at);
}
const requireReason=op=>{check(text(op.reason,LIMITS.text),'INVALID_FIELD','reason required (1..400 characters)');return op.reason;};
const requireToken=v=>{check(typeof v==='string'&&TOKEN_RE.test(v),'INVALID_FIELD','token must be 32 hex characters');return v;};
const requireLease=v=>{check(int(v,LIMITS.leaseMin,LIMITS.leaseMax),'INVALID_FIELD','leaseMs must be 60000..86400000');return v;};
const depsDone=(doc,t)=>t.dependsOn.every(d=>doc.tasks.find(x=>x.id===d)?.state==='DONE');
const eligible=(doc,t)=>t.state==='READY'&&depsDone(doc,t)&&t.attempts<t.maxAttempts;

function claimTask(doc,t,op){
  if(t.state!=='READY')fail('INVALID_TRANSITION',t.id+' is '+t.state+', not READY');
  if(!depsDone(doc,t))fail('DEPENDENCY_NOT_DONE',t.id+' depends on unfinished tasks');
  if(t.attempts>=t.maxAttempts)fail('BUDGET_EXHAUSTED',t.id+' used '+t.attempts+' of '+t.maxAttempts+' attempts');
  check(typeof op.owner==='string'&&ACTOR_RE.test(op.owner),'INVALID_FIELD','owner invalid');
  const token=requireToken(op.token),lease=requireLease(op.leaseMs);
  record(t,op,'IN_PROGRESS','claimed by '+op.owner);
  t.claim={owner:op.owner,token,at:op.at,leaseUntil:op.at+lease};
  t.attempts++;t.error=null;
}
function releaseAfterFailure(t,op,error,reason){
  const exhausted=t.attempts>=t.maxAttempts;
  record(t,op,exhausted?'FAILED':'READY',reason+(exhausted?' (attempt budget exhausted)':''));
  t.claim=null;t.submission=null;t.error=error;
}
function appendEvidence(t,e){
  t.evidence.push(e);
  while(t.evidence.length>LIMITS.evidence){t.evidence.shift();t.evidenceDropped++;}
}

const HANDLERS={
  propose(doc,op){
    const p=op.task;
    check(isObject(p),'INVALID_FIELD','task required');
    check(typeof p.id==='string'&&ID_RE.test(p.id),'INVALID_FIELD','task id must match '+ID_RE);
    if(doc.tasks.some(t=>t.id===p.id)){
      if(op.ifAbsent===true)return {changed:false,id:p.id,existed:true};
      fail('DUPLICATE_ID',p.id);
    }
    if(doc.tasks.length>=LIMITS.tasks)fail('LIMIT','backlog holds at most '+LIMITS.tasks+' tasks');
    check(text(p.title,LIMITS.title),'INVALID_FIELD','title must be 1..200 characters without control characters');
    check(typeof p.kind==='string'&&KIND_RE.test(p.kind),'INVALID_FIELD','kind invalid');
    check(typeof p.source==='string'&&SOURCE_RE.test(p.source),'INVALID_FIELD','source invalid');
    const priority=p.priority??500,maxAttempts=p.maxAttempts??3,rawDeps=p.dependsOn??[],subject=p.subject??null;
    check(int(priority,0,LIMITS.priority),'INVALID_FIELD','priority must be 0..1000');
    check(int(maxAttempts,1,LIMITS.maxAttempts),'INVALID_FIELD','maxAttempts must be 1..20');
    check(Array.isArray(rawDeps)&&rawDeps.every(d=>typeof d==='string'&&ID_RE.test(d)),'INVALID_FIELD','dependsOn must be task ids');
    const dependsOn=[...new Set(rawDeps)].sort();
    check(dependsOn.length<=LIMITS.dependsOn,'INVALID_FIELD','at most '+LIMITS.dependsOn+' dependencies');
    check(validSubject(subject),'INVALID_FIELD','subject must be a flat object of up to 12 strings, integers or booleans');
    for(const d of dependsOn)if(!doc.tasks.some(t=>t.id===d))fail('UNKNOWN_DEPENDENCY',d);
    const reason=op.reason==null?'':op.reason;
    check(text(reason,LIMITS.text,true),'INVALID_FIELD','reason invalid');
    const task={id:p.id,title:p.title,kind:p.kind,source:p.source,state:'PROPOSED',priority,dependsOn,attempts:0,maxAttempts,
      claim:null,submission:null,evidence:[],evidenceDropped:0,history:[],historyDropped:0,error:null,createdAt:op.at,updatedAt:op.at,subject};
    task.history.push({at:op.at,by:op.actor,op:'propose',from:null,to:'PROPOSED',reason});
    doc.tasks.push(task);doc.tasks.sort((a,b)=>a.id<b.id?-1:a.id>b.id?1:0);
    validateTask(task);
    return {changed:true,id:task.id};
  },
  accept(doc,op){
    const t=requireTask(doc,op.id);
    if(t.state!=='PROPOSED')fail('INVALID_TRANSITION',t.id+' is '+t.state+', not PROPOSED');
    record(t,op,'READY',op.reason==null?'accepted':requireReason(op));
    return {changed:true,id:t.id};
  },
  reject(doc,op){
    const t=requireTask(doc,op.id);
    if(!['PROPOSED','READY','BLOCKED','FAILED'].includes(t.state))fail('INVALID_TRANSITION',t.id+' is '+t.state);
    record(t,op,'REJECTED',requireReason(op));t.claim=null;t.submission=null;
    return {changed:true,id:t.id};
  },
  claim(doc,op){const t=requireTask(doc,op.id);claimTask(doc,t,op);return {changed:true,id:t.id};},
  claimNext(doc,op){
    const kinds=op.kinds??null;
    check(kinds===null||(Array.isArray(kinds)&&kinds.length<=16&&kinds.every(k=>typeof k==='string'&&KIND_RE.test(k))),'INVALID_FIELD','kinds invalid');
    const t=doc.tasks.filter(x=>eligible(doc,x)&&(!kinds||kinds.includes(x.kind)))
      .sort((a,b)=>b.priority-a.priority||a.createdAt-b.createdAt||(a.id<b.id?-1:1))[0];
    if(!t)fail('NO_ELIGIBLE_TASK','no READY task with finished dependencies and remaining budget');
    claimTask(doc,t,op);
    return {changed:true,id:t.id};
  },
  renew(doc,op){
    const t=requireTask(doc,op.id);
    if(t.state!=='IN_PROGRESS')fail('INVALID_TRANSITION',t.id+' is '+t.state);
    if(t.claim.token!==requireToken(op.token))fail('TOKEN_MISMATCH','claim belongs to another execution');
    if(op.at>t.claim.leaseUntil)fail('LEASE_EXPIRED','lease ended at '+t.claim.leaseUntil);
    t.claim.leaseUntil=op.at+requireLease(op.leaseMs);t.updatedAt=Math.max(t.updatedAt,op.at);
    return {changed:true,id:t.id};
  },
  submit(doc,op){
    const t=requireTask(doc,op.id);
    if(t.state!=='IN_PROGRESS')fail('INVALID_TRANSITION',t.id+' is '+t.state);
    if(t.claim.token!==requireToken(op.token))fail('TOKEN_MISMATCH','claim belongs to another execution');
    if(op.at>t.claim.leaseUntil)fail('LEASE_EXPIRED','lease ended at '+t.claim.leaseUntil);
    const a=op.artifact;
    check(isObject(a)&&ARTIFACT_TYPES.includes(a.type)&&typeof a.sha256==='string'&&SHA_RE.test(a.sha256),'INVALID_FIELD','artifact must be {type,sha256}');
    record(t,op,'VERIFYING','submitted '+a.type+' '+a.sha256.slice(0,12));
    t.submission={token:t.claim.token,by:op.actor,at:op.at,artifact:{type:a.type,sha256:a.sha256}};t.claim=null;
    return {changed:true,id:t.id};
  },
  complete(doc,op){
    const t=requireTask(doc,op.id);
    if(t.state!=='VERIFYING')fail('INVALID_TRANSITION',t.id+' is '+t.state+', not VERIFYING');
    const e=validateEvidence(op.evidence);
    const problems=evidenceProblems(t,e);
    if(problems.length)fail('EVIDENCE_REJECTED',problems.join('; '));
    appendEvidence(t,e);
    record(t,op,'DONE','verified by '+e.profiles.map(p=>p.profile+' '+p.executed+' tests').join(', '));
    t.error=null;
    return {changed:true,id:t.id};
  },
  fail(doc,op){
    const t=requireTask(doc,op.id);
    const token=requireToken(op.token);
    if(t.state==='IN_PROGRESS'){if(t.claim.token!==token)fail('TOKEN_MISMATCH','claim belongs to another execution');}
    else if(t.state==='VERIFYING'){if(t.submission.token!==token)fail('TOKEN_MISMATCH','submission belongs to another execution');}
    else fail('INVALID_TRANSITION',t.id+' is '+t.state);
    const er=op.error;
    check(isObject(er)&&typeof er.code==='string'&&CODE_RE.test(er.code)&&text(er.message,LIMITS.text,true),'INVALID_FIELD','error must be {code,message}');
    if(op.evidence!=null){
      const e=validateEvidence(op.evidence);
      check(e.taskId===t.id,'INVALID_FIELD','evidence belongs to another task');
      appendEvidence(t,e);
    }
    releaseAfterFailure(t,op,{code:er.code,message:er.message,at:op.at},er.code);
    return {changed:true,id:t.id};
  },
  expire(doc,op){
    const expired=[];
    for(const t of doc.tasks){
      if(t.state!=='IN_PROGRESS'||op.at<=t.claim.leaseUntil)continue;
      const owner=t.claim.owner;
      releaseAfterFailure(t,op,{code:'LEASE_EXPIRED',message:'lease of '+owner+' expired',at:op.at},'LEASE_EXPIRED');
      expired.push(t.id);
    }
    return {changed:expired.length>0,expired};
  },
  abort(doc,op){
    const t=requireTask(doc,op.id);
    if(TERMINAL.has(t.state))fail('INVALID_TRANSITION',t.id+' is '+t.state);
    record(t,op,'ABORTED',requireReason(op));t.claim=null;t.submission=null;
    return {changed:true,id:t.id};
  },
  retry(doc,op){
    const t=requireTask(doc,op.id);
    if(t.state!=='FAILED')fail('INVALID_TRANSITION',t.id+' is '+t.state+', not FAILED');
    record(t,op,'READY',requireReason(op));t.attempts=0;t.error=null;
    return {changed:true,id:t.id};
  },
  setPriority(doc,op){
    const t=requireTask(doc,op.id);
    if(TERMINAL.has(t.state))fail('INVALID_TRANSITION',t.id+' is '+t.state);
    check(int(op.priority,0,LIMITS.priority),'INVALID_FIELD','priority must be 0..1000');
    if(op.priority===t.priority)return {changed:false,id:t.id};
    record(t,op,t.state,'priority '+t.priority+' -> '+op.priority);t.priority=op.priority;
    return {changed:true,id:t.id};
  }
};

/** READY tasks with a failed dependency become BLOCKED, and back once it recovers. */
function reconcile(doc,op){
  const byId=new Map(doc.tasks.map(t=>[t.id,t]));
  for(const t of doc.tasks){
    const broken=t.dependsOn.find(d=>DEPENDENCY_FAILED.has(byId.get(d).state));
    if(t.state==='READY'&&broken)record(t,{...op,op:'reconcile'},'BLOCKED','dependency '+broken+' is '+byId.get(broken).state);
    else if(t.state==='BLOCKED'&&!broken)record(t,{...op,op:'reconcile'},'READY','dependencies recovered');
  }
}

/**
 * Apply one operation. Returns {doc, result}; `doc` is a new object (the input
 * is never mutated) or the same object when nothing changed. Throws
 * BacklogError with a stable code; then nothing changed. An operation with an
 * `opId` that was already applied is a reported no-op (exactly-once op logs).
 */
export function applyOp(doc,op){
  check(isObject(op)&&OPS.includes(op.op),'INVALID_OP','unknown operation '+String(op?.op).slice(0,40));
  check(typeof op.actor==='string'&&ACTOR_RE.test(op.actor),'INVALID_FIELD','actor invalid');
  check(int(op.at,0,MAX_SAFE),'INVALID_FIELD','at must be a non-negative integer (epoch ms)');
  if(op.opId!=null){
    check(typeof op.opId==='string'&&OP_ID_RE.test(op.opId),'INVALID_FIELD','opId must match '+OP_ID_RE);
    if((doc.recentOpIds??[]).includes(op.opId))return {doc,result:{changed:false,duplicate:true}};
  }
  const next=structuredClone(doc);
  const result=HANDLERS[op.op](next,op);
  if(!result.changed)return {doc,result};
  reconcile(next,op);
  if(op.opId!=null){
    next.recentOpIds=[...(doc.recentOpIds??[]),op.opId];
    while(next.recentOpIds.length>LIMITS.recentOps)next.recentOpIds.shift();
  }
  next.revision=doc.revision+1;next.updatedAt=op.at;next.updatedBy=op.actor;
  delete next.integrity;
  validateDocument(next);
  return {doc:next,result};
}

/** Apply several operations; every rejection is reported, never dropped silently. */
export function applyOps(doc,ops,{stopOnError=true}={}){
  let current=doc;const results=[];
  for(const [index,op] of ops.entries()){
    try{const r=applyOp(current,op);current=r.doc;results.push({index,ok:true,...r.result});}
    catch(e){
      if(!(e instanceof BacklogError))throw e;
      results.push({index,ok:false,code:e.code,message:e.detail});
      if(stopOnError)fail(e.code,'operation '+index+' ('+String(op?.op)+'): '+e.detail);
    }
  }
  return {doc:current,results};
}

export function nextEligible(doc,kinds=null){
  return doc.tasks.filter(x=>eligible(doc,x)&&(!kinds||kinds.includes(x.kind)))
    .sort((a,b)=>b.priority-a.priority||a.createdAt-b.createdAt||(a.id<b.id?-1:1))[0]??null;
}

export const newToken=()=>crypto.randomBytes(16).toString('hex');

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// File store: cross-process lock, atomic replace, backup, explicit recovery
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
const sleepMs=ms=>Atomics.wait(new Int32Array(new SharedArrayBuffer(4)),0,0,ms);

function fsyncDirectory(dir){
  let fd;try{fd=fs.openSync(dir,'r');fs.fsyncSync(fd);}catch{/* not supported on every platform */}finally{if(fd!==undefined)fs.closeSync(fd);}
}

function writeSynced(file,bytes){
  const fd=fs.openSync(file,'wx',0o600);
  try{fs.writeSync(fd,bytes,0,bytes.length,0);fs.fsyncSync(fd);}finally{fs.closeSync(fd);}
}

export class BacklogStore{
  constructor(file,{actor='cli',clock=Date.now,staleLockMs=60_000,waitMs=10_000}={}){
    check(typeof actor==='string'&&ACTOR_RE.test(actor),'INVALID_FIELD','actor invalid');
    this.file=path.resolve(file);this.actor=actor;this.clock=clock;this.staleLockMs=staleLockMs;this.waitMs=waitMs;
    this.lockFile=this.file+'.lock';this.backupFile=this.file+'.bak';
  }

  /** Read with recovery but without modifying files. */
  read(){return this.#load(false);}

  #decodeFile(file){
    const bytes=fs.readFileSync(file);
    return {...decodeDocument(bytes,{migrate:{at:this.clock(),actor:this.actor}}),bytes};
  }

  #load(repair){
    const exists=fs.existsSync(this.file);
    if(exists){
      try{const r=this.#decodeFile(this.file);return {doc:r.doc,bytes:r.bytes,migratedFrom:r.migratedFrom,recovered:null,exists:true};}
      catch(e){
        if(!(e instanceof BacklogError)||e.code==='UNSUPPORTED_VERSION')throw e;
        const backup=this.#tryBackup();
        if(!backup)fail(e.code,'backlog unreadable and no valid backup: '+e.detail);
        let quarantined=null;
        if(repair){quarantined=this.file+'.corrupt-'+this.clock()+'-'+crypto.randomBytes(3).toString('hex');fs.renameSync(this.file,quarantined);}
        return {doc:backup.doc,bytes:null,migratedFrom:backup.migratedFrom,exists:true,
          recovered:{from:'backup',reason:e.code+': '+e.detail,quarantined}};
      }
    }
    const backup=this.#tryBackup();
    if(backup)return {doc:backup.doc,bytes:null,migratedFrom:backup.migratedFrom,exists:false,recovered:{from:'backup',reason:'backlog file missing',quarantined:null}};
    return {doc:emptyDocument(this.clock(),this.actor),bytes:null,migratedFrom:null,recovered:null,exists:false};
  }

  #tryBackup(){
    if(!fs.existsSync(this.backupFile))return null;
    try{return this.#decodeFile(this.backupFile);}catch(e){if(e instanceof BacklogError)return null;throw e;}
  }

  #acquire(){
    const token=newToken();
    const body=Buffer.from(canonical({owner:this.actor,pid:process.pid,host:os.hostname().replace(/[^\w.-]/g,'').slice(0,64)||'host',token,at:this.clock()})+'\n','utf8');
    const deadline=Date.now()+this.waitMs;
    for(let round=0;;round++){
      try{writeSynced(this.lockFile,body);return token;}catch(e){if(e.code!=='EEXIST')throw e;}
      let st;try{st=fs.statSync(this.lockFile);}catch(e){if(e.code==='ENOENT')continue;throw e;}
      if(Date.now()-st.mtimeMs>this.staleLockMs){
        // Move the stale lock aside under a unique name; if what we moved is
        // in fact fresh (taken over in between), put it back.
        const aside=this.lockFile+'.stale-'+token;
        try{fs.renameSync(this.lockFile,aside);}catch(e){if(e.code==='ENOENT')continue;throw e;}
        if(Date.now()-fs.statSync(aside).mtimeMs<=this.staleLockMs){try{fs.linkSync(aside,this.lockFile);}catch{/* a new holder exists */}}
        fs.rmSync(aside,{force:true});
        continue;
      }
      if(Date.now()>deadline)fail('LOCK_TIMEOUT','backlog is locked by another process: '+this.lockFile);
      sleepMs(Math.min(200,20+round*10));
    }
  }

  #holds(token){
    try{return fs.readFileSync(this.lockFile,'utf8').includes('"token":"'+token+'"');}catch(e){if(e.code==='ENOENT')return false;throw e;}
  }

  #release(token){if(this.#holds(token))fs.rmSync(this.lockFile,{force:true});}

  #cleanupInterrupted(){
    const dir=path.dirname(this.file),base=path.basename(this.file);
    for(const name of fs.readdirSync(dir)){
      if(!name.startsWith(base+'.tmp-')&&!name.startsWith(base+'.bak.tmp-'))continue;
      const full=path.join(dir,name);
      try{if(Date.now()-fs.statSync(full).mtimeMs>this.staleLockMs)fs.rmSync(full,{force:true});}catch{/* vanished */}
    }
  }

  /**
   * Read-modify-write under the cross-process lock. `mutate(doc)` returns the
   * next document (e.g. via applyOps). Fails with CONFLICT when
   * expectedRevision is given and differs, or when the file changed although
   * we held the lock (lock broken as stale). Nothing is written then.
   */
  update(mutate,{expectedRevision=null}={}){
    fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(this.file),{recursive:true});
    const token=this.#acquire();
    try{
      this.#cleanupInterrupted();
      const current=this.#load(true);
      if(expectedRevision!==null&&current.doc.revision!==expectedRevision)
        fail('CONFLICT','expected revision '+expectedRevision+', found '+current.doc.revision);
      const next=mutate(current.doc);
      const bytes=encodeDocument(next);
      // a migrated, recovered or new backlog is always written; otherwise only real changes
      const fresh=current.migratedFrom!==null||current.recovered!==null||!current.exists;
      const same=current.bytes!==null&&bytes.equals(current.bytes);
      if(same&&!fresh)return {doc:current.doc,written:false,recovered:null,migratedFrom:null};
      if(!fresh&&next.revision<=current.doc.revision)fail('CONFLICT','a changed document must have a higher revision');
      const tmp=this.file+'.tmp-'+process.pid+'-'+crypto.randomBytes(4).toString('hex');
      writeSynced(tmp,bytes);
      try{
        if(!this.#holds(token))fail('LOCK_LOST','the lock was taken over; nothing written');
        // compare-and-swap: the file must still be what we read
        const now=fs.existsSync(this.file)?fs.readFileSync(this.file):null;
        if(current.bytes&&(!now||!now.equals(current.bytes)))fail('CONFLICT','backlog changed concurrently; nothing written');
        if(!current.bytes&&now&&current.recovered===null&&current.exists===false)fail('CONFLICT','backlog was created concurrently; nothing written');
        if(current.migratedFrom===1&&now&&!fs.existsSync(this.file+'.v1.json'))fs.copyFileSync(this.file,this.file+'.v1.json');
        if(now&&current.recovered===null){
          const bakTmp=this.file+'.bak.tmp-'+process.pid+'-'+crypto.randomBytes(4).toString('hex');
          writeSynced(bakTmp,now);fs.renameSync(bakTmp,this.backupFile);
        }
        fs.renameSync(tmp,this.file);
        fsyncDirectory(path.dirname(this.file));
      }finally{fs.rmSync(tmp,{force:true});}
      const written=decodeDocument(fs.readFileSync(this.file)).doc;
      return {doc:written,written:true,recovered:current.recovered,migratedFrom:current.migratedFrom};
    }finally{this.#release(token);}
  }

  /** Apply operations atomically (stopOnError) or leniently with per-op results. */
  apply(ops,{expectedRevision=null,stopOnError=true}={}){
    let results=[];
    const r=this.update(doc=>{const out=applyOps(doc,ops,{stopOnError});results=out.results;return out.doc;},{expectedRevision});
    return {...r,results};
  }
}

import {analyzeRepository} from './code-analyzer.mjs';
import {findingTask,sha256Hex,singleLine,LIMITS} from './development-backlog.mjs';

/**
 * Offline backlog planner: turns structural findings into small, reviewable
 * investigation tasks. No AI API, no writes, and no claim that a finding is a bug.
 */
export function prioritizeFindings(report,limit=12) {
  if(!report||!Array.isArray(report.findings))throw Error('Invalid analysis report');
  const priorities={DEAD_CLUSTER:3,TEST_ONLY:2,UNREFERENCED:1};
  return report.findings.filter(f=>f&&typeof f.kind==='string')
    .map(f=>({kind:f.kind,symbol:String(f.symbol??f.name??'').slice(0,120),
      file:String(f.file??f.definedIn?.[0]??'').slice(0,250),
      confidence:f.confidence??'unknown',
      score:priorities[f.kind]??0,
      action:'INVESTIGATE_ONLY'}))
    .filter(f=>f.score>0)
    .sort((a,b)=>b.score-a.score||a.file.localeCompare(b.file)||a.symbol.localeCompare(b.symbol))
    .slice(0,Math.max(0,Math.min(30,limit)));
}
export function planBacklog(root,limit=12){
  const {index,...result}=analyzeRepository(root);
  return {schemaVersion:1,mode:'review-required',analyzedAt:new Date().toISOString(),
    tasks:prioritizeFindings(result,limit)};
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Persistent backlog (development-backlog.mjs): planner findings and repair
// sessions become operations with the shared rules; nothing here writes.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

const PLANNED_KINDS=new Set(['DEAD_CLUSTER','TEST_ONLY','UNREFERENCED']);

/**
 * Operations that bring the backlog in line with an analysis report: new
 * findings are proposed (at most `limit` per run, highest priority first),
 * proposals of unchanged findings get their current priority, and proposals
 * whose finding disappeared are aborted with a reason. Accepted or rejected
 * tasks are never touched: that is a human decision.
 */
export function syncBacklogOps(doc,report,{at,actor='code-analyzer',limit=12}){
  if(!report||!Array.isArray(report.findings))throw Error('Invalid analysis report');
  const byId=new Map();
  for(const f of report.findings){
    if(!f||!PLANNED_KINDS.has(f.kind))continue;
    const task=findingTask({kind:f.kind,symbol:String(f.symbol??f.name??''),file:String(f.file??f.definedIn?.[0]??''),confidence:f.confidence});
    if(!byId.has(task.id))byId.set(task.id,task);
  }
  const known=new Map(doc.tasks.map(t=>[t.id,t]));
  const ops=[];let proposed=0;
  for(const task of [...byId.values()].sort((a,b)=>b.priority-a.priority||(a.id<b.id?-1:1))){
    const existing=known.get(task.id);
    if(!existing){
      if(proposed>=limit)continue;
      ops.push({op:'propose',actor,at,ifAbsent:true,task,reason:`finding ${task.subject.finding} (${task.subject.confidence} confidence)`});
      proposed++;
    }else if(existing.state==='PROPOSED'&&existing.priority!==task.priority){
      ops.push({op:'setPriority',actor,at,id:task.id,priority:task.priority});
    }
  }
  for(const t of doc.tasks)
    if(t.source==='code-analyzer'&&t.kind==='INVESTIGATE'&&t.state==='PROPOSED'&&!byId.has(t.id))
      ops.push({op:'abort',actor,at,id:t.id,reason:'finding no longer reported by code-analyzer'});
  return ops;
}

/** Stable task identity of a CI failure: the chain plus the set of diagnostics. */
export function repairTaskId(report){
  const prints=[...new Set((report?.baseline?.diagnostics??[]).filter(d=>d.file&&d.fingerprint).map(d=>d.fingerprint))].sort();
  const key=prints.length?report.chain+'\u0000'+prints.join(','):report.chain+'\u0000base\u0000'+report.base;
  return 'rep-'+sha256Hex(key).slice(0,16);
}

/**
 * Operations recording one repair session (repair-loop report) on its REPAIR
 * task: propose+accept (agent-owned CI repairs need no review to be attempted;
 * the result is still only a draft pull request), claim, then either submit +
 * complete with the evidence of the tests that verified the patch, or fail.
 * Every operation carries an opId derived from the session, so recording the
 * same report twice changes nothing. A task that is finished, failed for good,
 * rejected or held by another execution is not touched (`skipped` says why).
 */
export function repairSessionOps(doc,report,{actor='continuum-agent'}={}){
  if(!report||!/^[0-9a-f]{40}$/.test(report.base??''))throw Error('Repair report needs a full base commit');
  if(report.outcome==='NO_FAILURE')return {id:null,ops:[],skipped:'no failure reproduced'};
  const started=Date.parse(report.startedAt),finished=Date.parse(report.finishedAt??report.startedAt);
  if(!Number.isSafeInteger(started)||!Number.isSafeInteger(finished)||finished<started)throw Error('Repair report timestamps invalid');
  const id=repairTaskId(report);
  const session=sha256Hex(['repair-session',report.base,report.chain,report.startedAt,report.finishedAt??''].join('\u0000'));
  const opId=step=>`repair:${session.slice(0,24)}:${step}`;
  const token=session.slice(0,32);
  const first=(report.baseline?.diagnostics??[]).find(d=>d.file);
  const subject={base:report.base,chain:String(report.chain)};
  if(first){subject.diagnostic=first.fingerprint;subject.file=singleLine(first.file,LIMITS.subjectValue);if(Number.isSafeInteger(first.line))subject.line=first.line;}
  const title=singleLine(`Repair ${report.chain} failure at ${report.base.slice(0,12)}`+(first?`: ${first.kind} ${first.file}${first.line?':'+first.line:''}`:''),LIMITS.title);
  const leaseMs=Math.min(LIMITS.leaseMax,Math.max(LIMITS.leaseMin,finished-started+60_000));
  const existing=doc.tasks.find(t=>t.id===id);
  const recorded=(doc.recentOpIds??[]).includes(opId('claim'));
  if(existing&&!recorded&&!['PROPOSED','READY'].includes(existing.state))return {id,ops:[],skipped:`task ${id} is ${existing.state}`};
  const ops=[
    {op:'propose',actor,at:started,opId:opId('propose'),ifAbsent:true,reason:'CI failure reproduced by the repair loop',
      task:{id,title,kind:'REPAIR',source:'repair-loop',priority:900,maxAttempts:3,subject}}];
  if(!existing||existing.state==='PROPOSED')
    ops.push({op:'accept',actor,at:started,opId:opId('accept'),id,reason:'CI repairs are attempted automatically; results stay draft pull requests'});
  ops.push({op:'claim',actor,at:started,opId:opId('claim'),id,owner:actor,token,leaseMs});
  const attempt=report.verified&&(report.attempts??[]).find(a=>a.outcome==='VERIFIED'&&a.candidate===report.verified.candidate);
  if(attempt){
    const patch=report.verified.patchSha256;
    ops.push({op:'submit',actor,at:finished,opId:opId('submit'),id,token,artifact:{type:'PATCH',sha256:patch}});
    ops.push({op:'complete',actor,at:finished,opId:opId('complete'),id,evidence:{type:'TEST_RUN',taskId:id,submissionToken:token,artifactSha256:patch,
      chain:String(report.chain),commit:report.base,at:finished,by:actor,
      profiles:(attempt.tests??[]).map(t=>({profile:t.profile,passed:t.passed===true,executed:t.tests?.executed??0,failed:t.tests?.failed??0,skipped:t.tests?.skipped??0})),
      repair:{diagnostic:attempt.diagnostic,candidate:attempt.candidate,strategy:attempt.strategy,patchSha256:patch}}});
  }else{
    const tried=(report.attempts??[]).map(a=>a.strategy+'='+a.outcome).join(', ');
    ops.push({op:'fail',actor,at:finished,opId:opId('fail'),id,token,
      error:{code:/^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{1,47}$/.test(report.outcome??'')?report.outcome:'NO_VERIFIED_REPAIR',message:singleLine(tried?'tried '+tried:'no candidate',LIMITS.text)}});
  }
  return {id,ops,skipped:null};
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Persistent backlog integration
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
import {syncBacklogOps,repairSessionOps,repairTaskId} from './development-planner.mjs';
import * as B from './development-backlog.mjs';

const apply=(doc,ops)=>B.applyOps(doc,ops,{stopOnError:false});

test('analyzer findings become proposals once; vanished proposals are withdrawn, human decisions kept',()=>{
  const report={findings:[
    {kind:'DEAD_CLUSTER',symbol:'a.Dead',file:'main/java/a/Dead.kt',confidence:'medium'},
    {kind:'TEST_ONLY',symbol:'a.OnlyTests',file:'main/java/a/OnlyTests.kt',confidence:'medium'},
    {kind:'UNREFERENCED',symbol:'a.Lonely',file:'main/java/a/Lonely.kt',confidence:'high'},
    {kind:'POSSIBLY_UNUSED',symbol:'a.Maybe',file:'main/java/a/Maybe.kt',confidence:'low'}]};
  let doc=B.emptyDocument(0,'t');
  const first=apply(doc,syncBacklogOps(doc,report,{at:1,limit:2}));doc=first.doc;
  assert.deepEqual(doc.tasks.map(t=>t.subject.symbol).sort(),['a.Dead','a.OnlyTests'],'highest priority first, limited per run');
  assert.ok(doc.tasks.every(t=>t.state==='PROPOSED'&&t.subject.file.startsWith('app/src/main/')));
  doc=apply(doc,syncBacklogOps(doc,report,{at:2,limit:2})).doc;
  assert.equal(doc.tasks.length,3,'the remaining finding follows in the next run, nothing is duplicated');
  assert.deepEqual(syncBacklogOps(doc,report,{at:3,limit:2}),[],'a stable analysis changes nothing');
  const dead=doc.tasks.find(t=>t.subject.symbol==='a.Dead'),lonely=doc.tasks.find(t=>t.subject.symbol==='a.Lonely');
  doc=apply(doc,[{op:'accept',actor:'heinz',at:4,id:dead.id},{op:'reject',actor:'heinz',at:4,id:lonely.id,reason:'gewollt'}]).doc;
  const ops=syncBacklogOps(doc,{findings:[]},{at:5});
  assert.deepEqual(ops.map(o=>[o.op,o.id]),[['abort',doc.tasks.find(t=>t.subject.symbol==='a.OnlyTests').id]],'only untouched proposals are withdrawn');
  doc=apply(doc,ops).doc;
  assert.deepEqual(doc.tasks.map(t=>t.state).sort(),['ABORTED','READY','REJECTED']);
  assert.deepEqual(syncBacklogOps(doc,report,{at:6}),[],'rejected or aborted findings are not resurrected');
});

function repairReport({verified=true,base='a'.repeat(40),startedAt='2026-10-15T10:00:00.000Z',finishedAt='2026-10-15T10:20:00.000Z'}={}){
  const tests=[{profile:'android-compile',passed:true,testProfile:false,tests:{executed:0,failed:0,skipped:0}},
    {profile:'android-unit',passed:true,testProfile:true,tests:{executed:413,failed:0,skipped:0}}];
  return {base,chain:'android',startedAt,finishedAt,outcome:verified?'VERIFIED':'NO_VERIFIED_REPAIR',
    baseline:{diagnostics:[{kind:'UNRESOLVED_REFERENCE',file:'app/src/main/java/A.kt',line:7,fingerprint:'0123456789abcdef'}]},
    attempts:[{candidate:'fedcba9876543210',diagnostic:'0123456789abcdef',strategy:'KOTLIN_TYPO_REFERENCE',outcome:verified?'VERIFIED':'FAILED_TESTS',tests}],
    verified:verified?{candidate:'fedcba9876543210',strategy:'KOTLIN_TYPO_REFERENCE',patchSha256:'c'.repeat(64)}:null};
}

test('a verified repair session completes its REPAIR task with the evidence that verified it, exactly once',()=>{
  let doc=B.emptyDocument(0,'t');
  const report=repairReport();
  const {id,ops,skipped}=repairSessionOps(doc,report);
  assert.equal(id,repairTaskId(report));assert.equal(skipped,null);
  const r=apply(doc,ops);
  assert.ok(r.results.every(x=>x.ok&&!x.duplicate),JSON.stringify(r.results));
  doc=r.doc;
  const task=doc.tasks.find(t=>t.id===id);
  assert.equal(task.state,'DONE');
  assert.deepEqual(task.evidence[0].profiles.map(p=>[p.profile,p.executed]),[['android-compile',0],['android-unit',413]]);
  assert.equal(task.evidence[0].repair.strategy,'KOTLIN_TYPO_REFERENCE');
  const again=apply(doc,repairSessionOps(doc,report).ops);
  assert.ok(again.results.every(x=>x.ok&&(x.duplicate||x.changed===false)),'recording the same session twice is a no-op');
  assert.equal(again.doc.revision,doc.revision);
  assert.equal(repairSessionOps(doc,repairReport({startedAt:'2026-10-15T11:00:00.000Z',finishedAt:'2026-10-15T11:10:00.000Z'})).skipped,`task ${id} is DONE`);
});

test('failed repair sessions spend the attempt budget and then stop',()=>{
  let doc=B.emptyDocument(0,'t');
  for(let k=0;k<3;k++){
    const report=repairReport({verified:false,startedAt:`2026-10-15T1${k}:00:00.000Z`,finishedAt:`2026-10-15T1${k}:30:00.000Z`});
    doc=apply(doc,repairSessionOps(doc,report).ops).doc;
  }
  const task=doc.tasks[0];
  assert.deepEqual([task.state,task.attempts,task.error.code],['FAILED',3,'NO_VERIFIED_REPAIR']);
  const fourth=repairSessionOps(doc,repairReport({verified:false,startedAt:'2026-10-15T14:00:00.000Z',finishedAt:'2026-10-15T14:30:00.000Z'}));
  assert.deepEqual(fourth.ops,[]);assert.match(fourth.skipped,/FAILED/);
  assert.deepEqual(repairSessionOps(doc,{...repairReport(),outcome:'NO_FAILURE'}).ops,[]);
});

// Dialogue memory retrieval shared by the GitHub core and mirrored exactly by
// Android ContinuumMemoryDialogue.rank (cross-runtime fixture
// app/src/test/resources/continuum-dialogue.properties).
//
// Method selected on retrieval-benchmark.mjs DEV split, reported once on TEST
// (docs/retrieval-benchmark.json): a memory qualifies only with real word
// evidence (exact word, shared 5-letter prefix or trigram Dice >= 0.6) and is
// ranked by TF-IDF cosine over character 3-5 grams inside content words, with
// IDF learned from the current memory corpus. The neural similarity is still
// computed and reported but has no weight: on the benchmark it changed the
// top-3 order for 44% of queries without a consistent gain (noise tie-breaker).
export const STOP=new Set(['was','wie','weißt','über','und','noch','dazu','darüber','das','die','der','ist','ich','mir','mein','meine','du','bitte','kannst','erzähl','erkläre','welche','dieses','thema',
  'den','dem','des','ein','eine','einer','eines','einem','einen','mit','von','vom','zum','zur','für','auf','aus','bei','sich','sie','er','es','wir','ihr','sind','wird','werden','wurde','wurden','hat','haben','im','in','an','am','zu','oder','als','auch','nicht','nur','man','wo','wer','warum','wieso','weshalb','wann','woher','wohin','womit','woraus','worauf','gibt','kann','macht','dass','dabei','dadurch','deshalb','heute','meist','oft','etwa','viele','vielen','ganz','später','früher','etwas','mehr','erzähle','sag','sage','weiß','kennst','bekannt']);
export const EVIDENCE_THRESHOLD=0.6;
export const words=t=>(String(t).toLowerCase().match(/[\p{L}\p{N}]+/gu)??[]);
export const contentWords=t=>words(t).filter(w=>w.length>=3&&!STOP.has(w));
export function wordGrams(t){
  const m=new Map();
  for(const w of contentWords(t)){const p='^'+w+'$';for(let k=3;k<=5;k++)for(let i=0;i<=p.length-k;i++){const g=p.slice(i,i+k);m.set(g,(m.get(g)??0)+1);}}
  return m;
}
export function idfOf(docs,feature=wordGrams){
  const df=new Map();for(const d of docs)for(const g of feature(d).keys())df.set(g,(df.get(g)??0)+1);
  const N=docs.length,idf=new Map();for(const [g,c] of df)idf.set(g,Math.log((N+1)/(c+0.5)));
  return {get:g=>idf.get(g)??Math.log(N+1)};
}
export function weigh(counts,idf){const v=new Map();for(const [g,c] of counts)v.set(g,(1+Math.log(c))*idf.get(g));return v;}
export function cosine(a,b){let d=0,na=0,nb=0;for(const [g,x] of a){na+=x*x;const y=b.get(g);if(y)d+=x*y;}for(const y of b.values())nb+=y*y;return na&&nb?d/Math.sqrt(na*nb):0;}
const trigrams=w=>{const p='^'+w+'$',s=new Set();for(let i=0;i<=p.length-3;i++)s.add(p.slice(i,i+3));return s;};
export function wordEvidence(query,text){
  const q=contentWords(query),t=[...new Set(contentWords(text))];
  let best=0;
  for(const a of q)for(const b of t){
    if(a===b)return 1;
    if(a.length>=5&&b.length>=5&&a.slice(0,5)===b.slice(0,5))best=Math.max(best,0.8);
    const A=trigrams(a),B=trigrams(b);let i=0;for(const x of A)if(B.has(x))i++;
    best=Math.max(best,2*i/(A.size+B.size));
  }
  return best;
}
/** memories: [{id,text,...}]; semantic(query,text) optional, reported only. */
export function rankMemories(query,memories,{semantic=null,limit=3}={}){
  const q=String(query).slice(0,1000);
  const idf=idfOf(memories.map(m=>String(m.text).slice(0,1000)));
  const qv=weigh(wordGrams(q),idf);
  return memories.map(m=>{
    const text=String(m.text).slice(0,1000);
    const evidence=wordEvidence(q,text);
    if(evidence<EVIDENCE_THRESHOLD)return null;
    const score=cosine(qv,weigh(wordGrams(text),idf));
    if(!(score>0))return null;
    let sem=0.5;if(semantic)try{sem=semantic(q,text);}catch{}
    return {...m,evidence,score,semantic:sem};
  }).filter(Boolean).sort((a,b)=>b.score-a.score||String(a.id).localeCompare(String(b.id))).slice(0,limit);
}

FILE 38/375: .github/continuum/kotlin-tokenizer.mjs
SHA-256: 9c92cfe7d63ed9312a4c27b41085d8fe4fd79d11ca4c3a9049128c3032c5cf8e
============================================================================
// Bounded Kotlin lexer for read-only structural analysis. It understands nested
// block comments, escaped/raw strings with ${...} templates, char literals and
// backtick identifiers, so identifiers inside comments or plain string text are
// never mistaken for code references, while template expressions are.
// Hard keywords only (plus import): soft keywords and modifiers such as `value`,
// `data`, `get` or `field` are valid identifiers and must stay references.
const KEYWORDS=new Set(('as break class continue do else false for fun if in interface is null object package '+
 'return super this throw true try typealias typeof val var when while import').split(' '));
export const isKeyword=word=>KEYWORDS.has(word);

const isIdStart=c=>/[\p{L}_]/u.test(c);
const isIdPart=c=>/[\p{L}\p{N}_]/u.test(c);

export function tokenize(source,{maxTokens=400000}={}){
  if(typeof source!=='string')throw Error('Source must be text');
  const out=[];let i=0,line=1,col=1;
  const n=source.length;
  const advance=k=>{for(let j=0;j<k;j++){if(source[i]==='\n'){line++;col=1;}else col++;i++;}};
  const push=(type,text,l,c)=>{if(out.length>=maxTokens)throw Error('Token limit exceeded');out.push({type,text,line:l,col:c});};
  // Template expression inside a string: lex the code between braces recursively.
  function templateExpression(){
    const l=line,c=col;advance(2);let depth=1;const start=i,sl=l,sc=c+2;
    while(i<n&&depth>0){
      const ch=source[i];
      if(ch==='"'){skipString(false);continue;}
      if(ch==='{')depth++;else if(ch==='}'){depth--;if(depth===0)break;}
      advance(1);
    }
    const inner=source.slice(start,i);
    for(const t of tokenize(inner,{maxTokens:maxTokens-out.length})){
      push(t.type,t.text,t.line+sl-1,t.line===1?t.col+sc-1:t.col);
    }
    if(i<n)advance(1);
  }
  function skipString(emit){
    const l=line,c=col;
    const raw=source.startsWith('"""',i);
    advance(raw?3:1);
    while(i<n){
      if(raw&&source.startsWith('"""',i)){
        while(source.startsWith('""""',i))advance(1); // trailing quotes belong to content
        advance(3);break;
      }
      const ch=source[i];
      if(!raw&&ch==='\\'){advance(2);continue;}
      if(!raw&&(ch==='"')){advance(1);break;}
      if(!raw&&ch==='\n')break; // unterminated: stop at line end, compiler reports it
      if(ch==='$'&&source[i+1]==='{'&&emit){templateExpression();continue;}
      if(ch==='$'&&emit&&isIdStart(source[i+1]??'')){
        advance(1);const tl=line,tc=col;let j=i;while(j<n&&isIdPart(source[j]))j++;
        push('id',source.slice(i,j),tl,tc);advance(j-i);continue;
      }
      advance(1);
    }
    if(emit)push('str','',l,c);
  }
  while(i<n){
    const ch=source[i];
    if(ch==='\n'||ch===' '||ch==='\t'||ch==='\r'||ch==='\f'){advance(1);continue;}
    if(ch==='/'&&source[i+1]==='/'){while(i<n&&source[i]!=='\n')advance(1);continue;}
    if(ch==='/'&&source[i+1]==='*'){
      let depth=0;
      do{
        if(source.startsWith('/*',i)){depth++;advance(2);}
        else if(source.startsWith('*/',i)){depth--;advance(2);}
        else advance(1);
      }while(i<n&&depth>0);
      continue;
    }
    if(ch==='"'){skipString(true);continue;}
    if(ch==="'"){
      const l=line,c=col;advance(1);
      while(i<n&&source[i]!=="'"&&source[i]!=='\n'){if(source[i]==='\\')advance(1);advance(1);}
      if(source[i]==="'")advance(1);
      push('char','',l,c);continue;
    }
    if(ch==='`'){
      const l=line,c=col;advance(1);const start=i;
      while(i<n&&source[i]!=='`'&&source[i]!=='\n')advance(1);
      push('id',source.slice(start,i),l,c);if(source[i]==='`')advance(1);continue;
    }
    if(/[0-9]/.test(ch)){
      const l=line,c=col;let j=i;
      while(j<n&&/[0-9a-zA-Z_.]/.test(source[j])){if(source[j]==='.'&&!/[0-9]/.test(source[j+1]??''))break;j++;}
      push('num',source.slice(i,j),l,c);advance(j-i);continue;
    }
    if(isIdStart(ch)){
      const l=line,c=col;let j=i;while(j<n&&isIdPart(source[j]))j++;
      const word=source.slice(i,j);push(KEYWORDS.has(word)?'kw':'id',word,l,c);advance(j-i);continue;
    }
    if(ch==='@'){
      const l=line,c=col;advance(1);
      if(isIdStart(source[i]??'')){let j=i;while(j<n&&isIdPart(source[j]))j++;push('annotation',source.slice(i,j),l,c);advance(j-i);}
      continue;
    }
    const three=source.slice(i,i+3),two=source.slice(i,i+2);
    const op=['===','!==','...','?.:'].includes(three)?three:
      ['::','->','?.','?:','!!','&&','||','==','!=','<=','>=','+=','-=','*=','/=','%=','++','--','..'].includes(two)?two:ch;
    push('op',op,line,col);advance(op.length);
  }
  return out;
}

import {SubwordEncoder,sha256,buckets} from './portable-subword.mjs';

const VERSION=1, MAX_REPLAY=96;
const normalize=s=>s.toLowerCase().replace(/[^\p{L}\p{N}]+/gu,' ').trim();
const reserved=new Set([VALIDATION,AUDIT].flatMap(s=>[...s.intent.map(x=>x.text),...s.semantic.flatMap(x=>[x.left,x.right])]).map(normalize));
export const SUITE_HASH=sha256(JSON.stringify({VALIDATION,AUDIT}));
export function createNeuralState(){
  const bytes=new SubwordEncoder().save();
  return {version:VERSION,rounds:0,accepted:0,paused:false,model:bytes.toString('base64'),modelHash:sha256(bytes),lastKnownGood:null,replay:[],history:[]};
}
export function restoreNeuralState(value){
  if(value==null)return createNeuralState();
  if(value.version!==VERSION||!Array.isArray(value.replay)||value.replay.length>MAX_REPLAY||!Array.isArray(value.history)||value.history.length>64)throw Error('Invalid neural state');
  const bytes=Buffer.from(value.model,'base64');
  if(sha256(bytes)!==value.modelHash)throw Error('Neural model hash mismatch');
  SubwordEncoder.restore(bytes);
  for(const e of value.replay){
    if(e.trust!=='PUBLIC_OBSERVATION'||!publicUrl(e.url)||typeof e.left!=='string'||typeof e.right!=='string'||e.hash!==sha256(e.left+'\n'+e.right+'\n'+e.url))throw Error('Invalid replay provenance');
    buckets(e.left);buckets(e.right);
  }
  return structuredClone(value);
}
export const exportWeights=state=>Buffer.from(restoreNeuralState(state).model,'base64');
export const evaluateSuite=(model,suite)=>({intent:model.evaluate(suite.intent),semantic:model.evaluate(suite.semantic)});
function publicUrl(value){try{const u=new URL(value);return u.protocol==='https:'&&!u.username&&!u.password&&!/^(localhost|127\.|10\.|192\.168\.|172\.(1[6-9]|2\d|3[01])\.|\[|169\.254\.)/.test(u.hostname)&&u.hostname.includes('.');}catch{return false;}}
export function ingestPublicSources(value,sources,now=Date.now()){
  const state=restoreNeuralState(value);
  for(const source of sources.slice(0,256)){
    if(!['PublicWeb','Wikipedia','OpenAlex','Crossref','arXiv','GitHub'].includes(source.source)||!publicUrl(source.url))continue;
    const left=String(source.title??'').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim().slice(0,256);
    const right=String(source.text??'').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim().slice(0,1000);
    if(left.length<4||right.length<40||reserved.has(normalize(left))||reserved.has(normalize(right)))continue;
    try{buckets(left);buckets(right);}catch{continue;}
    const hash=sha256(left+'\n'+right+'\n'+source.url);
    if(state.replay.some(e=>e.hash===hash))continue;
    state.replay.push({id:'public-'+hash.slice(0,20),hash,left,right,url:source.url,source:source.source,at:now,trust:'PUBLIC_OBSERVATION',status:'REPLAY_PENDING',replays:0});
  }
  // Deterministic hash-priority reservoir: retains old material across restarts,
  // prevents a single large new batch from evicting all previous experience.
  state.replay.sort((a,b)=>a.hash.localeCompare(b.hash));state.replay=state.replay.slice(0,MAX_REPLAY);
  return state;
}
function noRegression(before,after){return ['intent','semantic'].every(k=>after[k].correct>=before[k].correct&&after[k].loss<=before[k].loss+.015);}
export function trainRound(value,{steps=12000,now=Date.now(),cancelled=()=>false,maxMillis=25000}={}){
  if(!Number.isInteger(steps)||steps<1||steps>24000||!Number.isInteger(maxMillis)||maxMillis<1||maxMillis>30000)throw Error('Invalid training budget');
  const state=restoreNeuralState(value),baseline=SubwordEncoder.restore(exportWeights(state)),candidate=SubwordEncoder.restore(baseline.save());
  const androidBefore=evaluateSuite(baseline,ANDROID_VALIDATION);
  const validationBefore=evaluateSuite(baseline,VALIDATION),retentionBefore=evaluateSuite(baseline,TRAIN);
  const start=performance.now();let completed=0,sourceUpdates=0,selected=null,selectedSteps=0;
  const replayCounts=new Map();let selectedReplayCounts=new Map();
  let bestLoss=validationBefore.intent.loss+validationBefore.semantic.loss;
  // Rotate curriculum across rounds; both tasks always replay in the same round.
  const offset=state.rounds*17;
  for(;completed<steps&&!state.paused&&!cancelled()&&performance.now()-start<maxMillis;completed++){
    const n=Math.floor(completed/2)+offset;
    if(completed%2===0)candidate.updateIntent(TRAIN.intent[n%TRAIN.intent.length]);
    else if(state.replay.length&&n%8===7){
      const e=state.replay[Math.floor(n/8)%state.replay.length];
      candidate.updateSemantic({left:e.left,right:e.right,similar:true},.035);sourceUpdates++;
      replayCounts.set(e.id,(replayCounts.get(e.id)??0)+1);
    }else candidate.updateSemantic(TRAIN.semantic[n%TRAIN.semantic.length]);
    // Selection sees validation only. Report-only audit is evaluated after selection.
    if((completed+1)%1000===0||completed+1===steps){
      const v=evaluateSuite(candidate,VALIDATION),r=evaluateSuite(candidate,TRAIN);
      const loss=v.intent.loss+v.semantic.loss;
      if(noRegression(validationBefore,v)&&noRegression(retentionBefore,r)&&noRegression(androidBefore,evaluateSuite(candidate,ANDROID_VALIDATION))&&loss<bestLoss-.001){
        selected=candidate.save();selectedSteps=completed+1;bestLoss=loss;selectedReplayCounts=new Map(replayCounts);
      }
    }
  }
  const proposed=selected?SubwordEncoder.restore(selected):candidate;
  const validationAfter=evaluateSuite(proposed,VALIDATION),retentionAfter=evaluateSuite(proposed,TRAIN);
  const complete=completed===steps&&!cancelled()&&!state.paused;
  const gain=['intent','semantic'].some(k=>validationAfter[k].loss<validationBefore[k].loss-.001);
  const accepted=complete&&selected!==null&&gain&&noRegression(validationBefore,validationAfter)&&noRegression(retentionBefore,retentionAfter);
  const beforeBytes=baseline.save(),afterBytes=proposed.save();
  const report={version:1,round:state.rounds+1,at:now,steps:completed,selectedSteps,sourceUpdates,accepted,
    reason:!complete?'PAUSED_OR_INTERRUPTED':!noRegression(validationBefore,validationAfter)?'VALIDATION_REGRESSION':!noRegression(retentionBefore,retentionAfter)?'REPLAY_REGRESSION':!gain?'NO_MEASURED_GAIN':'MULTITASK_GATE_PASSED',
    baselineHash:sha256(beforeBytes),candidateHash:sha256(afterBytes),suiteHash:SUITE_HASH,
    validationBefore,validationAfter,retentionBefore,retentionAfter,androidBefore,androidAfter:evaluateSuite(proposed,ANDROID_VALIDATION),
    auditBefore:evaluateSuite(baseline,AUDIT),auditAfter:evaluateSuite(proposed,AUDIT),auditUsedForSelection:false,
    benchmarkKind:'AUTHORED_SMALL_HOLDOUT_NOT_EXTERNAL_CERTIFICATION',replayExamples:state.replay.length};
  state.rounds++;if(accepted){state.accepted++;state.lastKnownGood=state.model;state.model=afterBytes.toString('base64');state.modelHash=report.candidateHash;
    for(const e of state.replay){const used=selectedReplayCounts.get(e.id)??0;if(used){e.replays+=used;e.status='REPLAYED_IN_ACCEPTED_MODEL';}} // Participation, not a truth claim.
  }
  state.history=[...state.history,report].slice(-64);
  return {state,report};
}
export function neuralStatus(value){
  const s=restoreNeuralState(value),m=SubwordEncoder.restore(exportWeights(s)),audit=evaluateSuite(m,AUDIT),last=s.history.at(-1);
  return {version:1,modelHash:s.modelHash,updates:m.updates,rounds:s.rounds,accepted:s.accepted,paused:s.paused,replay:s.replay.length,audit,suiteHash:SUITE_HASH,lastDecision:last?.reason??'NOT_TRAINED'};
}
export function formatNeuralStatus(value){
  const s=neuralStatus(value);
  return '**Neuronaler Kern:** '+s.updates+' Gewichtsupdates · '+s.accepted+'/'+s.rounds+' Lernrunden übernommen'+(s.paused?' · PAUSIERT':'')+'\n'+
    '**Separater Audit:** Intent '+s.audit.intent.correct+'/'+s.audit.intent.total+' (Loss '+s.audit.intent.loss.toFixed(4)+'), Semantik '+s.audit.semantic.correct+'/'+s.audit.semantic.total+' (Loss '+s.audit.semantic.loss.toFixed(4)+')\n'+
    '**Replay:** '+s.replay+' öffentliche Beobachtungen · letzte Entscheidung '+s.lastDecision+'\n'+
    'Kleine selbst verfasste Testmenge, keine externe Zertifizierung; Audit-Beispiele steuern weder Gradienten noch Modellfreigabe.';
}

export function selectNeuralResearchTarget(value){
 const state=restoreNeuralState(value);if(!state.replay.length)return null;
 const model=SubwordEncoder.restore(exportWeights(state));
 const ranked=state.replay.map(e=>{
   const p=model.similarity(e.left,e.right);
   const uncertainty=1-Math.abs(p-.5)*2;
   return {e,score:uncertainty/(1+Number(e.researchAttempts??0))+.1/(1+e.replays)};
 }).sort((a,b)=>b.score-a.score||a.e.id.localeCompare(b.e.id));
 const chosen=ranked[0];
 return {type:'neural-curiosity',experienceId:chosen.e.id,score:chosen.score,
   text:'Welche unabhängigen Experimente prüfen oder widerlegen die Aussagen zu '+chosen.e.left+'?'};
}

test('gradient updates change shared weights and survive checksummed restore', () => {
  const m=new SubwordEncoder(); const before=m.evaluate(TRAIN.intent).loss;
  for(let i=0;i<8000;i++)m.updateIntent(TRAIN.intent[i%TRAIN.intent.length],.12);
  assert.ok(m.evaluate(TRAIN.intent).loss<before*.75);
  const bytes=m.save(), restored=SubwordEncoder.restore(bytes);
  assert.equal(m.intentScore('Wie lernst du?'),restored.intentScore('Wie lernst du?'));
  bytes[40]^=1; assert.throws(()=>SubwordEncoder.restore(bytes),/checksum/);
  assert.throws(()=>buckets('!!!'));
});

test('curriculum, selection validation and audit have disjoint normalized texts',()=>{
  const texts=s=>new Set([...s.intent.map(x=>x.text),...s.semantic.flatMap(x=>[x.left,x.right])].map(x=>x.toLowerCase().replace(/[^\p{L}\p{N}]/gu,'')));
  const sets=[TRAIN,VALIDATION,AUDIT].map(texts);

test('bounded training is persistent, multitask gated and rollback is byte exact',()=>{
  const state=createNeuralState();
  const result=trainRound(state,{steps:12000,now:1000});
  assert.ok(result.report.steps>0);
  assert.ok(result.report.candidateHash!==result.report.baselineHash);
  assert.equal(result.report.auditUsedForSelection,false);
  assert.ok(result.report.accepted,'first curriculum round should demonstrate held-out gain');
  for(const task of ['intent','semantic'])assert.ok(result.report.validationAfter[task].correct>=result.report.validationBefore[task].correct);
  const reloaded=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(result.state));
  assert.deepEqual(exportWeights(reloaded),exportWeights(result.state));
  const cancelled=trainRound(reloaded,{steps:200,cancelled:()=>true,now:2000});
  assert.equal(cancelled.report.accepted,false);
  assert.deepEqual(exportWeights(cancelled.state),exportWeights(reloaded));
  assert.ok(evaluateSuite(SubwordEncoder.restore(exportWeights(reloaded)),AUDIT).intent.total>=20);
});

});

import {SubwordEncoder,sha256} from './portable-subword.mjs';
import {exportWeights} from './neural-core.mjs';
import {rankMemories} from './dialogue-retrieval.mjs';
export function dialogueTurn(state,input,now=Date.now()){
  const text=String(input).trim().slice(0,1200);
  state.dialogue??={turns:[],topic:''};
  const followUp=/\b(darüber|dazu|damit|weiter|noch mehr|und warum|und wie)\b/i.test(text);
  const resolvedQuery=followUp&&state.dialogue.topic?state.dialogue.topic+' '+text:text;
  const previousTopic=state.dialogue.topic||'';
  const weights=exportWeights(state.neural),modelHash=sha256(weights);
  const memories=[
    ...(state.lessons??[]).map(x=>({id:x.id,text:x.text,kind:'Nutzerlektion',urls:[]})),
    ...(state.baby?.beliefs??[]).filter(x=>x.status==='GROUNDED_OBSERVATION'&&x.evidenceMode==='EXPLICIT_CITATION').map(x=>({id:x.id,text:x.text,kind:'Quellenbeobachtung',urls:x.citationUrls??[]}))
  ];
  const greeting=/^(hallo|servus|guten (morgen|tag|abend)|hey)[!.\s]*$/i.test(text);
  const ranked=greeting?[]:rankDialogueMemories(weights,resolvedQuery,memories);
  // A topic is established by successful retrieval, never by a greeting or a
  // question for which the system has no evidence.
  if(!greeting)state.dialogue.topic=ranked.length?(followUp?previousTopic:text.slice(0,320)):'';
  let answer;
  if(greeting)answer='Hallo Heinz. Worüber möchtest du sprechen? Ich kann an unsere gespeicherten Themen anknüpfen.';
  else if(!ranked.length)answer='Dazu habe ich noch keine passende belegte Erinnerung. Mit `/learn <Text>` kannst du mir etwas ausdrücklich beibringen; mit `/research <Frage>` kann ich Quellen dazu suchen.';
  else answer=(followUp?'Ich knüpfe an unser Thema an. ':'Dazu finde ich in meinem Gedächtnis: ')+ranked.map(m=>'\n\n'+m.text.slice(0,650)+'\n('+m.kind+(m.urls.length?'; '+m.urls.slice(0,2).join(' · '):'')+')').join('')+'\n\nSoll ich einen dieser Punkte genauer untersuchen?';
  let intentScore=null;try{intentScore=SubwordEncoder.restore(weights).intentScore(text);}catch{}
  state.dialogue.turns=[...(state.dialogue.turns??[]),{at:now,input:text,answer,resolvedQuery,memoryIds:ranked.map(x=>x.id),intentScore,modelHash}].slice(-32);
  return {answer,resolvedQuery,memoryIds:ranked.map(x=>x.id),intentScore,modelHash};
}

export function rankDialogueMemories(weights,query,memories){
 const model=SubwordEncoder.restore(weights);
 return rankMemories(query,memories,{semantic:(a,b)=>model.similarity(a,b)});
}

FILE 46/375: .github/continuum/portable-subword.mjs

// Byte-compatible with Kotlin TrainableSubwordEncoder / LearningSnapshot SWB1.
// Original random weights; no model downloads or third-party inference.
import crypto from 'node:crypto';
export const sha256=bytes=>crypto.createHash('sha256').update(bytes).digest('hex');
const D=16, B=256, SCALE=2.5, CLIP=8;
const sigmoid=x=>x>=0?1/(1+Math.exp(-x)):Math.exp(x)/(1+Math.exp(x));
const clip=x=>Math.max(-CLIP,Math.min(CLIP,x));
function javaRandom(seed){
  let s=(BigInt(seed)^0x5deece66dn)&((1n<<48n)-1n);
  const next=n=>{s=(s*0x5deece66dn+11n)&((1n<<48n)-1n);return Number(s>>BigInt(48-n));};
  return ()=>((next(26)*134217728)+next(27))/9007199254740992;
}
export function buckets(text){
  if(typeof text!=='string'||text.length<1||text.length>2048)throw Error('Invalid encoder text');
  const normalized=text.toLowerCase().replace(/[^\p{L}\p{N}]+/gu,' ').trim().slice(0,512);
  if(!normalized)throw Error('Empty encoder text');
  const padded='^'+normalized+'$', values=new Set();
  const hash=value=>{let h=0x811c9dc5;for(const byte of Buffer.from(value,'utf8'))h=Math.imul(h^byte,0x01000193)>>>0;return h%B;};
  for(let n=2;n<=4&&values.size<128;n++)for(let i=0;i<=padded.length-n;i++){
    values.add(hash(padded.slice(i,i+n)));if(values.size>=128)break;
  }
  if(!values.size)values.add(hash(padded));
  return [...values];
}
export class SubwordEncoder {
  constructor(seed=73){
    this.seed=BigInt(seed);this.updates=0;
    const e=javaRandom(this.seed),h=javaRandom(this.seed^0x51a7n);
    this.embeddings=Array.from({length:B*D},()=> (e()*2-1)*.08);
    this.head=Array.from({length:D+1},(_,i)=>i===D?0:(h()*2-1)*.08);
    this.cache=new Map();
  }
  features(text){
    if(!this.cache.has(text)){if(this.cache.size>=1024)this.cache.clear();this.cache.set(text,buckets(text));}
    return this.cache.get(text);
  }
  encodeBuckets(ids){const z=Array(D).fill(0);for(const b of ids)for(let i=0;i<D;i++)z[i]+=this.embeddings[b*D+i];return z.map(x=>Math.tanh(x/ids.length));}
  encode(text){return this.encodeBuckets(this.features(text));}
  intentScore(text){const z=this.encode(text);return sigmoid(z.reduce((s,x,i)=>s+x*this.head[i],this.head[D]));}
  similarity(left,right){const a=this.encode(left),b=this.encode(right);return sigmoid(SCALE*a.reduce((s,x,i)=>s+x*b[i],0));}
  updateIntent(ex,rate=.12){
    if(![0,1].includes(ex.label)||!Number.isFinite(rate)||rate<=0||rate>.15)throw Error('Invalid training example/rate');
    const ids=this.features(ex.text),z=this.encodeBuckets(ids),old=this.head.slice();
    const error=sigmoid(z.reduce((s,x,i)=>s+x*old[i],old[D]))-ex.label;
    for(let i=0;i<D;i++)this.head[i]=clip(old[i]-rate*error*z[i]);
    this.head[D]=clip(old[D]-rate*error);
    for(const b of ids)for(let i=0;i<D;i++)this.embeddings[b*D+i]=clip(this.embeddings[b*D+i]-rate*error*old[i]*(1-z[i]*z[i])/ids.length);
    this.updates=Math.min(1000000,this.updates+1);
  }
  updateSemantic(ex,rate=.10){
    if(typeof ex.similar!=='boolean'||!Number.isFinite(rate)||rate<=0||rate>.12)throw Error('Invalid semantic example/rate');
    const ai=this.features(ex.left),bi=this.features(ex.right),a=this.encodeBuckets(ai),b=this.encodeBuckets(bi);
    const error=sigmoid(SCALE*a.reduce((s,x,i)=>s+x*b[i],0))-(ex.similar?1:0);
    const ga=a.map((x,i)=>error*SCALE*b[i]*(1-x*x)),gb=b.map((x,i)=>error*SCALE*a[i]*(1-x*x));
    for(const id of ai)for(let i=0;i<D;i++)this.embeddings[id*D+i]=clip(this.embeddings[id*D+i]-rate*ga[i]/ai.length);
    for(const id of bi)for(let i=0;i<D;i++)this.embeddings[id*D+i]=clip(this.embeddings[id*D+i]-rate*gb[i]/bi.length);
    this.updates=Math.min(1000000,this.updates+1);
  }
  evaluate(examples){
    if(!examples.length)throw Error('Empty evaluation');
    let loss=0,correct=0;
    for(const e of examples){const p=Math.max(1e-9,Math.min(1-1e-9,'label' in e?this.intentScore(e.text):this.similarity(e.left,e.right)));const y='label'in e?e.label:Number(e.similar);loss-=y*Math.log(p)+(1-y)*Math.log(1-p);correct+=Number((p>=.5)===(y===1));}
    return {loss:loss/examples.length,correct,total:examples.length};
  }
  save(){
    const body=Buffer.alloc(24+(B*D+D+1)*8);let o=0;
    body.writeInt32BE(0x53574231,o);o+=4;body.writeBigInt64BE(this.seed,o);o+=8;body.writeInt32BE(this.updates,o);o+=4;
    for(const row of [this.embeddings,this.head]){body.writeInt32BE(row.length,o);o+=4;for(const v of row){if(!Number.isFinite(v)||Math.abs(v)>8)throw Error('Nonfinite weights');body.writeDoubleBE(v,o);o+=8;}}
    return Buffer.concat([body,Buffer.from(sha256(body),'hex')]);
  }
  static restore(bytes){
    const data=Buffer.from(bytes);if(data.length!==32960)throw Error('Invalid SWB1 size');
    const body=data.subarray(0,-32);if(!crypto.timingSafeEqual(Buffer.from(sha256(body),'hex'),data.subarray(-32)))throw Error('SWB1 checksum mismatch');
    let o=0;if(body.readInt32BE(o)!==0x53574231)throw Error('Invalid SWB1 version');o+=4;
    const m=new SubwordEncoder(body.readBigInt64BE(o));o+=8;m.updates=body.readInt32BE(o);o+=4;
    if(m.updates<0||m.updates>1000000)throw Error('Invalid updates');
    for(const key of ['embeddings','head']){const size=body.readInt32BE(o);o+=4;if(size!==m[key].length)throw Error('Invalid dimensions');m[key]=Array.from({length:size},()=>{const x=body.readDoubleBE(o);o+=8;if(!Number.isFinite(x)||Math.abs(x)>8)throw Error('Invalid weights');return x;});}
    return m;
  }
}
