FILE 47/375: .github/continuum/progress-watcher.mjs

import {neuralStatus} from "./neural-core.mjs";
// Deterministic, offline Continuum progress observations.
// Activity counters are not evidence of intelligence or model improvement.
const LIMIT = 64;
const TASKS = ["intent", "semanticSimilarity", "replayRetention"];

const count = value => Array.isArray(value) ? value.length : 0;
const ratio = (numerator, denominator) => denominator > 0 ? numerator / denominator : null;
const finiteTime = value => Number.isSafeInteger(value) && value >= 0;

export function captureProgressSample(state, at = Date.now()) {
  const beliefs = Array.isArray(state?.baby?.beliefs) ? state.baby.beliefs : [];
  const quarantined = count(state?.baby?.quarantinedBeliefs);
  const explicit = beliefs.filter(b => b?.evidenceMode === "EXPLICIT_CITATION" &&
    Array.isArray(b.citationUrls) && b.citationUrls.some(validPublicCitation)).length;
  const grounded = beliefs.filter(b => b?.status === "GROUNDED_OBSERVATION").length;
  const cycles = Array.isArray(state?.cycles) ? state.cycles : [];
  const successful = cycles.filter(c => c?.success === true).length;
  const sample = {
    version: 1,
    at: finiteTime(at) ? at : 0,
    generation: Math.max(0, Math.trunc(Number(state?.generation) || 0)),
    research: {cycles: cycles.length, successful, failed: cycles.length-successful},
    memory: {
      active: beliefs.length,
      grounded,
      explicitlyCited: explicit,
      quarantined,
      citationCoverage: ratio(explicit, beliefs.length)
    },
    benchmark: state?.neural ? neuralStatus(state.neural) : "NOT_EVALUATED"
  };
  return sample;
}

function validPublicCitation(value) {
  try {
    const url = new URL(String(value || ""));
    return ["http:", "https:"].includes(url.protocol) && !url.username && !url.password;
  } catch { return false; }
}

function fingerprint(sample) {
  // Generation and timestamp are deliberately excluded: status requests are not learning.
  return JSON.stringify([sample.research, sample.memory, sample.benchmark]);
}

export function appendProgressSample(history, sample) {
  const previous = Array.isArray(history) ? history.filter(x => x?.version === 1).slice(-LIMIT) : [];
  if (!sample || sample.version !== 1 || !sample.memory || !sample.research) return previous;
  if (previous.length && fingerprint(previous[previous.length-1]) === fingerprint(sample)) return previous;
  return [...previous, structuredClone(sample)].slice(-LIMIT);
}

export function progressTrend(history) {
  const rows = Array.isArray(history) ? history.filter(x => x?.version === 1) : [];
  if (rows.length < 2) return {status:"BASELINE_ONLY", change:null, message:"Noch keine vergleichbare zweite Messung."};
  const a=rows[rows.length-2], b=rows[rows.length-1];
  // Coverage is a narrow data-quality proxy, not a measure of model accuracy.
  if (a.memory?.active < 5 || b.memory?.active < 5 ||
      !Number.isFinite(a.memory?.citationCoverage) ||
      !Number.isFinite(b.memory?.citationCoverage)) {
    return {status:"INSUFFICIENT_DATA",change:null,message:"Zu wenige aktive Überzeugungen für einen stabilen Quotenvergleich."};
  }
  const change=b.memory.citationCoverage-a.memory.citationCoverage;
  const status=change >= .05 ? "CITATION_COVERAGE_INCREASED" :
    change <= -.05 ? "CITATION_COVERAGE_DECREASED" : "NO_MATERIAL_COVERAGE_CHANGE";
  return {status,change,previous:a.memory.citationCoverage,current:b.memory.citationCoverage,
    message:"Nur Änderung der expliziten Zitationsabdeckung; kein Lern- oder Intelligenznachweis."};
}

export function formatProgressReport(history, current) {
  const rows=appendProgressSample(history,current);
  const trend=progressTrend(rows);
  const m=current.memory, r=current.research;
  const percent=m.citationCoverage === null ? "keine Daten" : (m.citationCoverage*100).toFixed(1)+"%";
  return [
    "## Continuum · Fortschrittswächter",
    "",
    "**Forschungsaktivität:** "+r.cycles+" Zyklen · "+r.successful+" erfolgreich · "+r.failed+" fehlgeschlagen",
    "**Wissensqualität:** "+m.active+" aktive Überzeugungen · "+m.explicitlyCited+" mit expliziter Quellenreferenz · "+m.quarantined+" in Quarantäne",
    "**Zitationsabdeckung:** "+percent,
    "**Trend:** "+trend.status+(trend.change==null?"":" · "+(trend.change*100).toFixed(1)+" Prozentpunkte"),
    current.benchmark === "NOT_EVALUATED"
      ? "**Neuronale Testleistung:** NICHT GEMESSEN (kein lokaler Held-out-Benchmark an diese Console angeschlossen)"
      : "**Neuronaler Audit (separat, klein, selbst verfasst):** Intent "+current.benchmark.audit.intent.correct+"/"+current.benchmark.audit.intent.total+
        " · Semantik "+current.benchmark.audit.semantic.correct+"/"+current.benchmark.audit.semantic.total+
        " · Gewichtsupdates "+current.benchmark.updates+" · übernommene Runden "+current.benchmark.accepted+"/"+current.benchmark.rounds,

    "",
    "_Mehr Recherche, mehr Speicher und höhere interne Rewards sind keine Belege für bessere Modellleistung. "+
    "Eine Zitation ist nicht automatisch eine geprüfte wahre Aussage. "+
    "Modellfreigaben verwenden getrennte Validierungs- und Replay-Prüfungen; der Audit steuert keine Freigabe._"
  ].join("\n");
}

// Pure decision policy for a future on-device evaluation harness. The caller must
// independently authenticate and reproduce these measurements. This function
// neither trains a model nor writes weights, state, files or permissions.
export function assessLearningCandidate(baseline, candidate, {
  minimumGain = .01, maximumTaskRegression = .03
} = {}) {
  const invalid = reason => ({decision:"INVALID_EVIDENCE",reason,taskDeltas:{}});
  if (!Number.isFinite(minimumGain) || minimumGain < 0 || minimumGain > .2 ||
      !Number.isFinite(maximumTaskRegression) || maximumTaskRegression < 0 || maximumTaskRegression > .2) {
    return invalid("INVALID_THRESHOLDS");
  }
  const validHash=x=>typeof x==="string" && /^[a-f0-9]{64}$/.test(x);
  const validRun=x=>typeof x==="string" && /^[A-Za-z0-9._:-]{8,128}$/.test(x);
  for(const evidence of [baseline,candidate]) {
    if (!evidence || typeof evidence !== "object" ||
        !validHash(evidence.modelHash) || !validHash(evidence.testSetHash) ||
        !validRun(evidence.runId) || typeof evidence.suiteId!=="string" ||
        !/^[A-Za-z0-9._:-]{4,128}$/.test(evidence.suiteId) ||
        evidence.testSetUsedInTraining !== false ||
        !evidence.tasks || typeof evidence.tasks!=="object") {
      return invalid("MISSING_HOLDOUT_PROVENANCE");
    }
    for(const task of TASKS) {
      const metric=evidence.tasks[task];
      if(!metric || !Number.isSafeInteger(metric.attempted) || metric.attempted < 20 ||
        !Number.isSafeInteger(metric.correct) || metric.correct<0 ||
        metric.correct>metric.attempted) {
        return invalid("INVALID_TASK_METRICS");
      }
    }
  }
  if (baseline.suiteId!==candidate.suiteId || baseline.testSetHash!==candidate.testSetHash ||
      baseline.modelHash===candidate.modelHash || baseline.runId===candidate.runId) {
    return invalid("INCOMPARABLE_SNAPSHOTS");
  }
  const deltas={};
  for(const task of TASKS) {
    const oldMetric=baseline.tasks[task],newMetric=candidate.tasks[task];
    if(oldMetric.attempted!==newMetric.attempted)
      return invalid("INCOMPARABLE_TEST_COUNTS");
    deltas[task]=newMetric.correct/newMetric.attempted-oldMetric.correct/oldMetric.attempted;
  }
  if(Object.values(deltas).some(delta=>delta< -maximumTaskRegression-1e-10))
    return {decision:"REJECT_REGRESSION",reason:"TASK_RETENTION_REGRESSION",taskDeltas:deltas};
  if(!Object.values(deltas).some(delta=>delta>=minimumGain-1e-10))
    return {decision:"NO_DEMONSTRATED_GAIN",reason:"IMPROVEMENT_BELOW_THRESHOLD",taskDeltas:deltas};
  return {decision:"ELIGIBLE_FOR_INDEPENDENT_REVIEW",reason:"POLICY_THRESHOLDS_MET",
    taskDeltas:deltas};
}

import test from "node:test";
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import {
  captureProgressSample, appendProgressSample, progressTrend,
  formatProgressReport, assessLearningCandidate
} from "./progress-watcher.mjs";

function makeState(beliefs, cycles=[]) {
  return {generation:3,cycles,baby:{beliefs,
    quarantinedBeliefs:[{id:"off-topic"}]}};
}
function belief(explicit) {
  return {status:explicit?"GROUNDED_OBSERVATION":"PROVISIONAL",
    evidenceMode:explicit?"EXPLICIT_CITATION":"ATTRIBUTED_UNVERIFIED",
    citationUrls:explicit?["https://example.org/paper"]:[]};
}
function fixture(int, semantic, replay, hash="a", run="baseline-001") {
  return {suiteId:"frozen-heldout-v1",modelHash:hash.repeat(64),
    testSetHash:"f".repeat(64),runId:run,testSetUsedInTraining:false,
    tasks:{
      intent:{attempted:100,correct:int},
      semanticSimilarity:{attempted:100,correct:semantic},
      replayRetention:{attempted:100,correct:replay}
    }};
}

test("activity alone never becomes a model improvement claim",()=>{
  const s=captureProgressSample(makeState([belief(true),belief(false)],
    [{success:true},{success:false}]),100);
  assert.equal(s.research.cycles,2);
  assert.equal(s.research.failed,1);
  assert.equal(s.memory.citationCoverage,.5);
  assert.equal(s.benchmark,"NOT_EVALUATED");
  assert.match(formatProgressReport([],s),/NICHT GEMESSEN/);
});

test("watcher samples are bounded and repeated status generations are deduplicated",()=>{
  const s=captureProgressSample(makeState([belief(true)]),100);
  const duplicates=appendProgressSample([s],{...s,at:200,generation:25});
  assert.equal(duplicates.length,1);
  let history=[];
  for(let i=0;i<100;i++)history=appendProgressSample(history,
    captureProgressSample(makeState(Array.from({length:i+1},()=>belief(true))),i));
  assert.equal(history.length,64);
});

test("a coverage gain is named only as data quality and requires enough evidence",()=>{
  const before=captureProgressSample(makeState(Array.from({length:10},(_,i)=>belief(i<3))),100);
  const after=captureProgressSample(makeState(Array.from({length:10},(_,i)=>belief(i<7))),200);
  const trend=progressTrend([before,after]);
  assert.equal(trend.status,"CITATION_COVERAGE_INCREASED");
  assert.ok(trend.change>0.39);
  assert.match(trend.message,/kein Lern/);
  const low=progressTrend([before,captureProgressSample(makeState([belief(true)]),300)]);
  assert.equal(low.status,"INSUFFICIENT_DATA");
});

test("historical baseline is not mistaken for progress",()=>{
  const s=captureProgressSample(makeState([]),100);
  assert.equal(progressTrend([s]).status,"BASELINE_ONLY");
  assert.match(formatProgressReport([],s),/nicht automatisch/);
});

test("snapshot gate rejects missing holdout provenance, leaks and mismatched fixtures",()=>{
  const old=fixture(70,70,70),next=fixture(75,74,72,"b","candidate-002");
  assert.equal(assessLearningCandidate(old,{...next,testSetUsedInTraining:true}).decision,"INVALID_EVIDENCE");
  assert.equal(assessLearningCandidate(old,{...next,testSetHash:"c".repeat(64)}).decision,"INVALID_EVIDENCE");
  assert.equal(assessLearningCandidate(old,{...next,modelHash:old.modelHash}).decision,"INVALID_EVIDENCE");
  assert.equal(assessLearningCandidate(old,{...next,tasks:{...next.tasks,intent:{attempted:100,correct:101}}}).decision,"INVALID_EVIDENCE");
});

test("forgetting regression blocks promotion even if intent dramatically improves",()=>{
  const old=fixture(65,70,85),next=fixture(94,74,80,"b","candidate-002");
  const result=assessLearningCandidate(old,next);
  assert.equal(result.decision,"REJECT_REGRESSION");
  assert.ok(result.taskDeltas.replayRetention<-.03);
});

test("valid accuracy improvement only becomes eligible for review, never auto-promoted",()=>{
  const old=fixture(70,70,70),next=fixture(76,71,69,"b","candidate-002");
  assert.equal(assessLearningCandidate(old,next).decision,"ELIGIBLE_FOR_INDEPENDENT_REVIEW");
  assert.equal(assessLearningCandidate(old,fixture(70,70,70,"b","candidate-002")).decision,"NO_DEMONSTRATED_GAIN");

import dns from "node:dns/promises";
import net from "node:net";

const USER_AGENT = "DeviceAI-Continuum/0.4 (+https://github.com/Ullmann27/device-ai)";

export async function assertPublicHttpUrl(value) {
  const url = new URL(String(value));
  if (!["http:","https:"].includes(url.protocol)) throw new Error("Only public HTTP(S) URLs are allowed.");
  if (url.username || url.password) throw new Error("Credential-bearing URLs are not allowed.");
  const host = url.hostname.toLocaleLowerCase("en-US");
  if (host === "localhost" || host.endsWith(".localhost") || host.endsWith(".local")) {
    throw new Error("Local hosts are not allowed.");
  }
  const addresses = net.isIP(host)
    ? [{address:host,family:net.isIP(host)}]
    : await dns.lookup(host,{all:true,verbatim:true});
  if (!addresses.length || addresses.some(x=>isBlockedAddress(x.address))) {
    throw new Error("Private, loopback or reserved network targets are not allowed.");
  }
  return url;
}

export function isBlockedAddress(address) {
  if (net.isIP(address) === 4) {
    const p=address.split(".").map(Number);
    if(p[0]===10||p[0]===127||p[0]===0)return true;
    if(p[0]===169&&p[1]===254)return true;
    if(p[0]===172&&p[1]>=16&&p[1]<=31)return true;
    if(p[0]===192&&p[1]===168)return true;
    if(p[0]===100&&p[1]>=64&&p[1]<=127)return true;
    if(p[0]>=224)return true;
    if(p[0]===198&&(p[1]===18||p[1]===19))return true;
    if(p[0]===192&&p[1]===0&&p[2]===0)return true;
    return false;
  }
  if (net.isIP(address) === 6) {
    const a=address.toLocaleLowerCase("en-US");
    return a==="::1"||a==="::"||a.startsWith("fc")||a.startsWith("fd")||
      /^fe[89ab]/.test(a)||a.startsWith("ff")||a.startsWith("2001:db8");
  }
  return true;
}

export async function fetchPublicPage(value, {maxBytes=350000, respectRobots=true}={}) {
  let url=await assertPublicHttpUrl(value);
  if(respectRobots && !(await robotsAllows(url)))throw new Error("robots.txt disallows this path.");
  for(let redirects=0;redirects<=3;redirects++){
    const response=await fetch(url,{
      redirect:"manual",
      headers:{"User-Agent":USER_AGENT,"Accept":"text/html,text/plain,application/xhtml+xml;q=0.9,*/*;q=0.2"},
      signal:AbortSignal.timeout(12000)
    });
    if(response.status>=300&&response.status<400&&response.headers.get("location")){
      url=await assertPublicHttpUrl(new URL(response.headers.get("location"),url).toString());
      continue;
    }
    if(!response.ok)throw new Error("HTTP "+response.status+" for "+url.hostname);
    const type=(response.headers.get("content-type")??"").toLocaleLowerCase("en-US");
    if(!type.includes("text/html")&&!type.includes("text/plain")&&!type.includes("application/xhtml+xml")){
      throw new Error("Unsupported public content type: "+type.slice(0,80));
    }
    const buf=Buffer.from(await response.arrayBuffer());
    if(buf.length>maxBytes)throw new Error("Public page exceeds bounded fetch size.");
    return extractPage(buf.toString("utf8"),url.toString(),type);
  }
  throw new Error("Too many redirects.");
}

export async function crawlPublicWeb({seeds,query="",maxPages=6,maxDepth=1,maxDomains=4}) {
  const queue=(seeds??[]).slice(0,6).map(url=>({url,depth:0}));
  const visited=new Set(), domains=new Set(), pages=[];
  while(queue.length&&pages.length<maxPages){
    const item=queue.shift();
    let parsed;
    try{parsed=await assertPublicHttpUrl(item.url);}catch{continue;}
    const normalized=parsed.toString();
    if(visited.has(normalized))continue;
    if(!domains.has(parsed.hostname)&&domains.size>=maxDomains)continue;
    visited.add(normalized);domains.add(parsed.hostname);
    try{
      const page=await fetchPublicPage(normalized);
      page.relevance=textRelevance(query,page.title+" "+page.text);
      if(page.text.length>=120)pages.push(page);
      if(item.depth<maxDepth){
        const ranked=page.links.map(url=>({url,score:textRelevance(query,url)}))
          .sort((a,b)=>b.score-a.score).slice(0,8);
        for(const link of ranked)queue.push({url:link.url,depth:item.depth+1});
      }
    }catch{}
  }
  return pages.sort((a,b)=>b.relevance-a.relevance).slice(0,maxPages);
}

export async function searchGitHubRepositories(query,token="",limit=4){
  const q=String(query).trim().slice(0,240);
  if(!q)return[];
  const response=await fetch("https://api.github.com/search/repositories?q="+encodeURIComponent(q)+"&sort=stars&order=desc&per_page="+limit,{
    headers:{
      "Accept":"application/vnd.github+json",
      "User-Agent":USER_AGENT,
      ...(token?{"Authorization":"Bearer "+token}:{})
    },
    signal:AbortSignal.timeout(12000)
  });
  if(!response.ok)return[];
  const data=await response.json();
  return (data.items??[]).slice(0,limit).map(x=>({
    source:"GitHub",
    title:x.full_name,
    url:x.html_url,
    text:[
      x.description??"",
      "Stars "+(x.stargazers_count??0),
      x.language?"Language "+x.language:"",
      Array.isArray(x.topics)?x.topics.join(" "):""
    ].filter(Boolean).join(". ")
  }));
}

export function extractPage(html,url,contentType="text/html"){
  const isHtml=contentType.includes("html");
  const title=isHtml ? decodeEntities((html.match(/<title[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/title>/i)?.[1]??"").replace(/\s+/g," ").trim()) : "";
  let body=String(html);
  const links=[];
  if(isHtml){
    body=body.replace(/<script\b[\s\S]*?<\/script>/gi," ")
      .replace(/<style\b[\s\S]*?<\/style>/gi," ")
      .replace(/<noscript\b[\s\S]*?<\/noscript>/gi," ")
      .replace(/<(nav|header|footer|aside|form)\b[\s\S]*?<\/\1>/gi," ");
    for(const match of html.matchAll(/<a\b[^>]*href\s*=\s*["']([^"'#]+)["'][^>]*>/gi)){
      try{
        const target=new URL(decodeEntities(match[1]),url);
        if(["http:","https:"].includes(target.protocol))links.push(target.toString());
      }catch{}
      if(links.length>=80)break;
    }
    body=body.replace(/<[^>]+>/g," ");
  }
  const text=decodeEntities(body)
    .replace(/\b(skip to main content|skip to main navigation|open menu|site footer|register login|privacy statement)\b/gi," ")
    .replace(/\s+/g," ").trim().slice(0,18000);
  return {source:"PublicWeb",title:title||new URL(url).hostname,url,text,links:[...new Set(links)].slice(0,80)};
}

async function robotsAllows(url){
  try{
    const robots=new URL("/robots.txt",url);
    const response=await fetch(robots,{headers:{"User-Agent":USER_AGENT},signal:AbortSignal.timeout(5000)});
    if(!response.ok)return true;
    const text=(await response.text()).slice(0,100000);
    let active=false;
    const disallows=[];
    for(const raw of text.split(/\r?\n/)){
      const line=raw.replace(/#.*/,"").trim();
      const [key,...rest]=line.split(":");
      const value=rest.join(":").trim();
      if(key?.trim().toLocaleLowerCase("en-US")==="user-agent")active=value==="*";
      else if(active&&key?.trim().toLocaleLowerCase("en-US")==="disallow"&&value)disallows.push(value);
    }
    return !disallows.some(path=>url.pathname.startsWith(path));
  }catch{return true;}
}

function textRelevance(query,text){
  const q=tokens(query),t=tokens(text);
  if(!q.size)return 0;
  let score=0;for(const x of q)if(t.has(x))score++;
  return score/q.size;
}
function tokens(text){return new Set(String(text).toLocaleLowerCase("en-US").split(/[^\p{L}\p{N}]+/u).filter(x=>x.length>=4));}
function decodeEntities(v){return String(v).replace(/&amp;/g,"&").replace(/&lt;/g,"<").replace(/&gt;/g,">").replace(/&quot;/g,'"').replace(/&#39;|&apos;/g,"'");}

export function injectFault(wt,fault){
  const file=path.join(wt,fault.file);
  if(!fs.existsSync(file))return {skipped:'file missing'};
  const text=fs.readFileSync(file,'utf8');
  if(text.split(fault.find).length!==2)return {skipped:'anchor not unique or absent at this revision'};
  fs.writeFileSync(file,text.replace(fault.find,()=>fault.replace));
  git(wt,['add','--',fault.file]);
  git(wt,['-c','user.name=continuum-benchmark','-c','user.email=continuum-benchmark@users.noreply.github.com',
    'commit','-q','-m','benchmark fault '+fault.id]);
  return {commit:git(wt,['rev-parse','HEAD']).stdout.trim(),original:text};
}

/**
 * Runs the selected faults sequentially in ONE worktree (incremental builds).
 * `chain` maps fault families to a check chain, e.g. {node:'node',kotlin:'android'}.
 */
export function runBenchmark({root,head,chains,faults=FAULTS,out,ledger,onSession=()=>{},log=()=>{}}){
  const selected=faults.filter(f=>chains[f.chain]);
  const results=[];
  const wt=createWorktree(root,head);
  try{
    for(const fault of selected){
      resetWorktree(wt,head);
      const injected=injectFault(wt,fault);
      if(injected.skipped){results.push({fault:fault.id,outcome:'SKIPPED',reason:injected.skipped});continue;}
      const faultPatch=git(wt,['diff','--binary',head,injected.commit]).stdout;
      const dir=path.join(out,fault.id);fs.mkdirSync(dir,{recursive:true});
      fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir,'fault.patch'),faultPatch);
      log(`fault ${fault.id} injected as ${injected.commit.slice(0,12)}`);
      const report=repairSession({wt,base:injected.commit,chain:chains[fault.chain],out:dir,ledger,log:m=>log('  '+m)});
      const repaired=report.verified?fs.readFileSync(path.join(wt,fault.file),'utf8'):null;
      const result={fault:fault.id,chain:chains[fault.chain],baseCommit:injected.commit,faultPatchSha256:sha256(faultPatch),
        outcome:report.outcome,strategy:report.verified?.strategy??null,expectedStrategy:fault.expect,
        attempts:report.attempts.length,diagnostics:report.baseline?.diagnostics?.length??0,
        restoredExactly:repaired!=null&&repaired===injected.original,patchSha256:report.verified?.patchSha256??null,
        ms:Date.parse(report.finishedAt??new Date().toISOString())-Date.parse(report.startedAt)};
      fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir,'report.json'),JSON.stringify(report,null,1)+'\n');
      results.push(result);
      ledger=onSession(report,result)??ledger;
    }
  }finally{removeWorktree(root,wt);}
  const attempted=results.filter(r=>r.outcome!=='SKIPPED');
  return {schemaVersion:1,head,chains,results,
    repaired:attempted.filter(r=>r.outcome==='VERIFIED').length,attempted:attempted.length,
    repairRate:attempted.length?Number((attempted.filter(r=>r.outcome==='VERIFIED').length/attempted.length).toFixed(3)):null,ledger};
}

/**
 * Critic: rejects candidate patches before any test runs. A patch the critic
 * rejects is never applied to a build tree. Tests are the specification, so
 * test sources may only receive the syntax-only escaped-newline repair.
 */
export const LIMITS=Object.freeze({maxFiles:3,maxChangedLines:40});

const FORBIDDEN_PATHS=[
  /^\.github\/workflows\//,/^\.github\/continuum\/(repair-|developer-agent|code-analyzer|kotlin-tokenizer)/,
  /(^|\/)(build\.gradle(\.kts)?|settings\.gradle(\.kts)?|gradle\.properties|local\.properties)$/,/^gradle\//,
  /AndroidManifest\.xml$/,/\.(jks|keystore|p12|pem|key)$/i,/^\.continuum\//,/(^|\/)\.git(\/|$)/,
  /(ToolGate|InternetConsent|SecureToken|Signer|Identity|Governance|Credential|Secret|Permission|ConsentPolicy)/i
];
// test sources and their recorded fixtures are the specification
const TEST_PATH=/(^|\/)(test|fixtures)\/|\.test\.m?js$/;
const SYNTAX_ONLY=new Set(['KOTLIN_ESCAPED_NEWLINE']);
const DANGEROUS=[
  [/Runtime\.getRuntime\(\)\.exec|ProcessBuilder\s*\(|child_process|spawnSync|execSync|\beval\s*\(|new\s+Function\s*\(/,'process or code execution'],
  [/@Ignore\b|\.skip\s*\(|\btest\.todo\b|@Suppress\b|eslint-disable/,'disables checks or tests'],
  [/https?:\/\//,'introduces a network address'],
  [/System\.exit|exitProcess|process\.exit/,'terminates the process'],
  [/catch\s*\([^)]*\)\s*\{\s*\}/,'swallows exceptions']
];

function changedLines(oldText,newText){
  const a=oldText.split('\n'),b=newText.split('\n');
  let p=0;while(p<a.length&&p<b.length&&a[p]===b[p])p++;
  let s=0;while(s<a.length-p&&s<b.length-p&&a[a.length-1-s]===b[b.length-1-s])s++;
  return {removed:a.slice(p,a.length-s),added:b.slice(p,b.length-s)};
}

export function critique(candidate){
  const reasons=[];
  const edits=candidate?.edits;
  if(!Array.isArray(edits)||!edits.length)return {approved:false,risk:1,reasons:['empty patch']};
  const files=new Set(edits.map(e=>e.file));
  if(files.size>LIMITS.maxFiles)reasons.push(`touches ${files.size} files (max ${LIMITS.maxFiles})`);
  let changed=0,addedAsserts=0,removedAsserts=0,bangDelta=0;
  for(const e of edits){
    if(typeof e.file!=='string'||e.file.includes('..')||e.file.startsWith('/')||/[\0\r\n]/.test(e.file)){reasons.push('invalid path');continue;}
    if(FORBIDDEN_PATHS.some(p=>p.test(e.file)))reasons.push('protected path '+e.file);
    if(TEST_PATH.test(e.file)&&!SYNTAX_ONLY.has(candidate.strategy))reasons.push('tests are the specification: '+e.file);
    const {removed,added}=changedLines(e.oldText??'',e.newText??'');
    changed+=Math.max(removed.length,added.length);
    const addedText=added.join('\n'),removedText=removed.join('\n');
    for(const [pattern,why] of DANGEROUS)if(pattern.test(addedText)&&!pattern.test(removedText))reasons.push(why);
    addedAsserts+=(addedText.match(/\bassert\w*\s*\(/g)??[]).length;
    removedAsserts+=(removedText.match(/\bassert\w*\s*\(/g)??[]).length;
    bangDelta+=(addedText.match(/!!/g)??[]).length-(removedText.match(/!!/g)??[]).length;
  }
  if(changed>LIMITS.maxChangedLines)reasons.push(`changes ${changed} lines (max ${LIMITS.maxChangedLines})`);
  if(removedAsserts>addedAsserts)reasons.push('removes assertions');
  if(bangDelta>0)reasons.push('adds non-null assertions (!!)');
  const revert=String(candidate.strategy).startsWith('REVERT_');
  const risk=Math.min(1,changed/LIMITS.maxChangedLines*0.5+(candidate.strategy==='REVERT_FILE_TO_PARENT'?0.4:revert?0.25:0)+(1-(candidate.prior??0.5))*0.3);
  return {approved:reasons.length===0,risk:Number(risk.toFixed(3)),reasons,changedLines:changed,
    reviewRequired:revert||changed>10};
}

import crypto from 'node:crypto';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';

/**
 * Diagnostician: turns the output of the agent's OWN reproduction run (compiler
 * text, JUnit XML) into structured diagnostics. Input is data only; nothing in
 * it is ever executed. Paths outside the checked-out tree are discarded.
 */
const MAX_TEXT=2_000_000, MAX_DIAGNOSTICS=60;

export const sha256=value=>crypto.createHash('sha256').update(value).digest('hex');

function relativeInside(root,file){
  const clean=file.replace(/^file:\/\//,'');
  const absolute=path.resolve(root,clean);
  const rel=path.relative(path.resolve(root),absolute);
  if(!rel||rel.startsWith('..')||path.isAbsolute(rel))return null;
  return rel.split(path.sep).join('/');
}

export function classifyKotlin(message){
  let m;
  if((m=message.match(/^Unresolved reference(?::|\s)\s*['`]?([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z_0-9]*)['`]?/)))return {kind:'UNRESOLVED_REFERENCE',symbol:m[1]};
  if(/^Syntax error/.test(message)||/^Expecting /.test(message))return {kind:'SYNTAX_ERROR'};
  if((m=message.match(/actual type is '([^']+)', but '([^']+)' was expected/)))return {kind:'TYPE_MISMATCH',actual:m[1],expected:m[2]};
  if(/^Only safe \(\?\.\) or non-null asserted/.test(message))return {kind:'NULLABLE_RECEIVER'};
  if(/is not abstract and does not implement abstract member/.test(message))return {kind:'MISSING_OVERRIDE'};
  return {kind:'COMPILER_ERROR'};
}

/** A stable identity for "the same problem": no line numbers, normalized numbers. */
export function fingerprint(d){
  const message=String(d.message??'').replace(/\d+/g,'#').replace(/\s+/g,' ').slice(0,200);
  return sha256([d.kind,d.file??'',d.symbol??'',message].join('\u0000')).slice(0,16);
}

/** Kotlin K2 (`e: file:///a/B.kt:8:70 msg`) and K1 (`e: /a/B.kt: (8, 70): msg`) errors. */
export function parseKotlinDiagnostics(text,root){
  const out=[];
  const source=String(text).slice(-MAX_TEXT);
  const patterns=[/^e: (?:file:\/\/)?(\/[^\n]*?\.kts?):(\d+):(\d+) ([^\n]+)$/gm,/^e: (?:file:\/\/)?(\/[^\n]*?\.kts?): \((\d+), (\d+)\): ([^\n]+)$/gm];
  for(const pattern of patterns)for(const m of source.matchAll(pattern)){
    const file=relativeInside(root,m[1]);if(!file)continue;
    const message=m[4].trim().slice(0,400);
    const d={tool:'kotlinc',severity:'error',file,line:Number(m[2]),col:Number(m[3]),message,...classifyKotlin(message)};
    d.fingerprint=fingerprint(d);
    if(!out.some(x=>x.file===d.file&&x.line===d.line&&x.col===d.col&&x.message===d.message))out.push(d);
    if(out.length>=MAX_DIAGNOSTICS)return out;
  }
  return out;
}

const xmlDecode=s=>s.replace(/&lt;/g,'<').replace(/&gt;/g,'>').replace(/&quot;/g,'"').replace(/&apos;/g,"'").replace(/&#(\d+);/g,(_,n)=>String.fromCharCode(Number(n))).replace(/&amp;/g,'&');

/**
 * V8 error headers as printed by util.inspect in Node's test reporters. The
 * bracketed tag differs between releases for the same error, e.g. a cause that
 * crossed the test-runner boundary prints as
 *   "ReferenceError [Error]: sqare is not defined"   (Node 20.20, 22.16)
 *   "ReferenceError: sqare is not defined"           (Node 22.22)
 * Only these specific types are recognized; generic "Error" and
 * "AssertionError" headers never become code diagnostics, so assertion text
 * that merely mentions "is not defined" or "SyntaxError" stays a TEST_FAILURE.
 */
const JS_ERROR_HEADER=/(?:^|[\s:\[{(])(?:Uncaught )?(ReferenceError|TypeError|SyntaxError|RangeError)(?: \[[A-Za-z_][\w ]{0,40}\])?: ([^\n]+)/g;
const FILE_FRAME=/file:\/\/(\/[^\s:)'"]+\.m?js):(\d+):(\d+)/g;

export function firstRepoFrame(text,root,from=0,to=text.length){
  FILE_FRAME.lastIndex=from;
  for(let m;(m=FILE_FRAME.exec(text))&&m.index<to;){
    const file=relativeInside(root,m[1]);
    if(file&&!file.includes('node_modules/'))return {file,line:Number(m[2]),col:Number(m[3])};
  }
  return null;
}

/** All specific JS error headers with the text span of their own stack. */
function errorHeaders(text){
  const headers=[];
  JS_ERROR_HEADER.lastIndex=0;
  for(let m;(m=JS_ERROR_HEADER.exec(text));)headers.push({type:m[1],message:m[2].trim().slice(0,400),start:m.index,end:m.index+m[0].length});
  // a header's frames end where the next header starts (bounded to ~60 lines)
  headers.forEach((h,i)=>{h.stackEnd=Math.min(headers[i+1]?.start??text.length,h.end+6000);});
  return headers;
}
const notDefined=(type,message)=>type==='ReferenceError'?(message.match(/^([A-Za-z_$][\w$]*) is not defined\b/)??[])[1]:undefined;

/** First specific JS error in a report text plus the first repository frame that follows it. */
export function parseJsError(text,root){
  const source=String(text).slice(0,MAX_TEXT);
  for(const h of errorHeaders(source)){
    const frame=firstRepoFrame(source,root,h.end,h.stackEnd);
    if(!frame)continue;
    return {type:h.type,message:h.type+': '+h.message,symbol:notDefined(h.type,h.message),...frame};
  }
  return null;
}

/** JUnit XML (Gradle and `node --test --test-reporter=junit`). */
export function parseJUnit(xml,root){
  const out=[];let total=0,failed=0,skipped=0,placeholders=0,crashed=0;
  const text=String(xml).slice(0,MAX_TEXT);
  for(const m of text.matchAll(/<testcase\b((?:[^>"]|"[^"]*")*?)(\/>|>([\s\S]*?)<\/testcase>)/g)){
    total++;
    const attrs=m[1],body=m[3]??'';
    // `node --test` reports a test FILE as one testcase when it defines no tests
    // (passing) or crashes while loading (failing): it is not executed evidence.
    // Node 20 names it by absolute path, Node 22 relative to the working directory.
    const placeholder=/\bname="[^"]*\.test\.m?js"/.test(attrs);
    if(placeholder)placeholders++;
    if(/<skipped\b/.test(body)){skipped++;continue;}
    // attribute values may contain '>' (e.g. assertion source), so match quoted values
    const failure=body.match(/<(failure|error)\b((?:[^>"]|"[^"]*")*)>([\s\S]*?)<\/\1>|<(failure|error)\b((?:[^>"]|"[^"]*")*)\/>/);
    if(!failure)continue;
    failed++;if(placeholder)crashed++;
    const attr=(src,name)=>xmlDecode((src.match(new RegExp('\\b'+name+'="([^"]*)"'))??[])[1]??'');
    const name=attr(attrs,'name'),classname=attr(attrs,'classname');
    const fattrs=failure[2]??failure[5]??'';
    const detail=xmlDecode(failure[3]??'');
    const message=(attr(fattrs,'message')||detail.split('\n')[0]).slice(0,400);
    const js=parseJsError(detail,root);
    let file=null,line=null,col=null,kind='TEST_FAILURE',symbol;
    if(js){
      ({file,line,col}=js);symbol=js.symbol;
      kind=js.type==='ReferenceError'&&js.symbol?'REFERENCE_ERROR':js.type==='SyntaxError'?'JS_SYNTAX_ERROR':'JS_RUNTIME_ERROR';
    }else{
      // assertion failures and other errors: first stack frame inside the tree
      const frame=firstRepoFrame(detail,root,0);
      if(frame)({file,line,col}=frame);
      else{const kt=detail.match(/at ([\w.$]+)\.[\w$<>]+\(([\w]+\.kt):(\d+)\)/);if(kt){file=kt[2];line=Number(kt[3]);}}
    }
    const d={tool:'junit',severity:'error',test:(classname?classname+'.':'')+name,file,line,col,message,kind,symbol};
    if(placeholder){const testFile=relativeInside(root,name);if(testFile)d.testFile=testFile;}
    d.fingerprint=fingerprint(d);
    out.push(d);
    if(out.length>=MAX_DIAGNOSTICS)break;
  }
  // executed = real test cases that ran (not skipped, not file placeholders);
  // passed = executed test cases without failure (a crashed file is not a test)
  const executed=total-skipped-placeholders;
  return {total,failed,skipped,placeholders,executed,passed:executed-(failed-crashed),diagnostics:out};
}

/** Node error text (stderr or TAP comments) for modules that fail while loading. */
export function parseJsErrorText(text,root){
  const out=[];
  const clean=String(text).slice(-MAX_TEXT).split('\n').map(l=>l.replace(/^#\s?/,'')).join('\n');
  const parse=/file:\/\/(\/[^\s:)]+\.m?js):(\d+)\n[^\n]*\n[^\n]*\n\s*(SyntaxError): ([^\n]+)/g;
  const add=(js,tool)=>{
    const kind=js.type==='ReferenceError'&&js.symbol?'REFERENCE_ERROR':js.type==='SyntaxError'?'JS_SYNTAX_ERROR':'JS_RUNTIME_ERROR';
    const d={tool,severity:'error',file:js.file,line:js.line,col:js.col,message:js.message,kind,symbol:js.symbol};
    d.fingerprint=fingerprint(d);if(!out.some(x=>x.fingerprint===d.fingerprint&&x.line===d.line))out.push(d);
  };
  // stderr / TAP comment blocks: "<Type>[ [tag]]: msg" followed by its frames
  for(const h of errorHeaders(clean)){
    const frame=firstRepoFrame(clean,root,h.end,h.stackEnd);
    if(frame)add({type:h.type,message:h.type+': '+h.message,symbol:notDefined(h.type,h.message),...frame},'node');
  }
  // TAP YAML diagnostics of a failed test: error/name/stack keys
  for(const m of clean.matchAll(/\n\s*error: '((?:[^'\n]|'')*)'\n(?:\s+\w+: [^\n]*\n)*?\s+name: '(ReferenceError|TypeError|SyntaxError|RangeError)'\n\s+stack: \|-\n((?:\s{4,}[^\n]*\n?)+)/g)){
    const frame=firstRepoFrame(m[3],root,0);if(!frame)continue;
    const message=m[1].replace(/''/g,"'").slice(0,400);
    add({type:m[2],message:m[2]+': '+message,symbol:notDefined(m[2],message),...frame},'node');
  }
  for(const m of clean.matchAll(parse)){
    const file=relativeInside(root,m[1]);if(!file)continue;
    const d={tool:'node',severity:'error',file,line:Number(m[2]),col:null,message:('SyntaxError: '+m[4]).slice(0,400),kind:'JS_SYNTAX_ERROR'};
    d.fingerprint=fingerprint(d);if(!out.some(x=>x.fingerprint===d.fingerprint))out.push(d);
  }
  return out.slice(0,MAX_DIAGNOSTICS);
}

export function readJUnitDirectory(dir,root){
  const result={total:0,failed:0,skipped:0,placeholders:0,executed:0,passed:0,diagnostics:[]};
  if(!fs.existsSync(dir))return result;
  for(const name of fs.readdirSync(dir).filter(n=>n.endsWith('.xml')).sort().slice(0,2000)){
    const file=path.join(dir,name);
    if(fs.statSync(file).size>5_000_000)continue;
    const part=parseJUnit(fs.readFileSync(file,'utf8'),root);
    for(const k of ['total','failed','skipped','placeholders','executed','passed'])result[k]+=part[k];
    result.diagnostics.push(...part.diagnostics.slice(0,MAX_DIAGNOSTICS-result.diagnostics.length));
  }
  return result;
}

test('classification is not over-generous',()=>{
  const xml=(message,body)=>`<testsuites><testcase name="t" classname="c"><failure message="${message}">${body}</failure></testcase></testsuites>`;

  assert.equal(d.kind,'TEST_FAILURE');assert.equal(d.symbol,undefined);assert.equal(d.file,'a.test.mjs');
  d=parseJUnit(xml('expected SyntaxError','AssertionError: expected SyntaxError to be thrown\n    at t (file:///repo/a.test.mjs:9:3)'),ROOT).diagnostics[0];
  assert.equal(d.kind,'TEST_FAILURE');
  // a ReferenceError that is not "x is not defined" has no symbol, so no typo/import repair
  d=parseJUnit(xml('x','ReferenceError: Cannot access \'x\' before initialization\n    at f (file:///repo/b.mjs:1:1)'),ROOT).diagnostics[0];

/**
 * Hand-reviewed rewrite rules for compiler errors with a single known fix.
 * Used by repair-strategies.mjs (strategy KOTLIN_KNOWN_FIX:<kind>) only for the
 * exact line a compiler diagnostic points at; it never scans or edits by itself.
 * Rules come from real failures of this repository.
 */
export const KNOWN_FIXES=Object.freeze([
  // 373bddb: Set has no takeLast(); bounded retention needs an ordered list.
  {kind:'SET_TAKELAST',from:'.toSet().takeLast(',to:'.toSet().toList().takeLast('}
]);

export function knownFixes(source){
  return KNOWN_FIXES.filter(f=>typeof source==='string'&&source.includes(f.from)).map(f=>({...f}));
}

import fs from 'node:fs';
/** Strategy outcome aggregation (Laplace-ranked). Persisted through repair-ledger.mjs,
 * which keys experiences as "<diagnostic kind>|<strategy>". */
export function mergeExperiences(previous=[],observations=[]) {
 const entries=new Map();
 for(const item of [...previous,...observations]){
  if(!item||typeof item.kind!=='string'||!item.kind.trim()||item.kind.length>80)continue;
  const aggregated=Number.isSafeInteger(item.successes)&&Number.isSafeInteger(item.failures)
    &&item.successes>=0&&item.failures>=0;
  const observed=item.status==='COMPILES'||item.status==='REJECTED';
  if(!aggregated&&!observed)continue;
  const current=entries.get(item.kind)??{kind:item.kind,successes:0,failures:0};
  const successes=current.successes+(aggregated?item.successes:Number(item.status==='COMPILES'));
  const failures=current.failures+(aggregated?item.failures:Number(item.status==='REJECTED'));
  if(!Number.isSafeInteger(successes)||!Number.isSafeInteger(failures))throw Error('Experience counter overflow');
  entries.set(item.kind,{kind:item.kind,successes,failures});
 }
 return [...entries.values()].sort((a,b)=>{
  const scoreA=(a.successes+1)/(a.successes+a.failures+2);
  const scoreB=(b.successes+1)/(b.successes+b.failures+2);
  return scoreB-scoreA||a.kind.localeCompare(b.kind);
 }).slice(0,100);
}
export function summarizeExperiences(observations=[]) {
 const grouped=new Map();
 for(const item of observations){
  if(!item||!['COMPILES','REJECTED'].includes(item.status))continue;
  const key=String(item.kind??'').slice(0,80);
  const record=grouped.get(key)??{kind:key,successes:0,failures:0};
  record[item.status==='COMPILES'?'successes':'failures']++;
  grouped.set(key,record);
 }
 return [...grouped.values()].sort((a,b)=>a.kind.localeCompare(b.kind));
}
export function verifyExperienceFile(data){
 if(!data||data.schemaVersion!==1||!Array.isArray(data.experiences)||data.experiences.length>100)throw Error('Invalid experience store');
 for(const x of data.experiences)if(!x||typeof x.kind!=='string'||x.kind.length>80||!Number.isSafeInteger(x.successes)||!Number.isSafeInteger(x.failures)||x.successes<0||x.failures<0)throw Error('Invalid experience entry');
 return data.experiences;
}
export function loadExperienceFile(file){
 if(!fs.existsSync(file))return [];
 const raw=fs.readFileSync(file,'utf8');
 if(raw.length>50000)throw Error('Experience store too large');
 return verifyExperienceFile(JSON.parse(raw));
}
export function saveExperienceFile(file,entries){
 const payload=JSON.stringify({schemaVersion:1,experiences:entries},null,2)+'\n';
 const tmp=file+'.tmp-'+process.pid;
 fs.writeFileSync(tmp,payload,{flag:'wx'});
 fs.renameSync(tmp,file);
}

FILE 58/375: .github/continuum/repair-ledger.mjs

import fs from 'node:fs';
import {mergeExperiences} from './repair-experience.mjs';

/**
 * Persistent repair ledger: every attempt with diagnosis, strategy, minimal
 * hunks, test outcome, base commit, patch hash and confidence. Aggregated
 * strategy statistics reuse repair-experience.mergeExperiences, keyed by
 * "<diagnostic kind>|<strategy>", so the agent prefers what worked for this
 * kind of problem and never re-runs a candidate already proven to fail.
 */
export const MAX_ATTEMPTS=400;
const OUTCOMES=new Set(['VERIFIED','FAILED_TESTS','INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE','REJECTED_BY_CRITIC','NOT_APPLICABLE']);
const HEX=/^[0-9a-f]{1,64}$/;

export function emptyLedger(){return {schemaVersion:2,attempts:[],experiences:[],sessions:[]};}

export function verifyLedger(data){
  if(!data||data.schemaVersion!==2||!Array.isArray(data.attempts)||!Array.isArray(data.experiences)||!Array.isArray(data.sessions))
    throw Error('Invalid repair ledger');
  if(data.attempts.length>MAX_ATTEMPTS||data.sessions.length>200||data.experiences.length>100)throw Error('Repair ledger too large');
  for(const a of data.attempts){
    if(!a||!OUTCOMES.has(a.outcome)||typeof a.strategy!=='string'||a.strategy.length>80||!HEX.test(a.diagnostic??'')||!HEX.test(a.candidate??''))
      throw Error('Invalid ledger attempt');
    if(!Array.isArray(a.edits)||a.edits.length>3||a.edits.some(e=>typeof e.file!=='string'||e.file.includes('..')||typeof e.oldText!=='string'||typeof e.newText!=='string'||e.oldText.length+e.newText.length>20000))
      throw Error('Invalid ledger edits');
  }
  for(const x of data.experiences)if(!x||typeof x.kind!=='string'||x.kind.length>80||!Number.isSafeInteger(x.successes)||!Number.isSafeInteger(x.failures)||x.successes<0||x.failures<0)
    throw Error('Invalid ledger experience');
  return data;
}

export function loadLedger(file){
  if(!file||!fs.existsSync(file))return emptyLedger();
  const raw=fs.readFileSync(file,'utf8');
  if(raw.length>4_000_000)throw Error('Repair ledger too large');
  return verifyLedger(JSON.parse(raw));
}

export function saveLedger(file,ledger){
  verifyLedger(ledger);
  const tmp=file+'.tmp-'+process.pid;
  fs.writeFileSync(tmp,JSON.stringify(ledger,null,1)+'\n');
  fs.renameSync(tmp,file);
}

/** Fold one session report into the ledger (returns a new object). */
export function recordSession(ledger,report,meta={}){
  const next=structuredClone(ledger);
  const attempts=(report.attempts??[]).filter(a=>OUTCOMES.has(a.outcome)).map(a=>({
    at:report.finishedAt??new Date().toISOString(),baseCommit:report.base,chain:report.chain,
    diagnostic:a.diagnostic,diagnosticKind:a.diagnosticKind,candidate:a.candidate,strategy:a.strategy,
    outcome:a.outcome,edits:a.edits,confidence:a.score??null,
    tests:(a.tests??[]).map(t=>({profile:t.profile,passed:t.passed,total:t.tests?.total??0,failed:t.tests?.failed??0,
      executed:t.tests?.executed??0,skipped:t.tests?.skipped??0})),
    patchSha256:a.outcome==='VERIFIED'?report.verified?.patchSha256??null:null,
    proposalCommit:a.outcome==='VERIFIED'?meta.proposalCommit??null:null,
    proposalBranch:a.outcome==='VERIFIED'?meta.branch??null:null,pullRequest:a.outcome==='VERIFIED'?meta.pullRequest??null:null}));
  next.attempts=[...next.attempts,...attempts].slice(-MAX_ATTEMPTS);
  // Critic rejections say nothing about whether a strategy repairs code.
  // Insufficient evidence counts against a strategy: it "passed" without proof.
  next.experiences=mergeExperiences(next.experiences,attempts.filter(a=>['VERIFIED','FAILED_TESTS','INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE'].includes(a.outcome))
    .map(a=>({kind:(a.diagnosticKind+'|'+a.strategy).slice(0,80),status:a.outcome==='VERIFIED'?'COMPILES':'REJECTED'})));
  next.sessions=[...next.sessions,{at:report.finishedAt??new Date().toISOString(),base:report.base,chain:report.chain,
    outcome:report.outcome,diagnostics:(report.baseline?.diagnostics??[]).length,attempts:attempts.length,
    verifiedStrategy:report.verified?.strategy??null,patchSha256:report.verified?.patchSha256??null,
    trigger:meta.trigger??null}].slice(-200);
  return verifyLedger(next);
}

import fs from 'node:fs';
import os from 'node:os';
import path from 'node:path';
import {spawnSync} from 'node:child_process';
import {parseKotlinDiagnostics,readJUnitDirectory,parseJUnit,parseJsErrorText,sha256} from './repair-diagnostics.mjs';
import {proposeCandidates,applyEdits} from './repair-strategies.mjs';
import {critique} from './repair-critic.mjs';
import {buildIndex,collectKotlin} from './code-analyzer.mjs';

/**
 * Test verifier and orchestrator of one repair session:
 *   reproduce (own run, never log text) -> diagnose -> propose -> critique ->
 *   apply in an isolated git worktree -> run the fixed check chain -> keep the
 *   first fully passing candidate as a patch, reset the worktree otherwise.
 * The original checkout is never modified. Commands come only from PROFILES.
 */
export const BRANCH_PREFIX='continuum-agent/';

const DEPTH=Number(process.env.CONTINUUM_REPAIR_DEPTH??0);
function run(cmd,args,{cwd,timeoutMs=120000,env}={}){
  const started=Date.now();
  // Child checks see the depth, so a test suite cannot start a nested repair loop.
  const childEnv={...process.env,...env,GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT:'0',CONTINUUM_REPAIR_DEPTH:String(DEPTH+1)};
  delete childEnv.NODE_TEST_CONTEXT; // a nested `node --test` must report on its own, not to a parent runner
  const r=spawnSync(cmd,args,{cwd,timeout:timeoutMs,encoding:'utf8',maxBuffer:64*1024*1024,shell:false,env:childEnv});
  return {status:r.status,signal:r.signal,error:r.error?.code??null,stdout:r.stdout??'',stderr:r.stderr??'',ms:Date.now()-started};
}
export function git(cwd,args,opts={}){
  const r=run('git',args,{cwd,timeoutMs:opts.timeoutMs??120000});
  if(r.status!==0&&!opts.allowFailure)throw Error('git '+args[0]+' failed: '+(r.stderr||r.stdout).slice(-400));
  return r;
}

function nodeTests(wt){
  const dir=path.join(wt,'.github/continuum');
  return fs.existsSync(dir)?fs.readdirSync(dir).filter(f=>f.endsWith('.test.mjs')).sort().map(f=>'.github/continuum/'+f):[];
}

/** Fixed, reviewed check commands. Nothing here is derived from logs or inputs. */
export const PROFILES=Object.freeze({
  'node-continuum':(wt,out)=>({cmd:process.execPath,args:['--test','--test-reporter=junit','--test-reporter-destination='+path.join(out,'node-junit.xml'),...nodeTests(wt)],
    cwd:wt,junitFiles:[path.join(out,'node-junit.xml')],timeoutMs:300000}),
  // Kotlin incremental compilation is disabled: after a failed build its caches
  // produced phantom "Conflicting overloads" errors in untouched files.
  'android-compile':wt=>({cmd:'gradle',args:[':app:compileDebugUnitTestKotlin','--console=plain','-Pkotlin.incremental=false'],cwd:wt,kotlin:true,timeoutMs:1200000}),
  'android-unit':wt=>({cmd:'gradle',args:[':app:testDebugUnitTest','--console=plain','-Pkotlin.incremental=false'],cwd:wt,kotlin:true,
    junitDirs:[path.join(wt,'app/build/test-results/testDebugUnitTest')],cleanDirs:[path.join(wt,'app/build/test-results/testDebugUnitTest')],timeoutMs:1500000}),
  'jvm-harness':wt=>{
    // Local development only: JVM harness that compiles app sources without the Android SDK.
    const harness=process.env.CONTINUUM_JVM_HARNESS;
    if(!harness||!fs.existsSync(path.join(harness,'build.gradle.kts')))throw Error('CONTINUUM_JVM_HARNESS not configured');
    return {cmd:'gradle',args:['-p',harness,'test','--console=plain','-q','-Pkotlin.incremental=false'],cwd:wt,env:{DEVICE_AI_REPO:wt},kotlin:true,
      junitDirs:[path.join(harness,'build/test-results/test')],cleanDirs:[path.join(harness,'build/test-results/test')],timeoutMs:1500000};
  }
});
export const CHAINS=Object.freeze({node:['node-continuum'],android:['android-compile','android-unit'],jvm:['jvm-harness']});
/** Profiles whose evidence is executed tests (independent of flags in a report). */
export const TEST_PROFILES=Object.freeze(['node-continuum','android-unit','jvm-harness']);

export function runProfile(name,wt,out){
  const factory=PROFILES[name];if(!factory)throw Error('Unknown check profile '+name);
  const p=factory(wt,out);
  for(const d of p.cleanDirs??[])fs.rmSync(d,{recursive:true,force:true});
  for(const f of p.junitFiles??[])fs.rmSync(f,{force:true});
  const r=run(p.cmd,p.args,{cwd:p.cwd,timeoutMs:p.timeoutMs,env:p.env});
  const text=r.stdout+'\n'+r.stderr;
  const diagnostics=p.kotlin?parseKotlinDiagnostics(text,wt):[];
  const tests={total:0,failed:0,skipped:0,placeholders:0,executed:0,passed:0};
  const addTests=j=>{for(const k of Object.keys(tests))tests[k]+=j[k]??0;diagnostics.push(...j.diagnostics);};
  for(const dir of p.junitDirs??[])addTests(readJUnitDirectory(dir,wt));
  for(const file of p.junitFiles??[])if(fs.existsSync(file))addTests(parseJUnit(fs.readFileSync(file,'utf8'),wt));
  // Test files that crash while importing report only "test failed" in JUnit;
  // re-run just those (same fixed runner, TAP) to recover the real error location.
  // Only files that were arguments of the fixed command itself are re-run.
  if(p.junitFiles){
    const listed=new Set(p.args.filter(a=>/^\.github\/continuum\/[\w.-]+\.test\.mjs$/.test(a)));
    const crashed=[...new Set(diagnostics.filter(d=>!d.file&&listed.has(d.testFile)).map(d=>d.testFile))].slice(0,3);
    for(const file of crashed){
      const again=run(p.cmd,['--test','--test-reporter=tap',file],{cwd:p.cwd,timeoutMs:120000});
      diagnostics.unshift(...parseJsErrorText(again.stdout+'\n'+again.stderr,wt));
    }
  }
  // A test profile passes only with executed evidence: exit 0 with no real test
  // run (missing report, only file placeholders or skips) is not a pass.
  const testProfile=Boolean(p.junitFiles||p.junitDirs);
  const passed=r.status===0&&tests.failed===0&&!r.error&&!r.signal&&(!testProfile||tests.executed>0);
  return {profile:name,passed,testProfile,exitCode:r.status,timedOut:r.signal==='SIGTERM'||r.error==='ETIMEDOUT',ms:r.ms,tests,diagnostics,
    outputTail:text.slice(-3000)};
}

/**
 * A candidate's checks may not provide less evidence than the failing baseline
 * did: per test profile, executed tests must not drop below the baseline's
 * passing tests and skipped tests must not increase. Profiles the baseline never
 * reached (e.g. unit tests after a compile error) only require executed > 0.
 */
export function evidenceSufficient(baselineResults,candidateResults){
  const reasons=[];
  for(const r of candidateResults){
    if(!r.passed){reasons.push(r.profile+' did not pass');continue;}
    if(!r.testProfile)continue;
    const before=baselineResults.find(b=>b.profile===r.profile);
    if(r.tests.executed<=0)reasons.push(r.profile+' executed no tests');
    if(before?.tests){
      const passingBefore=Math.max(0,before.tests.passed??before.tests.executed-before.tests.failed);
      if(r.tests.executed<passingBefore)reasons.push(`${r.profile} executed ${r.tests.executed} tests, baseline had ${passingBefore} passing`);
      if(r.tests.skipped>before.tests.skipped)reasons.push(`${r.profile} skips ${r.tests.skipped-before.tests.skipped} more tests than the baseline`);
    }
  }
  return {sufficient:reasons.length===0,reasons};
}

export function runChain(chain,wt,out){
  const results=[];
  for(const name of CHAINS[chain]??(()=>{throw Error('Unknown chain '+chain);})()){
    const r=runProfile(name,wt,out);results.push(r);
    if(!r.passed)break;
  }
  return {passed:results.every(r=>r.passed),results,diagnostics:results.flatMap(r=>r.diagnostics)};
}

export function createWorktree(root,base){
  const dir=fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(),'continuum-repair-wt-'));
  git(root,['worktree','add','--detach','--force',dir,base]);
  return dir;
}
export function resetWorktree(wt,base){
  git(wt,['reset','--hard','-q',base]);
  git(wt,['clean','-fdq','-e','build','-e','.gradle','-e','app/build']);
}
export function removeWorktree(root,wt){
  git(root,['worktree','remove','--force',wt],{allowFailure:true});
  fs.rmSync(wt,{recursive:true,force:true});
  git(root,['worktree','prune'],{allowFailure:true});
}

/** `@@ -a,b +c,d @@` headers of a --unified=0 diff (counts default to 1). */
export function parseUnifiedZeroHunks(diff){
  const hunks=[];
  for(const m of String(diff).matchAll(/^@@ -(\d+)(?:,(\d+))? \+(\d+)(?:,(\d+))? @@/gm)){
    hunks.push({oldStart:Number(m[1]),oldCount:m[2]==null?1:Number(m[2]),newStart:Number(m[3]),newCount:m[4]==null?1:Number(m[4])});
    if(hunks.length>=50)break;
  }
  return hunks;
}

function context(wt,base,experience){
  const readFile=rel=>{
    if(typeof rel!=='string'||rel.includes('..')||path.isAbsolute(rel))return null;
    const f=path.join(wt,rel);return fs.existsSync(f)&&fs.statSync(f).isFile()&&fs.statSync(f).size<1_000_000?fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8'):null;
  };
  let index=null;
  try{if(fs.existsSync(path.join(wt,'app/src')))index=buildIndex(collectKotlin(path.join(wt,'app/src')));}catch{}
  const jsSiblings=new Map();
  const jsDir=path.join(wt,'.github/continuum');
  if(fs.existsSync(jsDir))for(const f of fs.readdirSync(jsDir).filter(f=>f.endsWith('.mjs')&&!f.endsWith('.test.mjs')))
    jsSiblings.set('.github/continuum/'+f,fs.readFileSync(path.join(jsDir,f),'utf8'));
  const changedInBase=[];
  const parent=git(wt,['rev-parse','--verify','-q',base+'^'],{allowFailure:true});
  if(parent.status===0){
    const names=git(wt,['diff','--name-only',base+'^',base]).stdout.split('\n').filter(Boolean).slice(0,20);
    for(const file of names){
      const shown=git(wt,['show',base+'^:'+file],{allowFailure:true});
      const diff=git(wt,['diff','--unified=0','--no-color','--no-ext-diff',base+'^',base,'--',file],{allowFailure:true});
      changedInBase.push({file,parent:shown.status===0?shown.stdout:null,hunks:parseUnifiedZeroHunks(diff.stdout)});
    }
  }
  return {readFile,index,jsSiblings,changedInBase,experience};
}

/** Order by experience (Laplace-smoothed per diagnostic kind and strategy) blended with the prior. */
export function rankCandidates(candidates,stats=[],failedIds=new Set()){
  const byKey=new Map(stats.map(s=>[s.kind,s]));
  return candidates.filter(c=>!failedIds.has(c.diagnostic+':'+c.id)).map(c=>{
    const s=byKey.get((c.diagnosticKind+'|'+c.strategy).slice(0,80));
    const learned=s?(s.successes+1)/(s.successes+s.failures+2):0.5;
    return {...c,score:Number((0.6*learned+0.4*(c.prior??0.5)).toFixed(4))};
  }).sort((a,b)=>b.score-a.score||a.id.localeCompare(b.id));
}

/**
 * One repair session on commit `base` in `wt` (an existing clean worktree).
 * Returns a report; never touches the caller's checkout.
 */
export function repairSession({wt,base,chain,out,ledger={attempts:[],experiences:[]},maxCandidates=4,deadline=Date.now()+25*60000,log=()=>{}}){
  if(DEPTH>0)throw Error('Nested repair sessions are not allowed');
  if(!path.isAbsolute(out))throw Error('Report directory must be absolute (checks run inside the worktree)');
  fs.mkdirSync(out,{recursive:true});
  resetWorktree(wt,base);
  const report={schemaVersion:1,base,chain,startedAt:new Date().toISOString(),baseline:null,attempts:[],verified:null,outcome:null};
  const baseline=runChain(chain,wt,out);
  report.baseline={passed:baseline.passed,results:baseline.results.map(({outputTail,diagnostics,...r})=>({...r,diagnostics:diagnostics.length})),
    diagnostics:baseline.diagnostics};
  log(`baseline ${baseline.passed?'PASS':'FAIL'} with ${baseline.diagnostics.length} diagnostics`);
  if(baseline.passed){report.outcome='NO_FAILURE';return report;}
  const actionable=baseline.diagnostics.filter(d=>d.file);
  if(!actionable.length){report.outcome='NO_CODE_DIAGNOSTIC';report.baselineTail=baseline.results.at(-1)?.outputTail;return report;}
  const ctx=context(wt,base,ledger.attempts);
  const failedIds=new Set(ledger.attempts.filter(a=>a.outcome!=='VERIFIED').map(a=>a.diagnostic+':'+a.candidate));
  const ranked=rankCandidates(proposeCandidates(actionable,ctx),ledger.experiences,failedIds);
  log(`${ranked.length} candidates: `+ranked.map(c=>c.strategy+'@'+c.score).join(', '));
  const perStrategy=new Map();
  for(const c of ranked){
    if(report.attempts.filter(a=>a.outcome!=='REJECTED_BY_CRITIC').length>=maxCandidates||Date.now()>deadline)break;
    // keep strategy diversity: at most two tries per strategy family in one session
    const family=c.strategy.split(':')[0];
    if((perStrategy.get(family)??0)>=2)continue;
    perStrategy.set(family,(perStrategy.get(family)??0)+1);
    const verdict=critique(c);
    const attempt={candidate:c.id,strategy:c.strategy,diagnostic:c.diagnostic,diagnosticKind:c.diagnosticKind,
      description:c.description,score:c.score,critic:verdict,edits:c.edits};
    if(!verdict.approved){attempt.outcome='REJECTED_BY_CRITIC';report.attempts.push(attempt);log('critic rejected '+c.strategy+': '+verdict.reasons.join('; '));continue;}
    resetWorktree(wt,base);
    try{
      for(const [file,content] of applyEdits(ctx.readFile,c.edits))fs.writeFileSync(path.join(wt,file),content);
    }catch(e){attempt.outcome='NOT_APPLICABLE';attempt.error=e.message;report.attempts.push(attempt);continue;}
    const check=runChain(chain,wt,out);
    attempt.tests=check.results.map(r=>({profile:r.profile,passed:r.passed,testProfile:r.testProfile,exitCode:r.exitCode,ms:r.ms,tests:r.tests}));
    attempt.remainingDiagnostics=check.diagnostics.slice(0,10);
    const evidence=evidenceSufficient(baseline.results,check.results);
    attempt.evidence=evidence;
    attempt.outcome=!check.passed?'FAILED_TESTS':evidence.sufficient?'VERIFIED':'INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE';
    report.attempts.push(attempt);
    log(`${c.strategy} -> ${attempt.outcome}`);
    if(attempt.outcome==='VERIFIED'){
      const patch=git(wt,['diff','--binary',base]).stdout;
      report.verified={candidate:c.id,strategy:c.strategy,description:c.description,patch,patchSha256:sha256(patch),
        files:[...new Set(c.edits.map(e=>e.file))],tests:attempt.tests,reviewRequired:verdict.reviewRequired,
        confidence:Number((c.score*(verdict.reviewRequired?0.7:1)).toFixed(3))};
      fs.writeFileSync(path.join(out,'repair.patch'),patch);
      break;
    }
  }
  if(!report.verified)resetWorktree(wt,base);
  report.outcome=report.verified?'VERIFIED':'NO_VERIFIED_REPAIR';
  report.finishedAt=new Date().toISOString();
  return report;
}

/** Commit the verified worktree state on a namespaced proposal branch (local only). */
export function commitProposal(wt,report,{branch,message}){
  if(!branch.startsWith(BRANCH_PREFIX)||!/^[a-z0-9._/-]{1,120}$/.test(branch))throw Error('Proposal branches must live under '+BRANCH_PREFIX);
  git(wt,['checkout','-q','-B',branch]);
  git(wt,['add','--',...report.verified.files]);
  git(wt,['-c','user.name=continuum-developer-agent','-c','user.email=continuum-developer-agent@users.noreply.github.com',
    'commit','-q','-m',message]);
  return git(wt,['rev-parse','HEAD']).stdout.trim();
}

test('critic blocks protected paths, test edits, weakening and dangerous code',()=>{
 const edit=(file,o,n)=>({strategy:'KOTLIN_TYPO_REFERENCE',prior:0.6,edits:[{file,oldText:o,newText:n}]});
 assert.equal(critique(edit('app/src/main/A.kt','val a=fo()','val a=foo()')).approved,true);
 assert.equal(critique(edit('.github/workflows/x.yml','a','b')).approved,false);
 assert.equal(critique(edit('app/build.gradle.kts','a','b')).approved,false);
 assert.equal(critique(edit('app/src/main/cognitive/InternetConsentPolicy.kt','a','b')).approved,false);
 assert.equal(critique(edit('app/src/test/A.kt','a','b')).approved,false,'tests are the specification');
 assert.equal(critique(edit('.github/continuum/fixtures/node-reporter/junit-v22.22.0.xml','a','b')).approved,false,'recorded fixtures are the specification');
 assert.equal(critique({strategy:'KOTLIN_ESCAPED_NEWLINE',edits:[{file:'app/src/test/A.kt',oldText:'a\\nb',newText:'a\nb'}]}).approved,true);
 assert.equal(critique(edit('app/src/main/A.kt','assertTrue(x)\nf()','f()')).approved,false);
 assert.equal(critique(edit('app/src/main/A.kt','f()','Runtime.getRuntime().exec("x")')).approved,false);
 assert.equal(critique(edit('app/src/main/A.kt','f(a)','f(a!!)')).approved,false);
 assert.equal(critique(edit('../etc/x','a','b')).approved,false);
 assert.equal(critique(edit('app/src/main/A.kt','x',Array(50).fill('y').join('\n'))).approved,false);
});

test('ledger learns per diagnostic kind and strategy and skips proven failures',()=>{
 const report={base:'a'.repeat(40),chain:'node',outcome:'VERIFIED',finishedAt:'2026-01-01T00:00:00Z',verified:{patchSha256:'b'.repeat(64),strategy:'S'},
  attempts:[{candidate:'c1c1c1c1',diagnostic:'d1d1',diagnosticKind:'REFERENCE_ERROR',strategy:'JS_TYPO_REFERENCE',outcome:'FAILED_TESTS',edits:[],score:0.5},
   {candidate:'c2c2c2c2',diagnostic:'d1d1',diagnosticKind:'REFERENCE_ERROR',strategy:'JS_MISSING_IMPORT',outcome:'VERIFIED',edits:[],score:0.6}]};
 const ledger=recordSession(emptyLedger(),report,{trigger:'test'});
 const stats=Object.fromEntries(ledger.experiences.map(e=>[e.kind,[e.successes,e.failures]]));
 assert.deepEqual(stats,{'REFERENCE_ERROR|JS_MISSING_IMPORT':[1,0],'REFERENCE_ERROR|JS_TYPO_REFERENCE':[0,1]});
 const ranked=rankCandidates([
  {id:'c1c1c1c1',diagnostic:'d1d1',diagnosticKind:'REFERENCE_ERROR',strategy:'JS_TYPO_REFERENCE',prior:0.7},
  {id:'c3c3c3c3',diagnostic:'d1d1',diagnosticKind:'REFERENCE_ERROR',strategy:'JS_TYPO_REFERENCE',prior:0.7},
  {id:'c4c4c4c4',diagnostic:'d1d1',diagnosticKind:'REFERENCE_ERROR',strategy:'JS_MISSING_IMPORT',prior:0.6}],
  ledger.experiences,new Set(['d1d1:c1c1c1c1']));
 assert.deepEqual(ranked.map(c=>c.id),['c4c4c4c4','c3c3c3c3'],'proven failure skipped, learned strategy first');

});

function tempRepo(){
 const dir=fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(),'continuum-loop-test-'));
 const g=(...a)=>{const r=spawnSync('git',a,{cwd:dir,encoding:'utf8'});if(r.status!==0)throw Error(r.stderr);return r.stdout.trim();};
 fs.mkdirSync(path.join(dir,'.github/continuum'),{recursive:true});
 fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir,'.github/continuum/math.mjs'),"export function square(x){return x*x;}\nexport function quad(x){return square(square(x));}\n");
 fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir,'.github/continuum/math.test.mjs'),"import test from 'node:test';\nimport assert from 'node:assert/strict';\nimport {quad} from './math.mjs';\ntest('quad',()=>assert.equal(quad(2),16));\n");
 g('init','-q');g('-c','user.name=t','-c','user.email=t@t','add','.');g('-c','user.name=t','-c','user.email=t@t','commit','-qm','clean');
 fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir,'.github/continuum/math.mjs'),"export function square(x){return x*x;}\nexport function quad(x){return sqare(square(x));}\n");
 g('-c','user.name=t','-c','user.email=t@t','commit','-qam','fault');
 return {dir,head:g('rev-parse','HEAD'),g};
}

test('end-to-end: injected fault is reproduced, repaired in isolation, verified and committed',{skip:nested},()=>{
 const {dir,head,g}=tempRepo();
 const out=fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(),'continuum-loop-out-'));
 try{
  const wt=createWorktree(dir,head);
  let report;
  try{
   report=repairSession({wt,base:head,chain:'node',out,ledger:emptyLedger()});
   assert.equal(report.baseline.passed,false);
   assert.equal(report.outcome,'VERIFIED');
   assert.equal(report.verified.strategy,'JS_TYPO_REFERENCE');
   assert.match(fs.readFileSync(path.join(out,'repair.patch'),'utf8'),/-export function quad\(x\)\{return sqare/);
   const commit=commitProposal(wt,report,{branch:'continuum-agent/repair-test',message:'fix'});
   assert.match(commit,/^[0-9a-f]{40}$/);
  }finally{removeWorktree(dir,wt);}
  // the caller's checkout is untouched
  assert.match(fs.readFileSync(path.join(dir,'.github/continuum/math.mjs'),'utf8'),/sqare/);
  assert.equal(g('status','--porcelain'),'');
  // publisher re-validates the verified patch independently
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(out,'report.json'),JSON.stringify(report));
  const attempt=validateVerifiedReport(report,fs.readFileSync(path.join(out,'repair.patch'),'utf8'));
  assert.equal(attempt.strategy,'JS_TYPO_REFERENCE');
  assert.throws(()=>validateVerifiedReport(report,fs.readFileSync(path.join(out,'repair.patch'),'utf8')+'\n'),/hash/);
  // a report whose success does not rest on executed tests is never published,
  // even when its own flags claim otherwise
  const patchText=fs.readFileSync(path.join(out,'repair.patch'),'utf8');
  const tampered=change=>{const t=structuredClone(report);change(t.attempts.find(a=>a.outcome==='VERIFIED'));return t;};
  assert.throws(()=>validateVerifiedReport(tampered(a=>{a.tests[0].testProfile=false;a.tests[0].tests.executed=0;}),patchText),/executed test evidence/);
  assert.throws(()=>validateVerifiedReport(tampered(a=>{a.evidence.sufficient=false;}),patchText),/executed test evidence/);
  assert.throws(()=>validateVerifiedReport(tampered(a=>{delete a.evidence;}),patchText),/executed test evidence/);
  assert.throws(()=>validateVerifiedReport(tampered(a=>{a.tests=[];}),patchText),/every check/);
  return publishRepair({root:dir,outDir:out,targetBranch:'dev',push:false}).then(r=>{
   assert.equal(r.branch.startsWith('continuum-agent/repair-'),true);assert.match(r.commit,/^[0-9a-f]{40}$/);
  });
 }finally{fs.rmSync(dir,{recursive:true,force:true});fs.rmSync(out,{recursive:true,force:true});}
});

import {evidenceSufficient,runProfile,parseUnifiedZeroHunks} from './repair-loop.mjs';
import {revertHunk} from './repair-strategies.mjs';

test('hunk revert handles modification, insertion and deletion hunks exactly',()=>{
 const parent='a\nb\nc\nd\n';
 assert.equal(revertHunk('a\nB\nc\nd\n',parent,{oldStart:2,oldCount:1,newStart:2,newCount:1}),parent);
 assert.equal(revertHunk('a\nb\nX\nY\nc\nd\n',parent,{oldStart:2,oldCount:0,newStart:3,newCount:2}),parent);
 assert.equal(revertHunk('a\nd\n',parent,{oldStart:2,oldCount:2,newStart:1,newCount:0}),parent);
 assert.equal(revertHunk('a\n',parent,{oldStart:9,oldCount:1,newStart:9,newCount:1}),null,'out-of-range hunks are rejected');
 assert.deepEqual(parseUnifiedZeroHunks('@@ -2 +2 @@\n-b\n+B\n@@ -4,0 +5,2 @@\n+x\n+y\n'),
  [{oldStart:2,oldCount:1,newStart:2,newCount:1},{oldStart:4,oldCount:0,newStart:5,newCount:2}]);
});

test('baseline passing count excludes crashed test files and failures',()=>{
 const base={profile:'node-continuum',passed:false,testProfile:true,tests:{total:94,placeholders:3,executed:91,failed:5,passed:89,skipped:0}};
 const after=e=>({profile:'node-continuum',passed:true,testProfile:true,tests:{total:e,placeholders:0,executed:e,failed:0,passed:e,skipped:0}});
 assert.equal(evidenceSufficient([base],[after(88)]).sufficient,false,'one previously passing test no longer runs');
 assert.equal(evidenceSufficient([base],[after(89)]).sufficient,true);
});

test('success requires executed tests that do not shrink against the baseline',()=>{
 const res=(executed,skipped=0,failed=0,passed=true)=>({profile:'node-continuum',passed,testProfile:true,tests:{executed,skipped,failed,total:executed+skipped}});
 assert.equal(evidenceSufficient([res(10,0,1,false)],[res(10)]).sufficient,true);
 assert.equal(evidenceSufficient([res(10,0,1,false)],[res(0)]).sufficient,false,'no executed tests');
 assert.equal(evidenceSufficient([res(10,0,1,false)],[res(8)]).sufficient,false,'fewer tests than passed before');
 assert.equal(evidenceSufficient([res(10,1,1,false)],[res(9,2)]).sufficient,false,'more skipped tests');
 // a profile the baseline never reached (compile failed first) needs executed > 0
 const unit=e=>({profile:'android-unit',passed:true,testProfile:true,tests:{executed:e,skipped:0,failed:0}});
 const compile={profile:'android-compile',passed:true,testProfile:false,tests:{executed:0,skipped:0,failed:0}};
 assert.equal(evidenceSufficient([{...compile,passed:false}],[compile,unit(40)]).sufficient,true);
 assert.equal(evidenceSufficient([{...compile,passed:false}],[compile,unit(0)]).sufficient,false);
});

function gitRepo(files){
 const dir=fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(),'continuum-evidence-'));
 const g=(...a)=>{const r=spawnSync('git',a,{cwd:dir,encoding:'utf8'});if(r.status!==0)throw Error(r.stderr);return r.stdout.trim();};
 const write=fs_=>{for(const [f,c] of Object.entries(fs_)){fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(path.join(dir,f)),{recursive:true});fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir,f),c);}};
 write(files);g('init','-q');g('-c','user.name=t','-c','user.email=t@t','add','.');g('-c','user.name=t','-c','user.email=t@t','commit','-qm','base');
 return {dir,g,write,commit:(msg,next)=>{write(next);g('-c','user.name=t','-c','user.email=t@t','commit','-qam',msg);return g('rev-parse','HEAD');}};
}

test('regression search reverts only the culprit hunk and keeps unrelated changes',{skip:nested},()=>{
 const math="export function square(x){return x*x;}\n\nexport function quad(x){return square(square(x));}\n\n// end\n";
 const repo=gitRepo({'.github/continuum/math.mjs':math,
  '.github/continuum/math.test.mjs':"import test from 'node:test';\nimport assert from 'node:assert/strict';\nimport {quad} from './math.mjs';\ntest('quad',()=>assert.equal(quad(2),16));\n"});
 // one commit with an unrelated addition AND a behavior regression in the same file
 const broken="export function square(x){return x+x;}\n\nexport function quad(x){return square(square(x));}\n\n// end\nexport function cube(x){return x*x*x;}\n";
 const head=repo.commit('mixed change',{'.github/continuum/math.mjs':broken});
 const out=fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(),'continuum-hunk-out-'));
 try{
  const wt=createWorktree(repo.dir,head);
  try{
   const report=repairSession({wt,base:head,chain:'node',out,ledger:emptyLedger()});
   assert.equal(report.outcome,'VERIFIED');
   assert.equal(report.verified.strategy,'REVERT_HUNK_TO_PARENT');
   const repaired=fs.readFileSync(path.join(wt,'.github/continuum/math.mjs'),'utf8');
   assert.match(repaired,/return x\*x;/,'culprit hunk restored');
   assert.match(repaired,/export function cube/,'unrelated change kept');
   const patch=fs.readFileSync(path.join(out,'repair.patch'),'utf8');
   assert.ok(!/cube/.test(patch),'patch does not touch the unrelated hunk');
   const verifiedAttempt=report.attempts.find(a=>a.outcome==='VERIFIED');
   assert.ok(verifiedAttempt.tests.every(t=>!t.testProfile||t.tests.executed>0));
   assert.equal(verifiedAttempt.evidence.sufficient,true);
  }finally{removeWorktree(repo.dir,wt);}
  assert.equal(repo.g('status','--porcelain'),'','caller checkout untouched');
  assert.equal(repo.g('worktree','list','--porcelain').split('\n').filter(l=>l.startsWith('worktree ')).length,1,'no leftover worktree');
 }finally{fs.rmSync(repo.dir,{recursive:true,force:true});fs.rmSync(out,{recursive:true,force:true});}
});

test('a module that crashes while loading is located and gets its missing import back',{skip:nested},()=>{
