import fs from 'node:fs';
import os from 'node:os';
import path from 'node:path';
import {spawnSync} from 'node:child_process';
import {git,BRANCH_PREFIX,CHAINS,TEST_PROFILES} from './repair-loop.mjs';
import {decodeDocument,encodeDocument,emptyDocument} from './development-backlog.mjs';
import {critique} from './repair-critic.mjs';
import {sha256} from './repair-diagnostics.mjs';
import {emptyLedger,recordSession,verifyLedger} from './repair-ledger.mjs';

/**
 * Publisher (runs in a job WITHOUT build execution, holding the write token).
 * It re-checks the verified patch with the critic, applies it with `git apply`
 * onto the exact base commit, commits it on a branch under continuum-agent/
 * and opens a DRAFT pull request. It never pushes to the target branch itself.
 */
const BRANCH_RE=/^continuum-agent\/[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._/-]{0,110}$/;
const TARGET_RE=/^[A-Za-z0-9][\w./-]{0,120}$/;
const AUTHOR=['-c','user.name=continuum-developer-agent','-c','user.email=continuum-developer-agent@users.noreply.github.com'];

export function assertProposalBranch(branch){
  if(!BRANCH_RE.test(branch)||branch.includes('..')||!branch.startsWith(BRANCH_PREFIX))throw Error('Refusing branch outside '+BRANCH_PREFIX+': '+branch);
  return branch;
}

/** Defense in depth: the publishing job trusts nothing but the critic and hashes. */
export function validateVerifiedReport(report,patch){
  if(!report||report.outcome!=='VERIFIED'||!report.verified)throw Error('Report has no verified repair');
  if(!/^[0-9a-f]{40}$/.test(report.base??''))throw Error('Report base must be a full commit hash');
  if(sha256(patch)!==report.verified.patchSha256)throw Error('Patch hash does not match the verified report');
  const attempt=(report.attempts??[]).find(a=>a.outcome==='VERIFIED'&&a.candidate===report.verified.candidate);
  if(!attempt)throw Error('Verified attempt missing');
  const verdict=critique({strategy:attempt.strategy,prior:attempt.score,edits:attempt.edits});
  if(!verdict.approved)throw Error('Critic rejects the verified patch: '+verdict.reasons.join('; '));
  const touched=[...patch.matchAll(/^diff --git a\/(\S+) b\/(\S+)$/gm)].map(m=>m[2]);
  const declared=new Set(report.verified.files);
  if(!touched.length||touched.some(f=>!declared.has(f)))throw Error('Patch touches files outside the verified edit set');
  if((report.attempts??[]).some(a=>a.outcome==='VERIFIED'&&!a.tests?.every(t=>t.passed)))throw Error('Verified attempt has failing checks');
  // every profile of the chain ran and passed; success rests on tests that actually ran
  const profiles=CHAINS[report.chain];
  if(!profiles||profiles.some(p=>!attempt.tests?.some(t=>t.profile===p&&t.passed===true)))throw Error('Verified attempt did not pass every check of its chain');
  if(attempt.evidence?.sufficient!==true||attempt.tests.some(t=>(t.testProfile||TEST_PROFILES.includes(t.profile))&&!(t.tests?.executed>0)))
    throw Error('Verified attempt lacks executed test evidence');
  return attempt;
}

async function withWorktree(root,base,fn){
  const dir=fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(),'continuum-publish-'));
  git(root,['worktree','add','--detach','--force',dir,base]);
  try{return await fn(dir);}finally{git(root,['worktree','remove','--force',dir],{allowFailure:true});fs.rmSync(dir,{recursive:true,force:true});}
}

export function applyPatchCommit(wt,patch,message){
  const file=path.join(wt,'.git-continuum-proposal.patch');
  fs.writeFileSync(file,patch);
  try{
    git(wt,['apply','--check','--whitespace=nowarn',file]);
    git(wt,['apply','--whitespace=nowarn',file]);
  }finally{fs.rmSync(file,{force:true});}
  git(wt,['add','-A']);
  git(wt,[...AUTHOR,'commit','-q','-m',message]);
  return git(wt,['rev-parse','HEAD']).stdout.trim();
}

export function pullRequestBody(report,attempt,extra=''){
  const tests=(report.verified.tests??[]).map(t=>`- \`${t.profile}\`: ${t.passed?'passed':'FAILED'}${t.tests?.total?` (${t.tests.total-t.tests.failed}/${t.tests.total} tests)`:''}, exit ${t.exitCode}, ${Math.round((t.ms??0)/1000)} s`).join('\n');
  const diags=(report.baseline?.diagnostics??[]).slice(0,5).map(d=>`- \`${d.kind}\` ${d.file??''}${d.line?':'+d.line:''} — ${String(d.message).replace(/[`\r\n]/g,' ').slice(0,160)}`).join('\n');
  return [
    '## Continuum Developer Agent · verified repair proposal','',
    '**Draft. Human review required. Nothing was merged.**','',
    `Base commit: \`${report.base}\`  ·  Check chain: \`${report.chain}\``,'',
    '### Reproduced failure (agent\'s own run)',diags||'- (none recorded)','',
    `### Repair\nStrategy \`${attempt.strategy}\` — ${attempt.description}\nCritic risk ${attempt.critic?.risk} · changed lines ${attempt.critic?.changedLines} · review required: ${report.verified.reviewRequired?'yes':'no'} · confidence ${report.verified.confidence}`,'',
    '### Verification in an isolated worktree',tests,'',
    `Patch SHA-256: \`${report.verified.patchSha256}\``,'',
    'Generated deterministically (no LLM, no paid API). The agent may be wrong about intent; tests only prove the checks pass.',
    extra
  ].join('\n');
}

async function github(method,url,token,body){
  const response=await fetch('https://api.github.com'+url,{method,signal:AbortSignal.timeout(15000),
    headers:{Authorization:'Bearer '+token,Accept:'application/vnd.github+json','X-GitHub-Api-Version':'2022-11-28','Content-Type':'application/json'},
    body:body?JSON.stringify(body):undefined});
  const text=await response.text();
  let json=null;try{json=JSON.parse(text);}catch{}
  return {ok:response.ok,status:response.status,json,message:(json?.message??text).slice(0,300)};
}

export async function openDraftPullRequest({repository,token,head,base,title,body}){
  if(!/^[-\w.]+\/[-\w.]+$/.test(repository??''))throw Error('Invalid repository');
  if(!TARGET_RE.test(base))throw Error('Invalid base branch');
  assertProposalBranch(head);
  const r=await github('POST',`/repos/${repository}/pulls`,token,{title:title.slice(0,200),head,base,body:body.slice(0,60000),draft:true,maintainer_can_modify:true});
  if(r.ok)return {status:'OPENED',number:r.json.number,url:r.json.html_url};
  // e.g. 403 when "Allow GitHub Actions to create and approve pull requests" is off
  return {status:'NOT_PERMITTED',httpStatus:r.status,message:r.message,
    compare:`https://github.com/${repository}/compare/${encodeURIComponent(base)}...${encodeURIComponent(head)}?expand=1`};
}

export function pushBranch(wt,branch){
  assertProposalBranch(branch);
  git(wt,['push','--quiet','origin','HEAD:refs/heads/'+branch],{timeoutMs:120000});
}

/** Publish a verified repair of a real failing commit as branch + draft PR. */
export async function publishRepair({root,outDir,targetBranch,repository,token,push=true}){
  if(!TARGET_RE.test(targetBranch)||targetBranch==='main'||targetBranch.startsWith(BRANCH_PREFIX))throw Error('Invalid target branch '+targetBranch);
  const report=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(outDir,'report.json'),'utf8'));
  const patch=fs.readFileSync(path.join(outDir,'repair.patch'),'utf8');
  const attempt=validateVerifiedReport(report,patch);
  const branch=assertProposalBranch(`${BRANCH_PREFIX}repair-${report.base.slice(0,10)}-${attempt.diagnostic.slice(0,8)}`);
  const message=`fix(agent): ${attempt.strategy} for ${attempt.diagnosticKind}\n\n${attempt.description}\nBase: ${report.base}\nPatch-SHA256: ${report.verified.patchSha256}\nVerified by: ${report.chain} check chain (isolated worktree)`;
  return withWorktree(root,report.base,async wt=>{
    const commit=applyPatchCommit(wt,patch,message);
    const result={branch,commit,base:report.base,targetBranch,pullRequest:null};
    if(!push)return result;
    pushBranch(wt,branch);
    result.pullRequest=await openDraftPullRequest({repository,token,head:branch,base:targetBranch,
      title:`[Continuum agent] ${attempt.strategy}: ${attempt.description}`.slice(0,180),body:pullRequestBody(report,attempt)});
    return result;
  });
}

/** Benchmark demonstration: push the injected fault and its verified repair as two
 * branches and open a draft PR repair -> fault. Never targets a real branch. */
export async function publishBenchmarkDemo({root,head,faultDir,runId,repository,token,push=true}){
  const report=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(faultDir,'report.json'),'utf8'));
  const patch=fs.readFileSync(path.join(faultDir,'repair.patch'),'utf8');
  const faultPatch=fs.readFileSync(path.join(faultDir,'fault.patch'),'utf8');
  const attempt=validateVerifiedReport(report,patch);
  const id=path.basename(faultDir).toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9-]/g,'-').slice(0,48);
  const run=String(runId).replace(/[^0-9a-z]/gi,'').slice(0,20)||'local';
  const faultBranch=assertProposalBranch(`${BRANCH_PREFIX}demo/${run}/fault-${id}`);
  const repairBranch=assertProposalBranch(`${BRANCH_PREFIX}demo/${run}/repair-${id}`);
  return withWorktree(root,head,async wt=>{
    const faultCommit=applyPatchCommit(wt,faultPatch,`test(agent): inject benchmark fault ${id}\n\nDeliberate, reproducible fault for the repair benchmark.`);
    if(push)pushBranch(wt,faultBranch);
    const repairCommit=applyPatchCommit(wt,patch,`fix(agent): ${attempt.strategy} repairs benchmark fault ${id}\n\nPatch-SHA256: ${report.verified.patchSha256}`);
    const result={faultBranch,repairBranch,faultCommit,repairCommit,pullRequest:null};
    if(!push)return result;
    pushBranch(wt,repairBranch);
    result.pullRequest=await openDraftPullRequest({repository,token,head:repairBranch,base:faultBranch,
      title:`[Continuum agent demo] ${attempt.strategy} repairs injected fault ${id}`,
      body:pullRequestBody(report,attempt,`\n\nThis PR targets the demo fault branch \`${faultBranch}\`, not a development branch.`)});
    return result;
  });
}

/** Ledger and backlog persistence on a dedicated state branch with stale-write protection. */
export const STATE_BRANCH='continuum-agent-state';
export const BACKLOG_FILE='development-backlog.json';
const STATE_README='# Continuum developer-agent state\n\nWritten by CI only. repair-ledger.json: append-only repair ledger (code hunks and test outcomes). '+
  'development-backlog.json: development backlog (docs/DEVELOPMENT_BACKLOG.md). No device or personal data.\n';

function fetchStateBranch(root,branch){
  const fetched=git(root,['fetch','--quiet','--depth=1','origin',`+refs/heads/${branch}:refs/remotes/origin/${branch}`],{allowFailure:true});
  if(fetched.status===0)return git(root,['rev-parse',`refs/remotes/origin/${branch}`]).stdout.trim();
  // only a branch that does not exist yet is "empty state"; any other failure is an error
  const listed=git(root,['ls-remote','--heads','origin',branch],{allowFailure:true});
  if(listed.status===0&&!listed.stdout.trim())return null;
  throw Error('Cannot read state branch '+branch+': '+(fetched.stderr||listed.stderr||'').slice(-300));
}

function withStateWorktree(root,remoteHead,fn){
  const dir=fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(),'continuum-state-'));
  try{
    if(remoteHead)git(root,['worktree','add','--detach','--force',dir,remoteHead]);
    else{git(root,['worktree','add','--detach','--force',dir,'HEAD']);git(dir,['checkout','-q','--orphan','continuum-state-'+process.pid+'-'+Date.now()]);git(dir,['rm','-rq','--cached','.'],{allowFailure:true});
      for(const e of fs.readdirSync(dir))if(e!=='.git')fs.rmSync(path.join(dir,e),{recursive:true,force:true});}
    return fn(dir);
  }finally{git(root,['worktree','remove','--force',dir],{allowFailure:true});fs.rmSync(dir,{recursive:true,force:true});}
}

export function loadLedgerFromBranch(root,branch){
  const head=fetchStateBranch(root,branch);
  if(!head)return {ledger:emptyLedger(),remoteHead:null};
  const shown=git(root,['show',`${head}:repair-ledger.json`],{allowFailure:true});
  return {ledger:shown.status===0?verifyLedger(JSON.parse(shown.stdout)):emptyLedger(),remoteHead:head};
}

export function saveLedgerToBranch(root,branch,reports,meta={}){
  if(branch!==STATE_BRANCH)throw Error('Ledger branch must be '+STATE_BRANCH);
  for(let attempt=0;attempt<2;attempt++){
    const {ledger,remoteHead}=loadLedgerFromBranch(root,branch);
    let next=ledger;
    for(const {report,meta:m} of reports){
      if(next.sessions.some(s=>s.base===report.base&&s.at===(report.finishedAt??null)&&s.chain===report.chain))continue;
      next=recordSession(next,report,{...meta,...m});
    }
    const result=withStateWorktree(root,remoteHead,dir=>{
      fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir,'repair-ledger.json'),JSON.stringify(next,null,1)+'\n');
      fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir,'README.md'),STATE_README);
      git(dir,['add','repair-ledger.json','README.md']);
      if(git(dir,['diff','--cached','--quiet'],{allowFailure:true}).status===0)return {status:'UNCHANGED',sessions:next.sessions.length};
      git(dir,[...AUTHOR,'commit','-q','-m',`chore(agent): record ${reports.length} repair session(s)`]);
      const pushed=git(dir,['push','--quiet','origin',`HEAD:refs/heads/${branch}`],{allowFailure:true,timeoutMs:120000});
      return pushed.status===0?{status:'SAVED',sessions:next.sessions.length,attempts:next.attempts.length}:null;
    });
    if(result)return result;
  }
  throw Error('Ledger branch moved twice during save; refusing a stale write');
}

/**
 * The backlog on the state branch: {doc|null, remoteHead}. Unreadable state is
 * an error, never "empty" (an empty answer would let the agent repeat work).
 */
export function loadBacklogFromBranch(root,branch=STATE_BRANCH){
  const remoteHead=fetchStateBranch(root,branch);
  if(!remoteHead)return {doc:null,remoteHead:null};
  const shown=spawnSync('git',['show',`${remoteHead}:${BACKLOG_FILE}`],{cwd:root,maxBuffer:16*1024*1024});
  if(shown.status!==0){
    const exists=git(root,['cat-file','-e',`${remoteHead}:${BACKLOG_FILE}`],{allowFailure:true});
    if(exists.status!==0)return {doc:null,remoteHead};
    throw Error('Cannot read '+BACKLOG_FILE+' from '+branch);
  }
  return {doc:decodeDocument(shown.stdout,{migrate:{at:Date.now(),actor:'continuum-agent'}}).doc,remoteHead};
}

/**
 * Read-modify-write of the backlog on the state branch. `mutate(doc)` returns
 * {doc, ...report}; the push is a compare-and-swap on the branch head (one
 * retry from a fresh read when it moved).
 */
export function saveBacklogToBranch(root,branch,mutate,{message='chore(agent): update development backlog'}={}){
  if(branch!==STATE_BRANCH)throw Error('Backlog branch must be '+STATE_BRANCH);
  for(let attempt=0;attempt<2;attempt++){
    const {doc,remoteHead}=loadBacklogFromBranch(root,branch);
    const outcome=mutate(doc??emptyDocument(Date.now(),'continuum-agent'));
    const bytes=encodeDocument(outcome.doc);
    const result=withStateWorktree(root,remoteHead,dir=>{
      const file=path.join(dir,BACKLOG_FILE);
      if(fs.existsSync(file)&&fs.readFileSync(file).equals(bytes))return {status:'UNCHANGED',revision:outcome.doc.revision};
      fs.writeFileSync(file,bytes);
      fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir,'README.md'),STATE_README);
      git(dir,['add',BACKLOG_FILE,'README.md']);
      git(dir,[...AUTHOR,'commit','-q','-m',message]);
      const pushed=git(dir,['push','--quiet','origin',`HEAD:refs/heads/${branch}`],{allowFailure:true,timeoutMs:120000});
      return pushed.status===0?{status:'SAVED',revision:outcome.doc.revision}:null;
    });
    if(result)return {...outcome,...result,doc:undefined};
  }
  throw Error('State branch moved twice during save; refusing a stale write');
}

import {tokenize} from './kotlin-tokenizer.mjs';

/**
 * Solution developer + code generator. Deterministic strategies map a structured
 * diagnostic to concrete candidate edits. Every edit is a minimal hunk
 * {file, oldText, newText} that occurs exactly once in the base file, so the same
 * hunk can later be replayed from experience and reviewed as a normal diff.

export const JDK_IMPORTS=Object.freeze({
  File:'java.io.File',FileOutputStream:'java.io.FileOutputStream',FileInputStream:'java.io.FileInputStream',

export function editDistance(a,b){
  // Damerau-Levenshtein (optimal string alignment)
  const d=Array.from({length:a.length+1},(_,i)=>Array(b.length+1).fill(0).map((_,j)=>i===0?j:j===0?i:0));
  for(let i=1;i<=a.length;i++)for(let j=1;j<=b.length;j++){
    const cost=a[i-1]===b[j-1]?0:1;
    d[i][j]=Math.min(d[i-1][j]+1,d[i][j-1]+1,d[i-1][j-1]+cost);
    if(i>1&&j>1&&a[i-1]===b[j-2]&&a[i-2]===b[j-1])d[i][j]=Math.min(d[i][j],d[i-2][j-2]+1);
  }
  return d[a.length][b.length];
}

/** Minimal unique line-based hunk turning `before` into `after`. */
export function hunk(file,before,after){
  if(before===after)return null;
  const a=before.split('\n'),b=after.split('\n');
  let p=0;while(p<a.length&&p<b.length&&a[p]===b[p])p++;
  let s=0;while(s<a.length-p&&s<b.length-p&&a[a.length-1-s]===b[b.length-1-s])s++;
  for(let ctx=0;ctx<=6;ctx++){
    const from=Math.max(0,p-ctx),toA=Math.min(a.length,a.length-s+ctx),toB=Math.min(b.length,b.length-s+ctx);
    const oldText=a.slice(from,toA).join('\n'),newText=b.slice(from,toB).join('\n');
    if(oldText&&before.split(oldText).length===2)return {file,oldText,newText,line:from+1};
  }
  return {file,oldText:before,newText:after,line:1};
}

/** Undo one --unified=0 hunk of the parent->current change; null if it does not fit. */
export function revertHunk(current,parent,h){
  const cur=current.split('\n'),par=parent.split('\n');
  const cs=h.newCount===0?h.newStart:h.newStart-1;
  const ps=h.oldCount===0?h.oldStart:h.oldStart-1;
  if(cs<0||ps<0||cs+h.newCount>cur.length||ps+h.oldCount>par.length)return null;
  return [...cur.slice(0,cs),...par.slice(ps,ps+h.oldCount),...cur.slice(cs+h.newCount)].join('\n');
}

export function applyEdits(readFile,edits){
  const out=new Map();
  for(const e of edits){
    const current=out.get(e.file)??readFile(e.file);
    if(current==null)throw Error('Missing file '+e.file);
    if(current.split(e.oldText).length!==2)throw Error('Hunk is not unique in '+e.file);
    out.set(e.file,current.replace(e.oldText,()=>e.newText));
  }
  return out;
}

const lineAt=(text,line)=>text.split('\n')[line-1];
const replaceLine=(text,line,value)=>{const rows=text.split('\n');rows[line-1]=value;return rows.join('\n');};

function candidate(strategy,d,description,prior,file,before,after){
  const h=hunk(file,before,after);if(!h)return null;
  const edits=[h];
  return {id:sha256(strategy+'\u0000'+JSON.stringify(edits)).slice(0,16),strategy,diagnostic:d.fingerprint,
    diagnosticKind:d.kind,description,prior,edits};
}

/** `\n` typed as two characters outside string/char literals (historical CI failure 48bd150). */
export function unescapeCodeNewlines(line){
  let out='',inStr=false,inChar=false,changed=false;
  for(let i=0;i<line.length;i++){
    const c=line[i];
    if(inStr){out+=c;if(c==='\\'){out+=line[++i]??'';continue;}if(c==='"')inStr=false;continue;}
    if(inChar){out+=c;if(c==='\\'){out+=line[++i]??'';continue;}if(c==="'")inChar=false;continue;}
    if(c==='"'){inStr=true;out+=c;continue;}
    if(c==="'"){inChar=true;out+=c;continue;}
    if(c==='/'&&line[i+1]==='/'){out+=line.slice(i);break;}
    if(c==='\\'&&line[i+1]==='n'){out+='\n';i++;changed=true;continue;}
    out+=c;
  }
  return changed?out:null;
}

function kotlinEscapedNewline(d,text){
  const line=lineAt(text,d.line);if(line==null)return [];
  const fixed=unescapeCodeNewlines(line);if(fixed==null)return [];
  return [candidate('KOTLIN_ESCAPED_NEWLINE',d,'Replace literal "\\n" escapes outside string literals with line breaks',0.8,
    d.file,text,replaceLine(text,d.line,fixed))];
}

function kotlinKnownFix(d,text){
  const line=lineAt(text,d.line);if(line==null)return [];
  return knownFixes(line).filter(f=>line.split(f.from).length===2).map(f=>
    candidate('KOTLIN_KNOWN_FIX:'+f.kind,d,`Known fix ${f.kind}: ${f.from} -> ${f.to}`,0.75,d.file,text,replaceLine(text,d.line,line.replace(f.from,f.to))));
}

export function insertImport(text,fqn){
  if(new RegExp('^import\\s+'+fqn.replace(/\./g,'\\.')+'\\s*$','m').test(text))return null;
  const rows=text.split('\n');
  let last=-1,pkg=-1;
  rows.forEach((r,i)=>{if(/^import\s/.test(r))last=i;if(/^package\s/.test(r))pkg=i;});
  if(last>=0){
    // keep simple lexical order within the import block
    let at=last+1;for(let i=pkg+1;i<=last;i++)if(/^import\s/.test(rows[i])&&rows[i].slice(7).trim()>fqn){at=i;break;}
    rows.splice(at,0,'import '+fqn);
  }else rows.splice(pkg+1,0,'','import '+fqn);
  return rows.join('\n');
}

function kotlinMissingImport(d,text,index){
  const options=new Set();
  const pkg=(text.match(/^package\s+([\w.]+)/m)??[])[1]??'';
  const isTest=/(^|\/)test\//.test(d.file);
  for(const decl of index?.byName.get(d.symbol)??[]){
    if(decl.container||decl.package===pkg||!decl.package)continue;
    if(decl.test&&!isTest)continue;
    if(decl.visibility==='private')continue;
    options.add(decl.package+'.'+decl.name);
  }
  if(JDK_IMPORTS[d.symbol])options.add(JDK_IMPORTS[d.symbol]);
  const simpleAlreadyImported=new RegExp('^import\\s+[\\w.]+\\.'+d.symbol+'\\s*$','m').test(text);
  if(simpleAlreadyImported)return [];
  return [...options].slice(0,3).map(fqn=>{
    const after=insertImport(text,fqn);
    return after&&candidate('KOTLIN_MISSING_IMPORT',d,'Add import '+fqn,options.size===1?0.7:0.45,d.file,text,after);
  }).filter(Boolean);
}

function vocabulary(text,index,language){
  const counts=new Map();
  const words=language==='kotlin'?tokenize(text).filter(t=>t.type==='id').map(t=>t.text)
    :[...text.replace(/\/\/[^\n]*|\/\*[\s\S]*?\*\//g,' ').matchAll(/[A-Za-z_$][\w$]*/g)].map(m=>m[0]);
  for(const w of words)counts.set(w,(counts.get(w)??0)+1);
  for(const name of index?.byName?.keys()??[])if(!counts.has(name))counts.set(name,0);
  return counts;
}

export function nearestNames(symbol,vocab,limit=3){
  const maxDistance=symbol.length<=4?1:2;
  return [...vocab.entries()].filter(([w])=>w!==symbol&&Math.abs(w.length-symbol.length)<=maxDistance&&w.length>=3)
    .map(([w,c])=>({w,c,dist:editDistance(symbol,w)}))
    .filter(x=>x.dist<=maxDistance&&(x.c>0||x.dist===1))
    .sort((x,y)=>x.dist-y.dist||y.c-x.c||x.w.localeCompare(y.w)).slice(0,limit).map(x=>x.w);
}

function replaceTokenAt(line,symbol,col){
  const at=col?col-1:-1;
  if(at>=0&&line.slice(at,at+symbol.length)===symbol&&!/[\w$]/.test(line[at+symbol.length]??''))return [at,at+symbol.length];
  const m=new RegExp('(^|[^\\w$])('+symbol.replace(/\$/g,'\\$')+')(?![\\w$])').exec(line);
  return m?[m.index+m[1].length,m.index+m[1].length+symbol.length]:null;
}

function typoReference(d,text,index,language){
  const line=lineAt(text,d.line);if(line==null||!d.symbol)return [];
  const span=replaceTokenAt(line,d.symbol,d.col);if(!span)return [];
  return nearestNames(d.symbol,vocabulary(text,index,language)).map((name,rank)=>
    candidate(language==='kotlin'?'KOTLIN_TYPO_REFERENCE':'JS_TYPO_REFERENCE',d,`Replace unresolved '${d.symbol}' with nearby name '${name}'`,
      0.65-rank*0.1,d.file,text,replaceLine(text,d.line,line.slice(0,span[0])+name+line.slice(span[1]))));
}

function kotlinNullableString(d,text){
  if(d.actual!=='String?'||d.expected!=='String')return [];
  const line=lineAt(text,d.line);if(line==null)return [];
  let i=d.col-1,depth=0;
  if(!/[A-Za-z_]/.test(line[i]??''))return [];
  for(;i<line.length;i++){
    const c=line[i];
    if(c==='('||c==='[')depth++;
    else if(c===')'||c===']'){if(depth===0)break;depth--;}
    else if(depth===0&&(c===','||c===' '||c===';'))break;
  }
  const fixed=line.slice(0,i)+'.orEmpty()'+line.slice(i);
  return [candidate('KOTLIN_NULLABLE_STRING_DEFAULT',d,'Use orEmpty() where a non-null String is required',0.4,d.file,text,replaceLine(text,d.line,fixed))];
}

export function exportedNames(text){
  const names=new Set();
  for(const m of text.matchAll(/^export\s+(?:async\s+)?(?:function\*?|const|let|class)\s+([A-Za-z_$][\w$]*)/gm))names.add(m[1]);
  for(const m of text.matchAll(/^export\s*\{([^}]*)\}/gm))for(const part of m[1].split(','))names.add(part.trim().split(/\s+as\s+/).pop());
  return names;
}

function jsMissingImport(d,text,siblings){
  const out=[];
  for(const [file,content] of siblings){
    if(file===d.file||!exportedNames(content).has(d.symbol))continue;
    const spec='./'+file.split('/').pop();
    const existing=new RegExp("^import\\s*\\{([^}]*)\\}\\s*from\\s*['\"]"+spec.replace(/\./g,'\\.')+"['\"];?","m").exec(text);
    let after;
    if(existing)after=text.replace(existing[0],existing[0].replace('{'+existing[1]+'}','{'+existing[1].replace(/\s+$/,'')+','+d.symbol+'}'));
    else{
      const rows=text.split('\n');let last=-1;rows.forEach((r,i)=>{if(/^import\s/.test(r))last=i;});
      rows.splice(last+1,0,`import {${d.symbol}} from '${spec}';`);after=rows.join('\n');
    }
    // extending an existing import from that module is the most likely intent
    out.push(candidate('JS_MISSING_IMPORT',d,`Import ${d.symbol} from ${spec}`,existing?0.75:0.6,d.file,text,after));
  }
  return out.slice(0,2);
}

/**
 * @param diagnostics structured diagnostics of the failing base
 * @param ctx {readFile(rel), index (Kotlin), jsSiblings Map, changedInBase [{file,parent}], experience []}
 */
export function proposeCandidates(diagnostics,ctx){
  const out=[];const seen=new Set();
  const add=c=>{if(c&&!seen.has(c.id)){seen.add(c.id);out.push(c);}};
  for(const d of diagnostics.slice(0,12)){
    // experience replay: a verified hunk for the same problem identity
    for(const past of ctx.experience??[]){
      if(past.outcome!=='VERIFIED'||past.diagnostic!==d.fingerprint)continue;
      try{applyEdits(ctx.readFile,past.edits);
        add({id:sha256('EXPERIENCE\u0000'+JSON.stringify(past.edits)).slice(0,16),strategy:'EXPERIENCE_REPLAY',
          diagnostic:d.fingerprint,diagnosticKind:d.kind,description:'Replay patch verified for the same diagnostic in '+(past.baseCommit??'').slice(0,12),
          prior:0.9,edits:past.edits});}catch{}
    }
    if(!d.file)continue;
    const text=ctx.readFile(d.file);if(text==null)continue;
    const isKotlin=/\.kts?$/.test(d.file),isJs=/\.m?js$/.test(d.file);
    if(isKotlin&&d.kind==='SYNTAX_ERROR')kotlinEscapedNewline(d,text).forEach(add);
    if(isKotlin&&d.kind==='UNRESOLVED_REFERENCE'){
      kotlinKnownFix(d,text).forEach(add);
      const imports=kotlinMissingImport(d,text,ctx.index);imports.forEach(add);
      // A name that exists verbatim elsewhere is far more likely missing an import than misspelled.
      typoReference(d,text,ctx.index,'kotlin').map(c=>imports.length?{...c,prior:c.prior*0.5}:c).forEach(add);
    }
    if(isKotlin&&d.kind==='TYPE_MISMATCH')kotlinNullableString(d,text).forEach(add);
    if(isJs&&d.kind==='REFERENCE_ERROR'){
      const imports=jsMissingImport(d,text,ctx.jsSiblings??new Map());imports.forEach(add);
      typoReference(d,text,null,'js').map(c=>imports.length?{...c,prior:c.prior*0.5}:c).forEach(add);
    }
  }
  // Regression culprit search, smallest unit first: undo ONE hunk of the failing
  // commit (closest to a diagnostic first), so unrelated changes in the same
  // file survive. Whole-file revert remains the fallback.
  if(diagnostics.length){
    let hunkCandidates=0;
    for(const change of (ctx.changedInBase??[]).slice(0,4)){
      if(change.parent==null||!(change.hunks?.length>1))continue;
      const current=ctx.readFile(change.file);if(current==null||current===change.parent)continue;
      const lines=diagnostics.filter(d=>d.file===change.file&&d.line).map(d=>d.line);
      const distance=h=>lines.length?Math.min(...lines.map(l=>l>=h.newStart&&l<h.newStart+Math.max(1,h.newCount)?0:
        Math.min(Math.abs(l-h.newStart),Math.abs(l-(h.newStart+Math.max(0,h.newCount-1)))))):Infinity;
      const ordered=change.hunks.map((h,i)=>({h,i,d:distance(h)})).sort((a,b)=>a.d-b.d||a.i-b.i);
      for(const {h} of ordered.slice(0,3)){
        if(hunkCandidates>=4)break;
        const reverted=revertHunk(current,change.parent,h);
        if(reverted==null||reverted===current)continue;
        const near=diagnostics.find(d=>d.file===change.file)??diagnostics[0];
        add(candidate('REVERT_HUNK_TO_PARENT',near,`Restore lines ${h.newStart}-${h.newStart+Math.max(0,h.newCount-1)} of ${change.file} to the parent commit (smallest culprit)`,
          lines.length&&distance(h)===0?0.45:0.35,change.file,current,reverted));
        hunkCandidates++;
      }
    }
    for(const change of (ctx.changedInBase??[]).slice(0,4)){
      if(change.parent==null)continue;
      const current=ctx.readFile(change.file);if(current==null||current===change.parent)continue;
      const fp=diagnostics[0];
      add(candidate('REVERT_FILE_TO_PARENT',fp,`Restore ${change.file} to the parent commit (regression culprit search)`,0.25,
        change.file,current,change.parent));
    }
  }
  return out;
}

const tokenize=s=>s.toLowerCase().replace(/[^\p{L}\p{N}]+/gu,' ').trim().slice(0,512).split(' ').filter(Boolean);
function mask(tokens,rng,drop){
  const keep=tokens.filter(()=>rng.next()>=drop);
  return (keep.length?keep:[tokens[Math.min(tokens.length-1,Math.floor(rng.next()*tokens.length))]]).join(' ');
}
const cos=(a,b)=>{
  let d=0,na=0,nb=0;
  for(let i=0;i<a.length;i++){d+=a[i]*b[i];na+=a[i]*a[i];nb+=b[i]*b[i];}
  return na&&nb?d/Math.sqrt(na*nb):0;
};
function evaluate(model,docs,{seed,drop,policy}){
  const rng=new Rng(seed),memories=docs.map((text,i)=>({id:String(i),text}));
  let top1=0,rr=0,abstentions=0;
  for(let i=0;i<docs.length;i++){
    const q=mask(tokenize(docs[i]),rng,drop);
    let ranks;
    if(policy==='lexical'){
      ranks=rankMemories(q,memories,{limit:docs.length}).map(x=>Number(x.id));
    }else{
      const a=policy==='cosine'?model.encode(q):null;
      ranks=memories.map((m,j)=>({j,s:policy==='cosine'?cos(a,model.encode(m.text)):model.similarity(q,m.text)}))
        .sort((x,y)=>y.s-x.s||x.j-y.j).map(x=>x.j);
    }
    const rank=ranks.indexOf(i)+1;
    if(rank===0){abstentions++;continue;}
    rr+=1/rank;if(rank===1)top1++;
  }
  return {mrr:rr/docs.length,top1,abstentions,total:docs.length};
}
export function auditRetrievalAlignment(){
  const policies=['legacy','cosine','lexical'];
  const cases=[];
  const unknownQueries=[
    'zqvfix mnopqrst volxquartz',
    'xyzzymno plqwert zzzfragment',
    'unanwenderbare sonderzeichenkettex'
  ];
  const records=[];
  for(const seed of SEEDS){
    const baseline=new SubwordEncoder(seed);
    const training=trainContrastiveCandidate(baseline,TRAIN,HOLDOUTS.ecology,
      {steps:280,seed:seed*101+4,drop:0.65,rate:0.08});
    if(training.interrupted||training.steps!==280)throw Error('Training incomplete');
    for(const [domain,docs] of Object.entries(HOLDOUTS))for(const drop of DROPS){
      const viewSeed=131+Math.round(drop*100)+seed*7;
      for(const policy of policies){
        const before=evaluate(baseline,docs,{seed:viewSeed,drop,policy});
        const after=evaluate(training.candidate,docs,{seed:viewSeed,drop,policy});
        cases.push({seed,domain,drop,policy,before,after,
          deltaMRR:Number((after.mrr-before.mrr).toFixed(12))});
      }
    }
    const memories=Object.values(HOLDOUTS).flat().map((text,i)=>({id:String(i),text}));
    for(const q of unknownQueries){
      const found=rankMemories(q,memories,{limit:3});
      records.push({seed,query:q,lexicalHits:found.length,
        neuralAlwaysRanks:memories.length>0});
    }
  }
  const summaries=Object.fromEntries(policies.map(policy=>{
    const rows=cases.filter(c=>c.policy===policy);
    const mean=k=>Number((rows.reduce((n,x)=>n+x[k].mrr,0)/rows.length).toFixed(12));
    const delta=rows.map(x=>x.deltaMRR);
    return [policy,{cases:rows.length,meanMRRBefore:mean('before'),meanMRRAfter:mean('after'),
      meanDelta:Number((delta.reduce((s,x)=>s+x,0)/delta.length).toFixed(12)),
      improved:delta.filter(x=>x>0).length,regressed:delta.filter(x=>x<0).length,

  }));
  return {schema:1,method:'production-retrieval-alignment-frozen-holdouts',
    policies,modelSeeds:SEEDS,wordDropRates:DROPS,cases,summaries,

    automatedPromotion:false,

    caution:'Masked words from each indexed sentence are not paraphrase understanding or generalization to unrelated facts.'};

// Reproducible retrieval benchmark for the dialogue memory ranking (no network,
// no randomness). Data: app/src/main/resources/continuum/benchmark-v1.json —
// DEV queries may tune methods, TEST queries are report-only. Passages are
// candidate memories; each query is a German paraphrase of exactly one passage.
import fs from 'node:fs';
import {fileURLToPath} from 'node:url';
import {SubwordEncoder} from './portable-subword.mjs';

const ROOT=new URL('../../',import.meta.url);
export const loadBenchmark=()=>JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(new URL('app/src/main/resources/continuum/benchmark-v1.json',ROOT),'utf8'));
export const trainedWeights=()=>Buffer.from(fs.readFileSync(new URL('app/src/test/resources/continuum-neural-swb1.base64',ROOT),'utf8').trim(),'base64');

import {contentWords,wordGrams,idfOf,cosine,wordEvidence,weigh,rankMemories,EVIDENCE_THRESHOLD} from './dialogue-retrieval.mjs';
export {contentWords,wordGrams,idfOf,cosine,wordEvidence};

/** Methods return, per query, scores for all passages (null = abstain). */
export const METHODS={
  // Production ranking BEFORE this change: word-overlap gate, overlap/|q| + 0.35*(neural-0.5).
  current:(passages,weights)=>{
    const ORIGINAL_STOP=new Set(['was','wie','weißt','über','und','noch','dazu','darüber','das','die','der','ist','ich','mir','mein','meine','du','bitte','kannst','erzähl','erkläre','welche','dieses','thema']);
    const terms=t=>new Set(String(t).toLowerCase().match(/[\p{L}\p{N}]{3,}/gu)?.filter(x=>!ORIGINAL_STOP.has(x))??[]);
    const model=SubwordEncoder.restore(weights);
    return q=>{
      const qs=terms(q);
      const ranked=passages.map((p,i)=>{const t=terms(p),o=[...qs].filter(x=>t.has(x)).length;return {i,o,score:o/Math.max(1,qs.size)+0.35*(model.similarity(q,p)-0.5)};})
        .filter(x=>x.o>0).sort((a,b)=>b.score-a.score||a.i-b.i).slice(0,3);
      const s=passages.map(()=>null);ranked.forEach((r,k)=>{s[r.i]=3-k;});return s;
    };
  },
  // Production ranking AFTER this change (dialogue-retrieval.rankMemories), top 3 as shown in chat.
  adopted:(passages,weights)=>{
    const model=SubwordEncoder.restore(weights);
    return q=>{
      const ranked=rankMemories(q,passages.map((text,i)=>({id:String(i).padStart(3,'0'),text})),{semantic:(a,b)=>model.similarity(a,b)});
      const s=passages.map(()=>null);ranked.forEach((r,k)=>{s[Number(r.id)]=3-k;});return s;
    };
  },
  // Exact ablation of the production ranking: identical lexical code, neural term fixed at 0.5.
  'current-without-neural':(passages)=>{
    const ORIGINAL_STOP=new Set(['was','wie','weißt','über','und','noch','dazu','darüber','das','die','der','ist','ich','mir','mein','meine','du','bitte','kannst','erzähl','erkläre','welche','dieses','thema']);
    const terms=t=>new Set(String(t).toLowerCase().match(/[\p{L}\p{N}]{3,}/gu)?.filter(x=>!ORIGINAL_STOP.has(x))??[]);
    return q=>{
      const qs=terms(q);
      const ranked=passages.map((p,i)=>{const t=terms(p),o=[...qs].filter(x=>t.has(x)).length;return {i,o,score:o/Math.max(1,qs.size)};})
        .filter(x=>x.o>0).sort((a,b)=>b.score-a.score||a.i-b.i).slice(0,3);
      const s=passages.map(()=>null);ranked.forEach((r,k)=>{s[r.i]=3-k;});return s;
    };
  },
  'bm25-words':(passages)=>{
    const docs=passages.map(contentWords),avg=docs.reduce((a,d)=>a+d.length,0)/docs.length,N=docs.length;
    const df=new Map();docs.forEach(d=>new Set(d).forEach(w=>df.set(w,(df.get(w)??0)+1)));
    return q=>docs.map(d=>{let s=0;for(const w of new Set(contentWords(q))){const f=d.filter(x=>x===w).length;if(!f)continue;
      const idf=Math.log(1+(N-(df.get(w)??0)+0.5)/((df.get(w)??0)+0.5));s+=idf*f*2.2/(f+1.2*(0.25+0.75*d.length/avg));}return s>0?s:null;});
  },
  'tfidf-wordgrams':(passages)=>{
    const idf=idfOf(passages,wordGrams),P=passages.map(p=>weigh(wordGrams(p),idf));
    return q=>{const v=weigh(wordGrams(q),idf);return P.map(p=>{const c=cosine(v,p);return c>0?c:null;});};
  },
  // Adopted: tf-idf word-grams ranked, but only memories with real word evidence qualify.
  'gated-tfidf-wordgrams':(passages)=>{
    const idf=idfOf(passages,wordGrams),P=passages.map(p=>weigh(wordGrams(p),idf));
    return q=>{const v=weigh(wordGrams(q),idf);return P.map((p,i)=>wordEvidence(q,passages[i])>=EVIDENCE_THRESHOLD?cosine(v,p):null);};
  },
  'gated-tfidf+dense':(passages,weights,lambda=0.1)=>{
    const base=METHODS['gated-tfidf-wordgrams'](passages),m=SubwordEncoder.restore(weights);
    return q=>base(q).map((s,i)=>s==null?null:s+lambda*(m.similarity(q,passages[i])-0.5));
  }
};

export function evaluate(scorer,queries,{removeTarget=false,passages}={}){
  let top1=0,mrr=0,recall3=0,answered=0,abstained=0,wrongHit=0;
  for(const q of queries){
    const s=scorer(q.query);
    if(removeTarget){ // the true memory is absent: correct behavior is to abstain
      const others=s.map((x,i)=>i===q.passage?null:x);
      if(others.every(x=>x==null))abstained++;else wrongHit++;continue;
    }
    if(s.every(x=>x==null))continue;
    answered++;
    const t=s[q.passage];if(t==null)continue;
    const rank=1+s.filter(x=>x!=null&&x>t).length;
    if(rank===1)top1++;if(rank<=3)recall3++;mrr+=1/rank;
  }
  const n=queries.length,r=x=>Number(x.toFixed(3));
  return removeTarget?{abstainWhenUnknown:r(abstained/n),falseHitWhenUnknown:r(wrongHit/n)}
    :{top1:r(top1/n),mrr:r(mrr/n),recallAt3:r(recall3/n),answered:r(answered/n)};
}

/** How often does the neural term change the top-3 answer set? */
export function neuralInfluence(passages,queries,weights){
  const withNeural=METHODS.current(passages,weights),without=METHODS['current-without-neural'](passages);
  const top=s=>s.map((x,i)=>[x,i]).filter(([x])=>x!=null).sort((a,b)=>b[0]-a[0]||a[1]-b[1]).slice(0,3).map(([,i])=>i).join(',');
  let changed=0;for(const q of queries)if(top(withNeural(q.query))!==top(without(q.query)))changed++;
  return Number((changed/queries.length).toFixed(3));
}

export function runRetrievalBenchmark(){
  const bench=loadBenchmark(),P=bench.retrieval.passages,weights=trainedWeights();
  const untrained=new SubwordEncoder().save();
  const rows={};
  for(const [name,factory] of Object.entries(METHODS)){
    const scorer=factory(P,weights);
    rows[name]={dev:evaluate(scorer,bench.retrieval.dev),test:evaluate(scorer,bench.retrieval.test),
      unknown:evaluate(scorer,[...bench.retrieval.dev,...bench.retrieval.test],{removeTarget:true,passages:P})};
  }
  const untrainedCurrent=METHODS.current(P,untrained);
  rows['current (untrained encoder)']={dev:evaluate(untrainedCurrent,bench.retrieval.dev),test:evaluate(untrainedCurrent,bench.retrieval.test)};
  return {benchmark:bench.name+'@'+bench.version,passages:P.length,devQueries:bench.retrieval.dev.length,testQueries:bench.retrieval.test.length,
    neuralInfluenceOnCurrentTop3:neuralInfluence(P,[...bench.retrieval.dev,...bench.retrieval.test],weights),methods:rows};
}

if(process.argv[1]===fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)){
  const result=runRetrievalBenchmark();
  if(process.argv.includes('--write'))fs.writeFileSync(new URL('docs/retrieval-benchmark.json',ROOT),JSON.stringify(result,null,1)+'\n');
  console.log('| Method | DEV top1 | DEV MRR | TEST top1 | TEST MRR | TEST R@3 | abstain if unknown |');
  console.log('|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|');
  for(const [name,r] of Object.entries(result.methods))console.log(`| ${name} | ${r.dev.top1} | ${r.dev.mrr} | ${r.test.top1} | ${r.test.mrr} | ${r.test.recallAt3} | ${r.unknown?.abstainWhenUnknown??'—'} |`);
  console.log('Neural term changes the current top-3 for',result.neuralInfluenceOnCurrentTop3,'of all queries');
}

// Handwritten synthetic paraphrases: separate from training and word-masking views.
// This evaluates actual retrieval from user-like queries, NOT learned world knowledge.
import fs from 'node:fs';
import {SubwordEncoder} from './portable-subword.mjs';
import {trainContrastiveCandidate} from './contrastive-views.mjs';
import {rankMemories} from './dialogue-retrieval.mjs';
import {TRAIN,HOLDOUTS,SEEDS} from './contrastive-generalization.mjs';
export const QUESTIONS={
 ecology:[
  'woher bekommt die pflanze mineralstoffe im boden',
  'welcher vorgang eines baumes setzt atembares gas frei',
  'welche tiere helfen blueten bei der vermehrung',
  'was verwertet totes pflanzenmaterial in der natur',
  'wo schuetzen voegel ihre jungen'
 ],
 communication:[
  'wer bringt schriftliche sendungen zum empfaenger',
  'wie gelangen nachrichten ohne kabel durch die luft',
  'wo kann ich viele lesewerke ausleihen',

  'welche technik erlaubt unterhaltungen aus der ferne'
 ],
 geometry:[

  'welche strecke geht vom zentrum eines kreises nach aussen',
  'wie viele flaechen hat ein rechteckiger koerper',
  'was misst man zwischen zwei sich schneidenden geraden',
  'welche transformation erzeugt ein spiegelbild'
 ]
};
const cosine=(a,b)=>{
  let dot=0,na=0,nb=0;
  for(let i=0;i<a.length;i++){dot+=a[i]*b[i];na+=a[i]*a[i];nb+=b[i]*b[i];}
  return na&&nb?dot/Math.sqrt(na*nb):0;
};
function rank(model,query,memories,policy){
 if(policy==='lexical')
   return rankMemories(query,memories.map((text,i)=>({id:String(i),text})),{limit:memories.length})
     .map(x=>Number(x.id));
 const z=policy==='cosine'?model.encode(query):null;
 return memories.map((text,i)=>({i,s:policy==='cosine'?
   cosine(z,model.encode(text)):model.similarity(query,text)}))
   .sort((a,b)=>b.s-a.s||a.i-b.i).map(x=>x.i);
}
export function auditParaphrases(){
 const records=[],policies=['lexical','legacy','cosine'];
 for(const seed of SEEDS){
  const baseline=new SubwordEncoder(seed);
  const trained=trainContrastiveCandidate(baseline,TRAIN,HOLDOUTS.ecology,
    {steps:280,seed:seed*101+4,drop:0.65,rate:0.08});
  if(trained.interrupted)throw Error('Incomplete training');
  for(const [domain,docs] of Object.entries(HOLDOUTS)){
   const questions=QUESTIONS[domain];
   if(questions.length!==docs.length)throw Error('Corpus mismatch');
   for(const policy of policies){
    for(const state of ['before','after']){
     const model=state==='before'?baseline:trained.candidate;
     let rr=0,top1=0,abstained=0;
     questions.forEach((q,i)=>{
      const results=rank(model,q,docs,policy);
      const position=results.indexOf(i);
      if(position===-1)abstained++;
      else {rr+=1/(position+1);if(position===0)top1++;}
     });
     records.push({seed,domain,policy,state,
       mrr:Number((rr/docs.length).toFixed(12)),top1,abstained,total:docs.length});
    }
   }
  }
 }
 const summaries=Object.fromEntries(policies.map(policy=>{
  const before=records.filter(x=>x.policy===policy&&x.state==='before');
  const after=records.filter(x=>x.policy===policy&&x.state==='after');
  const avg=(xs,key)=>Number((xs.reduce((a,x)=>a+x[key],0)/xs.length).toFixed(12));
  return [policy,{queries:after.reduce((a,x)=>a+x.total,0),
   beforeMRR:avg(before,'mrr'),afterMRR:avg(after,'mrr'),
   beforeTop1Rate:Number((before.reduce((a,x)=>a+x.top1,0)/before.reduce((a,x)=>a+x.total,0)).toFixed(12)),
   afterTop1Rate:Number((after.reduce((a,x)=>a+x.top1,0)/after.reduce((a,x)=>a+x.total,0)).toFixed(12)),
   abstentions:after.reduce((a,x)=>a+x.abstained,0)}];
 }));
 return {schema:1,method:'human-authored-synthetic-paraphrase-retrieval',
  questions:QUESTIONS,records,summaries,automaticPromotion:false,
  qualification:'Small synthetic, manually authored paraphrases. Absent word evidence is safer than guessing. No real-world gains inferred.'};
}
if(process.argv[1]?.endsWith('retrieval-paraphrase.mjs')){
 const report=auditParaphrases();
 console.log(JSON.stringify(report.summaries,null,2));
 if(process.argv[2])fs.writeFileSync(process.argv[2],JSON.stringify(report,null,2)+'\n');

FILE 69/375: .github/continuum/semantic-gradient.test.mjs

import test from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import {SubwordEncoder} from './portable-subword.mjs';

const SCALE=2.5;
const sigmoid=x=>x>=0?1/(1+Math.exp(-x)):Math.exp(x)/(1+Math.exp(x));
function loss(m,left,right,similar){
 const a=m.encode(left),b=m.encode(right);
 const dot=a.reduce((s,v,i)=>s+v*b[i],0);
 const p=Math.max(1e-12,Math.min(1-1e-12,sigmoid(SCALE*dot)));
 return similar?-Math.log(p):-Math.log(1-p);
}
function finiteGradient(model,example,index) {
 const epsilon=1e-5,original=model.embeddings[index];
 model.embeddings[index]=original+epsilon;
 const plus=loss(model,example.left,example.right,example.similar);
 model.embeddings[index]=original-epsilon;
 const minus=loss(model,example.left,example.right,example.similar);
 model.embeddings[index]=original;
 return (plus-minus)/(2*epsilon);
}
test('semantic optimizer agrees with finite-difference gradients on shared/overlapping buckets',()=>{
 const cases=[
  {left:'sonnenlicht pflanze energie',right:'sonnenlicht pflanze energie',similar:true},
  {left:'regen wolken wasser',right:'wolken feuchtigkeit regen',similar:true},
  {left:'motor getriebe fahrzeug',right:'stern galaxie mond',similar:false},
  {left:'ababa ababa',right:'ababa baba',similar:false}
 ];
 for(const [n,e] of cases.entries()){
  const model=new SubwordEncoder(73+n);
  const ids=[...new Set([...model.features(e.left),...model.features(e.right)])];
  const indices=[...new Set([ids[0],ids[Math.floor(ids.length/2)],ids.at(-1)].filter(x=>x!==undefined))]
    .flatMap(bucket=>[bucket*16,bucket*16+7,bucket*16+15]);
  const gradients=indices.map(i=>({index:i,value:finiteGradient(model,e,i)}));
  const rate=0.002,old=model.embeddings.slice();
  model.updateSemantic(e,rate);
  assert.equal(model.updates,1);
  for(const g of gradients){
    const observed=(old[g.index]-model.embeddings[g.index])/rate;
    assert.ok(Math.abs(observed-g.value)<3e-7,
      'case '+n+' weight '+g.index+' measured '+observed+' finite '+g.value);
  }
 }
});
test('semantic SGD moves candidate without touching old SWB1 snapshot',()=>{
 const baseline=new SubwordEncoder(73),saved=baseline.save();
 const candidate=SubwordEncoder.restore(saved);
 candidate.updateSemantic({left:'katze tier',right:'regen wolken',similar:false},0.08);
 assert.deepEqual(baseline.save(),saved);

FILE 70/375: .github/continuum/world-model.mjs

import crypto from "node:crypto";

export function createWorldModel(now=Date.now()){
  return {schemaVersion:2,createdAt:now,updatedAt:now,hypotheses:[],history:[]};
}

export function migrateWorldModel(value,now=Date.now()){
  if(!value||![1,2].includes(value.schemaVersion))return createWorldModel(now);
  const m=structuredClone(value);
  m.schemaVersion=2;
  m.hypotheses=Array.isArray(m.hypotheses)?m.hypotheses.slice(-160):[];
  m.history=Array.isArray(m.history)?m.history.slice(-256):[];
  for(const h of m.hypotheses){
    h.supportEvidence=Array.isArray(h.supportEvidence)?h.supportEvidence.slice(-32):[];
    h.contradictEvidence=Array.isArray(h.contradictEvidence)?h.contradictEvidence.slice(-32):[];
    h.inconclusiveEvidence=Array.isArray(h.inconclusiveEvidence)?h.inconclusiveEvidence.slice(-32):[];
    recomputeHypothesis(h);
  }
  return m;
}

export function proposeHypothesis(modelInput,{claim,beliefId=null,citationUrls=[],confidence=.4,now=Date.now()}){
  const model=migrateWorldModel(modelInput,now);
  const text=clean(claim,650);
  if(text.length<35)return {model,hypothesis:null};
  const id="hyp-"+sha256(text.toLocaleLowerCase("de-DE")).slice(0,20);
  let h=model.hypotheses.find(x=>x.id===id);
  if(!h){
    h={
      id,claim:text,beliefIds:beliefId?[beliefId]:[],
      citationUrls:[...new Set(citationUrls)].slice(0,12),
      baseConfidence:clamp(confidence,.05,.85),confidence:clamp(confidence,.05,.85),
      status:"PROVISIONAL",attempts:0,
      supportEvidence:[],contradictEvidence:[],inconclusiveEvidence:[],
      createdAt:now,lastTestedAt:null,
      testQuestions:[
        "Finde unabhängige Evidenz, die diese Hypothese widerlegen oder stark begrenzen könnte: "+text,
        "Unter welchen Randbedingungen oder Gegenbeispielen gilt diese Hypothese nicht: "+text
      ]
    };
    model.hypotheses.push(h);
  }else{
    if(beliefId&&!h.beliefIds.includes(beliefId))h.beliefIds.push(beliefId);
    h.citationUrls=[...new Set([...h.citationUrls,...citationUrls])].slice(0,12);
    h.baseConfidence=Math.max(h.baseConfidence,clamp(confidence,.05,.85));
  }
  model.hypotheses=model.hypotheses.slice(-160);
  model.updatedAt=now;
  return {model,hypothesis:h};
}

export function selectHypothesisTest(modelInput,now=Date.now()){
  const model=migrateWorldModel(modelInput,now);
  const candidates=model.hypotheses.filter(h=>!["RETIRED","SUPPORTED"].includes(h.status));
  return candidates.map(h=>{
    const age=h.lastTestedAt?Math.min(1,(now-h.lastTestedAt)/86400000):1;
    const uncertainty=1-h.confidence;
    const exploration=1/Math.sqrt(1+h.attempts);
    return {hypothesis:h,score:uncertainty*.65+age*.2+exploration*.35};
  }).sort((a,b)=>b.score-a.score||a.hypothesis.id.localeCompare(b.hypothesis.id))[0]?.hypothesis??null;
}

export function evaluateHypothesisEvidence(modelInput,hypothesisId,{text,citations=[],now=Date.now()}){
  const model=migrateWorldModel(modelInput,now);
  const h=model.hypotheses.find(x=>x.id===hypothesisId);
  if(!h)return {model,classification:"MISSING",hypothesis:null};
  const overlap=tokenOverlap(h.claim,text);
  const negationDiff=hasNegation(h.claim)!==hasNegation(text);
  const domains=[...new Set(citations.map(x=>domainOf(x.url)).filter(Boolean))];
  const sourceKeys=[...new Set(citations.map(citationKey).filter(Boolean))];
  let classification="INCONCLUSIVE";
  if(overlap>=.24)classification=negationDiff?"CONTRADICT":"SUPPORT";
  const evidence={
    id:"ev-"+sha256([hypothesisId,text,domains.join(",")].join("\0")).slice(0,20),
    classification,overlap,domains,sourceKeys,text:clean(text,900),createdAt:now
  };
  const bucket=classification==="SUPPORT"?h.supportEvidence:
    classification==="CONTRADICT"?h.contradictEvidence:h.inconclusiveEvidence;
  if(!bucket.some(x=>x.id===evidence.id))bucket.push(evidence);
  h.attempts+=1;h.lastTestedAt=now;
  recomputeHypothesis(h);
  model.history.push({at:now,hypothesisId,classification,confidence:h.confidence,status:h.status});
  model.history=model.history.slice(-256);
  model.updatedAt=now;
  return {model,classification,hypothesis:h};
}

export function worldModelStatus(modelInput){
  const model=migrateWorldModel(modelInput);
  return {
    total:model.hypotheses.length,
    provisional:model.hypotheses.filter(x=>x.status==="PROVISIONAL").length,
    supported:model.hypotheses.filter(x=>x.status==="SUPPORTED").length,
    disputed:model.hypotheses.filter(x=>x.status==="DISPUTED").length,
    retired:model.hypotheses.filter(x=>x.status==="RETIRED").length,
    evidenceTests:model.history.length
  };
}

function recomputeHypothesis(h){
  const supportEvents=independentEvidenceEvents(h.supportEvidence);
  const contradictEvents=independentEvidenceEvents(h.contradictEvidence);
  const supportDomains=new Set(h.supportEvidence.flatMap(x=>x.domains??[])).size;
  const contradictDomains=new Set(h.contradictEvidence.flatMap(x=>x.domains??[])).size;
  let confidence=clamp(
    Number(h.baseConfidence??.35) +
      Math.min(.28,supportEvents*.10+supportDomains*.025) -
      Math.min(.48,contradictEvents*.18+contradictDomains*.06) -
      Math.min(.12,(h.inconclusiveEvidence?.length??0)*.015),
    .05,.95
  );
  if(supportEvents<2)confidence=Math.min(confidence,.84);
  h.confidence=confidence;
  h.status=contradictEvents>=1?"DISPUTED":
    supportEvents>=2&&confidence>=.68?"SUPPORTED":
    confidence<.18?"RETIRED":"PROVISIONAL";
  h.independentSupportEvents=supportEvents;
  h.independentContradictEvents=contradictEvents;
}

function independentEvidenceEvents(events){
  const sorted=[...(events??[])].sort((a,b)=>(a.createdAt??0)-(b.createdAt??0));
  const seenDomains=new Set();
  let independent=0;
  for(const event of sorted){
    const domains=[...new Set((event.domains??[]).filter(Boolean))];
    if(!domains.length)continue;
    const addsNovelDomain=domains.some(d=>!seenDomains.has(d));
    if(addsNovelDomain)independent++;
    domains.forEach(d=>seenDomains.add(d));
  }
  return independent;
}

function citationKey(citation){
  const title=String(citation?.title??"").toLocaleLowerCase("en-US")
    .replace(/[^\p{L}\p{N}]+/gu," ").trim();
  if(title.length>=18)return "title:"+title.slice(0,240);
  try{
    const u=new URL(String(citation?.url??""));
    if(u.hostname.toLocaleLowerCase("en-US")==="doi.org")return "doi:"+decodeURIComponent(u.pathname).toLocaleLowerCase("en-US");
    return "url:"+u.hostname.toLocaleLowerCase("en-US")+u.pathname.replace(/\/$/,"");
  }catch{return "";}
}

function tokenOverlap(a,b){
  const A=tokens(a),B=tokens(b);if(!A.size||!B.size)return 0;
  const inter=[...A].filter(x=>B.has(x)).length;
  return inter/Math.min(A.size,B.size);
}
function tokens(text){return new Set(String(text).toLocaleLowerCase("de-DE").split(/[^\p{L}\p{N}]+/u).filter(x=>x.length>=4&&!STOP.has(x)));}
const STOP=new Set(["dass","dieser","diese","eine","einer","einen","sind","wird","werden","with","that","this","from","into","using","über","unter","auch","nicht"]);
function hasNegation(text){return /\b(nicht|kein|keine|never|no|not|cannot|fails?|unmöglich|widerlegt)\b/i.test(String(text));}
function domainOf(url){try{return new URL(url).hostname.replace(/^www\./,"");}catch{return "";}}
function sha256(v){return crypto.createHash("sha256").update(String(v)).digest("hex");}
function clean(v,max){return String(v??"").replace(/[\u0000-\u001f\u007f]/g," ").replace(/\s+/g," ").trim().slice(0,max);}
function clamp(v,min,max){return Math.min(max,Math.max(min,Number.isFinite(Number(v))?Number(v):min));}

import test from "node:test";
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import {createWorldModel,migrateWorldModel,proposeHypothesis,selectHypothesisTest,evaluateHypothesisEvidence,worldModelStatus} from "./world-model.mjs";

test("world model keeps hypotheses provisional until independent support arrives",()=>{
  let model=createWorldModel(100);
  let p=proposeHypothesis(model,{claim:"Experience replay can reduce catastrophic forgetting in continual learning systems when older examples are sampled during updates.",confidence:.45,now:110});
  model=p.model;
  assert.equal(worldModelStatus(model).provisional,1);
  const selected=selectHypothesisTest(model,120);
  assert.equal(selected.id,p.hypothesis.id);
  let r=evaluateHypothesisEvidence(model,p.hypothesis.id,{
    text:"Independent experiments report that experience replay reduces catastrophic forgetting in continual learning by rehearsing older examples.",
    citations:[{url:"https://example.org/paper-a"}],now:130
  });
  model=r.model;
  assert.equal(r.classification,"SUPPORT");
  assert.equal(r.hypothesis.status,"PROVISIONAL");
  assert.equal(r.hypothesis.independentSupportEvents,1);
  r=evaluateHypothesisEvidence(model,p.hypothesis.id,{
    text:"A second study finds experience replay reduces catastrophic forgetting when previous samples are rehearsed during sequential learning.",
    citations:[{url:"https://example.net/paper-b"}],now:140
  });
  assert.equal(r.hypothesis.status,"SUPPORTED");
});

test("independent contradictory evidence makes a hypothesis disputed",()=>{
  let model=createWorldModel(100);
  const p=proposeHypothesis(model,{claim:"A fixed replay buffer always prevents catastrophic forgetting in every continual learning task.",confidence:.6,now:110});
  model=p.model;
  const r=evaluateHypothesisEvidence(model,p.hypothesis.id,{
    text:"A fixed replay buffer does not always prevent catastrophic forgetting in every continual learning task.",
    citations:[{url:"https://example.edu/negative"}],now:120
  });
  assert.equal(r.classification,"CONTRADICT");
  assert.equal(r.hypothesis.status,"DISPUTED");
});


test("repeating the same source domains in a second cycle does not promote a hypothesis",()=>{
  let model=createWorldModel(100);
  const p=proposeHypothesis(model,{
    claim:"Experience replay can reduce catastrophic forgetting in continual learning systems when older examples are sampled during updates.",
    confidence:.5,now:110
  });
  model=p.model;
  let r=evaluateHypothesisEvidence(model,p.hypothesis.id,{
    text:"Experience replay reduces catastrophic forgetting by rehearsing older examples during continual learning.",
    citations:[
      {title:"Replay Study",url:"https://doi.org/10.1000/replay"},
      {title:"Replay Study",url:"https://publisher.example/replay"}
    ],now:120
  });
  model=r.model;
  assert.equal(r.hypothesis.status,"PROVISIONAL");
  r=evaluateHypothesisEvidence(model,p.hypothesis.id,{
    text:"Experience replay reduces catastrophic forgetting by rehearsing older examples during continual learning.",
    citations:[
      {title:"Replay Study",url:"https://doi.org/10.1000/replay"},
      {title:"Replay Study",url:"https://publisher.example/replay"}
    ],now:130
  });
  assert.equal(r.hypothesis.status,"PROVISIONAL");
  assert.equal(r.hypothesis.independentSupportEvents,1);
});

test("migration recalibrates a legacy one-cycle supported hypothesis back to provisional",()=>{
