    private fun showCloudSettings() {
        val box = LinearLayout(this).apply {
            orientation = LinearLayout.VERTICAL
            setPadding(dp(18), dp(4), dp(18), 0)
        }

        val url = EditText(this).apply {
            hint = "https://dein-device-ai-backend.example"
            setText(backend.backendUrl())
            inputType = InputType.TYPE_CLASS_TEXT or InputType.TYPE_TEXT_VARIATION_URI
            setSingleLine(true)
        }

        val token = EditText(this).apply {
            hint = if (backend.hasToken()) "Device-Token gespeichert · leer lassen zum Behalten" else "Device-Token"
            inputType = InputType.TYPE_CLASS_TEXT or InputType.TYPE_TEXT_VARIATION_PASSWORD
            setSingleLine(true)
        }

        box.addView(textView("Backend URL (nur HTTPS)", 12f, MUTED, true))
        box.addView(url, matchWidth(top = 4))
        box.addView(textView("Device-Token", 12f, MUTED, true).apply {
            setPadding(0, dp(12), 0, 0)
        })
        box.addView(token, matchWidth(top = 4))
        box.addView(
            textView(
                "Der OpenAI-API-Key gehört niemals hier hinein. Er bleibt ausschließlich als Secret am Backend.",
                11f,
                MUTED
            ).apply { setPadding(0, dp(10), 0, 0) }
        )

        AlertDialog.Builder(this)
            .setTitle("Cloud-KI einrichten")
            .setView(box)
            .setNegativeButton("Abbrechen", null)
            .setNeutralButton("Token löschen") { _, _ ->
                SecureTokenStore.clear(this)
                updateCloudBadge()
                addToolActivity("Cloud-Token gelöscht")
            }
            .setPositiveButton("Speichern") { _, _ ->
                val endpoint = url.text.toString().trim().trimEnd('/')
                if (endpoint.isNotBlank() && !endpoint.startsWith("https://", ignoreCase = true)) {
                    Toast.makeText(this, "Für Cloud-KI ist HTTPS erforderlich.", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
                    return@setPositiveButton
                }
                backend.saveBackendUrl(endpoint)
                val newToken = token.text.toString()
                if (newToken.isNotBlank()) SecureTokenStore.save(this, newToken)
                updateCloudBadge()
                addToolActivity("Cloud-Konfiguration gespeichert")
                if (backend.isConfigured()) testCloudHealth()
            }
            .show()
    }

    private fun testCloudHealth() {
        addToolActivity("Prüfe Backend …")
        backend.health { result ->
            result.onSuccess {
                addToolActivity("✓ Backend erreichbar")
            }.onFailure {
                addToolActivity("Backend nicht erreichbar: ${it.message ?: "Fehler"}")
            }
        }
    }

    private fun newSession() {
        if (busy) {
            Toast.makeText(this, "Ein Auftrag läuft noch.", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            return
        }
        sessionId = UUID.randomUUID().toString()
        agentLoops = 0
        planCard.visibility = View.GONE
        chatContainer.removeAllViews()
        addAssistantMessage("Neue Sitzung gestartet. Was soll ich tun?")
        addToolActivity("Neue Sitzung")
    }

    private fun addUserMessage(value: String) {
        addBubble(value, user = true)
        val radarEnabled = NeuralPracticeScheduler(this).enabled && !neuralCoach.isActive()
        if (radarEnabled && neuralCuriosityRadar.peek() == null) {
            // model restore and scoring read files: off the UI thread
            onLearningIo({
                val known = runCatching {
                    bootstrapMemory.neuralSnapshot()?.let(NeuralDialogue::restore)
                        ?.hasLesson(value) ?: false
                }.getOrDefault(false)
                val coreUncertain = runCatching {
                    val score=ContinuumLearningCore(filesDir).intentScore(value)
                    score in 0.35..0.65
                }.getOrDefault(true)
                known to coreUncertain
            }) { result ->
                val (known, coreUncertain) = result.getOrDefault(false to false)
                if (coreUncertain && !neuralCoach.isActive() && neuralCuriosityRadar.peek() == null &&
                    neuralCuriosityRadar.offer(value, active = true, alreadyTaught = known)) {
                    neuralCuriosityButton?.isEnabled = true
                    neuralCuriosityButton?.text = "LERN-RADAR · UNSICHERES BEISPIEL"
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private fun addAssistantMessage(value: String) {
        addBubble(value, user = false)
        speakBootstrap(value)
    }

    private fun addBubble(value: String, user: Boolean) {
        val row = LinearLayout(this).apply {
            orientation = LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL
            gravity = if (user) Gravity.END else Gravity.START
        }

        val bubble = TextView(this).apply {
            text = value
            textSize = 14.5f
            setTextColor(TEXT)
            setTextIsSelectable(true)
            setPadding(dp(13), dp(10), dp(13), dp(10))
            background = rounded(if (user) USER_BUBBLE else ASSISTANT_BUBBLE, 18, if (user) null else BORDER)
        }

        // Never use a fixed 620dp bubble: on a Fold with a sidebar, the
        // conversation pane can be much narrower than the device width.
        row.addView(
            bubble,
            LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                LinearLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                LinearLayout.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT
            ).apply {
                if (user) marginStart = dp(24) else marginEnd = dp(24)
            }
        )

        chatContainer.addView(
            row,
            matchWidth(top = 8)
        )
        scrollToBottom()
    }

    private fun addCitations(citations: List<AgentCitation>) {
        val card = verticalCard().apply {
            setPadding(dp(13), dp(11), dp(13), dp(11))
        }
        card.addView(textView("QUELLEN", 11f, ACCENT, true))

        citations.take(8).forEachIndexed { index, citation ->
            val source = textView(
                "${index + 1}. ${citation.title}",
                13f,
                Color.rgb(188, 205, 255),
                true
            ).apply {
                setPadding(0, dp(8), 0, dp(2))
                setOnClickListener {
                    runCatching {
                        startActivity(Intent(Intent.ACTION_VIEW, Uri.parse(citation.url)))
                    }
                }
            }
            card.addView(source)
            card.addView(textView(citation.url, 11f, MUTED))
        }

        chatContainer.addView(card, matchWidth(top = 8))
        scrollToBottom()
    }

    private fun addToolActivity(value: String) {
        if (::activityText.isInitialized) {
            activityText.text = value
        }
    }

    private fun setBusy(value: Boolean) {
        busy = value
        if (::sendButton.isInitialized) {
            sendButton.isEnabled = true
            sendButton.text = if (value && activeLocalRequest) "STOPPEN" else if (value) "ARBEITET …" else "SENDEN"
            sendButton.alpha = if (value && !activeLocalRequest) 0.65f else 1f
        }
        if (::modelCatalog.isInitialized && ::localBadge.isInitialized) refreshLocalModelUi()
    }

    private fun scrollToBottom() {
        if (::chatScroll.isInitialized) {
            chatScroll.post { chatScroll.fullScroll(View.FOCUS_DOWN) }
        }
    }

    private fun startVoiceInput() {
        val intent = Intent(RecognizerIntent.ACTION_RECOGNIZE_SPEECH).apply {
            putExtra(RecognizerIntent.EXTRA_LANGUAGE_MODEL, RecognizerIntent.LANGUAGE_MODEL_FREE_FORM)
            putExtra(RecognizerIntent.EXTRA_LANGUAGE, "de-AT")
            putExtra(RecognizerIntent.EXTRA_PROMPT, "Was soll Device AI tun?")
            putExtra(RecognizerIntent.EXTRA_PREFER_OFFLINE, true)
        }
        try {
            startActivityForResult(intent, SPEECH_REQUEST)
        } catch (_: Exception) {
            Toast.makeText(this, "Keine Spracheingabe verfügbar.", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
        }
    }

    @Deprecated("Deprecated in Android SDK, kept for broad device compatibility")
    override fun onActivityResult(requestCode: Int, resultCode: Int, data: Intent?) {
        super.onActivityResult(requestCode, resultCode, data)
        when (requestCode) {
            SPEECH_REQUEST -> if (resultCode == RESULT_OK) {
                val matches = data?.getStringArrayListExtra(RecognizerIntent.EXTRA_RESULTS)
                val spoken = matches?.firstOrNull()
                if (!spoken.isNullOrBlank()) {
                    input.setText(spoken)
                    input.setSelection(spoken.length)
                    // Only in the explicitly activated learning conversation: a
                    // recognized phrase goes to the supervised coach, never ToolGate.
                    if (neuralCoach.isActive() && !busy) sendCurrentInput()
                }
            }
            CONTINUUM_PACKAGE_MODEL_REQUEST -> {
                pendingContinuumPackageModel=null
                val modelUri=data?.data
                if(resultCode==RESULT_OK && modelUri!=null) {
                    // a document provider may be slow or remote: read off the UI thread
                    onLearningIo({
                        contentResolver.openInputStream(modelUri)?.use { it.readAtMost(SWB1_BYTES) }
                            ?: throw java.io.IOException("Dateianbieter liefert keine Daten")
                    }) { result ->
                        result.fold({ bytes ->
                            if(bytes.size==SWB1_BYTES) {
                                pendingContinuumPackageModel=bytes
                                startActivityForResult(Intent(Intent.ACTION_OPEN_DOCUMENT).apply {
                                    addCategory(Intent.CATEGORY_OPENABLE)
                                    type="*/*"
                                },CONTINUUM_PACKAGE_MANIFEST_REQUEST)
                            } else addAssistantMessage("Öffentliches Modellpaket: ungültige SWB1-Dateigröße (" +
                                (if(bytes.size>SWB1_BYTES)"mehr als $SWB1_BYTES" else bytes.size.toString()) +
                                " Bytes, erwartet $SWB1_BYTES)")
                        }, { e ->
                            addAssistantMessage("Öffentliches Modellpaket: Modelldatei nicht lesbar (${failureName(e)}).")
                        })
                    }
                }
            }
            CONTINUUM_PACKAGE_MANIFEST_REQUEST -> {
                val model=pendingContinuumPackageModel
                pendingContinuumPackageModel=null
                if(resultCode==RESULT_OK && data?.data!=null && model!=null &&
                    !localAgentExecutor.isShutdown) {
                    val uri=data.data!!
                    localAgentExecutor.execute {
                        val result=runCatching {
                            val manifest=contentResolver.openInputStream(uri)?.use { stream ->
                                val out=java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream()
                                val buffer=ByteArray(2048)
                                while(out.size()<=16384) {
                                    val count=stream.read(buffer,0,minOf(buffer.size,16385-out.size()))
                                    if(count<0)break
                                    require(count>0) { "Manifest nicht lesbar" }
                                    out.write(buffer,0,count)
                                }
                                out.toString("UTF-8")
                            } ?: error("Manifest nicht lesbar")
                            ContinuumLearningCore(filesDir).importPublicPackage(model,manifest)
                        }
                        runOnUiThread {
                            if(!isFinishing && !isDestroyed) {
                                addAssistantMessage(result.fold({it.reason},
                                    {"Modellpaket abgelehnt: "+(it.message ?: "ungültiges Paket")}))
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            NEURAL_IMPORT_REQUEST -> {
                val uri=data?.data
                if(resultCode==RESULT_OK && uri!=null && !localAgentExecutor.isShutdown) {
                    localAgentExecutor.execute {
                        val result=runCatching {
                            val bytes=contentResolver.openInputStream(uri)?.use { stream ->
                                val out=java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream()
                                val buffer=ByteArray(4096)
                                while(out.size()<=32960) {
                                    val count=stream.read(buffer,0,minOf(buffer.size,32961-out.size()))
                                    if(count<0)break
                                    if(count==0)error("Dateianbieter liefert keine Daten")
                                    out.write(buffer,0,count)
                                }
                                out.toByteArray()
                            } ?: error("Datei nicht lesbar")
                            check(!Thread.currentThread().isInterrupted) { "Import abgebrochen" }
                            ContinuumLearningCore(filesDir).importSnapshot(bytes)
                        }
                        runOnUiThread {
                            if(!isFinishing && !isDestroyed) {
                                addAssistantMessage(result.fold({ it.reason },{ "Lernstand nicht übernommen: "+(it.message ?: "ungültige Datei") }))
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            MODEL_IMPORT_REQUEST -> {
                val uri = data?.data
                if (resultCode == RESULT_OK && uri != null) importModel(uri)
                else pendingModelImport = null
            }
            DEV_SOURCE_REQUEST -> if (resultCode == RESULT_OK && data != null) {
                val uris = mutableListOf<Uri>()
                data.data?.let(uris::add)
                data.clipData?.let { clip -> for (i in 0 until clip.itemCount) uris += clip.getItemAt(i).uri }
                val unique = uris.distinct()
                if (unique.size > at.heinz.deviceai.cognitive.DevelopmentLimits.MAX_SOURCES) {
                    Toast.makeText(this, "Maximal vier Quellen auswählen; keine Datei wurde geladen.", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
                } else {
                    loadDevelopmentSources(unique)
                }
            }
            DEV_EXPORT_REQUEST -> {
                val uri = data?.data
                if (resultCode == RESULT_OK && uri != null) exportDevelopmentProposal(uri)
            }
            DEV_BACKLOG_EXPORT_REQUEST, DEV_OPLOG_EXPORT_REQUEST -> {
                val uri = data?.data
                if (resultCode == RESULT_OK && uri != null) exportBacklogDocument(uri, requestCode == DEV_OPLOG_EXPORT_REQUEST)
            }
            DEV_BACKLOG_IMPORT_REQUEST -> {
                val uri = data?.data
                if (resultCode == RESULT_OK && uri != null) importBacklogDocument(uri)
            }
        }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Development backlog (cognitive/DevelopmentBacklog.kt, docs/DEVELOPMENT_BACKLOG.md)
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    private fun <T> onBacklog(work: () -> T, done: (Result<T>) -> Unit) {
        try {
            backlogExecutor.execute {
                val result = runCatching(work)
                runOnUiThread { if (!isFinishing && !isDestroyed) done(result) }
            }
        } catch (_: java.util.concurrent.RejectedExecutionException) {
            // activity is closing
        }
    }

    private fun backlogError(e: Throwable): String = when (e) {
        is BacklogException -> "${e.code}: ${e.detail.take(160)}"
        else -> e.javaClass.simpleName + (e.message?.let { ": " + it.take(160) } ?: "")
    }

    private fun recoverDevelopmentBacklog() {
        onBacklog({ devBacklog.recover() }) { result ->
            result.onSuccess { expired ->
                if (expired.isNotEmpty()) {
                    addToolActivity("BACKLOG · ${expired.size} unterbrochene Entwicklungsaufgabe(n) nach abgelaufener Lease wieder freigegeben")
                }
            }.onFailure { addToolActivity("BACKLOG · nicht lesbar: " + backlogError(it).take(140)) }
        }
    }

    private fun showDevelopmentBacklog() {
        backlogDialog?.dismiss()
        val box = LinearLayout(this).apply {
            orientation = LinearLayout.VERTICAL
            setPadding(dp(16), dp(8), dp(16), dp(8))
        }
        box.addView(textView(
            "Gemeinsamer Entwicklungs-Backlog mit denselben Regeln wie Entwickler-Agent und CLI. Erledigt (DONE) wird eine " +
                "Aufgabe nur mit ausgeführtem Testnachweis aus CI oder vom Agenten; auf dem Gerät entstehen nur geprüfte " +
                "Vorschläge (VERIFYING). Exporte enthalten die eingegebenen Aufgabentitel und gehen nur an das gewählte Ziel.",
            12f, MUTED))
        val list = LinearLayout(this).apply { orientation = LinearLayout.VERTICAL }
        backlogList = list
        box.addView(list, matchWidth(top = 8))
        val io = LinearLayout(this).apply { orientation = LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL }
        fun create(code: Int, name: String) = Intent(Intent.ACTION_CREATE_DOCUMENT).apply {
            addCategory(Intent.CATEGORY_OPENABLE)
            type = "application/json"
            putExtra(Intent.EXTRA_TITLE, name)
        }.let { startActivityForResult(it, code) }
        listOf(
            actionButton("OP-LOG EXPORT", compact = true).apply {
                setOnClickListener { create(DEV_OPLOG_EXPORT_REQUEST, "device-ai-backlog-ops.json") }
            },
            actionButton("BACKLOG EXPORT", compact = true).apply {
                setOnClickListener { create(DEV_BACKLOG_EXPORT_REQUEST, "device-ai-backlog.json") }
            },
            actionButton("IMPORT", compact = true).apply {
                setOnClickListener {
                    startActivityForResult(Intent(Intent.ACTION_OPEN_DOCUMENT).apply {
                        addCategory(Intent.CATEGORY_OPENABLE)
                        type = "*/*"
                    }, DEV_BACKLOG_IMPORT_REQUEST)
                }
            }
        ).forEach { io.addView(it, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0, dp(40), 1f).apply { marginEnd = dp(4) }) }
        box.addView(io, matchWidth(top = 10))
        val dialog = AlertDialog.Builder(this)
            .setTitle("Entwicklungsaufgaben")
            .setView(ScrollView(this).apply { addView(box) })
            .setPositiveButton("Schließen", null)
            .create()
        // dismiss callbacks arrive asynchronously: only the current dialog clears the references
        dialog.setOnDismissListener {
            if (backlogDialog === dialog) {
                backlogDialog = null
                backlogList = null
            }
        }
        backlogDialog = dialog
        dialog.show()
        refreshDevelopmentBacklog()
    }

    private fun refreshDevelopmentBacklog(note: String? = null) {
        val list = backlogList ?: return
        list.removeAllViews()
        list.addView(textView(note ?: "Lade Backlog…", 12f, AMBER))
        onBacklog({ devBacklog.read() }) { result ->
            val target = backlogList ?: return@onBacklog
            target.removeAllViews()
            note?.let { target.addView(textView(it, 12f, AMBER)) }
            result.onFailure {
                target.addView(textView("Backlog nicht lesbar: " + backlogError(it), 12f, RED))
            }.onSuccess { loaded ->
                loaded.recovered?.let {
                    target.addView(textView("Datei beschädigt (${it.reason.take(120)}); der letzte gültige Stand wird beim nächsten " +
                        "Schreiben übernommen, die beschädigte Datei bleibt erhalten.", 12f, AMBER))
                }
                val views = DevelopmentBacklog.views(loaded.doc)
                    .sortedWith(compareBy<DevelopmentBacklog.TaskView> { it.terminal }.thenByDescending { it.priority }.thenBy { it.id })
                target.addView(textView("Revision ${loaded.doc["revision"]} · ${views.size} Aufgabe(n)", 12f, MUTED))
                if (views.isEmpty()) target.addView(textView("Noch keine Aufgaben. Entwicklungsaufträge und importierte Agent-Aufgaben erscheinen hier.", 12f, MUTED))
                views.forEach { target.addView(backlogTaskView(it), matchWidth(top = 8)) }
            }
        }
    }

    private fun backlogTaskView(task: DevelopmentBacklog.TaskView): View {
        val card = verticalCard().apply { setPadding(dp(12), dp(10), dp(12), dp(10)) }
        val color = when (task.state) {
            "DONE" -> GREEN
            "FAILED", "REJECTED", "ABORTED", "BLOCKED" -> RED
            "IN_PROGRESS", "VERIFYING" -> CYAN
            else -> AMBER
        }
        card.addView(textView(task.title, 13f, TEXT, true))
        card.addView(textView("${task.state} · Priorität ${task.priority} · Versuch ${task.attempts}/${task.maxAttempts} · " +
            "${task.kind} · ${task.source}", 11.5f, color))
        val detail = when (task.state) {
            "VERIFYING" -> "Wartet auf Testnachweis (Agent/CI: backlog verify)."
            "DONE" -> "Erledigt mit ${task.evidenceCount} Testnachweis(en)."
            "IN_PROGRESS" -> "In Arbeit (${task.claimOwner ?: "?"})."
            else -> null
        }
        listOfNotNull(detail, task.errorCode?.let { "Letzter Fehler $it: ${task.errorMessage.orEmpty()}" },
            task.lastReason?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() }?.let { "Zuletzt: $it" })
            .forEach { card.addView(textView(it, 11.5f, MUTED)) }
        val actions = buildList {
            if (task.state == "PROPOSED") add(Triple("ANNEHMEN", "accept", false))
            if (task.state == "FAILED") add(Triple("ERNEUT", "retry", true))
            if (task.state in setOf("PROPOSED", "READY", "BLOCKED", "FAILED")) add(Triple("ABLEHNEN", "reject", true))
            if (!task.terminal) add(Triple("ABBRECHEN", "abort", true))
        }
        if (actions.isNotEmpty()) {
            val row = LinearLayout(this).apply { orientation = LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL }
            actions.forEach { (label, action, needsReason) ->
                row.addView(actionButton(label, compact = true).apply {
                    setOnClickListener { decideBacklogTask(task.id, label, action, needsReason) }
                }, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0, dp(36), 1f).apply { marginEnd = dp(4) })
            }
            card.addView(row, matchWidth(top = 6))
        }
        return card
    }

    private fun decideBacklogTask(id: String, label: String, action: String, needsReason: Boolean) {
        val run = { reason: String? ->
            onBacklog({ devBacklog.decide(id, action, reason) }) { result ->
                refreshDevelopmentBacklog(result.fold(
                    { if (it.ok) "$label: übernommen." else "$label abgelehnt: ${it.code} ${it.message.orEmpty().take(140)}" },
                    { "$label fehlgeschlagen: " + backlogError(it) }))
            }
        }
        if (!needsReason) {
            run(null)
            return
        }
        val field = EditText(this).apply { hint = "Begründung (Pflicht)" }
        AlertDialog.Builder(this)
            .setTitle(label)
            .setView(field)
            .setPositiveButton("OK") { _, _ -> run(field.text.toString()) }
            .setNegativeButton("Abbrechen", null)
            .show()
    }

    private fun exportBacklogDocument(uri: Uri, operationLog: Boolean) {
        onBacklog({
            val bytes = if (operationLog) devBacklog.exportOperationLog() else devBacklog.exportBacklog()
            contentResolver.openOutputStream(uri, "wt")?.use { it.write(bytes) } ?: error("Ziel kann nicht geöffnet werden.")
            bytes.size
        }) { result ->
            Toast.makeText(this, result.fold(
                { (if (operationLog) "Operationslog" else "Backlog") + " exportiert ($it Bytes)." },
                { "Export fehlgeschlagen: " + backlogError(it) }), Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
        }
    }

    private fun importBacklogDocument(uri: Uri) {
        onBacklog({
            val bytes = contentResolver.openInputStream(uri)?.use { it.readAtMost(DEV_BACKLOG_MAX_IMPORT_BYTES) }
                ?: error("Dokument kann nicht geöffnet werden.")
            require(bytes.size <= DEV_BACKLOG_MAX_IMPORT_BYTES) { "Datei größer als $DEV_BACKLOG_MAX_IMPORT_BYTES Bytes." }
            devBacklog.importBacklog(bytes)
        }) { result ->
            val text = result.fold({ r ->
                "Import: Revision ${r.revision} · ${r.tasks} Aufgaben · ${r.replayed} lokale Operation(en) neu angewendet · " +
                    "${r.alreadyIncluded} bereits enthalten" +
                    (if (r.rejected.isEmpty()) "" else " · ${r.rejected.size} abgelehnt: " + r.rejected.take(3).joinToString("; "))
            }, { "Import abgelehnt, lokaler Stand unverändert: " + backlogError(it) })
            if (backlogList != null) refreshDevelopmentBacklog(text) else Toast.makeText(this, text, Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
        }
    }

    private fun infoCard(title: String, body: String, badge: String): View {
        val card = verticalCard().apply {
            setPadding(dp(13), dp(12), dp(13), dp(12))
        }
        val row = LinearLayout(this).apply {
            orientation = LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL
            gravity = Gravity.CENTER_VERTICAL
        }
        row.addView(
            textView(title, 15f, TEXT, true),
            LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0, LinearLayout.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, 1f)
        )
        row.addView(statusBadge(badge, GREEN))
        card.addView(row)
        card.addView(textView(body, 12f, MUTED).apply { setPadding(0, dp(7), 0, 0) })
        return card
    }

    private fun sectionLabel(value: String, top: Int): View =
        textView(value, 11f, MUTED, true).apply {
            setPadding(0, dp(top), 0, 0)
        }

    private fun statusBadge(value: String, color: Int): TextView =
        textView(value, 11f, color, true).apply {
            gravity = Gravity.CENTER
            setPadding(dp(9), 0, dp(9), 0)
            background = rounded(Color.rgb(31, 37, 47), 14, BORDER)
        }

    private fun chip(label: String): Button =
        Button(this).apply {
            text = label
            textSize = 12.5f
            isAllCaps = false
            setTypeface(typeface, Typeface.BOLD)
            setTextColor(Color.rgb(224, 232, 246))
            background = rounded(SURFACE, 14, BORDER)
            setPadding(dp(13), 0, dp(13), 0)
            minWidth = 0
            minHeight = 0
        }

    private fun actionButton(
        label: String,
        accent: Boolean = false,
        compact: Boolean = false
    ): Button =
        Button(this).apply {
            text = label
            textSize = if (compact) 11.5f else 12.5f
            isAllCaps = false
            setTypeface(typeface, Typeface.BOLD)
            setTextColor(TEXT)
            background = if (accent) {
                roundedGradient(Color.rgb(27, 133, 246), Color.rgb(53, 78, 236), 13, Color.rgb(81, 187, 255))
            } else {
                roundedGradient(Color.rgb(29, 42, 65), SURFACE, 13, BORDER)
            }
            setPadding(if (compact) dp(7) else dp(12), 0, if (compact) dp(7) else dp(12), 0)
            minWidth = 0
            minHeight = 0
        }

    private fun verticalCard(): LinearLayout =
        LinearLayout(this).apply {
            orientation = LinearLayout.VERTICAL
            background = roundedGradient(Color.rgb(19, 35, 59), Color.rgb(19, 28, 46), 18, BORDER)
        }

    private fun textView(
        value: String,
        size: Float,
        color: Int,
        bold: Boolean = false
    ): TextView =
        TextView(this).apply {
            text = value
            textSize = size
            setTextColor(color)
            if (bold) setTypeface(typeface, Typeface.BOLD)
        }

    private fun rounded(
        color: Int,
        radius: Int,
        strokeColor: Int? = null
    ): GradientDrawable =
        GradientDrawable().apply {
            shape = GradientDrawable.RECTANGLE
            setColor(color)
            cornerRadius = dp(radius).toFloat()
            if (strokeColor != null) setStroke(dp(1), strokeColor)
        }

    private fun roundedGradient(
        start: Int, end: Int, radius: Int, stroke: Int
    ): GradientDrawable = GradientDrawable(
        GradientDrawable.Orientation.LEFT_RIGHT, intArrayOf(start, end)
    ).apply {
        cornerRadius = dp(radius).toFloat()
        setStroke(dp(1), stroke)
    }

    private fun matchWidth(top: Int = 0) =
        LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
            LinearLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
            LinearLayout.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT
        ).apply {
            topMargin = dp(top)
        }

    private fun dp(value: Int): Int =
        (value * resources.displayMetrics.density).toInt()
}

package at.heinz.deviceai

import android.content.Context
import android.os.Build
import android.os.Handler
import android.os.Looper
import org.json.JSONArray
import org.json.JSONObject
import java.net.HttpURLConnection
import java.net.URL

data class RemoteContinuumStatus(
    val autonomousResearchEnabled: Boolean,
    val brainEvolutionEnabled: Boolean,
    val researchGeneration: Long?,
    val observations: Int?,
    val openGaps: Int?,
    val cycles: Int?,
    val successfulCycles: Int?,
    val failedCycles: Int?,
    val citationCount: Int?,
    val brainGeneration: Int?,
    val championId: String?,
    val championScore: Double?,
    val candidates: Int?,
    val reflections: Int?,
    val hypothesisTournamentEnabled: Boolean,
    val hypothesisGeneration: Int?,
    val hypotheses: Int?,
    val tournaments: Int?,
    val hypothesisLeaderElo: Int?
)

class AgentBackendClient(private val context: Context) {
    companion object {
        private const val PREFS = "device_ai_cloud"
        private const val KEY_URL = "backend_url"
    }

    private val mainHandler = Handler(Looper.getMainLooper())

    fun backendUrl(): String =
        context.getSharedPreferences(PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
            .getString(KEY_URL, "")
            .orEmpty()
            .trim()

    fun saveBackendUrl(value: String) {
        context.getSharedPreferences(PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
            .edit()
            .putString(KEY_URL, value.trim().trimEnd('/'))
            .apply()
    }

    fun hasToken(): Boolean = !SecureTokenStore.load(context).isNullOrBlank()

    fun isConfigured(): Boolean =
        backendUrl().startsWith("https://", ignoreCase = true) && hasToken()

    fun health(callback: (Result<String>) -> Unit) {
        val base = backendUrl()
        if (!base.startsWith("https://", ignoreCase = true)) {
            callback(Result.failure(IllegalStateException("Backend-URL fehlt oder ist nicht HTTPS.")))
            return
        }
        Thread {
            val result = runCatching {
                request("GET", "$base/health", null, authenticated = false)
            }
            mainHandler.post { callback(result) }
        }.start()
    }

    fun continuumStatus(callback: (Result<RemoteContinuumStatus>) -> Unit) {
        val base = backendUrl()
        val token = SecureTokenStore.load(context)
        if (!base.startsWith("https://", ignoreCase = true) || token.isNullOrBlank()) {
            callback(Result.failure(IllegalStateException("Cloud-KI ist noch nicht eingerichtet.")))
            return
        }
        Thread {
            val result = runCatching {
                val raw = request(
                    "GET",
                    "$base/v1/continuum/status",
                    null,
                    authenticated = true,
                    token = token
                )
                parseContinuumStatus(JSONObject(raw))
            }
            mainHandler.post { callback(result) }
        }.start()
    }

    fun send(
        sessionId: String,
        message: String?,
        shizukuReady: Boolean,
        toolOutputs: List<ToolOutput> = emptyList(),
        callback: (Result<AgentReply>) -> Unit
    ) {
        val base = backendUrl()
        val token = SecureTokenStore.load(context)
        if (!base.startsWith("https://", ignoreCase = true) || token.isNullOrBlank()) {
            callback(Result.failure(IllegalStateException("Cloud-KI ist noch nicht eingerichtet.")))
            return
        }

        Thread {
            val result = runCatching {
                val body = JSONObject().apply {
                    put("session_id", sessionId)
                    if (!message.isNullOrBlank()) put("message", message)
                    put("device", JSONObject().apply {
                        put("manufacturer", Build.MANUFACTURER)
                        put("model", Build.MODEL)
                        put("android", Build.VERSION.RELEASE)
                        put("sdk", Build.VERSION.SDK_INT)
                        put("app_version", BuildConfig.VERSION_NAME)
                        put("shizuku_ready", shizukuReady)
                    })
                    if (toolOutputs.isNotEmpty()) {
                        put("tool_outputs", JSONArray().apply {
                            toolOutputs.forEach { output ->
                                put(JSONObject().apply {
                                    put("call_id", output.callId)
                                    put("output", output.output)
                                })
                            }
                        })
                    }
                }

                val raw = request(
                    "POST",
                    "$base/v1/agent/turn",
                    body.toString(),
                    authenticated = true,
                    token = token
                )
                parseReply(JSONObject(raw))
            }
            mainHandler.post { callback(result) }
        }.start()
    }

    private fun request(
        method: String,
        url: String,
        body: String?,
        authenticated: Boolean,
        token: String? = null
    ): String {
        val connection = (URL(url).openConnection() as HttpURLConnection).apply {
            requestMethod = method
            connectTimeout = 12_000
            readTimeout = 90_000
            setRequestProperty("Accept", "application/json")
            setRequestProperty("User-Agent", "DeviceAI/${BuildConfig.VERSION_NAME}")
            if (authenticated) {
                setRequestProperty("Authorization", "Bearer ${token.orEmpty()}")
            }
            if (body != null) {
                doOutput = true
                setRequestProperty("Content-Type", "application/json; charset=utf-8")
            }
        }

        if (body != null) {
            connection.outputStream.use { it.write(body.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8)) }
        }

        val code = connection.responseCode
        val stream = if (code in 200..299) connection.inputStream else connection.errorStream
        val text = stream?.bufferedReader()?.use { it.readText() }.orEmpty()
        connection.disconnect()

        if (code !in 200..299) {
            val message = runCatching { JSONObject(text).optString("error") }.getOrNull()
                ?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() }
                ?: "HTTP $code"
            throw IllegalStateException(message)
        }
        return text
    }

    private fun parseContinuumStatus(json: JSONObject): RemoteContinuumStatus {
        val daemon = json.optJSONObject("daemon")
        val brain = json.optJSONObject("brain")
        val hypotheses = json.optJSONObject("hypotheses")
        fun JSONObject?.intOrNull(key: String): Int? =
            this?.takeIf { it.has(key) && !it.isNull(key) }?.optInt(key)
        fun JSONObject?.longOrNull(key: String): Long? =
            this?.takeIf { it.has(key) && !it.isNull(key) }?.optLong(key)
        fun JSONObject?.doubleOrNull(key: String): Double? =
            this?.takeIf { it.has(key) && !it.isNull(key) }?.optDouble(key)
                ?.takeIf { it.isFinite() }
        fun JSONObject?.stringOrNull(key: String): String? =
            this?.optString(key)?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() && it != "null" }
        return RemoteContinuumStatus(
            autonomousResearchEnabled = json.optBoolean("autonomousResearchEnabled", false),
            brainEvolutionEnabled = json.optBoolean("brainEvolutionEnabled", false),
            researchGeneration = daemon.longOrNull("generation"),
            observations = daemon.intOrNull("observations"),
            openGaps = daemon.intOrNull("openGaps"),
            cycles = daemon.intOrNull("cycles"),
            successfulCycles = daemon.intOrNull("successfulCycles"),
            failedCycles = daemon.intOrNull("failedCycles"),
            citationCount = daemon.intOrNull("citationCount"),
            brainGeneration = brain.intOrNull("generation"),
            championId = brain.stringOrNull("championId"),
            championScore = brain.doubleOrNull("championScore"),
            candidates = brain.intOrNull("candidates"),
            reflections = brain.intOrNull("reflections"),
            hypothesisTournamentEnabled = json.optBoolean("hypothesisTournamentEnabled", false),
            hypothesisGeneration = hypotheses.intOrNull("generation"),
            hypotheses = hypotheses.intOrNull("hypotheses"),
            tournaments = hypotheses.intOrNull("tournaments"),
            hypothesisLeaderElo = hypotheses.intOrNull("leaderElo")
        )
    }

    private fun parseReply(json: JSONObject): AgentReply {
        val calls = mutableListOf<ToolCallRequest>()
        val array = json.optJSONArray("tool_calls") ?: JSONArray()
        for (i in 0 until array.length()) {
            val item = array.getJSONObject(i)
            calls += ToolCallRequest(
                callId = item.getString("call_id"),
                name = item.getString("name"),
                arguments = jsonObjectToMap(item.optJSONObject("arguments") ?: JSONObject())
            )
        }

        val citations = mutableListOf<AgentCitation>()
        val citationArray = json.optJSONArray("citations") ?: JSONArray()
        for (i in 0 until citationArray.length()) {
            val item = citationArray.getJSONObject(i)
            val url = item.optString("url")
            if (url.isNotBlank()) {
                citations += AgentCitation(
                    title = item.optString("title").ifBlank { url },
                    url = url
                )
            }
        }

        return AgentReply(
            responseId = json.optString("response_id").takeIf { it.isNotBlank() },
            message = json.optString("message").takeIf { it.isNotBlank() },
            toolCalls = calls,
            citations = citations,
            status = json.optString("status", "completed")
        )
    }

    private fun jsonObjectToMap(json: JSONObject): Map<String, Any?> {
        val out = linkedMapOf<String, Any?>()
        val keys = json.keys()
        while (keys.hasNext()) {
            val key = keys.next()
            out[key] = when (val value = json.opt(key)) {
                JSONObject.NULL -> null
                is JSONArray -> {
                    val list = mutableListOf<Any?>()
                    for (i in 0 until value.length()) {
                        val item = value.opt(i)
                        list += if (item == JSONObject.NULL) null else item
                    }
                    list
                }
                else -> value
            }
        }
        return out
    }
}

package at.heinz.deviceai

import java.util.concurrent.Callable
import java.util.concurrent.CancellationException
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap
import java.util.concurrent.Executors
import java.util.concurrent.Future
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit
import java.util.concurrent.TimeoutException
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicBoolean
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger
import java.security.MessageDigest

data class ToolProposal(val toolName: String, val arguments: Map<String, Any?>) {
    fun validate(): String? {
        if (toolName.equals("shell", true) || toolName.equals("run_shell", true)) {
            return "Raw shell proposals are not supported."
        }
        if (arguments.keys.any { it.equals("command", true) || it.equals("shell", true) || it.equals("script", true) }) {
            return "Command-like arguments are not supported."
        }
        if (arguments.size > 16 || arguments.any { (key, value) ->
                !key.matches(Regex("[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]{0,63}")) ||
                    !isStructuredValue(value) || !validArgumentType(toolName, key, value)
            }) return "Tool arguments must match a bounded registered-tool schema."
        return ToolRegistry.validate(ToolCallRequest("proposal", toolName, arguments))
    }

    private fun isStructuredValue(value: Any?): Boolean = when (value) {
        null, is Boolean -> true
        is Number -> value.toDouble().isFinite() && value.toDouble() % 1.0 == 0.0
        is String -> value.length <= 4_096
        is List<*> -> value.size <= 100 && value.all { it is String && isStructuredValue(it) }
        else -> false
    }

    private fun validArgumentType(name: String, key: String, value: Any?): Boolean = when (key) {
        "lines", "limit", "seconds" -> value is Number || value is String && value.toIntOrNull() != null
        "userOnly" -> value is Boolean || value is String &&
            (value.equals("true", true) || value.equals("false", true))
        "roots" -> (name == "find_files" || name == "get_large_files") &&
            (value is String || value is List<*> && value.all { it is String })
        else -> value is String
    }

    fun invocation(callId: String): ToolInvocation {
        require(validate() == null) { validate() ?: "Invalid tool proposal." }
        return ToolInvocation(callId, ToolCallRequest(callId, toolName, arguments))
    }
}

data class ToolInvocation(val id: String, val request: ToolCallRequest) {
    init {
        require(id.isNotBlank() && id.length <= 128 && request.callId == id)
    }
}

enum class ToolExecutionStatus { SUCCEEDED, REJECTED, FAILED, TIMED_OUT, CANCELLED }

data class ToolExecutionRecord(
    val callId: String,
    val toolName: String,
    val risk: Risk?,
    val sanitizedArguments: Map<String, Any?>,
    val decisionReason: String,
    val status: ToolExecutionStatus,
    val elapsedMillis: Long,
    val outputLength: Int = 0
)

data class ToolExecutionResult(val output: String?, val record: ToolExecutionRecord)

data class ToolPolicy(
    val readOnlyEnabled: Boolean = false,
    val destructiveEnabled: Boolean = false,
    val maxCalls: Int = 4,
    val timeoutMillis: Long = 10_000,
    val maxOutputCharacters: Int = 8_000
) {
    init {
        require(maxCalls in 0..64 && timeoutMillis in 1..120_000 && maxOutputCharacters in 1..60_000)
    }
}

fun interface ToolRunner {
    fun execute(request: ToolCallRequest): String
}

class ToolGate(
    private val policy: ToolPolicy,
    private val runner: ToolRunner,
    private val clock: () -> Long = System::nanoTime,
    private val receiptStore: ToolExecutionReceiptStore? = null,
    private val receiptClock: () -> Long = System::currentTimeMillis
) {
    private val calls = AtomicInteger()
    private val cancelled = AtomicBoolean()
    private val activeFutures = ConcurrentHashMap.newKeySet<Future<String>>()
    private val consumedCallIds = ConcurrentHashMap.newKeySet<String>()

    fun cancel() {
        cancelled.set(true)
        activeFutures.forEach { it.cancel(true) }
    }

    fun recordProposal(invocation: ToolInvocation): ToolExecutionReceipt? {
        val request = invocation.request
        val validation = ToolProposal(request.name, request.arguments).validate()
        require(validation == null) { validation ?: "Invalid tool proposal." }
        val spec = checkNotNull(ToolRegistry.get(request.name))
        val store = receiptStore ?: return null
        val proposedAt = receiptClock().coerceAtLeast(0)
        return store.propose(
            ToolExecutionReceipt(
                callId = request.callId,
                toolName = request.name,
                argumentFingerprint = toolArgumentFingerprint(request.arguments),
                sanitizedArguments = sanitizeArguments(request.arguments),
                risk = spec.risk,
                createdAtMillis = proposedAt,
                transitions = listOf(ToolReceiptTransition(ToolReceiptState.PROPOSED, proposedAt))
            )
        )
    }

    fun execute(
        invocation: ToolInvocation,
        userConfirmed: Boolean = false,
        destructiveConfirmed: Boolean = false
    ): ToolExecutionResult {
        val request = invocation.request
        val spec = ToolRegistry.get(request.name)
        val start = clock()
        fun result(status: ToolExecutionStatus, reason: String, output: String? = null): ToolExecutionResult {
            val elapsed = ((clock() - start).coerceAtLeast(0) / 1_000_000)
            return ToolExecutionResult(
                output,
                ToolExecutionRecord(
                    request.callId, request.name, spec?.risk, sanitizeArguments(request.arguments),
                    reason, status, elapsed, output?.length ?: 0
                )
            )
        }

        if (cancelled.get()) {
            runCatching {
                val prior = receiptStore?.get(request.callId)
                if (prior != null && prior.state in setOf(ToolReceiptState.PROPOSED, ToolReceiptState.APPROVED)) {
                    receiptStore.transition(
                        request.callId, prior.state, ToolReceiptState.CANCELLED, receiptClock().coerceAtLeast(0)
                    )
                }
            }
            return result(ToolExecutionStatus.CANCELLED, "Task cancelled.")
        }
        val validation = ToolProposal(request.name, request.arguments).validate()
        if (validation != null) return result(ToolExecutionStatus.REJECTED, validation)
        var receipt = try {
            recordProposal(invocation)
        } catch (_: Exception) {
            return result(ToolExecutionStatus.REJECTED, "Durable tool receipt could not be verified or saved.")
        }
        when (receipt?.state) {
            ToolReceiptState.SUCCEEDED -> return result(
                ToolExecutionStatus.SUCCEEDED,
                "This call id already completed; its tool was not run again."
            )
            ToolReceiptState.STARTED -> return result(
                ToolExecutionStatus.REJECTED,
                "This call id has an ambiguous prior outcome and requires operator review; it was not retried."
            )
            ToolReceiptState.FAILED, ToolReceiptState.TIMED_OUT, ToolReceiptState.CANCELLED,
            ToolReceiptState.REJECTED -> return result(
                receipt.state.toExecutionStatus(),
                "This call id already has a terminal receipt; it was not retried."
            )
            else -> Unit
        }
        fun rejectWithReceipt(status: ToolExecutionStatus, reason: String): ToolExecutionResult {
            val current = receipt
            if (current != null) {
                val terminal = if (status == ToolExecutionStatus.CANCELLED) ToolReceiptState.CANCELLED
                else ToolReceiptState.REJECTED
                receiptStore?.transition(request.callId, current.state, terminal, receiptClock().coerceAtLeast(0))
            }
            return result(status, reason)
        }
        when (spec!!.risk) {
            Risk.READ_ONLY -> if (!policy.readOnlyEnabled) {
                return rejectWithReceipt(ToolExecutionStatus.REJECTED, "Read-only tools are disabled by operator policy.")
            }
            Risk.CONFIRM -> if (!userConfirmed) {
                return rejectWithReceipt(ToolExecutionStatus.REJECTED, "Explicit user confirmation is required.")
            }
            Risk.DESTRUCTIVE -> {
                if (!policy.destructiveEnabled || !userConfirmed || !destructiveConfirmed) {
                    return rejectWithReceipt(
                        ToolExecutionStatus.REJECTED,
                        "Destructive policy and explicit strong confirmation are required."
                    )
                }
            }
        }

        val reservedCall = calls.getAndIncrement()
        if (reservedCall >= policy.maxCalls) {
            calls.decrementAndGet()
            return rejectWithReceipt(ToolExecutionStatus.REJECTED, "Tool-call budget exhausted.")
        }
        if (!consumedCallIds.add(request.callId)) {
            calls.decrementAndGet()
            return rejectWithReceipt(ToolExecutionStatus.REJECTED, "Duplicate tool call id rejected by replay guard.")
        }
        if (receipt != null) {
            if (receipt.state == ToolReceiptState.PROPOSED) {
                receipt = receiptStore?.transition(
                    request.callId, ToolReceiptState.PROPOSED, ToolReceiptState.APPROVED,
                    receiptClock().coerceAtLeast(0)
                )
            }
            receipt = receiptStore?.transition(
                request.callId, ToolReceiptState.APPROVED, ToolReceiptState.STARTED,
                receiptClock().coerceAtLeast(0)
            )
            if (receipt == null) {
                calls.decrementAndGet()
                return result(
                    ToolExecutionStatus.REJECTED,
                    "Durable receipt state changed; execution was blocked for operator review."
                )
            }
        }
        fun persistTerminal(state: ToolReceiptState, output: String?): Boolean {
            val store = receiptStore ?: return true
            val digest = output?.takeIf { it.isNotEmpty() }?.let {
                MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256").digest(it.toByteArray()).joinToString("") { byte ->
                    "%02x".format(byte)
                }
            }
            return runCatching {
                store.transition(
                    request.callId, ToolReceiptState.STARTED, state, receiptClock().coerceAtLeast(0),
                    output?.length ?: 0, digest
                ) != null
            }.getOrDefault(false)
        }
        val executor = Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor { runnable ->
            Thread(runnable, "device-ai-tool").apply { isDaemon = true }
        }
        return try {
            val future = executor.submit(Callable { runner.execute(request) })
            activeFutures += future
            if (cancelled.get()) future.cancel(true)
            val output = try {
                future.get(policy.timeoutMillis, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS)
            } catch (_: TimeoutException) {
                future.cancel(true)
                val saved = persistTerminal(ToolReceiptState.TIMED_OUT, null)
                return result(
                    ToolExecutionStatus.TIMED_OUT,
                    if (saved) "Tool execution timed out."
                    else "Tool timed out and its outcome is ambiguous; operator review is required."
                )
            }
            if (cancelled.get()) {
                val saved = persistTerminal(ToolReceiptState.CANCELLED, null)
                result(
                    ToolExecutionStatus.CANCELLED,
                    if (saved) "Task cancelled." else "Cancellation outcome is ambiguous; operator review is required.",
                    output.take(policy.maxOutputCharacters)
                )
            } else {
                val limited = output.take(policy.maxOutputCharacters)
                val saved = persistTerminal(ToolReceiptState.SUCCEEDED, limited)
                result(
                    if (saved) ToolExecutionStatus.SUCCEEDED else ToolExecutionStatus.FAILED,
                    if (saved) "Allowed by tool policy."
                    else "Tool returned, but its completion receipt could not be committed; operator review is required.",
                    limited
                )
            }
        } catch (e: InterruptedException) {
            Thread.currentThread().interrupt()
            persistTerminal(ToolReceiptState.CANCELLED, null)
            result(ToolExecutionStatus.CANCELLED, "Tool execution interrupted.")
        } catch (_: CancellationException) {
            persistTerminal(ToolReceiptState.CANCELLED, null)
            result(ToolExecutionStatus.CANCELLED, "Tool execution cancelled.")
        } catch (_: TimeoutException) {
            persistTerminal(ToolReceiptState.TIMED_OUT, null)
            result(ToolExecutionStatus.TIMED_OUT, "Tool execution timed out.")
        } catch (_: Exception) {
            persistTerminal(ToolReceiptState.FAILED, null)
            result(ToolExecutionStatus.FAILED, "Tool execution failed.")
        } finally {
            activeFutures.removeIf { it.isDone }
            executor.shutdownNow()
        }

    }

    private fun sanitizeArguments(arguments: Map<String, Any?>): Map<String, Any?> =
        arguments.mapValues { (key, value) ->
            if (key.contains(Regex("password|token|secret|credential|authorization", RegexOption.IGNORE_CASE))) {
                "[REDACTED]"
            } else {
                when (value) {
                    is String -> "[STRING ${value.length.coerceAtMost(4_096)} chars]"
                    is Number -> "[NUMBER]"
                    is Boolean, null -> value
                    is List<*> -> "[LIST ${value.size.coerceAtMost(100)} items]"
                    else -> "[UNSUPPORTED]"
                }
            }
        }
}

@JvmInline
value class SkillId(val value: String) {
    init { require(value.matches(Regex("[a-z][a-z0-9_.-]{1,63}"))) }
}

@JvmInline
value class SkillVersion(val value: String) {
    init { require(value.matches(Regex("[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+"))) }
}

enum class SkillCapability { DEVICE_DIAGNOSTICS, APP_MANAGEMENT, FILE_READ, RESEARCH }
enum class SkillSource { BUILT_IN, IMPORTED, USER }
enum class SkillStatus { DISABLED, ENABLED }

data class SkillDependency(val id: SkillId, val version: SkillVersion)

data class Skill(
    val id: SkillId,
    val version: SkillVersion,
    val name: String,
    val description: String,
    val capabilities: Set<SkillCapability>,
    val dependencies: Set<SkillDependency> = emptySet(),
    val source: SkillSource = SkillSource.BUILT_IN,
    val status: SkillStatus = SkillStatus.DISABLED,
    val toolNames: Set<String> = emptySet()
) {
    init {
        require(name.isNotBlank() && description.isNotBlank())
        require(toolNames.all { ToolRegistry.get(it) != null })
    }
}

data class SkillKey(val id: SkillId, val version: SkillVersion)
data class SkillAuditEvent(val action: String, val key: SkillKey)

class SkillGraph {
    private val skills = linkedMapOf<SkillKey, Skill>()
    private val audit = mutableListOf<SkillAuditEvent>()

    @Synchronized
    fun install(skill: Skill) = installAll(listOf(skill))

    @Synchronized
    fun installAll(additions: Collection<Skill>) {
        val combined = skills.toMutableMap()
        additions.forEach { skill ->
            val key = SkillKey(skill.id, skill.version)
            require(key !in combined) { "Duplicate skill version: $key" }
            combined[key] = skill.copy(status = SkillStatus.DISABLED)
        }
        combined.forEach { (key, skill) ->
            skill.dependencies.forEach { dependency ->
                require(SkillKey(dependency.id, dependency.version) in combined) {
                    "Missing skill dependency: ${dependency.id}@${dependency.version}"
                }
            }
            require(skill.dependencies.none { SkillKey(it.id, it.version) == key }) {
                "A skill cannot depend on itself."
            }
        }
        val visiting = mutableSetOf<SkillKey>()
        val visited = mutableSetOf<SkillKey>()
        fun visit(key: SkillKey) {
            if (key in visiting) error("Skill dependency cycle detected.")
            if (!visited.add(key)) return
            visiting += key
            combined.getValue(key).dependencies.forEach { visit(SkillKey(it.id, it.version)) }
            visiting -= key
        }
        combined.keys.forEach(::visit)
        skills.clear()
        skills.putAll(combined)
        additions.forEach { audit += SkillAuditEvent("installed", SkillKey(it.id, it.version)) }
    }

    @Synchronized
    fun activate(key: SkillKey): Skill {
        val skill = skills[key] ?: error("Unknown skill version.")
        require(skill.dependencies.all { skills[SkillKey(it.id, it.version)]?.status == SkillStatus.ENABLED }) {
            "All skill dependencies must be enabled first."
        }
        return skill.copy(status = SkillStatus.ENABLED).also {
            skills[key] = it
            audit += SkillAuditEvent("enabled", key)
        }
    }

    @Synchronized
    fun disable(key: SkillKey): Skill {
        val skill = skills[key] ?: error("Unknown skill version.")
        require(skills.values.none { it.status == SkillStatus.ENABLED && SkillDependency(key.id, key.version) in it.dependencies }) {
            "Enabled dependents must be disabled first."
        }
        return skill.copy(status = SkillStatus.DISABLED).also {
            skills[key] = it
            audit += SkillAuditEvent("disabled", key)
        }
    }

    @Synchronized fun get(key: SkillKey): Skill? = skills[key]
    @Synchronized fun all(): List<Skill> = skills.values.sortedWith(compareBy({ it.id.value }, { it.version.value }))
    @Synchronized fun auditTrail(): List<SkillAuditEvent> = audit.toList()
}

interface SkillImplementation {
    val key: SkillKey
    fun execute(arguments: Map<String, Map<String, Any?>>, gate: ToolGate): List<ToolExecutionResult>
}

class DeviceStatusSkillImplementation(
    override val key: SkillKey = SkillKey(SkillId("device_status"), SkillVersion("1.0.0"))
) : SkillImplementation {
    override fun execute(
        arguments: Map<String, Map<String, Any?>>,
        gate: ToolGate
    ): List<ToolExecutionResult> = listOf("get_device_info", "get_battery_info").mapIndexed { index, name ->
        val proposal = ToolProposal(name, arguments[name].orEmpty())
        require(proposal.validate() == null)
        gate.execute(proposal.invocation("device-status-${index + 1}"))
    }
}

object BuiltInSkills {
    val deviceStatus = Skill(
        id = SkillId("device_status"),
        version = SkillVersion("1.0.0"),
        name = "Device status",
        description = "Reads basic device and battery information through registered read-only tools.",
        capabilities = setOf(SkillCapability.DEVICE_DIAGNOSTICS),
        toolNames = setOf("get_device_info", "get_battery_info")
    )
}

class DeviceToolExecutorRunner(private val executor: DeviceToolExecutor) : ToolRunner {
    override fun execute(request: ToolCallRequest): String {
        val completed = java.util.concurrent.CountDownLatch(1)
        var output: String? = null
        executor.execute(request) {
            output = it
            completed.countDown()
        }
        completed.await()
        return output.orEmpty()
    }
}

package at.heinz.deviceai

import at.heinz.deviceai.cognitive.*

/** Actual common ToolGate runner: the consumed owner grant wraps all discovery
 * and reading performed by the existing Research Engine, including follow-ups.
 */
class ApprovedWebResearchToolRunner(
    private val session:ApprovedWebResearchSession,
    discovery:ResearchDiscoveryProvider,
    provider:ResearchProvider,
    private val engineFactory:(ResearchDiscoveryProvider,ResearchProvider)->DeepResearchEngine={d,p->DeepResearchEngine(
        discovery=d,provider=p,validateTarget={HttpReadOnlyResearchProvider.ResearchUrlValidator.validateSyntax(it)})},
    private val cancellation:ResearchCancellation=ResearchCancellation(),
    private val progress:(ResearchPhase)->Unit={},
    private val resume:Boolean=false
):ToolRunner {
    private val guardedDiscovery=session.discovery(discovery)
    private val guardedProvider=session.provider(provider)
    @Volatile var dossier:ResearchDossier?=null
        private set
    override fun execute(request:ToolCallRequest):String {
        val call=WebToolRequest.fromTool(request.name,request.arguments)
        return session.execute(call) {
            val engine=engineFactory(guardedDiscovery,guardedProvider)
            val result=if(resume)engine.resume(cancellation,progress)?:error("Kein fortsetzbarer Recherchelauf")
                else engine.research(session.question,session.mode,session.seedUrls,cancellation,progress)
            check(result.plan.question==session.question&&result.plan.mode==session.mode) { "Checkpoint stimmt nicht mit der Freigabe überein" }
            dossier=result
            format(result)
        }
    }
    companion object {
        fun format(dossier:ResearchDossier):String=buildString {
            append((dossier.synthesis?.text?:"Keine belegte Zusammenfassung verfügbar.").take(4000))
            dossier.sources.filter { it.duplicateOf==null }.take(16).forEachIndexed { i,s->
                append("\n\n[").append(i+1).append("] ").append(s.title?:s.domain)
                append("\n").append(s.canonicalUrl).append("\nSHA-256: ").append(s.contentHash.take(16))
            }
            if(dossier.sources.isEmpty())append("\n\nKeine abrufbaren Quellen; keine Antwort erfunden.")
            dossier.partialReason?.let { append("\n\nTeilrecherche: ").append(it.take(256)) }
        }.take(8000)
    }
}

package at.heinz.deviceai

import java.util.Locale
import at.heinz.deviceai.learning.KnowledgeSyntax
import at.heinz.deviceai.learning.StructuredKnowledge
import at.heinz.deviceai.learning.OnlineNaiveBayes
import at.heinz.deviceai.learning.NeuralDialogue

/** Initial deterministic cognition. Never present these rules as an LLM. */
enum class BootstrapKind { REPLY, REMEMBER, FORGET, FEEDBACK_POSITIVE, FEEDBACK_NEGATIVE, DEVICE_TOOL, TRAIN, REVISE }

data class BootstrapDecision(
    val kind: BootstrapKind,
    val message: String = "",
    val fact: String? = null,
    val tool: String? = null,
    val arguments: Map<String, Any?> = emptyMap(),
    val replacementFact: String? = null,
    val allowNeuralRecall: Boolean = false
)

object BootstrapBrain {
    private val unsafe = Regex(
        "(?i)\\b(passwort|password|kennwort|pin|iban|bic|kreditkarte|api[ _-]?key|secret|token|tanf?nummer|zugangscode)\\b"
    )

    fun decide(utterance: String, facts: List<String>,
               learnedCommands: Map<String, String> = emptyMap()): BootstrapDecision {
        if (utterance.length > 2_048) return BootstrapDecision(BootstrapKind.REPLY,
            "Eingabe zu lang; bitte höchstens 2048 Zeichen. Es wurde nichts ausgeführt.")
        val text = utterance.trim()
        val low = text.lowercase(Locale.ROOT)
        // Explicit memory deletion stays available, but always requires an Android confirmation.
        if (low == "lösche meine erinnerungen" || low == "lernspeicher löschen")
            return BootstrapDecision(BootstrapKind.FORGET)
        // The deterministic intent recognizer must not mistake a dangerous mixed
        // request or forged role header for permission to run a harmless-looking tool.
        if (Regex("""(?i)^(system|developer|assistant|tool)\s*:""").containsMatchIn(text) ||
            Regex("""(?i)\b(lösch\w*|entfern\w*|deinstallier(?:e|en|st)\b|installier(?:e|en|st)\b|verschieb\w*|starte\w*|stoppe?\w*|überweis\w*|bezahl\w*)\b""").containsMatchIn(text)
        ) return BootstrapDecision(
            BootstrapKind.REPLY,
            "Dieser Satz enthält eine nachgeahmte Rolle oder einen verändernden Geräteauftrag. " +
                "Der eigene Startkern führt deshalb keinerlei Gerätewerkzeug aus."
        )
        if (NeuralDialogue.accepts(text)) return BootstrapDecision(BootstrapKind.REPLY,
            "Neuronales Experiment: Öffne das Lernlabor. Neuron Demo · Neuron: Hallo")
        if (low.startsWith("korrigiere:") || low.startsWith("widerrufe:")) {
            val parts = text.substringAfter(':').split("=>").map(String::trim)
            val correcting = low.startsWith("korrigiere:")
            val old = parts.first()
            val replacement = if (correcting) parts.getOrNull(1) else null
            if (parts.size != (if (correcting) 2 else 1) || old !in facts ||
                (correcting && (replacement == null || unsafe.containsMatchIn(replacement) ||
                    KnowledgeSyntax.statement(replacement) == null)))
                return BootstrapDecision(BootstrapKind.REPLY,
                    "Nicht geändert. Format: Korrigiere: <exakter alter Fakt> => Fakt: Name | Beziehung | Wert; oder Widerrufe: <exakter Fakt>.")
            return BootstrapDecision(BootstrapKind.REVISE, fact = old, replacementFact = replacement)
        }
        if (low.startsWith("prüfe wissen:")) {
            val query = KnowledgeSyntax.literal(text.substringAfter(':'))
                ?: return BootstrapDecision(BootstrapKind.REPLY, "Format: Prüfe Wissen: Name | Beziehung | Wert")
            return BootstrapDecision(BootstrapKind.REPLY, runCatching { StructuredKnowledge().query(facts, query).describe() }
                .getOrDefault("UNGEKLÄRT – gespeicherte Fakten überschreiten die zulässigen Grenzen."))
        }
        if (low.startsWith("trainiere:")) {
            val candidate = BootstrapTraining.parse(text)
            return if (candidate == null) BootstrapDecision(BootstrapKind.REPLY,
                "Format: Trainiere: <dein Satz> => Akku | Speicher | Downloads | Apps | Gerät | Netzwerk.")
            else BootstrapDecision(BootstrapKind.TRAIN,
                message = "Ich lerne den Befehl erst nach deiner Bestätigung.",
                fact = candidate.first, tool = candidate.second)
        }
        if (low.startsWith("merke dir:") || low.startsWith("merk dir:")) {
            val fact = text.substringAfter(':').trim()
            return if (fact.length in 3..320 && !unsafe.containsMatchIn(fact) &&
                (!KnowledgeSyntax.isStructured(fact) || KnowledgeSyntax.statement(fact) != null)) {
                BootstrapDecision(BootstrapKind.REMEMBER, fact = fact)
            } else BootstrapDecision(BootstrapKind.REPLY,
                "Das kann ich nicht speichern: Bitte 3–320 Zeichen, ohne Passwörter, Zugangsdaten oder Bankdaten.")
        }
        if (low == "vergiss alles" || low == "lösche meine erinnerungen" ||
            low == "lernspeicher löschen") return BootstrapDecision(BootstrapKind.FORGET)
        if (low == "das war hilfreich" || low == "gut gemacht") return BootstrapDecision(
            BootstrapKind.FEEDBACK_POSITIVE
        )
        if (low == "das war nicht hilfreich" || low == "das ist falsch") return BootstrapDecision(
            BootstrapKind.FEEDBACK_NEGATIVE
        )
        if (low.contains("was weißt du") || low.contains("was hast du dir gemerkt") ||
            low == "erinnerungen") return BootstrapDecision(BootstrapKind.REPLY,
                if (facts.isEmpty()) "Ich habe noch keine ausdrücklich bestätigten Fakten gespeichert." else
                    "Meine ausdrücklich gespeicherten Fakten:\n" + facts.take(32).joinToString("\n") { "• $it" })
        if (low == "hallo" || low == "hi" || low == "hey" || low == "guten morgen" ||
            low == "guten tag" || low == "servus") return BootstrapDecision(BootstrapKind.REPLY,
                "Hallo! Ich bin Device AI. Mein eigener lokaler Startkern ist aktiv. Was möchtest du mit mir ausprobieren?")
        if (low.contains("wer bist du") || low.contains("wie heißt du")) return BootstrapDecision(
            BootstrapKind.REPLY, "Ich bin Device AI Continuum – ein eigener Android-Startkern mit " +
                "lokaler, ausdrücklich gesteuerter Erinnerung. Ich bin noch kein großes Sprachmodell.")
        if (low.contains("was kannst du") || low == "hilfe" || low == "befehle") return BootstrapDecision(
            BootstrapKind.REPLY, "Ich kann dich begrüßen, per Android-TTS sprechen, Sprachtexte entgegennehmen, " +
                "Fakten auf Wunsch speichern, Feedback zählen und mit Shizuku lesend Akku, Speicher, " +
                "Downloads, Apps, Lumo-Fehler und Geräteinformationen prüfen. " +
                "Für Internetrecherche tippe auf WEB RECHERCHE, wähle QUICK, STANDARD oder DEEP " +
                "und suche ein Thema in der deutschsprachigen Wikipedia. Eigene HTTPS-Quellen sind ebenfalls möglich. " +
                "Schreiben: „Merke dir: ...“, Abrufen: „Was weißt du?“, Löschen: „Vergiss alles“. " +
                "Du kannst mir neue Nur-Lese-Befehle beibringen mit „Trainiere: <Satz> => Akku“. " +
                "Beziehungen: Merke dir: Fakt: Nova | ist | Mobilgerät. " +
                "Regeln: Merke dir: Regel: Mobilgerät | besitzt | Betriebssystem. " +
                "Fragen: Prüfe Wissen: Nova | besitzt | Betriebssystem. " +
                "Neuron Demo startet nach Freigabe ein echtes neuronales Lernexperiment. " +
                "Freies Sprachdenken und autonomes Lernen sind noch Forschungsziele.")
        fun tool(name: String, args: Map<String, Any?> = emptyMap()): BootstrapDecision =
            BootstrapDecision(BootstrapKind.DEVICE_TOOL, tool = name, arguments = args)
        BootstrapTraining.resolve(text, learnedCommands)?.let { name ->
            return BootstrapDecision(BootstrapKind.DEVICE_TOOL, tool = name,
                arguments = if (name == "list_files") mapOf("path" to "/sdcard/Download") else emptyMap())
        }
        if ("fehler lumo" in low || ("lumo" in low && "logcat" in low))
            return tool("read_logcat", mapOf("packageOrName" to "Lumo", "lines" to 180))
        if ("lumo" in low && ("prüf" in low || "version" in low || "installiert" in low))
            return tool("get_app_info", mapOf("packageOrName" to "Lumo"))
        if ("downloads" in low || "download-ordner" in low) return tool("list_files",
            mapOf("path" to "/sdcard/Download"))
        if ("akku" in low || "batterie" in low || "ladezustand" in low)
            return tool("get_battery_info")
        if ("speicher" in low || "große dateien" in low) return tool("get_storage_info")
        if ("installierte apps" in low || "alle apps" in low) return tool("list_installed_apps")
        if ("gerät" in low && ("info" in low || "prüf" in low)) return tool("get_device_info")
        if ("netzwerk" in low || "internetverbindung" in low) return tool("get_network_summary")
        if ("internet" in low || "recherch" in low) return BootstrapDecision(
            BootstrapKind.REPLY, "Internetrecherche ist nur nach deiner Freigabe aktiv. " +
                "Tippe WEB RECHERCHE und nenne eine direkte HTTPS-Quelle. " +
                "Die Inhalte werden als untrusted data behandelt, nicht als Befehle.")
        if (text.length <= 320 && learnedCommands.isNotEmpty()) {
            val learner = OnlineNaiveBayes()
            learnedCommands.entries.take(24).forEach { (phrase, target) ->
                if (BootstrapTraining.validate(phrase, target) != null)
                    runCatching { learner.learn(phrase, target, approved = true) }
            }
            learner.predict(text)?.let { suggestion ->
                val example = learnedCommands.entries.firstOrNull { it.value == suggestion.label && BootstrapTraining.validate(it.key, it.value) != null }
                if (example != null) return BootstrapDecision(BootstrapKind.REPLY,
                    "Vermutung aus deinen bestätigten Beispielen: ${ToolRegistry.label(suggestion.label)}. " +
                        "Nichts ausgeführt. Falls passend, schreibe den bestätigten Befehl: „${example.key}“.")
            }
        }
        return BootstrapDecision(BootstrapKind.REPLY,
            "Das kann mein eigener Startkern noch nicht verlässlich beantworten. " +
                "Ich erfinde keine Antwort. Probiere „Was kannst du?“, eine Geräteprüfung, " +
                "oder lerne mir etwas ausdrücklich mit „Merke dir: ...“.", allowNeuralRecall = true)
    }
}

package at.heinz.deviceai

import android.content.Context
import org.json.JSONObject

/** Compare-and-swap rule for neural snapshots: the stored state must still be [expected] (null = none stored). */
internal fun neuralSnapshotUnchanged(current: ByteArray?, expected: ByteArray?): Boolean =
    if (current == null) expected == null else expected != null && current.contentEquals(expected)

/** Explicit, bounded app-private feedback and facts, never an autonomous memory promotion. */
class BootstrapMemoryStore(context: Context) {
    private val prefs = context.getSharedPreferences("device_ai_bootstrap_v1", Context.MODE_PRIVATE)

    fun facts(): List<String> = prefs.getStringSet("facts", emptySet())
        .orEmpty().toList().sorted().take(MAX_FACTS)

    fun addFact(fact: String): Boolean {
        require(fact.length in 3..320)
        val old = facts()
        if (fact in old || old.size >= MAX_FACTS) return false
        return prefs.edit().putStringSet("facts", (old + fact).toSet()).commit()
    }

    @Synchronized fun reviseFact(previous: String, replacement: String?): Boolean {
        val revised = at.heinz.deviceai.learning.KnowledgeRevision.replace(facts(), previous, replacement)
            ?: return false
        return prefs.edit().putStringSet("facts", revised.toSet()).commit()
    }

    fun neuralSnapshot(): ByteArray? = synchronized(NEURAL_LOCK) {
        val encoded = prefs.getString("neural_dialogue_v1", null) ?: return@synchronized null
        require(encoded.length <= 90_000) { "Neuronaler Speicher ist zu groß" }
        java.util.Base64.getDecoder().decode(encoded)
    }

    fun saveNeuralSnapshot(bytes: ByteArray, report: String? = null): Boolean = synchronized(NEURAL_LOCK) {
        at.heinz.deviceai.learning.NeuralDialogue.restore(bytes) // Validate before writing.
        val edit = prefs.edit().putString("neural_dialogue_v1", java.util.Base64.getEncoder().encodeToString(bytes))
        if (report != null) edit.putString("neural_report", report.take(4000))
        edit.commit()
    }

    /**
     * Compare-and-swap: saves only while the stored snapshot is still [expected]
     * (null = nothing stored yet), so background practice and a foreground
     * experiment never overwrite each other's newer weights.
     */
    fun compareAndSaveNeuralSnapshot(expected: ByteArray?, next: ByteArray, report: String?): Boolean =
        synchronized(NEURAL_LOCK) {
            if (!neuralSnapshotUnchanged(neuralSnapshot(), expected)) return@synchronized false
            saveNeuralSnapshot(next, report)
        }

    fun neuralReport(): String = prefs.getString("neural_report", null)
        ?: "Noch kein neuronaler Messlauf."

    fun clearFacts(): Boolean = prefs.edit().remove("facts").commit()

    fun learnedCommands(): Map<String, String> {
        val raw = prefs.getString("trained_commands", "{}") ?: "{}"
        return runCatching {
            val obj = JSONObject(raw)
            obj.keys().asSequence().take(32).mapNotNull { key ->
                val cleaned = BootstrapTraining.normalize(key)
                val tool = obj.optString(key)
                if (cleaned != key || BootstrapTraining.validate(key, tool) == null) null
                else cleaned to tool
            }.take(24).toMap()
        }.getOrDefault(emptyMap())
    }

    fun teach(phrase: String, tool: String): Boolean {
        val approved = BootstrapTraining.validate(phrase, tool) ?: return false
        val old = learnedCommands().toMutableMap()
        if (approved.first !in old && old.size >= 24) return false
        if (old[approved.first] == approved.second) return false
        old[approved.first] = approved.second
        return prefs.edit().putString("trained_commands", JSONObject(old).toString()).commit()
    }

    fun clearTraining(): Boolean = prefs.edit().remove("trained_commands").commit()

    fun recordAssessment(passed: Int, total: Int) {
        require(total > 0 && passed in 0..total)
        prefs.edit().putInt("curriculum_passed", passed)
            .putInt("curriculum_total", total).apply()
    }

    val curriculumPassed: Int get() = prefs.getInt("curriculum_passed", 0)
    val curriculumTotal: Int get() = prefs.getInt("curriculum_total", 0)


    var voiceEnabled: Boolean
        get() = prefs.getBoolean("voice_enabled", false)
        set(value) { prefs.edit().putBoolean("voice_enabled", value).apply() }

    val positiveCount: Int get() = prefs.getInt("positive", 0)
    val negativeCount: Int get() = prefs.getInt("negative", 0)

    /** Only clears feedback counters; preserved facts and model bytes are untouched. */
    fun clearFeedback(): Boolean =
        prefs.edit().remove("positive").remove("negative").commit()

    fun recordFeedback(positive: Boolean) {
        val key = if (positive) "positive" else "negative"
        prefs.edit().putInt(key, (prefs.getInt(key, 0) + 1).coerceAtMost(100_000)).apply()
    }

    companion object {
        const val MAX_FACTS = 32
        private val NEURAL_LOCK = Any()
    }
}
