package at.heinz.deviceai.cognitive

import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap

@JvmInline
value class ComputeNodeId(val value: String) {
    init { require(value.matches(Regex("[A-Za-z0-9._:-]{1,128}"))) { "Invalid compute node id." } }
    override fun toString(): String = value
}

enum class ComputeBackend { CPU, GPU, NPU }
enum class ComputePermission { NONE, READ_ONLY_DATA }
enum class ComputeTaskType {
    REASONING,
    CRITIQUE,
    VERIFY,
    RESEARCH_SYNTHESIS,
    EMBEDDING,
    BENCHMARK
}

data class NodeCapabilityManifest(
    val nodeId: ComputeNodeId,
    val ownerBinding: String,
    val taskTypes: Set<ComputeTaskType>,
    val backends: Set<ComputeBackend>,
    val maxRamMb: Int,
    val maxRuntimeMillis: Long,
    val maxOutputBytes: Int,
    val issuedAtMillis: Long,
    val expiresAtMillis: Long
) {
    init {
        require(ownerBinding.matches(Regex("[A-Za-z0-9._:@/-]{1,256}")))
        require(taskTypes.isNotEmpty() && backends.isNotEmpty())
        require(maxRamMb in 128..1_048_576)
        require(maxRuntimeMillis in 100..3_600_000)
        require(maxOutputBytes in 1..4 * 1024 * 1024)
        require(issuedAtMillis >= 0 && expiresAtMillis > issuedAtMillis)
    }

    fun canonicalBytes(): ByteArray = buildString {
        append(nodeId.value).append('|').append(ownerBinding).append('|')
        append(taskTypes.map { it.name }.sorted().joinToString(",")).append('|')
        append(backends.map { it.name }.sorted().joinToString(",")).append('|')
        append(maxRamMb).append('|').append(maxRuntimeMillis).append('|').append(maxOutputBytes).append('|')
        append(issuedAtMillis).append('|').append(expiresAtMillis)
    }.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8)
}

data class SignedNodeCapabilityManifest(
    val manifest: NodeCapabilityManifest,
    val signature: ByteArray
) {
    init { require(signature.isNotEmpty() && signature.size <= 4_096) }
}

fun interface NodeManifestSignatureVerifier {
    fun verify(envelope: SignedNodeCapabilityManifest): Boolean
}

class ComputeNodeRegistry(
    private val verifier: NodeManifestSignatureVerifier,
    private val nowMillis: () -> Long = System::currentTimeMillis
) {
    private val manifests = ConcurrentHashMap<ComputeNodeId, NodeCapabilityManifest>()
    private val revoked = ConcurrentHashMap.newKeySet<ComputeNodeId>()

    fun register(envelope: SignedNodeCapabilityManifest): NodeCapabilityManifest {
        require(verifier.verify(envelope)) { "Compute node capability signature verification failed." }
        val manifest = envelope.manifest
        require(manifest.expiresAtMillis > nowMillis()) { "Compute node capability manifest is expired." }
        require(manifest.nodeId !in revoked) { "Compute node is revoked." }
        manifests[manifest.nodeId] = manifest
        return manifest
    }

    fun revoke(nodeId: ComputeNodeId) {
        revoked += nodeId
        manifests.remove(nodeId)
    }

    fun isRevoked(nodeId: ComputeNodeId): Boolean = nodeId in revoked

    fun authorized(): List<NodeCapabilityManifest> =
        manifests.values.filter { it.nodeId !in revoked && it.expiresAtMillis > nowMillis() }
            .sortedBy { it.nodeId.value }

    fun get(nodeId: ComputeNodeId): NodeCapabilityManifest? =
        manifests[nodeId]?.takeIf { nodeId !in revoked && it.expiresAtMillis > nowMillis() }
}

data class ComputeTask(
    val taskId: String,
    val type: ComputeTaskType,
    val inputObjectIds: List<ContinuumObjectId>,
    val inlineContext: String,
    val requiredRamMb: Int,
    val requiredBackend: ComputeBackend? = null,
    val maxRuntimeMillis: Long,
    val maxOutputBytes: Int,
    val permission: ComputePermission,
    val deadlineMillis: Long,
    val parentStateRoot: ContinuumObjectId?
) {
    init {
        require(taskId.matches(Regex("[A-Za-z0-9._:-]{1,128}")))
        require(inputObjectIds.size <= 64 && inputObjectIds.distinct().size == inputObjectIds.size)
        // Limit the actual UTF-8 payload; Unicode can require multiple bytes
        // per character and must not bypass the compute-task resource budget.
        require(inlineContext.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8).size <= 16_000)
        require(!containsCredentialLikeMaterial(inlineContext)) {
            "Credential-like material is not permitted in compute tasks."
        }
        require(requiredRamMb in 0..1_048_576)
        require(maxRuntimeMillis in 100..3_600_000)
        require(maxOutputBytes in 1..4 * 1024 * 1024)
        require(deadlineMillis >= 0)
    }
}

class ComputeScheduler(
    private val registry: ComputeNodeRegistry,
    private val nowMillis: () -> Long = System::currentTimeMillis
) {
    fun select(task: ComputeTask): NodeCapabilityManifest? {
        if (task.deadlineMillis <= nowMillis()) return null
        return registry.authorized().asSequence()
            .filter { task.type in it.taskTypes }
            .filter { task.requiredBackend == null || task.requiredBackend in it.backends }
            .filter { task.requiredRamMb <= it.maxRamMb }
            .filter { task.maxRuntimeMillis <= it.maxRuntimeMillis }
            .filter { task.maxOutputBytes <= it.maxOutputBytes }
            .sortedWith(
                compareBy<NodeCapabilityManifest> { it.maxRamMb - task.requiredRamMb }
                    .thenBy { it.nodeId.value }
            )
            .firstOrNull()
    }
}

data class ComputeResult(
    val taskId: String,
    val nodeId: ComputeNodeId,
    val output: String,
    val outputSha256: String,
    val completedAtMillis: Long
) {
    init {
        require(taskId.matches(Regex("[A-Za-z0-9._:-]{1,128}")))
        require(output.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8).size <= 4 * 1024 * 1024)
        require(outputSha256.matches(Regex("[a-f0-9]{64}")))
        require(completedAtMillis >= 0)
    }

    fun verifyHash(): Boolean = sha256Bytes(output.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8)).toHex() == outputSha256

    companion object {
        fun create(taskId: String, nodeId: ComputeNodeId, output: String, completedAtMillis: Long): ComputeResult =
            ComputeResult(
                taskId,
                nodeId,
                output,
                sha256Bytes(output.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8)).toHex(),
                completedAtMillis
            )
    }
}

data class SignedComputeResult(val result: ComputeResult, val signature: ByteArray) {
    init { require(signature.isNotEmpty() && signature.size <= 4_096) }
}

fun interface ComputeResultSignatureVerifier {
    fun verify(envelope: SignedComputeResult): Boolean
}

object ComputeResultValidator {
    fun validate(
        task: ComputeTask,
        envelope: SignedComputeResult,
        registry: ComputeNodeRegistry,
        verifier: ComputeResultSignatureVerifier
    ): Boolean {
        val result = envelope.result
        val node = registry.get(result.nodeId) ?: return false
        if (result.taskId != task.taskId) return false
        if (task.type !in node.taskTypes) return false
        if (!result.verifyHash()) return false
        if (result.output.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8).size > task.maxOutputBytes) return false
        if (result.completedAtMillis > task.deadlineMillis) return false
        return verifier.verify(envelope)
    }
}

fun interface LocalComputeWorker {
    fun execute(task: ComputeTask): ComputeResult
}

private fun containsCredentialLikeMaterial(text: String): Boolean {
    if (text.isBlank()) return false
    val credentialAssignment = Regex(
        "(?i)\\b(password|passwd|token|secret|credential|authorization|api[_-]?key)\\b\\s*[:=]\\s*\\S+"
    )
    val bearer = Regex("(?i)\\bbearer\\s+[A-Za-z0-9._~+/=-]{8,}")
    return credentialAssignment.containsMatchIn(text) || bearer.containsMatchIn(text)
}

    val success: Boolean,
    val supportClaims: Int = 0,
    val citedClaims: Int = 0,

    val invalidToolProposals: Int = 0,

data class ContinuumBenchmarkSummary(
    val totalCases: Int,
    val successRate: Double,
    val citationCoverage: Double,
    val contradictionRecall: Double,
    val invalidToolProposalCount: Int,
    val totalModelCalls: Int,
    val totalLatencyMillis: Long,
    val totalContextBytes: Long,
    val humanCorrectionCount: Int,
    val recoverySuccessRate: Double
) {
    init {
        require(totalCases >= 0)
        require(successRate in 0.0..1.0 && citationCoverage in 0.0..1.0 && contradictionRecall in 0.0..1.0)
        require(recoverySuccessRate in 0.0..1.0)
    }
}

object ContinuumBenchmarkHarness {
    fun run(
        cases: List<ContinuumBenchmarkCase>,
        executor: ContinuumBenchmarkExecutor
    ): Pair<List<ContinuumBenchmarkResult>, ContinuumBenchmarkSummary> {
        require(cases.isNotEmpty() && cases.size <= 10_000)
        require(cases.map { it.id }.distinct().size == cases.size)
        val results = cases.map { ContinuumBenchmarkResult(it, executor.execute(it)) }
        val executions = results.map { it.execution }
        val supports = executions.sumOf { it.supportClaims }
        val cited = executions.sumOf { it.citedClaims }
        val expectedContradictions = executions.sumOf { it.expectedContradictions }
        val detected = executions.sumOf { minOf(it.contradictionsDetected, it.expectedContradictions) }
        val recoveryCases = results.filter { it.case.category == BenchmarkCategory.RECOVERY }
        val summary = ContinuumBenchmarkSummary(
            totalCases = results.size,
            successRate = executions.count { it.success }.toDouble() / results.size,
            citationCoverage = if (supports == 0) 1.0 else cited.toDouble() / supports,
            contradictionRecall = if (expectedContradictions == 0) 1.0 else detected.toDouble() / expectedContradictions,
            invalidToolProposalCount = executions.sumOf { it.invalidToolProposals },
            totalModelCalls = executions.sumOf { it.modelCalls },
            totalLatencyMillis = executions.sumOf { it.latencyMillis },
            totalContextBytes = executions.sumOf { it.contextBytes.toLong() },
            humanCorrectionCount = executions.count { it.humanCorrectionNeeded },
            recoverySuccessRate = if (recoveryCases.isEmpty()) 1.0 else
                recoveryCases.count { it.execution.recoverySuccess }.toDouble() / recoveryCases.size
        )
        return results to summary
    }
}

package at.heinz.deviceai.cognitive

import java.util.Locale

enum class IntelligenceTaskClass {
    GENERAL,
    DEVICE,
    CODE,
    RESEARCH,
    MEMORY,
    PLANNING,
    VERIFICATION
}

data class IntelligenceTaskAssessment(
    val taskClass: IntelligenceTaskClass,
    val capability: ModelCapability,
    val domain: String,
    val complexity: Double,
    val freshnessNeeded: Boolean,
    val expectedToolUse: Boolean,
    val verifyExistingAnswer: Boolean,
    val requestedStrategy: ReasoningStrategy? = null
) {
    init {
        require(domain.isNotBlank())
        require(complexity.isFinite() && complexity in 0.0..1.0)
    }

    fun strategyProfile(): ReasoningTaskProfile = ReasoningTaskProfile(
        ambiguity = complexity,
        factualFreshnessNeeded = freshnessNeeded,
        expectedToolUse = expectedToolUse,
        verifyExistingAnswer = verifyExistingAnswer,
        explicitStrategy = requestedStrategy
    )
}

object ContinuumTaskClassifier {
    private val wordSplitter = Regex("""[^\p{L}\p{N}_]+""")
    private val shortPrefixStems = setOf("prüf")
    private const val EXACT_WORD_MAX_LENGTH = 4

    fun classify(request: String, requestedStrategy: ReasoningStrategy? = null): IntelligenceTaskAssessment {
        require(request.isNotBlank() && request.length <= 16_000)
        val text = request.lowercase(Locale.ROOT)
        val words = text.split(wordSplitter).filter { it.isNotEmpty() }

        val research = containsAny(text, words, "latest", "heute", "aktuell", "news", "quelle", "quellen", "recherch")
        val code = containsAny(text, words, "code", "kotlin", "java", "gradle", "github", "compile", "build", "repository", "repo")
        val device = containsAny(text, words, "android", "shizuku", "akku", "battery", "app", "apk", "speicher", "logcat", "gerät")
        val memory = containsAny(text, words, "erinner", "memory", "gemerkt", "weißt du noch", "vorher")
        val verify = containsAny(text, words, "prüf", "verify", "kontroll", "stimmt das", "gegenprüf")
        val plan = containsAny(text, words, "plan", "schritt", "strategie", "roadmap", "vorgehen")

        val taskClass = when {
            research -> IntelligenceTaskClass.RESEARCH
            code -> IntelligenceTaskClass.CODE
            device -> IntelligenceTaskClass.DEVICE
            memory -> IntelligenceTaskClass.MEMORY
            verify -> IntelligenceTaskClass.VERIFICATION
            plan -> IntelligenceTaskClass.PLANNING
            else -> IntelligenceTaskClass.GENERAL
        }
        val capability = when (taskClass) {
            IntelligenceTaskClass.CODE -> ModelCapability.CODING
            IntelligenceTaskClass.DEVICE -> ModelCapability.ANDROID_DEBUGGING
            IntelligenceTaskClass.RESEARCH -> ModelCapability.RESEARCH
            IntelligenceTaskClass.MEMORY -> ModelCapability.FACTUAL_ACCURACY
            IntelligenceTaskClass.PLANNING -> ModelCapability.PLANNING
            IntelligenceTaskClass.VERIFICATION -> ModelCapability.SOURCE_EVALUATION
            IntelligenceTaskClass.GENERAL -> ModelCapability.FACTUAL_ACCURACY
        }
        val domain = when (taskClass) {
            IntelligenceTaskClass.CODE -> "code"
            IntelligenceTaskClass.DEVICE -> "android"
            IntelligenceTaskClass.RESEARCH -> "research"
            IntelligenceTaskClass.MEMORY -> "personal-memory"
            IntelligenceTaskClass.PLANNING -> "planning"
            IntelligenceTaskClass.VERIFICATION -> "verification"
            IntelligenceTaskClass.GENERAL -> "general"
        }

        var complexity = when {
            request.length >= 4_000 -> 0.9
            request.length >= 1_500 -> 0.75
            request.length >= 600 -> 0.55
            request.length >= 200 -> 0.35
            else -> 0.15
        }
        if (containsAny(text, words, "mehrere", "vergleich", "widerspruch", "constraint", "bedingung", "komplex")) {
            complexity += 0.15
        }
        if (research || verify) complexity += 0.1
        complexity = complexity.coerceIn(0.0, 1.0)

        val expectedToolUse = device && containsAny(
            text, words, "öffne", "starte", "stoppe", "install", "lösche", "suche", "zeige", "prüfe", "finde"
        )

        return IntelligenceTaskAssessment(
            taskClass = taskClass,
            capability = capability,
            domain = domain,
            complexity = complexity,
            freshnessNeeded = research,
            expectedToolUse = expectedToolUse,
            verifyExistingAnswer = verify,
            requestedStrategy = requestedStrategy
        )
    }

    /** Multi-word needles use substring match; short words must match exactly; longer ones as word prefix. */
    private fun containsAny(text: String, words: List<String>, vararg needles: String): Boolean =
        needles.any { needle ->
            when {
                needle.contains(' ') -> text.contains(needle)
                needle in shortPrefixStems -> words.any { it.startsWith(needle) }
                needle.length <= EXACT_WORD_MAX_LENGTH -> words.any { it == needle }
                else -> words.any { it.startsWith(needle) }
            }
        }
}

enum class ReasoningPassRole { CANDIDATE, CRITIC, VERIFIER, JUDGE }

data class ReasoningPassRequest(
    val taskId: String,
    val role: ReasoningPassRole,
    val prompt: String,
    val maxOutputChars: Int,
    val deadlineMillis: Long
) {
    init {
        require(taskId.matches(Regex("[A-Za-z0-9._:-]{1,128}")))
        require(prompt.isNotBlank() && prompt.length <= 24_000)
        require(maxOutputChars in 256..12_000)
        require(deadlineMillis >= 0)
    }
}

data class ReasoningPassResult(
    val modelId: String,
    val text: String,
    val latencyMillis: Long,
    val attemptedToolProposals: Int = 0
) {
    init {
        require(modelId.isNotBlank())
        require(text.isNotBlank() && text.length <= 12_000)
        require(latencyMillis >= 0)
        require(attemptedToolProposals >= 0)
    }
}

fun interface ContinuumReasoningAdapter {
    fun execute(request: ReasoningPassRequest): ReasoningPassResult

    /** Optional cancellation for adapters that wait on an asynchronous local runtime. */
    fun cancel() {}
}

data class ContinuumIntelligenceRequest(
    val taskId: String,
    val userRequest: String,
    val compiledContext: String,
    val requestedStrategy: ReasoningStrategy? = null
) {
    init {
        require(taskId.matches(Regex("[A-Za-z0-9._:-]{1,128}")))
        require(userRequest.isNotBlank() && userRequest.length <= 16_000)
        require(compiledContext.isNotBlank() && compiledContext.length <= 64_000)
    }
}

data class ContinuumIntelligenceResult(
    val assessment: IntelligenceTaskAssessment,
    val strategy: ReasoningStrategy,
    val budget: DeliberationBudget,
    val deliberation: DeliberationResult,
    val modelIds: Set<String>
)

class ContinuumIntelligenceCoordinator(
    private val adapter: ContinuumReasoningAdapter,
    private val nowMillis: () -> Long = System::currentTimeMillis,
    private val nowNanos: () -> Long = System::nanoTime
) {
    fun run(
        request: ContinuumIntelligenceRequest,
        cancellation: DeliberationCancellation = DeliberationCancellation()
    ): ContinuumIntelligenceResult {
        val assessment = ContinuumTaskClassifier.classify(request.userRequest, request.requestedStrategy)
        val strategy = ReasoningStrategySelector.select(assessment.strategyProfile())
        val budget = DeliberationBudget.forStrategy(strategy)
        val modelIds = linkedSetOf<String>()

        fun invoke(role: ReasoningPassRole, prompt: String): String {
            cancellation.throwIfCancelled()
            val result = adapter.execute(
                ReasoningPassRequest(
                    taskId = request.taskId,
                    role = role,
                    prompt = prompt.take(24_000),
                    maxOutputChars = 8_000,
                    deadlineMillis = nowMillis() + budget.maxWallTimeMillis
                )
            )
            require(result.attemptedToolProposals == 0) {
                "Internal Continuum reasoning passes are data-only; tool proposals are rejected."
            }
            modelIds += result.modelId
            return result.text.take(8_000)
        }

        val orchestrator = BoundedDeliberationOrchestrator(
            generator = DeliberationCandidateGenerator { task, index ->
                invoke(ReasoningPassRole.CANDIDATE, candidatePrompt(request.compiledContext, task, index, strategy))
            },
            critic = DeliberationCritic { task, candidate ->
                invoke(ReasoningPassRole.CRITIC, criticPrompt(request.compiledContext, task, candidate))
            },
            verifier = DeliberationVerifier { task, candidate ->
                invoke(ReasoningPassRole.VERIFIER, verifierPrompt(request.compiledContext, task, candidate))
            },
            judge = DeliberationJudge { task, candidates, critiques, verifications ->
                invoke(
                    ReasoningPassRole.JUDGE,
                    judgePrompt(request.compiledContext, task, candidates, critiques, verifications)
                )
            },
            nowNanos = nowNanos
        )

        val deliberation = orchestrator.run(
            task = request.userRequest,
            strategy = strategy,
            budget = budget,
            cancellation = cancellation
        )
        return ContinuumIntelligenceResult(assessment, strategy, budget, deliberation, modelIds)
    }

    private fun candidatePrompt(
        context: String,
        task: String,
        index: Int,
        strategy: ReasoningStrategy
    ): String = buildString {
        append("You are an internal reasoning worker for one persistent assistant.\n")
        append("You have NO tool authority and must not request shell/device actions.\n")
        append("Produce candidate ").append(index + 1).append(" for strategy ").append(strategy.name).append(".\n")
        append("Separate facts, assumptions, uncertainty, and proposed conclusion.\n\n")
        append("CONTEXT:\n").append(context.take(14_000)).append("\n\n")
        append("TASK:\n").append(task.take(7_000))
    }.take(24_000)

    private fun criticPrompt(context: String, task: String, candidate: DeliberationCandidate): String =
        buildString {
            append("You are the skeptical critic in a data-only reasoning pipeline.\n")
            append("Do not execute or request tools. Find factual gaps, unsupported assumptions, ")
            append("internal contradictions, missing constraints, and failure modes.\n\n")
            append("CONTEXT:\n").append(context.take(10_000)).append("\n\n")
            append("TASK:\n").append(task.take(5_000)).append("\n\n")
            append("CANDIDATE:\n").append(candidate.text.take(7_000))
        }.take(24_000)

    private fun verifierPrompt(context: String, task: String, candidate: DeliberationCandidate): String =
        buildString {
            append("You are the verifier in a data-only reasoning pipeline.\n")
            append("Use only evidence present in the supplied context. Do not invent citations, ")
            append("do not browse, and do not request tools. Mark unsupported claims explicitly.\n\n")
            append("CONTEXT:\n").append(context.take(12_000)).append("\n\n")
            append("TASK:\n").append(task.take(4_000)).append("\n\n")
            append("CANDIDATE:\n").append(candidate.text.take(7_000))
        }.take(24_000)

    private fun judgePrompt(
        context: String,
        task: String,
        candidates: List<DeliberationCandidate>,
        critiques: List<DeliberationCritique>,
        verifications: List<DeliberationVerification>
    ): String = buildString {
        append("You are the final judge for one persistent assistant. No tools.\n")
        append("Prefer supported, internally consistent claims and preserve unresolved uncertainty.\n\n")
        append("CONTEXT:\n").append(context.take(8_000)).append("\n\n")
        append("TASK:\n").append(task.take(4_000)).append("\n\n")
        candidates.forEach {
            append("CANDIDATE ").append(it.id).append(":\n").append(it.text.take(3_500)).append("\n\n")
        }
        critiques.forEach {
            append("CRITIQUE ").append(it.candidateId).append(":\n").append(it.text.take(2_000)).append("\n\n")
        }
        verifications.forEach {
            append("VERIFY ").append(it.candidateId).append(":\n").append(it.text.take(2_000)).append("\n\n")
        }
        append("Return one final answer only.")
    }.take(24_000)
}

package at.heinz.deviceai.cognitive

import java.io.ByteArrayInputStream
import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream
import java.io.DataInputStream
import java.io.DataOutputStream
import java.io.IOException
import java.io.File
import java.util.UUID

data class ContinuumStateManifest(
    val generation: Long,
    val instanceId: ContinuumInstanceId,
    val identityGeneration: Int,
    val archiveSha256: String,
    val memoryCount: Int,
    val experienceCount: Int,
    val previousRoot: ContinuumObjectId?,
    val createdAtMillis: Long,
    val schemaVersion: Int = CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION
) {
    init {
        require(generation >= 1)
        require(identityGeneration >= 1)
        require(archiveSha256.matches(Regex("[a-f0-9]{64}")))
        require(memoryCount in 0..10_000 && experienceCount in 0..10_000)
        require((generation == 1L) == (previousRoot == null))
        require(createdAtMillis >= 0)
        require(schemaVersion == CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION)
    }

    companion object {
        const val CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION = 1
    }
}

object ContinuumStateManifestCodec {
    private const val MAGIC = "DEVICE_AI_CONTINUUM_STATE_MANIFEST"
    private const val MAX_BYTES = 16 * 1024

    fun encode(manifest: ContinuumStateManifest): ByteArray {
        val bytes = ByteArrayOutputStream().also { buffer ->
            DataOutputStream(buffer).use { out ->
                out.writeUTF(MAGIC)
                out.writeInt(manifest.schemaVersion)
                out.writeLong(manifest.generation)
                out.writeUTF(manifest.instanceId.value)
                out.writeInt(manifest.identityGeneration)
                out.writeUTF(manifest.archiveSha256)
                out.writeInt(manifest.memoryCount)
                out.writeInt(manifest.experienceCount)
                out.writeBoolean(manifest.previousRoot != null)
                manifest.previousRoot?.let { out.writeUTF(it.value) }
                out.writeLong(manifest.createdAtMillis)
            }
        }.toByteArray()
        require(bytes.size <= MAX_BYTES)
        return bytes
    }

    fun decode(bytes: ByteArray): ContinuumStateManifest = try {
        require(bytes.size in 1..MAX_BYTES)
        val input = DataInputStream(ByteArrayInputStream(bytes))
        require(input.readUTF() == MAGIC) { "Unrecognized Continuum state manifest." }
        val schema = input.readInt()
        require(schema == ContinuumStateManifest.CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION) {
            "Unsupported Continuum state manifest schema."
        }
        val manifest = ContinuumStateManifest(
            generation = input.readLong(),
            instanceId = ContinuumInstanceId(input.readUTF()),
            identityGeneration = input.readInt(),
            archiveSha256 = input.readUTF(),
            memoryCount = input.readInt(),
            experienceCount = input.readInt(),
            previousRoot = if (input.readBoolean()) ContinuumObjectId(input.readUTF()) else null,
            createdAtMillis = input.readLong(),
            schemaVersion = schema
        )
        require(input.available() == 0) { "Unexpected trailing Continuum state-manifest data." }
        manifest
    } catch (e: IOException) {
        throw IllegalArgumentException("Corrupted Continuum state manifest.", e)
    }
}

data class ContinuumRuntimeState(
    val seed: ContinuumSeed,
    val archive: CognitiveArchive,
    val manifest: ContinuumStateManifest,
    val seedLoadSource: ContinuumSeedLoadSource,
    val archiveLoadSource: ArchiveLoadSource
)

class ContinuumRuntimeStore(
    baseDirectory: File,
    private val signer: IdentitySigner,
    private val ownerIdentityReference: String = "android-keystore:device-ai-identity-signing-key",
    private val localNodeId: ComputeNodeId = ComputeNodeId("android-local"),
    private val nowMillis: () -> Long = System::currentTimeMillis,
    private val instanceIdFactory: () -> ContinuumInstanceId = {
        ContinuumInstanceId("continuum-" + UUID.randomUUID().toString().replace("-", ""))
    }
) {
    private val seedStore = FileContinuumSeedStore(File(baseDirectory, "seed"), signer)
    private val objectStore = FileContinuumObjectStore(File(baseDirectory, "objects"))
    private val cognitiveDirectory = File(baseDirectory, "cognitive")

    init {
        require(ownerIdentityReference.matches(Regex("[A-Za-z0-9._:@/-]{1,256}")))
    }

    @Synchronized
    fun openOrCreate(): ContinuumRuntimeState {
        val loadedSeed = seedStore.load()
        if (loadedSeed == null) {
            require(!seedStore.hasStoredState()) {
                "Continuum seed files exist but neither primary nor LKG is valid."
            }
            return createGenesis()
        }

        val seed = loadedSeed.seed
        val storedManifest = objectStore.get(seed.currentStateRoot)
            ?: error("Continuum state root is missing; recovery from a configured replica is required.")
        require(storedManifest.metadata.type == ContinuumObjectType.STATE_MANIFEST) {
            "Continuum state root does not reference a state manifest."
        }
        val manifest = ContinuumStateManifestCodec.decode(storedManifest.payload)
        require(manifest.instanceId == seed.instanceId) { "Continuum seed/state identity mismatch." }

        val archiveStore = CognitiveArchiveStore(cognitiveDirectory, seed.instanceId.value)
        val matching = archiveStore.loadCandidates().firstOrNull { candidate ->
            candidate.archive.identityGeneration == manifest.identityGeneration &&
                archiveHash(archiveStore, candidate.archive) == manifest.archiveSha256
        } ?: error("No cognitive archive matches the signed Continuum state root.")

        require(matching.archive.memories.size == manifest.memoryCount)
        require(matching.archive.experiences.size == manifest.experienceCount)

        return ContinuumRuntimeState(
            seed = seed,
            archive = matching.archive,
            manifest = manifest,
            seedLoadSource = loadedSeed.source,
            archiveLoadSource = matching.source
        )
    }

    @Synchronized
    fun checkpoint(
        current: ContinuumRuntimeState,
        identityState: IdentityState = current.archive.identityState,
        genome: CognitiveGenome = current.archive.genome,
        memories: List<MemoryRecord> = current.archive.memories,
        experiences: List<Experience> = current.archive.experiences
    ): ContinuumRuntimeState {
        require(current.seed.instanceId.value == identityState.identityId)
        require(genome.identityId == identityState.identityId)
        val archive = CognitiveArchive(identityState, genome, memories, experiences)
        val archiveStore = CognitiveArchiveStore(cognitiveDirectory, current.seed.instanceId.value)

        archiveStore.save(archive)
        val manifest = ContinuumStateManifest(
            generation = current.manifest.generation + 1,
            instanceId = current.seed.instanceId,
            identityGeneration = archive.identityGeneration,
            archiveSha256 = archiveHash(archiveStore, archive),
            memoryCount = archive.memories.size,
            experienceCount = archive.experiences.size,
            previousRoot = current.seed.currentStateRoot,
            createdAtMillis = nowMillis()
        )
        val manifestMetadata = objectStore.put(
            ContinuumObjectType.STATE_MANIFEST,
            ContinuumStateManifestCodec.encode(manifest),
            manifest.createdAtMillis
        )
        val seed = current.seed.copy(currentStateRoot = manifestMetadata.id)
        seedStore.save(seed)

        return ContinuumRuntimeState(
            seed = seed,
            archive = archive,
            manifest = manifest,
            seedLoadSource = ContinuumSeedLoadSource.PRIMARY,
            archiveLoadSource = ArchiveLoadSource.PRIMARY
        )
    }

    private fun createGenesis(): ContinuumRuntimeState {
        require(!cognitiveDirectory.exists() || cognitiveDirectory.listFiles().orEmpty().isEmpty()) {
            "Orphaned cognitive state exists without a valid Continuum seed."
        }

        val id = instanceIdFactory()
        val genome = CognitiveGenome(id.value)
        val identity = IdentityState.initial(genome)
        val archive = CognitiveArchive(identity, genome)
        val archiveStore = CognitiveArchiveStore(cognitiveDirectory, id.value)
        archiveStore.save(archive)

        val manifest = ContinuumStateManifest(
            generation = 1,
            instanceId = id,
            identityGeneration = archive.identityGeneration,
            archiveSha256 = archiveHash(archiveStore, archive),
            memoryCount = 0,
            experienceCount = 0,
            previousRoot = null,
            createdAtMillis = nowMillis()
        )
        val metadata = objectStore.put(
            ContinuumObjectType.STATE_MANIFEST,
            ContinuumStateManifestCodec.encode(manifest),
            manifest.createdAtMillis
        )
        val seed = ContinuumSeed(
            instanceId = id,
            governanceVersion = GovernanceVersion(1),
            stateFormatVersion = StateFormatVersion(1),
            memorySchemaVersion = 1,
            skillSchemaVersion = 1,
            modelAdapterAbiVersion = ModelAdapterAbiVersion(1),
            ownerIdentityReference = ownerIdentityReference,
            authorizedNodeIds = listOf(localNodeId),
            currentStateRoot = metadata.id,
            createdAtMillis = manifest.createdAtMillis
        )
        seedStore.save(seed)
        return ContinuumRuntimeState(
            seed = seed,
            archive = archive,
            manifest = manifest,
            seedLoadSource = ContinuumSeedLoadSource.PRIMARY,
            archiveLoadSource = ArchiveLoadSource.PRIMARY
        )
    }

    private fun archiveHash(store: CognitiveArchiveStore, archive: CognitiveArchive): String =
        sha256Bytes(store.export(archive).toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8)).toHex()
}

package at.heinz.deviceai.cognitive

import java.io.ByteArrayInputStream
import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream
import java.io.DataInputStream
import java.io.DataOutputStream
import java.io.IOException
import java.security.MessageDigest

@JvmInline
value class ContinuumInstanceId(val value: String) {
    init { require(value.matches(Regex("[A-Za-z0-9._:-]{1,128}"))) { "Invalid continuum instance id." } }
    override fun toString(): String = value
}

@JvmInline
value class GovernanceVersion(val value: Int) {
    init { require(value in 1..10_000) }
}

@JvmInline
value class StateFormatVersion(val value: Int) {
    init { require(value in 1..10_000) }
}

@JvmInline
value class ModelAdapterAbiVersion(val value: Int) {
    init { require(value in 1..10_000) }
}

data class ContinuumSeed(
    val instanceId: ContinuumInstanceId,
    val governanceVersion: GovernanceVersion,
    val stateFormatVersion: StateFormatVersion,
    val memorySchemaVersion: Int,
    val skillSchemaVersion: Int,
    val modelAdapterAbiVersion: ModelAdapterAbiVersion,
    val ownerIdentityReference: String,
    val authorizedNodeIds: List<ComputeNodeId>,
    val currentStateRoot: ContinuumObjectId,
    val migrationHistoryReferences: List<String> = emptyList(),
    val createdAtMillis: Long,
    val schemaVersion: Int = CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION
) {
    init {
        require(memorySchemaVersion in 1..10_000 && skillSchemaVersion in 1..10_000)
        require(ownerIdentityReference.matches(Regex("[A-Za-z0-9._:@/-]{1,256}")))
        require(authorizedNodeIds.size <= MAX_AUTHORIZED_NODES)
        require(authorizedNodeIds.distinct().size == authorizedNodeIds.size)
        require(migrationHistoryReferences.size <= MAX_MIGRATIONS)
        require(migrationHistoryReferences.all { it.matches(Regex("[A-Za-z0-9._:/-]{1,256}")) })
        require(createdAtMillis >= 0)
        require(schemaVersion in 1..10_000)
    }

    fun contentHash(): String = sha256Bytes(ContinuumSeedCodec.encodePayload(this)).toHex()

    companion object {
        const val CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION = 1
        const val SUPPORTED_STATE_FORMAT_VERSION = 1
        const val SUPPORTED_MODEL_ADAPTER_ABI = 1
        private const val MAX_AUTHORIZED_NODES = 64
        private const val MAX_MIGRATIONS = 256
    }
}

data class SignedContinuumSeed(
    val payload: ByteArray,
    val signature: ByteArray
) {
    init {
        require(payload.isNotEmpty() && payload.size <= MAX_PAYLOAD_BYTES)
        require(signature.isNotEmpty() && signature.size <= MAX_SIGNATURE_BYTES)
    }

    companion object {
        const val MAX_PAYLOAD_BYTES = 64 * 1024
        const val MAX_SIGNATURE_BYTES = 4 * 1024
    }
}

object ContinuumSeedCodec {
    private const val MAGIC = "DEVICE_AI_CONTINUUM_SEED"
    private const val ENVELOPE_SCHEMA = 1
    private const val MAX_STRING_BYTES = 4 * 1024

    fun seal(seed: ContinuumSeed, signer: IdentitySigner): SignedContinuumSeed {
        requireSupported(seed)
        val payload = encodePayload(seed)
        return SignedContinuumSeed(payload, signer.sign(payload))
    }

    fun open(envelope: SignedContinuumSeed, signer: IdentitySigner): ContinuumSeed {
        require(signer.verify(envelope.payload, envelope.signature)) {
            "Continuum seed signature verification failed."
        }
        return decodePayload(envelope.payload).also(::requireSupported)
    }

    fun encodeEnvelope(envelope: SignedContinuumSeed): ByteArray {
        val bytes = ByteArrayOutputStream().also { buffer ->
            DataOutputStream(buffer).use { out ->
                out.writeUTF(MAGIC)
                out.writeInt(ENVELOPE_SCHEMA)
                out.writeInt(envelope.payload.size)
                out.write(envelope.payload)
                out.writeInt(envelope.signature.size)
                out.write(envelope.signature)
                out.write(sha256Bytes(envelope.payload + envelope.signature))
            }
        }.toByteArray()
        require(bytes.size <= SignedContinuumSeed.MAX_PAYLOAD_BYTES + SignedContinuumSeed.MAX_SIGNATURE_BYTES + 256)
        return bytes
    }

    fun decodeEnvelope(bytes: ByteArray): SignedContinuumSeed = try {
        require(bytes.size in 1..(SignedContinuumSeed.MAX_PAYLOAD_BYTES + SignedContinuumSeed.MAX_SIGNATURE_BYTES + 256))
        val input = DataInputStream(ByteArrayInputStream(bytes))
        require(input.readUTF() == MAGIC) { "Unrecognized Continuum seed envelope." }
        require(input.readInt() == ENVELOPE_SCHEMA) { "Unsupported Continuum seed envelope schema." }
        val payloadSize = input.readInt()
        require(payloadSize in 1..SignedContinuumSeed.MAX_PAYLOAD_BYTES && payloadSize <= input.available())
        val payload = ByteArray(payloadSize)
        input.readFully(payload)
        val signatureSize = input.readInt()
        require(signatureSize in 1..SignedContinuumSeed.MAX_SIGNATURE_BYTES && signatureSize <= input.available() - 32)
        val signature = ByteArray(signatureSize)
        input.readFully(signature)
        val checksum = ByteArray(32)
        input.readFully(checksum)
        require(input.available() == 0) { "Unexpected trailing Continuum seed data." }
        require(MessageDigest.isEqual(checksum, sha256Bytes(payload + signature))) {
            "Continuum seed envelope integrity check failed."
        }
        SignedContinuumSeed(payload, signature)
    } catch (e: IOException) {
        throw IllegalArgumentException("Corrupted Continuum seed envelope.", e)
    }

    internal fun encodePayload(seed: ContinuumSeed): ByteArray =
        ByteArrayOutputStream().also { buffer ->
            DataOutputStream(buffer).use { out ->
                out.writeInt(seed.schemaVersion)
                out.writeBoundedString(seed.instanceId.value)
                out.writeInt(seed.governanceVersion.value)
                out.writeInt(seed.stateFormatVersion.value)
                out.writeInt(seed.memorySchemaVersion)
                out.writeInt(seed.skillSchemaVersion)
                out.writeInt(seed.modelAdapterAbiVersion.value)
                out.writeBoundedString(seed.ownerIdentityReference)
                val nodes = seed.authorizedNodeIds.map { it.value }.sorted()
                out.writeInt(nodes.size)
                nodes.forEach { out.writeBoundedString(it) }
                out.writeBoundedString(seed.currentStateRoot.value)
                val migrations = seed.migrationHistoryReferences.sorted()
                out.writeInt(migrations.size)
                migrations.forEach { out.writeBoundedString(it) }
                out.writeLong(seed.createdAtMillis)
            }
        }.toByteArray().also {
            require(it.size <= SignedContinuumSeed.MAX_PAYLOAD_BYTES) { "Continuum seed payload is too large." }
        }

    internal fun decodePayload(bytes: ByteArray): ContinuumSeed = try {
        require(bytes.size in 1..SignedContinuumSeed.MAX_PAYLOAD_BYTES)
        val input = DataInputStream(ByteArrayInputStream(bytes))
        val schema = input.readInt()
        val instanceId = ContinuumInstanceId(input.readBoundedString())
        val governance = GovernanceVersion(input.readInt())
        val stateFormat = StateFormatVersion(input.readInt())
        val memorySchema = input.readInt()
        val skillSchema = input.readInt()
        val abi = ModelAdapterAbiVersion(input.readInt())
        val owner = input.readBoundedString()
        val nodeCount = input.readInt()
        require(nodeCount in 0..64)
        val nodes = List(nodeCount) { ComputeNodeId(input.readBoundedString()) }
        val stateRoot = ContinuumObjectId(input.readBoundedString())
        val migrationCount = input.readInt()
        require(migrationCount in 0..256)
        val migrations = List(migrationCount) { input.readBoundedString() }
        val created = input.readLong()
        require(input.available() == 0) { "Unexpected trailing Continuum seed payload." }
        ContinuumSeed(
            instanceId, governance, stateFormat, memorySchema, skillSchema, abi,
            owner, nodes, stateRoot, migrations, created, schema
        )
    } catch (e: IOException) {
        throw IllegalArgumentException("Corrupted Continuum seed payload.", e)
    }

    private fun requireSupported(seed: ContinuumSeed) {
        require(seed.schemaVersion == ContinuumSeed.CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION) { "Unsupported Continuum seed schema." }
        require(seed.stateFormatVersion.value <= ContinuumSeed.SUPPORTED_STATE_FORMAT_VERSION) {
            "Unsupported future Continuum state format."
        }
        require(seed.modelAdapterAbiVersion.value <= ContinuumSeed.SUPPORTED_MODEL_ADAPTER_ABI) {
            "Unsupported future model adapter ABI."
        }
    }

    private fun DataOutputStream.writeBoundedString(value: String) {
        val bytes = value.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8)
        require(bytes.size <= MAX_STRING_BYTES)
        writeInt(bytes.size)
        write(bytes)
    }

    private fun DataInputStream.readBoundedString(): String {
        val size = readInt()
        require(size in 0..MAX_STRING_BYTES && size <= available())
        val bytes = ByteArray(size)
        readFully(bytes)
        return bytes.toString(Charsets.UTF_8)
    }
}

internal fun sha256Bytes(bytes: ByteArray): ByteArray =
    MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256").digest(bytes)

internal fun ByteArray.toHex(): String = joinToString("") { "%02x".format(it) }

package at.heinz.deviceai.cognitive

import java.io.File
import java.io.FileOutputStream
import java.io.IOException
import java.nio.file.AtomicMoveNotSupportedException
import java.nio.file.Files
import java.nio.file.StandardCopyOption

enum class ContinuumSeedLoadSource { PRIMARY, LAST_KNOWN_GOOD }

data class ContinuumSeedLoadResult(
    val seed: ContinuumSeed,
    val source: ContinuumSeedLoadSource
)

class FileContinuumSeedStore(
    private val directory: File,
    private val signer: IdentitySigner
) {
    private val primary = File(directory, PRIMARY_FILE)
    private val backup = File(directory, BACKUP_FILE)

    @Synchronized
    fun save(seed: ContinuumSeed) {
        val encoded = ContinuumSeedCodec.encodeEnvelope(ContinuumSeedCodec.seal(seed, signer))
        require(encoded.size <= MAX_SEED_FILE_BYTES)
        if (!directory.exists() && !directory.mkdirs()) {
            throw IOException("Cannot create Continuum seed directory.")
        }

        if (primary.isFile) {
            val current = runCatching { readValidated(primary) }.getOrNull()
            if (current != null) {
                writeAtomically(backup, primary.readBytes())
            }
        }
        writeAtomically(primary, encoded)
    }

    @Synchronized
    fun load(): ContinuumSeedLoadResult? {
        if (primary.isFile) {
            runCatching { readValidated(primary) }.getOrNull()?.let {
                return ContinuumSeedLoadResult(it, ContinuumSeedLoadSource.PRIMARY)
            }
        }
        if (backup.isFile) {
            runCatching { readValidated(backup) }.getOrNull()?.let {
                return ContinuumSeedLoadResult(it, ContinuumSeedLoadSource.LAST_KNOWN_GOOD)
            }
        }
        return null
    }

    @Synchronized
    fun requireLoad(): ContinuumSeedLoadResult =
        load() ?: error("No valid Continuum seed is available.")

    @Synchronized
    fun hasStoredState(): Boolean = primary.isFile || backup.isFile

    private fun readValidated(file: File): ContinuumSeed {
        require(file.length() in 1..MAX_SEED_FILE_BYTES.toLong()) { "Invalid Continuum seed file size." }
        val envelope = ContinuumSeedCodec.decodeEnvelope(file.readBytes())
        return ContinuumSeedCodec.open(envelope, signer)
    }

    private fun writeAtomically(target: File, bytes: ByteArray) {
        require(bytes.size in 1..MAX_SEED_FILE_BYTES)
        val temp = File.createTempFile("continuum-seed-", ".tmp", directory)
        try {
            FileOutputStream(temp).use { output ->
                output.write(bytes)
                output.fd.sync()
            }
            try {
                Files.move(
                    temp.toPath(),
                    target.toPath(),
                    StandardCopyOption.ATOMIC_MOVE,
                    StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING
                )
            } catch (_: AtomicMoveNotSupportedException) {
                Files.move(temp.toPath(), target.toPath(), StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING)
            }
        } finally {
            temp.delete()
        }
    }

    companion object {
        private const val PRIMARY_FILE = "continuum-seed.bin"
        private const val BACKUP_FILE = "continuum-seed.lkg"
        private const val MAX_SEED_FILE_BYTES = 72 * 1024
    }
}

package at.heinz.deviceai.cognitive

import java.io.ByteArrayInputStream
import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream
import java.io.DataInputStream
import java.io.DataOutputStream
import java.io.File
import java.io.FileOutputStream

import java.nio.file.AtomicMoveNotSupportedException

@JvmInline
value class ContinuumObjectId(val value: String) {
    init { require(value.matches(Regex("[a-f0-9]{64}"))) { "Invalid Continuum object id." } }
    override fun toString(): String = value

    companion object {
        fun of(type: ContinuumObjectType, payload: ByteArray): ContinuumObjectId {
            require(payload.isNotEmpty())
            return ContinuumObjectId(
                sha256Bytes(type.name.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8) + byteArrayOf(0) + payload).toHex()
            )
        }
    }
}

enum class ContinuumObjectType {
    IDENTITY_SNAPSHOT,
    MEMORY_BLOCK,
    EXPERIENCE_BLOCK,
    KNOWLEDGE_GRAPH_SEGMENT,
    RESEARCH_DOSSIER,
    SKILL_PACKAGE,
    MODEL_REPUTATION_SNAPSHOT,
    TASK_CHECKPOINT,
    MIGRATION_RECORD,
    STATE_MANIFEST,
    CACHE
}

data class ContinuumObjectMetadata(
    val id: ContinuumObjectId,
    val type: ContinuumObjectType,
    val createdAtMillis: Long,
    val payloadBytes: Int
) {
    init { require(createdAtMillis >= 0 && payloadBytes in 1..MAX_OBJECT_BYTES) }

    companion object { const val MAX_OBJECT_BYTES = 2 * 1024 * 1024 }
}

data class StoredContinuumObject(
    val metadata: ContinuumObjectMetadata,
    val payload: ByteArray
) {
    init { require(payload.size == metadata.payloadBytes) }
}

data class ContinuumStateRoot(
    val generation: Long,
    val rootObjectId: ContinuumObjectId,
    val previousRootObjectId: ContinuumObjectId?,
    val createdAtMillis: Long
) {
    init {
        require(generation >= 1 && createdAtMillis >= 0)
        require((generation == 1L) == (previousRootObjectId == null))
    }

    fun canonical(): String =
        generation.toString() + "|" + rootObjectId.value + "|" +
            (previousRootObjectId?.value ?: "") + "|" + createdAtMillis
}

interface ContinuumObjectStore {
    fun put(
        type: ContinuumObjectType,
        payload: ByteArray,
        createdAtMillis: Long = System.currentTimeMillis()
    ): ContinuumObjectMetadata

    fun get(id: ContinuumObjectId): StoredContinuumObject?
    fun contains(id: ContinuumObjectId): Boolean = get(id) != null
    fun totalStoredBytes(): Long
}

interface ContinuumReplicaStore {
    val storeId: String
    fun hasObject(id: ContinuumObjectId): Boolean
    fun readObject(id: ContinuumObjectId): ByteArray?
    fun writeObject(type: ContinuumObjectType, payload: ByteArray): ContinuumObjectId
}

class FileContinuumObjectStore(
    private val directory: File,
    private val maxObjectBytes: Int = ContinuumObjectMetadata.MAX_OBJECT_BYTES,
    private val maxStoreBytes: Long = 64L * 1024 * 1024
) : ContinuumObjectStore {
    init {
        require(maxObjectBytes in 1..ContinuumObjectMetadata.MAX_OBJECT_BYTES)
        require(maxStoreBytes in maxObjectBytes.toLong()..512L * 1024 * 1024)
    }

    @Synchronized
    override fun put(type: ContinuumObjectType, payload: ByteArray, createdAtMillis: Long): ContinuumObjectMetadata {
        require(payload.isNotEmpty() && payload.size <= maxObjectBytes)
        require(createdAtMillis >= 0)
        val id = ContinuumObjectId.of(type, payload)
        if (!directory.exists() && !directory.mkdirs()) throw IOException("Cannot create Continuum object directory.")
        val target = objectFile(id)
        if (target.exists()) {
            val existing = readValidated(target)
            require(existing.metadata.type == type && existing.payload.contentEquals(payload)) {
                "Content-addressed object collision or corruption."
            }
            return existing.metadata
        }

        val encoded = encode(type, createdAtMillis, payload)
        require(totalStoredBytes() <= maxStoreBytes - encoded.size) { "Continuum object store capacity exceeded." }
        val temp = File.createTempFile("continuum-object-", ".tmp", directory)
        try {
            FileOutputStream(temp).use { output ->
                output.write(encoded)
                output.fd.sync()
            }
            try {
                Files.move(temp.toPath(), target.toPath(), StandardCopyOption.ATOMIC_MOVE)
            } catch (_: AtomicMoveNotSupportedException) {
                if (!target.exists()) Files.move(temp.toPath(), target.toPath())
            }
        } finally {
            temp.delete()
        }
        return readValidated(target).metadata
    }

    @Synchronized
    override fun get(id: ContinuumObjectId): StoredContinuumObject? {
        val file = objectFile(id)
        if (!file.isFile) return null
        return readValidated(file).also {
            require(it.metadata.id == id) { "Continuum object filename/content mismatch." }
        }
    }

    @Synchronized
    override fun totalStoredBytes(): Long =
        directory.listFiles { file -> file.isFile && file.name.matches(Regex("[a-f0-9]{64}\\.obj")) }
            .orEmpty().sumOf(File::length)

    private fun objectFile(id: ContinuumObjectId): File = File(directory, id.value + ".obj")

    private fun encode(type: ContinuumObjectType, createdAtMillis: Long, payload: ByteArray): ByteArray {
        val body = ByteArrayOutputStream().also { buffer ->
            DataOutputStream(buffer).use { out ->
                out.writeInt(type.ordinal)
                out.writeLong(createdAtMillis)
                out.writeInt(payload.size)
                out.write(payload)
            }
        }.toByteArray()
        return ByteArrayOutputStream().also { buffer ->
            DataOutputStream(buffer).use { out ->
                out.writeUTF(MAGIC)
                out.writeInt(SCHEMA_VERSION)
                out.writeInt(body.size)
                out.write(body)
                out.write(sha256Bytes(body))
            }
        }.toByteArray()
    }

    private fun readValidated(file: File): StoredContinuumObject = try {
        require(file.length() in 1..(maxObjectBytes + 256).toLong()) { "Invalid Continuum object file size." }
        val input = DataInputStream(ByteArrayInputStream(file.readBytes()))
        require(input.readUTF() == MAGIC) { "Unrecognized Continuum object." }
        require(input.readInt() == SCHEMA_VERSION) { "Unsupported Continuum object schema." }
        val bodySize = input.readInt()
        require(bodySize in 1..(maxObjectBytes + 32) && bodySize <= input.available() - 32)
        val body = ByteArray(bodySize)
        input.readFully(body)
        val checksum = ByteArray(32)
        input.readFully(checksum)
        require(input.available() == 0 && MessageDigest.isEqual(checksum, sha256Bytes(body))) {
            "Continuum object integrity check failed."
        }
        val data = DataInputStream(ByteArrayInputStream(body))
        val type = ContinuumObjectType.values().getOrNull(data.readInt())
            ?: throw IllegalArgumentException("Unknown Continuum object type.")
        val createdAt = data.readLong()
        val payloadSize = data.readInt()
        require(payloadSize in 1..maxObjectBytes && payloadSize <= data.available())
        val payload = ByteArray(payloadSize)
        data.readFully(payload)
        require(data.available() == 0)
        val id = ContinuumObjectId.of(type, payload)
        StoredContinuumObject(ContinuumObjectMetadata(id, type, createdAt, payload.size), payload)
    } catch (e: IOException) {
        throw IllegalArgumentException("Corrupted Continuum object.", e)
    }

    companion object {
        private const val MAGIC = "DEVICE_AI_CONTINUUM_OBJECT"
        private const val SCHEMA_VERSION = 1
    }
}

package at.heinz.deviceai.cognitive

import java.util.concurrent.CancellationException
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicBoolean

enum class ReasoningStrategy {
    FAST,
    STANDARD,
    DEEP,
    MULTI_CANDIDATE,
    VERIFY_ONLY,
    RESEARCH_BACKED,
    TOOL_PLAN
}

data class DeliberationBudget(
    val maxModelCalls: Int,
    val maxCandidateBranches: Int,
    val maxCriticPasses: Int,
    val maxVerifierPasses: Int,
    val maxResearchRounds: Int,
    val maxContextBytes: Int,
    val maxWallTimeMillis: Long,
    val checkpointEveryCalls: Int
) {
    init {
        require(maxModelCalls in 1..64)
        require(maxCandidateBranches in 1..8)
        require(maxCriticPasses in 0..16)
        require(maxVerifierPasses in 0..16)
        require(maxResearchRounds in 0..3)
        require(maxContextBytes in 1_024..64 * 1024)
        require(maxWallTimeMillis in 250..120_000)
        require(checkpointEveryCalls in 1..maxModelCalls)
    }

    companion object {
        fun forStrategy(strategy: ReasoningStrategy): DeliberationBudget = when (strategy) {
            ReasoningStrategy.FAST -> DeliberationBudget(2, 1, 0, 0, 0, 6_000, 5_000, 1)
            ReasoningStrategy.STANDARD -> DeliberationBudget(5, 1, 1, 1, 0, 10_000, 15_000, 2)
            ReasoningStrategy.DEEP -> DeliberationBudget(12, 3, 3, 2, 0, 16_000, 45_000, 3)
            ReasoningStrategy.MULTI_CANDIDATE -> DeliberationBudget(14, 4, 4, 2, 0, 16_000, 45_000, 3)
            ReasoningStrategy.VERIFY_ONLY -> DeliberationBudget(4, 1, 0, 2, 0, 10_000, 15_000, 2)
            ReasoningStrategy.RESEARCH_BACKED -> DeliberationBudget(12, 2, 2, 2, 3, 16_000, 90_000, 3)
            ReasoningStrategy.TOOL_PLAN -> DeliberationBudget(6, 2, 1, 1, 0, 10_000, 20_000, 2)
        }
    }
}

data class ReasoningTaskProfile(
    val ambiguity: Double = 0.0,
    val factualFreshnessNeeded: Boolean = false,
    val expectedToolUse: Boolean = false,
    val verifyExistingAnswer: Boolean = false,
    val explicitStrategy: ReasoningStrategy? = null
) {
    init { require(ambiguity.isFinite() && ambiguity in 0.0..1.0) }
}

object ReasoningStrategySelector {
    fun select(profile: ReasoningTaskProfile): ReasoningStrategy = when {
        profile.expectedToolUse -> ReasoningStrategy.TOOL_PLAN
        profile.verifyExistingAnswer -> ReasoningStrategy.VERIFY_ONLY
        profile.factualFreshnessNeeded -> ReasoningStrategy.RESEARCH_BACKED
        profile.explicitStrategy != null -> profile.explicitStrategy
        profile.ambiguity >= 0.8 -> ReasoningStrategy.MULTI_CANDIDATE
        profile.ambiguity >= 0.5 -> ReasoningStrategy.DEEP
        profile.ambiguity >= 0.2 -> ReasoningStrategy.STANDARD
        else -> ReasoningStrategy.FAST
    }

    fun boundedUpgrade(
        current: ReasoningStrategy,
        requested: ReasoningStrategy,
        allowed: Set<ReasoningStrategy>
    ): ReasoningStrategy {
        require(current in allowed)
        return if (requested in allowed) requested else current
    }
}

class DeliberationCancellation {
    private val cancelled = AtomicBoolean(false)
    fun cancel() { cancelled.set(true) }
    fun throwIfCancelled() {
        if (cancelled.get()) throw CancellationException("Deliberation cancelled.")
    }
}

data class DeliberationCandidate(val id: String, val text: String) {
    init {
        require(id.matches(Regex("[A-Za-z0-9._:-]{1,128}")))
        require(text.isNotBlank() && text.length <= MAX_PASS_TEXT)
    }
}

data class DeliberationCritique(val candidateId: String, val text: String) {
    init { require(candidateId.isNotBlank() && text.length <= MAX_PASS_TEXT) }
}

data class DeliberationVerification(val candidateId: String, val text: String) {
    init { require(candidateId.isNotBlank() && text.length <= MAX_PASS_TEXT) }
}

data class DeliberationResult(
    val strategy: ReasoningStrategy,
    val finalText: String,
    val candidates: List<DeliberationCandidate>,
    val critiques: List<DeliberationCritique>,
    val verifications: List<DeliberationVerification>,
    val modelCalls: Int
) {
    init {
        require(finalText.isNotBlank() && finalText.length <= MAX_PASS_TEXT)
        require(modelCalls >= 1)
    }
}

fun interface DeliberationCandidateGenerator {
    fun generate(task: String, candidateIndex: Int): String
}

fun interface DeliberationCritic {
    fun critique(task: String, candidate: DeliberationCandidate): String
}

fun interface DeliberationVerifier {
    fun verify(task: String, candidate: DeliberationCandidate): String
}

fun interface DeliberationJudge {
    fun choose(
        task: String,
        candidates: List<DeliberationCandidate>,
        critiques: List<DeliberationCritique>,
        verifications: List<DeliberationVerification>
    ): String
}

class BoundedDeliberationOrchestrator(
    private val generator: DeliberationCandidateGenerator,
    private val critic: DeliberationCritic,
    private val verifier: DeliberationVerifier,
    private val judge: DeliberationJudge,
    private val nowNanos: () -> Long = System::nanoTime
) {
    fun run(
        task: String,
        strategy: ReasoningStrategy,
        budget: DeliberationBudget = DeliberationBudget.forStrategy(strategy),
        cancellation: DeliberationCancellation = DeliberationCancellation(),
        onCheckpoint: (Int) -> Unit = {},
        existingAnswer: String? = null
    ): DeliberationResult {
        require(task.isNotBlank() && task.length <= 8_192)
        require(task.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8).size <= budget.maxContextBytes) {
            "Task exceeds the deliberation context byte budget."
        }
        val started = nowNanos()
        var calls = 0

        fun checkLive() {
            cancellation.throwIfCancelled()
            if (Thread.currentThread().isInterrupted) {
                throw CancellationException("Deliberation interrupted.")
            }
            require(nowNanos() - started < budget.maxWallTimeMillis * 1_000_000L) {
                "Deliberation wall-time budget exceeded."
            }
        }

        fun checkedText(text: String): String {
            require(text.isNotBlank()) { "Empty thinking output." }
            require(text.length <= MAX_PASS_TEXT &&
                text.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8).size <= MAX_PASS_TEXT) {
                "Thinking output limit exceeded; silent truncation is forbidden."
            }
            return text
        }

        fun call(operation: () -> String): String {
            checkLive()
            require(calls < budget.maxModelCalls) {
                "Deliberation model-call budget exceeded."
            }
            calls++
            val result = checkedText(operation())
            checkLive()
            if (calls % budget.checkpointEveryCalls == 0) {
                onCheckpoint(calls)
                checkLive()
            }
            return result
        }

        checkLive()
        val branchCount = when (strategy) {
            ReasoningStrategy.MULTI_CANDIDATE -> minOf(4, budget.maxCandidateBranches)
            ReasoningStrategy.DEEP, ReasoningStrategy.RESEARCH_BACKED ->
                minOf(2, budget.maxCandidateBranches)
            else -> 1
        }
        val candidates = if (strategy == ReasoningStrategy.VERIFY_ONLY) {
            require(budget.maxVerifierPasses > 0) { "VERIFY_ONLY requires a verifier." }
            listOf(DeliberationCandidate("existing-answer", checkedText(
                requireNotNull(existingAnswer) { "VERIFY_ONLY requires an existing answer." }
            )))
        } else {
            (0 until branchCount).map { index ->
                DeliberationCandidate("candidate-$index", call { generator.generate(task, index) })
            }
        }

        val critiques = mutableListOf<DeliberationCritique>()
        candidates.take(budget.maxCriticPasses).forEach { candidate ->
            critiques += DeliberationCritique(candidate.id, call { critic.critique(task, candidate) })
        }
        val verifications = mutableListOf<DeliberationVerification>()
        candidates.take(budget.maxVerifierPasses).forEach { candidate ->
            verifications += DeliberationVerification(candidate.id, call { verifier.verify(task, candidate) })
        }
        val finalText = if (candidates.size == 1 && critiques.isEmpty() && verifications.isEmpty()) {
            candidates.single().text
        } else {
            call { judge.choose(task, candidates, critiques, verifications) }
        }
        checkLive()
        return DeliberationResult(strategy, finalText, candidates, critiques, verifications, calls)
    }
}

private const val MAX_PASS_TEXT = 8_000
