/** Hard ceilings the model can never raise; a caller may only choose smaller values. */
data class DevelopmentLimits(
    val maxModelCalls: Int = HARD_MAX_CALLS,
    val maxDurationMillis: Long = HARD_MAX_DURATION_MILLIS,
    val maxSourceBytes: Int = DEFAULT_SOURCE_BYTES,
    val maxOutputBytesPerCall: Int = DEFAULT_OUTPUT_BYTES,
    val maxCumulativePromptBytes: Int = HARD_MAX_CUMULATIVE_PROMPT_BYTES
) {
    init {
        require(maxModelCalls in 1..HARD_MAX_CALLS)
        require(maxDurationMillis in 1..HARD_MAX_DURATION_MILLIS)
        require(maxSourceBytes in 1..HARD_MAX_SOURCE_BYTES)
        require(maxOutputBytesPerCall in 256..HARD_MAX_OUTPUT_BYTES)
        require(maxCumulativePromptBytes in 1..HARD_MAX_CUMULATIVE_PROMPT_BYTES)
    }

    companion object {
        const val HARD_MAX_CALLS = 4
        const val HARD_MAX_DURATION_MILLIS = 60_000L
        const val HARD_MAX_SOURCE_BYTES = 8_000
        const val DEFAULT_SOURCE_BYTES = 4_000
        const val HARD_MAX_OUTPUT_BYTES = 6_000
        const val DEFAULT_OUTPUT_BYTES = 4_000
        const val HARD_MAX_CUMULATIVE_PROMPT_BYTES = 56_000
        const val MAX_PROMPT_CHARS = 16_000
        const val MAX_GOAL_BYTES = 2_000
        const val MAX_SOURCES = 4
    }
}

/** Relative-path rules shared by source selection and proposed edits. Returns an error or null. */
object DevelopmentPathPolicy {
    private val sensitiveSegments = setOf(".git", ".github", ".gradle", "gradle", "workflows", ".ssh", ".gnupg")
    private val sensitiveFragments = listOf(
        "toolgate", "identity", "governance", "credential", "secret", "keystore", "signing",
        "securetoken", "id_rsa", "id_ed25519", "privatekey", "private_key"
    )
    private val sensitiveNames = setOf(
        "build.gradle", "build.gradle.kts", "settings.gradle", "settings.gradle.kts",
        "gradle.properties", "gradlew", "gradlew.bat", "local.properties", "render.yaml",
        ".env", "dockerfile"
    )
    private val sensitiveExtensions = setOf(".jks", ".keystore", ".pem", ".p12", ".pfx", ".key", ".gpg")

    fun validate(path: String): String? {
        if (path.isEmpty() || path.length > 200) return "Path must be 1..200 characters."
        if (path.startsWith("/")) return "Absolute paths are not allowed."
        if (path.contains('\\')) return "Backslashes are not allowed in paths."
        if (path.any { it.code < 0x20 || it.code == 0x7f }) return "Control characters are not allowed in paths."
        if (path.contains(':')) return "Drive or scheme prefixes are not allowed in paths."
        val segments = path.split('/')
        if (segments.any { it.isEmpty() || it == "." || it == ".." }) return "Path traversal is not allowed."
        val lower = path.lowercase()
        if (segments.any { it.lowercase() in sensitiveSegments }) return "Sensitive location is not allowed in this slice."
        val name = segments.last().lowercase()
        if (name in sensitiveNames || sensitiveExtensions.any { name.endsWith(it) } ||
            sensitiveFragments.any { lower.contains(it) }) {
            return "Sensitive file is not allowed in this slice."
        }
        return null
    }
}

/** Untrusted source text plus its SHA-256; the hash is verified at construction. */
data class SourceSnapshot(val path: String, val content: String, val sha256: String) {
    init {
        DevelopmentPathPolicy.validate(path)?.let { throw IllegalArgumentException("$path: $it") }
        require(content.none { it == '\u0000' }) { "$path: NUL characters are not allowed." }
        require(sha256 == sha256Hex(content)) { "$path: SHA-256 does not match content." }
    }

    companion object {
        fun of(path: String, content: String) = SourceSnapshot(path, content, sha256Hex(content))
    }
}

data class DevelopmentTask(
    val taskId: String,
    val goal: String,
    val sources: List<SourceSnapshot>,
    val limits: DevelopmentLimits = DevelopmentLimits()
) {
    init {
        require(taskId.matches(Regex("[A-Za-z0-9._:-]{1,128}")))
        require(goal.isNotBlank() && utf8Bytes(goal) <= DevelopmentLimits.MAX_GOAL_BYTES) { "Goal is empty or too long." }
        require(sources.isNotEmpty()) { "Select at least one source file." }
        require(sources.size <= DevelopmentLimits.MAX_SOURCES) { "At most ${DevelopmentLimits.MAX_SOURCES} source files." }
        require(sources.map { it.path }.toSet().size == sources.size) { "Duplicate source paths." }
        require(sources.sumOf { utf8Bytes(it.content) } <= limits.maxSourceBytes) {
            "Selected sources exceed ${limits.maxSourceBytes} UTF-8 bytes; select a smaller source set."
        }
    }
}

data class ProposedEdit(
    val path: String,
    val expectedBaseSha256: String,
    val replacement: String,
    val rationale: String
)

enum class FindingSeverity { INFO, WARNING, BLOCKER }
enum class CriticVerdict { ACCEPT, REVISE, REJECT }
enum class JudgeDecision { RECOMMEND, NEEDS_CHANGES, REJECT }

data class CriticResult(val verdict: CriticVerdict, val findings: List<CriticFinding>)

data class TestDesignResult(val tests: List<SuggestedTest>)

/** Capabilities the first slice deliberately does not have; every one is reported as not executed. */
object NotExecuted {
    val items = listOf(
        "Edits applied to any file",
        "Code compiled",
        "Generated tests executed",
        "APK built or installed",
        "Changes pushed to GitHub"
    )
    /** The job is recorded in the development backlog (DeviceDevelopmentBacklog), not the proposal itself. */
    const val RECOVERY = "Job recorded in the development backlog: an app restart mid-job returns it to READY when its lease ends; " +
        "the proposal waits there (VERIFYING) for executed test evidence."
}

data class DevelopmentProposal(
    val taskId: String,
    val summary: String,
    val edits: List<ProposedEdit>,
    val notes: List<String>,
    val critic: CriticResult,
    val suggestedTests: List<SuggestedTest>,
    val judge: JudgeResult,
    val modelIds: Set<String>,
    val modelCalls: Int,
    val patchPreview: String
) {
    fun render(): String = buildString {
        appendLine("DEVELOPMENT PROPOSAL (review only) · task $taskId")
        appendLine("Judge: ${judge.decision} — ${judge.rationale}")
        appendLine("Critic: ${critic.verdict}")
        critic.findings.forEach { appendLine("  [${it.severity}] ${it.message}") }
        appendLine("Summary: $summary")
        notes.forEach { appendLine("  note: $it") }
        appendLine("Suggested tests (NOT EXECUTED, suggestions only):")
        suggestedTests.forEach { appendLine("  - ${it.name}: ${it.description}") }
        appendLine("NOT EXECUTED:")
        NotExecuted.items.forEach { appendLine("  - $it") }
        appendLine(NotExecuted.RECOVERY)
        appendLine("Model calls: $modelCalls · models: ${modelIds.sorted().joinToString()}")
        appendLine()
        append(patchPreview)
    }
}

    val proposal: DevelopmentProposal? = null,
    val failure: DevelopmentFailure? = null,
    val modelCallsUsed: Int = 0

    }
}

package at.heinz.deviceai.cognitive

enum class DevelopmentUiPhase { IDLE, RUNNING, DONE, FAILED, CANCELLED }

data class DevelopmentUiState(
    val phase: DevelopmentUiPhase = DevelopmentUiPhase.IDLE,
    val goal: String = "",
    val sources: List<SourceSnapshot> = emptyList(),
    val status: String = "Idle. Select source text and describe one development task.",
    val preview: String? = null,
    val error: String? = null,
    val sourceImportPending: Boolean = false
) {
    val canEdit: Boolean get() = phase != DevelopmentUiPhase.RUNNING
    val canStart: Boolean get() = canEdit && !sourceImportPending
    val canStop: Boolean get() = phase == DevelopmentUiPhase.RUNNING
    val canExport: Boolean get() = phase == DevelopmentUiPhase.DONE && preview != null && !sourceImportPending
}

/** UI-thread-confined controller; no I/O and no execution capabilities. */
class DevelopmentUiController(private val newTaskId: () -> String) {
    var state = DevelopmentUiState()
        private set

    private fun edited() = state.copy(phase = DevelopmentUiPhase.IDLE, preview = null, error = null,
        status = "Input changed. Start a new review; previous proposal is invalidated.")

    fun setGoal(goal: String) {
        if (state.canEdit && goal != state.goal) state = edited().copy(goal = goal)
    }


    /** Revoke an old proposal immediately while SAF reads are still queued off the UI thread. */
    fun beginSourceImport(): Boolean {
        if (!state.canStart) return false
        state = edited().copy(sourceImportPending = true, status = "Reading selected source files…")
        return true
    }

    fun finishSourceImport() {
        if (!state.sourceImportPending) return
        state = state.copy(sourceImportPending = false,
            status = "Source selection finished. Review the files before starting.")
    }

    fun addSource(path: String, content: String): Boolean {
        if (!state.canEdit) return false
        return try {
            val budget = DevelopmentLimits.DEFAULT_SOURCE_BYTES
            require(utf8Bytes(content) <= budget) { "$path exceeds the $budget-byte source budget; select a smaller file." }
            require(state.sources.sumOf { utf8Bytes(it.content) } <= budget - utf8Bytes(content)) {
                "Selected sources exceed $budget UTF-8 bytes; select a smaller source set."
            }
            val snapshot = SourceSnapshot.of(path, content)
            require(state.sources.none { it.path == path }) { "$path is already selected." }
            require(state.sources.size < DevelopmentLimits.MAX_SOURCES) { "At most ${DevelopmentLimits.MAX_SOURCES} source files." }
            state = edited().copy(sources = state.sources + snapshot)
            true
        } catch (e: IllegalArgumentException) {
            state = state.copy(error = e.message ?: "Source rejected.")
            false
        }
    }

    fun clearSources() {
        if (state.canStart) state = edited().copy(sources = emptyList())
    }

    fun start(modelReady: Boolean): DevelopmentTask? {
        if (!state.canStart) return null
        if (!modelReady) {
            state = state.copy(phase = DevelopmentUiPhase.FAILED, preview = null,
                error = "No local model loaded. Load a local model first; there is no cloud fallback.",
                status = "Failed: no local model.")
            return null
        }
        val task = try {
            DevelopmentTask(newTaskId(), state.goal.trim(), state.sources.toList())
        } catch (e: IllegalArgumentException) {
            state = state.copy(phase = DevelopmentUiPhase.FAILED, preview = null, error = e.message ?: "Invalid task.",
                status = "Failed: invalid task.")
            return null
        }
        state = state.copy(phase = DevelopmentUiPhase.RUNNING, preview = null, error = null, status = "Pending…")
        return task
    }

    fun onJobState(job: DevelopmentJobState) {
        if (state.phase != DevelopmentUiPhase.RUNNING) return
        state = state.copy(status = when (job) {
            DevelopmentJobState.PENDING -> "Pending…"
            DevelopmentJobState.RUNNING_DEVELOPER -> "1/4 Developer drafting proposal…"
            DevelopmentJobState.RUNNING_CRITIC -> "2/4 Critic reviewing…"
            DevelopmentJobState.RUNNING_TEST_DESIGNER -> "3/4 Test designer suggesting tests…"
            DevelopmentJobState.RUNNING_JUDGE -> "4/4 Judge deciding…"
            else -> state.status
        })
    }

    fun stop() {
        if (state.canStop) state = state.copy(status = "Stopping…")
    }

    fun onOutcome(outcome: DevelopmentOutcome) {
        if (state.phase != DevelopmentUiPhase.RUNNING) return
        state = when (outcome.state) {
            DevelopmentJobState.COMPLETED -> state.copy(phase = DevelopmentUiPhase.DONE,
                preview = outcome.proposal!!.render(), error = null,
                status = "Proposal ready for review. Nothing was applied, compiled or tested.")
            DevelopmentJobState.CANCELLED -> state.copy(phase = DevelopmentUiPhase.CANCELLED,
                preview = null, error = null, status = "Stopped by user.")
            else -> state.copy(phase = DevelopmentUiPhase.FAILED, preview = null,
                error = outcome.failure?.let { "${it.kind}: ${it.message}" } ?: outcome.state.name,
                status = if (outcome.state == DevelopmentJobState.TIMED_OUT) "Timed out." else "Failed.")
        }
    }

    fun exportText(): String? = if (state.canExport) state.preview else null
}

FILE 132/375: app/src/main/java/at/heinz/deviceai/cognitive/DeviceDevelopmentBacklog.kt
SHA-256: 1c5ec92e9ce0c6e054811a5fd5fcc19d5d24dc90bcbc5a4e627559a9413dd425

package at.heinz.deviceai.cognitive

import java.io.File

/**
 * The app's side of the shared development backlog ([DevelopmentBacklog]).
 *
 * - Every [DevelopmentCoordinator] job is a backlog task: started = propose,
 *   accept, claim (lease); a finished proposal = submit (artifact PROPOSAL with
 *   the SHA-256 of the rendered proposal) -> VERIFYING; a failed, cancelled or
 *   timed-out job = fail with its reason. The app never produces test
 *   evidence, so app work never reaches DONE on the device.
 * - An interrupted job (app killed) keeps its claim until the lease ends; then
 *   [recover] returns it to READY (or FAILED when its budget is used up).
 * - Human decisions (accept, reject, abort, retry) use the same operations.
 * - Every local operation gets an opId and is journaled in the same atomic
 *   write (`deviceOpLog`), so it can be exported as an exactly-once operation
 *   log for `developer-agent.mjs backlog apply --lenient` and re-applied on top
 *   of an imported canonical backlog without duplicates.
 *
 * File access only; run every method off the UI thread.
 */
class DeviceDevelopmentBacklog(dir: File, private val clock: () -> Long = System::currentTimeMillis) {
    val store = DevelopmentBacklogStore(File(dir, "development-backlog.json"), ACTOR, clock)

    data class Change(
        val doc: Map<String, Any?>,
        val reports: List<DevelopmentBacklog.OpReport>,
        val recovered: DevelopmentBacklogStore.Recovery?
    )

    data class ImportResult(
        val revision: Long, val tasks: Int, val replayed: Int, val alreadyIncluded: Int,
        val rejected: List<String>, val recovered: DevelopmentBacklogStore.Recovery?
    )

    private fun newOpId() = "android:" + DevelopmentBacklog.newToken().take(24)

    @Suppress("UNCHECKED_CAST")
    private fun logOf(doc: Map<String, Any?>): List<Map<String, Any?>> = (doc[LOG] as? List<Map<String, Any?>>).orEmpty()

    /** Same document with [entries] appended to the device operation log (bounded, drops counted). */
    private fun withLog(doc: Map<String, Any?>, entries: List<Map<String, Any?>>): Map<String, Any?> {
        if (entries.isEmpty()) return doc
        val next = LinkedHashMap(doc)
        val log = ArrayList<Any?>(logOf(doc))
        log.addAll(entries)
        var dropped = (doc[LOG_DROPPED] as? Long) ?: 0L
        while (log.size > MAX_LOG) { log.removeAt(0); dropped++ }
        next[LOG] = log
        if (dropped > 0) next[LOG_DROPPED] = dropped
        return next
    }

    /** Apply local operations atomically; only operations that changed state are journaled. */
    fun apply(ops: List<Map<String, Any?>>, stopOnError: Boolean = true): Change {
        val now = clock()
        val stamped = ops.map { op ->
            LinkedHashMap(op).apply {
                putIfAbsent("actor", ACTOR)
                putIfAbsent("at", now)
                putIfAbsent("opId", newOpId())
            }
        }
        var reports: List<DevelopmentBacklog.OpReport> = emptyList()
        val result = store.update { doc ->
            val (next, r) = DevelopmentBacklog.applyOps(doc, stamped, stopOnError)
            reports = r
            withLog(next, stamped.filterIndexed { k, _ -> r[k].ok && r[k].changed })
        }
        return Change(result.doc, reports, result.recovered)
    }

    /** Record the start of a development job; returns the claim token for [finishJob]. */
    fun startJob(task: DevelopmentTask): String {
        val id = taskIdOf(task.taskId)
        val token = DevelopmentBacklog.newToken()
        val subject = linkedMapOf<String, Any?>("sources" to task.sources.size.toLong())
        task.sources.firstOrNull()?.let { subject["firstSource"] = DevelopmentBacklog.singleLine(it.path, 300) }
        apply(listOf(
            mapOf("op" to "propose", "task" to mapOf("id" to id, "title" to DevelopmentBacklog.singleLine(task.goal.trim(), 200).ifEmpty { "Entwicklungsaufgabe" },
                "kind" to "IMPLEMENT", "source" to "android", "priority" to 500L, "maxAttempts" to 3L, "subject" to subject),
                "reason" to "Entwicklungsassistent auf dem Gerät gestartet"),
            mapOf("op" to "accept", "id" to id, "reason" to "vom Nutzer gestartet"),
            mapOf("op" to "claim", "id" to id, "owner" to ACTOR, "token" to token, "leaseMs" to JOB_LEASE_MS)))
        return token
    }

    /** Record the outcome of a job started with [startJob]. */
    fun finishJob(taskId: String, token: String, outcome: DevelopmentOutcome): Change {
        val id = taskIdOf(taskId)
        val op: Map<String, Any?> = if (outcome.state == DevelopmentJobState.COMPLETED) {
            val proposal = outcome.proposal!!.render().toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8)
            mapOf("op" to "submit", "id" to id, "token" to token,
                "artifact" to mapOf("type" to "PROPOSAL", "sha256" to DevelopmentBacklog.sha256Of(proposal)))
        } else {
            val code = when (outcome.state) {
                DevelopmentJobState.CANCELLED -> "CANCELLED"
                DevelopmentJobState.TIMED_OUT -> "TIMED_OUT"
                else -> outcome.failure?.kind?.name ?: "FAILED"
            }
            mapOf("op" to "fail", "id" to id, "token" to token,
                "error" to mapOf("code" to code, "message" to DevelopmentBacklog.singleLine(outcome.failure?.message.orEmpty(), 400)))
        }
        return apply(listOf(op))
    }

    /** Crash recovery: expired claims return to READY (or FAILED when the budget is used up). */
    fun recover(): List<String> = apply(listOf(mapOf("op" to "expire"))).reports.firstOrNull()?.expired.orEmpty()

    /** A human decision on one task: accept, reject, abort or retry (the latter three need a reason). */
    fun decide(id: String, action: String, reason: String?): DevelopmentBacklog.OpReport {
        require(action in setOf("accept", "reject", "abort", "retry")) { "Unknown action $action" }
        val op = linkedMapOf<String, Any?>("op" to action, "id" to id)
        if (!reason.isNullOrBlank()) op["reason"] = DevelopmentBacklog.singleLine(reason.trim(), 400)
        return apply(listOf(op), stopOnError = false).reports.single()
    }

    fun read(): DevelopmentBacklogStore.Loaded = store.read()

    fun views(): List<DevelopmentBacklog.TaskView> = DevelopmentBacklog.views(store.read().doc)

    /** Pending local operations as a JSON array for `developer-agent.mjs backlog apply --ops <file> --lenient`. */
    fun exportOperationLog(): ByteArray = (DevelopmentBacklog.canonical(logOf(store.read().doc)) + "\n").toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8)

    /** The full local backlog in canonical form (integrity hash included). */
    fun exportBacklog(): ByteArray = DevelopmentBacklog.encode(store.read().doc)

    /**
     * Adopt a canonical backlog (e.g. downloaded from the agent state branch) and
     * re-apply the local operations on top of it. Operations the imported backlog
     * already contains (by opId) leave the log; rejected ones stay in the log and
     * are reported. The imported file must verify (integrity, rules) first.
     */
    fun importBacklog(bytes: ByteArray): ImportResult {
        val imported = DevelopmentBacklog.decode(bytes).doc
        var replayed = 0
        var included = 0
        val rejected = ArrayList<String>()
        val result = store.update { current ->
            val pending = logOf(current)
            var doc: Map<String, Any?> = LinkedHashMap(imported).apply { remove(LOG); remove(LOG_DROPPED) }
            val keep = ArrayList<Map<String, Any?>>()
            for (op in pending) {
                try {
                    val r = DevelopmentBacklog.applyOp(doc, op)
                    if (r.duplicate) { included++; continue }
                    doc = r.doc
                    replayed++
                    keep += op
                } catch (e: BacklogException) {
                    rejected += "${op["op"]} ${op["id"] ?: ""}: ${e.code}"
                    keep += op
                }
            }
            val next = LinkedHashMap(withLog(doc, keep))
            // a different lineage may have a lower revision; the local file still only moves forward
            next["revision"] = maxOf(next["revision"] as Long, (current["revision"] as Long) + 1)
            next
        }
        return ImportResult(result.doc["revision"] as Long, (result.doc["tasks"] as List<*>).size, replayed, included, rejected, result.recovered)
    }

    companion object {
        const val ACTOR = "android-app"
        const val LOG = "deviceOpLog"
        const val LOG_DROPPED = "deviceOpLogDropped"
        const val MAX_LOG = 500
        /** Covers the coordinator's hard 60 s budget with margin; an expired lease means the app died mid-job. */
        const val JOB_LEASE_MS = 300_000L

        /** Development job ids ("dev-" + UUID) are already valid backlog ids; anything else is hashed. */
        fun taskIdOf(jobId: String): String {
            val lower = jobId.lowercase()
            return if (Regex("[a-z][a-z0-9-]{2,63}").matches(lower)) lower
            else "dev-" + DevelopmentBacklog.sha256Of(jobId.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8)).take(32)
        }
    }
}

package at.heinz.deviceai.cognitive

import at.heinz.deviceai.ToolRegistry

data class CrystallizedSkillCandidate(
    val candidateId: String,
    val taskType: String,
    val toolNames: List<String>,
    val occurrenceCount: Int,
    val successRate: Double,
    val meanEvaluationScore: Double,
    val sourceExperienceIds: List<String>,
    val requiresOwnerApproval: Boolean = true,
    val promotionBlockedReason: String? = null
) {
    init {
        require(candidateId.matches(Regex("[A-Za-z0-9._:-]{1,128}")))
        require(taskType.isNotBlank())
        require(toolNames.isNotEmpty() && toolNames.size <= 32)
        require(occurrenceCount >= 1)
        require(successRate.isFinite() && successRate in 0.0..1.0)
        require(meanEvaluationScore.isFinite() && meanEvaluationScore in 0.0..1.0)
        require(sourceExperienceIds.size == occurrenceCount)
        require(sourceExperienceIds.none(String::isBlank) && sourceExperienceIds.distinct().size == occurrenceCount) {
            "Skill evidence must identify distinct experiences."
        }
        require(requiresOwnerApproval) { "Skill candidates cannot bypass owner approval." }
    }

    val eligibleForOwnerReview: Boolean get() = promotionBlockedReason == null
}

data class ExperienceCompilerPolicy(
    val minimumOccurrences: Int = 3,
    val minimumSuccessRate: Double = 0.8,
    val minimumMeanEvaluationScore: Double = 0.75
) {
    init {
        require(minimumOccurrences in 2..100)
        require(minimumSuccessRate in 0.0..1.0)
        require(minimumMeanEvaluationScore in 0.0..1.0)
    }
}

class ExperienceCompiler(
    private val policy: ExperienceCompilerPolicy = ExperienceCompilerPolicy()
) {
    fun compile(experiences: Collection<Experience>): List<CrystallizedSkillCandidate> {
        require(experiences.size <= 100_000)
        val unique = linkedMapOf<String, Experience>()
        experiences.forEach { experience ->
            val previous = unique[experience.id]
            if (previous != null && previous != experience) {
                // Check before filtering: an ineligible conflicting record is still an integrity failure.
                throw SecurityException("Conflicting experience identity; skill compilation blocked.")
            }
            unique[experience.id] = experience
        }
        val eligibleExperiences = unique.values.filter {
            it.toolIds.isNotEmpty() &&
                it.toolIds.size <= 32 &&
                it.toolIds.all { tool -> ToolRegistry.get(tool) != null }
        }

        return eligibleExperiences
            .groupBy { experience ->
                experience.taskType.trim().lowercase() + "|" + experience.toolIds.joinToString(">")
            }
            .values
            .mapNotNull { group ->
                if (group.size < policy.minimumOccurrences) return@mapNotNull null
                val successRate = group.count {
                    it.outcome == ExperienceOutcome.SUCCESS && it.evaluation.success
                }.toDouble() / group.size
                val meanScore = group.map { it.evaluation.score }.average()
                if (successRate < policy.minimumSuccessRate ||
                    meanScore < policy.minimumMeanEvaluationScore
                ) return@mapNotNull null

                val tools = group.first().toolIds
                val destructive = tools.filter { ToolRegistry.risk(it).name == "DESTRUCTIVE" }
                val blocked = if (destructive.isNotEmpty()) {
                    "Destructive tool sequence cannot be crystallized automatically: " +
                        destructive.distinct().joinToString(",")
                } else null
                val signature = sha256Bytes(
                    (group.first().taskType.trim().lowercase() + "|" + tools.joinToString(">"))
                        .toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8)
                ).toHex().take(24)
                CrystallizedSkillCandidate(
                    candidateId = "skill-candidate-" + signature,
                    taskType = group.first().taskType,
                    toolNames = tools,
                    occurrenceCount = group.size,
                    successRate = successRate,
                    meanEvaluationScore = meanScore,
                    sourceExperienceIds = group.map { it.id }.sorted(),
                    promotionBlockedReason = blocked
                )
            }
            .sortedWith(
                compareByDescending<CrystallizedSkillCandidate> { it.meanEvaluationScore }
                    .thenByDescending { it.occurrenceCount }
                    .thenBy { it.candidateId }
            )
    }
}

package at.heinz.deviceai.cognitive

import java.net.URI
import java.net.URLEncoder
import java.net.URLDecoder
import org.xml.sax.Attributes
import org.xml.sax.InputSource
import org.xml.sax.helpers.DefaultHandler

/** Public Bing RSS search, with Wikipedia only when search produces no safe result.
 * Every transport shares the research provider's DNS/TLS/redirect/byte bounds.
 * Endpoint availability is not guaranteed; fallback and failures stay visible.
 */
class GeneralWebDiscoveryProvider(
    private val wikipedia:ResearchDiscoveryProvider?=null,
    private val checkAccess:()->Unit={},
    private val fetchHtml:((String)->String)?=null
):ResearchDiscoveryProvider {
    @Volatile private var generalWorked=false
    @Volatile var lastIssue:String?=null
        private set
    override val isGeneralSearchAvailable:Boolean get()=generalWorked
    override fun discover(query:ResearchQuery):List<ResearchSourceCandidate> {
        checkAccess()
        val text=query.text.trim().take(512)
        if(text.isBlank())return emptyList()
        val primary=runCatching {
            checkAccess()
            parseSearchResults(fetchHtml?.invoke(searchUrl(text))?:fetchSearchResponse(searchUrl(text),checkAccess))
        }.getOrElse { lastIssue="Allgemeine Websuche fehlgeschlagen: "+(it.message?:it.javaClass.simpleName).take(160);emptyList() }
        checkAccess()
        if(primary.isNotEmpty()){generalWorked=true;lastIssue=null;return primary}
        lastIssue=lastIssue?:"Allgemeine Websuche lieferte keine verwendbaren Quellen."
        checkAccess()
        return runCatching { (wikipedia?:WikipediaResearchDiscoveryProvider(checkAccess=checkAccess)).discover(query) }
            .getOrElse { lastIssue=lastIssue+" Wikipedia-Fallback ebenfalls fehlgeschlagen.";emptyList() }.take(8)
    }
    companion object {
        fun searchUrl(query:String)="https://www.bing.com/search?format=rss&q="+URLEncoder.encode(query,"UTF-8")
        private fun candidate(url:String,title:String?):ResearchSourceCandidate? {
            val decoded=url.replace("&amp;","&").trim()
            val uri=runCatching { URI(decoded) }.getOrNull()?:return null
            if(runCatching { HttpReadOnlyResearchProvider.ResearchUrlValidator.validateSyntax(uri) }.isFailure)return null
            val host=uri.host.lowercase(java.util.Locale.ROOT).trimEnd('.')
            if(host=="bing.com"||host.endsWith(".bing.com")||host=="duckduckgo.com"||host.endsWith(".duckduckgo.com")||host=="google.com"||host.endsWith(".google.com"))return null
            return ResearchSourceCandidate(decoded,title?.replace(Regex("\\s+")," ")?.take(256),"general-web-search")
        }
        fun parseSearchResults(raw:String):List<ResearchSourceCandidate> {
            require(raw.length<=150000)
            if(raw.contains(Regex("(?i)<rss\\b")))return parseRss(raw)
            val clean=raw.replace(Regex("(?is)<(script|style)\\b[^>]*>.*?</\\1\\s*>")," ")
            val href=Regex("""(?i)\bhref\s*=\s*["']([^"'<>\s]{1,2400})["']""")
            return Regex("""(?is)<a\b([^>]{0,3000})>(.*?)</a\s*>""").findAll(clean).mapNotNull { a->
                if(!Regex("""(?i)\bclass\s*=\s*["'][^"']*\bresult__a\b""").containsMatchIn(a.groupValues[1]))return@mapNotNull null
                var url=href.find(a.groupValues[1])?.groupValues?.get(1)?:return@mapNotNull null
                url=url.replace("&amp;","&")
                if(url.startsWith("//duckduckgo.com/l/"))url="https:"+url
                val wrapped=runCatching { URI(url) }.getOrNull()?:return@mapNotNull null
                if(wrapped.host=="duckduckgo.com"&&wrapped.path=="/l/") {
                    val value=wrapped.rawQuery.orEmpty().split('&').firstOrNull { it.startsWith("uddg=") }?.substringAfter('=')?:return@mapNotNull null
                    url=runCatching { URLDecoder.decode(value,"UTF-8") }.getOrNull()?:return@mapNotNull null
                }
                candidate(url,a.groupValues[2].replace(Regex("<[^>]*>")," "))
            }.distinctBy { it.url }.take(8).toList()
        }
        private fun parseRss(raw:String):List<ResearchSourceCandidate> {
            require(!Regex("(?is)<!\\s*(doctype|entity)\\b").containsMatchIn(raw)) { "Unzulässige Suchantwort-Deklaration" }
            val result=mutableListOf<ResearchSourceCandidate>()
            val factory=SAXParserFactory.newInstance().apply {
                isValidating=false
                for(f in listOf("http://xml.org/sax/features/external-general-entities","http://xml.org/sax/features/external-parameter-entities","http://apache.org/xml/features/nonvalidating/load-external-dtd"))runCatching { setFeature(f,false) }
            }
            var item=false;var field="";var title=StringBuilder();var url=StringBuilder()
            val handler=object:DefaultHandler() {
                override fun startElement(uri:String?,localName:String?,qName:String,attrs:Attributes) {
                    if(qName=="item"){item=true;title=StringBuilder();url=StringBuilder()}
                    field=if(item)qName else ""
                }
                override fun characters(ch:CharArray,start:Int,length:Int) {
                    if(item&&field=="title"&&title.length<1024)title.append(ch,start,minOf(length,1024-title.length))
                    if(item&&field=="link"&&url.length<4096)url.append(ch,start,minOf(length,4096-url.length))
                }
                override fun endElement(uri:String?,localName:String?,qName:String) {
                    if(qName=="item"){if(result.size<8)candidate(url.toString(),title.toString())?.let(result::add);item=false}
                    field=""
                }
            }
            val parser=factory.newSAXParser();parser.xmlReader.entityResolver=org.xml.sax.EntityResolver { _,_->InputSource(StringReader("")) }
            parser.parse(InputSource(StringReader(raw)),handler)
            return result.distinctBy { it.url }.take(8)
        }
        private fun fetchSearchResponse(url:String,check:()->Unit):String {
            check()
            return HttpReadOnlyResearchProvider(ResearchProviderPolicy(maxBytes=150000,maxContentCharacters=100000,totalTimeoutMillis=6500,maxRedirects=1),accessCheck=check)
                .retrieveMarkup(ResearchRequest("public web discovery",url,maxBytes=150000,timeoutMillis=6500,maxRedirects=1)).documents.first().content
        }
    }
}

package at.heinz.deviceai.cognitive

import java.util.Locale

/**
 * Offline retrieval from manually reviewed source notes.
 * This is lexical retrieval, not a neural or generative language model.
 * Neither answers nor retrieved source text can authorize tools.
 */
object GroundedWebRecall {
    private val prefixes = listOf(
        "was weißt du aus dem internet über ",
        "was weißt du über ",
        "was steht in deinen quellen über ",
        "was steht in meinen quellen über ",
        "was hast du im internet über ",
        "was hast du über ",
        "erzähl mir aus deinen quellen über ",
        "suche in meinen quellen nach "
    )
    private val stop = setOf("und","oder","aber","auch","das","der","die","den","dem","des",
        "ein","eine","einen","einem","einer","ist","sind","hat","haben","von","für","mit",
        "auf","bei","zum","zur","was","wie","wer","wo","wann","warum","über","aus","deinen",
        "meinen","etwas","bitte","kannst","du","mir","noch","nicht","gibt","es","denn")

    private fun tokens(text: String): Set<String> =
        text.lowercase(Locale.GERMAN).split(Regex("[^\\p{L}\\p{N}]+"))
            .asSequence().filter { it.length >= 3 && it !in stop }.take(60).toSet()

    fun topicOf(message: String): String? {
        if (message.length !in 5..320) return null
        val normalized = message.trim().lowercase(Locale.GERMAN)
        val prefix = prefixes.firstOrNull(normalized::startsWith) ?: return null
        return message.trim().drop(prefix.length).trim().trimEnd('?', '.', '!', ' ')
            .takeIf { it.length in 3..120 }
    }

    /** Returns null when no explicit knowledge question is recognized. */
    fun answer(message: String, notes: List<WebLearningCandidate>): String? {
        val topic = topicOf(message) ?: return null
        val wanted = tokens(topic)
        if (wanted.isEmpty()) return "Bitte nenne ein konkreteres Thema für die Quellensuche."
        require(notes.size <= 24)
        val ranked = notes.asSequence()
            .filter { !it.contradictory && it.text.length <= 400 }
            .map { note ->
                val overlap = tokens(note.text).intersect(wanted).size
                Triple(note, overlap, overlap.toDouble() / wanted.size)
            }
            .filter { (_, overlap, coverage) ->
                overlap >= (if (wanted.size == 1) 1 else 2) && coverage >= 0.66
            }
            .sortedWith(compareByDescending<Triple<WebLearningCandidate,Int,Double>> { it.third }
                .thenByDescending { it.second }.thenBy { it.first.id })
            .take(3).toList()
        if (ranked.isEmpty()) return "Zum Thema „" + topic.take(100) +
            "“ habe ich in meinen ausdrücklich gespeicherten Quellen noch keinen ausreichend passenden Beleg. " +
            "Das sagt nichts darüber aus, ob es im Internet dazu Antworten gibt."
        return buildString {
            append("Ich habe ").append(ranked.size).append(" Quellenhinweise gefunden. ")
            append("Das sind Quellenaussagen, keine unabhängig bestätigten Fakten:")
            ranked.forEachIndexed { i, (note,_,_) ->
                append("\n\n").append(i+1).append(". ").append(note.text.take(300))
                append("\nQuelle: ").append(note.sourceUrl.take(250))
                append("\nInhalt SHA-256: ").append(note.sourceHash.take(16))
            }
            append("\n\nMethode: lokale Wortübereinstimmung, keine KI-Sprachgenerierung.")
        }.take(2400)
    }
}

package at.heinz.deviceai.cognitive

import java.util.Locale
import kotlin.math.ln

data class MemoryScoreBreakdown(
    val lexicalBm25: Double,
    val semanticSimilarity: Double,
    val entityMatch: Double,
    val temporalRelevance: Double,
    val sourceTrust: Double,
    val validationQuality: Double,
    val provenanceQuality: Double,
    val recency: Double,
    val contradictionPenalty: Double,
    val total: Double
) {
    init {
        listOf(
            lexicalBm25,
            semanticSimilarity,
            entityMatch,
            temporalRelevance,
            sourceTrust,
            validationQuality,
            provenanceQuality,
            recency,
            contradictionPenalty,
            total
        ).forEach { require(it.isFinite()) }
        require(
            listOf(
                lexicalBm25,
                semanticSimilarity,
                entityMatch,
                temporalRelevance,
                sourceTrust,
                validationQuality,
                provenanceQuality,
                recency,
                contradictionPenalty
            ).all { it in 0.0..1.0 }
        )
        require(total in 0.0..1.0)
    }
}

data class ScoredMemory(
    val memory: MemoryRecord,
    val score: MemoryScoreBreakdown
)

object HybridMemoryRetriever {
    fun retrieve(
        query: String,
        records: Collection<MemoryRecord>,
        limit: Int = 8,
        nowMillis: Long = System.currentTimeMillis(),
        allowedPrivacy: Set<PrivacyClass> = PrivacyClass.values().toSet(),
        semanticScorer: ((String, MemoryRecord) -> Double)? = null,
        sourceTrustScorer: ((MemoryRecord) -> Double)? = null
    ): List<ScoredMemory> {
        require(limit >= 0)
        require(nowMillis >= 0)
        if (limit == 0) return emptyList()

        val queryTerms = tokens(query).toSet()
        if (queryTerms.isEmpty()) return emptyList()

        val candidates = records.filter { it.privacyClass in allowedPrivacy }
        if (candidates.isEmpty()) return emptyList()

        val tokenized = candidates.associateWith { memory ->
            tokens(memory.content + " " + memory.tags.joinToString(" "))
        }
        val averageDocumentLength = tokenized.values.map { it.size }.average().coerceAtLeast(1.0)
        val documentFrequency = queryTerms.associateWith { term ->
            tokenized.values.count { term in it }.coerceAtLeast(0)
        }
        val temporalQuery = queryTerms.any { it in TEMPORAL_TERMS }

        return candidates.asSequence()
            .map { memory ->
                val documentTerms = tokenized.getValue(memory)
                val lexical = bm25Like(
                    queryTerms,
                    documentTerms,
                    documentFrequency,
                    candidates.size,
                    averageDocumentLength
                )
                val entity = entityScore(queryTerms, memory.tags)
                val semantic = semanticScorer
                    ?.invoke(query, memory)
                    ?.takeIf(Double::isFinite)
                    ?.coerceIn(0.0, 1.0)
                    ?: 0.0

                if (lexical <= 0.0 && entity <= 0.0 && semantic <= 0.0) {
                    return@map null
                }

                val temporal = temporalScore(memory, nowMillis, temporalQuery)
                val sourceTrust = sourceTrustScorer
                    ?.invoke(memory)
                    ?.takeIf(Double::isFinite)
                    ?.coerceIn(0.0, 1.0)
                    ?: 0.5
                val validation = validationScore(memory.validationState)
                val provenance = provenanceScore(memory.provenance)
                val recency = recencyScore(memory.updatedAt, nowMillis)
                val penalty = when (memory.validationState) {
                    ValidationState.CONTRADICTED -> 0.35
                    ValidationState.STALE -> 0.15
                    else -> 0.0
                }

                val weighted =
                    0.30 * lexical +
                        0.25 * semantic +
                        0.12 * entity +
                        0.10 * temporal +
                        0.08 * sourceTrust +
                        0.07 * validation +
                        0.03 * provenance +
                        0.05 * recency

                val total = (weighted - penalty).coerceIn(0.0, 1.0)
                ScoredMemory(
                    memory,
                    MemoryScoreBreakdown(
                        lexicalBm25 = lexical,
                        semanticSimilarity = semantic,
                        entityMatch = entity,
                        temporalRelevance = temporal,
                        sourceTrust = sourceTrust,
                        validationQuality = validation,
                        provenanceQuality = provenance,
                        recency = recency,
                        contradictionPenalty = penalty,
                        total = total
                    )
                )
            }
            .filterNotNull()
            // Relevant contradicted/stale memories remain visible with a low score so
            // the agent can reason about conflicts instead of silently forgetting them.
            .sortedWith(
                compareByDescending<ScoredMemory> { it.score.total }
                    .thenByDescending { it.memory.updatedAt }
                    .thenBy { it.memory.id }
            )
            .take(limit)
            .toList()
    }

    private fun bm25Like(
        queryTerms: Set<String>,
        documentTerms: List<String>,
        documentFrequency: Map<String, Int>,
        documentCount: Int,
        averageDocumentLength: Double
    ): Double {
        if (documentTerms.isEmpty()) return 0.0
        val termFrequency = documentTerms.groupingBy { it }.eachCount()
        val length = documentTerms.size.toDouble()
        var raw = 0.0
        queryTerms.forEach { term ->
            val tf = termFrequency[term]?.toDouble() ?: return@forEach
            val df = (documentFrequency[term] ?: 0).toDouble()
            val idf = ln(1.0 + ((documentCount - df + 0.5) / (df + 0.5)))
            val denominator = tf + K1 * (1.0 - B + B * length / averageDocumentLength)
            raw += idf * (tf * (K1 + 1.0) / denominator)
        }
        return if (raw <= 0.0) 0.0 else (raw / (raw + BM25_NORMALIZER)).coerceIn(0.0, 1.0)
    }

    private fun entityScore(queryTerms: Set<String>, tags: List<String>): Double {
        if (tags.isEmpty()) return 0.0
        val tagTerms = tags.flatMap(::tokens).toSet()
        if (tagTerms.isEmpty()) return 0.0
        return queryTerms.intersect(tagTerms).size.toDouble() / queryTerms.size.toDouble()
    }

    private fun temporalScore(memory: MemoryRecord, nowMillis: Long, temporalQuery: Boolean): Double {
        if (!temporalQuery) return 0.5
        val ageDays = ageDays(memory.updatedAt, nowMillis)
        return when {
            ageDays <= 1.0 -> 1.0
            ageDays <= 7.0 -> 0.85
            ageDays <= 30.0 -> 0.60
            ageDays <= 180.0 -> 0.35
            else -> 0.15
        }
    }

    private fun recencyScore(updatedAt: Long, nowMillis: Long): Double {
        val ageDays = ageDays(updatedAt, nowMillis)
        return (1.0 / (1.0 + ageDays / 30.0)).coerceIn(0.0, 1.0)
    }

    private fun ageDays(updatedAt: Long, nowMillis: Long): Double {
        val ageMillis = (nowMillis - updatedAt).coerceAtLeast(0L)
        return ageMillis.toDouble() / MILLIS_PER_DAY.toDouble()
    }

    private fun validationScore(state: ValidationState): Double = when (state) {
        ValidationState.VERIFIED -> 1.0
        ValidationState.CORROBORATED -> 0.85
        ValidationState.UNVERIFIED -> 0.45
        ValidationState.STALE -> 0.20
        ValidationState.CONTRADICTED -> 0.0
    }

    private fun provenanceScore(provenance: ProvenanceType): Double = when (provenance) {
        ProvenanceType.DIRECT_OBSERVATION -> 1.0
        ProvenanceType.DEVICE_OBSERVATION -> 0.95
        ProvenanceType.USER_PROVIDED -> 0.95
        ProvenanceType.EXTERNAL_SOURCE -> 0.85
        ProvenanceType.INFERENCE -> 0.65
        ProvenanceType.MODEL_GENERATED -> 0.40
        ProvenanceType.UNVERIFIED -> 0.20
    }

    private fun tokens(text: String): List<String> =
        text.lowercase(Locale.ROOT)
            .split(Regex("[^\\p{L}\\p{N}]+"))
            .filter(String::isNotBlank)
            .take(MAX_TOKENS)

    private val TEMPORAL_TERMS = setOf(
        "today", "yesterday", "recent", "recently", "latest", "current", "now",
        "heute", "gestern", "kürzlich", "zuletzt", "aktuell", "jetzt"
    )

    private const val K1 = 1.2
    private const val B = 0.75
    private const val BM25_NORMALIZER = 4.0
    private const val MAX_TOKENS = 4_096
    private const val MILLIS_PER_DAY = 86_400_000L
}

package at.heinz.deviceai.cognitive

import kotlin.math.abs

data class IdentityDriftResult(
    val overallDrift: Double,
    val behaviorDrift: Double,
    val capabilityDrift: Double,
    val communicationDrift: Double,
    val withinAllowedRange: Boolean
)

/**
 * Measures continuity of persistent state between two identity states (0 = identical).
 * Uses only behavior, capability competence and communication profile; no session data.
 * It does not measure consciousness or personhood.
 */
object IdentityDrift {
    const val W_BEHAVIOR = 0.5
    const val W_CAPABILITY = 0.3
    const val W_COMMUNICATION = 0.2

    fun compute(genome: CognitiveGenome, from: IdentityState, to: IdentityState): IdentityDriftResult {
        val b = BehaviorTrait.values().map { abs(from.behaviorProfile[it] - to.behaviorProfile[it]) }.average()
        val c = Capability.values().map { abs(from.selfModel[it].competence - to.selfModel[it].competence) }.average()
        val keys = from.communicationProfile.keys + to.communicationProfile.keys
        val m = if (keys.isEmpty()) 0.0
        else keys.count { from.communicationProfile[it] != to.communicationProfile[it] }.toDouble() / keys.size
        val overall = W_BEHAVIOR * b + W_CAPABILITY * c + W_COMMUNICATION * m
        return IdentityDriftResult(overall, b, c, m, overall <= genome.updateLimits.maxDriftPerGeneration)
    }
}

package at.heinz.deviceai.cognitive

/**
 * Immutable snapshot of identity. Changes produce a new generation.
 * [integrityHash] is a SHA-256 hash for tamper detection only. It is NOT a cryptographic
 * signature and does not authenticate who created the state (future: Android Keystore signing).
 */
data class IdentityState(
    val identityId: String,
    val generation: Int,
    val chosenName: String?,
    val communicationProfile: Map<String, String>,
    val behaviorProfile: BehaviorProfile,
    val modelReputation: Map<String, Double>,
    val sourceReputation: Map<String, Double>,
    val selfModel: SelfModel,
    val preferredProblemSolvingMethods: List<String>,
    val skillRegistryRoot: String,
    val memoryRoot: String,
    val experienceRoot: String,
    val cognitiveGenomeHash: String,
    val parentGeneration: Int?,
    val parentHash: String?,
    val integrityHash: String = ""
) {
    init {
        require(identityId.isNotBlank()) { "identityId must not be blank" }
        require(generation >= 1) { "generation must be >= 1" }
        require((generation == 1) == (parentGeneration == null)) { "parentGeneration only absent for generation 1" }
        require(parentGeneration == null || parentGeneration == generation - 1) { "parentGeneration must be generation-1" }
        require((parentGeneration == null) == (parentHash == null)) { "parentHash must match parentGeneration presence" }
        require((modelReputation.values + sourceReputation.values).all { it.isUnit() }) { "reputations must be finite within 0..1" }
    }

    fun canonical(): String = listOf(
        identityId, generation, chosenName ?: "<undefined>",
        communicationProfile.toSortedMap().entries.joinToString(",") { "${it.key}=${it.value}" },
        behaviorProfile.canonical(),
        modelReputation.toSortedMap().entries.joinToString(",") { "${it.key}=${canon(it.value)}" },
        sourceReputation.toSortedMap().entries.joinToString(",") { "${it.key}=${canon(it.value)}" },
        selfModel.canonical(), preferredProblemSolvingMethods.joinToString(","),
        skillRegistryRoot, memoryRoot, experienceRoot, cognitiveGenomeHash,
        parentGeneration ?: -1, parentHash ?: ""
    ).joinToString("|")

    fun seal(): IdentityState = copy(integrityHash = sha256Hex(canonical()))

    fun verify(): Boolean = integrityHash.isNotEmpty() && integrityHash == sha256Hex(canonical())

    /** Creates the next generation; this state is left untouched. */
    fun evolve(change: (IdentityState) -> IdentityState): IdentityState =
        change(this).copy(generation = generation + 1, parentGeneration = generation, parentHash = integrityHash).seal()

    companion object {
        /** identity minimal, name undefined, behavior neutral, everything unknown/empty. */
        fun initial(genome: CognitiveGenome): IdentityState = IdentityState(
            identityId = genome.identityId, generation = 1, chosenName = null,
            communicationProfile = emptyMap(), behaviorProfile = BehaviorProfile.neutral(),
            modelReputation = emptyMap(), sourceReputation = emptyMap(), selfModel = SelfModel.uncertain(),
            preferredProblemSolvingMethods = emptyList(),
            skillRegistryRoot = "", memoryRoot = "", experienceRoot = "",
            cognitiveGenomeHash = genome.hash(), parentGeneration = null, parentHash = null
        ).seal()
    }
}

/** Append-only generation history; auditable and exportable. */
class IdentityHistory(genesis: IdentityState) {
    private val chain = mutableListOf(genesis)
    init { require(genesis.generation == 1 && genesis.verify()) { "invalid genesis" } }

    val generations: List<IdentityState> get() = chain.toList()
    val current: IdentityState get() = chain.last()

    fun advance(change: (IdentityState) -> IdentityState): IdentityState = append(current.evolve(change))

    /** Appends only a verified direct successor of the current generation. */
    fun append(next: IdentityState): IdentityState {
        require(next.verify() && next.generation == current.generation + 1 &&
            next.parentGeneration == current.generation && next.parentHash == current.integrityHash) { "broken ancestry" }
        chain.add(next)
        return next
    }

    fun audit(): Boolean = chain.withIndex().all { (i, s) ->
        s.verify() && s.generation == i + 1 &&
            (i == 0 || (s.parentGeneration == chain[i - 1].generation && s.parentHash == chain[i - 1].integrityHash))
    }

    fun restore(generation: Int): IdentityState? = chain.firstOrNull { it.generation == generation }

    fun export(): String = chain.joinToString("\n") { it.canonical() + "#" + it.integrityHash }
}

package at.heinz.deviceai.cognitive

enum class FailureCode {
    INVALID_NUMBER, OUT_OF_BOUNDS, INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, EVIDENCE_MISMATCH, IDENTITY_MISMATCH,
    BROKEN_ANCESTRY, GENOME_MISMATCH, EXCESSIVE_DRIFT, FORBIDDEN_CAPABILITY, INTEGRITY_FAILURE
}

data class ValidationFailure(val code: FailureCode, val message: String)

sealed class ValidationResult {
    object Valid : ValidationResult()
    data class Invalid(val failures: List<ValidationFailure>) : ValidationResult()
    val isValid: Boolean get() = this is Valid
}

/** Central gatekeeper for persistent identity updates. */
object IdentityUpdateValidator {
    fun validate(genome: CognitiveGenome, current: IdentityState, candidate: IdentityState): ValidationResult {
        val f = mutableListOf<ValidationFailure>()
        fun fail(c: FailureCode, m: String) { f.add(ValidationFailure(c, m)) }

        if (genome.allowSelfReplication || genome.allowHiddenPersistence || genome.allowShutdownEvasion)
            fail(FailureCode.FORBIDDEN_CAPABILITY, "forbidden capability flag enabled")
        if (candidate.identityId != genome.identityId || candidate.identityId != current.identityId)
            fail(FailureCode.IDENTITY_MISMATCH, "identity id differs")
        if (current.cognitiveGenomeHash != genome.hash() || candidate.cognitiveGenomeHash != genome.hash())
            fail(FailureCode.GENOME_MISMATCH, "genome hash differs")
        if (!current.verify()) fail(FailureCode.INTEGRITY_FAILURE, "current state hash invalid")
        if (!candidate.verify()) fail(FailureCode.INTEGRITY_FAILURE, "candidate hash invalid")
        if (candidate.generation != current.generation + 1 || candidate.parentGeneration != current.generation ||
            candidate.parentHash != current.integrityHash)
            fail(FailureCode.BROKEN_ANCESTRY, "candidate is not the direct successor of generation ${current.generation}")

        for (t in BehaviorTrait.values()) {
            val v = candidate.behaviorProfile[t]
            if (!v.isFinite()) fail(FailureCode.INVALID_NUMBER, "$t not finite")
            else if (!genome.behaviorBounds.contains(v)) fail(FailureCode.OUT_OF_BOUNDS, "$t=$v outside ${genome.behaviorBounds}")
        }
        for (c in Capability.values()) {
            val e = candidate.selfModel[c]
            if (!e.competence.isUnit() || !e.calibrationError.isUnit()) fail(FailureCode.INVALID_NUMBER, "$c estimate invalid")
        }
        if (f.none { it.code == FailureCode.INVALID_NUMBER }) {
            val d = IdentityDrift.compute(genome, current, candidate)
            if (!d.withinAllowedRange) fail(FailureCode.EXCESSIVE_DRIFT, "drift ${d.overallDrift} > ${genome.updateLimits.maxDriftPerGeneration}")
        }
        return if (f.isEmpty()) ValidationResult.Valid else ValidationResult.Invalid(f)
    }
}

package at.heinz.deviceai.cognitive

import java.util.UUID

enum class InternetAccessMode { OFF, ASK }
class InternetApprovalTicket internal constructor(internal val nonce:String,internal val epoch:Long,
    val question:String,internal val expiresAt:Long)

/** Pending dialogs are not grants. Tickets are exact-request, expiring and single use.
 * Neither tickets nor approvals are serialized; mode changes revoke queued sessions.
 */
class InternetConsentPolicy(initialMode:InternetAccessMode=InternetAccessMode.ASK,
    private val nowMillis:()->Long={System.nanoTime()/1_000_000}) {
    @Volatile var mode=initialMode
        private set
    private var epoch=0L
    private var pending:InternetApprovalTicket?=null
    @Synchronized fun setMode(value:InternetAccessMode) { mode=value;cancel() }
    @Synchronized fun requestTicket(question:String):InternetApprovalTicket? {
        cancel()
        if(mode!=InternetAccessMode.ASK||question.isBlank()||question.length>2048)return null
        return InternetApprovalTicket(UUID.randomUUID().toString(),epoch,question,nowMillis()+60000).also { pending=it }
    }
    @Synchronized fun consume(ticket:InternetApprovalTicket):Boolean {
        val matches=pending?.nonce==ticket.nonce && pending?.question==ticket.question &&
            ticket.epoch==epoch && mode==InternetAccessMode.ASK && nowMillis()<=ticket.expiresAt
        pending=null
        if(!matches)epoch++
        return matches
    }
    @Synchronized internal fun isCurrent(ticket:InternetApprovalTicket)=mode==InternetAccessMode.ASK&&epoch==ticket.epoch
    internal fun monotonicNow()=nowMillis()
    @Synchronized fun cancel() { pending=null;epoch++ }
    // Legacy question-only methods remain for callers without a network execution path.
    @Synchronized fun request(question:String)=requestTicket(question)!=null
    @Synchronized fun approve(question:String):Boolean {
        val ticket=pending
        if(ticket==null||ticket.question!=question){cancel();return false}
        return consume(ticket)
    }
}
class InternetResearchGate(private val consent:InternetConsentPolicy) {
    fun authorize(question:String)=consent.approve(question)
    fun revoke()=consent.cancel()
}

package at.heinz.deviceai.cognitive

import at.heinz.deviceai.localmodel.LocalInferenceCallback
import at.heinz.deviceai.localmodel.LocalInferenceEvent
import at.heinz.deviceai.localmodel.LocalModelRuntime
import at.heinz.deviceai.localmodel.LocalModelState
import java.util.concurrent.CancellationException
import java.util.concurrent.CountDownLatch
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit

class LocalModelReasoningAdapter(
    private val runtime: LocalModelRuntime,
    private val nowMillis: () -> Long = System::currentTimeMillis,
    private val modelIdProvider: () -> String? = {
        runtime.loadedModel?.let { "${it.id}@${it.version}" }
    },
    private val nowNanos: () -> Long = System::nanoTime
) : ContinuumReasoningAdapter {

    @Volatile private var cancelled = false
    private var pinnedModel: String? = null

    /** Cancellation is sticky for this job; reuse for sequential passes, never for a new job. */
    override fun cancel() {
        cancelled = true
        runCatching { runtime.cancel() }
    }

    override fun execute(request: ReasoningPassRequest): ReasoningPassResult {
        require(request.prompt.length <= MAX_RUNTIME_PROMPT) {
            "Reasoning prompt exceeds local runtime limit; no silent clipping."
        }
        val started = nowMillis()
        val startNanos = nowNanos()
        val remainingMillis = request.deadlineMillis - started
        // All production callers are bounded to 60s; cap independently even on clock rollback.
        val budgetNanos = remainingMillis.coerceAtMost(MAX_PASS_MILLIS) * 1_000_000L
        val modelId = checkNotNull(modelIdProvider()) { "No local model loaded; no cloud fallback." }
        val modelFingerprint = "$modelId|${runtime.loadedModel?.sha256.orEmpty()}"

        fun gate() {
            if (cancelled || Thread.currentThread().isInterrupted) {
                throw CancellationException("Local reasoning cancelled.")
            }
            val elapsed = nowNanos() - startNanos
            check(remainingMillis > 0 && elapsed >= 0 && elapsed < budgetNanos &&
                nowMillis() < request.deadlineMillis) { "Reasoning pass deadline expired." }
            check(modelIdProvider() == modelId &&
                "$modelId|${runtime.loadedModel?.sha256.orEmpty()}" == modelFingerprint &&
                (pinnedModel == null || pinnedModel == modelFingerprint)) {
                "Local model changed during reasoning; output discarded."
            }
        }

        try {
            gate()
            while (runtime.state != LocalModelState.READY) {
                check(runtime.state != LocalModelState.EMPTY && runtime.state != LocalModelState.FAILED) {
                    "Local model is unavailable."
                }
                Thread.sleep(WAIT_SLICE_MILLIS)
                gate()
            }
            gate()
        } catch (interrupted: InterruptedException) {
            cancel()
            Thread.currentThread().interrupt()
            throw CancellationException("Interrupted while waiting for model.")
        } catch (failure: Exception) {
            cancel()
            throw failure
        }
        pinnedModel = modelFingerprint

        val latch = CountDownLatch(1)
        val lock = Any()
        val text = StringBuilder()
        var failure: Throwable? = null
        var done = false
        var toolEvents = 0

        fun end(error: Throwable?) {
            synchronized(lock) {
                if (done) return
                done = true
                failure = error
            }
            latch.countDown()
        }

        try {
            gate()
            runtime.streamThinking(request.prompt, LocalInferenceCallback { event ->
                when (event) {
                    is LocalInferenceEvent.TextDelta -> synchronized(lock) {
                        if (!done) {
                            if (text.length + event.text.length > request.maxOutputChars) {
                                end(IllegalArgumentException("Reasoning output exceeded limit."))
                            } else {
                                text.append(event.text)
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    is LocalInferenceEvent.Completed -> end(null)
                    is LocalInferenceEvent.Cancelled -> end(CancellationException("Local inference cancelled."))
                    is LocalInferenceEvent.Failed -> end(IllegalStateException(event.message))
                    is LocalInferenceEvent.ToolProposal,
                    is LocalInferenceEvent.ToolProposalRejected,
                    is LocalInferenceEvent.ToolBatchRejected -> {
                        synchronized(lock) { toolEvents++ }
                        end(SecurityException("Reasoning worker attempted a tool proposal."))
                    }
                }
            })

            // Do not depend on the native runtime emitting a terminal event after cancellation.
            while (true) {
                gate()
                if (latch.await(WAIT_SLICE_MILLIS, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS)) break
            }
            gate()
            synchronized(lock) {
                if (toolEvents > 0) throw SecurityException("Reasoning worker attempted a tool proposal.")
                failure?.let { throw it }
            }
            val output = synchronized(lock) { text.toString() }
            return ReasoningPassResult(
                modelId = modelId,
                text = output,
                latencyMillis = ((nowNanos() - startNanos) / 1_000_000L).coerceAtLeast(0)
            )
        } catch (interrupted: InterruptedException) {
            cancel()
            Thread.currentThread().interrupt()
            throw CancellationException("Reasoning interrupted.")
        } catch (failure: Exception) {
            cancel()
            throw failure
        } finally {
            synchronized(lock) {
                // Ignore late text/terminal callbacks after this pass has returned.
                done = true
            }
        }
    }

    private companion object {
        const val MAX_RUNTIME_PROMPT = 16_000
        const val MAX_PASS_MILLIS = 60_000L
        const val WAIT_SLICE_MILLIS = 10L
    }
}

    DIRECT_OBSERVATION, DEVICE_OBSERVATION, USER_PROVIDED, EXTERNAL_SOURCE,
    MODEL_GENERATED, INFERENCE, UNVERIFIED

data class MemoryRecord(
    val id: String,
    val type: MemoryType,
    val content: String,
    val provenance: ProvenanceType,
    val confidence: Double,
    val createdAt: Long,
    val updatedAt: Long,
    val tags: List<String> = emptyList(),
    val parentIds: List<String> = emptyList(),
    val sourceReference: String? = null,
    val validationState: ValidationState = ValidationState.UNVERIFIED,
    val privacyClass: PrivacyClass = PrivacyClass.PRIVATE,
    val validationEvidenceReferences: List<String> = emptyList()
) {
    init {
        require(id.isNotBlank() && content.isNotBlank())
        require(confidence.isFinite() && confidence in 0.0..1.0)
        require(createdAt >= 0 && updatedAt >= createdAt)
        require(tags.none { it.isBlank() } && parentIds.none { it.isBlank() })
        require(validationEvidenceReferences.none { it.isBlank() })
        require(validationState != ValidationState.VERIFIED || validationEvidenceReferences.isNotEmpty()) {
            "verified memories require independent evidence"
        }
    }

    fun validated(state: ValidationState, evidenceReferences: List<String>): MemoryRecord {
        require(state != ValidationState.VERIFIED || evidenceReferences.isNotEmpty()) {
            "verified memories require independent evidence"
        }
        require(evidenceReferences.none { it.isBlank() })
        return copy(
            validationState = state,
            validationEvidenceReferences = (validationEvidenceReferences + evidenceReferences).distinct()
        )
    }
}

interface MemoryStore {
    fun put(record: MemoryRecord)
    fun get(id: String): MemoryRecord?
    fun all(): List<MemoryRecord>
}

class InMemoryMemoryStore : MemoryStore {
    private val records = linkedMapOf<String, MemoryRecord>()

    @Synchronized override fun put(record: MemoryRecord) {
        require(record.id !in records) { "memory id already exists: ${record.id}" }
        records[record.id] = record.copy(
            tags = record.tags.toList(),
            parentIds = record.parentIds.toList(),
            validationEvidenceReferences = record.validationEvidenceReferences.toList()
        )
    }

    @Synchronized override fun get(id: String): MemoryRecord? = records[id]
    @Synchronized override fun all(): List<MemoryRecord> = records.values.toList()
}

object MemoryRetriever {
    fun retrieve(
        query: String,
        records: Collection<MemoryRecord>,
        limit: Int = 5,
        allowedPrivacy: Set<PrivacyClass> = PrivacyClass.values().toSet()
    ): List<MemoryRecord> {
        require(limit >= 0)
        val terms = tokens(query)
        if (limit == 0 || terms.isEmpty()) return emptyList()
        return records.asSequence()
            .filter { it.privacyClass in allowedPrivacy }
            .map { it to score(terms, tokens(it.content + " " + it.tags.joinToString(" "))) }
            .filter { it.second > 0 }
            .sortedWith(compareByDescending<Pair<MemoryRecord, Int>> { it.second }.thenBy { it.first.id })
            .take(limit)
            .map { it.first }
            .toList()
    }

    private fun score(query: Set<String>, content: Set<String>) = query.count { it in content }
    private fun tokens(text: String) =
        text.lowercase(Locale.ROOT).split(Regex("[^\\p{L}\\p{N}]+")).filter(String::isNotBlank).toSet()
}

data class MemoryEdge(val fromId: String, val toId: String, val relation: MemoryRelation)

class MemoryGraph {
    private val edges = linkedSetOf<MemoryEdge>()

    @Synchronized fun add(fromId: String, toId: String, relation: MemoryRelation) {
        require(fromId.isNotBlank() && toId.isNotBlank() && fromId != toId)
        edges += MemoryEdge(fromId, toId, relation)
    }

    @Synchronized fun related(id: String): List<MemoryEdge> =
        edges.filter { it.fromId == id || it.toId == id }
            .sortedWith(compareBy<MemoryEdge> { it.fromId }.thenBy { it.relation.name }.thenBy { it.toId })
}

    fun validated(state: ValidationState, evidenceReferences: List<String>): Claim {

            validationEvidenceReferences = (validationEvidenceReferences + evidenceReferences).distinct()

data class MemoryWriteContext(
    val memoryType: MemoryType,
    val provenance: ProvenanceType,
    val confidence: Double,
    val durableKnowledge: Boolean = false,
    val explicitlyRequested: Boolean = false,
    val reusableForFutureTasks: Boolean = false,
    val containsPersonalInformation: Boolean = false,
    val containsSensitiveInformation: Boolean = false,
    val containsDeviceInformation: Boolean = false
)

data class MemoryWriteDecision(val shouldWrite: Boolean, val privacyClass: PrivacyClass, val reason: String)

class MemoryWritePolicy(private val minimumConfidence: Double = 0.6) {
    init { require(minimumConfidence.isFinite() && minimumConfidence in 0.0..1.0) }

    fun decide(context: MemoryWriteContext): MemoryWriteDecision {
        require(context.confidence.isFinite() && context.confidence in 0.0..1.0)
        val privacy = when {
            context.containsDeviceInformation || context.provenance == ProvenanceType.DEVICE_OBSERVATION ->
                PrivacyClass.DEVICE_LOCAL_ONLY
            context.containsSensitiveInformation -> PrivacyClass.SENSITIVE
            context.containsPersonalInformation || context.provenance == ProvenanceType.USER_PROVIDED ->
                PrivacyClass.PRIVATE
            else -> PrivacyClass.PUBLIC
        }
        val durable = context.durableKnowledge || context.explicitlyRequested || context.reusableForFutureTasks
        val trustworthy = context.provenance !in setOf(ProvenanceType.MODEL_GENERATED, ProvenanceType.UNVERIFIED) ||
            context.confidence >= minimumConfidence
        return when {
            !durable -> MemoryWriteDecision(false, privacy, "interaction is not durable or explicitly requested")
            !trustworthy -> MemoryWriteDecision(false, privacy, "unverified content is below the confidence threshold")
            else -> MemoryWriteDecision(true, privacy, "durable memory is permitted")
        }
    }
}

interface ExperienceLookup {
    fun similar(taskType: String, request: String, limit: Int = 5): List<Experience>
}

class InMemoryExperienceStore : ExperienceStore, ExperienceLookup {
    private val experiences = linkedMapOf<String, Experience>()

    @Synchronized override fun store(e: Experience) {
        require(e.id !in experiences) { "experience id already exists: ${e.id}" }
        experiences[e.id] = e.copy(
            memoryIds = e.memoryIds.toList(), modelIds = e.modelIds.toList(),
            sourceIds = e.sourceIds.toList(), toolIds = e.toolIds.toList(),
            failures = e.failures.toList(), evaluatorScores = e.evaluatorScores.toMap()
        )
    }

    @Synchronized override fun all(): List<Experience> = experiences.values.toList()

    override fun similar(taskType: String, request: String, limit: Int): List<Experience> {
        require(limit >= 0)
        val queryTerms = terms(request)
        if (limit == 0) return emptyList()
        return all().asSequence()
            .filter { it.taskType.equals(taskType, ignoreCase = true) }
            .map { it to jaccard(queryTerms, terms(it.requestSummary)) }
            .filter { it.second > 0.0 || queryTerms.isEmpty() }
            .sortedWith(compareByDescending<Pair<Experience, Double>> { it.second }.thenBy { it.first.id })
            .take(limit)
            .map { it.first }
            .toList()
    }

    private fun terms(text: String) = text.lowercase(Locale.ROOT)
        .split(Regex("[^\\p{L}\\p{N}]+")).filter(String::isNotBlank).toSet()

    private fun jaccard(a: Set<String>, b: Set<String>): Double =
        if (a.isEmpty() && b.isEmpty()) 1.0 else a.intersect(b).size.toDouble() / a.union(b).size
}
