data class ReputationEvidence(
    val evaluated: Boolean,
    val success: Boolean,
    val evaluatorScore: Double,
    val failure: Boolean = false,
    val hallucination: Boolean = false,
    val correction: Boolean = false,
    val latencyMillis: Long
) {
    init {
        require(evaluatorScore.isFinite() && evaluatorScore in 0.0..1.0)
        require(latencyMillis >= 0)
    }
}

data class CapabilityReputation(
    val successRate: Double = 0.5,
    val evaluatorScore: Double = 0.5,
    val failureRate: Double = 0.5,
    val hallucinationRate: Double = 0.0,
    val correctionRate: Double = 0.0,
    val meanLatencyMillis: Double = 0.0,
    val taskCount: Int = 0
) {
    init {
        require((listOf(successRate, evaluatorScore, failureRate, hallucinationRate, correctionRate)
            .all { it.isFinite() && it in 0.0..1.0 }) && meanLatencyMillis.isFinite() &&
            meanLatencyMillis >= 0 && taskCount >= 0)
    }
}

class ModelReputationStore(private val learningRate: Double = 0.1) {
    private val reputation = linkedMapOf<Triple<String, ModelCapability, String>, CapabilityReputation>()

    init { require(learningRate.isFinite() && learningRate in 0.0..1.0) }

    @Synchronized fun get(modelId: String, capability: ModelCapability, domain: String): CapabilityReputation =
        reputation[Triple(modelId, capability, domain)] ?: CapabilityReputation()

    @Synchronized fun updateAfterEvaluation(
        modelId: String,
        capability: ModelCapability,
        domain: String,
        evidence: ReputationEvidence
    ): CapabilityReputation {
        require(modelId.isNotBlank() && domain.isNotBlank())
        require(evidence.evaluated) { "reputation updates require an evaluated result" }
        val old = get(modelId, capability, domain)
        fun smooth(before: Double, after: Double) = before + learningRate * (after - before)
        val updated = CapabilityReputation(
            successRate = smooth(old.successRate, if (evidence.success) 1.0 else 0.0),
            evaluatorScore = smooth(old.evaluatorScore, evidence.evaluatorScore),
            failureRate = smooth(old.failureRate, if (evidence.failure) 1.0 else 0.0),
            hallucinationRate = smooth(old.hallucinationRate, if (evidence.hallucination) 1.0 else 0.0),
            correctionRate = smooth(old.correctionRate, if (evidence.correction) 1.0 else 0.0),
            meanLatencyMillis = if (old.taskCount == 0) evidence.latencyMillis.toDouble()
            else smooth(old.meanLatencyMillis, evidence.latencyMillis.toDouble()),
            taskCount = old.taskCount + 1
        )
        reputation[Triple(modelId, capability, domain)] = updated
        return updated
    }
}

enum class RoutingStrategy { SINGLE_MODEL, ENSEMBLE, DEBATE, SPECIALIST_PIPELINE, DYNAMIC_TEAM }

data class TaskDescriptor(
    val taskType: String,
    val request: String,
    val capability: ModelCapability,
    val domain: String,
    val complexity: Double = 0.5,
    val requiresIndependentVerification: Boolean = false,
    val preferredStrategy: RoutingStrategy? = null
) {
    init {
        require(taskType.isNotBlank() && request.isNotBlank() && domain.isNotBlank())
        require(complexity.isFinite() && complexity in 0.0..1.0)
    }
}

data class ResourceConstraints(
    val maxModels: Int = 3,
    val maxLatencyMillis: Long? = null,
    val allowEnsemble: Boolean = true
) {
    init { require(maxModels >= 1 && (maxLatencyMillis == null || maxLatencyMillis >= 0)) }
}

data class RoutingPlan(
    val selectedModelIds: List<String>,
    val strategy: RoutingStrategy,
    val reasons: List<String>,
    val confidence: Double,
    val evidence: List<String>
)

class ModelRouter {
    fun route(
        task: TaskDescriptor,
        selfModel: SelfModel,
        adapters: List<ModelAdapter>,
        reputation: ModelReputationStore,
        resources: ResourceConstraints = ResourceConstraints()
    ): RoutingPlan {
        val eligible = adapters.distinctBy { it.id }.filter { adapter ->
            task.capability in adapter.capabilities &&
                (resources.maxLatencyMillis == null ||
                    reputation.get(adapter.id, task.capability, task.domain).meanLatencyMillis <= resources.maxLatencyMillis)
        }.sortedWith(
            compareByDescending<ModelAdapter> {
                reputation.get(it.id, task.capability, task.domain).evaluatorScore
            }.thenBy { it.id }
        )
        require(eligible.isNotEmpty()) { "no adapter satisfies the requested capability and resources" }

        val selfCapability = task.capability.toSelfCapability()
        val estimate = selfCapability?.let(selfModel::get)
        val supportsMultiple = eligible.size >= 2 && resources.maxModels >= 2
        val selectedStrategy = when {
            task.preferredStrategy == RoutingStrategy.DEBATE && supportsMultiple -> RoutingStrategy.DEBATE
            task.preferredStrategy == RoutingStrategy.SPECIALIST_PIPELINE && supportsMultiple -> RoutingStrategy.SPECIALIST_PIPELINE
            task.preferredStrategy == RoutingStrategy.DYNAMIC_TEAM && supportsMultiple -> RoutingStrategy.DYNAMIC_TEAM
            task.preferredStrategy == RoutingStrategy.ENSEMBLE && supportsMultiple && resources.allowEnsemble -> RoutingStrategy.ENSEMBLE
            task.requiresIndependentVerification && supportsMultiple && resources.allowEnsemble -> RoutingStrategy.ENSEMBLE
            estimate?.confidence?.let { it < 0.35 } == true && supportsMultiple && resources.allowEnsemble ->
                RoutingStrategy.ENSEMBLE
            task.complexity >= 0.85 && supportsMultiple && eligible.size >= 3 -> RoutingStrategy.DYNAMIC_TEAM
            else -> RoutingStrategy.SINGLE_MODEL
        }
        val count = when (selectedStrategy) {
            RoutingStrategy.SINGLE_MODEL -> 1
            RoutingStrategy.ENSEMBLE, RoutingStrategy.DEBATE -> 2
            RoutingStrategy.SPECIALIST_PIPELINE -> minOf(2, eligible.size)
            RoutingStrategy.DYNAMIC_TEAM -> minOf(resources.maxModels, eligible.size)
        }.coerceAtMost(resources.maxModels).coerceAtMost(eligible.size)
        val chosen = eligible.take(count)
        val reasons = mutableListOf("Adapters are ranked by evaluated reputation for ${task.capability} in ${task.domain}.")
        if (estimate != null) {
            reasons += "Self-model ${selfCapability} confidence=${"%.2f".format(Locale.ROOT, estimate.confidence)} " +
                "and competence=${"%.2f".format(Locale.ROOT, estimate.competence)} informed strategy selection."
        }
        if (chosen.size > 1) reasons += "Multiple eligible adapters are selected for ${selectedStrategy.name.lowercase(Locale.ROOT)}."
        val score = chosen.map { reputation.get(it.id, task.capability, task.domain).evaluatorScore }.average()
        val confidence = (score * (estimate?.confidence?.let { 0.75 + 0.25 * it } ?: 1.0)).coerceIn(0.0, 1.0)
        return RoutingPlan(
            selectedModelIds = chosen.map { it.id },
            strategy = selectedStrategy,
            reasons = reasons,
            confidence = confidence,
            evidence = chosen.map {
                "${it.id}: evaluated score=${reputation.get(it.id, task.capability, task.domain).evaluatorScore}, " +
                    "tasks=${reputation.get(it.id, task.capability, task.domain).taskCount}"
            }
        )
    }

    private fun ModelCapability.toSelfCapability(): Capability? = when (this) {
        ModelCapability.CODING -> Capability.CODING
        ModelCapability.RESEARCH -> Capability.RESEARCH
        ModelCapability.MATHEMATICS -> Capability.MATHEMATICS
        ModelCapability.PLANNING -> Capability.PLANNING
        ModelCapability.FACTUAL_ACCURACY -> Capability.FACTUAL_ACCURACY
        ModelCapability.DOCUMENT_ANALYSIS -> Capability.DOCUMENT_ANALYSIS
        ModelCapability.ANDROID_DEBUGGING -> Capability.ANDROID_DEBUGGING
        ModelCapability.TOOL_USE -> Capability.TOOL_USE
        ModelCapability.SOURCE_EVALUATION -> Capability.SOURCE_EVALUATION
    }
}

data class SourceIdentity(val id: String, val domain: String) {
    init { require(id.isNotBlank() && domain.isNotBlank()) }
}

data class SourceObservation(
    val source: SourceIdentity,
    val evaluated: Boolean,
    val accuracy: Double,
    val freshness: Double,
    val corroborated: Boolean = false,
    val contradicted: Boolean = false,
    val corrected: Boolean = false
) {
    init {
        require(listOf(accuracy, freshness).all { it.isFinite() && it in 0.0..1.0 })
    }
}

data class SourceTrustProfile(
    val source: SourceIdentity,
    val historicalAccuracy: Double = 0.5,
    val freshness: Double = 0.5,
    val corroborationRate: Double = 0.5,
    val contradictionRate: Double = 0.0,
    val correctionRate: Double = 0.0,
    val evaluatedClaims: Int = 0,
    val confidence: Double = 0.0
) {
    init {
        require(listOf(historicalAccuracy, freshness, corroborationRate, contradictionRate, correctionRate)
            .all { it.isFinite() && it in 0.0..1.0 } &&
            confidence.isFinite() && confidence in 0.0..1.0 && evaluatedClaims >= 0)
    }
}

class SourceTrustStore(private val learningRate: Double = 0.1) {
    private val profiles = linkedMapOf<SourceIdentity, SourceTrustProfile>()
    init { require(learningRate.isFinite() && learningRate in 0.0..1.0) }

    @Synchronized fun get(source: SourceIdentity): SourceTrustProfile =
        profiles[source] ?: SourceTrustProfile(source)

    @Synchronized fun observe(observation: SourceObservation): SourceTrustProfile {
        require(observation.evaluated) { "source trust changes require an evaluated claim" }
        val old = get(observation.source)
        fun smooth(before: Double, after: Double) = before + learningRate * (after - before)
        return SourceTrustProfile(
            source = observation.source,
            historicalAccuracy = smooth(old.historicalAccuracy, observation.accuracy),
            freshness = smooth(old.freshness, observation.freshness),
            corroborationRate = smooth(old.corroborationRate, if (observation.corroborated) 1.0 else 0.0),
            contradictionRate = smooth(old.contradictionRate, if (observation.contradicted) 1.0 else 0.0),
            correctionRate = smooth(old.correctionRate, if (observation.corrected) 1.0 else 0.0),
            evaluatedClaims = old.evaluatedClaims + 1,
            confidence = smooth(old.confidence, 1.0)
        ).also { profiles[observation.source] = it }
    }
}

package at.heinz.deviceai.cognitive

import java.net.InetAddress
import java.net.Proxy
import java.net.URI
import java.security.cert.Certificate
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit
import javax.net.ssl.HttpsURLConnection
import okhttp3.Call
import okhttp3.ConnectionPool
import okhttp3.Dns
import okhttp3.OkHttpClient
import okhttp3.Request
import okhttp3.Response

/** Private GET-only adapter for the existing bounded research reader. Pinning
 * happens at route selection, BEFORE TCP connects, rather than after a platform
 * URLConnection may have resolved the host again. TLS and hostname verification
 * use OkHttp's normal certificate validation. No global cookies/auth/cache/proxy.
 */
internal class PinnedResearchHttpsConnection(
    uri:URI, addresses:List<InetAddress>, private val deadlineMillis:Int
):HttpsURLConnection(uri.toURL()) {
    private val approvedHost=uri.host.removePrefix("[").removeSuffix("]")
    private val pinned=addresses.toList()
    @Volatile private var call:Call?=null
    @Volatile private var response:Response?=null
    @Volatile private var stopped=false

    internal fun client():OkHttpClient = OkHttpClient.Builder()
        .dns(object:Dns {
            override fun lookup(hostname:String):List<InetAddress> {
                check(hostname.equals(approvedHost,true)&&!stopped) { "Unapproved research DNS route" }
                return pinned
            }
        })
        .proxy(Proxy.NO_PROXY)
        .followRedirects(false).followSslRedirects(false)
        .retryOnConnectionFailure(false)
        .connectionPool(ConnectionPool(0,1,TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS))
        .connectTimeout(connectTimeout.coerceAtLeast(1).toLong(),TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS)
        .readTimeout(readTimeout.coerceAtLeast(1).toLong(),TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS)
        .callTimeout(deadlineMillis.toLong(),TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS)
        .build()

    @Synchronized override fun connect() {
        if(response!=null)return
        check(!stopped) { "Research connection cancelled" }
        require(requestMethod=="GET"&&!doOutput) { "Research transport is GET-only" }
        val builder=Request.Builder().url(url).get()
        requestProperties.forEach { (name,values)->values.forEach { builder.addHeader(name,it) } }
        val pending=client().newCall(builder.build())
        call=pending
        if(stopped)pending.cancel()
        val received=pending.execute()
        if(stopped){received.close();error("Research connection cancelled")}
        response=received
        connected=true
    }
    override fun disconnect() { stopped=true;call?.cancel();response?.close() }
    override fun usingProxy()=false
    private fun result():Response { connect();return checkNotNull(response) }
    override fun getResponseCode()=result().code
    override fun getContentType()=result().header("Content-Type")
    override fun getContentLengthLong()=result().body?.contentLength()?:-1L
    override fun getHeaderField(name:String)=result().header(name)
    override fun getInputStream()=checkNotNull(result().body).byteStream()
    override fun getCipherSuite()=result().handshake?.cipherSuite?.javaName?:""
    override fun getLocalCertificates():Array<Certificate>?=result().handshake?.localCertificates?.toTypedArray()
    override fun getServerCertificates():Array<Certificate> = result().handshake?.peerCertificates?.toTypedArray()?:emptyArray()
}

enum class MemoryMutationReason {
    USER_CORRECTION,
    NEW_EVIDENCE,
    CONTRADICTION_RESOLUTION,
    CONSOLIDATION,
    SUPERSESSION,
    PRIVACY_CHANGE

data class MemoryMutationPayload(
    val mutationId: String,
    val recordId: String,
    val beforeHash: String?,
    val afterHash: String,
    val reason: MemoryMutationReason,
    val provenance: ProvenanceType,
    val evidenceReferences: List<String>,
    val contradictionReferences: List<String>,
    val previousMutationHash: String?,
    val createdAtMillis: Long
) {
    init {
        require(mutationId.matches(Regex("[A-Za-z0-9._:-]{1,128}")))
        require(recordId.isNotBlank() && recordId.length <= 256)
        require(beforeHash == null || beforeHash.matches(Regex("[a-f0-9]{64}")))
        require(afterHash.matches(Regex("[a-f0-9]{64}")))
        require(previousMutationHash == null || previousMutationHash.matches(Regex("[a-f0-9]{64}")))
        require(evidenceReferences.size <= 128 && evidenceReferences.none(String::isBlank))
        require(contradictionReferences.size <= 128 && contradictionReferences.none(String::isBlank))
        require(createdAtMillis >= 0)
    }

    fun canonicalBytes(): ByteArray = buildString {
        append(mutationId).append('|')
        append(recordId).append('|')
        append(beforeHash.orEmpty()).append('|')
        append(afterHash).append('|')
        append(reason.name).append('|')
        append(provenance.name).append('|')
        append(evidenceReferences.distinct().sorted().joinToString(",")).append('|')
        append(contradictionReferences.distinct().sorted().joinToString(",")).append('|')
        append(previousMutationHash.orEmpty()).append('|')
        append(createdAtMillis)
    }.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8)

    fun hash(): String = sha256Bytes(canonicalBytes()).toHex()
}

data class ProofCarryingMemoryMutation(
    val payload: MemoryMutationPayload,
    val signature: ByteArray
) {
    init { require(signature.isNotEmpty() && signature.size <= 4_096) }

    fun verify(signer: IdentitySigner): Boolean =
        signer.verify(payload.canonicalBytes(), signature)

    companion object {
        fun create(
            mutationId: String,
            before: MemoryRecord?,
            after: MemoryRecord,
            reason: MemoryMutationReason,
            evidenceReferences: List<String>,
            contradictionReferences: List<String>,
            previousMutationHash: String?,
            decision: MemoryWriteDecision,
            signer: IdentitySigner,
            createdAtMillis: Long
        ): ProofCarryingMemoryMutation {
            require(decision.shouldWrite) { "MemoryWritePolicy rejected durable memory mutation." }
            require(before == null || before.id == after.id) { "Memory mutation cannot change record identity." }
            require(after.privacyClass == decision.privacyClass) {
                "Mutation privacy class must match MemoryWritePolicy decision."
            }
            if (reason in setOf(
                    MemoryMutationReason.NEW_EVIDENCE,
                    MemoryMutationReason.CONTRADICTION_RESOLUTION,
                    MemoryMutationReason.SUPERSESSION
                )
            ) {
                require(evidenceReferences.isNotEmpty()) {
                    "Evidence-bearing memory mutations require provenance references."
                }
            }
            val payload = MemoryMutationPayload(
                mutationId = mutationId,
                recordId = after.id,
                beforeHash = before?.let(::memoryRecordHash),
                afterHash = memoryRecordHash(after),
                reason = reason,
                provenance = after.provenance,
                evidenceReferences = evidenceReferences.distinct().sorted(),
                contradictionReferences = contradictionReferences.distinct().sorted(),
                previousMutationHash = previousMutationHash,
                createdAtMillis = createdAtMillis
            )
            return ProofCarryingMemoryMutation(payload, signer.sign(payload.canonicalBytes()))
        }
    }
}

class MemoryMutationLedger(private val signer: IdentitySigner) {
    private val entries = mutableListOf<ProofCarryingMemoryMutation>()

    @Synchronized
    fun append(mutation: ProofCarryingMemoryMutation) {
        require(mutation.verify(signer)) { "Memory mutation signature verification failed." }
        val expectedPrevious = entries.lastOrNull()?.payload?.hash()
        require(mutation.payload.previousMutationHash == expectedPrevious) {
            "Memory mutation chain is discontinuous."
        }
        entries += mutation
    }

    @Synchronized
    fun all(): List<ProofCarryingMemoryMutation> = entries.toList()

    @Synchronized
    fun verifyChain(): Boolean {
        var previous: String? = null
        for (entry in entries) {
            if (!entry.verify(signer)) return false
            if (entry.payload.previousMutationHash != previous) return false
            previous = entry.payload.hash()
        }
        return true
    }

    @Synchronized
    fun lastHash(): String? = entries.lastOrNull()?.payload?.hash()
}

fun memoryRecordHash(record: MemoryRecord): String {
    val canonical = buildString {
        append(record.id).append('|')
        append(record.type.name).append('|')
        append(record.content).append('|')
        append(record.provenance.name).append('|')
        append(record.confidence).append('|')
        append(record.createdAt).append('|').append(record.updatedAt).append('|')
        append(record.tags.distinct().sorted().joinToString(",")).append('|')
        append(record.parentIds.distinct().sorted().joinToString(",")).append('|')
        append(record.sourceReference.orEmpty()).append('|')
        append(record.validationState.name).append('|')
        append(record.privacyClass.name).append('|')
        append(record.validationEvidenceReferences.distinct().sorted().joinToString(","))
    }
    return sha256Bytes(canonical.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8)).toHex()
}

class HttpReadOnlyResearchProvider private constructor(
    private val policy: ResearchProviderPolicy,
    private val now: () -> Long,
    private val accessCheck: () -> Unit,
    private val network:ResearchHttpEnvironment
) : ResearchProvider {
    constructor(policy:ResearchProviderPolicy=ResearchProviderPolicy(),now:()->Long=System::currentTimeMillis,
        accessCheck:()->Unit={}):this(policy,now,accessCheck,PublicResearchHttpEnvironment)
    internal constructor(network:ResearchHttpEnvironment,policy:ResearchProviderPolicy=ResearchProviderPolicy(),
        now:()->Long=System::currentTimeMillis,accessCheck:()->Unit={}):this(policy,now,accessCheck,network)
    override fun retrieve(request: ResearchRequest): ResearchResult = fetch(request,false)
    /** Raw bounded markup is for discovery parsers only, never a model instruction. */
    fun retrieveMarkup(request:ResearchRequest):ResearchResult = fetch(request,true)
    private fun fetch(request:ResearchRequest,keepMarkup:Boolean):ResearchResult {
        accessCheck()
        require(request.maxBytes <= policy.maxBytes)
        var uri = URI(request.url)
        var redirects = 0
        val deadlineNanos = System.nanoTime() +
            minOf(policy.totalTimeoutMillis, request.timeoutMillis) * 1_000_000L
        while (true) {
            accessCheck()
            val validatedAddresses = ResearchUrlValidator.validate(uri, policy.allowedHosts,network::resolve)
            val remainingMillis = remainingTimeoutMillis(deadlineNanos)
            val connection = network.open(uri,validatedAddresses,remainingMillis).apply {
                requestMethod = "GET"
                useCaches = false
                instanceFollowRedirects = false
                connectTimeout = minOf(policy.connectTimeoutMillis, request.timeoutMillis, remainingMillis)
                readTimeout = minOf(policy.readTimeoutMillis, request.timeoutMillis, remainingMillis)
                setRequestProperty("Accept", "text/html,text/plain,application/json,application/xml")
                setRequestProperty("User-Agent", "DeviceAI-Research/1.0")
            }
            val timeoutTask = REQUEST_TIMEOUTS.schedule(
                { connection.disconnect() },
                remainingMillis.toLong(),
                TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS
            )
            try {
                val status = connection.responseCode
                if (status in 300..399) {
                    require(redirects < minOf(policy.maxRedirects, request.maxRedirects)) {
                        "Too many research redirects."
                    }
                    val location = connection.getHeaderField("Location")
                        ?: throw IllegalArgumentException("Redirect has no location.")
                    uri = uri.resolve(location)
                    redirects++
                    continue
                }
                require(status in 200..299) { "Research request failed with HTTP $status." }
                val mime = connection.contentType?.substringBefore(';')?.trim()?.lowercase(Locale.ROOT)
                    ?: throw IllegalArgumentException("Research response has no MIME type.")
                require(mime in SAFE_MIME_TYPES) { "Unsupported research MIME type." }
                val announced = connection.contentLengthLong
                require(announced < 0 || announced <= request.maxBytes) { "Research response is too large." }
                val body = connection.inputStream.use { readLimited(it, request.maxBytes, deadlineNanos) }
                val rawText = String(body, Charsets.UTF_8)
                val content=responseText(rawText,mime,keepMarkup,policy.maxContentCharacters)
                require(content.isNotBlank()) { "Research document is empty." }
                val finalUrl = uri.toASCIIString()
                val sourceHost = uri.host.lowercase(Locale.ROOT).removePrefix("[").removeSuffix("]")
                val title = Regex(
                    "<title\\b[^>]*>(.*?)</title\\s*>",
                    setOf(RegexOption.IGNORE_CASE, RegexOption.DOT_MATCHES_ALL)
                ).find(rawText)?.groupValues?.get(1)
                    ?.replace(Regex("<[^>]+>"), "")?.trim()?.take(256)?.takeIf(String::isNotBlank)
                val document = ResearchDocument(
                    url = finalUrl,
                    title = title,
                    retrievedAt = now(),
                    contentHash = sha256Hex(content),
                    mimeType = mime,
                    source = SourceIdentity(sourceHost, sourceHost),
                    content = content
                )
                return ResearchResult(listOf(document), listOf(document.citation()))
            } finally {
                timeoutTask.cancel(false)
                connection.disconnect()
            }
        }
    }

    private fun readLimited(input: java.io.InputStream, maximum: Int, deadlineNanos: Long): ByteArray {
        val output = ByteArrayOutputStream()
        val buffer = ByteArray(8_192)
        while (true) {
            remainingTimeoutMillis(deadlineNanos)
            val read = input.read(buffer)
            if (read < 0) break
            require(output.size() + read <= maximum) { "Research response is too large." }
            output.write(buffer, 0, read)
        }
        return output.toByteArray()
    }

    private fun remainingTimeoutMillis(deadlineNanos: Long): Int {
        accessCheck()
        require(!Thread.currentThread().isInterrupted) { "Research request cancelled" }
        val remainingNanos = deadlineNanos - System.nanoTime()
        require(remainingNanos > 0) { "Research request exceeded its total time limit." }
        return ((remainingNanos + 999_999) / 1_000_000).coerceAtMost(Int.MAX_VALUE.toLong()).toInt()
    }

    object ResearchUrlValidator {
        fun validateSyntax(uri:URI,allowedHosts:Set<String> = emptySet()) {
            require(uri.scheme.equals("https", ignoreCase = true)) { "Research supports HTTPS only." }
            require(uri.userInfo == null && uri.host != null && (uri.port == -1 || uri.port == 443)) {
                "Unsafe research URL authority."
            }
            val host = uri.host.removePrefix("[").removeSuffix("]").lowercase(Locale.ROOT).trimEnd('.')
            require(host.contains('.') || host.contains(':')) { "Single-label research hosts are blocked." }
            require(uri.rawQuery.orEmpty().split('&').none {
                var key=it.substringBefore('=')
                repeat(3) { key=runCatching { java.net.URLDecoder.decode(key,"UTF-8") }.getOrDefault(key) }
                key.matches(Regex("(?i).*(token|secret|password|credential|api[_-]?key|authorization).*"))
            }) { "Credential-like URL parameters are not accepted." }
            require(host !in setOf("localhost", "localhost.localdomain") && !host.endsWith(".local") &&
                !host.endsWith(".localhost") && !host.endsWith(".internal") && !host.endsWith(".lan") &&
                !host.endsWith(".home.arpa") && !host.endsWith(".corp") && !host.endsWith(".intranet") &&
                !host.endsWith(".test") && !host.endsWith(".example") && !host.endsWith(".invalid")) {
                "Private or reserved research hosts are blocked."
            }
            if (allowedHosts.isNotEmpty()) {
                require(allowedHosts.any { host == it || host.endsWith(".$it") }) { "Research host is not allowlisted." }
            }
            if(host.contains(':') || host.matches(Regex("[0-9.]+"))) {
                require(runCatching { isPublicAddress(InetAddress.getByName(host)) }.getOrDefault(false)) { "Private or reserved address literal" }
            }
        }
        fun validate(uri:URI,allowedHosts:Set<String> = emptySet(),resolve:(String)->List<InetAddress> = {InetAddress.getAllByName(it).toList()}):List<InetAddress> {
            validateSyntax(uri,allowedHosts)
            val host=uri.host.removePrefix("[").removeSuffix("]").lowercase(Locale.ROOT).trimEnd('.')
            val addresses = runCatching { resolve(host) }
                .getOrElse { throw IllegalArgumentException("Research host could not be resolved.") }
            require(addresses.size in 1..16) { "Research host returned an unsafe number of addresses." }
            require(addresses.isNotEmpty() && addresses.all(::isPublicAddress)) { "Private or reserved network targets are blocked." }
            return addresses.toList()
        }

        private fun isPublicAddress(address: InetAddress): Boolean {
            if (address.isAnyLocalAddress || address.isLoopbackAddress || address.isLinkLocalAddress ||
                address.isSiteLocalAddress || address.isMulticastAddress) return false
            val bytes = address.address
            if (bytes.size == 4) {
                val first = bytes[0].toInt() and 0xff
                val second = bytes[1].toInt() and 0xff
                val third = bytes[2].toInt() and 0xff
                if (first == 0 || first == 10 || first == 127 || first >= 224) return false
                if (first == 100 && second in 64..127) return false
                if (first == 169 && second == 254 || first == 172 && second in 16..31 ||
                    first == 192 && second == 168 || first == 192 && second == 0 ||
                    first == 192 && second == 2 || first == 192 && second == 88 && third == 99 ||
                    first == 198 && second in 18..19 || first == 198 && second == 51 && third == 100 ||
                    first == 203 && second == 0 && third == 113) return false
            } else if (bytes.size == 16) {
                val first = bytes[0].toInt() and 0xff
                if (bytes.take(10).all { it == 0.toByte() } &&
                    (bytes[10].toInt() and 0xff) == 0xff && (bytes[11].toInt() and 0xff) == 0xff) {
                    return isPublicAddress(InetAddress.getByAddress(bytes.copyOfRange(12, 16)))
                }
                if (bytes.take(12).all { it == 0.toByte() }) {
                    return isPublicAddress(InetAddress.getByAddress(bytes.copyOfRange(12, 16)))
                }
                val second = bytes[1].toInt() and 0xff
                val third = bytes[2].toInt() and 0xff
                val fourth = bytes[3].toInt() and 0xff
                if ((first and 0xe0) != 0x20 || (first and 0xfe) == 0xfc ||
                    first == 0x20 && second == 0x01 && third in 0..1 ||
                    first == 0x20 && second == 0x01 && third == 0x0d && fourth == 0xb8 ||
                    first == 0x20 && second == 0x02) return false
            }
            return true
        }
    }

    companion object {
        fun responseText(raw:String,mime:String,keepMarkup:Boolean,limit:Int):String {
            require(limit in 1..100000)
            if(keepMarkup || mime !in setOf("text/html"))return raw.trim().take(limit)
            return raw.replace(Regex("<script\\b[^>]*>[\\s\\S]*?</script\\s*>",RegexOption.IGNORE_CASE)," ")
                .replace(Regex("<style\\b[^>]*>[\\s\\S]*?</style\\s*>",RegexOption.IGNORE_CASE)," ")
                .replace(Regex("<[^>]+>")," ").replace(Regex("\\s+")," ").trim().take(limit)
        }
        private val SAFE_MIME_TYPES = setOf(
            "text/html", "text/plain", "application/json", "application/xml", "text/xml", "application/rss+xml"
        )
        private val REQUEST_TIMEOUTS = Executors.newSingleThreadScheduledExecutor { runnable ->
            Thread(runnable, "device-ai-research-timeout").apply { isDaemon = true }
        }
    }
}

fun interface ClaimExtractor {
    fun extract(document: ResearchDocument): List<Claim>
}

class BaselineClaimExtractor(private val now: () -> Long = System::currentTimeMillis) : ClaimExtractor {
    override fun extract(document: ResearchDocument): List<Claim> =
        document.content.split(Regex("(?<=[.!?])\\s+|\\n+"))
            .map(String::trim)
            .filter { it.length >= 12 }
            .take(100)
            .mapIndexed { index, text ->
                Claim(
                    id = "${sha256Hex(document.url).take(12)}-$index",
                    text = text.take(512),
                    provenance = ProvenanceType.EXTERNAL_SOURCE,
                    sourceReferences = listOf(document.url),
                    createdAt = now()
                )
            }
}

data class ClaimRelationship(val fromId: String, val toId: String, val relation: ClaimRelation)

data class CorroborationPolicy(val minimumIndependentSources: Int = 2) {
    init { require(minimumIndependentSources in 2..10) }

    fun verifiedClaims(
        claims: List<Claim>,
        sourcesByUrl: Map<String, SourceIdentity>,
        relationships: List<ClaimRelationship>
    ): List<Claim> {
        val supportedIds = relationships.filter { it.relation == ClaimRelation.SUPPORTS }
            .flatMap { listOf(it.fromId, it.toId) }.toSet()
        return claims.map { claim ->
            val related = relationships.filter {
                it.relation == ClaimRelation.SUPPORTS && (it.fromId == claim.id || it.toId == claim.id)
            }.flatMap { listOf(it.fromId, it.toId) }.filterNot { it == claim.id }.toSet()
            val independent = (claim.sourceReferences.mapNotNull(sourcesByUrl::get) +
                claims.filter { it.id in related }.flatMap { relatedClaim ->
                    relatedClaim.sourceReferences.mapNotNull(sourcesByUrl::get)
                }).distinctBy { it.domain }
            if (claim.id in supportedIds && independent.size >= minimumIndependentSources) {
                claim.validated(
                    ValidationState.VERIFIED,
                    (claim.sourceReferences + claims.filter { it.id in related }.flatMap { it.sourceReferences }).distinct()
                )
            } else claim
        }
    }
}

data class ResearchSynthesis(
    val documents: List<ResearchDocument>,
    val claims: List<Claim>,
    val relationships: List<ClaimRelationship>,
    val citations: List<ResearchCitation>
)

class ResearchPipeline(
    private val provider: ResearchProvider,
    private val extractor: ClaimExtractor = BaselineClaimExtractor(),
    private val corroborationPolicy: CorroborationPolicy = CorroborationPolicy(),
    private val sourceTrust: SourceTrustStore? = null
) {
    fun research(request: ResearchRequest): ResearchSynthesis {
        val result = provider.retrieve(request)
        val claims = result.documents.flatMap(extractor::extract)
        val relationships = mutableListOf<ClaimRelationship>()
        for (left in claims.indices) for (right in left + 1 until claims.size) {
            val a = claims[left]
            val b = claims[right]
            val aSource = result.documents.firstOrNull { it.url in a.sourceReferences }?.source
            val bSource = result.documents.firstOrNull { it.url in b.sourceReferences }?.source
            if (aSource != null && bSource != null && aSource.domain != bSource.domain) {
                val similarity = similarity(a.text, b.text)
                when {
                    similarity >= 0.7 -> relationships += ClaimRelationship(a.id, b.id, ClaimRelation.SUPPORTS)
                    contradicts(a.text, b.text) -> relationships += ClaimRelationship(a.id, b.id, ClaimRelation.CONTRADICTS)
                }
            }
        }
        val sources = result.documents.associate { it.url to it.source }
        val verified = corroborationPolicy.verifiedClaims(claims, sources, relationships)
        return ResearchSynthesis(result.documents, verified, relationships, result.citations)
    }

    fun recordEvaluatedSource(
        document: ResearchDocument,
        accuracy: Double,
        corroborated: Boolean,
        contradicted: Boolean
    ): SourceTrustProfile? = sourceTrust?.observe(
        SourceObservation(
            document.source, evaluated = true, accuracy = accuracy,
            freshness = 1.0, corroborated = corroborated, contradicted = contradicted
        )
    )

    fun storeClaimMemory(
        claim: Claim,
        store: MemoryStore,
        writePolicy: MemoryWritePolicy,
        durableKnowledge: Boolean
    ): MemoryRecord? {
        val decision = writePolicy.decide(
            MemoryWriteContext(
                memoryType = MemoryType.SEMANTIC,
                provenance = claim.provenance,
                confidence = claim.confidence,
                durableKnowledge = durableKnowledge
            )
        )
        if (!decision.shouldWrite) return null
        return MemoryRecord(
            id = "research-${claim.id}",
            type = MemoryType.SEMANTIC,
            content = claim.text,
            provenance = claim.provenance,
            confidence = claim.confidence,
            createdAt = claim.createdAt,
            updatedAt = claim.createdAt,
            sourceReference = claim.sourceReferences.firstOrNull(),
            validationState = claim.validationState,
            privacyClass = decision.privacyClass,
            validationEvidenceReferences = claim.validationEvidenceReferences
        ).also(store::put)
    }

    private fun similarity(first: String, second: String): Double {
        val a = tokens(first)
        val b = tokens(second)
        if (a.isEmpty() || b.isEmpty()) return 0.0
        return a.intersect(b).size.toDouble() / a.union(b).size
    }

    private fun contradicts(first: String, second: String): Boolean {
        val a = tokens(first)
        val b = tokens(second)
        val negations = setOf("not", "no", "never", "false", "cannot", "isn't", "doesn't")
        return similarity(first, second) >= 0.45 && a.intersect(negations).isEmpty() != b.intersect(negations).isEmpty()
    }

    private fun tokens(text: String) = text.lowercase(Locale.ROOT)
        .split(Regex("[^\\p{L}\\p{N}']+")).filter(String::isNotBlank).toSet()
}

package at.heinz.deviceai.cognitive

import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream
import java.io.DataInputStream

class FileResearchDossierStore(private val directory: File) :
    ResearchDossierRepository, ResearchCheckpointStore {
    private val dossierFile = File(directory, "research-dossier.bin")
    private val checkpointFile = File(directory, "research-checkpoint.bin")

    @Synchronized
    override fun save(dossier: ResearchDossier) {
        writeAtomically(dossierFile) { out -> out.writeDossier(dossier) }
    }

    @Synchronized
    fun loadDossier(): ResearchDossier? = if (!dossierFile.exists()) null else readEnvelope(dossierFile) {
        it.readDossier().also { dossier -> require(it.available() == 0) }
    }

    @Synchronized
    override fun loadLatest(): ResearchDossier? = loadDossier()

    @Synchronized
    override fun save(checkpoint: ResearchRunCheckpoint) {
        writeAtomically(checkpointFile) { out ->
            out.writeString(checkpoint.dossierId)
            out.writeInt(checkpoint.phase.ordinal)
            out.writeStrings(checkpoint.completedSourceHashes.toList())
            out.writeStrings(checkpoint.completedUrls.toList())
            out.writeLong(checkpoint.updatedAt)
            out.writeInt(checkpoint.totalBytes)
        }
    }

    @Synchronized
    override fun load(): ResearchRunCheckpoint? = if (!checkpointFile.exists()) null else readEnvelope(checkpointFile) {
        val checkpoint = ResearchRunCheckpoint(
            it.readString(64),
            ResearchPhase.values().getOrNull(it.readInt()) ?: error("Unknown research phase."),
            it.readStrings(24, 64).toSet(),
            it.readStrings(24, 4_096).toSet(),
            it.readLong(),
            it.readInt()
        )
        require(it.available() == 0)
        checkpoint
    }

    @Synchronized
    fun clearCheckpoint() {
        checkpointFile.delete()
    }

    private fun writeAtomically(file: File, encode: (DataOutputStream) -> Unit) {
        directory.mkdirs()
        val payloadBuffer = ByteArrayOutputStream()
        DataOutputStream(payloadBuffer).use(encode)
        val payload = payloadBuffer.toByteArray()
        require(payload.size in 1..MAX_BYTES) { "Research dossier exceeds its storage limit." }
        val temp = File.createTempFile("research-", ".tmp", directory)
        try {
            temp.outputStream().use { raw ->
                DataOutputStream(raw).use { out ->
                    out.writeUTF(MAGIC)
                    out.writeInt(SCHEMA_VERSION)
                    out.writeInt(payload.size)
                    out.write(payload)
                    out.write(sha256(payload))
                    out.flush()
                }
            }
            Files.move(temp.toPath(), file.toPath(), StandardCopyOption.ATOMIC_MOVE, StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING)
        } finally {
            temp.delete()
        }
    }

    private fun <T> readEnvelope(file: File, decode: (DataInputStream) -> T): T {
        require(file.length() in 1..(MAX_BYTES + 64).toLong()) { "Invalid research record size." }
        val bytes = file.readBytes()
        val envelope = DataInputStream(ByteArrayInputStream(bytes))
        require(envelope.readUTF() == MAGIC) { "Unrecognized research record." }
        require(envelope.readInt() == SCHEMA_VERSION) { "Unsupported research schema." }
        val size = envelope.readInt()
        require(size in 1..MAX_BYTES && size + CHECKSUM_BYTES == envelope.available()) { "Invalid research payload size." }
        val payload = ByteArray(size)
        envelope.readFully(payload)
        val checksum = ByteArray(CHECKSUM_BYTES)
        envelope.readFully(checksum)
        require(envelope.available() == 0 && MessageDigest.isEqual(checksum, sha256(payload))) {
            "Research record integrity check failed."
        }
        return decode(DataInputStream(ByteArrayInputStream(payload)))
    }

    private fun DataOutputStream.writeDossier(value: ResearchDossier) {
        writeString(value.id); writeLong(value.createdAt); writeLong(value.updatedAt)
        writePlan(value.plan); writeInt(value.phase.ordinal)
        writeInt(value.sources.size)
        value.sources.forEach { source ->
            writeString(source.canonicalUrl); writeNullableString(source.title); writeLong(source.retrievedAt)
            writeString(source.contentHash); writeString(source.domain); writeNullableString(source.duplicateOf)
            writeString(source.snippet); writeBoolean(source.trust.evaluated); writeDouble(source.trust.score)
            writeString(source.trust.explanation); writeDouble(source.trust.authority)
            writeDouble(source.trust.relevance); writeDouble(source.trust.freshness)
            writeDouble(source.trust.corroboration); writeDouble(source.trust.duplicatePenalty)
            writeNullableString(source.versionApplicability); writeNullableString(source.dateApplicability)
        }
        writeInt(value.graph.claims.size); value.graph.claims.forEach { writeClaim(it) }
        writeInt(value.graph.evidence.size); value.graph.evidence.forEach { link ->
            writeString(link.claimId); writeString(link.sourceUrl); writeInt(link.relation.ordinal)
            writeDouble(link.supportScore); writeString(link.explanation)
        }
        writeInt(value.graph.relationships.size); value.graph.relationships.forEach { edge ->
            writeString(edge.fromClaimId); writeString(edge.toClaimId); writeInt(edge.relation.ordinal)
        }
        writeDoubleMap(value.graph.coverage)
        writeInt(value.graph.independentSourceCounts.size)
        value.graph.independentSourceCounts.toSortedMap().forEach { (key, count) -> writeString(key); writeInt(count) }
        writeInt(value.gaps.size); value.gaps.forEach {
            writeString(it.questionId); writeString(it.reason); writeString(it.suggestedQuery)
            writeBoolean(it.counterEvidence)
        }
        writeNullableString(value.synthesis?.text)
        writeStrings(value.completedSourceHashes.toList())
        writeBoolean(value.generalSearchAvailable); writeNullableString(value.partialReason)
        writeInt(value.rounds.size); value.rounds.forEach { round ->
            writeInt(round.number); writeInt(round.phase.ordinal); writeStrings(round.queryIds)
            writeStrings(round.sourceUrls); writeLong(round.startedAt)
            writeBoolean(round.completedAt != null); round.completedAt?.let { writeLong(it) }
        }
        writeInt(value.privacyClass.ordinal)
    }

    private fun DataInputStream.readDossier(): ResearchDossier {
        val id = readString(64); val created = readLong(); val updated = readLong()
        val plan = readPlan()
        val phase = ResearchPhase.values().getOrNull(readInt()) ?: error("Unknown research phase.")
        val sources = List(readCount(24)) {
            val url = readString(4_096)
            val title = readNullableString(256)
            val retrievedAt = readLong()
            val contentHash = readString(64)
            val domain = readString(512)
            val duplicateOf = readNullableString(4_096)
            val snippet = readString(2_048)
            val trust = SourceTrustSnapshot(
                readBoolean(), readDouble(), readString(256), readDouble(), readDouble(),
                readDouble(), readDouble(), readDouble()
            )
            val version = readNullableString(128)
            val date = readNullableString(128)
            ResearchSource(url, title, retrievedAt, contentHash, domain, duplicateOf, snippet, trust, version, date)
        }
        val claims = List(readCount(256)) { readClaim() }
        val evidence = List(readCount(2_048)) {
            ClaimEvidenceLink(
                readString(128), readString(4_096),
                EvidenceRelation.values().getOrNull(readInt()) ?: error("Unknown evidence relation."),
                readDouble(), readString(256)
            )
        }
        val edges = List(readCount(2_048)) {
            ResearchClaimEdge(
                readString(128), readString(128),
                ClaimRelation.values().getOrNull(readInt()) ?: error("Unknown claim relation.")
            )
        }
        val coverage = readDoubleMap(256)
        val independent = List(readCount(256)) { readString(128) to readInt() }.toMap()
        val gaps = List(readCount(32)) {
            ResearchGap(readString(64), readString(256), readString(512), readBoolean())
        }
        val synthesis = readNullableString(8_000)?.let(::ResearchSynthesisOutput)
        val hashes = readStrings(24, 64).toSet()
        val generalSearchAvailable = readBoolean()
        val partialReason = readNullableString(512)
        val rounds = List(readCount(3)) {
            val number = readInt()
            val roundPhase = ResearchPhase.values().getOrNull(readInt()) ?: error("Unknown research round phase.")
            val queries = readStrings(12, 48)
            val urls = readStrings(24, 4_096)
            val started = readLong()
            val completed = if (readBoolean()) readLong() else null
            ResearchRound(number, roundPhase, queries, urls, started, completed)
        }
        val privacyClass = PrivacyClass.values().getOrNull(readInt())
            ?: error("Unknown research dossier privacy classification.")
        return ResearchDossier(
            id, created, updated, plan, phase, sources,
            ResearchEvidenceGraph(claims, evidence, edges, coverage, independent),
            gaps, synthesis, hashes, generalSearchAvailable, partialReason, rounds, privacyClass
        )
    }

    private fun DataOutputStream.writePlan(plan: ResearchPlan) {
        writeInt(plan.mode.ordinal); writeString(plan.question)
        writeInt(plan.questions.size); plan.questions.forEach {
            writeString(it.id); writeString(it.text); writeInt(it.importance)
        }
        writeInt(plan.paths.size); plan.paths.forEach {
            writeString(it.id); writeString(it.query.text); writeString(it.query.questionId)
            writeBoolean(it.query.counterEvidence)
        }
        val b = plan.budget
        writeInt(b.maxDiscoveryQueries); writeInt(b.maxResearchRounds); writeInt(b.maxSourcesFetched)
        writeInt(b.maxBytesPerSource); writeInt(b.maxTotalBytes); writeInt(b.maxClaims)
        writeInt(b.maxRedirects); writeInt(b.requestTimeoutMillis); writeLong(b.totalDeadlineMillis)
        writeInt(b.maxCounterEvidenceAttempts); writeInt(b.maxFollowUpQueries); writeInt(b.maxSourcesPerDomain)
    }

    private fun DataInputStream.readPlan(): ResearchPlan {
        val mode = ResearchMode.values().getOrNull(readInt()) ?: error("Unknown research mode.")
        val question = readString(2_048)
        val questions = List(readCount(32)) { ResearchQuestion(readString(48), readString(512), readInt()) }
        val paths = List(readCount(12)) {
            ResearchSearchPath(readString(48), ResearchQuery(readString(512), readString(48), readBoolean()))
        }
        val budget = ResearchBudgetPolicy(
            readInt(), readInt(), readInt(), readInt(), readInt(), readInt(), readInt(), readInt(),
            readLong(), readInt(), readInt(), readInt()
        )
        return ResearchPlan(mode, question, questions, paths, budget)
    }

    private fun DataOutputStream.writeClaim(claim: Claim) {
        writeString(claim.id); writeString(claim.text); writeInt(claim.provenance.ordinal)
        writeStrings(claim.sourceReferences); writeInt(claim.validationState.ordinal); writeDouble(claim.confidence)
        writeLong(claim.createdAt); writeStrings(claim.validationEvidenceReferences)
    }

    private fun DataInputStream.readClaim() = Claim(
        readString(128), readString(2_048),
        ProvenanceType.values().getOrNull(readInt()) ?: error("Unknown claim provenance."),
        readStrings(24, 4_096),
        ValidationState.values().getOrNull(readInt()) ?: error("Unknown validation state."),
        readDouble(), readLong(), readStrings(24, 4_096)
    )

    private fun DataOutputStream.writeDoubleMap(map: Map<String, Double>) {
        writeInt(map.size); map.toSortedMap().forEach { (key, value) -> writeString(key); writeDouble(value) }
    }

    private fun DataInputStream.readDoubleMap(max: Int): Map<String, Double> =
        List(readCount(max)) { readString(128) to readDouble() }.toMap().also {
            require(it.values.all { value -> value.isFinite() && value in 0.0..1.0 })
        }

    private fun DataOutputStream.writeStrings(values: List<String>) {
        writeInt(values.size); values.forEach { writeString(it) }
    }

    private fun DataInputStream.readStrings(max: Int, maxLength: Int): List<String> =
        List(readCount(max)) { readString(maxLength) }

    private fun DataOutputStream.writeString(value: String) {
        require(value.length <= 8_000)
        val bytes = value.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8)
        require(bytes.size <= MAX_STRING_BYTES)
        writeInt(bytes.size); write(bytes)
    }

    private fun DataInputStream.readString(maxLength: Int): String {
        val size = readInt()
        require(size in 0..MAX_STRING_BYTES && size <= available())
        val bytes = ByteArray(size); readFully(bytes)
        return String(bytes, Charsets.UTF_8).also { require(it.length <= maxLength) }
    }

    private fun DataOutputStream.writeNullableString(value: String?) {
        writeBoolean(value != null); if (value != null) writeString(value)
    }

    private fun DataInputStream.readNullableString(maxLength: Int = 8_000): String? =
        if (readBoolean()) readString(maxLength) else null

    private fun DataInputStream.readCount(max: Int): Int = readInt().also { require(it in 0..max) }

    companion object {
        private const val MAGIC = "DEVICE_AI_RESEARCH"
        private const val SCHEMA_VERSION = 3
        private const val MAX_BYTES = 1_000_000
        private const val MAX_STRING_BYTES = 32_000
        private const val CHECKSUM_BYTES = 32

        private fun sha256(bytes: ByteArray) = MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256").digest(bytes)
    }
}

package at.heinz.deviceai.cognitive

import java.net.URI
import java.util.Locale
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicBoolean
import java.util.concurrent.FutureTask
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit

enum class ResearchMode { QUICK, STANDARD, DEEP }

object ResearchOptInPolicy {
    fun shouldResearch(question: String, explicitButtonSelected: Boolean): Boolean =
        explicitButtonSelected && question.isNotBlank()
}

data class ResearchBudgetPolicy(
    val maxDiscoveryQueries: Int,
    val maxResearchRounds: Int,
    val maxSourcesFetched: Int,
    val maxBytesPerSource: Int,
    val maxTotalBytes: Int,
    val maxClaims: Int,
    val maxRedirects: Int,
    val requestTimeoutMillis: Int,
    val totalDeadlineMillis: Long,
    val maxCounterEvidenceAttempts: Int,
    val maxFollowUpQueries: Int,
    val maxSourcesPerDomain: Int = 2
) {
    init {
        require(maxDiscoveryQueries in 1..12 && maxResearchRounds in 1..3)
        require(maxSourcesFetched in 1..24 && maxBytesPerSource in 1..512_000)
        require(maxTotalBytes in maxBytesPerSource..2_000_000 && maxClaims in 1..256)
        require(maxRedirects in 0..5 && requestTimeoutMillis in 1..30_000)
        require(totalDeadlineMillis in requestTimeoutMillis.toLong()..120_000L)
        require(maxCounterEvidenceAttempts in 0..8 && maxFollowUpQueries in 0..8)
        require(maxSourcesPerDomain in 1..4)
    }

    companion object {
        fun forMode(mode: ResearchMode): ResearchBudgetPolicy = when (mode) {
            ResearchMode.QUICK -> ResearchBudgetPolicy(2, 1, 3, 64_000, 128_000, 32, 1, 5_000, 15_000, 0, 0)
            ResearchMode.STANDARD -> ResearchBudgetPolicy(5, 2, 8, 128_000, 512_000, 96, 3, 8_000, 45_000, 2, 3)
            ResearchMode.DEEP -> ResearchBudgetPolicy(10, 3, 16, 256_000, 1_500_000, 192, 4, 10_000, 90_000, 8, 8)
        }
    }
}

data class ResearchQuestion(val id: String, val text: String, val importance: Int = 1) {
    init { require(id.matches(Regex("[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,48}")) && text.isNotBlank() && text.length <= 512 && importance in 1..5) }
}

data class ResearchQuery(val text: String, val questionId: String, val counterEvidence: Boolean = false) {
    init { require(text.isNotBlank() && text.length <= 512 && questionId.isNotBlank()) }
}

data class ResearchSearchPath(val id: String, val query: ResearchQuery) {
    init { require(id.matches(Regex("[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,48}"))) }
}

data class ResearchPlan(
    val mode: ResearchMode,
    val question: String,
    val questions: List<ResearchQuestion>,
    val paths: List<ResearchSearchPath>,
    val budget: ResearchBudgetPolicy
) {
    init {
        require(question.isNotBlank() && question.length <= 2_048)
        require(questions.size in 1..32 && questions.map { it.id }.distinct().size == questions.size)
        require(paths.size <= budget.maxDiscoveryQueries && paths.map { it.id }.distinct().size == paths.size)
        require(budget == ResearchBudgetPolicy.forMode(mode))
        require(paths.all { path -> questions.any { it.id == path.query.questionId } })
        require(paths.count { it.query.counterEvidence } <= budget.maxCounterEvidenceAttempts)
    }
}

fun interface ResearchPlanner {
    fun plan(question: String, mode: ResearchMode): ResearchPlan
}

class DeterministicResearchPlanner : ResearchPlanner {
    override fun plan(question: String, mode: ResearchMode): ResearchPlan {
        require(question.isNotBlank() && question.length <= 2_048)
        val budget = ResearchBudgetPolicy.forMode(mode)
        val fragments = question.split(Regex("[?!.;\\n]+|\\b(?:and|and also|sowie)\\b", RegexOption.IGNORE_CASE))
            .map(String::trim).filter(String::isNotBlank).distinct().take(8)
            .ifEmpty { listOf(question.trim()) }
        val questions = fragments.mapIndexed { index, text ->
            ResearchQuestion("q$index", text.take(512), if (index == 0) 3 else 2)
        }
        val paths = mutableListOf<ResearchSearchPath>()
        questions.forEach { subquestion ->
            if (paths.size < budget.maxDiscoveryQueries) {
                paths += ResearchSearchPath("search-${paths.size}", ResearchQuery(subquestion.text, subquestion.id))
            }
        }
        if (mode == ResearchMode.DEEP && paths.size < budget.maxDiscoveryQueries &&
            budget.maxCounterEvidenceAttempts > 0) {
            paths += ResearchSearchPath(
                "counter-${paths.size}",
                ResearchQuery("Find credible evidence that challenges or falsifies: ${questions.first().text}".take(512),
                    questions.first().id, counterEvidence = true)
            )
        }
        return ResearchPlan(mode, question, questions, paths, budget)
    }
}

fun interface ResearchPlanGenerator {
    fun generate(question: String, mode: ResearchMode, budget: ResearchBudgetPolicy): ResearchPlan
}

class BoundedResearchPlanner(private val generator: ResearchPlanGenerator) : ResearchPlanner {
    override fun plan(question: String, mode: ResearchMode): ResearchPlan {
        require(question.isNotBlank() && question.length <= 2_048)
        val budget = ResearchBudgetPolicy.forMode(mode)
        val proposed = generator.generate(question, mode, budget)
        require(proposed.question == question && proposed.mode == mode && proposed.budget == budget)
        val questions = proposed.questions.take(8).distinctBy { it.id }
            .ifEmpty { listOf(ResearchQuestion("q0", question.take(512))) }
        val validIds = questions.map { it.id }.toSet()
        val paths = proposed.paths.asSequence()
            .filter { it.query.questionId in validIds }
            .distinctBy { it.query.text.lowercase(Locale.ROOT) }
            .take(budget.maxDiscoveryQueries)
            .toMutableList()
        val counters = paths.filter { it.query.counterEvidence }.take(budget.maxCounterEvidenceAttempts)
        val counterIds = counters.map { it.id }.toSet()
        val boundedPaths = paths.filterNot { it.query.counterEvidence || it.id in counterIds } + counters
        return ResearchPlan(mode, question, questions, boundedPaths, budget)
    }
}

data class ResearchSourceCandidate(val url: String, val title: String? = null, val discoveredBy: String = "seed") {
    init { require(url.isNotBlank() && url.length <= 4_096 && (title?.length ?: 0) <= 256 && discoveredBy.length <= 64) }
}

interface ResearchDiscoveryProvider {
    val isGeneralSearchAvailable: Boolean
    fun discover(query: ResearchQuery): List<ResearchSourceCandidate>
}

class UnconfiguredResearchDiscoveryProvider : ResearchDiscoveryProvider {
    override val isGeneralSearchAvailable = false
    override fun discover(query: ResearchQuery) = emptyList<ResearchSourceCandidate>()
}

class SeedUrlResearchDiscoveryProvider(private val seedUrls: List<String>) : ResearchDiscoveryProvider {
    override val isGeneralSearchAvailable = false
    override fun discover(query: ResearchQuery) = seedUrls.take(24).map { ResearchSourceCandidate(it) }
}

object ResearchUrlCanonicalizer {
    private val trackingParameters = Regex("(?i)^(utm_.+|fbclid|gclid|mc_cid|mc_eid)$")

    fun canonicalize(value: String): String {
        require(value.length <= 4_096)
        val uri = URI(value.trim()).normalize()
        require(uri.scheme.equals("https", ignoreCase = true) && uri.host != null && uri.userInfo == null)
        require(uri.port == -1 || uri.port == 443)
        val host = uri.host.lowercase(Locale.ROOT).trimEnd('.')
        val path = uri.rawPath.orEmpty().ifBlank { "/" }
        val query = uri.rawQuery.orEmpty().split('&').filter(String::isNotBlank)
            .filterNot { trackingParameters.matches(it.substringBefore('=')) }
            .sorted().joinToString("&").ifBlank { null }
        return URI("https://"+host+path+(query?.let { "?"+it } ?: "")).toASCIIString()
    }
}

    val score: Double,
    val explanation: String,
    val authority: Double = 0.5,
    val relevance: Double = 0.0,
    val freshness: Double = 0.5,

data class ResearchSource(
    val canonicalUrl: String,
    val title: String?,
    val retrievedAt: Long,
    val contentHash: String,
    val domain: String,
