package at.heinz.deviceai.learning

import java.io.File
import java.nio.file.AtomicMoveNotSupportedException
import java.nio.file.Files
import java.nio.file.StandardCopyOption
import java.util.Locale

data class ReviewedWebObservation(val text:String,val url:String,val sourceHash:String)

data class ContinualLearningReport(
    val task:String,
    val accepted:Boolean,
    val steps:Int,
    val replayExamples:Int,
    val trainingBefore:SubwordEvaluation,
    val trainingAfter:SubwordEvaluation,
    val holdoutBefore:SubwordEvaluation,
    val holdoutAfter:SubwordEvaluation,
    val experienceIds:List<String>,
    val reason:String,
    /** False for cancellation/time-budget interruption; never mark source hashes completed. */
    val completedEvaluation:Boolean=true
)

enum class OwnerFactChange { ADDED, REACTIVATED, ALREADY_ACTIVE }

/**
 * Explicit owner ratings are feedback metadata, not supervised labels.
 * A positive rating does not prove factual correctness, and ratings must
 * never be replayed as semantic/intent training examples.
 */
data class ContinuumFeedbackSummary(val positive:Int,val negative:Int,val revoked:Int)
data class ContinuumCorrectionSummary(val active:Int,val revoked:Int)


data class ContinuumLearningStatus(
    val experiences:LearningExperienceStats,
    val modelUpdates:Int,
    val parameters:Int,
    val intentHoldout:SubwordEvaluation,
    val semanticHoldout:SubwordEvaluation,
    val lastAudit:String?
)

/**
 * Persistent local continual-learning coordinator.
 *
 * Every training round starts from the last committed encoder snapshot, replays
 * bounded prior experiences, measures frozen holdouts and commits candidate
 * weights only when regression gates pass. A rejected candidate is discarded.
 */
class ContinuumLearningCore(
    baseDirectory:File,
    private val nowMillis:()->Long=System::currentTimeMillis
) {
    private val directory=File(baseDirectory,"learning-core-v2")
    private val store=FileLearningExperienceStore(directory)
    private val modelFile=File(directory,"subword-v1.bin")
    private val modelBackup=File(directory,"subword-v1.lkg")
    private val dialogue=ContinuumMemoryDialogue(directory)
    private val checkpoints=ModelCheckpointStore(File(directory,"checkpoints"))

    /** Offline public curriculum: no owner interaction, no network and no private data.
     * Runs once per persisted model. Holdout gates reject regressions.
     */
    fun bootstrapOfflineCurriculum(cancelled:()->Boolean={false}):ContinualLearningReport? =
        synchronized(CORE_LOCK) {
            // Audit is the idempotency marker, including rejected candidates.
            // Imported weights or owner lessons must never be silently retrained.
            if (store.all().any {
                    it.type==LearningExperienceType.TRAINING_AUDIT &&
                    it.annotation=="offline-bootstrap"
                } || loadModel().updates > 0 ||
                store.all().any {
                    it.type==LearningExperienceType.INTENT_LABEL ||
                    it.type==LearningExperienceType.USER_FACT
                }) return@synchronized null
            val baseline=loadModel()
            val candidate=TrainableSubwordEncoder.restore(baseline.save())
            val before=candidate.evaluateIntent(INTENT_BOOTSTRAP)
            val holdoutBefore=candidate.evaluateIntent(INTENT_HOLDOUT)
            val otherBefore=candidate.evaluateSemantic(SEMANTIC_HOLDOUT)
            val train=candidate.trainIntent(INTENT_BOOTSTRAP,steps=650,maxMillis=2500,cancelled=cancelled)
            val after=candidate.evaluateIntent(INTENT_BOOTSTRAP)
            val holdoutAfter=candidate.evaluateIntent(INTENT_HOLDOUT)
            val otherAfter=candidate.evaluateSemantic(SEMANTIC_HOLDOUT)
            // The audit is this stage's run-once marker: an interrupted run (job
            // stopped, app closed) writes none, so the stage runs again later.
            if(interrupted(cancelled))return@synchronized interruptedReport("offline-bootstrap",train.steps,
                before,after,holdoutBefore,holdoutAfter)
            val accepted=!cancelled() && !train.stoppedEarly &&
                after.loss+1e-7<before.loss && retains(holdoutBefore,holdoutAfter) &&
                retains(otherBefore,otherAfter)
            if(accepted) saveModel(candidate.save(),"offline-bootstrap")
            val reason=if(accepted) "Öffentliches Offline-Curriculum verbessert; Holdouts geschützt"
                else "Offline-Kandidat verworfen; bisherige Gewichte erhalten"
            appendAudit("offline-bootstrap",accepted,train.steps,before,after,
                holdoutBefore,holdoutAfter,emptyList(),reason)
            ContinualLearningReport("offline-bootstrap",accepted,train.steps,0,before,after,
                holdoutBefore,holdoutAfter,emptyList(),reason)
        }

    /** Bounded autonomous public semantic curriculum, no network or owner labels.
     * Only attempts after the initial bootstrap and at most once per local model.
     */
    fun bootstrapSemanticCurriculum(cancelled:()->Boolean={false}):ContinualLearningReport? =
        synchronized(CORE_LOCK) {
            if (store.all().any {
                    it.type==LearningExperienceType.TRAINING_AUDIT &&
                    it.annotation=="offline-semantic-bootstrap"
                } || store.all().any {
                    it.type==LearningExperienceType.INTENT_LABEL ||
                    it.type==LearningExperienceType.USER_FACT
                }) return@synchronized null
            val baseline=loadModel()
            val candidate=TrainableSubwordEncoder.restore(baseline.save())
            val before=candidate.evaluateSemantic(SEMANTIC_BOOTSTRAP)
            val holdoutBefore=candidate.evaluateSemantic(SEMANTIC_HOLDOUT)
            val intentBefore=candidate.evaluateIntent(INTENT_HOLDOUT)
            val train=candidate.trainSemantic(SEMANTIC_BOOTSTRAP,steps=550,
                maxMillis=2500,cancelled=cancelled)
            val after=candidate.evaluateSemantic(SEMANTIC_BOOTSTRAP)
            val holdoutAfter=candidate.evaluateSemantic(SEMANTIC_HOLDOUT)
            val intentAfter=candidate.evaluateIntent(INTENT_HOLDOUT)
            if(interrupted(cancelled))return@synchronized interruptedReport("offline-semantic-bootstrap",train.steps,
                before,after,holdoutBefore,holdoutAfter)
            val accepted=!cancelled() && !train.stoppedEarly &&
                after.loss+1e-7<before.loss && retains(holdoutBefore,holdoutAfter) &&
                retains(intentBefore,intentAfter)
            if(accepted)saveModel(candidate.save(),"offline-semantic-bootstrap")
            val reason=if(accepted) "Öffentliches Semantiktraining verbessert; Holdouts geschützt"
                else "Semantikkandidat verworfen; bisherige Gewichte erhalten"
            appendAudit("offline-semantic-bootstrap",accepted,train.steps,before,after,
                holdoutBefore,holdoutAfter,emptyList(),reason)
            ContinualLearningReport("offline-semantic-bootstrap",accepted,train.steps,0,
                before,after,holdoutBefore,holdoutAfter,emptyList(),reason)
        }

    fun teachIntent(
        text:String,
        label:Int,
        cancelled:()->Boolean={false}
    ):ContinualLearningReport = synchronized(CORE_LOCK) {
        require(label in 0..1 && text.trim().length in 3..320)
        val experience=LearningExperienceFactory.create(
            type=LearningExperienceType.INTENT_LABEL,
            provenance=LearningProvenance.USER_CONFIRMED,
            trust=LearningTrustClass.OWNER_CONFIRMED,
            status=LearningStatus.CONFIRMED,
            content=text.trim(),
            annotation=label.toString(),
            now=nowMillis()
        )
        store.append(experience)

        val baseline=loadModel()
        val candidate=TrainableSubwordEncoder.restore(baseline.save())
        val replay=store.replay(LearningExperienceType.INTENT_LABEL,64)
            .mapNotNull { item ->
                val itemLabel=item.annotation?.toIntOrNull()
                if(itemLabel in 0..1)SubwordIntentExample(item.content,itemLabel!!) else null
            }
            .distinctBy { it.text.lowercase(Locale.ROOT) to it.label }
        val training=(INTENT_BOOTSTRAP+replay).takeLast(96)
        val before=candidate.evaluateIntent(training)
        val holdoutBefore=candidate.evaluateIntent(INTENT_HOLDOUT)
        val otherBefore=candidate.evaluateSemantic(SEMANTIC_HOLDOUT)
        val train=candidate.trainIntent(
            training,steps=650,maxMillis=2500,cancelled=cancelled
        )
        val after=candidate.evaluateIntent(training)
        val holdoutAfter=candidate.evaluateIntent(INTENT_HOLDOUT)
        val otherAfter=candidate.evaluateSemantic(SEMANTIC_HOLDOUT)
        val otherRetained=retains(otherBefore,otherAfter)
        val newScore=candidate.intentScore(experience.content)
        val learnedNew=if(label==1)newScore>=0.55 else newScore<=0.45
        val accepted=!cancelled() && !train.stoppedEarly && learnedNew && otherRetained &&
            after.loss+1e-7<before.loss &&
            holdoutAfter.correct>=holdoutBefore.correct &&
            holdoutAfter.loss<=holdoutBefore.loss+0.035
        if(accepted) {
            saveModel(candidate.save(),"intent")
            store.updateStatus(experience.id,LearningStatus.LEARNED,nowMillis())
        } else {
            store.updateStatus(experience.id,LearningStatus.REPLAY_PENDING,nowMillis())
        }
        val reason=when {
            cancelled() || train.stoppedEarly -> "Abgebrochen; Snapshot unverändert"
            !learnedNew -> "Neue bestätigte Lektion noch nicht ausreichend gelernt"
            !otherRetained -> "Gemeinsame Gewichte würden semantisches Wissen verschlechtern"
            holdoutAfter.correct<holdoutBefore.correct -> "Intent-Holdout würde Treffer verlieren"
            holdoutAfter.loss>holdoutBefore.loss+0.035 -> "Intent-Holdout-Verlust überschreitet Regressionsgrenze"
            after.loss>=before.loss-1e-7 -> "Replay-Trainingsverlust nicht verbessert"
            else -> "Replay verbessert und fester Intent-Holdout nicht verschlechtert"
        }
        appendAudit("intent",accepted,train.steps,before,after,holdoutBefore,holdoutAfter,
            listOf(experience.id),reason)
        ContinualLearningReport(
            "intent",accepted,train.steps,replay.size,before,after,
            holdoutBefore,holdoutAfter,listOf(experience.id),reason
        )
    }

    fun learnFromSources(
        sources:List<MentorSource>,
        cancelled:()->Boolean={false}
    ):ContinualLearningReport? = synchronized(CORE_LOCK) {
        if(sources.isEmpty())return@synchronized null
        sources.forEach(MentorSourceValidation::checkSource)
        val ids=mutableListOf<String>()
        sources.forEach { source ->
            val experience=LearningExperienceFactory.create(
                type=LearningExperienceType.SOURCE_TEXT,
                provenance=LearningProvenance.MENTOR_WIKIPEDIA,
                trust=LearningTrustClass.SOURCE_OBSERVATION,
                status=LearningStatus.OBSERVED,
                content=source.excerpt,
                annotation=source.subject,
                sourceRef=source.url+"#sha256="+source.sha,
                now=nowMillis()
            )
            store.append(experience)
            ids+=experience.id
        }

        val replay=store.replay(LearningExperienceType.SOURCE_TEXT,48)
        val positives=replay.mapNotNull { item ->
            val topic=item.annotation?.takeIf { it.length>=3 } ?: return@mapNotNull null
            SubwordSemanticExample(topic,item.content,true)
        }
        val sourcePairs=positives.takeLast(48)
        val training=(SEMANTIC_BOOTSTRAP+sourcePairs).takeLast(96)
        val baseline=loadModel()
        val candidate=TrainableSubwordEncoder.restore(baseline.save())
        val before=candidate.evaluateSemantic(training)
        val holdoutBefore=candidate.evaluateSemantic(SEMANTIC_HOLDOUT)
        val protectedIntent=(INTENT_HOLDOUT+ownerIntentReplay()).take(128)
        val otherBefore=candidate.evaluateIntent(protectedIntent)
        val train=candidate.trainSemantic(
            training,steps=550,maxMillis=2500,cancelled=cancelled
        )
        val after=candidate.evaluateSemantic(training)
        val holdoutAfter=candidate.evaluateSemantic(SEMANTIC_HOLDOUT)
        val otherAfter=candidate.evaluateIntent(protectedIntent)
        val otherRetained=retains(otherBefore,otherAfter)
        val accepted=!cancelled() && !train.stoppedEarly && otherRetained &&
            after.loss+1e-7<before.loss &&
            holdoutAfter.correct>=holdoutBefore.correct &&
            holdoutAfter.loss<=holdoutBefore.loss+0.045
        if(accepted)saveModel(candidate.save(),"semantic")
        ids.forEach { id ->
            store.updateStatus(id,
                if(accepted)LearningStatus.LEARNED else LearningStatus.REPLAY_PENDING,
                nowMillis())
        }
        val reason=when {
            cancelled() || train.stoppedEarly -> "Abgebrochen; Snapshot unverändert"
            !otherRetained -> "Gemeinsame Gewichte würden Intent oder persönliche Lektionen verschlechtern"
            holdoutAfter.correct<holdoutBefore.correct -> "Semantik-Holdout würde Treffer verlieren"
            holdoutAfter.loss>holdoutBefore.loss+0.045 -> "Semantik-Holdout-Verlust überschreitet Regressionsgrenze"
            after.loss>=before.loss-1e-7 -> "Quellen-Replay-Verlust nicht verbessert"
            else -> "Quellenkontexte verbessert; semantischer Holdout nicht verschlechtert"
        }
        appendAudit("semantic",accepted,train.steps,before,after,holdoutBefore,holdoutAfter,ids,reason)
        ContinualLearningReport(
            "semantic",accepted,train.steps,replay.size,before,after,
            holdoutBefore,holdoutAfter,ids,reason,
            completedEvaluation=!cancelled() && !train.stoppedEarly
        )
    }

    /** Already owner-reviewed notes join retrieval, never become truth labels. */
    private fun reviewedExperience(note:ReviewedWebObservation):LearningExperience {
        require(note.text.length in 20..400 && note.url.length in 10..400 && note.sourceHash.matches(Regex("[a-f0-9]{64}")))
        val uri=java.net.URI(note.url)
        require(uri.scheme=="https" && !uri.host.isNullOrBlank() && uri.userInfo==null)
        return LearningExperienceFactory.create(
            LearningExperienceType.SOURCE_TEXT,LearningProvenance.REVIEWED_WEB_SOURCE,
            LearningTrustClass.SOURCE_OBSERVATION,LearningStatus.OBSERVED,note.text,
            sourceRef=note.url+"#sha256="+note.sourceHash,now=nowMillis()
        )
    }

    fun recordReviewedWebObservation(content:String,url:String,sourceHash:String):Boolean=synchronized(CORE_LOCK) {
        store.append(reviewedExperience(ReviewedWebObservation(content,url,sourceHash)))
    }

    /** Mirror the current reviewed notebook so removed/disputed notes cannot survive
     * as a second hidden source of answers. Validate before mutating the ledger.
     */
    fun synchronizeReviewedWebObservations(notes:List<ReviewedWebObservation>)=synchronized(CORE_LOCK) {
        require(notes.size<=24)
        val live=notes.map(::reviewedExperience)
        val ids=live.map { it.id }.toSet()
        val old=store.all().filter { it.provenance==LearningProvenance.REVIEWED_WEB_SOURCE }
        if(old.any { it.id !in ids && it.status!=LearningStatus.REVOKED })dialogue.clear()
        old.filter { it.id !in ids }.forEach { store.updateStatus(it.id,LearningStatus.REVOKED,nowMillis()) }
        live.forEach { store.append(it);store.updateStatus(it.id,LearningStatus.OBSERVED,nowMillis()) }
    }

    private fun ownerFact(content:String)=LearningExperienceFactory.create(
        LearningExperienceType.USER_FACT,
        LearningProvenance.USER_CONFIRMED,
        LearningTrustClass.OWNER_CONFIRMED,
        LearningStatus.CONFIRMED,
        content.trim(),
        now=nowMillis()
    )

    /** Adds a missing owner fact; a fact the owner revoked stays revoked (see [confirmOwnerFact]). */
    fun recordOwnerFact(content:String):Boolean=synchronized(CORE_LOCK) {
        store.append(ownerFact(content))
    }

    /**
     * Mirrors the Android owner memory into the ledger with one read and at most
     * one write. Like [recordOwnerFact] it never re-activates a revoked fact, so a
     * revocation is not undone by facts that are still listed elsewhere.
     */
    fun syncOwnerFacts(facts:List<String>):Int=synchronized(CORE_LOCK) {
        store.appendMissing(facts.map(::ownerFact))
    }

    /**
     * An explicit owner statement ("Merke dir: ..."): adds the fact, or confirms
     * again a fact the owner revoked earlier (the id is the content hash, so the
     * revoked record would otherwise stay revoked forever).
     */
    fun confirmOwnerFact(content:String):OwnerFactChange=synchronized(CORE_LOCK) {
        val item=ownerFact(content)
        if(store.append(item))return@synchronized OwnerFactChange.ADDED
        val existing=store.all().first { it.id==item.id }
        if(existing.status!=LearningStatus.REVOKED && existing.status!=LearningStatus.REJECTED)
            return@synchronized OwnerFactChange.ALREADY_ACTIVE
        check(store.updateStatus(item.id,LearningStatus.CONFIRMED,nowMillis())) { "Owner fact vanished" }
        OwnerFactChange.REACTIVATED
    }

    /** Confirmed, not revoked owner facts (the memory the chat may cite), oldest first. */
    fun activeOwnerFacts():List<LearningExperience> = synchronized(CORE_LOCK) {
        store.all().filter {
            it.type==LearningExperienceType.USER_FACT && it.trust==LearningTrustClass.OWNER_CONFIRMED &&
                it.status in setOf(LearningStatus.CONFIRMED,LearningStatus.LEARNED,LearningStatus.REPLAY_PENDING)
        }
    }

    fun revokeOwnerFact(content:String):Int=synchronized(CORE_LOCK) {
        dialogue.clear()
        store.updateMatching(
            LearningExperienceType.USER_FACT,content.trim(),
            LearningStatus.REVOKED,nowMillis()
        )
    }

    fun revokeAllOwnerFacts():Int=synchronized(CORE_LOCK) {
        dialogue.clear()
        store.updateMatching(
            LearningExperienceType.USER_FACT,null,
            LearningStatus.REVOKED,nowMillis()
        )
    }

    fun recordCommandMapping(phrase:String,tool:String):Boolean=synchronized(CORE_LOCK) {
        require(phrase.trim().length in 3..320 && tool.matches(Regex("[a-z_]{2,64}")))
        val item=LearningExperienceFactory.create(
            LearningExperienceType.COMMAND_MAPPING,
            LearningProvenance.USER_CONFIRMED,
            LearningTrustClass.OWNER_CONFIRMED,
            LearningStatus.CONFIRMED,
            phrase.trim(),
            annotation=tool,
            now=nowMillis()
        )
        store.append(item)
    }

    fun revokeAllCommandMappings():Int=synchronized(CORE_LOCK) {
        store.updateMatching(
            LearningExperienceType.COMMAND_MAPPING,null,
            LearningStatus.REVOKED,nowMillis()
        )
    }

    /** Capture explicit feedback without text, credentials or generated answers. */
    fun recordExplicitFeedback(positive:Boolean):Boolean=synchronized(CORE_LOCK) {
        val item=LearningExperienceFactory.create(
            type=LearningExperienceType.USER_FEEDBACK,
            provenance=LearningProvenance.USER_CONFIRMED,
            trust=LearningTrustClass.OWNER_CONFIRMED,
            status=LearningStatus.CONFIRMED,
            content=if(positive)"helpful" else "not-helpful",
            annotation="rating-only-no-training",
            sourceRef="local-feedback/"+java.util.UUID.randomUUID().toString(),
            now=nowMillis()
        )
        store.appendFeedback(item)
    }

    /** Rating counts reflect the current, non-revoked local evidence ledger. */
    fun feedbackSummary():ContinuumFeedbackSummary=synchronized(CORE_LOCK) {
        val entries=store.all().filter { it.type==LearningExperienceType.USER_FEEDBACK }
        val active=entries.filter { it.status!=LearningStatus.REVOKED }
        ContinuumFeedbackSummary(
            positive=active.count { it.content=="helpful" },
            negative=active.count { it.content=="not-helpful" },
            revoked=entries.count { it.status==LearningStatus.REVOKED }
        )
    }

    /** Safe and repeatable removal of every explicit feedback record. */
    fun revokeExplicitFeedback():Int=synchronized(CORE_LOCK) {
        store.updateMatching(LearningExperienceType.USER_FEEDBACK,
            status=LearningStatus.REVOKED,now=nowMillis())
    }

    /** Explicitly confirmed correction to the latest local dialogue turn only.
     * No implicit model-weight change and no generalization to other questions.
     */
    fun confirmAnswerCorrection(question:String,answer:String):Boolean=synchronized(CORE_LOCK) {
        val turn=dialogue.history().lastOrNull()
        require(turn!=null && turn.resolvedQuery==question) {
            "Conversation changed since correction was proposed"
        }
        val clean=answer.trim()
        require(clean.length in 3..500 && clean.none { it.code==0 })
        val item=LearningExperienceFactory.create(
            type=LearningExperienceType.ANSWER_CORRECTION,
            provenance=LearningProvenance.USER_CONFIRMED,
            trust=LearningTrustClass.OWNER_CONFIRMED,
            status=LearningStatus.CONFIRMED,
            content=clean,
            annotation=ContinuumAnswerCorrection.queryKey(question),
            now=nowMillis()
        )
        store.putAnswerCorrection(item,nowMillis())
    }

    fun correctionSummary():ContinuumCorrectionSummary=synchronized(CORE_LOCK) {
        val all=store.all().filter { it.type==LearningExperienceType.ANSWER_CORRECTION }
        ContinuumCorrectionSummary(
            active=all.count { it.status==LearningStatus.CONFIRMED },
            revoked=all.count { it.status==LearningStatus.REVOKED }
        )
    }

    /** Owner-directed selective correction removal, without touching other questions. */
    fun revokeAnswerCorrection(question:String):Int=synchronized(CORE_LOCK) {
        val key=ContinuumAnswerCorrection.queryKey(question)
        val count=store.revokeCorrectionByQuestionKey(key,nowMillis())
        // A previously corrected response may remain in a recent chat turn.
        // Clear derived conversation context only after the ledger write succeeds.
        if(count>0)dialogue.clear()
        count
    }

    fun revokeAnswerCorrections():Int=synchronized(CORE_LOCK) {
        val revoked=store.updateMatching(LearningExperienceType.ANSWER_CORRECTION,
            status=LearningStatus.REVOKED,now=nowMillis())
        // A past corrected answer may remain in the last eight dialogue turns.
        // Remove stale derived context only after the ledger revocation commits.
        if(revoked>0)dialogue.clear()
        revoked
    }

    fun status():ContinuumLearningStatus=synchronized(CORE_LOCK) {
        val model=loadModel()
        ContinuumLearningStatus(
            experiences=store.stats(),
            modelUpdates=model.updates,
            parameters=model.parameterCount,
            intentHoldout=model.evaluateIntent(INTENT_HOLDOUT),
            semanticHoldout=model.evaluateSemantic(SEMANTIC_HOLDOUT),
            lastAudit=store.all().lastOrNull { it.type==LearningExperienceType.TRAINING_AUDIT }?.content
        )
    }

    /** Experimental decoder: uses the exact active encoder snapshot, never private
     * experiences as decoder training data and never replaces production chat.
     */
    fun decoderStatus():ContinuumDecoderBridge.Status=synchronized(CORE_LOCK) {
        ContinuumDecoderBridge(directory).status()
    }

    fun trainExperimentalDecoder(
        training:DecoderCorpus,
        audit:DecoderCorpus,
        steps:Int=600,
        cancelled:()->Boolean={false}
    ):DecoderExperimentResult=synchronized(CORE_LOCK) {
        ContinuumDecoderBridge(directory).trainExperiment(
            training,audit,loadModel().save(),steps,cancelled
        )
    }

    fun experimentalDecoderContinuation(prompt:String,maxBytes:Int=48):DecoderGeneration?=
        synchronized(CORE_LOCK) {
            ContinuumDecoderBridge(directory).experimentalContinuation(
                prompt,loadModel().save(),maxBytes
            )
        }

    fun intentScore(text:String):Double=synchronized(CORE_LOCK) { loadModel().intentScore(text) }
    fun similarity(left:String,right:String):Double=synchronized(CORE_LOCK) { loadModel().similarity(left,right) }
    fun modelSnapshot():ByteArray=synchronized(CORE_LOCK) { loadModel().save() }
    fun modelHash():String=synchronized(CORE_LOCK) { ContinuumMemoryDialogue.hash(loadModel().save()) }
    fun replyFromMemory(input:String):ContinuumDialogueTurn=synchronized(CORE_LOCK) {
        dialogue.reply(loadModel().save(),store.all(),input,nowMillis())
    }
    fun dialogueHistory():List<ContinuumDialogueTurn> = synchronized(CORE_LOCK) { dialogue.history() }

    /** Explicit local public-package import. Verification precedes all writes and
     * model acceptance still depends on frozen local benchmarks and owner replay.
     */
    fun importPublicPackage(model:ByteArray,manifest:String):ContinualLearningReport {
        ContinuumPublicModelPackage.verify(model,manifest)
        return importSnapshot(model)
    }

    /** Owner-selected SWB1 only. Checksum is integrity, not a publisher signature.
     * Independent local evaluation protects both tasks and private owner lessons.
     * This method never replaces the experience ledger or command permissions.
     */
    fun importSnapshot(bytes:ByteArray):ContinualLearningReport=synchronized(CORE_LOCK) {
        require(bytes.size==32960) { "Ungültige SWB1-Dateigröße" }
        val candidate=TrainableSubwordEncoder.restore(bytes)
        val baseline=loadModel()
        val intentBefore=baseline.evaluateIntent(INTENT_HOLDOUT)
        val intentAfter=candidate.evaluateIntent(INTENT_HOLDOUT)
        val semanticBefore=baseline.evaluateSemantic(SEMANTIC_HOLDOUT)
        val semanticAfter=candidate.evaluateSemantic(SEMANTIC_HOLDOUT)
        val replay=ownerIntentReplay()
        val replayRetained=replay.isEmpty() || retains(baseline.evaluateIntent(replay),candidate.evaluateIntent(replay))
        val gained=intentAfter.loss+semanticAfter.loss<intentBefore.loss+semanticBefore.loss-0.001
        val accepted=retains(intentBefore,intentAfter) && retains(semanticBefore,semanticAfter) && replayRetained && gained
        val reason=when {
            !retains(intentBefore,intentAfter) -> "Import verworfen: lokaler Intent-Holdout verschlechtert"
            !retains(semanticBefore,semanticAfter) -> "Import verworfen: lokaler Semantik-Holdout verschlechtert"
            !replayRetained -> "Import verworfen: persönliche Intent-Lektionen würden verschlechtert"
            !gained -> "Import unverändert: kein zusätzlicher gemessener Lerngewinn"
            else -> "Import übernommen: beide lokalen Aufgaben und persönliche Lektionen geprüft"
        }
        if(accepted)saveModel(candidate.save(),"snapshot-import")
        appendAudit("snapshot-import",accepted,0,intentBefore,intentAfter,semanticBefore,semanticAfter,emptyList(),reason)
        ContinualLearningReport("snapshot-import",accepted,0,replay.size,intentBefore,intentAfter,
            semanticBefore,semanticAfter,emptyList(),reason)
    }

    /** Most recent training/import/rollback decisions (newest first) with their measurements. */
    fun trainingAudits(limit:Int=8):List<String> = synchronized(CORE_LOCK) {
        require(limit in 1..64)
        store.all().filter { it.type==LearningExperienceType.TRAINING_AUDIT }
            .sortedByDescending { it.createdAt }.take(limit).map { it.content }
    }

    /** Archived pre-change states, oldest first. The active model is [modelHash]. */
    fun checkpoints():List<ModelCheckpoint> = synchronized(CORE_LOCK) { checkpoints.list() }

    /** Owner-initiated restore of an archived state. Not a learning claim: the
     * restore itself is archived (so it can be undone) and audited with the
     * frozen holdout measurements of both states. No experience is deleted.
     */
    fun rollbackTo(sha256:String):ContinualLearningReport = synchronized(CORE_LOCK) {
        val target=TrainableSubwordEncoder.restore(checkpoints.read(sha256))
        val current=loadModel()
        val intentBefore=current.evaluateIntent(INTENT_HOLDOUT)
        val intentAfter=target.evaluateIntent(INTENT_HOLDOUT)
        val semanticBefore=current.evaluateSemantic(SEMANTIC_HOLDOUT)
        val semanticAfter=target.evaluateSemantic(SEMANTIC_HOLDOUT)
        val changed=!current.save().contentEquals(target.save())
        if(changed)saveModel(target.save(),"rollback")
        val reason=if(changed) "Wiederhergestellt: Checkpoint "+sha256.take(12)+" (vorheriger Stand archiviert)"
            else "Checkpoint "+sha256.take(12)+" ist bereits aktiv"
        appendAudit("rollback",changed,0,intentBefore,intentAfter,semanticBefore,semanticAfter,emptyList(),reason)
        ContinualLearningReport("rollback",changed,0,0,intentBefore,intentAfter,
            semanticBefore,semanticAfter,emptyList(),reason)
    }

    /** Restore the newest archived state that differs from the active weights. */
    fun rollbackToPrevious():ContinualLearningReport? = synchronized(CORE_LOCK) {
        val active=ContinuumMemoryDialogue.hash(loadModel().save())
        val previous=checkpoints.list().lastOrNull { it.sha256!=active } ?: return@synchronized null
        rollbackTo(previous.sha256)
    }

    private fun ownerIntentReplay():List<SubwordIntentExample> =
        store.replay(LearningExperienceType.INTENT_LABEL,96).mapNotNull { item ->
            val label=item.annotation?.toIntOrNull()
            if(label in 0..1)SubwordIntentExample(item.content,label!!) else null
        }

    private fun interrupted(cancelled:()->Boolean)=cancelled() || Thread.currentThread().isInterrupted

    /** Nothing saved and no audit written: the stage is attempted again later. */
    private fun interruptedReport(task:String,steps:Int,before:SubwordEvaluation,after:SubwordEvaluation,
        holdoutBefore:SubwordEvaluation,holdoutAfter:SubwordEvaluation)=
        ContinualLearningReport(task,false,steps,0,before,after,holdoutBefore,holdoutAfter,emptyList(),
            "Unterbrochen; nichts gespeichert, wird später erneut versucht",completedEvaluation=false)

    private fun retains(before:SubwordEvaluation,after:SubwordEvaluation):Boolean =
        after.correct>=before.correct && after.loss<=before.loss+0.015

    private fun appendAudit(
        task:String,
        accepted:Boolean,
        steps:Int,
        before:SubwordEvaluation,
        after:SubwordEvaluation,
        holdoutBefore:SubwordEvaluation,
        holdoutAfter:SubwordEvaluation,
        sourceIds:List<String>,
        reason:String
    ) {
        val content=buildString {
            append(task).append(" · ").append(if(accepted)"accepted" else "rejected")
            append(" · steps=").append(steps)
            append(" · train=").append("%.5f".format(Locale.ROOT,before.loss))
                .append("→").append("%.5f".format(Locale.ROOT,after.loss))
            append(" · holdout=").append(holdoutBefore.correct).append("/").append(holdoutBefore.total)
                .append("→").append(holdoutAfter.correct).append("/").append(holdoutAfter.total)
            append(" · ").append(reason)
        }.take(1000)
        store.append(LearningExperienceFactory.create(
            type=LearningExperienceType.TRAINING_AUDIT,
            provenance=LearningProvenance.LOCAL_TRAINING,
            trust=LearningTrustClass.SYSTEM_MEASUREMENT,
            status=if(accepted)LearningStatus.LEARNED else LearningStatus.REJECTED,
            content=content,
            annotation=task,
            sourceRef=sourceIds.joinToString(",").takeIf { it.isNotEmpty() },
            now=nowMillis()
        ))
    }

    /**
     * Active weights. Unreadable bytes (not an I/O error) are replaced by the
     * last-known-good copy once: the damaged file is kept as
     * subword-v1.bin.corrupt-<time>, the copy becomes active again and the
     * recovery is audited, so it is visible instead of silently repeated.
     */
    private fun loadModel():TrainableSubwordEncoder {
        if(!modelFile.exists())return TrainableSubwordEncoder()
        val bytes=modelFile.readBytes()
        return try { TrainableSubwordEncoder.restore(bytes) } catch (damaged:IllegalArgumentException) {
            if(!modelBackup.exists())throw damaged
            val backupBytes=modelBackup.readBytes()
            val good=TrainableSubwordEncoder.restore(backupBytes)
            Files.move(modelFile.toPath(),File(directory,"${modelFile.name}.corrupt-${nowMillis()}").toPath())
            writeAtomically(modelFile,backupBytes)
            val intent=good.evaluateIntent(INTENT_HOLDOUT)
            val semantic=good.evaluateSemantic(SEMANTIC_HOLDOUT)
            appendAudit("model-recovery",true,0,intent,intent,semantic,semantic,emptyList(),
                "Aktive Gewichte unlesbar; letzter geprüfter Stand wiederhergestellt, beschädigte Datei gesichert")
            good
        }
    }

    /** Archives the active state first; if that fails the model is not changed. */
    private fun saveModel(bytes:ByteArray,reason:String) {
        TrainableSubwordEncoder.restore(bytes)
        if(!directory.exists() && !directory.mkdirs())error("Cannot create learning-core directory")
        checkpoints.archive(loadModel().save(),"vor "+reason,nowMillis())
        if(modelFile.exists()) {
            runCatching { TrainableSubwordEncoder.restore(modelFile.readBytes()) }
                .onSuccess { writeAtomically(modelBackup,modelFile.readBytes()) }
        }
        writeAtomically(modelFile,bytes)
    }

    private fun writeAtomically(target:File,bytes:ByteArray) {
        val temp=File.createTempFile("subword-", ".tmp",directory)
        try {
            java.io.FileOutputStream(temp).use { out -> out.write(bytes);out.fd.sync() }
            try {
                Files.move(temp.toPath(),target.toPath(),StandardCopyOption.ATOMIC_MOVE,StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING)
            } catch (_:AtomicMoveNotSupportedException) {
                Files.move(temp.toPath(),target.toPath(),StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING)
            }
        } finally { temp.delete() }
    }

    companion object {
        private val CORE_LOCK=Any()

        val INTENT_BOOTSTRAP=listOf(
            SubwordIntentExample("hallo",0),SubwordIntentExample("servus miteinander",0),
            SubwordIntentExample("guten morgen",0),SubwordIntentExample("schönen abend euch",0),
            SubwordIntentExample("grüß dich",0),SubwordIntentExample("willkommen zurück",0),
            SubwordIntentExample("was bedeutet das",1),SubwordIntentExample("wie funktioniert das",1),
            SubwordIntentExample("kannst du mir helfen",1),SubwordIntentExample("warum ist das so",1),
            SubwordIntentExample("wo liegt wien",1),SubwordIntentExample("wann beginnt der sommer",1)
        )
        val INTENT_HOLDOUT=listOf(
            SubwordIntentExample("moin zusammen",0),SubwordIntentExample("einen schönen tag",0),
            SubwordIntentExample("herzliche grüße",0),SubwordIntentExample("mahlzeit allerseits",0),
            SubwordIntentExample("ist morgen feiertag",1),SubwordIntentExample("dürfen wir starten",1),
            SubwordIntentExample("welche zeit ist es",1),SubwordIntentExample("woher kommt silizium",1)
        )
        val SEMANTIC_BOOTSTRAP=listOf(
            SubwordSemanticExample("pflanze licht energie","pflanzen nutzen sonnenlicht für energie",true),
            SubwordSemanticExample("motor fahrzeug bewegung","antrieb bewegt ein fahrzeug",true),
            SubwordSemanticExample("sprache grammatik","grammatik beschreibt sprachliche strukturen",true),
            SubwordSemanticExample("pflanze licht energie","motor getriebe fahrzeug",false),
            SubwordSemanticExample("astronomie planeten","grammatik satzbau",false),
            SubwordSemanticExample("musik harmonie","plattentektonik erdbeben",false)
        )
        val SEMANTIC_HOLDOUT=listOf(
            SubwordSemanticExample("sonne licht pflanzen","pflanzen brauchen licht",true),
            SubwordSemanticExample("fahrzeug antrieb","motor bewegt fahrzeug",true),
            SubwordSemanticExample("wörter sätze sprache","sprachliche sätze und wörter",true),
            SubwordSemanticExample("sonne pflanzen","getriebe automobil",false),
            SubwordSemanticExample("musik rhythmus","planet umlaufbahn",false),
            SubwordSemanticExample("zelle biologie","roman literatur",false)
        )
    }
}

package at.heinz.deviceai.learning

import java.io.ByteArrayInputStream
import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream
import java.io.DataInputStream
import java.io.DataOutputStream
import java.io.File
import java.io.IOException
import java.nio.file.AtomicMoveNotSupportedException
import java.nio.file.Files
import java.nio.file.StandardCopyOption
import java.security.MessageDigest

enum class LearningExperienceType {
    INTENT_LABEL, SOURCE_TEXT, SEMANTIC_PAIR, TRAINING_AUDIT,
    USER_FACT, COMMAND_MAPPING, USER_FEEDBACK, ANSWER_CORRECTION
}
enum class LearningProvenance { USER_CONFIRMED, MENTOR_WIKIPEDIA, SYNTHETIC_FIXTURE, LOCAL_TRAINING, REVIEWED_WEB_SOURCE }
enum class LearningTrustClass { OWNER_CONFIRMED, SOURCE_OBSERVATION, SYNTHETIC, SYSTEM_MEASUREMENT }
enum class LearningStatus { OBSERVED, CONFIRMED, LEARNED, REPLAY_PENDING, REJECTED, REVOKED }

data class LearningExperience(
    val id:String,
    val type:LearningExperienceType,
    val provenance:LearningProvenance,
    val trust:LearningTrustClass,
    val status:LearningStatus,
    val content:String,
    val annotation:String?=null,
    val sourceRef:String?=null,
    val contentHash:String,
    val createdAt:Long,
    val updatedAt:Long
) {
    init {
        require(id.matches(Regex("lx-[a-f0-9]{24}")))
        require(content.length in 1..2048)
        require(annotation==null || annotation.length in 1..160)
        require(sourceRef==null || sourceRef.length in 1..500)
        require(contentHash.matches(Regex("[a-f0-9]{64}")))
        require(createdAt>=0 && updatedAt>=createdAt)
        require(contentHash==LearningExperienceFactory.hash(type,provenance,trust,content,annotation,sourceRef))
        require(id=="lx-"+contentHash.take(24))
    }
}

object LearningExperienceFactory {
    fun create(
        type:LearningExperienceType,
        provenance:LearningProvenance,
        trust:LearningTrustClass,
        status:LearningStatus,
        content:String,
        annotation:String?=null,
        sourceRef:String?=null,
        now:Long=System.currentTimeMillis()
    ):LearningExperience {
        require(now>=0)
        val cleaned=content.trim()
        val label=annotation?.trim()?.takeIf(String::isNotEmpty)
        val source=sourceRef?.trim()?.takeIf(String::isNotEmpty)
        val digest=hash(type,provenance,trust,cleaned,label,source)
        return LearningExperience(
            id="lx-"+digest.take(24), type=type, provenance=provenance, trust=trust,
            status=status, content=cleaned, annotation=label, sourceRef=source,
            contentHash=digest, createdAt=now, updatedAt=now
        )
    }

    internal fun hash(
        type:LearningExperienceType,
        provenance:LearningProvenance,
        trust:LearningTrustClass,
        content:String,
        annotation:String?,
        sourceRef:String?
    ):String {
        val digest=MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256")
        listOf(type.name,provenance.name,trust.name,content,annotation.orEmpty(),sourceRef.orEmpty())
            .forEach { value ->
                digest.update(value.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8))
                digest.update(0.toByte())
            }
        return digest.digest().joinToString("") { "%02x".format(it) }
    }
}

data class LearningExperienceStats(
    val total:Int,
    val confirmed:Int,
    val learned:Int,
    val replayPending:Int,
    val sourceObservations:Int,
    val intentLabels:Int,
    val audits:Int,
    val userFacts:Int,
    val commandMappings:Int,
    val revoked:Int
)

class FileLearningExperienceStore(private val directory:File) {
    private val primary=File(directory,"experiences-v2.bin")
    private val backup=File(directory,"experiences-v2.lkg")

    fun all():List<LearningExperience> = synchronized(FILE_LOCK) { loadValidated() }

    fun append(experience:LearningExperience):Boolean = synchronized(FILE_LOCK) {
        val current=loadValidated()
        val existing=current.firstOrNull { it.id==experience.id }
        if(existing!=null) {
            require(existing.contentHash==experience.contentHash) { "Conflicting learning experience identity" }
            return@synchronized false
        }
        val next=(current+experience)
            .sortedWith(compareBy<LearningExperience>{it.createdAt}.thenBy{it.id})
            .takeLast(MAX_RECORDS)
        save(next)
        true
    }

    /**
     * Local ratings have a strict separate retention budget. A thumbs-up/down
     * must NEVER evict an older owner fact, source observation or training audit
     * when the shared Experience ledger approaches MAX_RECORDS.
     *
     * Only the oldest feedback entries may be compacted; if there is no free
     * room after that, feedback fails closed without modifying the ledger.
     */
    fun appendFeedback(experience:LearningExperience):Boolean=synchronized(FILE_LOCK) {
        require(experience.type==LearningExperienceType.USER_FEEDBACK)
        val current=loadValidated()
        if(current.any { it.id==experience.id })return@synchronized false
        val existingRatings=current.filter { it.type==LearningExperienceType.USER_FEEDBACK }
            .sortedWith(compareBy<LearningExperience> { it.createdAt }.thenBy { it.id })
        val oldIds=existingRatings.take((existingRatings.size-23).coerceAtLeast(0))
            .map { it.id }.toSet()
        val retained=current.filterNot { it.id in oldIds }
        check(retained.size<MAX_RECORDS) {
            "Experience ledger is full; user facts cannot be displaced by feedback"
        }
        save((retained+experience).sortedWith(
            compareBy<LearningExperience> { it.createdAt }.thenBy { it.id }))
        true
    }

    /**
     * Atomically replace a confirmed answer for its exact question. Corrections
     * have a 16-entry retention budget and cannot evict any other experience.
     */
    fun putAnswerCorrection(item:LearningExperience,now:Long):Boolean=synchronized(FILE_LOCK) {
        require(item.type==LearningExperienceType.ANSWER_CORRECTION &&
            item.trust==LearningTrustClass.OWNER_CONFIRMED &&
            item.provenance==LearningProvenance.USER_CONFIRMED &&
            item.status==LearningStatus.CONFIRMED &&
            item.annotation?.matches(Regex("query-sha256:[a-f0-9]{64}"))==true)
        require(now>=0)
        val current=loadValidated()
        // Different writes can share the same wall-clock millisecond. Make
        // correction timestamps strictly monotonic so retention means oldest
        // actual confirmation, not lexicographically smallest content hash.
        val latest=current.asSequence()
            .filter { it.type==LearningExperienceType.ANSWER_CORRECTION }
            .maxOfOrNull { it.updatedAt } ?: -1L
        check(latest<Long.MAX_VALUE) { "Correction timestamp exhausted" }
        val effectiveNow=maxOf(now,latest+1)
        val same=current.firstOrNull { it.id==item.id }
        if(same?.status==LearningStatus.CONFIRMED &&
            current.none { it.id!=item.id && it.type==LearningExperienceType.ANSWER_CORRECTION &&
                it.annotation==item.annotation && it.status==LearningStatus.CONFIRMED })
            return@synchronized false
        val revised=current.map { e ->
            when {
                e.type!=LearningExperienceType.ANSWER_CORRECTION ||
                    e.annotation!=item.annotation -> e
                e.id==item.id -> e.copy(status=LearningStatus.CONFIRMED,updatedAt=maxOf(effectiveNow,e.updatedAt))
                e.status==LearningStatus.CONFIRMED ->
                    e.copy(status=LearningStatus.REVOKED,updatedAt=maxOf(effectiveNow,e.updatedAt))
                else -> e
            }
        }
        val combined=if(same==null) revised+item.copy(createdAt=effectiveNow,updatedAt=effectiveNow) else revised
        val corrections=combined.filter { it.type==LearningExperienceType.ANSWER_CORRECTION }
            // Retire revoked revisions before evicting still-active answers.
            .sortedWith(compareBy<LearningExperience>{it.status!=LearningStatus.REVOKED}
                .thenBy{it.updatedAt}.thenBy{it.id})
        // Always retain the just confirmed correction even when multiple
        // writes share the same millisecond; tie-breaking may not evict it.
        val discarded=corrections.filter { it.id!=item.id }
            .take((corrections.size-16).coerceAtLeast(0))
            .map { it.id }.toSet()
        val retained=combined.filterNot { it.id in discarded }
        check(retained.size<=MAX_RECORDS) {
            "Experience ledger full; an answer correction must not evict owner facts"
        }
        save(retained.sortedWith(compareBy<LearningExperience>{it.createdAt}.thenBy{it.id}))
        true
    }

    /** One read and at most one write for a batch; ids already present (any status) are skipped. */
    fun appendMissing(items:List<LearningExperience>):Int = synchronized(FILE_LOCK) {
        val current=loadValidated()
        val known=current.associateBy { it.id }
        val added=LinkedHashMap<String,LearningExperience>()
        for(item in items) {
            val existing=known[item.id] ?: added[item.id]
            if(existing!=null) {
                require(existing.contentHash==item.contentHash) { "Conflicting learning experience identity" }
                continue
            }
            added[item.id]=item
        }
        if(added.isEmpty())return@synchronized 0
        save((current+added.values)
            .sortedWith(compareBy<LearningExperience>{it.createdAt}.thenBy{it.id})
            .takeLast(MAX_RECORDS))
        added.size
    }

    fun updateStatus(id:String,status:LearningStatus,now:Long=System.currentTimeMillis()):Boolean =
        synchronized(FILE_LOCK) {
            require(now>=0)
            val current=loadValidated()
            val index=current.indexOfFirst { it.id==id }
            if(index<0)return@synchronized false
            val old=current[index]
            if(old.status==status)return@synchronized true
            val next=current.toMutableList()
            next[index]=old.copy(status=status,updatedAt=maxOf(now,old.updatedAt))
            save(next)
            true
        }

    fun updateMatching(
        type:LearningExperienceType,
        content:String?=null,
        status:LearningStatus,
        now:Long=System.currentTimeMillis()
    ):Int = synchronized(FILE_LOCK) {
        require(now>=0)
        val current=loadValidated()
        var changed=0
        val next=current.map { item ->
            if(item.type==type && (content==null || item.content==content) && item.status!=status) {
                changed++
                item.copy(status=status,updatedAt=maxOf(now,item.updatedAt))
            } else item
        }
        if(changed>0)save(next)
        changed
    }

    /**
     * Revokes exactly one normalized question's owner-confirmed corrections.
     * The query hash is an opaque locator and no question text is persisted.
     * Other corrections, memories and training experiences are not touched.
     */
    fun revokeCorrectionByQuestionKey(questionKey:String,now:Long):Int=synchronized(FILE_LOCK) {
        require(now>=0 && questionKey.matches(Regex("query-sha256:[a-f0-9]{64}")))
        val current=loadValidated()
        var count=0
        val next=current.map { entry ->
            if(entry.type==LearningExperienceType.ANSWER_CORRECTION &&
                entry.annotation==questionKey &&
                entry.provenance==LearningProvenance.USER_CONFIRMED &&
                entry.trust==LearningTrustClass.OWNER_CONFIRMED &&
                entry.status==LearningStatus.CONFIRMED) {
                count++
                entry.copy(status=LearningStatus.REVOKED,updatedAt=maxOf(now,entry.updatedAt))
            } else entry
        }
        if(count>0)save(next)
        count
    }

    fun replay(type:LearningExperienceType,limit:Int=64):List<LearningExperience> =
        synchronized(FILE_LOCK) {
            require(limit in 1..128)
            loadValidated().asReversed().asSequence()
                .filter { it.type==type && it.status in setOf(
                    LearningStatus.OBSERVED,LearningStatus.CONFIRMED,
                    LearningStatus.LEARNED,LearningStatus.REPLAY_PENDING
                ) }
                .take(limit).toList().asReversed()
        }

    fun stats():LearningExperienceStats {
        val items=all()
        return LearningExperienceStats(
            total=items.size,
            confirmed=items.count { it.status==LearningStatus.CONFIRMED },
            learned=items.count { it.status==LearningStatus.LEARNED },
            replayPending=items.count { it.status==LearningStatus.REPLAY_PENDING },
            sourceObservations=items.count { it.type==LearningExperienceType.SOURCE_TEXT },
            intentLabels=items.count { it.type==LearningExperienceType.INTENT_LABEL },
            audits=items.count { it.type==LearningExperienceType.TRAINING_AUDIT },
            userFacts=items.count { it.type==LearningExperienceType.USER_FACT },
            commandMappings=items.count { it.type==LearningExperienceType.COMMAND_MAPPING },
            revoked=items.count { it.status==LearningStatus.REVOKED }
        )
    }

    private fun loadValidated():List<LearningExperience> {
        if(!primary.exists())return emptyList()
        return runCatching { LearningExperienceCodec.decode(primary.readBytes()) }
            .getOrElse {
                if(backup.exists())LearningExperienceCodec.decode(backup.readBytes()) else throw it
            }
    }

    private fun save(items:List<LearningExperience>) {
        require(items.size<=MAX_RECORDS && items.map { it.id }.distinct().size==items.size)
        if(!directory.exists() && !directory.mkdirs())throw IOException("Cannot create learning-core directory")
        if(primary.exists()) {
            runCatching { LearningExperienceCodec.decode(primary.readBytes()) }
                .onSuccess { writeAtomically(backup,primary.readBytes()) }
        }
        writeAtomically(primary,LearningExperienceCodec.encode(items))
    }

    private fun writeAtomically(target:File,bytes:ByteArray) {
        val temp=File.createTempFile("experience-", ".tmp",directory)
        try {
            java.io.FileOutputStream(temp).use { output -> output.write(bytes);output.fd.sync() }
            try {
                Files.move(temp.toPath(),target.toPath(),StandardCopyOption.ATOMIC_MOVE,StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING)
            } catch (_:AtomicMoveNotSupportedException) {
                Files.move(temp.toPath(),target.toPath(),StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING)
            }
        } finally { temp.delete() }
    }

    companion object {
        const val MAX_RECORDS=256
        private val FILE_LOCK=Any()
    }
}

private object LearningExperienceCodec {
    private const val MAGIC=0x4c455832
    private const val MAX_BYTES=512*1024

    fun encode(items:List<LearningExperience>):ByteArray {
        val payload=ByteArrayOutputStream().also { buffer ->
            DataOutputStream(buffer).use { out ->
                out.writeInt(MAGIC);out.writeInt(items.size)
                items.forEach { e ->
                    out.writeUTF(e.id)
                    out.writeUTF(e.type.name);out.writeUTF(e.provenance.name)
                    out.writeUTF(e.trust.name);out.writeUTF(e.status.name)
                    writeString(out,e.content)
                    writeNullable(out,e.annotation);writeNullable(out,e.sourceRef)
                    out.writeUTF(e.contentHash);out.writeLong(e.createdAt);out.writeLong(e.updatedAt)
                }
            }
        }.toByteArray()
        val checksum=MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256").digest(payload)
        val bytes=payload+checksum
        require(bytes.size<=MAX_BYTES)
        return bytes
    }

    fun decode(bytes:ByteArray):List<LearningExperience> {
        require(bytes.size in 40..MAX_BYTES)
        val payload=bytes.copyOfRange(0,bytes.size-32)
        val checksum=bytes.copyOfRange(bytes.size-32,bytes.size)
        require(MessageDigest.isEqual(checksum,MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256").digest(payload))) {
            "Learning experience checksum mismatch"
        }
        try {
            val input=DataInputStream(ByteArrayInputStream(payload))
            require(input.readInt()==MAGIC)
            val count=input.readInt().also { require(it in 0..FileLearningExperienceStore.MAX_RECORDS) }
            val result=List(count) {
                LearningExperience(
                    id=input.readUTF(),
                    type=LearningExperienceType.valueOf(input.readUTF()),
                    provenance=LearningProvenance.valueOf(input.readUTF()),
                    trust=LearningTrustClass.valueOf(input.readUTF()),
                    status=LearningStatus.valueOf(input.readUTF()),
                    content=readString(input),
                    annotation=readNullable(input),
                    sourceRef=readNullable(input),
                    contentHash=input.readUTF(),
                    createdAt=input.readLong(),
                    updatedAt=input.readLong()
                )
            }
            require(input.available()==0 && result.map { it.id }.distinct().size==result.size)
            return result
        } catch(e:IOException) {
            throw IllegalArgumentException("Invalid learning experience archive",e)
        }
    }

    private fun writeString(out:DataOutputStream,value:String) {
        val bytes=value.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8)
        require(bytes.size<=8192)
        out.writeInt(bytes.size);out.write(bytes)
    }
    private fun readString(input:DataInputStream):String {
        val size=input.readInt().also { require(it in 0..8192 && it<=input.available()) }
        val bytes=ByteArray(size);input.readFully(bytes)
        return bytes.toString(Charsets.UTF_8)
    }
    private fun writeNullable(out:DataOutputStream,value:String?) {
        out.writeBoolean(value!=null);if(value!=null)writeString(out,value)
    }
    private fun readNullable(input:DataInputStream):String?=if(input.readBoolean())readString(input) else null
}

package at.heinz.deviceai.learning

/**
 * Android-callable research integration, isolated from the production trainer.
 * Uses only public synthetic examples and a copy of the current SWB1 snapshot.
 * There is deliberately no save/promote method.
 */
data class ContinuumContrastiveProbeResult(
    val steps:Int,
    val completed:Boolean,
    val baselineHash:String,
    val candidateHash:String,
    val trainBefore:ContrastiveRetrieval,
    val trainAfter:ContrastiveRetrieval,
    val holdoutBefore:ContrastiveRetrieval,
    val holdoutAfter:ContrastiveRetrieval
) {
    fun display():String = buildString {
        append("Kontrastiver SWB1-Experimentlauf (öffentliche Testsätze)\n\n")
        append("Lernschritte: ").append(steps)
            .append(if(completed)" · abgeschlossen" else " · unterbrochen")
        append("\nTrainingsabruf MRR: ")
            .append("%.3f".format(java.util.Locale.ROOT,trainBefore.reciprocalRank))
            .append(" → ")
            .append("%.3f".format(java.util.Locale.ROOT,trainAfter.reciprocalRank))
        append("\nUnabhängiger Holdout MRR: ")
            .append("%.3f".format(java.util.Locale.ROOT,holdoutBefore.reciprocalRank))
            .append(" → ")
            .append("%.3f".format(java.util.Locale.ROOT,holdoutAfter.reciprocalRank))
        append("\nAktiver Modell-Hash: ").append(baselineHash.take(16))
        append("\nKandidaten-Hash: ").append(candidateHash.take(16))
        append("\n\nKein Modellimport, keine Gewichtsübernahme und kein Upload.")
        append("\nEin solcher Einzeltest genügt nicht zur Freigabe des automatischen Lernens.")
    }
}
object ContinuumLocalContrastiveProbe {
    private val TRAIN=listOf(
        "pflanze wandelt licht in energie um",
        "motor bewegt ein fahrzeug mit getriebe",
        "musikinstrumente erzeugen melodien und rhythmus",
        "regen entsteht aus wasser in wolken",
        "planeten kreisen um einen stern",
        "brot entsteht beim backen aus mehl"
    )
    private val HOLDOUT=listOf(
        "insekten bestauben blueten im fruehling",
        "ein arzt untersucht medizinische beschwerden",
        "winkel verbinden zwei geometrische geraden",
        "ein leser leiht buecher aus einer bibliothek"
    )
    fun run(snapshot:ByteArray,cancelled:()->Boolean={false},steps:Int=100):ContinuumContrastiveProbeResult {
        require(steps in 1..150)
        val baseline=TrainableSubwordEncoder.restore(snapshot)
        val original=baseline.save()
        val report=ContinuumContrastiveViews.trainCandidate(
            baseline,TRAIN,HOLDOUT,steps=steps,seed=43L,drop=0.65,rate=0.08,
            cancelled=cancelled
        )
        check(baseline.save().contentEquals(original)) { "The baseline model was changed" }
        return ContinuumContrastiveProbeResult(
            report.steps,!report.interrupted,
            ContinuumMemoryDialogue.hash(original),
            ContinuumMemoryDialogue.hash(report.candidate.save()),
            report.trainingBefore,report.trainingAfter,
            report.validationBefore,report.validationAfter
        )
    }
}

package at.heinz.deviceai.learning

import java.io.File
import java.io.FileOutputStream
import java.nio.file.Files
import java.nio.file.StandardCopyOption
import java.nio.file.AtomicMoveNotSupportedException
import java.security.MessageDigest
import java.util.Locale

data class ContinuumMemoryHit(val id:String,val text:String,val kind:String,val sourceRef:String?,val score:Double,val semantic:Double)
data class ContinuumDialogueTurn(
    val at:Long,val input:String,val resolvedQuery:String,val answer:String,
    val topic:String,val modelHash:String,val memoryIds:List<String>,val grounded:Boolean,
    /** The stored conversation context was unreadable; it was moved aside and this turn started fresh. */
    val contextReset:Boolean=false
)

/** Bounded contextual retrieval from current ledger entries using the active SWB1.
 * Conversation text never trains weights or grants tool authority. Old responses
 * are not factual memory; every answer reselects current nonrevoked evidence.
 */
class ContinuumMemoryDialogue(private val directory:File) {
    private val file=File(directory,"dialogue-v1.bin")

    fun reply(bytes:ByteArray,experiences:List<LearningExperience>,input:String,at:Long):ContinuumDialogueTurn {
        require(input.trim().length in 1..512 && at>=0)
        // The history is only conversation context (memories live in the ledger),
        // so an unreadable file must not block every later turn: it is kept as
        // dialogue-v1.bin.corrupt-<time> and the conversation starts fresh.
        var contextReset=false
        val history=try { history() } catch (e:IllegalArgumentException) {
            quarantine(at)
            contextReset=true
            emptyList()
        }
        val text=input.trim()
        val followUp=Regex("(?i)\\b(darüber|dazu|damit|weiter|noch mehr|und warum|und wie)\\b").containsMatchIn(text)
        val previousTopic=history.lastOrNull()?.topic.orEmpty()
        val resolved=if(followUp&&previousTopic.isNotBlank())(previousTopic+" "+text).take(512) else text
        val greeting=Regex("(?i)^(hallo|servus|guten (morgen|tag|abend)|hey)[!.\\s]*$").matches(text)
        val correction=if(greeting)null else ContinuumAnswerCorrection.find(resolved,experiences)
        val hits=if(correction==null)rank(bytes,resolved,experiences) else emptyList()
        // A greeting must not accidentally cite memories containing the word "Hallo".
        // An unanswered new question invalidates the old topic; only retrieved evidence
        // can establish a topic for future follow-ups.
        val selected=if(greeting)emptyList<ContinuumMemoryHit>() else hits
        val topic=when {
            greeting -> previousTopic
            correction!=null -> text.take(320)
            selected.isEmpty() -> ""
            followUp -> previousTopic
            else -> text.take(320)
        }
        val answer=when {
            greeting -> "Hallo Heinz. Worüber möchtest du sprechen? Ich kann an unsere gespeicherten Themen anknüpfen."
            correction!=null -> "Deine ausdrücklich bestätigte Korrektur für genau diese Frage:\n\n"+correction.content
            selected.isEmpty() -> "Dazu habe ich noch keine passende bestätigte Erinnerung oder Quellenbeobachtung. Du kannst mir mit „Merke dir: …“ etwas beibringen oder eine Recherche ausdrücklich starten."
            else -> (if(followUp)"Ich knüpfe an unser Thema an." else "Dazu finde ich in meinem Gedächtnis:")+selected.joinToString("") {
                "\n\n"+it.text.take(250)+"\n("+it.kind+(it.sourceRef?.let { ref -> "; "+ref.take(180) } ?: "")+")"
            }
        }.take(1000)
        val ids=if(correction!=null)listOf(correction.id) else selected.map { it.id }
        val turn=ContinuumDialogueTurn(at,text.take(320),resolved,answer,topic,hash(bytes),ids,ids.isNotEmpty(),contextReset)
        save((history+turn).takeLast(8))
        return turn
    }

    fun history():List<ContinuumDialogueTurn> {
        if(!file.exists())return emptyList()
        require(file.length() in 36..65536) { "Ungültige Dialogdatei" }
        return LearningSnapshot.decode(file.readBytes()) { input ->
            require(input.readInt()==0x43444c31)
            val count=input.readInt().also { require(it in 0..8) }
            List(count) {
                val at=input.readLong().also { require(it>=0) }
                val text=input.readUTF().also { require(it.length<=320) }
                val query=input.readUTF().also { require(it.length<=512) }
                val answer=input.readUTF().also { require(it.length<=1000) }
                val topic=input.readUTF().also { require(it.length<=320) }
                val modelHash=input.readUTF().also { require(it.matches(Regex("[a-f0-9]{64}"))) }
                val grounded=input.readBoolean()
                val n=input.readInt().also { require(it in 0..3) }
                val ids=List(n) { input.readUTF().also { id -> require(id.matches(Regex("lx-[a-f0-9]{24}"))) } }
                require(grounded==ids.isNotEmpty())
                ContinuumDialogueTurn(at,text,query,answer,topic,modelHash,ids,grounded)
            }
        }
    }

    fun clear() { check(!file.exists()||file.delete()) { "Dialog konnte nicht gelöscht werden" } }

    /** Keeps the unreadable bytes for inspection (newest [MAX_QUARANTINED] files). */
    private fun quarantine(at:Long) {
        var target=File(directory,"${file.name}.corrupt-$at")
        var n=1
        while(target.exists())target=File(directory,"${file.name}.corrupt-$at-${n++}")
        Files.move(file.toPath(),target.toPath())
        directory.listFiles { f -> f.name.startsWith(file.name+".corrupt-") }.orEmpty()
            .sortedByDescending { it.lastModified() }.drop(MAX_QUARANTINED).forEach { it.delete() }
    }

    private fun save(turns:List<ContinuumDialogueTurn>) {
        val bytes=LearningSnapshot.encode { out ->
            out.writeInt(0x43444c31);out.writeInt(turns.size)
            turns.forEach { t ->
                out.writeLong(t.at);out.writeUTF(t.input);out.writeUTF(t.resolvedQuery)
                out.writeUTF(t.answer);out.writeUTF(t.topic);out.writeUTF(t.modelHash)
                out.writeBoolean(t.grounded);out.writeInt(t.memoryIds.size);t.memoryIds.forEach(out::writeUTF)
            }
        }
        check(directory.exists()||directory.mkdirs())
        val temporary=File.createTempFile("dialogue-",".tmp",directory)
        try {
            FileOutputStream(temporary).use { it.write(bytes);it.fd.sync() }
            try { Files.move(temporary.toPath(),file.toPath(),StandardCopyOption.ATOMIC_MOVE,StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING) }
            catch(_:AtomicMoveNotSupportedException) { Files.move(temporary.toPath(),file.toPath(),StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING) }
        } finally { temporary.delete() }
    }

    companion object {
        const val MAX_QUARANTINED=3
        fun hash(bytes:ByteArray):String=MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256").digest(bytes).joinToString("") { "%02x".format(it) }

        /** Mirrors .github/continuum/dialogue-retrieval.mjs exactly (cross-runtime fixture).
         * Selected on the frozen retrieval benchmark (docs/retrieval-benchmark.json):
         * word-evidence gate + TF-IDF over character 3-5 grams inside content words,
         * IDF from the current memory corpus. Neural similarity is reported, not weighted:
         * it changed the top-3 for 44% of benchmark queries without a consistent gain.
         */
        private val STOP=setOf("was","wie","weißt","über","und","noch","dazu","darüber","das","die","der","ist","ich","mir","mein","meine","du","bitte","kannst","erzähl","erkläre","welche","dieses","thema",
            "den","dem","des","ein","eine","einer","eines","einem","einen","mit","von","vom","zum","zur","für","auf","aus","bei","sich","sie","er","es","wir","ihr","sind","wird","werden","wurde","wurden","hat","haben","im","in","an","am","zu","oder","als","auch","nicht","nur","man","wo","wer","warum","wieso","weshalb","wann","woher","wohin","womit","woraus","worauf","gibt","kann","macht","dass","dabei","dadurch","deshalb","heute","meist","oft","etwa","viele","vielen","ganz","später","früher","etwas","mehr","erzähle","sag","sage","weiß","kennst","bekannt")
        const val EVIDENCE_THRESHOLD=0.6
        private val WORD=Regex("[\\p{L}\\p{N}]+")

        internal fun contentWords(text:String):List<String> =
            WORD.findAll(text.lowercase(Locale.ROOT)).map { it.value }.filter { it.length>=3 && it !in STOP }.toList()

        internal fun wordGrams(text:String):LinkedHashMap<String,Int> {
            val grams=LinkedHashMap<String,Int>()
            for(word in contentWords(text)) {
                val padded="^$word$"
                for(k in 3..5) for(i in 0..padded.length-k) {
                    val g=padded.substring(i,i+k);grams[g]=(grams[g] ?: 0)+1
                }
            }
            return grams
        }

        private fun trigrams(word:String):Set<String> {
            val padded="^$word$";val out=LinkedHashSet<String>()
            for(i in 0..padded.length-3)out+=padded.substring(i,i+3)
            return out
        }

        /** 1 = exact content word, 0.8 = shared 5-letter prefix, else best trigram Dice. */
        internal fun wordEvidence(query:String,text:String):Double {
            val q=contentWords(query);val t=contentWords(text).distinct()
            var best=0.0
            for(a in q)for(b in t) {
                if(a==b)return 1.0
                if(a.length>=5 && b.length>=5 && a.substring(0,5)==b.substring(0,5))best=maxOf(best,0.8)
                val ta=trigrams(a);val tb=trigrams(b)
                val shared=ta.count { it in tb }
                best=maxOf(best,2.0*shared/(ta.size+tb.size))
            }
            return best
        }

        private fun weigh(counts:Map<String,Int>,idf:(String)->Double):LinkedHashMap<String,Double> {
            val v=LinkedHashMap<String,Double>()
            for((g,c) in counts)v[g]=(1+StrictMath.log(c.toDouble()))*idf(g)
            return v
        }

        private fun cosine(a:Map<String,Double>,b:Map<String,Double>):Double {
            var dot=0.0;var na=0.0;var nb=0.0
            for((g,x) in a){na+=x*x;val y=b[g];if(y!=null && y!=0.0)dot+=x*y}
            for(y in b.values)nb+=y*y
            return if(na>0 && nb>0)dot/StrictMath.sqrt(na*nb) else 0.0
        }

        private fun eligible(e:LearningExperience):Boolean =
            e.status in setOf(LearningStatus.CONFIRMED,LearningStatus.LEARNED,LearningStatus.OBSERVED,LearningStatus.REPLAY_PENDING) &&
            ((e.type==LearningExperienceType.USER_FACT && e.trust==LearningTrustClass.OWNER_CONFIRMED && e.provenance==LearningProvenance.USER_CONFIRMED && e.status!=LearningStatus.OBSERVED) ||
             (e.type==LearningExperienceType.SOURCE_TEXT && e.trust==LearningTrustClass.SOURCE_OBSERVATION &&
              e.provenance in setOf(LearningProvenance.REVIEWED_WEB_SOURCE,LearningProvenance.MENTOR_WIKIPEDIA) &&
              e.sourceRef?.startsWith("https://")==true))

        fun rank(bytes:ByteArray,query:String,experiences:List<LearningExperience>):List<ContinuumMemoryHit> {
            val model=TrainableSubwordEncoder.restore(bytes)
            val q=query.take(1000)
            val pool=experiences.filter(::eligible).distinctBy { it.id }
            val df=HashMap<String,Int>()
            for(e in pool)for(g in wordGrams(e.content.take(1000)).keys)df[g]=(df[g] ?: 0)+1
            val n=pool.size
            val idf={ g:String -> df[g]?.let { StrictMath.log((n+1.0)/(it+0.5)) } ?: StrictMath.log(n+1.0) }
            val qv=weigh(wordGrams(q),idf)
            return pool.mapNotNull { e ->
                val text=e.content.take(1000)
                if(wordEvidence(q,text)<EVIDENCE_THRESHOLD)return@mapNotNull null
                val score=cosine(qv,weigh(wordGrams(text),idf))
                if(!(score>0.0))return@mapNotNull null
                ContinuumMemoryHit(e.id,e.content,if(e.type==LearningExperienceType.USER_FACT)"Bestätigte Nutzererinnerung" else "Unbestätigte Quellenbeobachtung",e.sourceRef,
                    score,model.similarity(q,text))
            }.sortedWith(compareByDescending<ContinuumMemoryHit>{it.score}.thenBy{it.id}).take(3)
        }
    }
}

package at.heinz.deviceai.learning

import android.content.Context
import java.text.SimpleDateFormat
import java.util.Date
import java.util.Locale

/**
 * Local, bounded metadata about the actual JobScheduler path. No source contents,
 * owner facts, embeddings or model weights are written to preferences.
 */
data class ContinuumOfflineJobSnapshot(
    val scheduled: Boolean?,
    val phase: String,
    val lastStartedAt: Long,
    val lastFinishedAt: Long,
    val lastError: String,
    val scheduleError: String = ""
) {
    fun display(): String = buildString {
        append("Täglicher Offline-Lernjob: ")
        append(when(scheduled) { true -> "eingeplant"; false -> "Einplanung fehlgeschlagen"; null -> "nicht geprüft" })
        if(scheduled==false && scheduleError.isNotBlank())append(" (").append(scheduleError.take(60)).append(")")
        append("\nLetzter Zustand: ").append(phase)
        fun date(timestamp: Long): String =
            SimpleDateFormat("dd.MM.yyyy HH:mm",Locale.GERMANY).format(Date(timestamp))
        if(lastStartedAt>0L)append("\nBeginn: ").append(date(lastStartedAt))
        if(lastFinishedAt>0L)append("\nLetzter Abschluss: ").append(date(lastFinishedAt))
        if(lastError.isNotBlank())append("\nLetzter Fehler: ").append(lastError.take(120))
        append("\nAusführung erfordert Laden des Geräts; Android kann den Job verschieben.")
    }
}
object ContinuumOfflineJobStatus {
    private const val PREFS="continuum-offline-job-state"
    private fun prefs(context:Context)=context.applicationContext.getSharedPreferences(PREFS,Context.MODE_PRIVATE)

    fun scheduled(context:Context,success:Boolean,error:String?=null) {
        val edit=prefs(context).edit().putBoolean("scheduled",success)
        // Exception class name only, like failed(): no messages in preferences.
        if(error==null)edit.remove("schedule_error") else edit.putString("schedule_error",error.take(60))
        edit.apply()
    }
    fun started(context:Context,now:Long=System.currentTimeMillis()) {
        prefs(context).edit().putString("phase","RUNNING")
            .putLong("started",now).remove("error").apply()
    }
    fun finished(context:Context,now:Long=System.currentTimeMillis()) {
        prefs(context).edit().putString("phase","FINISHED")
            .putLong("finished",now).remove("error").apply()
    }
    fun stopped(context:Context,now:Long=System.currentTimeMillis()) {
        prefs(context).edit().putString("phase","INTERRUPTED")
            .putLong("finished",now).apply()
    }
    fun failed(context:Context,error:Throwable,now:Long=System.currentTimeMillis()) {
        // Never store exception messages: they may include source URLs or owner data.
        prefs(context).edit().putString("phase","FAILED")
            .putLong("finished",now)
            .putString("error",error.javaClass.simpleName.take(60)).apply()
    }
    fun read(context:Context):ContinuumOfflineJobSnapshot {
        val p=prefs(context)
        return ContinuumOfflineJobSnapshot(
            if(p.contains("scheduled"))p.getBoolean("scheduled",false) else null,
            p.getString("phase","NOT_RUN") ?: "NOT_RUN",
            p.getLong("started",0L),p.getLong("finished",0L),
            p.getString("error","").orEmpty(),
            p.getString("schedule_error","").orEmpty()
        )
    }
}

package at.heinz.deviceai.learning

import java.security.MessageDigest

/**
 * Byte-exact provenance binding for the public GitHub research model.
 * A SHA-256 digest provides integrity, NOT publisher authentication.
 * Import remains explicitly user selected; no network requests occur here.
 */
object ContinuumPublicModelPackage {
    data class Verified(val modelSha256:String,val codeSha:String?,val updates:Int)

    fun verify(model:ByteArray,manifestText:String):Verified {
        require(model.size==32960) { "Ungültige Modellgröße" }
        require(model.copyOfRange(0,4).contentEquals(byteArrayOf(83,87,66,49))) { "Ungültiger SWB1-Header" }
        require(manifestText.length in 30..16384) { "Ungültige Manifestgröße" }
        // Strict parser: duplicate keys or lenient syntax could otherwise make the
        // verified value differ from the value another reader would see.
        val json=StrictJson.parseObject(manifestText)
        require(json.optionalLong("schemaVersion",0L..1000L)==1L) { "Unbekannte Paketversion" }
        require(json.optionalString("format",16)=="SWB1") { "Unbekanntes Modellformat" }
        require(json.optionalString("privacy",64)=="PUBLIC_AND_CURATED_TRAINING_ONLY") {
            "Nicht-öffentliches Trainingspaket"
        }
        require(json.optionalLong("modelBytes",0L..1_000_000L)==model.size.toLong()) { "Modellgröße stimmt nicht" }
        val hash=json.requiredString("modelSha256",64)
        require(hash.matches(Regex("[a-f0-9]{64}"))) { "Ungültiger Modellhash" }
        json.optionalString("modelHash",64)?.let { require(it==hash) { "Manifest-Hashes widersprechen sich" } }
        val actual=MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256").digest(model)
            .joinToString("") { "%02x".format(it.toInt() and 255) }
        require(MessageDigest.isEqual(hash.toByteArray(Charsets.US_ASCII),
            actual.toByteArray(Charsets.US_ASCII))) { "Modell und Manifest stimmen nicht überein" }
        val codeSha=json.optionalString("codeSha",64)
        require(codeSha==null || codeSha.matches(Regex("[a-fA-F0-9]{40}"))) {
            "Ungültiger Code-Commit"
        }
        val updates=json.optionalLong("updates",0L..1_000_000L) ?: 0L
        return Verified(actual,codeSha,updates.toInt())
    }
}

package at.heinz.deviceai.learning

import java.io.File
import java.nio.file.Files
import java.nio.file.StandardCopyOption

/** Durable deduplication of previously examined, consent-gated source revisions. */
object ContinuumSourceNovelty {
    private val lock=Any()
    private val shaPattern=Regex("[0-9a-fA-F]{64}")
    private fun journal(base:File)=File(base,"learning-core-v2/source-attempts-v1.txt")

    fun pending(sources:List<MentorSource>,completed:Set<String>):List<MentorSource> =
        sources.filter { shaPattern.matches(it.sha) && it.sha.lowercase() !in completed }
            .distinctBy { it.sha.lowercase() }

    fun completedHashes(base:File):Set<String> = synchronized(lock) {
        val file=journal(base)
        if(!file.exists())return@synchronized emptySet()
        require(file.length()<=8192) { "Source attempts journal too large" }
        file.readLines().filter(shaPattern::matches).map(String::lowercase).toSet()
    }

    /** Mark after a completed, evaluated round (accepted or rejected); never after cancellation. */
    fun markCompleted(base:File,sources:List<MentorSource>) = synchronized(lock) {
        val old=completedHashes(base)
        val merged=(old+sources.map { it.sha.lowercase() }.filter(shaPattern::matches))
            .sorted().takeLast(120)
        val target=journal(base)
        target.parentFile?.mkdirs()
        val tmp=File(target.parentFile,target.name+".tmp")
        tmp.writeText(merged.joinToString("\n",postfix="\n"))
        try { Files.move(tmp.toPath(),target.toPath(),StandardCopyOption.ATOMIC_MOVE,
            StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING) }
        catch (_:java.nio.file.AtomicMoveNotSupportedException) {
            Files.move(tmp.toPath(),target.toPath(),StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING)
        }
    }
}

package at.heinz.deviceai.learning

import java.io.ByteArrayInputStream
import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream
import java.io.DataInputStream
import java.io.DataOutputStream
import java.security.MessageDigest

/** Bounded checksummed snapshots; checksum detects damage, not a hostile writer. */
internal object LearningSnapshot {
    fun encode(write: (DataOutputStream) -> Unit): ByteArray {
        val buffer = ByteArrayOutputStream()
        DataOutputStream(buffer).use(write)
        val body = buffer.toByteArray()
        require(body.size <= 65504)
        return body + MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256").digest(body)
    }
    fun <T> decode(bytes: ByteArray, read: (DataInputStream) -> T): T {
        require(bytes.size in 36..65536)
        val copy = bytes.copyOf()
        val body = copy.copyOfRange(0, copy.size - 32)
        require(MessageDigest.isEqual(MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256").digest(body),
            copy.copyOfRange(body.size, copy.size))) { "Learning snapshot checksum mismatch" }
        try {
            return DataInputStream(ByteArrayInputStream(body)).use { input ->
                read(input).also { require(input.available() == 0) }
            }
        } catch (e: java.io.IOException) {
            throw IllegalArgumentException("Invalid learning snapshot", e)
        }
    }
}
