package at.heinz.deviceai.learning

import java.security.MessageDigest
import java.util.Locale

/**
 * Local source-bound associative graph. It learns co-occurring terms from
 * retrieved text, not semantics or truth. No tools, labels or weights are changed.
 */
class MentorConceptNetwork private constructor(
    private val fingerprint:String,
    private val noteCount:Int,
    private val edges:List<Edge>
) {
    data class Edge(val left:String,val right:String,val source:Int)
    data class Relation(val term:String,val sources:List<Int>)
    val edgeCount:Int get()=edges.size
    val vocabularySize:Int get()=edges.flatMap { listOf(it.left,it.right) }.toSet().size
    fun related(term:String,limit:Int=6):List<Relation> {
        require(limit in 1..16)
        val key=terms(term).firstOrNull() ?: return emptyList()
        return edges.mapNotNull { e ->
            when(key) { e.left -> e.right to e.source; e.right -> e.left to e.source; else -> null }
        }.groupBy({it.first},{it.second})
            .map { (word,docs) -> Relation(word,docs.distinct().sorted()) }
            .sortedWith(compareByDescending<Relation>{it.sources.size}.thenBy{it.term})
            .take(limit)
    }
    fun serialize():String=buildString {
        append("MCA1\t").append(noteCount).append('\t').append(fingerprint).append('\n')
        edges.forEach { append(it.left).append('\t').append(it.right)
            .append('\t').append(it.source).append('\n') }
    }
    companion object {
        private const val MAX_NOTES=48
        private const val MAX_EDGES=1440
        private val stop=setOf("und","der","die","das","den","dem","des","ein","eine",
            "mit","für","von","oder","aus","ist","sind","auf","als","bei",
            "auch","werden","kann","nicht","nach","über","durch","wird",
            "einem","einen","einer","dieser","diese","eines")
        private val valid=Regex("[\\p{L}]{4,24}")
        private fun terms(text:String):List<String> =
            text.lowercase(Locale.GERMAN).split(Regex("[^\\p{L}]+"))
                .asSequence().filter { valid.matches(it) && it !in stop }
                .distinct().take(12).toList()
        private fun sourceFingerprint(notes:List<MentorSource>):String {
            val digest=MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256")
            notes.forEach { v ->
                listOf(v.subject,v.url,v.sha,v.excerpt).forEach { value ->
                    digest.update(value.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8))
                    digest.update(0.toByte())
                }
            }
            return digest.digest().joinToString("") { "%02x".format(it) }
        }
        fun build(notes:List<MentorSource>):MentorConceptNetwork {
            require(notes.size<=MAX_NOTES)
            val edges=linkedSetOf<Edge>()
            notes.forEachIndexed { index,note ->
                MentorSourceNotebook.checkSource(note)
                val words=terms(note.excerpt)
                for(i in words.indices) for(j in i+1..minOf(i+2,words.lastIndex)){
                    val a=minOf(words[i],words[j])
                    val b=maxOf(words[i],words[j])
                    if(a!=b)edges+=Edge(a,b,index)
                }
            }
            require(edges.size<=MAX_EDGES)
            return MentorConceptNetwork(sourceFingerprint(notes),notes.size,edges.toList())
        }
        fun restore(encoded:String,notes:List<MentorSource>):MentorConceptNetwork {
            require(encoded.length<=64000 && notes.size<=MAX_NOTES)
            val lines=encoded.lineSequence().filter(String::isNotEmpty).toList()
            require(lines.isNotEmpty() && lines.size<=MAX_EDGES+1)
            val header=lines.first().split('\t')
            require(header.size==3 && header[0]=="MCA1" &&
                header[1].toIntOrNull()==notes.size && header[2]==sourceFingerprint(notes))
            val loaded=lines.drop(1).map { line ->
                val fields=line.split('\t')
                require(fields.size==3)
                val source=fields[2].toIntOrNull()
                require(source!=null && source in notes.indices)
                require(valid.matches(fields[0]) && valid.matches(fields[1]) &&
                    fields[0]<fields[1])
                Edge(fields[0],fields[1],source)
            }
            val expected=build(notes)
            require(loaded==expected.edges)
            return expected
        }
    }
}

/** Source-linked responses about co-occurrence; no ungrounded inferred facts. */
object MentorAssociativeRecall {
    fun topic(message:String):String? {
        val prefix="mentor verbindungen:"
        val trimmed=message.trim()
        if(!trimmed.lowercase(Locale.GERMAN).startsWith(prefix))return null
        return trimmed.drop(prefix.length).trim().takeIf { it.length in 4..100 }
    }
    fun answer(message:String,notes:List<MentorSource>,model:MentorConceptNetwork):String? {
        val query=topic(message) ?: return null
        val related=model.related(query)
        if(related.isEmpty())return "Mentor: Zu "+query.take(60)+
            " kenne ich noch keine dokumentierten Begriffsverbindungen."
        return buildString {
            append("MENTOR · GELERNTE BEGRIFFSVERBINDUNGEN\n")
            append("Ausgangspunkt: ").append(query.take(60))
            related.forEach { edge ->
                append("\n\n• ").append(edge.term).append(" · ")
                    .append(edge.sources.size).append(" Quellenausschnitt(e)")
                val source=notes[edge.sources.first()]
                append("\nBeleg: ").append(source.url.take(220))
                append("\nSHA-256: ").append(source.sha.take(16))
            }
            append("\n\nUnbestätigte Internetbeobachtungen. Es handelt sich um " +
                "Wortnähe, nicht um bewiesene Zusammenhänge oder Sprachverständnis.")
        }.take(3000)
    }
}

package at.heinz.deviceai.learning

import java.util.Locale

/**
 * Expands the fixed interdisciplinary bootstrap syllabus using repeated,
 * source-bound terms from the existing Mentor notebook.
 *
 * Extracted terms are only search topics for the already constrained German
 * Wikipedia provider. They never become commands, facts, labels or tool input.
 */
object MentorCuriosityPlanner {
    private val valid=Regex("[\\p{L}]{5,28}")
    private val stop=setOf(
        "und","oder","sowie","aber","dass","dieser","diese","dieses","einer","einem",
        "einen","werden","wurde","wird","sind","ist","auch","nicht","durch","über",
        "unter","zwischen","gegen","ohne","nach","beim","deren","dessen","mehr",
        "heute","dabei","damit","kann","können","wurde","wurden","eine","eines",
        "lösche","loesche","öffne","oeffne","starte","installiere","deinstalliere",
        "passwort","token","dateien","kamera","mikrofon","shell","befehl"
    )

    private fun terms(text:String):List<String> =
        text.lowercase(Locale.GERMAN).split(Regex("[^\\p{L}]+"))
            .asSequence().filter { valid.matches(it) && it !in stop }
            .take(80).toList()

    private val fixedTerms: Set<String> by lazy {
        MentorCurriculum.topics.flatMap { topic -> terms(topic.area+" "+topic.query) }.toSet()
    }

    fun select(attempt:Long,notes:List<MentorSource>):MentorCurriculum.Topic {
        require(attempt>=0 && notes.size<=48)
        notes.forEach { MentorSourceNotebook.checkSource(it) }
        val fixed=MentorCurriculum.select(attempt)

        // Preserve broad coverage: every fourth acquisition stays on the authored syllabus.
        if(notes.size<6 || attempt%4L==0L)return fixed

        val sourceCount=linkedMapOf<String,Int>()
        val occurrenceCount=linkedMapOf<String,Int>()
        notes.forEach { note ->
            val words=terms(note.excerpt)
            words.forEach { word -> occurrenceCount[word]=(occurrenceCount[word] ?: 0)+1 }
            words.toSet().forEach { word -> sourceCount[word]=(sourceCount[word] ?: 0)+1 }
        }
        val candidates=occurrenceCount.keys.asSequence()
            .filter { it !in fixedTerms }
            .filter { (sourceCount[it] ?: 0)>=2 || (occurrenceCount[it] ?: 0)>=3 }
            .sortedWith(
                compareByDescending<String>{sourceCount[it] ?: 0}
                    .thenByDescending{occurrenceCount[it] ?: 0}
                    .thenBy{it}
            ).take(64).toList()
        if(candidates.isEmpty())return fixed

        val dynamicOrdinal=(attempt-attempt/4L-1L).coerceAtLeast(0L)
        val index=(dynamicOrdinal%candidates.size).toInt()
        val term=candidates[index]
        val label=term.replaceFirstChar {
            if(it.isLowerCase())it.titlecase(Locale.GERMAN) else it.toString()
        }
        return MentorCurriculum.Topic("Vertiefung · "+label,term)
    }
}

package at.heinz.deviceai.learning

/** An expandable interdisciplinary syllabus; topics are research questions, not answers. */
object MentorCurriculum {
    data class Topic(val area:String, val query:String)
    val topics=listOf(
        Topic("Biologie","Fotosynthese"), Topic("Physik","Gravitation"),
        Topic("Geschichte","Geschichte der Antike"), Topic("Mathematik","Primzahlen"),

package at.heinz.deviceai.learning

import java.util.Locale

/**
 * Bounded topic retrieval from opt-in source observations.
 * Not a language model. Never promotes a retrieved statement to truth or an action.
 */
object MentorRecall {
    private val stop= setOf("und","der","die","das","den","dem","des","ein","eine",
        "über","aus","mit","was","wie","ist","sind","bitte","wird","im","in","von")
    fun topic(message:String):String? {
        val prefix="mentor wissen:"
        val candidate=message.trim()
        if(!candidate.lowercase(Locale.GERMAN).startsWith(prefix))return null
        return candidate.drop(prefix.length).trim().takeIf { it.length in 3..120 }
    }
    private fun terms(s:String):Set<String> =
        s.lowercase(Locale.GERMAN).split(Regex("[^\\p{L}\\p{N}]+"))
            .asSequence().filter { it.length>=3 && it !in stop }.take(60).toSet()

    fun answer(message:String,notes:List<MentorSource>):String? {
        val sought=topic(message) ?: return null
        val tokens=terms(sought)
        if(tokens.isEmpty())return "Mentor: Bitte nenne ein konkretes Fachthema."
        val matched=notes.asSequence().filter { it.excerpt.length<=400 }
            .map { it to terms(it.subject+" "+it.excerpt).intersect(tokens).size }
            .filter { (_,matches)->matches >= if(tokens.size==1) 1 else 2 }
            .sortedWith(compareByDescending<Pair<MentorSource,Int>> { it.second }.thenBy { it.first.sha })
            .take(3).toList()
        if(matched.isEmpty())return "Mentor: Zu diesem Thema liegen noch keine passenden Quellenbeobachtungen " +
            "in meinem lokalen Studienheft vor. Ich erfinde keine Antwort."
        return buildString {
            append("Mentor: Ich habe ").append(matched.size)
                .append(" passende Quellenstellen gefunden. NICHT UNABHÄNGIG BESTÄTIGT:")
            matched.forEachIndexed { i,(note,_) ->
                append("\n\n").append(i+1).append(". ").append(note.excerpt.take(330))
                append("\nQuelle: ").append(note.url.take(250))
                append("\nSHA-256: ").append(note.sha.take(16))
            }
            append("\n\nDas ist quellengestützte Suche, keine eigene Sprachgenerierung und kein geprüfter Wahrheitsanspruch.")
        }.take(2400)
    }
}

FILE 170/375: app/src/main/java/at/heinz/deviceai/learning/MentorSemanticModel.kt
SHA-256: 5e8c204cafbc65f13faf2ed42b3cb847483178567adb47734fc17e177c9cbbf8

package at.heinz.deviceai.learning

import java.security.MessageDigest
import java.util.Locale
import kotlin.math.sqrt

/**
 * Small original distributional representation learned only from the bounded
 * Mentor source notebook. Terms become similar when they occur in similar local
 * contexts, even if the two terms never occur together.
 *
 * This is an experiment in representation learning, not a truth model and not
 * a general language model. It never grants tool authority or edits user memory.
 */
class MentorSemanticModel private constructor(
    private val fingerprint:String,
    private val noteCount:Int,
    private val vectors:Map<String,IntArray>,
    private val sources:Map<String,List<Int>>
) {
    data class SimilarTerm(
        val term:String,
        val similarity:Double,
        val sources:List<Int>
    )

    val vocabularySize:Int get()=vectors.size
    val activeDimensions:Int
        get()=vectors.values.sumOf { vector -> vector.count { it>0 } }

    fun similar(term:String,limit:Int=6):List<SimilarTerm> {
        require(limit in 1..16)
        val key=tokens(term).firstOrNull { vectors.containsKey(it) } ?: return emptyList()
        val query=vectors.getValue(key)
        val queryNorm=norm(query)
        if(queryNorm==0.0)return emptyList()
        return vectors.asSequence()
            .filter { (word,_) -> word!=key }
            .mapNotNull { (word,vector) ->
                val denominator=queryNorm*norm(vector)
                if(denominator==0.0)null else {
                    val score=dot(query,vector).toDouble()/denominator
                    if(score<MIN_SIMILARITY)null
                    else SimilarTerm(word,score,sources[word].orEmpty())
                }
            }
            .sortedWith(compareByDescending<SimilarTerm>{it.similarity}
                .thenByDescending{it.sources.size}.thenBy{it.term})
            .take(limit).toList()
    }

    fun serialize():String=buildString {
        append("MDS1\t").append(noteCount).append('\t').append(fingerprint).append('\n')
        vectors.keys.sorted().forEach { term ->
            append(term).append('\t')
            append(sources[term].orEmpty().joinToString(","))
            append('\t')
            val vector=vectors.getValue(term)
            append(vector.indices.asSequence().filter { vector[it]>0 }
                .joinToString(",") { i -> "${i}:${vector[i]}" })
            append('\n')
        }
    }

    companion object {
        private const val MAX_NOTES=48
        private const val MAX_VOCAB=128
        private const val MAX_TOKENS_PER_NOTE=64
        private const val DIMENSIONS=32
        private const val CONTEXT_RADIUS=3
        private const val MAX_SERIALIZED=90000
        private const val MIN_SIMILARITY=0.20
        private val valid=Regex("[\\p{L}]{4,28}")
        private val stop=setOf(
            "und","der","die","das","den","dem","des","ein","eine","einer","eines",
            "mit","für","von","oder","aus","ist","sind","auf","als","bei","auch",
            "werden","kann","nicht","nach","über","durch","wird","einem","einen",
            "dieser","diese","sowie","dass","sich","wie","was","wenn","mehr"
        )

        private fun tokens(text:String):List<String> =
            text.lowercase(Locale.GERMAN).split(Regex("[^\\p{L}]+"))
                .asSequence().filter { valid.matches(it) && it !in stop }
                .take(MAX_TOKENS_PER_NOTE).toList()

        private fun fingerprint(notes:List<MentorSource>):String {
            val digest=MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256")
            notes.forEach { note ->
                listOf(note.subject,note.url,note.sha,note.excerpt).forEach { value ->
                    digest.update(value.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8))
                    digest.update(0.toByte())
                }
            }
            return digest.digest().joinToString("") { "%02x".format(it) }
        }

        private fun stableBucket(value:String):Int {
            var hash=0x811c9dc5L
            value.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8).forEach { b ->
                hash=hash xor (b.toLong() and 0xffL)
                hash=(hash*0x01000193L) and 0xffffffffL
            }
            return (hash%DIMENSIONS).toInt()
        }

        private fun dot(a:IntArray,b:IntArray):Long {
            var total=0L
            for(i in a.indices)total+=a[i].toLong()*b[i].toLong()
            return total
        }

        private fun norm(a:IntArray):Double =
            sqrt(a.fold(0.0) { total,value -> total+value.toDouble()*value.toDouble() })

        fun build(notes:List<MentorSource>):MentorSemanticModel {
            require(notes.size<=MAX_NOTES)
            notes.forEach(MentorSourceNotebook::checkSource)
            val noteTokens=notes.map { tokens(it.excerpt) }
            val frequency=linkedMapOf<String,Int>()
            noteTokens.flatten().forEach { word -> frequency[word]=(frequency[word] ?: 0)+1 }
            val vocabulary=frequency.entries
                .sortedWith(compareByDescending<Map.Entry<String,Int>>{it.value}.thenBy{it.key})
                .take(MAX_VOCAB).map { it.key }.toSet()

            val vectors=linkedMapOf<String,IntArray>()
            val sourceSets=linkedMapOf<String,MutableSet<Int>>()
            vocabulary.sorted().forEach { word ->
                vectors[word]=IntArray(DIMENSIONS)
                sourceSets[word]=linkedSetOf()
            }

            noteTokens.forEachIndexed { sourceIndex,words ->
                words.forEachIndexed { index,word ->
                    val vector=vectors[word] ?: return@forEachIndexed
                    sourceSets.getValue(word).add(sourceIndex)
                    val start=maxOf(0,index-CONTEXT_RADIUS)
                    val end=minOf(words.lastIndex,index+CONTEXT_RADIUS)
                    for(contextIndex in start..end) {
                        if(contextIndex==index)continue
                        val context=words[contextIndex]
                        val distance=kotlin.math.abs(contextIndex-index)
                        val weight=CONTEXT_RADIUS+1-distance
                        val bucket=stableBucket(context)
                        vector[bucket]=(vector[bucket]+weight).coerceAtMost(100000)
                    }
                }
            }
            val frozenSources=sourceSets.mapValues { (_,set)->set.toList().sorted() }
            return MentorSemanticModel(fingerprint(notes),notes.size,vectors,frozenSources)
        }

        fun restore(encoded:String,notes:List<MentorSource>):MentorSemanticModel {
            require(encoded.length<=MAX_SERIALIZED && notes.size<=MAX_NOTES)
            val header=encoded.lineSequence().firstOrNull()?.split('\t') ?: emptyList()
            require(header.size==3 && header[0]=="MDS1" &&
                header[1].toIntOrNull()==notes.size && header[2]==fingerprint(notes))
            val expected=build(notes)
            require(encoded==expected.serialize())
            return expected
        }
    }
}

/** Read-only chat surface for the experimental local distributional representation. */
object MentorSemanticRecall {
    fun topic(message:String):String? {
        val trimmed=message.trim()
        val lower=trimmed.lowercase(Locale.GERMAN)
        val prefixes=listOf("mentor ähnlich:","mentor aehnlich:","mentor semantik:")
        val prefix=prefixes.firstOrNull(lower::startsWith) ?: return null
        return trimmed.drop(prefix.length).trim().takeIf { it.length in 4..100 }
    }

    fun answer(message:String,notes:List<MentorSource>,model:MentorSemanticModel):String? {
        val query=topic(message) ?: return null
        val similar=model.similar(query)
        if(similar.isEmpty())return "Mentor: Für "+query.take(60)+
            " habe ich noch kein belastbares lokales Verteilungsmuster gelernt."
        return buildString {
            append("MENTOR · VERTEILUNGSMUSTER (EXPERIMENT)\n")
            append("Ausgangspunkt: ").append(query.take(60))
            similar.forEach { result ->
                append("\n\n• ").append(result.term)
                append(" · Ähnlichkeit ")
                append(String.format(Locale.ROOT,"%.2f",result.similarity))
                if(result.sources.isNotEmpty()) {
                    val source=notes[result.sources.first()]
                    append("\nBeispielquelle: ").append(source.url.take(220))
                    append("\nSHA-256: ").append(source.sha.take(16))
                }
            }
            append("\n\nDie Ähnlichkeit entsteht aus gemeinsamem Wortkontext in lokal ")
            append("gespeicherten, unbestätigten Quellen. Sie beweist weder Bedeutung noch Wahrheit.")
        }.take(3000)
    }
}

package at.heinz.deviceai.learning

/** Public excerpt, never a trusted fact or a device instruction. */
data class MentorSource(val subject:String,val url:String,val sha:String,val excerpt:String)

/** Shared pure-JVM validation used by the Android notebook and learning core. */

        require(x.subject.length in 3..80 && x.url.startsWith("https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/") &&
            x.url.length<=420 && x.sha.matches(Regex("[0-9a-f]{64}")) &&
            x.excerpt.length in 20..400)
    }
}

package at.heinz.deviceai.learning

import android.app.job.JobParameters
import android.app.job.JobScheduler
import android.app.job.JobService
import android.content.Context
import at.heinz.deviceai.cognitive.*
import org.json.JSONArray
import org.json.JSONObject


class MentorSourceNotebook(context:Context) {
    private val prefs=context.applicationContext.getSharedPreferences("device_ai_mentor_studies_v1",Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
    val enabled:Boolean get()=prefs.getBoolean("enabled",false)
    val attempts:Long get()=prefs.getLong("attempts",0)
    val successes:Long get()=prefs.getLong("successes",0)
    val status:String get()=prefs.getString("status","Noch kein Studienzyklus.") ?: "Kein Status"
    fun enable():Boolean=prefs.edit().putBoolean("enabled",true).putString("status","Mentor bereit; jede Internetrecherche benötigt eine einmalige Freigabe.").commit()
    fun disable():Boolean=prefs.edit().putBoolean("enabled",false).putString("status","Forschung angehalten.").commit()
    fun entries():List<MentorSource> = synchronized(LOCK) {
        val text=prefs.getString("entries","[]") ?: "[]"
        require(text.length<=70000)
        val a=JSONArray(text)
        require(a.length()<=48)
        (0 until a.length()).map { i ->
            val o=a.getJSONObject(i)
            MentorSource(o.getString("subject"),o.getString("url"),o.getString("sha"),o.getString("excerpt"))
                .also(::checkSource)
        }
    }
    /** Restores an exact-source-bound associative model, rebuilding older notebooks on read. */
    fun conceptNetwork():MentorConceptNetwork=synchronized(LOCK) {
        val current=entries()
        val encoded=prefs.getString("associations",null)
        if(encoded==null)MentorConceptNetwork.build(current)
        else MentorConceptNetwork.restore(encoded,current)
    }
    /** Restores the source-bound distributional representation learned from the same notes. */
    fun semanticModel():MentorSemanticModel=synchronized(LOCK) {
        val current=entries()
        val encoded=prefs.getString("semantics",null)
        if(encoded==null)MentorSemanticModel.build(current)
        else MentorSemanticModel.restore(encoded,current)
    }
    fun add(newItems:List<MentorSource>):Int=synchronized(LOCK) {
        newItems.forEach(::checkSource)
        val old=entries()
        val merged=(old+newItems).distinctBy { it.sha+it.excerpt }.takeLast(48)
        val added=merged.count { next -> old.none { it.sha==next.sha && it.excerpt==next.excerpt } }
        val data=JSONArray()
        for (item in merged) data.put(JSONObject().put("subject",item.subject).put("url",item.url)
            .put("sha",item.sha).put("excerpt",item.excerpt))
        // Compute a new graph before the write. Both records and graph are published
        // atomically in one SharedPreferences editor, or neither replaces the old state.
        val network=MentorConceptNetwork.build(merged).serialize()
        val semantics=MentorSemanticModel.build(merged).serialize()
        check(prefs.edit().putString("entries",data.toString())
            .putString("associations",network)
            .putString("semantics",semantics).commit())
        added
    }
    fun record(subject:String,found:Int,message:String) {
        synchronized(LOCK) {
            val edit=prefs.edit()
                .putLong("attempts",(attempts+1).coerceAtMost(Long.MAX_VALUE-1))
                .putString("status",(subject+": "+message).take(400))
            if(found>0)edit.putLong("successes",(successes+1).coerceAtMost(Long.MAX_VALUE-1))
            check(edit.commit())
        }
    }
    fun clear():Boolean=synchronized(LOCK){
        prefs.edit().remove("entries").remove("associations").remove("semantics").commit()
    }
    companion object {
        private val LOCK=Any()
        fun checkSource(x:MentorSource) = MentorSourceValidation.checkSource(x)
    }
}

/** Converts an already owner-approved dossier; performs no network access. */
class MentorResearchCycle {
    fun sources(area:String,dossier:ResearchDossier):List<MentorSource> {
        val claims=WebLearningInbox.candidates(dossier).filter { !it.contradictory }.take(3)
            .map { MentorSource(area,it.sourceUrl,it.sourceHash,it.text.take(390)) }
        val excerpts=if(claims.isEmpty())dossier.sources.filter { it.duplicateOf==null }.take(2)
            .map { MentorSource(area,it.canonicalUrl,it.contentHash,
                it.snippet.replace(Regex("\\s+")," ").trim().take(390)) } else emptyList()
        return (claims+excerpts).filter { runCatching { MentorSourceNotebook.checkSource(it) }.isSuccess }
            .distinctBy { it.sha+it.excerpt }.take(3)
    }
}

class MentorStudyScheduler(context:Context) {
    private val app=context.applicationContext
    private val jobs get()=app.getSystemService(JobScheduler::class.java)
    val notebook get()=MentorSourceNotebook(app)
    fun enable():Boolean { jobs.cancel(JOB_ID);return notebook.enable() }
    fun disable(){notebook.disable();jobs.cancel(JOB_ID)}
    // Legacy schedules have no one-shot owner grant and cannot perform network I/O.
    fun restore(){jobs.cancel(JOB_ID)}
    fun runOnce(cancelled:()->Boolean={false}):String {
        jobs.cancel(JOB_ID)
        return "Internet auf Nachfrage: Forschungsfrage im Chat einmal freigeben."
    }
    companion object {
        const val JOB_ID=620133
    }
}
/** Installed upgrades can retain an old job. Cancel it without any I/O. */
class MentorStudyJobService:JobService() {
    override fun onStartJob(params:JobParameters):Boolean {
        MentorStudyScheduler(this).restore()
        return false
    }
    override fun onStopJob(params:JobParameters)=false
}

package at.heinz.deviceai.learning

import java.io.File
import java.io.FileOutputStream
import java.nio.file.AtomicMoveNotSupportedException
import java.nio.file.Files
import java.nio.file.StandardCopyOption

data class ModelCheckpoint(
    val sha256:String,
    val createdAt:Long,
    val reason:String,
    val updates:Int
)

/**
 * Content-addressed history of SWB1 encoder snapshots.
 *
 * The learning core archives the currently active weights here BEFORE any
 * model change (training acceptance, import, rollback), so every change can be
 * undone. Files are named by their SHA-256 and re-verified on restore; the
 * bounded index is checksummed and replaced atomically.
 */
class ModelCheckpointStore(private val directory:File) {
    private val index=File(directory,"index-v1.bin")

    fun list():List<ModelCheckpoint> = synchronized(LOCK) { load() }

    /** Archive [bytes] (a valid SWB1) unless the newest entry already holds it. */
    fun archive(bytes:ByteArray,reason:String,now:Long):ModelCheckpoint = synchronized(LOCK) {
        require(now>=0)
        val model=TrainableSubwordEncoder.restore(bytes)
        val hash=ContinuumMemoryDialogue.hash(bytes)
        val label=reason.trim().replace(Regex("[\\p{Cntrl}]")," ").take(MAX_REASON)
            .ifEmpty { "unbenannt" }
        val current=load()
        current.lastOrNull()?.takeIf { it.sha256==hash }?.let { return@synchronized it }
        if(!directory.isDirectory && !directory.mkdirs())error("Checkpoint-Verzeichnis nicht anlegbar")
        val file=fileFor(hash)
        if(!file.exists() || !verifies(file,hash))writeAtomically(file,bytes)
        val entry=ModelCheckpoint(hash,now,label,model.updates)
        val next=(current.filter { it.sha256!=hash }+entry).takeLast(MAX_CHECKPOINTS)
        save(next)
        val keep=next.map { it.sha256 }.toSet()
        directory.listFiles { f -> f.name.endsWith(SUFFIX) }?.forEach { f ->
            if(f.name.removeSuffix(SUFFIX) !in keep)f.delete()
        }
        entry
    }

    /** Verified bytes of a stored checkpoint, or an exception if missing/damaged. */
    fun read(sha256:String):ByteArray = synchronized(LOCK) {
        require(sha256.matches(HASH)) { "Ungültiger Checkpoint-Hash" }
        require(load().any { it.sha256==sha256 }) { "Checkpoint unbekannt" }
        val file=fileFor(sha256)
        require(file.exists() && file.length()<=65536) { "Checkpoint-Datei fehlt" }
        val bytes=file.readBytes()
        require(ContinuumMemoryDialogue.hash(bytes)==sha256) { "Checkpoint beschädigt" }
        TrainableSubwordEncoder.restore(bytes)
        bytes
    }

    private fun verifies(file:File,hash:String)=runCatching {
        file.length()<=65536 && ContinuumMemoryDialogue.hash(file.readBytes())==hash
    }.getOrDefault(false)

    private fun fileFor(hash:String)=File(directory,hash+SUFFIX)

    private fun load():List<ModelCheckpoint> {
        if(!index.exists())return emptyList()
        require(index.length() in 36..65536) { "Checkpoint-Index ungültig" }
        return LearningSnapshot.decode(index.readBytes()) { input ->
            require(input.readInt()==MAGIC)
            val count=input.readInt().also { require(it in 0..MAX_CHECKPOINTS) }
            List(count) {
                val hash=input.readUTF().also { require(it.matches(HASH)) }
                val at=input.readLong().also { require(it>=0) }
                val reason=input.readUTF().also { require(it.length in 1..MAX_REASON) }
                val updates=input.readInt().also { require(it in 0..1_000_000) }
                ModelCheckpoint(hash,at,reason,updates)
            }.also { list -> require(list.map { it.sha256 }.distinct().size==list.size) }
        }
    }

    private fun save(items:List<ModelCheckpoint>) {
        writeAtomically(index,LearningSnapshot.encode { out ->
            out.writeInt(MAGIC);out.writeInt(items.size)
            items.forEach { c ->
                out.writeUTF(c.sha256);out.writeLong(c.createdAt);out.writeUTF(c.reason);out.writeInt(c.updates)
            }
        })
    }

    private fun writeAtomically(target:File,bytes:ByteArray) {
        val temp=File.createTempFile("checkpoint-",".tmp",directory)
        try {
            FileOutputStream(temp).use { it.write(bytes);it.fd.sync() }
            try {
                Files.move(temp.toPath(),target.toPath(),StandardCopyOption.ATOMIC_MOVE,StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING)
            } catch(_:AtomicMoveNotSupportedException) {
                Files.move(temp.toPath(),target.toPath(),StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING)
            }
        } finally { temp.delete() }
    }

    companion object {
        const val MAX_CHECKPOINTS=12
        private const val MAX_REASON=120
        private const val MAGIC=0x434b5031 // "CKP1"
        private const val SUFFIX=".swb1"
        private val HASH=Regex("[a-f0-9]{64}")
        private val LOCK=Any()
    }
}

SHA-256: b437f621fd9cd5b6692f5d82873faa538ca28d1f5132d39853507bbe9761c6aa

package at.heinz.deviceai.learning

import java.util.Locale

/**
 * Privacy-first active-learning question generator.
 * Stores one brief, *unlabeled* utterance in volatile memory, never disk.
 * A user must choose the correct label and then confirm the existing training dialog.
 * It cannot call device tools, collect speech in the background, or assign labels itself.
 */
class NeuralCuriosityRadar {
    private var pending: String? = null
    private val forbidden = Regex(
        """(?i)\b(passwort|password|pin|iban|token|secret|schlüssel|api.?key|lösch\w*|"""+
        """installier\w*|deinstallier\w*|überweis\w*|bezah\w*|trainier\w*|"""+
        """neuron|hilfe|system|developer|merke|vergiss|recherchier\w*|https?)\b"""
    )
    fun peek(): String? = pending

    /** A visible curiosity question, NOT automatic learning of the chat itself. */
    fun offer(text: String, active: Boolean, alreadyTaught: Boolean = false): Boolean {
        if (!active || alreadyTaught || pending != null) return false
        val line = text.trim().replace(Regex("\\s+")," ")
        if (line.length !in 10..110 || line.any { it.isDigit() } ||
            !line.matches(Regex("[\\p{L} .,!?-]+")) ||
            forbidden.containsMatchIn(line.lowercase(Locale.ROOT))) return false
        val terms = line.split(Regex("\\s+"))
        if (terms.size !in 3..16) return false
        pending = line
        return true
    }

    fun consume(): String? = pending.also { pending = null }
    fun clear() { pending = null }
}

package at.heinz.deviceai.learning

import java.util.Locale

data class NeuralDialogueReport(
    val before: NeuralEvaluation,
    val after: NeuralEvaluation,
    val holdout: NeuralEvaluation,
    val holdoutBefore: NeuralEvaluation,
    val training: NeuralTraining,
    val unfamiliarBefore: NeuralEvaluation,
    val unfamiliarAfter: NeuralEvaluation

    val attemptedSteps: Int,
    val completedSteps: Int,
    val accepted: Boolean,
    val reason: String,

/** Measured, transactional outcome of one human-approved labeled lesson.
 * Prior examples exclude an explicitly corrected label for the same phrase.
 */
data class NeuralTeachingAudit(
    val training: NeuralTraining,
    val accepted: Boolean,
    val retainedBefore: Int,
    val retainedAfter: Int,
    val retainedTotal: Int,
    val priorLoss: Double?,
    val afterLoss: Double?,
    val newExampleScoreBefore: Double,
    val newExampleScoreAfter: Double,
    val reason: String
)

/** Experimental dialogue classification, NOT language generation or a factual authority.
 * Corpus is explicit, local and bounded. No chat logs/web text are implicitly learned.
 * Training is transactional: cancelled/partial training is never published.
 */
class NeuralDialogue {
    private var model = TinyNeuralNetwork(32, 42)
    private var lessons: List<Pair<String, Int>> = emptyList()
    private fun words(text: String): List<String> {
        require(text.length in 1..320)
        return text.lowercase(Locale.ROOT).split(Regex("[^\\p{L}\\p{N}]+"))
            .filter(String::isNotEmpty).take(48)
    }
    private fun features(text: String): List<Double> {
        val values = DoubleArray(32)
        words(text).forEach { values[(it.hashCode() and Int.MAX_VALUE) % values.size] = 1.0 }
        return values.toList()
    }
    private fun examples(data: List<Pair<String, Int>>) = data.map { NeuralExample(features(it.first), it.second) }

    @Synchronized fun trainDemo(
        approved: Boolean, cancelled: () -> Boolean = { false },
        onProgress: (NeuralLearningProgress) -> Unit = {}
    ): NeuralDialogueReport {
        require(approved)
        // Isolated reference experiment. Existing custom lessons require an explicit reset first.
        require(lessons.isEmpty()) { "Experiment zuerst ausdrücklich zurücksetzen; eigene Beispiele bleiben erhalten." }
        val candidate = TinyNeuralNetwork(32, 42)
        val train = examples(DEMO_TRAINING)
        val before = candidate.evaluate(train)
        val holdoutBefore = candidate.evaluate(examples(DEMO_HOLDOUT))
        val unfamiliarBefore = candidate.evaluate(examples(UNFAMILIAR_HOLDOUT))
        val result = candidate.train(train, 4000, cancelled = cancelled, onProgress = onProgress)
        val after = candidate.evaluate(train)
        val holdout = candidate.evaluate(examples(DEMO_HOLDOUT))
        if (!result.stoppedEarly && !cancelled()) { model = candidate; lessons = DEMO_TRAINING.toList() }
        return NeuralDialogueReport(before, after, holdout, holdoutBefore, result,
            unfamiliarBefore, candidate.evaluate(examples(UNFAMILIAR_HOLDOUT)))
    }
    @Synchronized fun teach(
        text: String, label: Int, approved: Boolean, cancelled: () -> Boolean = { false },
        onProgress: (NeuralLearningProgress) -> Unit = {}
    ): NeuralTraining = teachWithAudit(text, label, approved, cancelled, onProgress).training

    /**
     * Rehearse all previously approved examples, then test whether the proposed weights
     * learn the new lesson *without reducing* accuracy on the other approved lessons.
     * A deliberately corrected label supersedes the old label for that exact sentence.
     * Rejected attempts NEVER change the model or the persisted example list.
     */
    @Synchronized fun teachWithAudit(
        text: String, label: Int, approved: Boolean, cancelled: () -> Boolean = { false },
        onProgress: (NeuralLearningProgress) -> Unit = {}
    ): NeuralTeachingAudit {
        require(approved && label in 0..1 && words(text).isNotEmpty())
        require(lessons.size < 64 || lessons.any { it.first == text })
        val previous = lessons.filterNot { it.first == text }
        val nextLessons = previous + (text to label)
        val priorExamples = if (previous.isNotEmpty()) examples(previous) else null
        val priorBefore = priorExamples?.let(model::evaluate)
        val incoming = features(text)
        val incomingBefore = model.predict(incoming)
        val candidate = TinyNeuralNetwork.restore(model.save())
        val training = candidate.train(
            examples(nextLessons), 800, cancelled = cancelled, onProgress = onProgress
        )
        val priorAfter = priorExamples?.let(candidate::evaluate)
        val incomingAfter = candidate.predict(incoming)
        // 0.55/0.45 is a modest classification confidence gate, not semantic certainty.
        val learnedNewExample = if (label == 1) incomingAfter >= 0.55 else incomingAfter <= 0.45
        val retained = priorBefore == null || (
            priorAfter!!.correct >= priorBefore.correct &&
            priorAfter.loss <= priorBefore.loss + 0.075
        )
        val accepted = !training.stoppedEarly && !cancelled() && learnedNewExample && retained
        val reason = when {
            training.stoppedEarly || cancelled() -> "Abgebrochen oder Zeitlimit; alter Stand erhalten"
            !learnedNewExample -> "Neuer Satz noch nicht zuverlässig als Gruß/Frage erkannt"
            !retained -> "Bestehende bestätigte Sprachbeispiele würden schlechter erkannt"
            else -> "Neuer Satz erkannt und bestätigte ältere Beispiele behalten"
        }
        if (accepted) { model = candidate; lessons = nextLessons }
        return NeuralTeachingAudit(
            training, accepted,
            priorBefore?.correct ?: 0, priorAfter?.correct ?: 0, previous.size,
            priorBefore?.loss, priorAfter?.loss,
            incomingBefore, incomingAfter, reason
        )
    }
    @Synchronized fun reply(text: String): String {
        val inputWords = words(text)
        if (lessons.isEmpty()) return "Neuronales Experiment noch nicht trainiert. Öffne das Lernlabor oder schreibe „Neuron Demo“."
        val known = lessons.flatMap { words(it.first) }.toSet()
        if (inputWords.isEmpty() || inputWords.count { it in known } * 2 < inputWords.size)
            return "Neuronales Experiment: Wortschatz unbekannt; keine belastbare Zuordnung."
        val score = model.predict(features(text))
        if (lessons.map { it.second }.distinct().size < 2 || score in 0.2..0.8)
            return "Neuronales Experiment: unsicher. Bitte weitere Beispiele für Gruß und Frage beibringen."
        val label = if (score < 0.5) "Gruß" else "Frage"
        val response = if (label == "Gruß") "Hallo! Ich bin da." else "Ich erkenne möglicherweise eine Frage. Was möchtest du mir beibringen?"
        return "$response\nNeuronales Experiment: $label, Modellscore ${String.format(Locale.ROOT, "%.3f", if (score < 0.5) 1-score else score)}. " +
            "Die Zuordnung wurde neuronal gelernt; dieser Antworttext ist vorgegeben. Noch keine freie Sprachgenerierung."
    }
    @Synchronized fun lessonCount(): Int = lessons.size
    @Synchronized fun hasLesson(text: String): Boolean =
        lessons.any { (phrase, _) -> phrase.equals(text.trim(), ignoreCase = true) }

    /** Content fingerprint over explicitly approved examples only (not passwords, chat logs or URLs). */
    @Synchronized fun lessonFingerprint(): String {
        val digest = java.security.MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256")
        lessons.sortedWith(compareBy<Pair<String, Int>> { it.first }.thenBy { it.second }).forEach { (text, label) ->
            digest.update(label.toByte())
            digest.update(text.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8))
            digest.update(0.toByte())
        }
        return digest.digest().joinToString("") { "%02x".format(it) }
    }

    /** Repeat a small bounded neural learning cycle using ONLY already approved lessons.
     * Candidate weights are discarded if tests regress or the cycle is cancelled.
     * This is not self-supervised web learning or a generative language model.
     */
    @Synchronized fun practice(
        steps: Int = 200,
        cancelled: () -> Boolean = { false },
        onProgress: (NeuralLearningProgress) -> Unit = {}
    ): NeuralPracticeReport {
        require(steps in 1..300)
        require(lessons.isNotEmpty()) { "Keine bestätigten neuronalen Beispiele vorhanden." }
        val candidate = TinyNeuralNetwork.restore(model.save())
        val trainingExamples = examples(lessons)
        val trainingBefore = candidate.evaluate(trainingExamples)
        val knownBefore = candidate.evaluate(examples(DEMO_HOLDOUT))
        val unfamiliarBefore = candidate.evaluate(examples(UNFAMILIAR_HOLDOUT))
        val result = candidate.train(
            trainingExamples, steps, maxMillis = 1_200,
            cancelled = cancelled, onProgress = onProgress
        )
        val trainingAfter = candidate.evaluate(trainingExamples)
        val knownAfter = candidate.evaluate(examples(DEMO_HOLDOUT))
        val unfamiliarAfter = candidate.evaluate(examples(UNFAMILIAR_HOLDOUT))
        val accepted = !result.stoppedEarly && !cancelled() &&
            trainingAfter.loss + 0.000001 < trainingBefore.loss &&
            knownAfter.correct >= knownBefore.correct &&
            knownAfter.loss <= knownBefore.loss + 0.02 &&
            unfamiliarAfter.correct >= unfamiliarBefore.correct &&
            unfamiliarAfter.loss <= unfamiliarBefore.loss + 0.02
        val reason = when {
            result.stoppedEarly || cancelled() -> "Abgebrochen oder Zeitlimit"
            !accepted -> "Keine sichere Verbesserung auf Trainings- und unabhängigen Prüfbeispielen"
            else -> "Trainingsverlust verbessert; unabhängige Tests nicht verschlechtert"
        }
        if (accepted) model = candidate
        return NeuralPracticeReport(
            steps, result.steps, accepted, reason,
            trainingBefore.loss, trainingAfter.loss,
            knownBefore, knownAfter, unfamiliarBefore, unfamiliarAfter
        )
    }

    /** OOD benchmark; never trains or modifies weights. Unknown word tokens by design. */
    @Synchronized fun unfamiliarEvaluation(): NeuralEvaluation =
        model.evaluate(examples(UNFAMILIAR_HOLDOUT))

    @Synchronized fun status(): String = "Neuronales Gesprächsexperiment: ${lessons.size}/64 Beispiele, ${model.updates} Gewichtsaktualisierungen. " +
        "32 Eingaben, 8 versteckte Neuronen, 1 Ausgabe. Kein Sprachmodell.\n" +
        "Neuron Demo · Neuron Sprachlabor · Neuron Vergleichslabor · Neuron üben · Neuron Härtetest · Neuron: Hallo · Neuron lerne: Servus => Gruß · Neuron zurücksetzen"
    @Synchronized fun reset() { model = TinyNeuralNetwork(32, 42); lessons = emptyList() }
    @Synchronized fun save(): ByteArray = LearningSnapshot.encode { out ->
        out.writeInt(0x44444331)
        val state = model.save()
        out.writeInt(state.size); out.write(state)
        out.writeInt(lessons.size)
        lessons.forEach { (text, label) -> out.writeUTF(text); out.writeInt(label) }
    }
    companion object {
        // Authored synthetic examples; no private user data, downloads, or imported weights.
        val DEMO_TRAINING = listOf(
            "hallo" to 0, "servus" to 0, "hey" to 0, "guten morgen" to 0,
            "guten tag" to 0, "hallo device" to 0, "servus device" to 0, "hey device" to 0,
            "was kannst du" to 1, "wie geht es dir" to 1, "wer bist du" to 1, "was weißt du" to 1,
            "wie lernst du" to 1, "was bedeutet das" to 1, "wer kann helfen" to 1, "wie funktioniert das" to 1
        )
        val DEMO_HOLDOUT = listOf(
            "hallo guten tag" to 0, "servus guten morgen" to 0, "hey guten tag" to 0, "hallo servus" to 0,
            "was lernst du" to 1, "wie kannst du helfen" to 1, "wer weiß das" to 1, "wie geht das" to 1
        )
        // Frozen novel-vocabulary corpus. Deliberately no tokens from DEMO_TRAINING.
        val UNFAMILIAR_HOLDOUT = listOf(
            "moin" to 0, "grüß gott" to 0, "tachchen" to 0,
            "willkommen zurück" to 0, "schönen abend" to 0, "na ihr" to 0,
            "woher stammt silizium" to 1, "warum leuchten sterne" to 1,
            "welche zeit herrscht" to 1, "wann beginnt sommer" to 1,
            "wo liegt graz" to 1, "wieviel kostet brot" to 1
        )
        fun accepts(text: String): Boolean {
            val key = text.trim().lowercase(Locale.ROOT)
            return key == "neuron" || key.startsWith("neuron:") || key.startsWith("neuron ")
        }
        fun restore(bytes: ByteArray): NeuralDialogue = LearningSnapshot.decode(bytes) { input ->
            require(input.readInt() == 0x44444331)
            val length = input.readInt().also { require(it in 36..4096 && it <= input.available()) }
            val saved = ByteArray(length).also(input::readFully)
            val model = TinyNeuralNetwork.restore(saved)
            require(model.inputSize == 32)
            val count = input.readInt().also { require(it in 0..64) }
            val lab = NeuralDialogue()

                val text = input.readUTF()
                val label = input.readInt()
                require(label in 0..1 && lab.words(text).isNotEmpty())

            }
            require(lessons.map { it.first }.distinct().size == lessons.size)
            require((count == 0) == (model.updates == 0))
            lab.model = model; lab.lessons = lessons
            lab
        }
    }

enum class NeuralCommandKind { STATUS, DEMO, PREDICT, TEACH, RESET, UNFAMILIAR_TEST, PRACTICE, STRUCTURE_LAB, COMPARE_LAB }
data class NeuralCommand(val kind: NeuralCommandKind, val text: String = "", val label: Int = 0)
object NeuralCommandParser {
    fun parse(input: String): NeuralCommand? {
        if (input.length > 400) return null
        val text = input.trim()
        val low = text.lowercase(Locale.ROOT)
        return when {
            low == "neuron" || low == "neuron status" -> NeuralCommand(NeuralCommandKind.STATUS)
            low == "neuron demo" -> NeuralCommand(NeuralCommandKind.DEMO)
            low == "neuron vergleichslabor" || low == "neuron vergleich" ->
                NeuralCommand(NeuralCommandKind.COMPARE_LAB)
            low == "neuron sprachlabor" || low == "neuron strukturtest" ->
                NeuralCommand(NeuralCommandKind.STRUCTURE_LAB)
            low == "neuron üben" || low == "neuron wiederholen" ->
                NeuralCommand(NeuralCommandKind.PRACTICE)
            low == "neuron härtetest" || low == "neuron generalisierung" ||
                low == "neuron ood" -> NeuralCommand(NeuralCommandKind.UNFAMILIAR_TEST)
            low == "neuron zurücksetzen" -> NeuralCommand(NeuralCommandKind.RESET)
            low.startsWith("neuron:") -> text.substringAfter(':').trim().takeIf { it.length in 1..320 }
                ?.let { NeuralCommand(NeuralCommandKind.PREDICT, it) }
            low.startsWith("neuron lerne:") -> {
                val parts = text.substringAfter(':').split("=>").map(String::trim)
                if (parts.size != 2 || parts[0].length !in 3..320) null else {
                    val label = when (parts[1].lowercase(Locale.ROOT)) { "gruß", "gruss" -> 0; "frage" -> 1; else -> -1 }
                    if (label < 0) null else NeuralCommand(NeuralCommandKind.TEACH, parts[0], label)
                }
            }
            else -> null
        }
    }
}

package at.heinz.deviceai.learning

import java.util.Locale

/**
 * Read-only, independently seeded research comparison.
 * All datasets are intentionally small, authored synthetic fixtures, NOT evidence
 * of general German understanding. No production model or user record is updated.
 *
 * Factorial design: original vs broader example coverage, crossed with
 * coarse first-letter vs character-bigram features.
 * This separates more data from a changed feature representation.
 */
object NeuralGeneralizationComparison {
    enum class Encoder { FIRST_LETTER, CHAR_BIGRAM }

    data class Trial(
        val encoder: Encoder,
        val examples: Int,
        val train: NeuralEvaluation,
        val familiar: NeuralEvaluation,
        val unfamiliar: NeuralEvaluation,
        val counterexamples: NeuralEvaluation,
        val fresh: NeuralEvaluation,
        val steps: Int,
        val stoppedEarly: Boolean,
        val unfamiliarOverlapTokens: Int
    )

    private const val STEPS = 3000
    private const val FEATURE_COUNT = 32

    // New approved-by-developer synthetic fixtures; never sourced from user
    // conversations or web pages. No example sentence duplicates the test pools.
    val DIVERSE_TRAINING: List<Pair<String, Int>> = listOf(
        "liebe grüße an euch" to 0,
        "wünsche einen freundlichen tag" to 0,
        "frohen feierabend miteinander" to 0,
        "herzlichen empfang" to 0,
        "einen angenehmen morgengruß" to 0,
        "schön dich wiederzusehen" to 0,
        "willkommen mein freund" to 0,
        "wunderbaren sonntag euch" to 0,
        "servus an alle" to 0,
        "guten abend zusammen" to 0,
        "beste grüße" to 0,
        "hey leute schön euch zu sehen" to 0,
        "ist das eine gute idee" to 1,
        "hast du eine antwort" to 1,
        "kannst du zuhören" to 1,
        "dürfte das klappen" to 1,
        "wäre dies möglich" to 1,
        "magst du kaffee" to 1,
        "soll ich beginnen" to 1,
        "können wir reden" to 1,
        "möchtest du einen tipp" to 1,
        "gibt es einen plan" to 1,
        "brauchst du hilfe" to 1,
        "stimmt diese erklärung" to 1
    )

    // Newly authored control group with question forms, greetings and punctuation
    // variants; no exact training text occurs here. It becomes an exploratory
    // test after first use and MUST NOT be presented as external real-world proof.
    val FRESH_CONTROL: List<Pair<String, Int>> = listOf(
        "Sollte ich morgen fahren" to 1,
        "Würdest du das empfehlen" to 1,
        "Kann man dort parken" to 1,
        "Brauchst du noch etwas" to 1,
        "Was wäre anders" to 1,
        "Gibt es Alternativen" to 1,
        "Musst du jetzt gehen" to 1,
        "Dürfen wir starten" to 1,
        "Ist morgen Feiertag" to 1,
        "Weiß jemand Bescheid" to 1,
        "Herzlichste Grüße aus der Ferne" to 0,
        "Guten Start in die Woche" to 0,
        "Einen sonnigen Gruß" to 0,
        "Hi ihr Lieben" to 0,
        "Wünsche dir Glück" to 0,
        "Frohe Feiertage miteinander" to 0,
        "Morgen allerseits" to 0,
        "Beste Wünsche" to 0,
        "Hallo zurück" to 0,
        "Tach in die Runde" to 0
    )

    private fun tokens(text: String): List<String> =
        text.lowercase(Locale.GERMAN)
            .split(Regex("[^\\p{L}\\p{N}]+"))
            .filter { it.isNotEmpty() }.take(48)

    /** No rules for 'question' or 'greeting' labels live in this encoder. */
    fun features(text: String, encoder: Encoder): List<Double> {
        require(text.length in 1..320)
        if (encoder == Encoder.FIRST_LETTER) return NeuralTransferExperiment.features(text)
        val words = tokens(text)
        val values = DoubleArray(FEATURE_COUNT)
        val first = words.firstOrNull()
        if (first != null) {
            // First two characters distinguish e.g. wie/was/willkommen/wunderbar.
            val prefix = first.take(2)
            values[(prefix.hashCode() and Int.MAX_VALUE) % 12] = 1.0
            words.forEach { word ->
                val padded = "^" + word + "$"
                for (i in 0 until padded.length - 1) {
                    val pair = padded.substring(i, i + 2)
                    values[12 + ((pair.hashCode() and Int.MAX_VALUE) % 15)] = 1.0
                }
            }
        }
        values[27] = if (text.trimEnd().endsWith("?")) 1.0 else 0.0
        values[28] = if (words.size == 1) 1.0 else 0.0
        values[29] = if (words.size >= 3) 1.0 else 0.0
        values[30] = if (words.size >= 5) 1.0 else 0.0
        values[31] = if (first != null && first.length >= 7) 1.0 else 0.0
        return values.toList()
    }

    private fun lexicalOverlap(training: List<Pair<String, Int>>,
                               holdout: List<Pair<String, Int>>): Int {
        val known = training.flatMap { tokens(it.first) }.toSet()
        return holdout.flatMap { tokens(it.first) }.toSet().intersect(known).size
    }

    fun run(
        cancelled: () -> Boolean = { false },
        onProgress: (NeuralLearningProgress) -> Unit = {}
    ): List<Trial> {
        val stages = listOf(
            Encoder.FIRST_LETTER to false,
            Encoder.FIRST_LETTER to true,
            Encoder.CHAR_BIGRAM to false,
            Encoder.CHAR_BIGRAM to true
        )
        val results = mutableListOf<Trial>()
        stages.forEachIndexed { index, (encoder, diverse) ->
            if (cancelled()) return results
            val corpus = if (diverse) NeuralDialogue.DEMO_TRAINING + DIVERSE_TRAINING
                         else NeuralDialogue.DEMO_TRAINING
            fun examples(items: List<Pair<String, Int>>) =
                items.map { (s, label) -> NeuralExample(features(s, encoder), label) }
            val net = TinyNeuralNetwork(FEATURE_COUNT, seed = 42)
            val process = net.train(examples(corpus), STEPS, maxMillis = 3500,
                cancelled = cancelled, onProgress = { progress ->
                    onProgress(progress.copy(
                        step = index * STEPS + progress.step,
                        total = stages.size * STEPS
                    ))
                })
            results += Trial(
                encoder = encoder, examples = corpus.size,
                train = net.evaluate(examples(corpus)),
                familiar = net.evaluate(examples(NeuralDialogue.DEMO_HOLDOUT)),
                unfamiliar = net.evaluate(examples(NeuralDialogue.UNFAMILIAR_HOLDOUT)),
                counterexamples = net.evaluate(examples(NeuralTransferExperiment.CHALLENGE)),
                fresh = net.evaluate(examples(FRESH_CONTROL)),
                steps = process.steps, stoppedEarly = process.stoppedEarly,
                unfamiliarOverlapTokens = lexicalOverlap(
                    corpus, NeuralDialogue.UNFAMILIAR_HOLDOUT)
            )
            if (process.stoppedEarly) return results
        }
        return results
    }
}

package at.heinz.deviceai.learning

import java.util.Locale

/** An explicit, bounded conversation for teaching the *existing* binary neural learner.
 * No general-purpose prompt, internet or device instruction is ever executed here.
 */
class NeuralLearningCoach {
    private var awaitingLabelFor: String? = null
    private val queuedExamples = java.util.ArrayDeque<String>()
    private var batchTotal = 0
    private var batchIndex = 0
    private var running = false

    data class Reply(
        val message: String,
        val approvedLesson: NeuralCommand? = null,
        val closed: Boolean = false
    )

    fun isActive() = running

    fun begin(): Reply {
        running = true
        awaitingLabelFor = null
        queuedExamples.clear()
        batchTotal = 0
        batchIndex = 0
        return Reply("LERN-GESPRÄCH AKTIV. Ich lerne kleine Sprachmuster, noch keine freien Gespräche. " +
            "Sag oder schreibe einen kurzen Beispielsatz (3–320 Zeichen). " +
            "Ich frage danach, ob es ein Gruß oder eine Frage ist. " +
            "Jede Gewichtsänderung braucht danach deine ausdrückliche Bestätigung. " +
            "Mit „Ende“ kannst du jederzeit aufhören.")
    }

    fun accept(text: String): Reply? {
        if (!running) return null
        val phrase = text.trim()
        val low = phrase.lowercase(Locale.ROOT)
        if (low in setOf("ende", "stopp", "lernmodus beenden", "neuron tutor aus")) {
            running = false
            awaitingLabelFor = null
            queuedExamples.clear()
            batchTotal = 0
            batchIndex = 0
            return Reply("Lern-Gespräch beendet. Bereits bestätigte Gewichte bleiben gespeichert.", closed = true)
        }
        val pending = awaitingLabelFor
        if (pending == null) {
            val examples = extractExamples(phrase)
            if (examples.isEmpty())
                return Reply("Bitte nur einen kurzen, unkritischen Beispielsatz mit 3–320 Zeichen sagen. Keine Passwörter oder Zugangsdaten.")
            awaitingLabelFor = examples.first()
            queuedExamples.clear()
            examples.drop(1).forEach(queuedExamples::addLast)
            batchTotal = examples.size
            batchIndex = 1
            val prefix = if (examples.size > 1)
                "Ich habe ${examples.size} getrennte Beispiele erkannt und gehe sie nacheinander durch. "
                else ""
            val count = if (examples.size > 1) "1/${examples.size} " else ""
            return Reply(prefix + "Beispiel " + count + "gehört: „${examples.first().take(120)}“. " +
                "War das ein **Gruß** oder eine **Frage**? Sag „Gruß“ oder „Frage“, oder „Ende“.")
        }
        val label = when(low) { "gruß", "gruss" -> 0; "frage" -> 1; else -> null }
            ?: return Reply("Bitte antworte mit „Gruß“, „Frage“ oder „Ende“. Noch nichts trainiert.")
        val command=NeuralCommand(NeuralCommandKind.TEACH, pending, label)
        val next=queuedExamples.pollFirst()
        if(next==null) {
            awaitingLabelFor = null
            batchTotal = 0
            batchIndex = 0
            return Reply("Beispiel klassifiziert. Ich bitte nun um deine Trainingsfreigabe. Danach kannst du mir ein weiteres Beispiel sagen.",
                command)
        }
        batchIndex += 1
        awaitingLabelFor = next
        return Reply("Beispiel klassifiziert; die Trainingsfreigabe folgt separat. " +
            "Nächstes Beispiel ${batchIndex}/${batchTotal}: „${next.take(120)}“. " +
            "War das ein **Gruß** oder eine **Frage**?", command)
    }

    private fun extractExamples(text:String):List<String> {
        if(text.length !in 3..1600)return emptyList()
        val quoted = buildList {
            Regex("„([^„“]{3,320})“").findAll(text).forEach { add(it.range.first to it.groupValues[1].trim()) }
            Regex("\"([^\"]{3,320})\"").findAll(text).forEach { add(it.range.first to it.groupValues[1].trim()) }
        }.sortedBy { it.first }.map { it.second }.distinct()
        val candidates = if(quoted.size>=2) quoted else listOf(text.trim())
        return candidates.filter(::validExample).take(12)
    }

    private fun validExample(text:String):Boolean =
        text.length in 3..320 &&
            !text.startsWith("neuron",true) &&
            !text.contains(Regex("""(?i)\b(passwort|password|token|api.?key|secret|iban|pin)\b"""))
}

package at.heinz.deviceai.learning

import android.app.job.JobInfo
import android.app.job.JobParameters
import android.app.job.JobScheduler
import android.app.job.JobService
import android.content.ComponentName
import android.content.Context
import at.heinz.deviceai.BootstrapMemoryStore
import java.util.Locale
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicBoolean

/**
 * Explicitly opted-in learning conductor for the EXISTING local 273-weight classifier.
 *
 * - While UI is visible: short opportunities without charging (activity checks battery/power saver).
 * - Background: JobScheduler permits small cycles when charging, not a permanent process.
 * - When three cycles do not improve generalization, stop weight updates until new APPROVED lessons.
 * - All prior weights are retained unless frozen holdouts and user-approved training improve.
 * No network, always-listening microphone, device tool call or unreviewed self-labeling.
 */
class NeuralPracticeScheduler(context: Context) {
    private val app = context.applicationContext
    private val prefs = app.getSharedPreferences(PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
    private val jobs get() = app.getSystemService(JobScheduler::class.java)

    val enabled: Boolean get() = prefs.getBoolean("enabled", false)
    val lastStatus: String get() = prefs.getString("status", "Noch kein Lernzyklus.")
        ?: "Noch kein Lernzyklus."
    val attempts: Int get() = prefs.getInt("attempts", 0)
    val improvements: Int get() = prefs.getInt("improvements", 0)
    val waitingForExperience: Boolean get() =
        enabled && prefs.getInt("stagnant", 0) >= 3

    fun enable(): Boolean {
        val lab = runCatching {
            BootstrapMemoryStore(app).neuralSnapshot()?.let(NeuralDialogue::restore)
        }.getOrNull()
        if (lab == null || lab.lessonCount() == 0) return false
        if (!schedule()) return false
        val success = prefs.edit()
            .putBoolean("enabled", true)
            .putInt("stagnant", 0)
            .putString("fingerprint", lab.lessonFingerprint())
            .putString("status", "Lernbereit: im Vordergrund und beim Laden im Hintergrund.")
            .commit()
        if (!success) jobs.cancel(JOB_ID)
        return success
    }

    fun restoreIfEnabled() {
        if (enabled && jobs.getPendingJob(JOB_ID) == null) schedule()
    }

    fun disable() {
        prefs.edit().putBoolean("enabled", false)
            .putString("status", "Automatisches Üben ausgeschaltet. Gewichte bleiben erhalten.").commit()
        jobs.cancel(JOB_ID)
    }

    /**
     * One bounded cycle, also usable from the visible app's background executor.
     * Caller must not invoke on main thread. Serialized across JobService and foreground.
     */
    fun practiceOnce(cancelled: () -> Boolean = { false },
        progress: (NeuralLearningProgress) -> Unit = {}
    ): String {
        if (!enabled || cancelled()) return "Lernzyklus nicht aktiv."
        if (!RUNNING.compareAndSet(false, true)) return "Bereits ein Lernzyklus aktiv."
        try {
            val memory = BootstrapMemoryStore(app)
            val original = memory.neuralSnapshot()
                ?: return record("Kein trainierter neuronaler Lernstand vorhanden.", false, "")
            val model = NeuralDialogue.restore(original)
            if (model.lessonCount() == 0)
                return record("Keine bestätigten Lernbeispiele vorhanden.", false, model.lessonFingerprint())
            val fingerprint = model.lessonFingerprint()
            if (!canPractice(fingerprint)) {
                val waiting = "Lernbereit: Ich warte auf ein neues bestätigtes Sprachbeispiel. " +
                    "Die bisherigen Wiederholungen haben keinen weiteren Fortschritt gebracht."
                prefs.edit().putString("status", waiting).apply()
                return waiting
            }
            val result = model.practice(steps = 200, cancelled = cancelled, onProgress = progress)
            if (cancelled() || !enabled) return "Übungsdurchgang abgebrochen; nichts gespeichert."
            if (!result.accepted)
                return record("200er-Zyklus verworfen: " + result.reason +
                    "; neuer Wortschatz " + result.unfamiliarAfter.correct + "/12.", false, fingerprint)
            val report = "Lernzyklus: " + result.completedSteps + " Updates; Verlust " +
                "%.5f → %.5f".format(Locale.ROOT, result.trainingLossBefore,result.trainingLossAfter) +
                "; Härtetest " + result.unfamiliarBefore.correct + "/12 → " +
                result.unfamiliarAfter.correct + "/12."
            val saved = !cancelled() && enabled &&
                memory.compareAndSaveNeuralSnapshot(original,model.save(),report)
            return record(if(saved) report else
                "Neue Gewichte nicht übernommen: Speicherstand wurde verändert oder Speichern fehlgeschlagen.",
                saved, fingerprint)
        } catch (error: Exception) {
            if (cancelled()) return "Übungsdurchgang abgebrochen."
            return record("Lernzyklus fehlgeschlagen: " + error.javaClass.simpleName,false,"")
        } finally { RUNNING.set(false) }
    }

    private fun canPractice(fingerprint: String): Boolean {
        if (prefs.getString("fingerprint", "") != fingerprint) {
            // New approved examples resume the already consented, periodic learning cycle.
            prefs.edit().putInt("stagnant", 0).putString("fingerprint", fingerprint).commit()
        }
        return prefs.getInt("stagnant", 0) < 3
    }

    private fun record(text: String, improved: Boolean, fingerprint: String): String {
        val old = prefs.getInt("stagnant", 0)
        val misses = if (improved) 0 else (old + 1).coerceAtMost(3)
        val message = if (misses >= 3)
            text + " Nächste Gewichtsübungen erst nach neuen bestätigten Beispielen."
        else text
        prefs.edit()
            .putInt("stagnant", misses)
            .putString("fingerprint", fingerprint)
            .putInt("attempts", (attempts + 1).coerceAtMost(1000000))
            .putInt("improvements", (improvements + if(improved) 1 else 0).coerceAtMost(1000000))
            .putString("status", message.take(500))
            .putLong("last_run", System.currentTimeMillis())
            .commit()
        return message
    }

    private fun schedule(): Boolean {
        val info = JobInfo.Builder(JOB_ID, ComponentName(app, NeuralPracticeJobService::class.java))
            .setRequiresCharging(true)
            .setRequiredNetworkType(JobInfo.NETWORK_TYPE_NONE)
            .setPeriodic(PERIOD_MS)
            .setPersisted(true).build()
        return jobs.schedule(info) == JobScheduler.RESULT_SUCCESS
    }

    companion object {
        private val RUNNING = AtomicBoolean(false)
        private const val PREFS = "device_ai_neural_practice_v1"
        const val JOB_ID = 620132
        const val PERIOD_MS = 15 * 60 * 1000L
    }
}

/** One short scheduled learning opportunity, limited by Android's background policy. */
class NeuralPracticeJobService : JobService() {
    private val cancelled = AtomicBoolean(false)
    private var worker: Thread? = null

    override fun onStartJob(params: JobParameters): Boolean {
        val scheduler = NeuralPracticeScheduler(this)
        if (!scheduler.enabled) return false
        cancelled.set(false)
        worker = Thread({
            try { scheduler.practiceOnce(cancelled::get) }
            finally { if (!cancelled.get()) jobFinished(params, false) }
        }, "device-ai-neural-practice").apply { isDaemon = true; start() }
        return true
    }

    override fun onStopJob(params: JobParameters): Boolean {
        cancelled.set(true)
        worker?.interrupt()
        return false
    }
}

package at.heinz.deviceai.learning

import java.util.Locale

/**
 * Research-only, small structural feature encoder. Character-level shape hints allow
 * the SAME neuron to recognize some previously unseen words, but do not understand
 * their meanings. Features contain no pre-trained parameters or model weights.
 *
 * Explicitly isolated: this experiment never changes NeuralDialogue's saved weights,
 * training examples, model version, device rights or the owner's memories.
 */
object NeuralTransferExperiment {
    private const val SIZE = 32

    data class Result(
        val trained: NeuralEvaluation,
        val known: NeuralEvaluation,
        val unseenBefore: NeuralEvaluation,
        val unseenAfter: NeuralEvaluation,
        val challengeBefore: NeuralEvaluation,
        val challengeAfter: NeuralEvaluation,
        val training: NeuralTraining
    )

    // Separate test: yes/no questions often do NOT start with 'w', while some
    // greetings DO. This prevents the misleading claim that an initial-letter
    // shortcut is general German language understanding.
    val CHALLENGE = listOf(
        "Ist diese Aussage wahr" to 1,
        "Könntest du bitte helfen" to 1,
        "Darf ich fragen" to 1,
        "Kann das funktionieren" to 1,
        "Hast du Hunger" to 1,
        "Willkommen zu Hause" to 0,
        "Wunderschönen Nachmittag" to 0,
        "Mahlzeit zusammen" to 0,
        "Schön dich zu sehen" to 0,
        "Grüß dich" to 0
    )

    /**
     * Hash first-character shape into 24 slots, word identities into only five
     * additional slots and simple punctuation/token-count patterns into three.
     * Unlike the original whole-word-only vector, unseen words can share
     * structural signals. This is intentionally a falsifiable experiment.
     */
    fun features(text: String): List<Double> {
        require(text.length in 1..320)
        val words = text.lowercase(Locale.GERMAN)
            .split(Regex("[^\\p{L}\\p{N}]+"))
            .filter { it.isNotEmpty() }.take(48)
        val values = DoubleArray(SIZE)
        val first = words.firstOrNull()
        if (first != null) {
            values[(first.first().code * 7 and Int.MAX_VALUE) % 24] = 1.0
            words.forEach { word ->
                values[24 + (word.hashCode() and Int.MAX_VALUE) % 5] = 1.0
            }
        }
        values[29] = if (text.trimEnd().endsWith("?")) 1.0 else 0.0
        values[30] = if (words.size == 1) 1.0 else 0.0
        values[31] = if (words.size >= 4) 1.0 else 0.0
        return values.toList()
    }

    fun run(
        cancelled: () -> Boolean = { false },
        progress: (NeuralLearningProgress) -> Unit = {}
    ): Result {
        val candidate = TinyNeuralNetwork(SIZE, seed = 42)
        fun examples(items: List<Pair<String, Int>>) = items.map { (phrase, label) ->
            NeuralExample(features(phrase), label)
        }
        val train = examples(NeuralDialogue.DEMO_TRAINING)
        val known = examples(NeuralDialogue.DEMO_HOLDOUT)
        val unseen = examples(NeuralDialogue.UNFAMILIAR_HOLDOUT)
        val challenge = examples(CHALLENGE)
        val unfamiliarBefore = candidate.evaluate(unseen)
        val challengeBefore = candidate.evaluate(challenge)
        val result = candidate.train(train, steps = 4000, maxMillis = 2800,
            cancelled = cancelled, onProgress = progress)
        return Result(
            candidate.evaluate(train), candidate.evaluate(known),
            unfamiliarBefore, candidate.evaluate(unseen),
            challengeBefore, candidate.evaluate(challenge), result
        )
    }
}

package at.heinz.deviceai.learning

import java.util.Locale
import kotlin.math.exp
import kotlin.math.ln

data class OnlinePrediction(val label: String, val score: Double)
data class OnlineEvaluation(val correct: Int, val total: Int, val abstained: Int)

/** Incremental multinomial NB with Laplace smoothing. Scores are NOT calibrated probabilities.
 * Bounded vocabulary, six labels, 256 approved examples. Suggestions cannot issue tool calls.
 */
class OnlineNaiveBayes {
    private val documents = linkedMapOf<String, Int>()
    private val counts = linkedMapOf<String, MutableMap<String, Int>>()
    private val vocabulary = linkedSetOf<String>()
    private fun tokens(text: String): List<String> {
        require(text.length <= 320)
        return text.lowercase(Locale.ROOT).split(Regex("[^\\p{L}\\p{N}]+"))
            .filter { it.length in 2..32 }.take(32)
    }
    @Synchronized fun learn(text: String, label: String, approved: Boolean) {
        require(approved && label.matches(Regex("[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,47}")))
        val words = tokens(text)
        require(words.isNotEmpty() && documents.values.sum() < 256)
        require(label in documents || documents.size < 6)
        require((vocabulary + words).size <= 256)
        vocabulary.addAll(words)
        documents[label] = (documents[label] ?: 0) + 1
        val target = counts.getOrPut(label) { linkedMapOf() }
        words.forEach { target[it] = (target[it] ?: 0) + 1 }
    }
    @Synchronized fun predict(text: String): OnlinePrediction? {
        val all = tokens(text)
        val words = all.filter { it in vocabulary }
        if (documents.size < 2 || words.isEmpty() || words.size * 2 < all.size) return null
        val totalDocs = documents.values.sum()
        val scores = documents.map { (label, n) ->
            val bag = counts.getValue(label)
            val total = bag.values.sum() + vocabulary.size
            label to (ln(n.toDouble() / totalDocs) + words.sumOf { ln(((bag[it] ?: 0) + 1.0) / total) })
        }.sortedWith(compareByDescending<Pair<String, Double>> { it.second }.thenBy { it.first })
        val best = scores.first()
        val score = 1.0 / scores.sumOf { exp(it.second - best.second) }
        return if (score + 1e-12 < 0.60) null else OnlinePrediction(best.first, score)
    }
    @Synchronized fun evaluate(test: List<Pair<String, String>>): OnlineEvaluation {
        require(test.size in 1..128)
        val predictions = test.map { predict(it.first) }
        return OnlineEvaluation(test.indices.count { predictions[it]?.label == test[it].second },
            test.size, predictions.count { it == null })
    }
    @Synchronized fun reset() { documents.clear(); counts.clear(); vocabulary.clear() }
    @Synchronized fun save(): ByteArray = LearningSnapshot.encode { out ->
        out.writeInt(0x444e4231)
        out.writeInt(documents.size)
        documents.toSortedMap().forEach { (label, docs) ->
            out.writeUTF(label); out.writeInt(docs)
            val bag = counts.getValue(label)
            out.writeInt(bag.size)
            bag.toSortedMap().forEach { (word, n) -> out.writeUTF(word); out.writeInt(n) }
        }
    }
    companion object {
        fun restore(bytes: ByteArray): OnlineNaiveBayes = LearningSnapshot.decode(bytes) { input ->
            require(input.readInt() == 0x444e4231)
            val model = OnlineNaiveBayes()
            val labels = input.readInt().also { require(it in 0..6) }
            repeat(labels) {
                val label = input.readUTF()
                require(label.matches(Regex("[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,47}")) && label !in model.documents)
                val docs = input.readInt().also { require(it in 1..256) }
                val size = input.readInt().also { require(it in 1..256) }
                val bag = linkedMapOf<String, Int>()
                repeat(size) {
                    val word = input.readUTF()
                    require(word.length in 2..32 && model.tokens(word) == listOf(word) && word !in bag)
                    val n = input.readInt().also { require(it in 1..8192) }
                    bag[word] = n
                }
                require(bag.values.sum() in docs..docs * 32)
                model.documents[label] = docs
                model.counts[label] = bag
                model.vocabulary.addAll(bag.keys)
            }
            require(model.documents.values.sum() <= 256 && model.vocabulary.size <= 256)
            model
        }
    }
}
