package at.heinz.deviceai.learning

/**
 * Strict, bounded RFC 8259 reader for package manifests.
 *
 * Pure JVM (no android org.json), so verification behaves identically in unit
 * tests and on the device. Unlike lenient parsers it rejects duplicate keys,
 * comments, single quotes, leading zeros, unescaped control characters, lone
 * surrogates and trailing content: two parsers can never disagree about which
 * value a signed or hashed manifest contains.
 *
 * Objects become [Map] (insertion ordered), arrays [List], integers [Long],
 * other numbers [Double], plus [String], [Boolean] and null.
 */
object StrictJson {
    const val MAX_INPUT_CHARS=262_144
    const val MAX_DEPTH=16
    const val MAX_CONTAINER_ITEMS=4096

    fun parse(text:String,maxChars:Int=MAX_INPUT_CHARS):Any? {
        require(text.length<=maxChars) { "JSON zu groß" }
        val reader=Reader(text)
        reader.skipWhitespace()
        val value=reader.value(0)
        reader.skipWhitespace()
        require(reader.atEnd()) { "Unerwartete Zeichen nach JSON-Wert" }
        return value
    }

    fun parseObject(text:String):Map<String,Any?> {
        val value=parse(text)
        require(value is Map<*,*>) { "JSON-Objekt erwartet" }
        @Suppress("UNCHECKED_CAST")
        return value as Map<String,Any?>
    }

    private class Reader(private val s:String) {
        private var i=0

        fun atEnd()=i==s.length

        fun skipWhitespace() {
            while(i<s.length && (s[i]==' ' || s[i]=='\n' || s[i]=='\r' || s[i]=='\t'))i++
        }

        fun value(depth:Int):Any? {
            require(depth<=MAX_DEPTH) { "JSON zu tief verschachtelt" }
            require(i<s.length) { "Unerwartetes Ende" }
            return when(s[i]) {
                '{' -> obj(depth+1)
                '[' -> array(depth+1)
                '"' -> string()
                't' -> literal("true",true)
                'f' -> literal("false",false)
                'n' -> literal("null",null)
                else -> number()
            }
        }

        private fun literal(word:String,result:Any?):Any? {
            require(s.startsWith(word,i)) { "Ungültiges JSON-Literal" }
            i+=word.length
            return result
        }

        private fun obj(depth:Int):Map<String,Any?> {
            i++
            val result=LinkedHashMap<String,Any?>()
            skipWhitespace()
            if(peek()=='}') { i++;return result }
            while(true) {
                skipWhitespace()
                require(peek()=='"') { "Objektschlüssel erwartet" }
                val key=string()
                require(key !in result) { "Doppelter JSON-Schlüssel: "+key.take(40) }
                skipWhitespace()
                require(peek()==':') { "':' erwartet" }
                i++
                skipWhitespace()
                result[key]=value(depth)
                require(result.size<=MAX_CONTAINER_ITEMS) { "JSON-Objekt zu groß" }
                skipWhitespace()
                when(peek()) {
                    ',' -> i++
                    '}' -> { i++;return result }
                    else -> throw IllegalArgumentException("',' oder '}' erwartet")
                }
            }
        }

        private fun array(depth:Int):List<Any?> {
            i++
            val result=ArrayList<Any?>()
            skipWhitespace()
            if(peek()==']') { i++;return result }
            while(true) {
                skipWhitespace()
                result+=value(depth)
                require(result.size<=MAX_CONTAINER_ITEMS) { "JSON-Liste zu groß" }
                skipWhitespace()
                when(peek()) {
                    ',' -> i++
                    ']' -> { i++;return result }
                    else -> throw IllegalArgumentException("',' oder ']' erwartet")
                }
            }
        }

        private fun string():String {
            i++
            val out=StringBuilder()
            while(true) {
                require(i<s.length) { "Unterminierte Zeichenkette" }
                val c=s[i++]
                when {
                    c=='"' -> break
                    c=='\\' -> {
                        require(i<s.length) { "Unterminierte Escape-Sequenz" }
                        when(val e=s[i++]) {
                            '"' -> out.append('"')
                            '\\' -> out.append('\\')
                            '/' -> out.append('/')
                            'b' -> out.append('\b')
                            'f' -> out.append('\u000c')
                            'n' -> out.append('\n')
                            'r' -> out.append('\r')
                            't' -> out.append('\t')
                            'u' -> out.append(unicodeEscape())
                            else -> throw IllegalArgumentException("Ungültige Escape-Sequenz \\"+e)
                        }
                    }
                    c<' ' -> throw IllegalArgumentException("Steuerzeichen in Zeichenkette")
                    else -> out.append(c)
                }
            }
            val result=out.toString()
            // Lone surrogates make UTF-8 hashing ambiguous across runtimes.
            var k=0
            while(k<result.length) {
                val ch=result[k]
                if(Character.isHighSurrogate(ch)) {
                    require(k+1<result.length && Character.isLowSurrogate(result[k+1])) { "Ungültiges Surrogat" }
                    k+=2
                } else {
                    require(!Character.isLowSurrogate(ch)) { "Ungültiges Surrogat" }
                    k++
                }
            }
            return result
        }

        private fun unicodeEscape():Char {
            require(i+4<=s.length) { "Unvollständige Unicode-Escape-Sequenz" }
            var code=0
            repeat(4) {
                // ASCII hex only: Character.digit would also accept non-ASCII digits
                val digit=when(val ch=s[i++]) {
                    in '0'..'9' -> ch-'0'
                    in 'a'..'f' -> ch-'a'+10
                    in 'A'..'F' -> ch-'A'+10
                    else -> -1
                }
                require(digit>=0) { "Ungültige Unicode-Escape-Sequenz" }
                code=code*16+digit
            }
            return code.toChar()
        }

        private fun number():Any {
            val start=i
            if(peek()=='-')i++
            require(i<s.length && s[i] in '0'..'9') { "Ungültiger JSON-Wert" }
            if(s[i]=='0') {
                i++
                require(i>=s.length || s[i] !in '0'..'9') { "Führende Null" }
            } else while(i<s.length && s[i] in '0'..'9')i++
            var integral=true
            if(i<s.length && s[i]=='.') {
                integral=false;i++
                require(i<s.length && s[i] in '0'..'9') { "Ziffer nach Dezimalpunkt erwartet" }
                while(i<s.length && s[i] in '0'..'9')i++
            }
            if(i<s.length && (s[i]=='e' || s[i]=='E')) {
                integral=false;i++
                if(i<s.length && (s[i]=='+' || s[i]=='-'))i++
                require(i<s.length && s[i] in '0'..'9') { "Exponent erwartet" }
                while(i<s.length && s[i] in '0'..'9')i++
            }
            val literal=s.substring(start,i)
            require(literal.length<=64) { "Zahl zu lang" }
            if(integral)literal.toLongOrNull()?.let { return it }
            val parsed=literal.toDouble()
            require(parsed.isFinite()) { "Zahl außerhalb des Wertebereichs" }
            return parsed
        }

        private fun peek():Char? = if(i<s.length)s[i] else null
    }
}

/** Typed, fail-closed accessors for manifest fields. */
internal fun Map<String,Any?>.requiredString(key:String,maxLength:Int=1024):String {
    val value=this[key]
    require(value is String && value.length<=maxLength) { "Feld $key fehlt oder ist ungültig" }
    return value
}

internal fun Map<String,Any?>.optionalString(key:String,maxLength:Int=1024):String? {
    if(!containsKey(key) || this[key]==null)return null
    return requiredString(key,maxLength)
}

internal fun Map<String,Any?>.requiredLong(key:String,range:LongRange):Long {
    val value=this[key]
    require(value is Long && value in range) { "Feld $key fehlt oder ist ungültig" }
    return value
}

internal fun Map<String,Any?>.optionalLong(key:String,range:LongRange):Long? {
    if(!containsKey(key) || this[key]==null)return null
    return requiredLong(key,range)
}

package at.heinz.deviceai.learning

import java.security.MessageDigest
import java.util.Locale

/** A small, explicit language; ordinary prose is never silently promoted to a rule. */
data class KnowledgeAtom(val subject: String, val relation: String, val value: String)
data class KnowledgeLiteral(val atom: KnowledgeAtom, val negative: Boolean = false)
data class KnowledgeStatement(val literal: KnowledgeLiteral, val universal: Boolean)
enum class KnowledgeStatus { SUPPORTED, REFUTED, CONFLICT, UNKNOWN, LIMIT }
data class KnowledgeEvidence(val id: String, val text: String)
data class KnowledgeAnswer(
    val status: KnowledgeStatus,
    val evidence: List<KnowledgeEvidence> = emptyList(),
    val steps: List<String> = emptyList(),
    val ruleChecks: Int = 0
) {
    fun describe(): String = buildString {
        append(when (status) {
            KnowledgeStatus.SUPPORTED -> if (steps.isEmpty()) "BESTÄTIGT gespeichert" else "ABGELEITET"
            KnowledgeStatus.REFUTED -> "GEGENAUSSAGE belegt"
            KnowledgeStatus.CONFLICT -> "WIDERSPRUCH – ungeklärt"
            KnowledgeStatus.UNKNOWN -> "UNBEKANNT – keine widerspruchsfreie Ableitung"
            KnowledgeStatus.LIMIT -> "UNGEKLÄRT – Rechengrenze erreicht"
        })
        append(". Gilt relativ zu deinen ausdrücklich gespeicherten Angaben; keine unabhängige Wahrheitsprüfung.")
        steps.forEach { append("\n→ ").append(it) }
        evidence.forEach { append("\nQuelle ").append(it.id.take(12)).append(": ").append(it.text) }
    }
}

object KnowledgeSyntax {
    private val field = Regex("[\\p{L}\\p{N}][\\p{L}\\p{N} _.-]{0,63}")
    fun literal(text: String): KnowledgeLiteral? {
        if (text.length > 220) return null
        val parts = text.split('|').map { it.trim().lowercase(Locale.ROOT) }
        if (parts.size != 3) return null
        val negative = parts[1].startsWith("nicht ")
        val relation = if (negative) parts[1].removePrefix("nicht ") else parts[1]
        if (!field.matches(parts[0]) || !field.matches(relation) || !field.matches(parts[2])) return null
        return KnowledgeLiteral(KnowledgeAtom(parts[0], relation, parts[2]), negative)
    }
    fun statement(text: String): KnowledgeStatement? {
        if (text.length > 320) return null
        val prefix = text.substringBefore(':').trim().lowercase(Locale.ROOT)
        if (prefix !in setOf("fakt", "regel") || ':' !in text) return null
        return literal(text.substringAfter(':'))?.let { KnowledgeStatement(it, prefix == "regel") }
    }
    fun isStructured(text: String): Boolean =
        text.trim().startsWith("Fakt:", true) || text.trim().startsWith("Regel:", true)
}

/** Rebuilds from the current confirmed memory snapshot: revocation cannot leave stale inferences.
 * Finite forward chaining, explicit negation, no closed-world assumption, no tool dependency.
 * A conflicting intermediate atom taints every downstream proof (conservative abstention).
 */
class StructuredKnowledge(private val maxChecks: Int = 4096) {
    init { require(maxChecks in 1..4096) }
    private data class Proof(val sources: Set<Int>, val dependencies: Set<KnowledgeAtom>, val steps: List<String>)

    fun query(confirmedFacts: List<String>, query: KnowledgeLiteral): KnowledgeAnswer {
        require(confirmedFacts.size <= 32 && confirmedFacts.all { it.length <= 320 })
        val source = confirmedFacts.toList()
        val parsed = source.mapIndexedNotNull { i, s -> KnowledgeSyntax.statement(s)?.let { i to it } }
        val known = linkedMapOf<KnowledgeLiteral, Proof>()
        parsed.filter { !it.second.universal }.forEach { (i, statement) ->
            known.putIfAbsent(statement.literal, Proof(setOf(i), setOf(statement.literal.atom), emptyList()))
        }
        val rules = parsed.filter { it.second.universal }
        var checks = 0
        var limited = false
        var changed = true
        while (changed && !limited) {
            changed = false
            val memberships = known.entries.filter { !it.key.negative && it.key.atom.relation == "ist" }
            for ((premise, proof) in memberships) {
                for ((id, rule) in rules) {
                    if (checks >= maxChecks || Thread.currentThread().isInterrupted) { limited = true; break }
                    checks++
                    if (premise.atom.value != rule.literal.atom.subject) continue
                    val next = rule.literal.copy(atom = rule.literal.atom.copy(subject = premise.atom.subject))
                    if (next in known) continue
                    if (known.size >= 256 || proof.steps.size >= 16) { limited = true; break }
                    known[next] = Proof(proof.sources + id, proof.dependencies + next.atom,
                        proof.steps + "${next.atom.subject} | ${if (next.negative) "nicht " else ""}${next.atom.relation} | ${next.atom.value}")
                    changed = true
                }
                if (limited) break
            }
        }
        if (limited) return KnowledgeAnswer(KnowledgeStatus.LIMIT, ruleChecks = checks)
        val conflicts = known.keys.filter { it.copy(negative = !it.negative) in known }.map { it.atom }.toSet()
        val positive = known[query]
        val negative = known[query.copy(negative = !query.negative)]
        val selected = listOfNotNull(positive, negative)
        val tainted = selected.any { proof -> proof.dependencies.any { it in conflicts } }
        val status = when {
            query.atom in conflicts -> KnowledgeStatus.CONFLICT
            tainted -> KnowledgeStatus.UNKNOWN
            positive != null -> KnowledgeStatus.SUPPORTED
            negative != null -> KnowledgeStatus.REFUTED
            else -> KnowledgeStatus.UNKNOWN
        }
        // Include both sides of every conflict in a returned proof, not just the preferred side.
        val conflictProofs = selected.flatMap { it.dependencies }.filter { it in conflicts }
            .flatMap { atom -> listOfNotNull(known[KnowledgeLiteral(atom)], known[KnowledgeLiteral(atom, true)]) }
        val ids = (selected + conflictProofs).flatMap { it.sources }.distinct().sorted()
        val evidence = ids.map { i -> KnowledgeEvidence(
            MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256").digest(source[i].toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8))
                .joinToString("") { "%02x".format(it) }, source[i]) }
        return KnowledgeAnswer(status, evidence, selected.flatMap { it.steps }.distinct(), checks)
    }
}

/** Atomic, exact-value replacement shared by persistence and regression tests. */
object KnowledgeRevision {
    fun replace(facts: List<String>, previous: String, replacement: String?): List<String>? {
        if (facts.size > 32 || previous !in facts || replacement == previous) return null
        if (replacement != null && (replacement.length !in 3..320 ||
                KnowledgeSyntax.statement(replacement) == null)) return null
        return (facts.filterNot { it == previous } + listOfNotNull(replacement)).distinct().sorted()
    }
}

package at.heinz.deviceai.learning

import java.util.Random
import kotlin.math.exp
import kotlin.math.ln
import kotlin.math.tanh

enum class DecoderSplit { TRAIN, AUDIT }
/** Caller supplies authored/public experimental text. No Android memory is read. */
data class DecoderCorpus(val texts:List<String>,val split:DecoderSplit) {
    init {
        require(texts.size in 1..64)
        require(texts.all { it.isNotBlank() && it.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8).size<=512 })
        require(texts.sumOf { it.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8).size }<=8192)
    }
}
data class DecoderTrainingReport(val steps:Int,val interrupted:Boolean,val lossBefore:Double,val lossAfter:Double)
data class DecoderGeneration(val text:String,val bytesGenerated:Int,val ended:Boolean)

/** Experimental causal byte-language model: learned positional embeddings,
 * tanh context MLP, 258-way softmax, exact SGD backpropagation. No model files,
 * APIs or pretrained weights. Optional 16-vector conditioning consumes the
 * existing shared subword representation. This class has no productive chat hook.
 */
class TinyContextDecoder private constructor(
    private val seed:Long,private var embedding:DoubleArray,
    private var hiddenWeights:DoubleArray,private var hiddenBias:DoubleArray,
    private var outputWeights:DoubleArray,private var outputBias:DoubleArray,
    var updates:Int
) {
    constructor(seed:Long=91):this(seed,initial(seed,VOCAB*EMBED,.08),
        initial(seed xor 19,INPUT*HIDDEN,.08),DoubleArray(HIDDEN),
        initial(seed xor 37,HIDDEN*VOCAB,.08),DoubleArray(VOCAB),0)

    val parameterCount:Int get()=embedding.size+hiddenWeights.size+hiddenBias.size+outputWeights.size+outputBias.size
    private data class Forward(val x:DoubleArray,val h:DoubleArray,val p:DoubleArray)
    private data class Sample(val context:IntArray,val target:Int)

    private fun condition(values:DoubleArray):DoubleArray {
        require(values.size==CONDITION && values.all { it.isFinite() && it in -1.0..1.0 })
        return values.copyOf()
    }
    private fun context(bytes:ByteArray):IntArray = IntArray(CONTEXT) { i ->
        val index=bytes.size-CONTEXT+i
        if(index<0)BOS else bytes[index].toInt() and 255
    }
    private fun forward(tokens:IntArray,c:DoubleArray):Forward {
        val x=DoubleArray(INPUT)
        for(position in 0 until CONTEXT)for(i in 0 until EMBED)x[position*EMBED+i]=embedding[tokens[position]*EMBED+i]
        c.copyInto(x,CONTEXT*EMBED)
        val h=DoubleArray(HIDDEN) { j ->
            var sum=hiddenBias[j]
            for(i in x.indices)sum+=hiddenWeights[j*INPUT+i]*x[i]
            tanh(sum)
        }
        val logits=DoubleArray(VOCAB) { t ->
            var sum=outputBias[t]
            for(j in 0 until HIDDEN)sum+=outputWeights[j*VOCAB+t]*h[j]
            sum
        }
        // BOS pads context only; it is never a generation target.
        logits[BOS]=Double.NEGATIVE_INFINITY
        val maximum=logits.maxOrNull()!!
        val p=DoubleArray(VOCAB) { exp(logits[it]-maximum) }
        val total=p.sum();for(i in p.indices)p[i]/=total
        return Forward(x,h,p)
    }
    private fun samples(corpus:DecoderCorpus):List<Sample> = corpus.texts.flatMap { text ->
        val bytes=text.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8)
        (0..bytes.size).map { n ->
            val tokens=IntArray(CONTEXT) { position ->
                val i=n-CONTEXT+position
                if(i<0)BOS else bytes[i].toInt() and 255
            }
            Sample(tokens,if(n==bytes.size)EOS else bytes[n].toInt() and 255)
        }
    }
    private fun loss(samples:List<Sample>,c:DoubleArray):Double =
        samples.sumOf { -ln(forward(it.context,c).p[it.target].coerceAtLeast(1e-12)) }/samples.size

    @Synchronized fun nextTokenProbabilities(prompt:String,conditioning:DoubleArray=DoubleArray(CONDITION)):DoubleArray {
        require(prompt.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8).size<=512)
        return forward(context(prompt.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8)),condition(conditioning)).p
    }
    @Synchronized fun evaluate(corpus:DecoderCorpus,conditioning:DoubleArray=DoubleArray(CONDITION)):Double =
        loss(samples(corpus),condition(conditioning))

    @Synchronized fun train(
        corpus:DecoderCorpus,steps:Int=1000,learningRate:Double=.035,
        conditioning:DoubleArray=DoubleArray(CONDITION),maxMillis:Long=3000,
        cancelled:()->Boolean={false},nowNanos:()->Long=System::nanoTime
    ):DecoderTrainingReport {
        require(corpus.split==DecoderSplit.TRAIN) { "Audit corpus cannot be used for gradients" }
        require(steps in 1..20000 && learningRate in .0001.. .08 && maxMillis in 1..5000)
        require(updates<=MAX_UPDATES-steps) { "Decoder update budget exhausted" }
        val examples=samples(corpus);val c=condition(conditioning)
        val before=loss(examples,c);val start=nowNanos();var completed=0
        while(completed<steps && !cancelled() && !Thread.currentThread().isInterrupted && nowNanos()-start<maxMillis*1_000_000L) {
            val sample=examples[updates%examples.size]
            update(sample,c,learningRate)
            updates++;completed++
        }
        return DecoderTrainingReport(completed,completed<steps,before,loss(examples,c))
    }
    private fun update(sample:Sample,c:DoubleArray,rate:Double) {
        val f=forward(sample.context,c)
        val error=f.p.copyOf();error[sample.target]-=1
        // Backpropagate with pre-update weights, including repeated byte buckets.
        val dh=DoubleArray(HIDDEN) { j ->
            var sum=0.0;for(t in 0 until VOCAB)sum+=error[t]*outputWeights[j*VOCAB+t]
            sum*(1-f.h[j]*f.h[j])
        }
        val dx=DoubleArray(CONTEXT*EMBED) { i ->
            var sum=0.0;for(j in 0 until HIDDEN)sum+=dh[j]*hiddenWeights[j*INPUT+i];sum
        }
        for(t in 0 until VOCAB) {
            outputBias[t]=clip(outputBias[t]-rate*error[t])
            for(j in 0 until HIDDEN)outputWeights[j*VOCAB+t]=clip(outputWeights[j*VOCAB+t]-rate*error[t]*f.h[j])
        }
        for(j in 0 until HIDDEN) {
            hiddenBias[j]=clip(hiddenBias[j]-rate*dh[j])
            for(i in 0 until INPUT)hiddenWeights[j*INPUT+i]=clip(hiddenWeights[j*INPUT+i]-rate*dh[j]*f.x[i])
        }
        for(position in 0 until CONTEXT)for(i in 0 until EMBED) {
            val index=sample.context[position]*EMBED+i
            embedding[index]=clip(embedding[index]-rate*dx[position*EMBED+i])
        }
    }

    /** Greedy, reproducible, bounded continuation. Raw bytes are decoded as UTF-8;
     * malformed sequences may appear as replacement characters in an immature model.
     */
    @Synchronized fun generate(prompt:String,maxBytes:Int=64,conditioning:DoubleArray=DoubleArray(CONDITION)):DecoderGeneration {
        val prefix=prompt.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8)
        require(prefix.size<=512 && maxBytes in 1..128)
        val c=condition(conditioning);var tokens=context(prefix)
        val output=java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream();var ended=false
        repeat(maxBytes) {
            if(!ended) {
                val p=forward(tokens,c).p
                var token=0;for(i in 1 until VOCAB)if(p[i]>p[token])token=i
                if(token==EOS)ended=true else {
                    output.write(token)
                    tokens=IntArray(CONTEXT) { i -> if(i==CONTEXT-1)token else tokens[i+1] }
                }
            }
        }
        return DecoderGeneration(output.toByteArray().toString(Charsets.UTF_8),output.size(),ended)
    }

    @Synchronized fun save():ByteArray=LearningSnapshot.encode { out ->
        out.writeInt(MAGIC);out.writeLong(seed);out.writeInt(updates)
        listOf(embedding,hiddenWeights,hiddenBias,outputWeights,outputBias).forEach { array ->
            out.writeInt(array.size);array.forEach(out::writeDouble)
        }
    }
    /** Atomic experimental persistence; retain the previous valid checkpoint. */
    @Synchronized fun saveTo(file:java.io.File) {
        val next=save();restore(next)
        val directory=file.absoluteFile.parentFile
        check(directory.exists()||directory.mkdirs())
        fun write(target:java.io.File,bytes:ByteArray) {
            val temp=java.io.File.createTempFile("decoder-",".tmp",directory)
            try {
                java.io.FileOutputStream(temp).use { it.write(bytes);it.fd.sync() }
                try {
                    java.nio.file.Files.move(temp.toPath(),target.toPath(),java.nio.file.StandardCopyOption.ATOMIC_MOVE,java.nio.file.StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING)
                } catch(_:java.nio.file.AtomicMoveNotSupportedException) {
                    java.nio.file.Files.move(temp.toPath(),target.toPath(),java.nio.file.StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING)
                }
            } finally { temp.delete() }
        }
        if(file.exists()) {
            require(file.length() in 36..65536)
            val old=file.readBytes();restore(old)
            write(java.io.File(file.absolutePath+".lkg"),old)
        }
        write(file,next)
    }

    companion object {
        const val CONTEXT=8
        const val CONDITION=16
        private const val EMBED=8
        private const val HIDDEN=16
        private const val INPUT=CONTEXT*EMBED+CONDITION
        private const val VOCAB=258
        private const val BOS=256
        private const val EOS=257
        private const val MAGIC=0x43445831
        private const val MAX_UPDATES=10000000
        private fun initial(seed:Long,size:Int,scale:Double):DoubleArray {
            val r=Random(seed);return DoubleArray(size) { (r.nextDouble()*2-1)*scale }
        }
        private fun clip(x:Double)=x.coerceIn(-8.0,8.0)
        fun restoreFrom(file:java.io.File):TinyContextDecoder {
            require(file.length() in 36..65536)
            return restore(file.readBytes())
        }
        fun restore(bytes:ByteArray):TinyContextDecoder=LearningSnapshot.decode(bytes) { input ->
            require(input.readInt()==MAGIC)
            val seed=input.readLong();val updates=input.readInt().also { require(it in 0..MAX_UPDATES) }
            val arrays=listOf(VOCAB*EMBED,INPUT*HIDDEN,HIDDEN,HIDDEN*VOCAB,VOCAB).map { expected ->
                require(input.readInt()==expected)
                DoubleArray(expected) { input.readDouble().also { x -> require(x.isFinite() && x in -8.0..8.0) } }
            }
            TinyContextDecoder(seed,arrays[0],arrays[1],arrays[2],arrays[3],arrays[4],updates)
        }
    }
}

package at.heinz.deviceai.learning

import java.util.Random
import kotlin.math.abs
import kotlin.math.exp
import kotlin.math.ln1p
import kotlin.math.max
import kotlin.math.sqrt
import kotlin.math.tanh

data class NeuralExample(val inputs: List<Double>, val label: Int)
data class NeuralEvaluation(val loss: Double, val correct: Int, val total: Int)
data class NeuralTraining(val steps: Int, val elapsedNanos: Long, val stoppedEarly: Boolean)

/** Transient training telemetry. No weights or private examples leave this device. */
data class NeuralLearningProgress(
    val step: Int,
    val total: Int,
    val loss: Double,
    val correct: Int,
    val examples: Int
)

/** Original tiny dense MLP: bounded inputs -> 8 tanh units -> one binary logit.
 * Analytic backpropagation + SGD; no pretrained weights, autograd graph, network, or tools.
 * Caller owns data approval and scheduling. Never run training on Android's UI thread.
 */
class TinyNeuralNetwork(val inputSize: Int, private val seed: Long = 42) {
    init { require(inputSize in 1..32) }
    private var weights = initialWeights()
    var updates: Int = 0
        private set
    private fun initialWeights(): DoubleArray {
        val random = Random(seed)
        return DoubleArray(8 * (inputSize + 1) + 9) { i ->
            if (i < 8 * (inputSize + 1) && i % (inputSize + 1) == inputSize || i == 8 * (inputSize + 1) + 8) 0.0
            else (random.nextDouble() * 2 - 1) / sqrt(inputSize.toDouble())
        }
    }
    private fun validated(input: List<Double>): DoubleArray {
        require(input.size == inputSize)
        return input.toDoubleArray().also { require(it.all { x -> x.isFinite() && abs(x) <= 1.0 }) }
    }
    private fun forward(x: DoubleArray): Pair<DoubleArray, Double> {
        val hidden = DoubleArray(8) { h ->
            val offset = h * (inputSize + 1)
            var z = weights[offset + inputSize]
            for (i in x.indices) z += x[i] * weights[offset + i]
            tanh(z)
        }
        val offset = 8 * (inputSize + 1)
        var logit = weights[offset + 8]
        for (h in hidden.indices) logit += hidden[h] * weights[offset + h]
        return hidden to logit
    }
    private fun sigmoid(z: Double): Double = if (z >= 0) 1 / (1 + exp(-z)) else exp(z) / (1 + exp(z))
    @Synchronized fun predict(input: List<Double>): Double = sigmoid(forward(validated(input)).second)
    @Synchronized fun evaluate(examples: List<NeuralExample>): NeuralEvaluation {
        require(examples.size in 1..128)
        var loss = 0.0
        var correct = 0
        examples.forEach { example ->
            require(example.label in 0..1)
            val z = forward(validated(example.inputs)).second
            loss += max(z, 0.0) - z * example.label + ln1p(exp(-abs(z)))
            if ((if (z >= 0) 1 else 0) == example.label) correct++
        }
        return NeuralEvaluation(loss / examples.size, correct, examples.size)
    }
    @Synchronized fun train(
        examples: List<NeuralExample>, steps: Int, learningRate: Double = 0.1,
        maxMillis: Long = 2000, cancelled: () -> Boolean = { false },
        nowNanos: () -> Long = System::nanoTime,
        onProgress: (NeuralLearningProgress) -> Unit = {}
    ): NeuralTraining {
        require(examples.size in 1..128 && steps in 1..5000)
        require(learningRate.isFinite() && learningRate in 0.0001..0.2 && maxMillis in 1..5000)
        require(updates <= 100000 - steps) { "Reset experiment before further training" }
        // Snapshot and validate the entire batch before the first weight mutation.
        val batch = examples.map { require(it.label in 0..1); validated(it.inputs) to it.label }
        val start = nowNanos()
        var completed = 0
        while (completed < steps) {
            if (cancelled() || Thread.currentThread().isInterrupted || nowNanos() - start >= maxMillis * 1000000) break
            val (x, label) = batch[updates % batch.size]
            val (hidden, z) = forward(x)
            val error = sigmoid(z) - label
            val outputOffset = 8 * (inputSize + 1)
            // Compute hidden gradients using the OLD output weights.
            val delta = DoubleArray(8) { h -> error * weights[outputOffset + h] * (1 - hidden[h] * hidden[h]) }
            val next = weights.copyOf()
            for (h in 0 until 8) {
                val offset = h * (inputSize + 1)
                for (i in x.indices) next[offset + i] -= learningRate * delta[h] * x[i]
                next[offset + inputSize] -= learningRate * delta[h]
                next[outputOffset + h] -= learningRate * error * hidden[h]
            }
            next[outputOffset + 8] -= learningRate * error
            check(next.all { it.isFinite() }) { "Non-finite weight update rejected" }
            weights = DoubleArray(next.size) { next[it].coerceIn(-16.0, 16.0) }
            updates++
            completed++
            if (completed == 1 || completed % 100 == 0 || completed == steps) {
                val check = evaluate(examples)
                onProgress(NeuralLearningProgress(completed, steps, check.loss, check.correct, check.total))
            }
        }
        return NeuralTraining(completed, (nowNanos() - start).coerceAtLeast(0), completed < steps)
    }
    @Synchronized fun reset() { weights = initialWeights(); updates = 0 }
    @Synchronized fun save(): ByteArray = LearningSnapshot.encode { out ->
        out.writeInt(0x444e4e31)
        out.writeInt(inputSize)
        out.writeLong(seed)
        out.writeInt(updates)
        out.writeInt(weights.size)
        weights.forEach(out::writeDouble)
    }
    companion object {
        fun restore(bytes: ByteArray): TinyNeuralNetwork = LearningSnapshot.decode(bytes) { input ->
            require(input.readInt() == 0x444e4e31)
            val model = TinyNeuralNetwork(input.readInt(), input.readLong())
            val updates = input.readInt()
            require(updates in 0..100000 && input.readInt() == model.weights.size)
            val weights = DoubleArray(model.weights.size) { input.readDouble() }
            require(weights.all { it.isFinite() && abs(it) <= 16.0 })
            model.weights = weights
            model.updates = updates
            model
        }
    }
}

package at.heinz.deviceai.learning

import java.util.Locale
import java.util.Random
import kotlin.math.abs
import kotlin.math.exp
import kotlin.math.ln
import kotlin.math.max
import kotlin.math.min
import kotlin.math.tanh

data class SubwordIntentExample(val text:String,val label:Int)
data class SubwordSemanticExample(val left:String,val right:String,val similar:Boolean)
data class SubwordEvaluation(val loss:Double,val correct:Int,val total:Int)
data class SubwordTrainingResult(
    val steps:Int,
    val stoppedEarly:Boolean,
    val before:SubwordEvaluation,
    val after:SubwordEvaluation
)

/**
 * Original local trainable text encoder.
 *
 * Character 2-4 grams are hashed into a bounded table of trainable embeddings.
 * The same embedding table serves both intent classification and text-pair
 * similarity. No vocabulary, model file or pretrained weight is imported.
 */
class TrainableSubwordEncoder private constructor(
    private val seed:Long,
    private var embeddings:DoubleArray,
    private var intentHead:DoubleArray,
    var updates:Int
) {
    constructor(seed:Long=73L):this(
        seed,
        initialEmbeddings(seed),
        initialIntentHead(seed),
        0
    )

    val parameterCount:Int get()=embeddings.size+intentHead.size

    /** Immutable shared representation for experimental decoder conditioning. */
    @Synchronized fun representation(text:String):DoubleArray = encode(text)

    @Synchronized fun intentScore(text:String):Double {
        val z=encode(text)
        var logit=intentHead[DIMENSIONS]
        for(i in 0 until DIMENSIONS)logit+=z[i]*intentHead[i]
        return sigmoid(logit)
    }

    @Synchronized fun similarity(left:String,right:String):Double {
        val a=encode(left);val b=encode(right)
        var dot=0.0
        for(i in 0 until DIMENSIONS)dot+=a[i]*b[i]
        return sigmoid(dot*SIMILARITY_SCALE)
    }

    @Synchronized fun evaluateIntent(examples:List<SubwordIntentExample>):SubwordEvaluation {
        require(examples.size in 1..128)
        var loss=0.0;var correct=0
        examples.forEach { ex ->
            require(ex.label in 0..1)
            val p=intentScore(ex.text).coerceIn(1e-9,1.0-1e-9)
            loss+=-(ex.label*ln(p)+(1-ex.label)*ln(1-p))
            if((if(p>=0.5)1 else 0)==ex.label)correct++
        }
        return SubwordEvaluation(loss/examples.size,correct,examples.size)
    }

    @Synchronized fun evaluateSemantic(examples:List<SubwordSemanticExample>):SubwordEvaluation {
        require(examples.size in 1..128)
        var loss=0.0;var correct=0
        examples.forEach { ex ->
            val target=if(ex.similar)1 else 0
            val p=similarity(ex.left,ex.right).coerceIn(1e-9,1.0-1e-9)
            loss+=-(target*ln(p)+(1-target)*ln(1-p))
            if((p>=0.5)==ex.similar)correct++
        }
        return SubwordEvaluation(loss/examples.size,correct,examples.size)
    }

    @Synchronized fun trainIntent(
        examples:List<SubwordIntentExample>,
        steps:Int=400,
        learningRate:Double=0.055,
        maxMillis:Long=1800,
        cancelled:()->Boolean={false},
        nowNanos:()->Long=System::nanoTime
    ):SubwordTrainingResult {
        require(examples.size in 1..128 && steps in 1..2000)
        require(learningRate in 0.0001..0.15 && maxMillis in 1..4000)
        examples.forEach { require(it.label in 0..1);subwordBuckets(it.text) }
        val before=evaluateIntent(examples)
        val start=nowNanos();var completed=0
        while(completed<steps && !cancelled() && !Thread.currentThread().isInterrupted &&
            nowNanos()-start<maxMillis*1_000_000L) {
            val ex=examples[(updates+completed)%examples.size]
            updateIntent(ex,learningRate)
            completed++
        }
        updates=(updates+completed).coerceAtMost(1_000_000)
        return SubwordTrainingResult(completed,completed<steps,before,evaluateIntent(examples))
    }

    @Synchronized fun trainSemantic(
        examples:List<SubwordSemanticExample>,
        steps:Int=400,
        learningRate:Double=0.035,
        maxMillis:Long=1800,
        cancelled:()->Boolean={false},
        nowNanos:()->Long=System::nanoTime
    ):SubwordTrainingResult {
        require(examples.size in 1..128 && steps in 1..2000)
        require(learningRate in 0.0001..0.12 && maxMillis in 1..4000)
        examples.forEach { subwordBuckets(it.left);subwordBuckets(it.right) }
        val before=evaluateSemantic(examples)
        val start=nowNanos();var completed=0
        while(completed<steps && !cancelled() && !Thread.currentThread().isInterrupted &&
            nowNanos()-start<maxMillis*1_000_000L) {
            val ex=examples[(updates+completed)%examples.size]
            updateSemantic(ex,learningRate)
            completed++
        }
        updates=(updates+completed).coerceAtMost(1_000_000)
        return SubwordTrainingResult(completed,completed<steps,before,evaluateSemantic(examples))
    }

    private fun updateIntent(ex:SubwordIntentExample,rate:Double) {
        val buckets=subwordBuckets(ex.text)
        val z=encodeBuckets(buckets)
        var logit=intentHead[DIMENSIONS]
        for(i in 0 until DIMENSIONS)logit+=z[i]*intentHead[i]
        val error=sigmoid(logit)-ex.label
        val oldHead=intentHead.copyOf()
        for(i in 0 until DIMENSIONS)intentHead[i]=clip(intentHead[i]-rate*error*z[i])
        intentHead[DIMENSIONS]=clip(intentHead[DIMENSIONS]-rate*error)
        val scale=1.0/buckets.size
        buckets.forEach { bucket ->
            val offset=bucket*DIMENSIONS
            for(i in 0 until DIMENSIONS) {
                val grad=error*oldHead[i]*(1-z[i]*z[i])*scale
                embeddings[offset+i]=clip(embeddings[offset+i]-rate*grad)
            }
        }
    }

    private fun updateSemantic(ex:SubwordSemanticExample,rate:Double) {
        val aBuckets=subwordBuckets(ex.left);val bBuckets=subwordBuckets(ex.right)
        val a=encodeBuckets(aBuckets);val b=encodeBuckets(bBuckets)
        var dot=0.0
        for(i in 0 until DIMENSIONS)dot+=a[i]*b[i]
        val target=if(ex.similar)1.0 else 0.0
        val error=sigmoid(dot*SIMILARITY_SCALE)-target
        val aGrad=DoubleArray(DIMENSIONS) { i ->
            error*SIMILARITY_SCALE*b[i]*(1-a[i]*a[i])
        }
        val bGrad=DoubleArray(DIMENSIONS) { i ->
            error*SIMILARITY_SCALE*a[i]*(1-b[i]*b[i])
        }
        val aScale=1.0/aBuckets.size;val bScale=1.0/bBuckets.size
        aBuckets.forEach { bucket ->
            val offset=bucket*DIMENSIONS
            for(i in 0 until DIMENSIONS)
                embeddings[offset+i]=clip(embeddings[offset+i]-rate*aGrad[i]*aScale)
        }
        bBuckets.forEach { bucket ->
            val offset=bucket*DIMENSIONS
            for(i in 0 until DIMENSIONS)
                embeddings[offset+i]=clip(embeddings[offset+i]-rate*bGrad[i]*bScale)
        }
    }

    private fun encode(text:String):DoubleArray=encodeBuckets(subwordBuckets(text))

    private fun encodeBuckets(buckets:IntArray):DoubleArray {
        val z=DoubleArray(DIMENSIONS)
        buckets.forEach { bucket ->
            val offset=bucket*DIMENSIONS
            for(i in 0 until DIMENSIONS)z[i]+=embeddings[offset+i]
        }
        val scale=1.0/buckets.size
        for(i in z.indices)z[i]=tanh(z[i]*scale)
        return z
    }

    @Synchronized fun save():ByteArray=LearningSnapshot.encode { out ->
        out.writeInt(MAGIC);out.writeLong(seed);out.writeInt(updates)
        out.writeInt(embeddings.size);embeddings.forEach(out::writeDouble)
        out.writeInt(intentHead.size);intentHead.forEach(out::writeDouble)
    }

    companion object {
        const val BUCKETS=256
        const val DIMENSIONS=16
        private const val MAGIC=0x53574231
        private const val SIMILARITY_SCALE=2.5

        private fun initialEmbeddings(seed:Long):DoubleArray {
            val random=Random(seed)
            return DoubleArray(BUCKETS*DIMENSIONS) { (random.nextDouble()*2.0-1.0)*0.08 }
        }
        private fun initialIntentHead(seed:Long):DoubleArray {
            val random=Random(seed xor 0x51a7L)
            return DoubleArray(DIMENSIONS+1) { if(it==DIMENSIONS)0.0 else (random.nextDouble()*2.0-1.0)*0.08 }
        }
        private fun clip(value:Double)=value.coerceIn(-8.0,8.0)
        private fun sigmoid(value:Double):Double =
            if(value>=0)1.0/(1.0+exp(-value)) else exp(value)/(1.0+exp(value))

        internal fun subwordBuckets(text:String):IntArray {
            require(text.length in 1..2048)
            val normalized=text.lowercase(Locale.ROOT)
                .replace(Regex("[^\\p{L}\\p{N}]+")," ").trim().take(512)
            require(normalized.isNotEmpty())
            val padded="^$normalized$"
            val values=linkedSetOf<Int>()
            for(n in 2..4) {
                if(padded.length<n)continue
                for(i in 0..padded.length-n) {
                    values+=stableBucket(padded.substring(i,i+n))
                    if(values.size>=128)break
                }
                if(values.size>=128)break
            }
            if(values.isEmpty())values+=stableBucket(padded)
            return values.toIntArray()
        }

        private fun stableBucket(value:String):Int {
            var hash=0x811c9dc5L
            value.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8).forEach { byte ->
                hash=hash xor (byte.toLong() and 0xffL)
                hash=(hash*0x01000193L) and 0xffffffffL
            }
            return (hash%BUCKETS).toInt()
        }

        fun restore(bytes:ByteArray):TrainableSubwordEncoder=LearningSnapshot.decode(bytes) { input ->
            require(input.readInt()==MAGIC)
            val seed=input.readLong()
            val updates=input.readInt().also { require(it in 0..1_000_000) }
            val eSize=input.readInt().also { require(it==BUCKETS*DIMENSIONS) }
            val embeddings=DoubleArray(eSize) { input.readDouble() }
            val hSize=input.readInt().also { require(it==DIMENSIONS+1) }
            val head=DoubleArray(hSize) { input.readDouble() }
            require((embeddings.asList()+head.asList()).all { it.isFinite() && abs(it)<=8.0 })
            TrainableSubwordEncoder(seed,embeddings,head,updates)
        }
    }
}

package at.heinz.deviceai.localmodel

import at.heinz.deviceai.ToolProposal
import at.heinz.deviceai.ToolRegistry
import at.heinz.deviceai.ToolSpec
import com.google.ai.edge.litertlm.Backend
import com.google.ai.edge.litertlm.Content
import com.google.ai.edge.litertlm.Contents
import com.google.ai.edge.litertlm.Conversation
import com.google.ai.edge.litertlm.ConversationConfig
import com.google.ai.edge.litertlm.Engine
import com.google.ai.edge.litertlm.EngineConfig
import com.google.ai.edge.litertlm.Message
import com.google.ai.edge.litertlm.MessageCallback
import com.google.ai.edge.litertlm.OpenApiTool
import com.google.ai.edge.litertlm.tool
import org.json.JSONArray
import org.json.JSONObject
import java.io.File
import java.util.concurrent.CancellationException
import java.util.concurrent.Executors
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicBoolean

enum class LocalModelState { EMPTY, LOADING, READY, GENERATING, UNLOADING, FAILED }

data class LocalInferenceMetrics(
    val promptCharacters: Int,
    val responseCharacters: Int,
    val streamedChunks: Int,
    val inputTokens: Int?,
    val outputTokens: Int?,
    val firstTokenLatencyMillis: Long?,
    val totalLatencyMillis: Long
)

sealed interface LocalInferenceEvent {
    data class TextDelta(val text: String) : LocalInferenceEvent
    data class ToolProposal(val proposal: at.heinz.deviceai.ToolProposal) : LocalInferenceEvent
    data class ToolProposalRejected(
        val name: String,
        val reason: String,
        val arguments: Map<String, Any?> = emptyMap()
    ) : LocalInferenceEvent
    data class ToolBatchRejected(val responses: List<LocalToolResponse>) : LocalInferenceEvent
    data class Completed(val metrics: LocalInferenceMetrics) : LocalInferenceEvent
    data object Cancelled : LocalInferenceEvent
    data class Failed(val message: String) : LocalInferenceEvent
}

fun interface LocalInferenceCallback {
    fun onEvent(event: LocalInferenceEvent)
}

data class LocalToolResponse(val toolName: String, val response: String) {
    init {
        require(toolName.isNotBlank() && toolName.length <= 128)
        require(response.length <= 8_000)
    }
}

interface LocalModelRuntime {
    val state: LocalModelState
    val loadedModel: ImportedLocalModel?
    fun load(id: String, version: String, callback: (Result<ImportedLocalModel>) -> Unit)
    fun unload(callback: (Result<Unit>) -> Unit = {})
    fun stream(prompt: String, callback: LocalInferenceCallback)
    fun streamThinking(prompt: String, callback: LocalInferenceCallback) {
        error("This runtime does not provide isolated tool-free thinking.")
    }
    fun respondToTools(responses: List<LocalToolResponse>, callback: LocalInferenceCallback) {
        val continuation = responses.joinToString("\n") { "${it.toolName}: ${it.response}" }
        stream(continuation, callback)
    }
    fun cancel()
}

class LiteRtLmLocalModelRuntime(
    private val catalog: LocalModelCatalog,
    private val cacheDirectory: File,
    private val systemPrompt: String = "You are Device AI, an on-device assistant."
) : LocalModelRuntime {
    private val background = Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor { runnable ->
        Thread(runnable, "device-ai-local-model").apply { isDaemon = true }
    }
    private val lock = Any()

    @Volatile
    override var state: LocalModelState = LocalModelState.EMPTY
        private set

    @Volatile
    override var loadedModel: ImportedLocalModel? = null
        private set

    private var engine: Engine? = null
    private var conversation: Conversation? = null
    private var inferenceConversation: Conversation? = null
    private var inferenceActive = false
    private var pendingUnload: ((Result<Unit>) -> Unit)? = null

    init { require(systemPrompt.isNotBlank() && systemPrompt.length <= 4_096) }

    override fun load(id: String, version: String, callback: (Result<ImportedLocalModel>) -> Unit) {
        synchronized(lock) {
            check(state == LocalModelState.EMPTY || state == LocalModelState.FAILED) {
                "A local model is already loaded or loading."
            }
            state = LocalModelState.LOADING
        }
        background.execute {
            val result = runCatching {
                val model = catalog.get(id, version)
                    ?: error("Imported model is missing or failed its integrity check.")
                val file = catalog.modelFile(model)
                val capabilities = NativeLiteRtModelInspector().inspect(file)
                require(capabilities == model.capabilities) {
                    "Model capability metadata changed after import."
                }
                require(LocalModelBackend.CPU in capabilities.supportedBackends) {
                    "This runtime currently requires CPU support."
                }
                if (!cacheDirectory.exists() && !cacheDirectory.mkdirs()) {
                    error("Cannot create LiteRT-LM cache directory.")
                }
                val newEngine = Engine(
                    EngineConfig(
                        modelPath = file.absolutePath,
                        backend = Backend.CPU(),
                        cacheDir = cacheDirectory.absolutePath
                    )
                )
                try {
                    newEngine.initialize()
                    val newConversation = newEngine.createConversation(
                        ConversationConfig(
                            systemInstruction = Contents.of(systemPrompt),
                            tools = ToolRegistry.all().map(::registeredToolProvider),
                            automaticToolCalling = false,
                            maxOutputToken = MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS
                        )
                    )
                    synchronized(lock) {
                        engine = newEngine
                        conversation = newConversation
                        loadedModel = model
                        state = LocalModelState.READY
                    }
                } catch (failure: Throwable) {
                    runCatching { if (newEngine.isInitialized()) newEngine.close() }
                    throw failure
                }
                model
            }
            if (result.isFailure) {
                synchronized(lock) { state = LocalModelState.FAILED }
            }
            callback(result)
        }
    }

    override fun stream(prompt: String, callback: LocalInferenceCallback) {
        require(prompt.isNotBlank() && prompt.length <= MAX_PROMPT_CHARACTERS)
        streamMessage(Message.user(Contents.of(prompt)), prompt.length, callback, false)
    }

    override fun streamThinking(prompt: String, callback: LocalInferenceCallback) {
        require(prompt.isNotBlank() && prompt.length <= MAX_PROMPT_CHARACTERS)
        streamMessage(Message.user(Contents.of(prompt)), prompt.length, callback, true)
    }

    override fun respondToTools(responses: List<LocalToolResponse>, callback: LocalInferenceCallback) {
        require(responses.isNotEmpty() && responses.size <= MAX_TOOL_RESPONSES)
        val contents: List<Content> = responses.map { Content.ToolResponse(it.toolName, it.response) }
        val characterCount = responses.sumOf { it.response.length }
        require(characterCount <= MAX_PROMPT_CHARACTERS)
        streamMessage(Message.tool(Contents.of(contents)), characterCount, callback, false)
    }

    private fun streamMessage(
        message: Message,
        promptCharacters: Int,
        callback: LocalInferenceCallback,
        isolatedThinking: Boolean
    ) {
        val activeConversation: Conversation
        val startNanos = System.nanoTime()
        val inputTokens: Int?
        synchronized(lock) {
            check(state == LocalModelState.READY) { "A local model is not ready." }
            activeConversation = if (isolatedThinking) {
                checkNotNull(engine).createConversation(
                    ConversationConfig(
                        systemInstruction = Contents.of(
                            "You are a data-only reasoning worker for Device AI. " +
                                "You have no tools and no authority to act."
                        ),
                        tools = emptyList(),
                        automaticToolCalling = false,
                        maxOutputToken = MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS
                    )
                )
            } else {
                checkNotNull(conversation)
            }
            inferenceConversation = activeConversation
            inferenceActive = true
            state = LocalModelState.GENERATING
            inputTokens = runCatching { activeConversation.getTokenCount() }.getOrNull()
        }
        val responseCharacters = intArrayOf(0)
        val chunks = intArrayOf(0)
        var firstTokenNanos: Long? = null
        val finished = AtomicBoolean()
        val outputLimitReached = AtomicBoolean()

        fun finish(event: LocalInferenceEvent?) {
            if (!finished.compareAndSet(false, true)) return
            if (isolatedThinking) {
                background.execute {
                    runCatching { if (activeConversation.isAlive) activeConversation.close() }
                }
            }
            synchronized(lock) {
                if (inferenceConversation === activeConversation) inferenceConversation = null
            }
            finishInference()
            if (event != null && !outputLimitReached.get()) deliver(callback, event)
        }

        try {
            activeConversation.sendMessageAsync(
                message,
                object : MessageCallback {
                    override fun onMessage(message: com.google.ai.edge.litertlm.Message) {
                        if (message.toolCalls.isNotEmpty()) {
                            if (message.toolCalls.size > 1) {
                                if (message.toolCalls.size > MAX_TOOL_RESPONSES) {
                                    deliver(callback, LocalInferenceEvent.Failed("Local model proposed too many tools; none were run."))
                                    runCatching { activeConversation.cancelProcess() }
                                    return
                                }
                                deliver(
                                    callback,
                                    LocalInferenceEvent.ToolBatchRejected(
                                        message.toolCalls.map {
                                            LocalToolResponse(
                                                it.name,
                                                """{"status":"REJECTED","reason":"Only one registered tool proposal is permitted per step."}"""
                                            )
                                        }
                                    )
                                )
                            } else {
                                val toolCall = message.toolCalls.single()
                                val validation = ToolProposal(toolCall.name, toolCall.arguments).validate()
                                val event = if (validation == null) {
                                    LocalInferenceEvent.ToolProposal(
                                        at.heinz.deviceai.ToolProposal(toolCall.name, toolCall.arguments)
                                    )
                                } else {
                                    LocalInferenceEvent.ToolProposalRejected(
                                        toolCall.name, validation, toolCall.arguments
                                    )
                                }
                                deliver(callback, event)
                            }
                        }
                        message.contents.contents.filterIsInstance<Content.Text>().forEach { text ->
                            if (text.text.isBlank()) return@forEach
                            if (responseCharacters[0] + text.text.length > MAX_RESPONSE_CHARACTERS) {
                                if (outputLimitReached.compareAndSet(false, true)) {
                                    deliver(callback, LocalInferenceEvent.Failed("Local model response exceeded the output limit."))
                                    runCatching { activeConversation.cancelProcess() }
                                }
                                return
                            }
                            responseCharacters[0] += text.text.length
                            chunks[0]++
                            if (firstTokenNanos == null) firstTokenNanos = System.nanoTime()
                            deliver(callback, LocalInferenceEvent.TextDelta(text.text))
                        }
                    }

                    override fun onDone() {
                        if (outputLimitReached.get()) {
                            finish(null)
                            return
                        }
                        val elapsed = (System.nanoTime() - startNanos).coerceAtLeast(0) / 1_000_000
                        val outputTokens = runCatching {
                            activeConversation.getTokenCount() -
                                (inputTokens ?: activeConversation.getTokenCount())
                        }.getOrNull()?.coerceAtLeast(0)
                        finish(
                            LocalInferenceEvent.Completed(
                                LocalInferenceMetrics(
                                    promptCharacters = promptCharacters,
                                    responseCharacters = responseCharacters[0],
                                    streamedChunks = chunks[0],
                                    inputTokens = inputTokens,
                                    outputTokens = outputTokens,
                                    firstTokenLatencyMillis = firstTokenNanos?.let {
                                        (it - startNanos).coerceAtLeast(0) / 1_000_000
                                    },
                                    totalLatencyMillis = elapsed
                                )
                            )
                        )
                    }

                    override fun onError(throwable: Throwable) {
                        if (outputLimitReached.get()) {
                            finish(null)
                            return
                        }
                        finish(
                            if (throwable is CancellationException) LocalInferenceEvent.Cancelled
                            else LocalInferenceEvent.Failed(throwable.message.orEmpty().take(512))
                        )
                    }
                }
            )
        } catch (failure: Throwable) {
            if (outputLimitReached.get()) finish(null)
            else finish(LocalInferenceEvent.Failed(failure.message.orEmpty().take(512)))
        }
    }

    override fun cancel() {
        val active = synchronized(lock) {
            if (state != LocalModelState.GENERATING && state != LocalModelState.UNLOADING) null
            else inferenceConversation ?: conversation
        }
        runCatching { active?.cancelProcess() }
    }

    override fun unload(callback: (Result<Unit>) -> Unit) {
        val activeConversation: Conversation?
        synchronized(lock) {
            check(state != LocalModelState.LOADING && state != LocalModelState.UNLOADING) {
                "Local model lifecycle operation is already in progress."
            }
            activeConversation = inferenceConversation ?: conversation
            if (inferenceActive) {
                state = LocalModelState.UNLOADING
                pendingUnload = callback
            }
        }
        if (activeConversation != null && synchronized(lock) { inferenceActive }) {
            runCatching { activeConversation.cancelProcess() }
            return
        }
        background.execute { closeResources(callback) }
    }

    private fun finishInference() {
        val shouldUnload = synchronized(lock) {
            inferenceActive = false
            if (pendingUnload != null) true
            else {
                if (state == LocalModelState.GENERATING) state = LocalModelState.READY
                false
            }
        }
        if (shouldUnload) {
            val callback = synchronized(lock) {
                pendingUnload.also { pendingUnload = null }
            } ?: return
            background.execute { closeResources(callback) }
        }
    }

    private fun closeResources(callback: (Result<Unit>) -> Unit) {
        val resources = synchronized(lock) {
            val oldConversation = conversation
            val oldEngine = engine
            conversation = null
            inferenceConversation = null
            engine = null
            loadedModel = null
            oldConversation to oldEngine
        }
        val result = runCatching {
            resources.first?.let { if (it.isAlive) it.close() }
            resources.second?.let { if (it.isInitialized()) it.close() }
            Unit
        }
        synchronized(lock) {
            state = if (result.isSuccess) LocalModelState.EMPTY else LocalModelState.FAILED
        }
        callback(result)
    }

    private fun deliver(callback: LocalInferenceCallback, event: LocalInferenceEvent) {
        runCatching { callback.onEvent(event) }
    }

    private fun registeredToolProvider(spec: ToolSpec) = tool(
        object : OpenApiTool {
            override fun getToolDescriptionJsonString(): String {
                val properties = JSONObject()
                (spec.required + spec.optional).sorted().forEach { argument ->
                    val type = when {
                        argument in setOf("lines", "limit", "seconds") -> "integer"
                        argument == "userOnly" -> "boolean"
                        argument == "roots" -> "array"
                        else -> "string"
                    }
                    val field = JSONObject().put("type", type)
                    if (type == "array") field.put("items", JSONObject().put("type", "string"))
                    properties.put(argument, field)
                }
                val parameters = JSONObject()
                    .put("type", "object")
                    .put("properties", properties)
                if (spec.required.isNotEmpty()) {
                    parameters.put("required", JSONArray(spec.required.sorted()))
                }
                return JSONObject()
                    .put("name", spec.name)
                    .put("description", "${spec.description} Risk: ${spec.risk.name}.")
                    .put("parameters", parameters)
                    .toString()
            }

            override fun execute(paramsJsonString: String): String =
                """{"error":"Tool execution must be submitted to Device AI's explicit ToolGate."}"""
        }
    )

    private companion object {

SHA-256: f8c79f47698054a839ef7be48107d76307666f3dc51efa272dd4e9b4cdf36b32

package at.heinz.deviceai.localmodel

import com.google.ai.edge.litertlm.BackendType
import com.google.ai.edge.litertlm.ModelInfo
import com.google.ai.edge.litertlm.Modality
import java.io.ByteArrayInputStream
import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream
import java.io.DataInputStream
import java.io.DataOutputStream
import java.io.File
import java.io.FileInputStream
import java.io.FileOutputStream
import java.io.InputStream
import java.io.IOException
import java.nio.file.AtomicMoveNotSupportedException
import java.nio.file.Files
import java.nio.file.StandardCopyOption
import java.security.MessageDigest

enum class LocalModelBackend { CPU, GPU, NPU }

data class LocalModelCapabilities(
    val text: Boolean,
    val vision: Boolean,
    val audio: Boolean,
    val video: Boolean,
    val functionCalling: Boolean,
    val maxContextTokens: Int,
    val minimumRuntimeVersion: String?,
    val supportedBackends: Set<LocalModelBackend>
) {
    init {
        require(maxContextTokens >= 0)
        require(minimumRuntimeVersion == null || minimumRuntimeVersion.length <= 64)
        require(supportedBackends.isNotEmpty())
    }
}

data class ImportedLocalModel(
    val id: String,
    val version: String,
    val sha256: String,
    val byteCount: Long,
    val capabilities: LocalModelCapabilities
) {
    init {
        require(isSafeIdentifier(id) && isSafeIdentifier(version))
        require(sha256.matches(Regex("[a-f0-9]{64}")) && byteCount in 1..MAX_MODEL_BYTES)
        require(capabilities.text && LocalModelBackend.CPU in capabilities.supportedBackends)
    }
}

fun interface LocalModelInspector {
    fun inspect(modelFile: File): LocalModelCapabilities
}

class NativeLiteRtModelInspector : LocalModelInspector {
    override fun inspect(modelFile: File): LocalModelCapabilities =
        ModelInfo.from(modelFile.absolutePath).use { info ->
            require(info is ModelInfo.Llm) { "Only LiteRT-LM language models are supported." }
            val modalities = info.inputModalities()
            LocalModelCapabilities(
                text = modalities.text,
                vision = modalities.vision,
                audio = modalities.audio,
                video = modalities.video,
                functionCalling = info.supportsFunctionCalling(),
                maxContextTokens = info.maxContextTokens(),
                minimumRuntimeVersion = info.minRuntimeVersion(),
                supportedBackends = info.supportedBackends(Modality.TEXT).mapNotNull {
                    when (it) {
                        BackendType.CPU -> LocalModelBackend.CPU
                        BackendType.GPU -> LocalModelBackend.GPU
                        BackendType.NPU -> LocalModelBackend.NPU
                    }
                }.toSet()
            )
        }.also {
            require(it.text && LocalModelBackend.CPU in it.supportedBackends) {
                "Model must support text input on the CPU backend."
            }
        }
}

class LocalModelCatalog(
    private val directory: File,
    private val inspector: LocalModelInspector,
    private val maxModelBytes: Long = DEFAULT_MAX_MODEL_BYTES
) {
    init { require(maxModelBytes in 1..MAX_ALLOWED_MODEL_BYTES) }

    @Synchronized
    fun import(
        id: String,
        version: String,
        input: InputStream,
        expectedSha256: String
    ): ImportedLocalModel {
        require(isSafeIdentifier(id) && isSafeIdentifier(version))
        require(expectedSha256.matches(Regex("[a-f0-9]{64}")))
        if (!directory.exists() && !directory.mkdirs()) throw IOException("Cannot create local model directory.")
        val modelFile = modelFile(id, version)
        val metadataFile = metadataFile(id, version)
        require(!modelFile.exists() && !metadataFile.exists()) { "Model version is already imported." }
        require(directory.listFiles { file -> file.isFile && file.name.endsWith(METADATA_SUFFIX) }
            .orEmpty().size < MAX_CATALOG_ENTRIES) { "Local model catalog is full." }
        val temporary = File.createTempFile("model-import-", ".litertlm", directory)
        try {
            val digest = MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256")
            var total = 0L
            FileOutputStream(temporary).use { output ->
                input.use { source ->
                    val buffer = ByteArray(COPY_BUFFER_SIZE)
                    while (true) {
                        val count = source.read(buffer)
                        if (count < 0) break
                        require(total <= maxModelBytes - count) { "Model exceeds the configured import limit." }
                        total += count
                        digest.update(buffer, 0, count)
                        output.write(buffer, 0, count)
                    }
                }
                output.fd.sync()
            }
            require(total > 0) { "Model file is empty." }
            val hash = digest.digest().toHex()
            require(MessageDigest.isEqual(hash.toByteArray(), expectedSha256.toByteArray())) {
                "Model SHA-256 does not match the expected digest."
            }
            val capabilities = inspector.inspect(temporary)
            require(capabilities.text && LocalModelBackend.CPU in capabilities.supportedBackends) {
                "Only text models with CPU support can be imported."
            }
            val record = ImportedLocalModel(id, version, hash, total, capabilities)
            moveAtomically(temporary, modelFile)
            try {
                writeMetadata(metadataFile, record)
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                modelFile.delete()
                throw e
            }
            return record
        } finally {
            temporary.delete()
        }
    }

    @Synchronized
    fun all(): List<ImportedLocalModel> =
        directory.listFiles { file -> file.isFile && file.name.endsWith(METADATA_SUFFIX) }
            .orEmpty()
            .take(MAX_CATALOG_ENTRIES)
            .mapNotNull { file ->
                runCatching { readMetadata(file) }.getOrNull()?.takeIf { record ->
                    metadataFile(record.id, record.version).name == file.name &&
                        modelFile(record.id, record.version).let { it.isFile && it.length() == record.byteCount }
                }
            }
            .sortedWith(compareBy({ it.id }, { it.version }))

    @Synchronized
    fun get(id: String, version: String, verifyBytes: Boolean = true): ImportedLocalModel? {
        require(isSafeIdentifier(id) && isSafeIdentifier(version))
        val record = runCatching { readMetadata(metadataFile(id, version)) }.getOrNull() ?: return null
        if (record.id != id || record.version != version) return null
        val file = modelFile(id, version)
        if (!file.isFile || file.length() != record.byteCount) return null
        if (verifyBytes && sha256(file) != record.sha256) return null
        return record
    }

    @Synchronized
    fun modelFile(record: ImportedLocalModel): File {
        require(get(record.id, record.version) == record) { "Imported model failed catalog verification." }
        return modelFile(record.id, record.version)
    }

    @Synchronized
    fun delete(id: String, version: String): Boolean {
        require(isSafeIdentifier(id) && isSafeIdentifier(version))
        val model = modelFile(id, version)
        val metadata = metadataFile(id, version)
        if (!metadata.exists()) return false
        model.delete()
        return metadata.delete()
    }

    private fun modelFile(id: String, version: String) =
        File(directory, "${keyPrefix(id, version)}.litertlm")
    private fun metadataFile(id: String, version: String) =
        File(directory, "${keyPrefix(id, version)}.meta")

    private fun keyPrefix(id: String, version: String): String =
        MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256")
            .digest("$id\u0000$version".toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8)).toHex()

    private fun writeMetadata(file: File, record: ImportedLocalModel) {
        val bytes = ByteArrayOutputStream().also { buffer ->
            DataOutputStream(buffer).use { out ->
                out.writeUTF(METADATA_MAGIC)
                out.writeInt(METADATA_SCHEMA)
                out.writeUTF(record.id)
                out.writeUTF(record.version)
                out.writeUTF(record.sha256)
                out.writeLong(record.byteCount)
                val caps = record.capabilities
                out.writeBoolean(caps.text)
                out.writeBoolean(caps.vision)
                out.writeBoolean(caps.audio)
                out.writeBoolean(caps.video)
                out.writeBoolean(caps.functionCalling)
                out.writeInt(caps.maxContextTokens)
                out.writeBoolean(caps.minimumRuntimeVersion != null)
                caps.minimumRuntimeVersion?.let(out::writeUTF)
                out.writeInt(caps.supportedBackends.size)
                caps.supportedBackends.sortedBy { it.name }.forEach { out.writeUTF(it.name) }
            }
        }.toByteArray()
        require(bytes.size <= MAX_METADATA_BYTES)
        val temporary = File.createTempFile("model-meta-", ".tmp", directory)
        try {
            FileOutputStream(temporary).use { output ->
                output.write(bytes)
                output.fd.sync()
            }
            moveAtomically(temporary, file)
        } finally {
            temporary.delete()
        }
    }

    private fun readMetadata(file: File): ImportedLocalModel {
        require(file.isFile && file.length() in 1..MAX_METADATA_BYTES.toLong())
        val input = DataInputStream(ByteArrayInputStream(file.readBytes()))
        require(input.readUTF() == METADATA_MAGIC)
        require(input.readInt() == METADATA_SCHEMA) { "Unsupported local model metadata schema." }
        val id = input.readUTF()
        val version = input.readUTF()
        val hash = input.readUTF()
        val bytes = input.readLong()
        val text = input.readBoolean()
        val vision = input.readBoolean()
        val audio = input.readBoolean()
        val video = input.readBoolean()
        val functionCalling = input.readBoolean()
        val contextTokens = input.readInt()
        val runtimeVersion = if (input.readBoolean()) input.readUTF() else null
        val count = input.readInt()
        require(count in 1..3)
        val backends = List(count) { LocalModelBackend.valueOf(input.readUTF()) }.toSet()
        require(input.available() == 0)
        return ImportedLocalModel(
            id, version, hash, bytes,
            LocalModelCapabilities(text, vision, audio, video, functionCalling, contextTokens, runtimeVersion, backends)
        )
    }

    private fun sha256(file: File): String {
        val digest = MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256")
        FileInputStream(file).use { input ->
            val buffer = ByteArray(COPY_BUFFER_SIZE)
            while (true) {
                val count = input.read(buffer)
                if (count < 0) break
                digest.update(buffer, 0, count)
            }
        }
        return digest.digest().toHex()
    }

    private fun moveAtomically(source: File, target: File) {
        try {
            Files.move(source.toPath(), target.toPath(), StandardCopyOption.ATOMIC_MOVE)
        } catch (_: AtomicMoveNotSupportedException) {
            Files.move(source.toPath(), target.toPath())
        }
    }

    companion object {
        const val DEFAULT_MAX_MODEL_BYTES = 20L * 1024 * 1024 * 1024
        private const val MAX_ALLOWED_MODEL_BYTES = 64L * 1024 * 1024 * 1024
        private const val COPY_BUFFER_SIZE = 64 * 1024
        private const val METADATA_MAGIC = "DEVICE_AI_LOCAL_MODEL"
        private const val METADATA_SCHEMA = 1
        private const val METADATA_SUFFIX = ".meta"
        private const val MAX_METADATA_BYTES = 4 * 1024
        private const val MAX_CATALOG_ENTRIES = 256
    }
}

private const val MAX_MODEL_BYTES = 64L * 1024 * 1024 * 1024

internal fun isSafeIdentifier(value: String) =
    value.length in 1..64 && value.matches(Regex("[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]*"))

private fun ByteArray.toHex(): String = joinToString("") { "%02x".format(it) }

package at.heinz.deviceai.localmodel

import android.content.Context
import java.io.File

/**
 * One model catalog and one LiteRT-LM runtime per process. An activity that is
 * recreated (rotation, folding) reuses the loaded engine instead of loading a
 * second copy of a model of several hundred megabytes or leaking the first one
 * together with its worker thread. The activity unloads the model only when it
 * is really finishing.
 */
object LocalModelHost {
    class Host(val catalog: LocalModelCatalog, val runtime: LiteRtLmLocalModelRuntime)

    @Volatile private var host: Host? = null

    fun get(context: Context): Host = host ?: synchronized(this) {
        host ?: context.applicationContext.let { app ->
            val catalog = LocalModelCatalog(File(app.filesDir, "local-models"), NativeLiteRtModelInspector())
            Host(catalog, LiteRtLmLocalModelRuntime(catalog, File(app.cacheDir, "litertlm")))
        }.also { host = it }
    }
}

FILE 195/375: app/src/test/java/at/heinz/deviceai/AgentToolLayerTest.kt
SHA-256: 5233c15dfb9271b055c0efcd755c4c8c346efaeef91792b968dae3278fc6ce32
