import org.junit.Assert.assertThrows
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test

class ContinuumIntelligencePhase2Test {
    @Test
    fun difficultRequestUsesMultipleDataOnlyReasoningPasses() {
        val roles = mutableListOf<ReasoningPassRole>()
        val coordinator = ContinuumIntelligenceCoordinator(
            adapter = ContinuumReasoningAdapter { request ->
                roles += request.role
                ReasoningPassResult(
                    modelId = "fake-local",
                    text = when (request.role) {
                        ReasoningPassRole.CANDIDATE -> "candidate"
                        ReasoningPassRole.CRITIC -> "critique"
                        ReasoningPassRole.VERIFIER -> "verified"
                        ReasoningPassRole.JUDGE -> "final"
                    },
                    latencyMillis = 1
                )
            },
            nowMillis = { 1_000L },
            nowNanos = { 1_000L }
        )

        val result = coordinator.run(
            ContinuumIntelligenceRequest(
                taskId = "task-1",
                userRequest = "Erstelle einen komplexen Plan mit mehreren Bedingungen und Gegenargumenten.",
                compiledContext = "verified identity and memory context",
                requestedStrategy = ReasoningStrategy.MULTI_CANDIDATE
            )
        )

    @Test
    fun proofCarryingMutationRequiresPolicyAndMaintainsSignatureChain() {
        val signer = TestSigner()
        val ledger = MemoryMutationLedger(signer)
        val policy = MemoryWritePolicy()
        val first = memory("m1", "old", 100)
        val second = first.copy(content = "corrected", updatedAt = 200)
        val decision = policy.decide(
            MemoryWriteContext(
                memoryType = MemoryType.SEMANTIC,
                provenance = ProvenanceType.USER_PROVIDED,
                confidence = 0.9,
                explicitlyRequested = true,
                containsPersonalInformation = true
            )
        )

        val mutation1 = ProofCarryingMemoryMutation.create(
            mutationId = "mut-1",
            before = null,
            after = first,
            reason = MemoryMutationReason.USER_CORRECTION,
            evidenceReferences = emptyList(),
            contradictionReferences = emptyList(),
            previousMutationHash = null,
            decision = decision,
            signer = signer,
            createdAtMillis = 100
        )
        ledger.append(mutation1)

        val mutation2 = ProofCarryingMemoryMutation.create(
            mutationId = "mut-2",
            before = first,
            after = second,
            reason = MemoryMutationReason.NEW_EVIDENCE,
            evidenceReferences = listOf("source:1"),
            contradictionReferences = emptyList(),
            previousMutationHash = ledger.lastHash(),
            decision = decision,
            signer = signer,
            createdAtMillis = 200
        )
        ledger.append(mutation2)

        assertTrue(ledger.verifyChain())
        assertEquals(memoryRecordHash(first), mutation2.payload.beforeHash)
        assertEquals(memoryRecordHash(second), mutation2.payload.afterHash)
    }

        try {
            val signer = TestSigner()
            val runtime = runtimeStore(dir, signer)
            val state = runtime.openOrCreate()
            val archiveFile = File(dir, "cognitive/cognitive-state.bin")
            val encoded = archiveFile.readBytes()
            val input = DataInputStream(ByteArrayInputStream(encoded))
            input.readUTF()
            input.readInt()
            val payloadSize = input.readInt()
            val payloadOffset = encoded.size - input.available()
            val payload = encoded.copyOfRange(payloadOffset, payloadOffset + payloadSize)
            val hashOffset = String(payload, Charsets.ISO_8859_1).indexOf(state.archive.identityState.integrityHash)
            assertTrue(hashOffset >= 0)
            payload[hashOffset] = (payload[hashOffset].toInt() xor 1).toByte()
            payload.copyInto(encoded, payloadOffset)
            sha256Bytes(payload).copyInto(encoded, payloadOffset + payloadSize)
            archiveFile.writeBytes(encoded)

            assertThrows(IllegalStateException::class.java) { runtime.openOrCreate() }
        } finally {
            dir.deleteRecursively()
        }
    }

            val genesis = runtime.openOrCreate()

                genesis,
                memories = listOf(memory("committed", 20))
            )

            // Simulate a crash after CognitiveArchiveStore.save() but before the
            // Continuum seed/state-root commit. This advances the mutable archive
            // while leaving the signed seed on the previous state root.
            val archiveStore = CognitiveArchiveStore(
                File(dir, "cognitive"),
                committed.seed.instanceId.value
            )
            archiveStore.save(
                committed.archive.copy(
                    memories = committed.archive.memories + memory("uncommitted", 30)
                )
            )

            val recovered = store(dir, signer).openOrCreate()
            assertEquals(ArchiveLoadSource.LAST_KNOWN_GOOD, recovered.archiveLoadSource)
            assertEquals(listOf("committed"), recovered.archive.memories.map { it.id })
            assertTrue(recovered.manifest.archiveSha256.isNotBlank())
        } finally {
            dir.deleteRecursively()
        }
    }

class ContinuumSeedStoreTest {
    @Test
    fun primaryRoundTripAndLkgFallbackWork() {
        val dir = Files.createTempDirectory("continuum-seed-store").toFile()
        try {
            val signer = TestSigner()
            val store = FileContinuumSeedStore(dir, signer)
            val first = seed("root-a")

                    ContinuumObjectType.STATE_MANIFEST,
                    "root-b".toByteArray()

            primary.writeBytes(bytes)

            val recovered = store.requireLoad()
            assertEquals(ContinuumSeedLoadSource.LAST_KNOWN_GOOD, recovered.source)
            assertEquals(first, recovered.seed)
            assertNotNull(recovered.seed.contentHash())
        } finally {
            dir.deleteRecursively()
        }
    }

            val file = dir.listFiles { item -> item.name.endsWith(".obj") }!!.single()
            val bytes = file.readBytes()
            bytes[bytes.lastIndex] = (bytes.last().toInt() xor 0x01).toByte()
            file.writeBytes(bytes)

            assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { store.get(metadata.id) }
        } finally {
            dir.deleteRecursively()
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun boundedStoreRejectsCapacityOverflow() {
        val dir = Files.createTempDirectory("continuum-capacity-test").toFile()
        try {
            val store = FileContinuumObjectStore(dir, maxObjectBytes = 128, maxStoreBytes = 256)
            store.put(ContinuumObjectType.CACHE, ByteArray(120) { 1 }, 1)
            assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) {
                store.put(ContinuumObjectType.CACHE, ByteArray(120) { 2 }, 2)
            }
            assertTrue(store.totalStoredBytes() <= 256)
        } finally {
            dir.deleteRecursively()
        }
    }
}

package at.heinz.deviceai.cognitive

import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertThrows
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test
import java.util.concurrent.CancellationException

class DeliberationTest {
    @Test
    fun selectorUsesResearchForFreshFactsAndToolPlanForDeviceActions() {
        assertEquals(
            ReasoningStrategy.RESEARCH_BACKED,
            ReasoningStrategySelector.select(ReasoningTaskProfile(factualFreshnessNeeded = true))
        )
        assertEquals(
            ReasoningStrategy.TOOL_PLAN,
            ReasoningStrategySelector.select(ReasoningTaskProfile(expectedToolUse = true))
        )
    }

    @Test
    fun multiCandidateRunIsBoundedAndProducesOneFinalAnswer() {
        val orchestrator = BoundedDeliberationOrchestrator(
            generator = DeliberationCandidateGenerator { _, index -> "candidate " + index },
            critic = DeliberationCritic { _, candidate -> "critic " + candidate.id },
            verifier = DeliberationVerifier { _, candidate -> "verified " + candidate.id },
            judge = DeliberationJudge { _, candidates, _, _ -> "winner " + candidates.first().id },
            nowNanos = { 1_000L }
        )

        val result = orchestrator.run(
            task = "solve",
            strategy = ReasoningStrategy.MULTI_CANDIDATE,
            budget = DeliberationBudget.forStrategy(ReasoningStrategy.MULTI_CANDIDATE)
        )

        assertEquals(4, result.candidates.size)
        assertEquals(4, result.critiques.size)
        assertEquals(2, result.verifications.size)
        assertEquals("winner candidate-0", result.finalText)
        assertTrue(result.modelCalls <= 14)
    }

    @Test
    fun hardModelCallBudgetCannotBeRaisedByThePipeline() {
        val orchestrator = BoundedDeliberationOrchestrator(
            generator = DeliberationCandidateGenerator { _, index -> "candidate " + index },
            critic = DeliberationCritic { _, _ -> "critique" },
            verifier = DeliberationVerifier { _, _ -> "verify" },
            judge = DeliberationJudge { _, _, _, _ -> "judge" },
            nowNanos = { 1_000L }
        )
        val tinyBudget = DeliberationBudget(
            maxModelCalls = 2,
            maxCandidateBranches = 4,
            maxCriticPasses = 4,
            maxVerifierPasses = 2,
            maxResearchRounds = 0,
            maxContextBytes = 4_096,
            maxWallTimeMillis = 1_000,
            checkpointEveryCalls = 1
        )

        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) {
            orchestrator.run("hard task", ReasoningStrategy.MULTI_CANDIDATE, tinyBudget)
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun cancellationStopsBeforeModelWork() {
        var calls = 0
        val cancellation = DeliberationCancellation().also { it.cancel() }
        val orchestrator = BoundedDeliberationOrchestrator(
            generator = DeliberationCandidateGenerator { _, _ -> calls++; "candidate" },
            critic = DeliberationCritic { _, _ -> "critic" },
            verifier = DeliberationVerifier { _, _ -> "verify" },
            judge = DeliberationJudge { _, _, _, _ -> "judge" }
        )

        assertThrows(CancellationException::class.java) {
            orchestrator.run("task", ReasoningStrategy.FAST, cancellation = cancellation)
        }
        assertEquals(0, calls)
    }
}

package at.heinz.deviceai.cognitive

import at.heinz.deviceai.learning.StrictJson
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test
import java.io.File
import java.nio.file.Files

/**
 * Kotlin half of the Node -> Kotlin -> Node round trip.
 *
 * In CI (android.yml) the directory comes from CONTINUUM_BACKLOG_ROUNDTRIP_DIR:
 * Node wrote backlog.json just before this test, and Node verifies this test's
 * output right after it (backlog-fixtures.mjs roundtrip-verify). Without the
 * variable the committed Node output (roundtrip-node.json) is used, so the
 * Kotlin half always runs.
 */
class DevelopmentBacklogRoundtripTest {
    private fun resource(name: String): ByteArray =
        javaClass.getResourceAsStream("/continuum/backlog/$name")?.use { it.readBytes() } ?: error("missing fixture $name")

    @Suppress("UNCHECKED_CAST")
    private fun Any?.map() = this as Map<String, Any?>

    @Suppress("UNCHECKED_CAST")
    private fun Any?.list() = this as List<Map<String, Any?>>

    @Test fun kotlinChangesNodeWrittenBacklogWithTheSharedRules() {
        val live = System.getenv("CONTINUUM_BACKLOG_ROUNDTRIP_DIR")?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() }
        val dir = live?.let(::File) ?: Files.createTempDirectory("backlog-roundtrip").toFile().also {
            File(it, "backlog.json").writeBytes(resource("roundtrip-node.json"))
            File(it, "node-state.json").writeBytes(resource("roundtrip-node-state.json"))
        }
        try {
            val nodeState = StrictJson.parse(File(dir, "node-state.json").readText()).map()
            val plan = StrictJson.parse(String(resource("roundtrip.json"), Charsets.UTF_8)).map()
            val store = DevelopmentBacklogStore(File(dir, "backlog.json"), "android-roundtrip")

            val before = store.read()
            assertEquals("Node output must verify unchanged", nodeState["integrity"], before.doc["integrity"])
            assertEquals(nodeState["revision"], before.doc["revision"])

            val result = store.apply(plan["ops"].list())
            val expected = plan["expected"].map()
            assertEquals((nodeState["revision"] as Long) + (expected["revisionDelta"] as Long), result.doc["revision"])
            val states = result.doc["tasks"].list().associate { it["id"] to it["state"] }
            for ((id, state) in expected["states"].map()) assertEquals(id, state, states[id])
            assertEquals("unknown Node field survives the Kotlin rewrite",
                mapOf("writtenBy" to "node", "items" to listOf(1L, 2L, 3L)), result.doc["roundtripMarker"])

            File(dir, "kotlin-ops.json").writeText(DevelopmentBacklog.canonical(plan["opLog"]) + "\n")
            File(dir, "kotlin-state.json").writeText(DevelopmentBacklog.canonical(linkedMapOf(
                "revision" to result.doc["revision"], "integrity" to result.doc["integrity"])) + "\n")
            assertTrue(File(dir, "backlog.json.bak").exists())
        } finally {
            if (live == null) dir.deleteRecursively()
        }
    }
}

    @Test fun conformanceVectorsMatchTheNodeImplementation() {

            case["steps"].list().forEachIndexed { k, rawStep ->

                val outcome = try {
                    doc = DevelopmentBacklog.applyOp(doc, step["op"].map()).doc

                } catch (e: BacklogException) {
                    e.code
                }
                assertEquals("${case["name"]} step $k", step["expect"], outcome)
            }

            assertEquals("${case["name"]} revision", final["revision"], doc["revision"])
            assertEquals("${case["name"]} integrity", final["integrity"], DevelopmentBacklog.integrityOf(doc))

            assertEquals("${case["name"]} states", final["states"].map(), states)
        }
    }

    @Test fun fixtureDocumentsRoundTripByteIdentically() {

            "id" to "task-beta", "priority" to 5L)).doc

        val gamma = again["tasks"].list().map { it.map() }.first { it["id"] == "task-gamma" }

    @Test fun concurrentWritersInSeparateStoresLoseNoUpdate() = withDir { dir ->
        val file = File(dir, "backlog.json")

        val perThread = 4
        val pool = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(threads)
        val start = CountDownLatch(1)
        val errors = java.util.Collections.synchronizedList(ArrayList<Throwable>())
        repeat(threads) { t ->
            pool.execute {
                val store = DevelopmentBacklogStore(file, "writer-$t", waitMillis = 60_000)
                start.await()
                repeat(perThread) { k ->
                    try { store.apply(listOf(propose("task-$t-$k", (t * 100 + k).toLong()))) } catch (e: Throwable) { errors += e }
                }
            }
        }
        start.countDown()
        pool.shutdown()
        assertTrue(pool.awaitTermination(120, TimeUnit.SECONDS))
        if (errors.isNotEmpty()) fail("writer failed: ${errors.first()}")
        val doc = DevelopmentBacklogStore(file, "reader").read().doc
        assertEquals((threads * perThread).toLong(), doc["revision"])
        assertEquals(threads * perThread, doc["tasks"].list().size)
        assertFalse(File(dir, "backlog.json.lock").exists())
    }

        assertArrayEquals(v1, File(dir, "backlog.json.v1.json").readBytes())
    }

        assertEquals("DONE", views.getValue("task-alpha").state)

    private fun q(s: String) = jsonString(s)

    private fun devJson(
        path: String = source.path,
        hash: String = source.sha256,
        replacement: String = "fun greet() = \"HI\"\n",
        extra: String = ""
    ) = """{"summary":"louder","edits":[{"path":${q(path)},"expectedBaseSha256":"$hash","replacement":${q(replacement)},"rationale":"r"}]$extra}"""

    private val criticJson = """{"verdict":"ACCEPT","findings":[{"severity":"INFO","message":"ok"}]}"""
    private val testsJson = """{"tests":[{"name":"greetIsLoud","description":"asserts HI"}]}"""
    private val judgeJson = """{"decision":"RECOMMEND","rationale":"small and safe"}"""
    private fun chain(dev: String = devJson()) = listOf(dev, criticJson, testsJson, judgeJson)

    private class Fake(
        private val responses: List<String>,
        var onBefore: (Int) -> Unit = {},
        var onAfter: (Int) -> Unit = {},
        var failWith: ((Int) -> Throwable?) = { null }
    ) : ContinuumReasoningAdapter {
        val requests = mutableListOf<ReasoningPassRequest>()
        val active = AtomicInteger()
        var maxActive = 0
        override fun execute(request: ReasoningPassRequest): ReasoningPassResult {
            val index = requests.size
            requests += request
            maxActive = maxOf(maxActive, active.incrementAndGet())
            try {
                onBefore(index)
                failWith(index)?.let { throw it }
                val text = responses[index]
                onAfter(index)
                return ReasoningPassResult("fake@1", text, 1)
            } finally {
                active.decrementAndGet()
            }
        }
    }

    private class Harness(val fake: Fake, var now: Long = 1_000L) {
        var runtimeCancels = 0
        val states = mutableListOf<DevelopmentJobState>()
        val coordinator = DevelopmentCoordinator(fake, { runtimeCancels++ }, { now })
    }

    private fun run(h: Harness, t: DevelopmentTask = task()) = h.coordinator.run(t) { h.states += it }

    private fun assertFailed(o: DevelopmentOutcome, kind: DevelopmentFailureKind) {
        assertEquals(DevelopmentJobState.FAILED, o.state)
        assertEquals(kind, o.failure?.kind)
        assertNull(o.proposal)
    }

    @Test
    fun successfulFourRoleChainReturnsOneNotExecutedProposal() {
        val h = Harness(Fake(chain()))
        val o = run(h)
        assertEquals(DevelopmentJobState.COMPLETED, o.state)
        assertEquals(4, o.modelCallsUsed)
        assertEquals(listOf(ReasoningPassRole.CANDIDATE, ReasoningPassRole.CRITIC, ReasoningPassRole.VERIFIER, ReasoningPassRole.JUDGE),
            h.fake.requests.map { it.role })
        assertEquals(1, h.fake.maxActive)
        assertEquals(listOf(DevelopmentJobState.PENDING, DevelopmentJobState.RUNNING_DEVELOPER, DevelopmentJobState.RUNNING_CRITIC,
            DevelopmentJobState.RUNNING_TEST_DESIGNER, DevelopmentJobState.RUNNING_JUDGE, DevelopmentJobState.COMPLETED), h.states)
        val p = o.proposal!!
        assertEquals(JudgeDecision.RECOMMEND, p.judge.decision)
        assertTrue(p.patchPreview.contains("-fun greet() = \"hi\""))
        assertTrue(p.patchPreview.contains("+fun greet() = \"HI\""))
        val text = p.render()
        assertTrue(text.contains("NOT EXECUTED"))
        assertTrue(text.contains("Generated tests executed"))
        assertTrue(text.contains("Job recorded in the development backlog"))
        assertFalse(text.contains("tests passed", ignoreCase = true))
        assertEquals(0, h.runtimeCancels)
    }

    @Test
    fun limitsCannotExceedHardCeilings() {
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { DevelopmentLimits(maxModelCalls = 5) }

    }

    @Test
    fun malformedJsonVariantsAreRejected() {
        val bad = listOf(
            "{", "[]", "{\"summary\":\"x\"}", devJson() + " trailing", "{\"summary\":1,\"edits\":[]}",
            """{"summary":"a","summary":"b","edits":[]}""", """{"summary":"a","edits":[],"extra":"x"}""",
            """{"summary":"a","edits":[{"path":"a/B.kt"}]}""",
            """{"summary":"a","edits":[1]}""", "{\"summary\":\"a\nb\",\"edits\":[]}",
            """{"summary":"a","edits":[],"notes":[${(1..9).joinToString(",") { "\"n\"" }}]}""",
            """{"summary":"a","edits":[{},{},{},{},{}]}""",
            "```python\n${devJson()}\n```"
        )
        for (text in bad) {
            val o = run(Harness(Fake(listOf(text))))
            assertFailed(o, DevelopmentFailureKind.MALFORMED_OUTPUT)
        }
        assertFailed(run(Harness(Fake(listOf("")))), DevelopmentFailureKind.MODEL_FAILURE) // blank output rejected by result type
        val fenced = run(Harness(Fake(chain("```json\n${devJson()}\n```"))))
        assertEquals(DevelopmentJobState.COMPLETED, fenced.state)
    }

    }

        val o = run(h)

        assertEquals(2, fake.requests.size)

    fun noModelLoadedFailsVisiblyWithRealAdapterAndNoCloudFallback() {

        assertFailed(c.run(task()), DevelopmentFailureKind.NO_MODEL)
        assertEquals(0, rt.thinkingCalls)
        assertEquals(0, rt.agentCalls)
    }

    @Test
    fun realAdapterRunsSequentiallyThroughThinkingChannelOnly() {
        val rt = ScriptedRuntime(chain())
        val adapter = LocalModelReasoningAdapter(rt, modelIdProvider = { "fake@1" })
        val c = DevelopmentCoordinator(adapter, rt::cancel)
        val o = c.run(task())
        assertEquals(DevelopmentJobState.COMPLETED, o.state)
        assertEquals(4, rt.thinkingCalls)
        assertEquals(0, rt.agentCalls)
        assertEquals(1, rt.maxActive)
    }

    fun workersCauseNoSideEffectsOnSources() {
        val before = source.copy()
        val h = Harness(Fake(chain()))
        run(h)
        assertEquals(before, source)
        assertEquals("fun greet() = \"hi\"\n", source.content)
    }

    @Test
    fun coordinatorIsSingleUse() {
        val h = Harness(Fake(chain()))
        run(h)
        assertThrows(IllegalStateException::class.java) { run(h) }
    }

    private class ScriptedRuntime(
        private val responses: List<String>,
        override val state: LocalModelState = LocalModelState.READY
    ) : LocalModelRuntime {
        override val loadedModel: ImportedLocalModel? = null
        var thinkingCalls = 0
        var agentCalls = 0
        val active = AtomicInteger()
        var maxActive = 0
        override fun load(id: String, version: String, callback: (Result<ImportedLocalModel>) -> Unit) = error("unused")
        override fun unload(callback: (Result<Unit>) -> Unit) = callback(Result.success(Unit))
        override fun stream(prompt: String, callback: LocalInferenceCallback) { agentCalls++; error("must not be used") }
        override fun streamThinking(prompt: String, callback: LocalInferenceCallback) {
            maxActive = maxOf(maxActive, active.incrementAndGet())
            val text = responses[thinkingCalls++]
            callback.onEvent(LocalInferenceEvent.TextDelta(text))
            callback.onEvent(LocalInferenceEvent.Completed(LocalInferenceMetrics(0, 0, 1, null, null, null, 0)))
            active.decrementAndGet()
        }
        override fun cancel() {}
    }
}

package at.heinz.deviceai.cognitive

import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test

/**
 * DEMONSTRATION WITH A SCRIPTED FAKE MODEL — NOT a benchmark and NOT evidence of real model quality or latency.
 * It only shows that a well-formed fake chain yields a reviewable proposal whose execution status is NOT EXECUTED.
 */
class DevelopmentFakeModelDemonstrationTest {
    @Test
    fun scriptedFakeModelProducesReviewableProposal() {
        val src = SourceSnapshot.of("app/Counter.kt", "fun next(n: Int) = n\n")
        val task = DevelopmentTask("demo-1", "Counter.next should increment", listOf(src))
        val replies = ArrayDeque(listOf(
            """{"summary":"Increment n","edits":[{"path":"app/Counter.kt","expectedBaseSha256":"${src.sha256}","replacement":"fun next(n: Int) = n + 1\n","rationale":"bug"}]}""",
            """{"verdict":"ACCEPT","findings":[{"severity":"INFO","message":"Overflow at Int.MAX_VALUE not handled"}]}""",
            """{"tests":[{"name":"nextIncrements","description":"next(1)==2"}]}""",
            """{"decision":"RECOMMEND","rationale":"Minimal change"}"""
        ))
        val outcome = DevelopmentCoordinator({ ReasoningPassResult("scripted-fake@0", replies.removeFirst(), 0) }, {}).run(task)
        assertEquals(DevelopmentJobState.COMPLETED, outcome.state)
        val text = outcome.proposal!!.render()
        println(text)
        assertTrue(text.contains("+fun next(n: Int) = n + 1"))
        assertTrue(text.contains("Generated tests executed"))
    }
}

package at.heinz.deviceai.cognitive

import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class DevelopmentReviewRegressionTest {
    private val source = SourceSnapshot.of("app/Counter.kt", "fun increment(value: Int): Int = value - 1\n")
    private val replacement = "fun increment(value: Int): Int = value + 1\n"
    private fun task() = DevelopmentTask("counter-test", "Correct increment(1) to return 2", listOf(source))
    private fun developer() = """{"summary":"Fix increment","edits":[{"path":"${source.path}","expectedBaseSha256":"${source.sha256}","replacement":${jsonString(replacement)},"rationale":"Wrong operator"}]}"""
    private val accept = """{"verdict":"ACCEPT","findings":[]}"""
    private val tests = """{"tests":[{"name":"incrementOne","description":"Assert increment(1) == 2; not executed"}]}"""
    private val recommend = """{"decision":"RECOMMEND","rationale":"Reviewed replacement"}"""

    private fun runChain(critic: String = accept, dev: String = developer(), judge: String = recommend): DevelopmentOutcome {
        val responses = ArrayDeque(listOf(dev, critic, tests, judge))
        return DevelopmentCoordinator({ ReasoningPassResult("scripted-fake@1", responses.removeFirst(), 0) }, {}).run(task())
    }

    @Test fun actualReplacementAndTestDescriptionsReachReviewers() {
        val requests = mutableListOf<ReasoningPassRequest>()
        val responses = ArrayDeque(listOf(developer(), accept, tests, recommend))
        val original = source.content
        val result = DevelopmentCoordinator({ request ->
            requests += request
            ReasoningPassResult("scripted-fake@1", responses.removeFirst(), 0)
        }, {}).run(task())
        assertEquals(DevelopmentJobState.COMPLETED, result.state)
        assertEquals(4, requests.size)
        for (request in requests.drop(1)) {
            assertTrue(request.prompt.contains(jsonString(developer())))
            assertTrue(request.prompt.contains(jsonString(source.content)))
        }
        assertTrue(requests.last().prompt.contains(jsonString(tests)))
        assertEquals(original, source.content)
        assertTrue(result.proposal!!.render().contains("NOT EXECUTED"))
    }

    @Test fun recommendationCannotOverrideCriticRejectOrRevise() {
        for (verdict in listOf("REJECT", "REVISE")) {
            val critic = """{"verdict":"$verdict","findings":[]}"""
            val result = runChain(critic)
            assertEquals(DevelopmentJobState.FAILED, result.state)
            assertEquals(DevelopmentFailureKind.POLICY_REJECTED, result.failure!!.kind)
            assertNull(result.proposal)
        }
    }

    @Test fun acceptedVerdictWithBlockerCannotBeRecommended() {
        val critic = """{"verdict":"ACCEPT","findings":[{"severity":"BLOCKER","message":"Still unsafe"}]}"""
        assertEquals(DevelopmentFailureKind.POLICY_REJECTED, runChain(critic).failure!!.kind)
    }

    @Test fun emptyEditsCannotBeRecommended() {
        assertEquals(DevelopmentFailureKind.POLICY_REJECTED,
            runChain(dev = """{"summary":"No changes","edits":[]}""").failure!!.kind)
    }

    @Test fun rejectionCanStillProduceAnExplicitReviewOnlyReport() {
        val result = runChain("""{"verdict":"REJECT","findings":[]}""",
            judge = """{"decision":"REJECT","rationale":"Not suitable"}""")
        assertEquals(DevelopmentJobState.COMPLETED, result.state)
        assertEquals(JudgeDecision.REJECT, result.proposal!!.judge.decision)
    }

    @Test fun cancellationFromStateObserverPreventsFirstModelCall() {
        var calls = 0
        lateinit var coordinator: DevelopmentCoordinator
        coordinator = DevelopmentCoordinator({ calls++; ReasoningPassResult("fake", developer(), 0) }, {})
        val result = coordinator.run(task()) { state ->
            if (state == DevelopmentJobState.RUNNING_DEVELOPER) coordinator.cancel()
        }
        assertEquals(DevelopmentJobState.CANCELLED, result.state)
        assertEquals(0, calls)
    }

    @Test fun monotonicDeadlineSurvivesWallClockRollback() {
        var wall = 1_000L
        var nanos = 0L
        var calls = 0
        val result = DevelopmentCoordinator({
            calls++; wall = 0; nanos = 60_000_000_000L
            ReasoningPassResult("fake", developer(), 0)
        }, {}, { wall }, { nanos }).run(task())
        assertEquals(DevelopmentJobState.TIMED_OUT, result.state)
        assertEquals(1, calls)
    }

    @Test fun mutableSourceListCannotChangeTheActiveSnapshot() {
        val backing = mutableListOf(source)
        val input = DevelopmentTask("mutable-test", "Fix increment", backing)
        val responses = ArrayDeque(listOf(developer(), accept, tests, recommend))
        val result = DevelopmentCoordinator({
            backing.clear()
            ReasoningPassResult("fake", responses.removeFirst(), 0)
        }, {}).run(input)
        assertEquals(DevelopmentJobState.COMPLETED, result.state)
    }

    @Test fun observerExceptionsDoNotLeaveAnUnfinishedJob() {
        val responses = ArrayDeque(listOf(developer(), accept, tests, recommend))
        val result = DevelopmentCoordinator({ ReasoningPassResult("fake", responses.removeFirst(), 0) }, {})
            .run(task()) { throw IllegalStateException("UI detached") }
        assertEquals(DevelopmentJobState.COMPLETED, result.state)
    }

    @Test fun sourceBudgetIsEnforcedDuringSelectionInUtf8Bytes() {
        val controller = DevelopmentUiController { "ui" }
        assertTrue(controller.addSource("A.kt", "ä".repeat(1_999)))
        assertFalse(controller.addSource("B.kt", "abc"))
        assertEquals(1, controller.state.sources.size)
        assertNotNull(controller.state.error)
    }

    @Test fun changingInputsInvalidatesPreviousExport() {
        val controller = DevelopmentUiController { "ui" }
        controller.setGoal("Fix increment")
        controller.addSource(source.path, source.content)
        assertNotNull(controller.start(true))
        controller.onOutcome(runChain())
        assertNotNull(controller.exportText())
        controller.setGoal("Another task")
        assertNull(controller.exportText())
        assertEquals(DevelopmentUiPhase.IDLE, controller.state.phase)
    }
}

package at.heinz.deviceai.cognitive

import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertThrows
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test

class DevelopmentSharedHashTest {
    @Test fun sharedHashMatchesKnownVectors() {
        assertEquals("e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855", sha256Hex(""))
        assertEquals("ba7816bf8f01cfea414140de5dae2223b00361a396177a9cb410ff61f20015ad", sha256Hex("abc"))
    }

    @Test fun developmentSnapshotUsesSharedHashAndRejectsTampering() {
        val snapshot = SourceSnapshot.of("app/Counter.kt", "abc")
        assertEquals(sha256Hex("abc"), snapshot.sha256)
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) {
            SourceSnapshot(snapshot.path, "changed", snapshot.sha256)
        }
    }

    @Test fun identityIntegrityStillUsesTheUnchangedSharedHash() {

        assertEquals(sha256Hex(genome.canonical()), genome.hash())
        val identity = IdentityState.initial(genome)
        assertTrue(identity.verify())

package at.heinz.deviceai.cognitive

import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertNotNull
import org.junit.Assert.assertNull
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test
import java.io.File
import java.nio.file.Files

class DeviceDevelopmentBacklogTest {
    private var now = 1_000_000L

    private fun withBacklog(block: (DeviceDevelopmentBacklog, File) -> Unit) {
        val dir = Files.createTempDirectory("device-backlog").toFile()
        try { block(DeviceDevelopmentBacklog(dir) { now }, dir) } finally { dir.deleteRecursively() }
    }

    private fun task(id: String = "dev-123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000") =
        DevelopmentTask(id, "Fehlerbehandlung im Importdialog verbessern", listOf(SourceSnapshot.of("app/src/main/A.kt", "class A")))

    private fun proposal(taskId: String) = DevelopmentProposal(taskId, "summary", emptyList(), emptyList(),
        CriticResult(CriticVerdict.ACCEPT, emptyList()), emptyList(), JudgeResult(JudgeDecision.RECOMMEND, "ok"),
        setOf("local-model"), 4, "--- preview")

    private fun state(b: DeviceDevelopmentBacklog, id: String) = b.views().single { it.id == id }

    @Test fun completedJobWaitsForTestEvidenceInsteadOfBeingDone() = withBacklog { b, _ ->
        val t = task()
        val token = b.startJob(t)
        assertEquals("IN_PROGRESS", state(b, t.taskId).state)
        now += 30_000
        b.finishJob(t.taskId, token, DevelopmentOutcome(DevelopmentJobState.COMPLETED, proposal(t.taskId), null, 4))
        val view = state(b, t.taskId)
        assertEquals("VERIFYING", view.state)
        val doc = b.read().doc
        @Suppress("UNCHECKED_CAST")
        val submission = ((doc["tasks"] as List<Map<String, Any?>>).single()["submission"] as Map<String, Any?>)["artifact"] as Map<String, Any?>
        assertEquals("PROPOSAL", submission["type"])
        assertEquals(DevelopmentBacklog.sha256Of(proposal(t.taskId).render().toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8)), submission["sha256"])
    }

    @Test fun failedAndCancelledJobsKeepTheirReasonAndBudget() = withBacklog { b, _ ->
        val t = task()
        var token = b.startJob(t)
        b.finishJob(t.taskId, token, DevelopmentOutcome(DevelopmentJobState.FAILED, null,
            DevelopmentFailure(DevelopmentFailureKind.NO_MODEL, "No local model loaded."), 0))
        assertEquals("READY" to "NO_MODEL", state(b, t.taskId).let { it.state to it.errorCode })
        // the same job id claimed again (user retries the same task)
        token = b.apply(listOf(mapOf("op" to "claim", "id" to t.taskId, "owner" to "android-app", "token" to "a".repeat(32), "leaseMs" to 300_000L)))
            .let { "a".repeat(32) }
        b.finishJob(t.taskId, token, DevelopmentOutcome(DevelopmentJobState.CANCELLED, null,
            DevelopmentFailure(DevelopmentFailureKind.MODEL_FAILURE, "Cancelled."), 1))
        val view = state(b, t.taskId)
        assertEquals(listOf("READY", "CANCELLED", "2"), listOf(view.state, view.errorCode, view.attempts.toString()))
    }

    @Test fun jobInterruptedByAppDeathIsRecoveredWhenItsLeaseEnds() = withBacklog { b, dir ->
        val t = task()
        b.startJob(t)
        // the process dies: a new instance on the next app start
        val restarted = DeviceDevelopmentBacklog(dir) { now }
        assertTrue("lease still running", restarted.recover().isEmpty())
        now += DeviceDevelopmentBacklog.JOB_LEASE_MS + 1
        assertEquals(listOf(t.taskId), restarted.recover())
        val view = state(restarted, t.taskId)
        assertEquals("READY" to "LEASE_EXPIRED", view.state to view.errorCode)
        assertTrue("nothing else to recover", restarted.recover().isEmpty())
    }

    @Test fun humanDecisionsUseTheSharedRulesAndReportRejections() = withBacklog { b, _ ->
        b.apply(listOf(mapOf("op" to "propose", "task" to mapOf("id" to "task-review", "title" to "Prüfen", "kind" to "INVESTIGATE", "source" to "android"))))
        val rejectWithoutReason = b.decide("task-review", "reject", null)
        assertFalse(rejectWithoutReason.ok)
        assertEquals("INVALID_FIELD", rejectWithoutReason.code)
        assertTrue(b.decide("task-review", "accept", null).ok)
        val again = b.decide("task-review", "accept", null)
        assertEquals("INVALID_TRANSITION", again.code)
        assertTrue(b.decide("task-review", "abort", "nicht mehr nötig").ok)
        assertEquals("ABORTED", state(b, "task-review").state)
    }

    @Test fun operationLogIsExactlyOnceAndImportRebasesLocalWork() = withBacklog { b, _ ->
        val t = task()
        val token = b.startJob(t)
        b.finishJob(t.taskId, token, DevelopmentOutcome(DevelopmentJobState.COMPLETED, proposal(t.taskId), null, 4))
        b.decide(t.taskId, "accept", null) // rejected (INVALID_TRANSITION): never journaled
        @Suppress("UNCHECKED_CAST")
        val log = at.heinz.deviceai.learning.StrictJson.parse(String(b.exportOperationLog(), Charsets.UTF_8)) as List<Map<String, Any?>>
        assertEquals(listOf("propose", "accept", "claim", "submit"), log.map { it["op"] })
        assertTrue(log.all { (it["opId"] as String).startsWith("android:") })

        // the canonical backlog already applied the first two operations (e.g. via `backlog apply`)
        var canonical: Map<String, Any?> = DevelopmentBacklog.emptyDocument(1L, "continuum-agent")
        canonical = DevelopmentBacklog.applyOps(canonical, log.take(2)).first
        canonical = DevelopmentBacklog.applyOp(canonical, mapOf("op" to "propose", "actor" to "code-analyzer", "at" to 5L,
            "task" to mapOf("id" to "inv-0000000000000001", "title" to "Befund", "kind" to "INVESTIGATE", "source" to "code-analyzer"))).doc
        val result = b.importBacklog(DevelopmentBacklog.encode(canonical))
        assertEquals(2, result.alreadyIncluded)
        assertEquals(2, result.replayed)
        assertTrue(result.rejected.isEmpty())
        assertEquals(setOf(t.taskId, "inv-0000000000000001"), b.views().map { it.id }.toSet())
        assertEquals("VERIFYING", state(b, t.taskId).state)
        @Suppress("UNCHECKED_CAST")
        val remaining = at.heinz.deviceai.learning.StrictJson.parse(String(b.exportOperationLog(), Charsets.UTF_8)) as List<Map<String, Any?>>
        assertEquals("operations the canonical backlog already has leave the log", listOf("claim", "submit"), remaining.map { it["op"] })
        // importing the same file again changes nothing that was already there
        val second = b.importBacklog(DevelopmentBacklog.encode(canonical))
        assertEquals(2, second.replayed)
        assertEquals("VERIFYING", state(b, t.taskId).state)
    }

    @Test fun importRejectsTamperedFilesAndKeepsLocalState() = withBacklog { b, _ ->
        b.startJob(task())
        val before = b.exportBacklog()
        val tampered = String(before, Charsets.UTF_8).replace("Fehlerbehandlung", "Fehlerbehendlung").toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8)
        val code = try { b.importBacklog(tampered); null } catch (e: BacklogException) { e.code }
        assertEquals("INTEGRITY_MISMATCH", code)
        assertTrue(before.contentEquals(b.exportBacklog()))
    }

    @Test fun corruptLocalBacklogIsRecoveredFromBackupAndReported() = withBacklog { b, dir ->
        b.startJob(task())
        b.decide(task().taskId, "abort", "Test")
        val file = File(dir, "development-backlog.json")
        file.writeText("kaputt")
        val change = b.apply(listOf(mapOf("op" to "expire")))
        assertNotNull(change.recovered)
        assertNotNull(change.recovered!!.quarantined)
        assertEquals("kaputt", File(change.recovered!!.quarantined!!).readText())
        assertNull(b.read().recovered)
    }

    @Test fun jobIdsMapToValidBacklogIds() {
        assertEquals("dev-123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000", DeviceDevelopmentBacklog.taskIdOf("dev-123E4567-E89B-12D3-A456-426614174000"))
        val hashed = DeviceDevelopmentBacklog.taskIdOf("Job #1 with spaces")
        assertTrue(hashed.startsWith("dev-") && hashed.length == 36)
    }
}

package at.heinz.deviceai.cognitive

import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test
import java.util.Locale

/** Evidence replay must not turn one successful attempt into a learned skill. */
class ExperienceEvidenceRegressionTest {
    private fun experience(id: String, success: Boolean = true) = Experience(
        id = id, taskType = "DEVICE-INFO", requestSummary = "Check device health",
        toolIds = listOf("get_device_info"), outcome = if (success) ExperienceOutcome.SUCCESS else ExperienceOutcome.FAILURE,
        startedAt = 100, completedAt = 200, evaluation = Evaluation(success, if (success) 0.95 else 0.1)
    )

    @Test fun replayedSuccessCannotMeetOccurrenceThreshold() {
        val one = experience("one")
        assertTrue(ExperienceCompiler().compile(List(3) { one }).isEmpty())
    }

    @Test fun replayDoesNotInflateSuccessRateOrMeanScore() {
        val one = experience("one")
        val evidence = List(20) { one } + listOf(experience("two", false), experience("three", false))
        assertTrue(ExperienceCompiler().compile(evidence).isEmpty())
    }

    @Test fun conflictingIdentityFailsClosedBeforeEligibilityFiltering() {
        val one = experience("one")
        val conflicting = one.copy(toolIds = listOf("unregistered_tool"), resultSummary = "altered")
        assertThrows(SecurityException::class.java) {
            ExperienceCompiler().compile(listOf(one, experience("two"), experience("three"), conflicting))
        }
    }

    @Test fun uniqueExperiencesRemainEligibleButAlwaysRequireOwnerReview() {
        val records = (1..3).map { experience("e$it") }
        val candidate = ExperienceCompiler().compile(records + records).single()
        assertEquals(3, candidate.occurrenceCount)
        assertEquals(listOf("e1", "e2", "e3"), candidate.sourceExperienceIds)
        assertTrue(candidate.eligibleForOwnerReview)
        assertTrue(candidate.requiresOwnerApproval)
    }

    @Test fun candidateCannotDisableOwnerApproval() {
        val candidate = ExperienceCompiler().compile((1..3).map { experience("e$it") }).single()
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { candidate.copy(requiresOwnerApproval = false) }
    }

    @Test fun candidateCannotCarryDuplicatedEvidenceIds() {
        val candidate = ExperienceCompiler().compile((1..3).map { experience("e$it") }).single()
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) {
            candidate.copy(sourceExperienceIds = listOf("e1", "e1", "e1"))
        }
    }

    @Test fun candidateIdentityDoesNotDependOnDeviceLocale() {
        val before = Locale.getDefault()
        val records = (1..3).map { experience("e$it") }
        try {
            Locale.setDefault(Locale.US)
            val expected = ExperienceCompiler().compile(records).single().candidateId
            Locale.setDefault(Locale.forLanguageTag("tr-TR"))
            assertEquals(expected, ExperienceCompiler().compile(records).single().candidateId)
        } finally { Locale.setDefault(before) }
    }

    @Test fun destructiveSequenceRemainsBlocked() {
        val records = (1..3).map { experience("e$it").copy(toolIds = listOf("delete_file")) }
        val candidate = ExperienceCompiler().compile(records).single()
        assertFalse(candidate.eligibleForOwnerReview)
        assertTrue(candidate.requiresOwnerApproval)
        assertNotNull(candidate.promotionBlockedReason)
    }
}

package at.heinz.deviceai.cognitive

import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class GeneralWebDiscoveryProviderTest {
    private class Fallback : ResearchDiscoveryProvider {
        var calls = 0
        override val isGeneralSearchAvailable = false
        override fun discover(query: ResearchQuery): List<ResearchSourceCandidate> {
            calls++
            return listOf(ResearchSourceCandidate("https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/Test", "Test"))
        }
    }

    @Test fun parsesPublicSearchResultAndDoesNotUseFallback() {
        val fallback = Fallback()
        val provider = GeneralWebDiscoveryProvider(fallback) {
            """<rss><channel><item><title>NASA</title><link>https://www.nasa.gov/science/</link></item></channel></rss>"""
        }
        val results = provider.discover(ResearchQuery("space", "q0"))
        assertEquals("https://www.nasa.gov/science/", results.first().url)
        assertEquals(1, results.size)
        assertEquals(0, fallback.calls)
        assertTrue(provider.isGeneralSearchAvailable)
    }

    @Test fun fallsBackOnSearchFailure() {
        val fallback = Fallback()
        val provider = GeneralWebDiscoveryProvider(fallback) { error("Search provider unavailable") }
        assertEquals(1, provider.discover(ResearchQuery("space", "q0")).size)
        assertEquals(1, fallback.calls)
    }

    @Test fun rejectsLocalHostsAndNonHttpsResults() {
        val html = """<a class="result__a" href="https://localhost/admin">Local</a><a class="result__a" href="http://public.org/">HTTP</a><a class="result__a" href="https://router.local/">Local</a><a class="result__a" href="https://example.org:8443/">Port</a>"""
        assertTrue(GeneralWebDiscoveryProvider.parseSearchResults(html).isEmpty())
    }
    @Test fun doesNotExtractUrlsFromPlainTextOrScripts() {
        val html = """<script>const tracking = "https://www.example.net/tracker"</script><p>https://www.example.com</p>"""
        assertTrue(GeneralWebDiscoveryProvider.parseSearchResults(html).isEmpty())
    }

    @Test fun rssRejectsExternalEntitiesAndProviderNavigationLinks() {
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) {
            GeneralWebDiscoveryProvider.parseSearchResults("""<!DOCTYPE rss [<!ENTITY x SYSTEM "file:///etc/passwd">]><rss><channel/></rss>""")
        }
        val xml="""<rss><channel><link>https://www.bing.com/search</link><item><title>Nav</title><link>https://www.bing.com/search?q=secret</link></item><item><title>Local</title><link>https://127.0.0.1/</link></item></channel></rss>"""
        assertTrue(GeneralWebDiscoveryProvider.parseSearchResults(xml).isEmpty())
    }

    @Test fun fallbackFailureIsVisibleAndRevocationStopsBothProviders() {
        val fallback=Fallback()
        val provider=GeneralWebDiscoveryProvider(fallback,checkAccess={error("revoked")},fetchHtml={error("must not fetch")})
        assertThrows(IllegalStateException::class.java) { provider.discover(ResearchQuery("topic","q")) }
        assertEquals(0,fallback.calls)
        val broken=GeneralWebDiscoveryProvider(object:ResearchDiscoveryProvider {
            override val isGeneralSearchAvailable=false
            override fun discover(query:ResearchQuery):List<ResearchSourceCandidate> = error("down")
        },fetchHtml={error("down")})
        assertTrue(broken.discover(ResearchQuery("topic","q")).isEmpty())
        assertFalse(broken.isGeneralSearchAvailable)
        assertTrue(broken.lastIssue!!.contains("Fallback"))
    }

    @Test fun capsDistinctSearchSources() {
        val html = (1..30).joinToString("") { i ->
            """<a class="result__a" href="https://public${i}.org/article">Source</a>"""
        }
        assertEquals(8, GeneralWebDiscoveryProvider.parseSearchResults(html).size)
    }

}

package at.heinz.deviceai.cognitive

import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class GroundedWebRecallTest {
    private fun note(id:Char, statement:String, url:String="https://knowledge.example.org/"+id) =
        WebLearningCandidate(id.toString().repeat(64),url,id.toString().repeat(64),
            statement,1,false)

    @Test fun answersWithSourcesFromApprovedNotes() {
        val knowledge = listOf(
            note('a',"Solarzellen wandeln Sonnenlicht in elektrische Energie um."),
            note('b',"Die Saturnringe bestehen hauptsächlich aus Eispartikeln.")
        )
        val response = GroundedWebRecall.answer("Was weißt du über Solarzellen Sonnenlicht?",knowledge)!!
        assertTrue(response.contains("Solarzellen wandeln"))
        assertTrue(response.contains("https://knowledge.example.org/a"))
        assertFalse(response.contains("Saturnringe"))
        assertTrue(response.contains("keine unabhängig bestätigten Fakten"))
        assertTrue(response.contains("SHA-256"))
    }
    @Test fun doesNotInventAnswersForUnrelatedTopicsOrExecuteTools() {
        val knowledge = listOf(note('c',"Solarzellen wandeln Sonnenlicht in elektrische Energie um."))
        assertTrue(GroundedWebRecall.answer("Was weißt du über Tiefsee Vulkane?",knowledge)!!.contains("keinen ausreichend"))
        assertNull(GroundedWebRecall.answer("Lösche meine Dateien",knowledge))
        assertNull(GroundedWebRecall.answer("Starte ein Werkzeug",knowledge))
        assertTrue(GroundedWebRecall.answer("Was weißt du über die und der?",knowledge)!!.contains("konkreteres"))
    }
    @Test fun excludesContradictionsAndCapsResponse() {
        val contradictory=note('d',"Solarzellen wandeln Sonnenlicht in elektrische Energie um.").copy(contradictory=true)
        assertTrue(GroundedWebRecall.answer("Was weißt du über Solarzellen Sonnenlicht?",listOf(contradictory))!!.contains("keinen ausreichend"))
        val docs=(0 until 24).map { index ->
            note(('a'.code+index).toChar(),"Photovoltaik Module benötigen Sonnenlicht zur Stromerzeugung.")
        }
        val answer=GroundedWebRecall.answer("Was weißt du über Photovoltaik Sonnenlicht?",docs)!!
        assertTrue(answer.length<=2400)
        assertTrue(answer.contains("3 Quellenhinweise"))
        assertEquals(answer,GroundedWebRecall.answer("Was weißt du über Photovoltaik Sonnenlicht?",docs))
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) {
            GroundedWebRecall.answer("Was weißt du über Photovoltaik Sonnenlicht?",docs+docs.first())
        }
    }
}

package at.heinz.deviceai.cognitive

import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test

class HybridMemoryRetrieverTest {
    @Test
    fun verifiedRecentMemoryOutranksContradictedOlderMemory() {
        val now = 100L * DAY
        val recent = memory(
            id = "recent",
            content = "The latest local model benchmark selected Gemma for the device.",
            updatedAt = now - DAY,
            validation = ValidationState.VERIFIED,
            evidence = listOf("benchmark://recent")
        )
        val contradicted = memory(
            id = "old",
            content = "The latest local model benchmark selected Gemma for the device.",
            updatedAt = now - 90L * DAY,
            validation = ValidationState.CONTRADICTED
        )

        val results = HybridMemoryRetriever.retrieve(
            query = "latest local model benchmark",
            records = listOf(contradicted, recent),
            nowMillis = now
        )

        assertEquals(listOf("recent", "old"), results.map { it.memory.id })
        assertTrue(results.first().score.total > results.last().score.total)
        assertTrue(results.last().score.contradictionPenalty > 0.0)
    }

    @Test
    fun privacyFilterIsEnforcedBeforeScoring() {
        val now = 10L * DAY
        val privateMemory = memory(
            id = "private",
            content = "My preferred Android model is Gemma.",
            updatedAt = now,
            privacy = PrivacyClass.PRIVATE
        )
        val publicMemory = memory(
            id = "public",
            content = "Android model documentation mentions Gemma.",
            updatedAt = now,
            privacy = PrivacyClass.PUBLIC
        )

        val results = HybridMemoryRetriever.retrieve(
            query = "Android Gemma model",
            records = listOf(privateMemory, publicMemory),
            nowMillis = now,
            allowedPrivacy = setOf(PrivacyClass.PUBLIC)
        )

        assertEquals(listOf("public"), results.map { it.memory.id })
    }

    @Test
    fun optionalSemanticScoreCanRecoverAConceptWithoutLexicalOverlap() {
        val now = 20L * DAY
        val memory = memory(
            id = "semantic",
            content = "The handset becomes warm during sustained inference.",
            updatedAt = now
        )

        val lexicalOnly = HybridMemoryRetriever.retrieve(
            query = "thermal throttling",
            records = listOf(memory),
            nowMillis = now
        )
        assertTrue(lexicalOnly.isEmpty())

        val semantic = HybridMemoryRetriever.retrieve(
            query = "thermal throttling",
            records = listOf(memory),
            nowMillis = now,
            semanticScorer = { _, candidate -> if (candidate.id == "semantic") 0.9 else 0.0 }
        )

        assertEquals("semantic", semantic.single().memory.id)
        assertEquals(0.9, semantic.single().score.semanticSimilarity, 0.0001)
    }

    private fun memory(
        id: String,
        content: String,
        updatedAt: Long,
        validation: ValidationState = ValidationState.UNVERIFIED,
        evidence: List<String> = emptyList(),
        privacy: PrivacyClass = PrivacyClass.PRIVATE
    ) = MemoryRecord(
        id = id,
        type = MemoryType.SEMANTIC,
        content = content,
        provenance = ProvenanceType.USER_PROVIDED,
        confidence = 0.9,
        createdAt = updatedAt,
        updatedAt = updatedAt,
        tags = listOf("android", "model"),
        validationState = validation,
        privacyClass = privacy,
        validationEvidenceReferences = evidence
    )

    companion object {
        private const val DAY = 86_400_000L
    }
}

class IdentityStateTest {

        assertFalse(policy.approve("Welche Quellen gibt es?"))

        assertFalse(gate.authorize("different"))
        assertFalse(gate.authorize("question"))
        assertTrue(consent.request("question"))
        assertTrue(gate.authorize("question"))
        assertFalse(gate.authorize("question"))
    }

        consent.setMode(InternetAccessMode.OFF)
        assertFalse(gate.authorize("topic"))

package at.heinz.deviceai.cognitive

import at.heinz.deviceai.localmodel.ImportedLocalModel
import at.heinz.deviceai.localmodel.LocalInferenceCallback
import at.heinz.deviceai.localmodel.LocalInferenceEvent
import at.heinz.deviceai.localmodel.LocalInferenceMetrics
import at.heinz.deviceai.localmodel.LocalModelRuntime
import at.heinz.deviceai.localmodel.LocalModelState
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertThrows
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test

class LocalModelReasoningAdapterTest {
    private fun request(prompt: String = "hello", deadlineIn: Long = 5_000) = ReasoningPassRequest(
        taskId = "t1",
        role = ReasoningPassRole.CANDIDATE,
        prompt = prompt,
        maxOutputChars = 1_000,
        deadlineMillis = System.currentTimeMillis() + deadlineIn
    )

    private fun adapter(rt: FakeRuntime) = LocalModelReasoningAdapter(rt, modelIdProvider = { "fake@1" })

    @Test
    fun returnsTextFromRuntime() {
        val rt = FakeRuntime { cb ->
            cb.onEvent(LocalInferenceEvent.TextDelta("answer"))
            cb.onEvent(completed())
        }
        val result = adapter(rt).execute(request())
        assertEquals("answer", result.text)
        assertEquals("fake@1", result.modelId)
        assertTrue(rt.thinkingUsed)
        assertFalse(rt.agentConversationUsed)
    }

    @Test
    fun toolProposalFailsClosedAndCancels() {
        val rt = FakeRuntime { cb ->
            cb.onEvent(LocalInferenceEvent.ToolProposalRejected("delete_file", "x"))
        }
        assertThrows(SecurityException::class.java) { adapter(rt).execute(request()) }
        assertTrue(rt.cancelled)
    }

    @Test
    fun outputOverflowIsRejected() {
        val rt = FakeRuntime { cb -> cb.onEvent(LocalInferenceEvent.TextDelta("x".repeat(1_001))) }
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { adapter(rt).execute(request()) }
        assertTrue(rt.cancelled)
    }

    @Test
    fun oversizedPromptIsNotClipped() {
        val rt = FakeRuntime { }
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) {
            adapter(rt).execute(request("p".repeat(16_001)))
        }
        assertFalse(rt.thinkingUsed)
    }

    @Test
    fun deadlineExpiryCancelsRuntime() {
        val rt = FakeRuntime { }
        assertThrows(IllegalStateException::class.java) {
            adapter(rt).execute(request(deadlineIn = 60))
        }
        assertTrue(rt.cancelled)
    }

    @Test
    fun missingModelFailsWithoutFallback() {
        val rt = FakeRuntime { }
        assertThrows(IllegalStateException::class.java) {
            LocalModelReasoningAdapter(rt, modelIdProvider = { null }).execute(request())
        }
        assertFalse(rt.thinkingUsed)
    }

    private fun completed() = LocalInferenceEvent.Completed(
        LocalInferenceMetrics(0, 0, 1, null, null, null, 0)
    )

    private class FakeRuntime(private val behavior: (LocalInferenceCallback) -> Unit) : LocalModelRuntime {
        override val state = LocalModelState.READY
        override val loadedModel: ImportedLocalModel? = null
        var cancelled = false
        var thinkingUsed = false
        var agentConversationUsed = false
        override fun load(id: String, version: String, callback: (Result<ImportedLocalModel>) -> Unit) = error("unused")
        override fun unload(callback: (Result<Unit>) -> Unit) = callback(Result.success(Unit))
        override fun stream(prompt: String, callback: LocalInferenceCallback) {
            agentConversationUsed = true
            error("Reasoning workers must not use the agent conversation.")
        }
        override fun streamThinking(prompt: String, callback: LocalInferenceCallback) {
            thinkingUsed = true
            behavior(callback)
        }
        override fun cancel() { cancelled = true }
    }
}

package at.heinz.deviceai.cognitive

import at.heinz.deviceai.localmodel.ImportedLocalModel
import at.heinz.deviceai.localmodel.LocalInferenceCallback
import at.heinz.deviceai.localmodel.LocalInferenceEvent
import at.heinz.deviceai.localmodel.LocalInferenceMetrics
import at.heinz.deviceai.localmodel.LocalModelRuntime
import at.heinz.deviceai.localmodel.LocalModelState
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test
import java.util.concurrent.CountDownLatch
import java.util.concurrent.Executors
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit

/** Real adapter/coordinator boundaries; scripted runtime events are not a model-quality benchmark. */
class LocalReasoningBoundaryRegressionTest {
    private fun request(deadline: Long = 2_000) = ReasoningPassRequest(
        "boundary", ReasoningPassRole.CANDIDATE, "Review this source", 1_000, deadline
    )

    @Test fun expiredReadyRequestNeverStartsInference() {
        val runtime = Runtime { it.onEvent(LocalInferenceEvent.TextDelta("answer")); it.onEvent(completed()) }
        val adapter = LocalModelReasoningAdapter(runtime, { 2_000 }, { "model@1" })
        assertThrows(IllegalStateException::class.java) { adapter.execute(request()) }
        assertEquals(0, runtime.starts)
    }

    @Test fun interruptedReadyThreadNeverStartsInference() {
        val runtime = Runtime { it.onEvent(LocalInferenceEvent.TextDelta("answer")); it.onEvent(completed()) }
        val adapter = LocalModelReasoningAdapter(runtime, { 1_000 }, { "model@1" })
        try {
            Thread.currentThread().interrupt()
            assertThrows(java.util.concurrent.CancellationException::class.java) { adapter.execute(request()) }
            assertEquals(0, runtime.starts)
            assertTrue(Thread.currentThread().isInterrupted)
        } finally { Thread.interrupted() }
    }

    @Test fun changedModelIdentityInvalidatesOutput() {
        var model = "model@1"
        val runtime = Runtime { callback ->
            model = "other-model@2"
            callback.onEvent(LocalInferenceEvent.TextDelta("answer"))
            callback.onEvent(completed())
        }
        val adapter = LocalModelReasoningAdapter(runtime, { 1_000 }, { model })
        assertThrows(IllegalStateException::class.java) { adapter.execute(request()) }
        assertTrue(runtime.cancelled)
    }

    @Test fun toolsAfterCompletionStillInvalidatePass() {
        val runtime = Runtime { callback ->
            callback.onEvent(LocalInferenceEvent.TextDelta("answer"))
            callback.onEvent(completed())
            callback.onEvent(LocalInferenceEvent.ToolProposalRejected("delete_file", "late tool"))
        }
        val adapter = LocalModelReasoningAdapter(runtime, { 1_000 }, { "model@1" })
        assertThrows(SecurityException::class.java) { adapter.execute(request()) }
        assertTrue(runtime.cancelled)
    }

    @Test fun stopReleasesDevelopmentWorkerWithoutRuntimeTerminalEvent() {
        val started = CountDownLatch(1)
        val runtime = Runtime { started.countDown() } // Intentionally never emits Completed/Cancelled.
        val adapter = LocalModelReasoningAdapter(runtime, modelIdProvider = { "model@1" })
        val coordinator = DevelopmentCoordinator(adapter, runtime::cancel)
        val executor = Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor()
        val job = executor.submit<DevelopmentOutcome> {
            coordinator.run(DevelopmentTask("stop", "Review increment", listOf(
                SourceSnapshot.of("Counter.kt", "fun increment(n: Int) = n - 1")
            ), DevelopmentLimits(maxDurationMillis = 3_000)))
        }
        try {
            assertTrue(started.await(1, TimeUnit.SECONDS))
            coordinator.cancel()
            val outcome = job.get(500, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS)
            assertEquals(DevelopmentJobState.CANCELLED, outcome.state)
            assertNull(outcome.proposal)
            assertEquals(1, runtime.starts)
            assertTrue(runtime.cancelled)
        } finally {
            job.cancel(true)
            executor.shutdownNow()
            assertTrue(executor.awaitTermination(1, TimeUnit.SECONDS))
        }
    }

    @Test fun unchangedModelProducesDataOnlyResult() {
        val runtime = Runtime { callback ->
            callback.onEvent(LocalInferenceEvent.TextDelta("answer"))
            callback.onEvent(completed())
        }
        val result = LocalModelReasoningAdapter(runtime, { 1_000 }, { "model@1" }).execute(request())
        assertEquals("answer", result.text)
        assertEquals("model@1", result.modelId)
        assertEquals(1, runtime.starts)
        assertFalse(runtime.cancelled)
    }

    private fun completed() = LocalInferenceEvent.Completed(LocalInferenceMetrics(0, 0, 1, null, null, null, 0))

    private class Runtime(val behavior: (LocalInferenceCallback) -> Unit) : LocalModelRuntime {
        override val state = LocalModelState.READY
        override val loadedModel: ImportedLocalModel? = null
        @Volatile var starts = 0
        @Volatile var cancelled = false
        override fun load(id: String, version: String, callback: (Result<ImportedLocalModel>) -> Unit) = error("unused")
        override fun unload(callback: (Result<Unit>) -> Unit) = error("unused")
        override fun stream(prompt: String, callback: LocalInferenceCallback) = error("No chat/tool channel allowed")
        override fun streamThinking(prompt: String, callback: LocalInferenceCallback) {
            starts++
            behavior(callback)
        }
        override fun cancel() { cancelled = true }
    }
}

class MemoryEcologyTest {
    @Test fun memoryValidationStoreRetrievalAndGraphAreDeterministic() {
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) {
            memory("bad", provenance = ProvenanceType.MODEL_GENERATED, validation = ValidationState.VERIFIED)
        }
        assertEquals(
            ValidationState.VERIFIED,
            memory("validated", provenance = ProvenanceType.MODEL_GENERATED)
                .validated(ValidationState.VERIFIED, listOf("independent-source")).validationState
        )
        val store = InMemoryMemoryStore()
        store.put(memory("z", content = "Android device battery"))
        store.put(memory("a", content = "Android device usage"))
        store.put(memory("private", content = "Android account", privacy = PrivacyClass.SENSITIVE))
        assertEquals(
            listOf("a", "z", "private"),
            MemoryRetriever.retrieve("android device", store.all()).map { it.id }
        )
        assertEquals(
            listOf("a", "z"),
            MemoryRetriever.retrieve(
                "android device", store.all(), allowedPrivacy = setOf(PrivacyClass.PRIVATE)
            ).map { it.id }
        )
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { store.put(memory("a")) }
        val graph = MemoryGraph()
        graph.add("a", "z", MemoryRelation.DERIVED_FROM)
        graph.add("a", "z", MemoryRelation.SUPPORTS)
        assertEquals(2, graph.related("a").size)
    }

    @Test fun provenanceAndValidationStateArePreserved() {
        val record = memory(
            "observed", provenance = ProvenanceType.DEVICE_OBSERVATION,
            validation = ValidationState.CORROBORATED
        )
        val store = InMemoryMemoryStore()
        store.put(record)
        assertEquals(ProvenanceType.DEVICE_OBSERVATION, store.get("observed")!!.provenance)
        assertEquals(ValidationState.CORROBORATED, store.get("observed")!!.validationState)
    }

    @Test fun writePolicyAvoidsEphemeralMemoryAndPreservesPrivateClasses() {
        val policy = MemoryWritePolicy()
        assertFalse(policy.decide(MemoryWriteContext(MemoryType.EPISODIC, ProvenanceType.USER_PROVIDED, 1.0)).shouldWrite)
        val user = policy.decide(
            MemoryWriteContext(
                MemoryType.SEMANTIC, ProvenanceType.USER_PROVIDED, 0.9,
                explicitlyRequested = true, containsPersonalInformation = true
            )
        )
        assertTrue(user.shouldWrite)
        assertEquals(PrivacyClass.PRIVATE, user.privacyClass)
        assertEquals(
            PrivacyClass.PRIVATE,
            policy.decide(
                MemoryWriteContext(MemoryType.SEMANTIC, ProvenanceType.USER_PROVIDED, 0.9, explicitlyRequested = true)
            ).privacyClass
        )
        val device = policy.decide(
            MemoryWriteContext(
                MemoryType.SEMANTIC, ProvenanceType.DEVICE_OBSERVATION, 1.0,
                durableKnowledge = true, containsDeviceInformation = true
            )
        )
        assertEquals(PrivacyClass.DEVICE_LOCAL_ONLY, device.privacyClass)
        assertEquals(
            PrivacyClass.DEVICE_LOCAL_ONLY,
            policy.decide(
                MemoryWriteContext(MemoryType.SELF, ProvenanceType.DEVICE_OBSERVATION, 0.9, durableKnowledge = true)
            ).privacyClass
        )
        assertFalse(
            policy.decide(
                MemoryWriteContext(MemoryType.SEMANTIC, ProvenanceType.MODEL_GENERATED, 0.2, durableKnowledge = true)
            ).shouldWrite
        )
    }

    @Test fun modelReputationUpdatesGraduallyOnlyAfterEvaluation() {

        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) {
            reputation.updateAfterEvaluation(

                ReputationEvidence(false, true, 1.0, latencyMillis = 20)
            )
        }
        val next = reputation.updateAfterEvaluation(
            "m", ModelCapability.CODING, "code",

        )
        assertEquals(0.55, next.successRate, 0.0001)
        assertEquals(0.55, next.evaluatorScore, 0.0001)
        assertEquals(1, next.taskCount)
        assertEquals(0.5, reputation.get("m", ModelCapability.CODING, "other-domain").evaluatorScore, 0.0)
    }

    @Test fun routerExplainsChoiceAndSelfModelInfluencesStrategy() {
        val adapters = listOf(
            MockModelAdapter("a", setOf(ModelCapability.CODING), "a"),
            MockModelAdapter("b", setOf(ModelCapability.CODING), "b")
        )
        val task = TaskDescriptor("coding", "implement a parser", ModelCapability.CODING, "code")
        val router = ModelRouter()
        val uncertain = router.route(task, SelfModel.uncertain(), adapters, ModelReputationStore())
        assertEquals(RoutingStrategy.ENSEMBLE, uncertain.strategy)
        assertEquals(2, uncertain.selectedModelIds.size)
        assertTrue(uncertain.reasons.any { it.contains("Self-model") })
        assertTrue(uncertain.evidence.isNotEmpty())

        var self = SelfModel.uncertain()
        repeat(10) { index ->
            self = self.withEvidence(
                CapabilityEvidence("task-$index", Capability.CODING, 1.0, 1.0, "test", index.toLong()),
                rate = 1.0
            )
        }
        val confident = router.route(task, self, adapters, ModelReputationStore())
        assertEquals(RoutingStrategy.SINGLE_MODEL, confident.strategy)
        assertEquals(1, confident.selectedModelIds.size)

        val three = adapters + MockModelAdapter("c", setOf(ModelCapability.CODING), "c")
        for (strategy in listOf(RoutingStrategy.DEBATE, RoutingStrategy.SPECIALIST_PIPELINE, RoutingStrategy.DYNAMIC_TEAM)) {
            assertEquals(
                strategy,
                router.route(task.copy(preferredStrategy = strategy), self, three, ModelReputationStore()).strategy
            )
        }
        val constrained = router.route(
            task.copy(preferredStrategy = RoutingStrategy.ENSEMBLE),
            SelfModel.uncertain(), three, ModelReputationStore(), ResourceConstraints(maxModels = 1)
        )
        assertEquals(RoutingStrategy.SINGLE_MODEL, constrained.strategy)
        assertEquals(1, constrained.selectedModelIds.size)
    }

    @Test fun sourceTrustIsGradualAndDomainAware() {
        val store = SourceTrustStore(0.1)
        val source = SourceIdentity("publisher", "science")
        assertEquals(0.5, store.get(source).historicalAccuracy, 0.0)
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) {
            store.observe(SourceObservation(source, false, 1.0, 1.0))
        }
        val updated = store.observe(SourceObservation(source, true, 1.0, 0.8, corroborated = true))
        assertEquals(0.55, updated.historicalAccuracy, 0.0001)

        assertEquals(0.1, updated.confidence, 0.0001)
        assertEquals(0.5, store.get(SourceIdentity("publisher", "finance")).historicalAccuracy, 0.0)
    }

    @Test fun claimsKeepEvidenceAndRelationsExplicit() {
        val generated = Claim("c1", "a generated claim", ProvenanceType.MODEL_GENERATED, createdAt = 1)
        assertEquals(ValidationState.UNVERIFIED, generated.validationState)
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) {
            generated.validated(ValidationState.VERIFIED, emptyList())
        }
        assertEquals(
            listOf("independent-source"),
            generated.validated(ValidationState.VERIFIED, listOf("independent-source")).sourceReferences
        )
        val graph = ClaimGraph()
        graph.add("c2", "c1", ClaimRelation.SUPPORTS)
        graph.add("c3", "c1", ClaimRelation.CONTRADICTS)
        graph.add("c4", "c1", ClaimRelation.SUPERSEDES)
        assertEquals(3, graph.relations("c1").size)
    }

    @Test fun contentHashIsNotAnIdentitySignature() {
        val content = "identity payload".toByteArray()
        assertEquals(contentHash("identity payload"), contentHash("identity payload"))
        assertNotEquals(contentHash("identity payload"), contentHash("different"))
        val signer = TestIdentitySigner(byteArrayOf(1, 2, 3))
        val signature = signer.sign(content)
        assertTrue(signer.verify(content, signature))
        assertFalse(signer.verify("changed".toByteArray(), signature))
        assertNotEquals(contentHash("identity payload"), signature.joinToString("") { "%02x".format(it) })
    }

    private fun memory(
        id: String,
        content: String = "memory content",
        provenance: ProvenanceType = ProvenanceType.USER_PROVIDED,
        validation: ValidationState = ValidationState.UNVERIFIED,
        privacy: PrivacyClass = PrivacyClass.PRIVATE
    ) = MemoryRecord(id, MemoryType.SEMANTIC, content, provenance, 0.8, 1, 2, privacyClass = privacy, validationState = validation)

    private fun experience(id: String, request: String) = Experience(
        id = id, taskType = "debugging", requestSummary = request, startedAt = 1, completedAt = 2,
        evaluation = Evaluation(true, 0.8)
    )
}

private class TestIdentitySigner(private val key: ByteArray) : IdentitySigner {
    override fun sign(payload: ByteArray): ByteArray = mac(payload)
    override fun verify(payload: ByteArray, signature: ByteArray): Boolean =
        java.security.MessageDigest.isEqual(sign(payload), signature)

    private fun mac(payload: ByteArray): ByteArray =
        Mac.getInstance("HmacSHA256").run {
            init(SecretKeySpec(key, "HmacSHA256"))
            doFinal(payload)
        }
}

package at.heinz.deviceai.cognitive

import java.net.InetAddress
import java.net.Proxy
import java.net.URI
import okhttp3.Authenticator
import okhttp3.CookieJar
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class PinnedResearchHttpsConnectionTest {
    @Test fun routesUseOnlyPrevalidatedAddressesWithoutReresolvingOrSharingConnections() {
        val ip=InetAddress.getByName("8.8.8.8")
        val addresses=mutableListOf(ip)
        val connection=PinnedResearchHttpsConnection(URI("https://www.nasa.gov/"),addresses,1000)
        connection.connectTimeout=500;connection.readTimeout=500
        addresses.clear()
        val client=connection.client()
        assertEquals(listOf(ip),client.dns.lookup("www.nasa.gov"))
        assertThrows(IllegalStateException::class.java) { client.dns.lookup("private.example.org") }
        assertEquals(Proxy.NO_PROXY,client.proxy)
        assertFalse(client.followRedirects);assertFalse(client.followSslRedirects)
        assertFalse(client.retryOnConnectionFailure)
        assertSame(CookieJar.NO_COOKIES,client.cookieJar)
        assertSame(Authenticator.NONE,client.authenticator)
        assertNull(client.cache)
        connection.disconnect()
        assertThrows(IllegalStateException::class.java) { client.dns.lookup("www.nasa.gov") }
        assertThrows(IllegalStateException::class.java) { connection.connect() }
    }
}

package at.heinz.deviceai.cognitive

class ResearchEngineTest {
    @Test
    fun modeBudgetsAreHardBoundedAndDeepPlanIncludesCounterEvidence() {
        val quick = ResearchBudgetPolicy.forMode(ResearchMode.QUICK)
        val standard = ResearchBudgetPolicy.forMode(ResearchMode.STANDARD)
        val deep = ResearchBudgetPolicy.forMode(ResearchMode.DEEP)
        assertTrue(quick.maxSourcesFetched < standard.maxSourcesFetched)
        assertTrue(standard.maxSourcesFetched < deep.maxSourcesFetched)
        assertTrue(quick.totalDeadlineMillis < deep.totalDeadlineMillis)
        assertTrue(runCatching { quick.copy(maxSourcesFetched = 25) }.isFailure)

        val plan = DeterministicResearchPlanner().plan("Battery life and repairability?", ResearchMode.DEEP)
        assertTrue(plan.questions.size <= 8)
        assertTrue(plan.paths.size <= plan.budget.maxDiscoveryQueries)
        assertTrue(plan.paths.any { it.query.counterEvidence })
    }

    @Test
    fun canonicalUrlsDropTrackingAndDeduplicateBeforeFetch() {
        val one = ResearchUrlCanonicalizer.canonicalize("HTTPS://News.Example.org:443/a/../story?utm_source=x&b=2#top")
        val two = ResearchUrlCanonicalizer.canonicalize("https://news.example.org/story?b=2")

    }

    @Test
    fun mirrorContentDoesNotCountAsIndependentCorroboration() {

        val second = document("https://beta.example.org/b", "beta.example.org", content, 2)

    @Test
    fun unsupportedFirstWaveRunsBoundedFollowUpAndPreservesContradictions() {
        val positive = document(
            "https://one.example.org/a", "one.example.org",
            "The phone supports wireless charging and lasts ten hours.", 1
        )
        val negative = document(
            "https://two.example.org/b", "two.example.org",
            "The phone does not support wireless charging and lasts ten hours.", 2
        )
        val follow = document(
            "https://three.example.org/c", "three.example.org",
            "Wireless charging is not supported by this phone according to its manual.", 3
        )
        val docs = listOf(positive, negative, follow).associateBy { it.url }
        val provider = object : ResearchProvider {
            override fun retrieve(request: ResearchRequest): ResearchResult {
                val doc = docs[request.url] ?: error("Unknown source")
                return ResearchResult(listOf(doc), listOf(doc.citation()))
            }
        }
        var discoveryCalls = 0
        val discovery = object : ResearchDiscoveryProvider {
            override val isGeneralSearchAvailable = true
            override fun discover(query: ResearchQuery): List<ResearchSourceCandidate> {
                discoveryCalls++
                return if (query.text.startsWith("Find counter-evidence")) {
                    listOf(ResearchSourceCandidate(follow.url))
                } else listOf(ResearchSourceCandidate(positive.url), ResearchSourceCandidate(negative.url))
            }
        }
        val plan = DeterministicResearchPlanner().plan("wireless charging support", ResearchMode.STANDARD)
        val engine = DeepResearchEngine(
            planner = ResearchPlanner { _, _ ->
                plan.copy(
                    questions = listOf(ResearchQuestion("q0", "wireless charging support")),
                    paths = listOf(ResearchSearchPath("p0", ResearchQuery("wireless charging support", "q0")))
                )
            },
            discovery = discovery, provider = provider, now = { 200L }, validateTarget = {}
        )
        val dossier = engine.research("wireless charging support", ResearchMode.STANDARD)
        assertTrue(discoveryCalls > 1)
        assertTrue(dossier.gaps.isNotEmpty())
        assertTrue(dossier.gaps.any { it.counterEvidence })
        assertTrue(dossier.graph.relationships.any { it.relation == ClaimRelation.CONTRADICTS })
        assertTrue(dossier.graph.claims.any { it.validationState == ValidationState.CONTRADICTED })
        assertTrue(dossier.sources.size <= ResearchBudgetPolicy.forMode(ResearchMode.STANDARD).maxSourcesFetched)
    }
