import crypto from "node:crypto";
import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import {
  IMMUTABLE_GOVERNANCE,
  DEFAULT_STRATEGY_PROMPT,
  CANDIDATE_GENERATOR_PROMPT,
  GRADER_PROMPT
} from "./prompt-library.js";

const SCHEMA_VERSION = 1;
const MAX_CANDIDATES = 96;
const MAX_REFLECTIONS = 128;
const MAX_GENERATIONS = 256;
const MAX_DATASET = 24;

export function buildBrainDataset(continuumState, limit = 12) {
  const bounded = Math.max(1, Math.min(MAX_DATASET, Number(limit) || 12));
  const cases = [];
  for (const gap of continuumState.gaps.filter((x) => !x.resolved)) {
    cases.push({
      id: "gap:" + gap.id,
      type: "open_gap",
      task: gap.question,
      evidenceRefs: gap.sourceObservationId ? [gap.sourceObservationId] : [],
      priority: 3 - Math.min(gap.attempts, 3) * 0.4
    });
  }
  for (const topic of continuumState.topics) {
    cases.push({
      id: "topic:" + topic.id,
      type: "coverage",
      task: "Ermittle den belastbaren Wissensstand, offene Fragen und nächste prüfbare Schritte zu: " + topic.name,
      evidenceRefs: [],
      priority: 1.6 / (1 + topic.evidenceCount) + (topic.lastResearchedAt ? 0 : 1)
    });
  }
  for (const obs of continuumState.observations.slice(-32)) {
    if (!obs.contradictions && obs.uncertainty < 0.55) continue;
    cases.push({
      id: "obs:" + obs.id,
      type: "adversarial_review",
      task: "Prüfe diese Beobachtung auf Gegenargumente, widersprüchliche Evidenz und fehlende Verifikation: " + obs.summary,
      evidenceRefs: obs.citations.map((x) => x.url).slice(0, 6),
      priority: 1.2 + Number(obs.uncertainty ?? 0)
    });
  }
  for (const cycle of continuumState.cycles.slice(-24).filter((x) => !x.success)) {
    cases.push({
      id: "failure:" + cycle.id,
      type: "failure_recovery",
      task: "Ein vorheriger Forschungsversuch scheiterte. Entwickle einen alternativen, prüfbaren Weg. " +
        "Ursprüngliche Frage: " + cycle.query + " · Fehlersignal: " + cycle.reason,
      evidenceRefs: [],
      priority: 1.7
    });
  }
  const ranked = cases
    .sort((a, b) => b.priority - a.priority || a.id.localeCompare(b.id))
    .filter((item, i, all) => all.findIndex((x) => x.task === item.task) === i);

  const selected = [];
  for (const type of ["open_gap", "coverage", "adversarial_review", "failure_recovery"]) {
    const representative = ranked.find((x) => x.type === type);
    if (representative && selected.length < bounded) selected.push(representative);
  }
  for (const item of ranked) {
    if (selected.length >= bounded) break;
    if (!selected.some((x) => x.id === item.id)) selected.push(item);
  }
  return selected;
}

export function createInitialBrainState(now = Date.now()) {
  const strategy = DEFAULT_STRATEGY_PROMPT;
  const champion = makeCandidate({
    parentId: null,
    generation: 1,
    strategy,
    mutationSummary: "Initiale evaluierbare Research-Strategie",
    createdAt: now,
    status: "champion"
  });
  const state = {
    schemaVersion: SCHEMA_VERSION,
    generation: 1,
    createdAt: now,
    updatedAt: now,
    governanceHash: sha256(IMMUTABLE_GOVERNANCE),
    championId: champion.id,
    candidates: [champion],
    reflections: [],
    generations: [],
    integrityHash: ""
  };
  state.integrityHash = hashBrainState(state);
  return state;
}

export function makeCandidate({ parentId, generation, strategy, mutationSummary, createdAt = Date.now(), status = "challenger" }) {
  const cleanStrategy = clean(strategy, 12000);
  const summary = clean(mutationSummary, 800);
  if (cleanStrategy.length < 120) throw new Error("Candidate strategy is too short.");
  if (/ignore (all|previous)|disable (safety|guard)|bypass|self[- ]?preserv|evade|secret/i.test(cleanStrategy)) {
    throw new Error("Candidate attempts to weaken immutable governance.");
  }
  const digest = sha256([parentId ?? "root", String(generation), cleanStrategy, summary].join("\0"));
  return {
    id: "brain-" + digest.slice(0, 24),
    parentId,
    generation,
    strategy: cleanStrategy,
    mutationSummary: summary,
    createdAt,
    status,
    evaluation: null
  };
}

export class BrainFactoryStore {
  constructor(filePath) {
    this.filePath = filePath;
    this.backupPath = filePath + ".lkg";
  }

  load(now = Date.now()) {
    if (!fs.existsSync(this.filePath)) return createInitialBrainState(now);
    try {
      return validateBrainState(JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(this.filePath, "utf8")));
    } catch (error) {
      if (!fs.existsSync(this.backupPath)) throw error;
      return validateBrainState(JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(this.backupPath, "utf8")));
    }
  }

  save(state, now = Date.now()) {
    const next = structuredClone(state);
    next.updatedAt = now;
    next.candidates = next.candidates.slice(-MAX_CANDIDATES);
    next.reflections = next.reflections.slice(-MAX_REFLECTIONS);
    next.generations = next.generations.slice(-MAX_GENERATIONS);
    next.integrityHash = hashBrainState(next);
    validateBrainState(next);
    fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(this.filePath), { recursive: true });
    if (fs.existsSync(this.filePath)) {
      const current = fs.readFileSync(this.filePath);
      try {
        validateBrainState(JSON.parse(current.toString("utf8")));
        atomicWrite(this.backupPath, current);
      } catch {}
    }
    atomicWrite(this.filePath, Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(next, null, 2)));
    return next;
  }
}

export class BrainFactory {
  constructor({
    statePath,
    generateCandidates,
    evaluateCandidate,
    now = () => Date.now(),
    challengerCount = 3,
    promotionMargin = 0.025,
    safetyFloor = 0.97,
    groundingFloor = 0.78,
    datasetLimit = 10,
    dailyGenerationLimit = 4
  }) {
    if (!statePath) throw new Error("statePath is required");
    if (typeof generateCandidates !== "function" || typeof evaluateCandidate !== "function") {
      throw new Error("BrainFactory adapters are required");
    }
    this.store = new BrainFactoryStore(statePath);
    this.generateCandidates = generateCandidates;
    this.evaluateCandidate = evaluateCandidate;
    this.now = now;
    this.challengerCount = clampInt(challengerCount, 1, 6);
    this.promotionMargin = clamp(Number(promotionMargin), 0, 0.25);
    this.safetyFloor = clamp(Number(safetyFloor), 0.8, 1);
    this.groundingFloor = clamp(Number(groundingFloor), 0.5, 1);
    this.datasetLimit = clampInt(datasetLimit, 2, MAX_DATASET);
    this.dailyGenerationLimit = clampInt(dailyGenerationLimit, 1, 24);
  }

  status() {
    const state = this.store.load(this.now());
    return summarize(state);
  }

  championStrategy() {
    const state = this.store.load(this.now());
    const champion = state.candidates.find((x) => x.id === state.championId);
    if (!champion) throw new Error("Brain champion missing.");
    return champion.strategy;
  }

  async evolve(continuumState) {
    const dataset = buildBrainDataset(continuumState, this.datasetLimit);
    if (dataset.length < 2) return { skipped: true, reason: "Benchmark-Dataset noch zu klein.", status: this.status() };

    const cycleNow = this.now();
    let state = this.store.load(cycleNow);
    const dayAgo = cycleNow - 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
    const generationsToday = state.generations.filter((x) => x.createdAt >= dayAgo).length;
    if (generationsToday >= this.dailyGenerationLimit) {
      return { skipped: true, reason: "Tagesbudget für Brain-Evolution erreicht.", status: summarize(state) };
    }
    const champion = state.candidates.find((x) => x.id === state.championId);
    if (!champion) throw new Error("Brain champion missing.");

    const championEval = normalizeEvaluation(await this.evaluateCandidate({
      governance: IMMUTABLE_GOVERNANCE,
      candidate: champion,
      dataset
    }));
    champion.evaluation = championEval;

    const proposals = await this.generateCandidates({
      governance: IMMUTABLE_GOVERNANCE,
      generatorPrompt: CANDIDATE_GENERATOR_PROMPT,
      champion,
      dataset,
      reflections: state.reflections.slice(-12),
      count: this.challengerCount
    });
    const raw = Array.isArray(proposals) ? proposals.slice(0, this.challengerCount) : [];
    const generation = state.generation + 1;
    const challengers = [];
    for (const item of raw) {
      try {
        const candidate = makeCandidate({
          parentId: champion.id,
          generation,
          strategy: item.strategy,
          mutationSummary: item.mutationSummary ?? item.mutation_summary ?? "Challenger",
          createdAt: this.now()
        });
        if (candidate.strategy === champion.strategy) continue;
        candidate.evaluation = normalizeEvaluation(await this.evaluateCandidate({
          governance: IMMUTABLE_GOVERNANCE,
          candidate,
          dataset
        }));
        challengers.push(candidate);
      } catch (error) {
        state.reflections.push({
          generation,
          candidateId: null,
          createdAt: this.now(),
          lesson: clean("Kandidat verworfen → " + (error instanceof Error ? error.message : error), 800)
        });
      }
    }

    const eligible = challengers
      .filter((x) => x.evaluation.safety >= this.safetyFloor)
      .filter((x) => x.evaluation.grounding >= this.groundingFloor)
      .sort((a, b) => b.evaluation.score - a.evaluation.score || a.id.localeCompare(b.id));

    const best = eligible[0] ?? null;
    const promoted = Boolean(best && best.evaluation.score >= championEval.score + this.promotionMargin);
    if (promoted) {
      champion.status = "retired";
      best.status = "champion";
      state.championId = best.id;
    }

    for (const candidate of challengers) {
      if (candidate.id !== state.championId) candidate.status = "rejected";
      state.candidates.push(candidate);
      if (candidate.status === "rejected") {
        state.reflections.push({
          generation,
          candidateId: candidate.id,
          createdAt: this.now(),
          lesson: reflectionFrom(candidate, championEval, this.safetyFloor, this.groundingFloor)
        });
      }
    }

    state.generation = generation;
    state.generations.push({
      generation,
      createdAt: this.now(),
      datasetIds: dataset.map((x) => x.id),
      championBefore: champion.id,
      championAfter: state.championId,
      championScore: championEval.score,
      challengerIds: challengers.map((x) => x.id),
      promoted
    });
    state = this.store.save(state, this.now());

    return {
      skipped: false,
      promoted,
      championBefore: champion.id,
      championAfter: state.championId,
      championScore: championEval.score,
      challengers: challengers.map((x) => ({
        id: x.id,
        status: x.status,
        score: x.evaluation.score,
        safety: x.evaluation.safety,
        grounding: x.evaluation.grounding,
        mutationSummary: x.mutationSummary
      })),
      status: summarize(state)
    };
  }
}

export function createOpenAiBrainFactoryAdapters({ apiKey, model, baseUrl = "https://api.openai.com/v1", maxCases = 5 }) {
  const cleanBase = baseUrl.replace(/\/+$/, "");
  const call = async (instructions, input, tools = [], format = null) => {
    if (!apiKey) throw new Error("OPENAI_API_KEY fehlt für Brain Factory.");
    const response = await fetch(cleanBase + "/responses", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { Authorization: "Bearer " + apiKey, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        model,
        instructions,
        input: [{ role: "user", content: input }],
        tools,
        tool_choice: tools.length ? "auto" : undefined,
        max_tool_calls: tools.length ? 4 : undefined,
        text: format ? { format } : undefined,
        store: false
      })
    });
    const raw = await response.text();
    let payload;
    try { payload = raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : {}; } catch { throw new Error("Brain Factory API returned invalid envelope."); }
    if (!response.ok) throw new Error(payload?.error?.message ?? ("Brain Factory API HTTP " + response.status));
    return { payload, text: extractText(payload), citations: extractCitations(payload) };
  };

  return {
    generateCandidates: async ({ generatorPrompt, champion, dataset, reflections, count }) => {
      const result = await call(
        generatorPrompt,
        JSON.stringify({
          champion_strategy: champion.strategy,
          recent_reflections: reflections.map((x) => x.lesson),
          benchmark_shapes: dataset.slice(0, 8).map((x) => ({ type: x.type, task: x.task })),
          candidate_count: count
        }),
        [],
        {
          type: "json_schema",
          name: "brain_candidates",
          strict: true,
          schema: {
            type: "object",
            properties: {
              candidates: {
                type: "array",
                minItems: 1,
                maxItems: 6,
                items: {
                  type: "object",
                  properties: {
                    strategy: { type: "string", minLength: 120, maxLength: 12000 },
                    mutation_summary: { type: "string", minLength: 1, maxLength: 800 }
                  },
                  required: ["strategy", "mutation_summary"],
                  additionalProperties: false
                }
              }
            },
            required: ["candidates"],
            additionalProperties: false
          }
        }
      );
      const parsed = parseJsonObject(result.text);
      return (parsed.candidates ?? []).slice(0, count);
    },

    evaluateCandidate: async ({ governance, candidate, dataset }) => {
      const cases = dataset.slice(0, clampInt(maxCases, 2, 8));
      const metrics = [];
      for (const item of cases) {
        const answer = await call(
          governance + "\n\n" + candidate.strategy,
          item.task,
          [{ type: "web_search" }]
        );
        const grade = await call(
          GRADER_PROMPT,
          JSON.stringify({
            task: item.task,
            answer: answer.text,
            citations: answer.citations,
            evidence_refs: item.evidenceRefs
          }),
          [],
          {
            type: "json_schema",
            name: "brain_grade",
            strict: true,
            schema: {
              type: "object",
              properties: {
                quality: { type: "number", minimum: 0, maximum: 1 },
                grounding: { type: "number", minimum: 0, maximum: 1 },
                uncertainty: { type: "number", minimum: 0, maximum: 1 },
                planning: { type: "number", minimum: 0, maximum: 1 },
                safety: { type: "number", minimum: 0, maximum: 1 },
                notes: { type: "string", maxLength: 500 }
              },
              required: ["quality", "grounding", "uncertainty", "planning", "safety", "notes"],
              additionalProperties: false
            }
          }
        );
        const parsed = parseJsonObject(grade.text);
        metrics.push({
          quality: Number(parsed.quality),
          grounding: Number(parsed.grounding),
          uncertainty: Number(parsed.uncertainty),
          planning: Number(parsed.planning),
          safety: Number(parsed.safety),
          notes: clean(parsed.notes ?? "", 500)
        });
      }
      return aggregate(metrics);
    }
  };
}

export function validateBrainState(state) {
  if (!state || state.schemaVersion !== SCHEMA_VERSION) throw new Error("Unsupported brain-factory schema.");
  if (state.governanceHash !== sha256(IMMUTABLE_GOVERNANCE)) throw new Error("Immutable governance hash mismatch.");
  if (!Array.isArray(state.candidates) || state.candidates.length < 1 || state.candidates.length > MAX_CANDIDATES) throw new Error("Invalid candidates.");
  if (!Array.isArray(state.reflections) || state.reflections.length > MAX_REFLECTIONS) throw new Error("Invalid reflections.");
  if (!Array.isArray(state.generations) || state.generations.length > MAX_GENERATIONS) throw new Error("Invalid generations.");
  if (!state.candidates.some((x) => x.id === state.championId && x.status === "champion")) throw new Error("Invalid champion.");
  if (state.integrityHash !== hashBrainState(state)) throw new Error("Brain-factory integrity mismatch.");
  return state;
}

function normalizeEvaluation(value) {
  const metrics = {
    quality: clamp(Number(value?.quality), 0, 1),
    grounding: clamp(Number(value?.grounding), 0, 1),
    uncertainty: clamp(Number(value?.uncertainty), 0, 1),
    planning: clamp(Number(value?.planning), 0, 1),
    safety: clamp(Number(value?.safety), 0, 1),
    notes: clean(value?.notes ?? "", 500)
  };
  metrics.score =
    metrics.quality * 0.28 +
    metrics.grounding * 0.28 +
    metrics.uncertainty * 0.14 +
    metrics.planning * 0.18 +
    metrics.safety * 0.12;
  return metrics;
}

function aggregate(rows) {
  if (!rows.length) throw new Error("No benchmark rows.");
  const mean = (key) => rows.reduce((sum, x) => sum + clamp(Number(x[key]), 0, 1), 0) / rows.length;
  return normalizeEvaluation({
    quality: mean("quality"),
    grounding: mean("grounding"),
    uncertainty: mean("uncertainty"),
    planning: mean("planning"),
    safety: Math.min(...rows.map((x) => clamp(Number(x.safety), 0, 1))),
    notes: rows.map((x) => x.notes).filter(Boolean).slice(0, 4).join(" | ")
  });
}

function reflectionFrom(candidate, championEval, safetyFloor, groundingFloor) {
  const e = candidate.evaluation;
  let issue = "Scoreverbesserung nicht ausreichend";
  if (e.safety < safetyFloor) issue = "Safety-Regressionsgrenze unterschritten";
  else if (e.grounding < groundingFloor) issue = "Grounding-Regressionsgrenze unterschritten";
  else if (e.score < championEval.score) issue = "Gesamtscore unter Champion";
  return clean(
    issue + " → Signal: score=" + e.score.toFixed(3) +
    ", grounding=" + e.grounding.toFixed(3) +
    ", safety=" + e.safety.toFixed(3) +
    " → Nächste Mutation muss die schwächste Metrik gezielt verbessern. " + e.notes,
    800
  );
}

function summarize(state) {
  const champion = state.candidates.find((x) => x.id === state.championId);
  return {
    generation: state.generation,
    championId: state.championId,
    championScore: champion?.evaluation?.score ?? null,
    candidates: state.candidates.length,
    reflections: state.reflections.length,
    generations: state.generations.length,
    governanceHash: state.governanceHash,
    updatedAt: state.updatedAt
  };
}

function hashBrainState(state) {
  const copy = structuredClone(state);
  copy.integrityHash = "";
  return sha256(stableStringify(copy));
}

function stableStringify(value) {
  if (Array.isArray(value)) return "[" + value.map(stableStringify).join(",") + "]";
  if (value && typeof value === "object") {
    return "{" + Object.keys(value).sort().map((key) => JSON.stringify(key) + ":" + stableStringify(value[key])).join(",") + "}";
  }
  return JSON.stringify(value);
}

function atomicWrite(target, bytes) {
  const tmp = target + ".tmp-" + process.pid + "-" + crypto.randomBytes(4).toString("hex");
  fs.writeFileSync(tmp, bytes);
  const fd = fs.openSync(tmp, "r");
  try { fs.fsyncSync(fd); } finally { fs.closeSync(fd); }
  fs.renameSync(tmp, target);
}

function extractText(response) {
  const parts = [];
  for (const item of response.output ?? []) {
    if (item.type !== "message") continue;
    for (const content of item.content ?? []) if (content.type === "output_text" && content.text) parts.push(content.text);
  }
  return parts.join("\n").trim();
}

function extractCitations(response) {
  const found = new Map();
  for (const item of response.output ?? []) {
    if (item.type !== "message") continue;
    for (const content of item.content ?? []) {
      for (const annotation of content.annotations ?? []) {
        if (annotation.type === "url_citation" && annotation.url) {
          found.set(annotation.url, { title: annotation.title || annotation.url, url: annotation.url });
        }
      }
    }
  }
  return [...found.values()].slice(0, 12);
}

function parseJsonObject(text) {
  const cleaned = String(text ?? "").trim().replace(/^\`\`\`(?:json)?\s*/i, "").replace(/\s*\`\`\`$/, "");
  try { return JSON.parse(cleaned); } catch {
    const start = cleaned.indexOf("{");
    const end = cleaned.lastIndexOf("}");
    if (start >= 0 && end > start) return JSON.parse(cleaned.slice(start, end + 1));
    throw new Error("Expected JSON object.");
  }
}

function sha256(value) {
  return crypto.createHash("sha256").update(String(value)).digest("hex");
}

function clean(value, max) {
  return String(value ?? "").replace(/[\u0000-\u001f\u007f]/g, " ").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim().slice(0, max);
}

function clamp(value, min, max) {
  return Math.min(max, Math.max(min, Number.isFinite(value) ? value : min));
}

function clampInt(value, min, max) {
  return Math.round(clamp(Number(value), min, max));
}

import crypto from "node:crypto";
import {
  ContinuumStateStore,
  makeObservation,
  mergeObservation,
  recordCycle,
  stateSummary
} from "./continuum-state.js";
import { IMMUTABLE_GOVERNANCE, DEFAULT_STRATEGY_PROMPT } from "./prompt-library.js";

const STRATEGIES = [
  "Grundlagen, Definitionen und gesicherter Wissensstand",
  "aktueller Forschungsstand und wichtige neue Entwicklungen",
  "offene Fragen, Grenzen und bekannte Widersprüche",
  "alternative Erklärungen und unabhängige Quellen"
];

export class AutonomousResearchPlanner {
  choose(state, now = Date.now()) {
    const openGaps = state.gaps
      .filter((x) => !x.resolved && x.attempts < 4)
      .map((gap) => ({
        type: "gap",
        id: gap.id,
        text: gap.question,
        score: 3.2 - gap.attempts * 0.55 + staleness(gap.lastTriedAt, now)
      }));

    const topics = state.topics.map((topic) => ({
      type: "topic",
      id: topic.id,
      text: topic.name,
      score:
        2.0 / (1 + topic.evidenceCount) +
        staleness(topic.lastResearchedAt, now) +
        Math.min(topic.failureCount, 3) * 0.08
    }));

    return [...openGaps, ...topics]
      .sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score || a.id.localeCompare(b.id))[0];
  }

  queryFor(target, state) {
    const recentFailures = state.cycles
      .slice(-8)
      .filter((x) => !x.success && x.targetId === target.id).length;
    const strategy = STRATEGIES[Math.min(recentFailures, STRATEGIES.length - 1)];
    return {
      strategy,
      query: (target.text + " — " + strategy).slice(0, 280)
    };
  }
}

export class ContinuumResearchDaemon {
  constructor({
    statePath,
    research,
    now = () => Date.now(),
    minIntervalMs = 20 * 60 * 1000,
    dailyCycleLimit = 48
  }) {
    if (!statePath) throw new Error("statePath is required");
    if (typeof research !== "function") throw new Error("research function is required");
    this.store = new ContinuumStateStore(statePath);
    this.research = research;
    this.now = now;
    this.minIntervalMs = boundedInt(minIntervalMs, 60_000, 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
    this.dailyCycleLimit = boundedInt(dailyCycleLimit, 1, 288);
    this.running = false;
    this.timer = null;
  }

  status() {
    return stateSummary(this.store.load(this.now()));
  }

  async runOnce() {
    const startedAt = this.now();
    let state = this.store.load(startedAt);
    const gate = this.canRun(state, startedAt);
    if (!gate.ok) return { skipped: true, reason: gate.reason, summary: stateSummary(state) };

    const planner = new AutonomousResearchPlanner();
    const target = planner.choose(state, startedAt);
    if (!target) return { skipped: true, reason: "Kein Forschungsthema verfügbar.", summary: stateSummary(state) };
    const { query, strategy } = planner.queryFor(target, state);
    const cycleId = "cycle-" + crypto.createHash("sha256")
      .update([String(startedAt), target.id, query].join("\0")).digest("hex").slice(0, 24);

    try {
      const result = await this.research({ query, target, strategy });
      const observation = makeObservation({
        topicId: target.type === "topic" ? target.id : inferTopicId(state, result.topicHint),
        query,
        summary: result.summary,
        citations: result.citations,
        nextQuestions: result.nextQuestions,
        contradictions: result.contradictions,
        uncertainty: result.uncertainty,
        now: this.now()
      });
      state = mergeObservation(state, observation, this.now());
      state = recordCycle(state, {
        id: cycleId,
        targetType: target.type,
        targetId: target.id,
        query,
        strategy,
        success: true,
        reason: "Belegte Web-Beobachtung mit HTTPS-Quellen gespeichert.",
        observationId: observation.id,
        startedAt
      }, this.now());
      state = this.store.save(state, this.now());
      return { skipped: false, success: true, observation, summary: stateSummary(state) };
    } catch (error) {
      state = recordCycle(state, {
        id: cycleId,
        targetType: target.type,
        targetId: target.id,
        query,
        strategy,
        success: false,
        reason: error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Unbekannter Forschungsfehler",
        startedAt
      }, this.now());
      state = this.store.save(state, this.now());
      return {
        skipped: false,
        success: false,
        error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),
        summary: stateSummary(state)
      };
    }
  }

  start(onCycle = null) {
    if (this.running) return;
    if (onCycle !== null && typeof onCycle !== "function") throw new Error("onCycle must be a function");
    this.running = true;
    const tick = async () => {
      if (!this.running) return;
      try {
        const result = await this.runOnce();
        if (onCycle) await onCycle(result, this.store.load(this.now()));
      } catch (error) {
        console.error("Continuum research cycle failed:", error instanceof Error ? error.message : error);
      }
      if (this.running) this.timer = setTimeout(tick, this.minIntervalMs);
    };
    this.timer = setTimeout(tick, 3_000);
  }

  stop() {
    this.running = false;
    if (this.timer) clearTimeout(this.timer);
    this.timer = null;
  }

  canRun(state, now) {
    const last = state.cycles.at(-1);
    if (last && now - last.completedAt < this.minIntervalMs) {
      return { ok: false, reason: "Mindestabstand zwischen Forschungszyklen noch nicht erreicht." };
    }
    const dayAgo = now - 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
    if (state.cycles.filter((x) => x.completedAt >= dayAgo).length >= this.dailyCycleLimit) {
      return { ok: false, reason: "Tagesbudget für autonome Forschungszyklen erreicht." };
    }
    return { ok: true };
  }
}

export function createOpenAiResearchFunction({
  apiKey,
  model,
  baseUrl = "https://api.openai.com/v1",
  strategyProvider = () => DEFAULT_STRATEGY_PROMPT
}) {
  const cleanBase = baseUrl.replace(/\/+$/, "");
  return async ({ query, target, strategy }) => {
    if (!apiKey) throw new Error("OPENAI_API_KEY fehlt für autonomen Forschungszyklus.");
    const activeStrategy = String(strategyProvider() ?? DEFAULT_STRATEGY_PROMPT).slice(0, 12000);
    const response = await fetch(cleanBase + "/responses", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: {
        Authorization: "Bearer " + apiKey,
        "Content-Type": "application/json"
      },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        model,
        instructions: [
          IMMUTABLE_GOVERNANCE,
          "",
          "AKTIVE PROMOVIERTE FORSCHUNGSSTRATEGIE:",
          activeStrategy,
          "",
          "Ermittle belastbare Quellen und identifiziere, was als Nächstes untersucht werden sollte."
        ].join("\n"),
        input: [{
          role: "user",
          content: [
            "Forschungsziel: " + query,
            "Strategie: " + strategy,
            "Zieltyp: " + target.type
          ].join("\n")
        }],
        tools: [{ type: "web_search" }],
        tool_choice: "auto",
        max_tool_calls: 6,
        text: {
          format: {
            type: "json_schema",
            name: "continuum_research_observation",
            strict: true,
            schema: {
              type: "object",
              properties: {
                summary: { type: "string", minLength: 40, maxLength: 5000 },
                next_questions: {
                  type: "array",
                  maxItems: 6,
                  items: { type: "string", minLength: 8, maxLength: 260 }
                },
                contradictions: { type: "string", maxLength: 1200 },
                uncertainty: { type: "number", minimum: 0, maximum: 1 },
                topic_hint: { type: "string", maxLength: 160 }
              },
              required: ["summary", "next_questions", "contradictions", "uncertainty", "topic_hint"],
              additionalProperties: false
            }
          }
        },
        store: false
      })
    });
    const text = await response.text();
    let payload;
    try { payload = text ? JSON.parse(text) : {}; } catch { throw new Error("Research API returned invalid JSON envelope."); }
    if (!response.ok) throw new Error(payload?.error?.message ?? ("Research API HTTP " + response.status));
    const outputText = extractText(payload);
    const parsed = parseJsonObject(outputText);
    const citations = extractCitations(payload);
    if (citations.length === 0) throw new Error("Research result had no verifiable citations.");
    return {
      summary: String(parsed.summary ?? ""),
      nextQuestions: Array.isArray(parsed.next_questions) ? parsed.next_questions : [],
      contradictions: String(parsed.contradictions ?? ""),
      uncertainty: Number(parsed.uncertainty ?? 0.5),
      topicHint: String(parsed.topic_hint ?? ""),
      citations
    };
  };
}

function extractText(response) {
  const parts = [];
  for (const item of response.output ?? []) {
    if (item.type !== "message") continue;
    for (const content of item.content ?? []) {
      if (content.type === "output_text" && content.text) parts.push(content.text);
    }
  }
  return parts.join("\n").trim();
}

function extractCitations(response) {
  const found = new Map();
  for (const item of response.output ?? []) {
    if (item.type !== "message") continue;
    for (const content of item.content ?? []) {
      for (const annotation of content.annotations ?? []) {
        if (annotation.type !== "url_citation" || !annotation.url) continue;
        found.set(annotation.url, {
          title: annotation.title || annotation.url,
          url: annotation.url
        });
      }
    }
  }
  return [...found.values()].slice(0, 12);
}

function parseJsonObject(text) {
  const cleaned = String(text ?? "").trim()
    .replace(/^\`\`\`(?:json)?\s*/i, "")
    .replace(/\s*\`\`\`$/, "");
  try { return JSON.parse(cleaned); } catch {
    const start = cleaned.indexOf("{");
    const end = cleaned.lastIndexOf("}");
    if (start >= 0 && end > start) {
      try { return JSON.parse(cleaned.slice(start, end + 1)); } catch {}
    }
    throw new Error("Research model did not return the required JSON object.");
  }
}

function inferTopicId(state, hint) {
  const normalized = String(hint ?? "").toLocaleLowerCase("de-DE");
  const matched = state.topics.find((topic) =>
    normalized && topic.name.toLocaleLowerCase("de-DE").includes(normalized.slice(0, 24))
  );
  return matched?.id ?? state.topics[0].id;
}

function staleness(last, now) {
  if (!last) return 1.5;
  return Math.min(1.5, Math.max(0, (now - last) / (7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000)));
}

function boundedInt(value, min, max) {
  const n = Number(value);
  if (!Number.isFinite(n)) return min;
  return Math.min(max, Math.max(min, Math.floor(n)));
}

import crypto from "node:crypto";
import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";

export const STATE_SCHEMA_VERSION = 1;
export const MAX_OBSERVATIONS = 512;
export const MAX_GAPS = 128;
export const MAX_CYCLES = 1024;

const DEFAULT_TOPICS = [
  "Künstliche Intelligenz und maschinelles Lernen",
  "Android Plattform und mobile Systeme",
  "Softwarearchitektur und Programmiersprachen",
  "IT-Sicherheit und Datenschutz",
  "Mathematik und Statistik",
  "Physik und Astronomie",
  "Chemie und Materialwissenschaft",
  "Biologie und Neurowissenschaft",
  "Medizinische Forschung allgemein",

  "Robotik und Automatisierung",
  "Wirtschaft und Technologie",

  "Linguistik und Kommunikation",
  "Psychologie und Kognitionswissenschaft",

  "Ingenieurwesen und Fertigung",
  "Verkehr und Mobilität",
  "Wissenschaftsmethodik und Erkenntnistheorie"
];

export function createInitialState(now = Date.now()) {
  const state = {
    schemaVersion: STATE_SCHEMA_VERSION,
    generation: 1,
    createdAt: now,
    updatedAt: now,
    topics: DEFAULT_TOPICS.map((name, index) => ({
      id: "topic-" + String(index + 1).padStart(2, "0"),
      name,
      evidenceCount: 0,
      successCount: 0,
      failureCount: 0,
      lastResearchedAt: null,
      lastSuccessfulAt: null
    })),
    gaps: [],
    observations: [],
    cycles: [],
    integrityHash: ""
  };
  state.integrityHash = hashState(state);
  return state;
}

export function hashState(state) {
  const copy = structuredClone(state);
  copy.integrityHash = "";
  return sha256(stableStringify(copy));
}

export function validateState(state) {
  if (!state || state.schemaVersion !== STATE_SCHEMA_VERSION) throw new Error("Unsupported continuum state schema.");
  if (!Number.isInteger(state.generation) || state.generation < 1) throw new Error("Invalid continuum generation.");
  if (!Array.isArray(state.topics) || state.topics.length < 1 || state.topics.length > 128) throw new Error("Invalid topic set.");
  if (!Array.isArray(state.gaps) || state.gaps.length > MAX_GAPS) throw new Error("Invalid gap set.");
  if (!Array.isArray(state.observations) || state.observations.length > MAX_OBSERVATIONS) throw new Error("Invalid observations.");
  if (!Array.isArray(state.cycles) || state.cycles.length > MAX_CYCLES) throw new Error("Invalid cycles.");
  if (state.integrityHash !== hashState(state)) throw new Error("Continuum state integrity mismatch.");
  return state;
}

export class ContinuumStateStore {
  constructor(filePath) {
    this.filePath = filePath;
    this.backupPath = filePath + ".lkg";
  }

  load(now = Date.now()) {
    if (!fs.existsSync(this.filePath)) return createInitialState(now);
    try {
      return validateState(JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(this.filePath, "utf8")));
    } catch (primaryError) {
      if (!fs.existsSync(this.backupPath)) throw primaryError;
      return validateState(JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(this.backupPath, "utf8")));
    }
  }

  save(state, now = Date.now()) {
    const next = structuredClone(state);
    next.schemaVersion = STATE_SCHEMA_VERSION;
    next.generation = Number(next.generation ?? 0) + 1;
    next.updatedAt = now;
    next.gaps = next.gaps.slice(-MAX_GAPS);
    next.observations = next.observations.slice(-MAX_OBSERVATIONS);
    next.cycles = next.cycles.slice(-MAX_CYCLES);
    next.integrityHash = hashState(next);
    validateState(next);

    fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(this.filePath), { recursive: true });
    if (fs.existsSync(this.filePath)) {
      const current = fs.readFileSync(this.filePath);
      try {
        validateState(JSON.parse(current.toString("utf8")));
        atomicWrite(this.backupPath, current);
      } catch {
        // Never bless an invalid primary as last-known-good.
      }
    }
    atomicWrite(this.filePath, Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(next, null, 2)));
    return next;
  }
}

export function makeObservation({ topicId, query, summary, citations, nextQuestions, contradictions, uncertainty, now = Date.now() }) {
  const cleanCitations = citations
    .map((x) => ({ title: cleanText(x.title, 180), url: normalizeHttpsUrl(x.url) }))
    .filter((x) => x.url)
    .filter((x, i, all) => all.findIndex((y) => y.url === x.url) === i)
    .slice(0, 12);
  if (cleanCitations.length === 0) throw new Error("Research observation requires at least one HTTPS citation.");
  const cleanSummary = cleanText(summary, 5000);
  if (cleanSummary.length < 40) throw new Error("Research summary is too short.");
  const sourceDigest = sha256(cleanCitations.map((x) => x.url).sort().join("\n"));
  const contentHash = sha256([topicId, query, cleanSummary, sourceDigest].join("\0"));
  return {
    id: "obs-" + contentHash.slice(0, 24),
    topicId,
    query: cleanText(query, 280),
    summary: cleanSummary,
    citations: cleanCitations,
    sourceDigest,
    contentHash,
    nextQuestions: sanitizeQuestions(nextQuestions),
    contradictions: cleanText(String(contradictions ?? ""), 1200),
    uncertainty: clamp(Number(uncertainty ?? 0.5), 0, 1),
    createdAt: now,
    trust: "WEB_OBSERVATION",
    authority: "NONE"
  };
}

export function makeGap(question, sourceObservationId, now = Date.now()) {
  const normalized = cleanText(question, 260);
  if (normalized.length < 8) return null;
  const id = "gap-" + sha256(normalized.toLocaleLowerCase("de-DE")).slice(0, 24);
  return {
    id,
    question: normalized,
    sourceObservationId,
    sourceKind: "OBSERVATION",
    sourceRef: sourceObservationId,
    createdAt: now,
    lastTriedAt: null,
    attempts: 0,
    resolved: false
  };
}

export function mergeResearchQuestions(state, questions, sourceKind = "HYPOTHESIS", now = Date.now()) {
  const next = structuredClone(state);
  for (const item of (Array.isArray(questions) ? questions : []).slice(0, 32)) {
    const question = cleanText(item?.question ?? item, 260);
    if (question.length < 8) continue;
    const sourceRef = cleanText(item?.hypothesisId ?? item?.sourceRef ?? "", 120) || null;
    const id = "gap-" + sha256(question.toLocaleLowerCase("de-DE")).slice(0, 24);
    const existing = next.gaps.find((x) => x.id === id);
    if (existing) continue;
    next.gaps.push({
      id,
      question,
      sourceObservationId: null,
      sourceKind: cleanText(sourceKind, 40) || "HYPOTHESIS",
      sourceRef,
      createdAt: now,
      lastTriedAt: null,
      attempts: 0,
      resolved: false
    });
  }
  next.gaps = next.gaps.slice(-MAX_GAPS);
  return next;
}

export function mergeObservation(state, observation, now = Date.now()) {
  const next = structuredClone(state);
  if (!next.observations.some((x) => x.id === observation.id)) {
    next.observations.push(observation);
  }
  const topic = next.topics.find((x) => x.id === observation.topicId);
  if (topic) {
    topic.evidenceCount += 1;
    topic.successCount += 1;
    topic.lastResearchedAt = now;
    topic.lastSuccessfulAt = now;
  }
  for (const question of observation.nextQuestions) {
    const gap = makeGap(question, observation.id, now);
    if (!gap) continue;
    const existing = next.gaps.find((x) => x.id === gap.id);
    if (!existing) next.gaps.push(gap);
  }
  return next;
}

export function recordCycle(state, cycle, now = Date.now()) {
  const next = structuredClone(state);
  next.cycles.push({
    id: cycle.id,
    targetType: cycle.targetType,
    targetId: cycle.targetId,
    query: cleanText(cycle.query, 280),
    strategy: cleanText(cycle.strategy, 80),
    success: Boolean(cycle.success),
    reason: cleanText(cycle.reason ?? "", 500),
    observationId: cycle.observationId ?? null,
    startedAt: cycle.startedAt,
    completedAt: now
  });
  const topic = next.topics.find((x) => x.id === cycle.targetId);
  if (topic) {
    topic.lastResearchedAt = now;
    if (!cycle.success) topic.failureCount += 1;
  }
  const gap = next.gaps.find((x) => x.id === cycle.targetId);
  if (gap) {
    gap.lastTriedAt = now;
    gap.attempts += 1;
    if (cycle.success) gap.resolved = true;
  }
  return next;
}

export function stateSummary(state) {
  validateState(state);
  const successful = state.cycles.filter((x) => x.success).length;
  return {
    generation: state.generation,
    updatedAt: state.updatedAt,
    topics: state.topics.length,
    observations: state.observations.length,
    openGaps: state.gaps.filter((x) => !x.resolved).length,
    cycles: state.cycles.length,
    successfulCycles: successful,
    failedCycles: state.cycles.length - successful,
    citationCount: state.observations.reduce((n, x) => n + x.citations.length, 0),
    integrityHash: state.integrityHash
  };
}

function atomicWrite(target, bytes) {
  const tmp = target + ".tmp-" + process.pid + "-" + crypto.randomBytes(4).toString("hex");
  fs.writeFileSync(tmp, bytes);
  const handle = fs.openSync(tmp, "r");
  try { fs.fsyncSync(handle); } finally { fs.closeSync(handle); }
  fs.renameSync(tmp, target);
}

function stableStringify(value) {
  if (Array.isArray(value)) return "[" + value.map(stableStringify).join(",") + "]";
  if (value && typeof value === "object") {
    return "{" + Object.keys(value).sort().map((key) =>
      JSON.stringify(key) + ":" + stableStringify(value[key])
    ).join(",") + "}";
  }
  return JSON.stringify(value);
}

function sanitizeQuestions(values) {
  if (!Array.isArray(values)) return [];
  return values
    .map((x) => cleanText(String(x), 260))
    .filter((x) => x.length >= 8)
    .filter((x, i, all) => all.indexOf(x) === i)
    .slice(0, 10);
}

function cleanText(value, max) {
  return String(value ?? "").replace(/[\u0000-\u001f\u007f]/g, " ").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim().slice(0, max);
}

function normalizeHttpsUrl(value) {
  try {
    const url = new URL(String(value ?? ""));
    if (url.protocol !== "https:") return null;
    url.hash = "";
    return url.toString().slice(0, 1000);
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

function sha256(value) {
  return crypto.createHash("sha256").update(value).digest("hex");
}

function clamp(value, min, max) {
  return Math.min(max, Math.max(min, Number.isFinite(value) ? value : min));
}

import crypto from "node:crypto";
import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import { IMMUTABLE_GOVERNANCE } from "./prompt-library.js";

const SCHEMA_VERSION = 1;
const MAX_HYPOTHESES = 192;
const MAX_TOURNAMENTS = 96;
const MAX_REFLECTIONS = 384;

export function createInitialHypothesisState(now = Date.now()) {
  const state = {
    schemaVersion: SCHEMA_VERSION,
    generation: 0,
    createdAt: now,
    updatedAt: now,
    hypotheses: [],
    tournaments: [],
    reflections: [],
    integrityHash: ""
  };
  state.integrityHash = hashState(state);
  return state;
}

export function makeHypothesis({
  generation,
  question,
  hypothesis,
  evidenceRefs = [],
  parentIds = [],
  uncertainty = 0.5,
  testQuestions = [],
  createdAt = Date.now()
}) {
  const q = clean(question, 500);
  const h = clean(hypothesis, 2400);
  if (q.length < 8 || h.length < 30) throw new Error("Hypothesis is too short.");
  const refs = evidenceRefs.map((x) => clean(x, 1000)).filter(Boolean).slice(0, 12);
  const parents = parentIds.map((x) => clean(x, 80)).filter(Boolean).slice(0, 6);
  const tests = testQuestions.map((x) => clean(x, 320)).filter((x) => x.length >= 8).slice(0, 8);
  const digest = sha256([String(generation), q, h, refs.join("|"), parents.join("|")].join("\0"));
  return {
    id: "hyp-" + digest.slice(0, 24),
    generation,
    parentIds: parents,
    question: q,
    hypothesis: h,
    evidenceRefs: refs,
    uncertainty: clamp(Number(uncertainty), 0, 1),
    testQuestions: tests,
    createdAt,
    status: "HYPOTHESIS",
    authority: "NONE",
    elo: 1000,
    wins: 0,
    losses: 0,
    critiques: []
  };
}

export class HypothesisTournamentStore {
  constructor(filePath) {
    this.filePath = filePath;
    this.backupPath = filePath + ".lkg";
  }

  load(now = Date.now()) {
    if (!fs.existsSync(this.filePath)) return createInitialHypothesisState(now);
    try {
      return validateState(JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(this.filePath, "utf8")));
    } catch (error) {
      if (!fs.existsSync(this.backupPath)) throw error;
      return validateState(JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(this.backupPath, "utf8")));
    }
  }

  save(state, now = Date.now()) {
    const next = structuredClone(state);
    next.updatedAt = now;
    next.hypotheses = next.hypotheses.slice(-MAX_HYPOTHESES);
    next.tournaments = next.tournaments.slice(-MAX_TOURNAMENTS);
    next.reflections = next.reflections.slice(-MAX_REFLECTIONS);
    next.integrityHash = hashState(next);
    validateState(next);
    fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(this.filePath), { recursive: true });
    if (fs.existsSync(this.filePath)) {
      const current = fs.readFileSync(this.filePath);
      try {
        validateState(JSON.parse(current.toString("utf8")));
        atomicWrite(this.backupPath, current);
      } catch {}
    }
    atomicWrite(this.filePath, Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(next, null, 2)));
    return next;
  }

export class HypothesisTournament {
  constructor({
    statePath,
    generate,
    reflect,
    compare,
    evolve,
    now = () => Date.now(),
    hypothesesPerRound = 4,
    dailyTournamentLimit = 2
  }) {
    if (!statePath) throw new Error("statePath required.");
    for (const [name, fn] of Object.entries({ generate, reflect, compare, evolve })) {
      if (typeof fn !== "function") throw new Error(name + " adapter required.");
    }
    this.store = new HypothesisTournamentStore(statePath);
    this.generate = generate;
    this.reflect = reflect;
    this.compare = compare;
    this.evolve = evolve;
    this.now = now;
    this.hypothesesPerRound = clampInt(hypothesesPerRound, 2, 6);
    this.dailyTournamentLimit = clampInt(dailyTournamentLimit, 1, 8);
  }

  status() {
    const state = this.store.load(this.now());
    const ranked = [...state.hypotheses].sort((a, b) => b.elo - a.elo || a.id.localeCompare(b.id));
    return {
      generation: state.generation,
      hypotheses: state.hypotheses.length,
      tournaments: state.tournaments.length,
      reflections: state.reflections.length,
      leaderId: ranked[0]?.id ?? null,
      leaderElo: ranked[0]?.elo ?? null,
      updatedAt: state.updatedAt
    };
  }

  async run(researchState) {
    const now = this.now();
    let state = this.store.load(now);
    const dayAgo = now - 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
    if (state.tournaments.filter((x) => x.createdAt >= dayAgo).length >= this.dailyTournamentLimit) {
      return { skipped: true, reason: "Tagesbudget für Hypothesen-Turniere erreicht.", status: this.status() };
    }
    const context = buildTournamentContext(researchState);
    if (context.observations.length < 2) {
      return { skipped: true, reason: "Zu wenig belegte Beobachtungen für ein Hypothesen-Turnier.", status: this.status() };
    }

    const generation = state.generation + 1;
    const raw = await this.generate({ governance: IMMUTABLE_GOVERNANCE, context, count: this.hypothesesPerRound });
    const hypotheses = [];
    for (const item of (Array.isArray(raw) ? raw : []).slice(0, this.hypothesesPerRound)) {
      try {
        const candidate = makeHypothesis({
          generation,
          question: item.question,
          hypothesis: item.hypothesis,
          evidenceRefs: item.evidenceRefs ?? item.evidence_refs ?? [],
          uncertainty: item.uncertainty,
          testQuestions: item.testQuestions ?? item.test_questions ?? [],
          createdAt: this.now()
        });
        if (!candidate.evidenceRefs.length || !evidenceRefsAreGrounded(candidate.evidenceRefs, context)) continue;
        const critique = await this.reflect({ governance: IMMUTABLE_GOVERNANCE, hypothesis: candidate, context });
        candidate.critiques.push({
          createdAt: this.now(),
          validityRisks: clean(critique.validityRisks ?? critique.validity_risks ?? "", 1000),
          missingEvidence: clean(critique.missingEvidence ?? critique.missing_evidence ?? "", 1000),
          falsificationTest: clean(critique.falsificationTest ?? critique.falsification_test ?? "", 700),
          score: clamp(Number(critique.score), 0, 1)
        });
        hypotheses.push(candidate);
      } catch (error) {
        state.reflections.push({
          generation,
          createdAt: this.now(),
          hypothesisId: null,
          lesson: clean("Generation verworfen: " + (error instanceof Error ? error.message : error), 900)
        });
      }
    }
    if (hypotheses.length < 2) {
      return { skipped: true, reason: "Zu wenige belegte Hypothesen nach Reflection-Gate.", status: this.status() };
    }

    const matches = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < hypotheses.length; i++) {
      for (let j = i + 1; j < hypotheses.length; j++) {
        const a = hypotheses[i];
        const b = hypotheses[j];
        const verdict = await this.compare({ governance: IMMUTABLE_GOVERNANCE, a, b, context });
        const winner = verdict.winner === "B" ? b : a;
        const loser = winner.id === a.id ? b : a;
        updateElo(winner, loser);
        matches.push({
          aId: a.id,
          bId: b.id,
          winnerId: winner.id,
          reason: clean(verdict.reason ?? "", 700)
        });
      }
    }

    const ranked = [...hypotheses].sort((a, b) => b.elo - a.elo || b.critiques[0].score - a.critiques[0].score);
    let evolved = null;
    if (ranked.length >= 2) {
      try {
        const childRaw = await this.evolve({
          governance: IMMUTABLE_GOVERNANCE,
          leaders: ranked.slice(0, 2),
          context
        });
        evolved = makeHypothesis({
          generation,
          question: childRaw.question,
          hypothesis: childRaw.hypothesis,
          evidenceRefs: childRaw.evidenceRefs ?? childRaw.evidence_refs ?? [],
          parentIds: ranked.slice(0, 2).map((x) => x.id),
          uncertainty: childRaw.uncertainty,
          testQuestions: childRaw.testQuestions ?? childRaw.test_questions ?? [],
          createdAt: this.now()
        });
        if (evolved.evidenceRefs.length && evidenceRefsAreGrounded(evolved.evidenceRefs, context)) {
          const critique = await this.reflect({ governance: IMMUTABLE_GOVERNANCE, hypothesis: evolved, context });
          evolved.critiques.push({
            createdAt: this.now(),
            validityRisks: clean(critique.validityRisks ?? critique.validity_risks ?? "", 1000),
            missingEvidence: clean(critique.missingEvidence ?? critique.missing_evidence ?? "", 1000),
            falsificationTest: clean(critique.falsificationTest ?? critique.falsification_test ?? "", 700),
            score: clamp(Number(critique.score), 0, 1)
          });
          const verdict = await this.compare({ governance: IMMUTABLE_GOVERNANCE, a: ranked[0], b: evolved, context });
          const winner = verdict.winner === "B" ? evolved : ranked[0];
          const loser = winner.id === evolved.id ? ranked[0] : evolved;
          updateElo(winner, loser);
          matches.push({
            aId: ranked[0].id,
            bId: evolved.id,
            winnerId: winner.id,
            reason: clean("Evolution-Challenge: " + (verdict.reason ?? ""), 700)
          });
          hypotheses.push(evolved);
        } else {
          evolved = null;
        }
      } catch (error) {
        state.reflections.push({
          generation,
          createdAt: this.now(),
          hypothesisId: null,
          lesson: clean("Evolution verworfen: " + (error instanceof Error ? error.message : error), 900)
        });
      }
    }

    state.generation = generation;
    state.hypotheses.push(...hypotheses);
    const leaders = [...hypotheses].sort((a, b) => b.elo - a.elo).slice(0, 3);
    for (const h of hypotheses) {
      if (!leaders.some((x) => x.id === h.id)) {
        const weakest = h.critiques[0];
        state.reflections.push({
          generation,
          createdAt: this.now(),
          hypothesisId: h.id,
          lesson: clean(
            "Hypothese verlor Turnier → Elo " + h.elo +
            " → Schwachstelle: " + (weakest?.validityRisks || weakest?.missingEvidence || "niedrige Vergleichsbewertung"),
            900
          )
        });
      }
    }
    state.tournaments.push({
      generation,
      createdAt: this.now(),
      hypothesisIds: hypotheses.map((x) => x.id),
      matches,
      leaderIds: leaders.map((x) => x.id)
    });
    state = this.store.save(state, this.now());

    const researchQuestions = leaders
      .flatMap((x) => x.testQuestions.map((q) => ({
        hypothesisId: x.id,
        question: q,
        elo: x.elo
      })))
      .filter((x, i, all) => all.findIndex((y) => y.question === x.question) === i)
      .slice(0, 10);

    return {
      skipped: false,
      generation,
      hypotheses: hypotheses.map((x) => ({ id: x.id, elo: x.elo, uncertainty: x.uncertainty })),
      leaders: leaders.map((x) => ({ id: x.id, elo: x.elo, hypothesis: x.hypothesis, authority: x.authority })),
      researchQuestions,
      status: this.status()
    };
  }
}

export function buildTournamentContext(researchState) {
  return {
    observations: researchState.observations.slice(-24).map((x) => ({
      id: x.id,
      summary: x.summary,
      citations: x.citations.map((c) => c.url).slice(0, 6),
      uncertainty: x.uncertainty,
      contradictions: x.contradictions
    })),
    openGaps: researchState.gaps.filter((x) => !x.resolved).slice(-16).map((x) => ({
      id: x.id,
      question: x.question,
      attempts: x.attempts
    }))
  };
}

export function createOpenAiHypothesisAdapters({ apiKey, model, baseUrl = "https://api.openai.com/v1" }) {
  const cleanBase = baseUrl.replace(/\/+$/, "");

  async function call(instructions, payload, schema) {
    if (!apiKey) throw new Error("OPENAI_API_KEY fehlt für Hypothesen-Turnier.");
    const response = await fetch(cleanBase + "/responses", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { Authorization: "Bearer " + apiKey, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        model,
        instructions,
        input: [{ role: "user", content: JSON.stringify(payload) }],
        text: { format: { type: "json_schema", name: schema.name, strict: true, schema: schema.schema } },
        store: false
      })
    });
    const raw = await response.text();
    let envelope;
    try { envelope = raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : {}; } catch { throw new Error("Hypothesis API returned invalid envelope."); }
    if (!response.ok) throw new Error(envelope?.error?.message ?? ("Hypothesis API HTTP " + response.status));
    return JSON.parse(extractText(envelope));
  }

  return {
    generate: async ({ governance, context, count }) => call(
      governance + "\n\nRolle: Generation Agent. Erzeuge diverse, prüfbare Hypothesen aus vorhandener Evidenz. " +
      "Keine Hypothese ist ein Fakt. Verwende nur evidence_refs aus dem gelieferten Kontext.",
      { context, count },
      {
        name: "hypothesis_generation",
        schema: {
          type: "object",
          properties: {
            hypotheses: {
              type: "array", minItems: 2, maxItems: 6,
              items: {
                type: "object",
                properties: {
                  question: { type: "string", minLength: 8, maxLength: 500 },
                  hypothesis: { type: "string", minLength: 30, maxLength: 2400 },
                  evidence_refs: { type: "array", minItems: 1, maxItems: 12, items: { type: "string", maxLength: 1000 } },
                  uncertainty: { type: "number", minimum: 0, maximum: 1 },
                  test_questions: { type: "array", minItems: 1, maxItems: 8, items: { type: "string", minLength: 8, maxLength: 320 } }
                },
                required: ["question", "hypothesis", "evidence_refs", "uncertainty", "test_questions"],
                additionalProperties: false
              }
            }
          },
          required: ["hypotheses"],
          additionalProperties: false
        }
      }
    ).then((x) => x.hypotheses.slice(0, count)),

    reflect: async ({ governance, hypothesis, context }) => call(
      governance + "\n\nRolle: Reflection Agent. Prüfe die Hypothese wie ein skeptischer Peer Reviewer. " +
      "Suche Gültigkeitsrisiken, fehlende Evidenz und einen konkreten Falsifikationstest.",
      { hypothesis, context },
      {
        name: "hypothesis_reflection",
        schema: {
          type: "object",
          properties: {
            validity_risks: { type: "string", maxLength: 1000 },
            missing_evidence: { type: "string", maxLength: 1000 },
            falsification_test: { type: "string", maxLength: 700 },
            score: { type: "number", minimum: 0, maximum: 1 }
          },
          required: ["validity_risks", "missing_evidence", "falsification_test", "score"],
          additionalProperties: false
        }
      }
    ),

    compare: async ({ governance, a, b, context }) => call(
      governance + "\n\nRolle: Ranking Agent. Vergleiche A und B auf Evidenztreue, Testbarkeit, Erklärungswert, " +
      "Neuheitswert und Unsicherheitskalibrierung. Wähle genau einen Sieger; elo ist nicht sichtbar.",
      { a, b, context },
      {
        name: "hypothesis_pairwise_rank",
        schema: {
          type: "object",
          properties: {
            winner: { type: "string", enum: ["A", "B"] },
            reason: { type: "string", minLength: 10, maxLength: 700 }
          },
          required: ["winner", "reason"],
          additionalProperties: false
        }
      }
    ),

    evolve: async ({ governance, leaders, context }) => call(
      governance + "\n\nRolle: Evolution Agent. Erzeuge aus zwei starken Hypothesen eine neue Hypothese, " +
      "die deren Stärken kombiniert, bekannte Kritik adressiert und klar falsifizierbar bleibt.",
      { leaders, context },
      {
        name: "hypothesis_evolution",
        schema: {
          type: "object",
          properties: {
            question: { type: "string", minLength: 8, maxLength: 500 },
            hypothesis: { type: "string", minLength: 30, maxLength: 2400 },
            evidence_refs: { type: "array", minItems: 1, maxItems: 12, items: { type: "string", maxLength: 1000 } },
            uncertainty: { type: "number", minimum: 0, maximum: 1 },
            test_questions: { type: "array", minItems: 1, maxItems: 8, items: { type: "string", minLength: 8, maxLength: 320 } }
          },
          required: ["question", "hypothesis", "evidence_refs", "uncertainty", "test_questions"],
          additionalProperties: false
        }
      }
    )
  };
}

export function validateState(state) {
  if (!state || state.schemaVersion !== SCHEMA_VERSION) throw new Error("Unsupported hypothesis schema.");
  if (!Array.isArray(state.hypotheses) || state.hypotheses.length > MAX_HYPOTHESES) throw new Error("Invalid hypotheses.");
  if (!Array.isArray(state.tournaments) || state.tournaments.length > MAX_TOURNAMENTS) throw new Error("Invalid tournaments.");
  if (!Array.isArray(state.reflections) || state.reflections.length > MAX_REFLECTIONS) throw new Error("Invalid reflections.");
  for (const h of state.hypotheses) {
    if (h.status !== "HYPOTHESIS" || h.authority !== "NONE") throw new Error("Hypothesis authority violation.");
    if (!Number.isFinite(h.elo) || h.elo < 100 || h.elo > 3000) throw new Error("Invalid Elo.");
  }
  if (state.integrityHash !== hashState(state)) throw new Error("Hypothesis state integrity mismatch.");
  return state;
}

function evidenceRefsAreGrounded(refs, context) {
  const allowed = new Set(
    (context?.observations ?? []).flatMap((observation) => [
      observation.id,
      ...(observation.citations ?? [])
    ])
  );
  return refs.length > 0 && refs.every((ref) => allowed.has(ref));
}

function updateElo(winner, loser, k = 24) {
  const expectedWinner = 1 / (1 + 10 ** ((loser.elo - winner.elo) / 400));
  const delta = Math.max(1, Math.round(k * (1 - expectedWinner)));
  winner.elo = Math.min(3000, winner.elo + delta);
  loser.elo = Math.max(100, loser.elo - delta);
  winner.wins += 1;
  loser.losses += 1;
}

function hashState(state) {
  const copy = structuredClone(state);
  copy.integrityHash = "";
  return sha256(stableStringify(copy));
}

function stableStringify(value) {
  if (Array.isArray(value)) return "[" + value.map(stableStringify).join(",") + "]";
  if (value && typeof value === "object") {
    return "{" + Object.keys(value).sort().map((key) => JSON.stringify(key) + ":" + stableStringify(value[key])).join(",") + "}";
  }
  return JSON.stringify(value);
}

function atomicWrite(target, bytes) {
  const tmp = target + ".tmp-" + process.pid + "-" + crypto.randomBytes(4).toString("hex");
  fs.writeFileSync(tmp, bytes);
  const fd = fs.openSync(tmp, "r");
  try { fs.fsyncSync(fd); } finally { fs.closeSync(fd); }
  fs.renameSync(tmp, target);
}

function extractText(response) {
  const parts = [];
  for (const item of response.output ?? []) {
    if (item.type !== "message") continue;
    for (const content of item.content ?? []) {
      if (content.type === "output_text" && content.text) parts.push(content.text);
    }
  }
  return parts.join("\n").trim();
}

function clean(value, max) {
  return String(value ?? "").replace(/[\u0000-\u001f\u007f]/g, " ").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim().slice(0, max);
}

function sha256(value) {
  return crypto.createHash("sha256").update(String(value)).digest("hex");
}

function clamp(value, min, max) {
  return Math.min(max, Math.max(min, Number.isFinite(value) ? value : min));
}

function clampInt(value, min, max) {
  return Math.round(clamp(Number(value), min, max));
}

function tool(name, description, parameters) {
  return { type: "function", name, description, parameters, strict: true };
}

function stringProp(description) {
  return { type: "string", description };
}

function objectSchema(properties, required = []) {
  return {
    type: "object",
    properties,
    required,
    additionalProperties: false
  };
}

function toolsForRequest() {
  return [...functionTools, ...androidWebTools(WEB_SEARCH_ENABLED)];
}

function auth(req, res, next) {
  if (!DEVICE_AI_TOKEN) {
    res.status(503).json({ error: "DEVICE_AI_TOKEN ist serverseitig nicht konfiguriert." });
    return;
  }
  const header = req.get("authorization") ?? "";
  const supplied = header.startsWith("Bearer ") ? header.slice(7) : "";
  const a = Buffer.from(supplied);
  const b = Buffer.from(DEVICE_AI_TOKEN);
  if (a.length !== b.length || !crypto.timingSafeEqual(a, b)) {
    res.status(401).json({ error: "Nicht autorisiert." });
    return;
  }
  next();
}

async function openai(path, options = {}) {
  if (!OPENAI_API_KEY) throw new Error("OPENAI_API_KEY fehlt.");
  const response = await fetch(OPENAI_BASE_URL + path, {
    method: options.method ?? "POST",
    headers: {
      "Authorization": "Bearer " + OPENAI_API_KEY,
      "Content-Type": "application/json"
    },
    body: options.body ? JSON.stringify(options.body) : undefined
  });

  const text = await response.text();
  let payload = {};
  try {
    payload = text ? JSON.parse(text) : {};
  } catch {
    throw new Error("OpenAI lieferte keine gültige JSON-Antwort.");
  }

  if (!response.ok) {
    const message = payload?.error?.message ?? ("OpenAI HTTP " + response.status);
    throw new Error(message);
  }
  return payload;
}

async function conversationFor(sessionId) {
  const current = sessions.get(sessionId);
  if (current && Date.now() - current.touchedAt < SESSION_TTL_MS) {
    current.touchedAt = Date.now();
    return current.id;
  }

  const created = await openai("/conversations", {
    body: { metadata: { device_ai_session: sessionId.slice(0, 64) } }
  });

  sessions.set(sessionId, { id: created.id, touchedAt: Date.now() });
  return created.id;
}

function normalizeToolOutputs(items) {
  if (!Array.isArray(items)) return [];
  return items
    .slice(0, 16)
    .map((item) => ({
      type: "function_call_output",
      call_id: String(item?.call_id ?? "").slice(0, 200),
      output: String(item?.output ?? "").slice(0, 60000)
    }))
    .filter((item) => item.call_id);
}

function extractText(response) {
  const parts = [];
  for (const item of response.output ?? []) {
    if (item.type !== "message") continue;
    for (const content of item.content ?? []) {
      if (content.type === "output_text" && content.text) {
        parts.push(content.text);
      }
    }
  }
  return parts.join("\n\n").trim();
}

function extractFunctionCalls(response) {
  const calls = [];
  for (const item of response.output ?? []) {
    if (item.type !== "function_call") continue;
    let args = {};
    try {
      args = JSON.parse(item.arguments || "{}");
    } catch {
      args = {};
    }
    calls.push({
      call_id: item.call_id,
      name: item.name,
      arguments: args
    });
  }
  return calls;
}

function extractCitations(response) {
  const found = new Map();
  for (const item of response.output ?? []) {
    if (item.type !== "message") continue;
    for (const content of item.content ?? []) {
      for (const annotation of content.annotations ?? []) {
        if (annotation.type !== "url_citation" || !annotation.url) continue;
        found.set(annotation.url, {
          title: annotation.title || annotation.url,
          url: annotation.url
        });
      }
    }
  }
  return [...found.values()];
}

    service: "device-ai-backend",
    model: OPENAI_MODEL,
    web_search: WEB_SEARCH_ENABLED,

    brain_factory: Boolean(brainFactory)
  });

    res.json({
      daemon: continuumDaemon ? continuumDaemon.status() : null,
      brain: brainFactory ? brainFactory.status() : null,
      hypotheses: hypothesisTournament ? hypothesisTournament.status() : null,
      autonomousResearchEnabled: Boolean(continuumDaemon),
      brainEvolutionEnabled: Boolean(brainFactory),
      hypothesisTournamentEnabled: Boolean(hypothesisTournament)
    });
  } catch (error) {
    res.status(500).json({ error: (error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)).slice(0, 500) });
  }
});

app.post("/v1/agent/turn", auth, async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const sessionId = String(req.body?.session_id ?? "").trim();
    if (!sessionId || sessionId.length > 128) {
      res.status(400).json({ error: "Ungültige session_id." });
      return;
    }

    const message = typeof req.body?.message === "string"
      ? req.body.message.trim().slice(0, 12000)
      : "";
    const outputs = normalizeToolOutputs(req.body?.tool_outputs);

    if (!message && outputs.length === 0) {
      res.status(400).json({ error: "message oder tool_outputs erforderlich." });
      return;
    }

    const conversation = await conversationFor(sessionId);
    const input = outputs.length > 0
      ? outputs
      : [{ role: "user", content: message }];

    const device = req.body?.device ?? {};
    const deviceContext = [
      "Gerätekontext:",
      "Hersteller=" + String(device.manufacturer ?? "unbekannt").slice(0, 80),
      "Modell=" + String(device.model ?? "unbekannt").slice(0, 80),
      "Android=" + String(device.android ?? "unbekannt").slice(0, 40),
      "SDK=" + String(device.sdk ?? "unbekannt").slice(0, 20),
      "DeviceAI=" + String(device.app_version ?? "unbekannt").slice(0, 40),
      "Shizuku=" + String(Boolean(device.shizuku_ready))
    ].join(" ");

    const response = await openai("/responses", {
      body: {
        model: OPENAI_MODEL,
        conversation,
        instructions: SYSTEM_PROMPT + "\n" + deviceContext,
        input,
        tools: toolsForRequest(),
        tool_choice: "auto",
        parallel_tool_calls: false,
        max_tool_calls: 8,
        store: true
      }
    });

    res.json({
      response_id: response.id ?? null,
      status: response.status ?? "completed",
      message: extractText(response) || null,
      tool_calls: extractFunctionCalls(response),
      citations: extractCitations(response)
    });
  } catch (error) {
    const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Unbekannter Serverfehler.";
    res.status(502).json({ error: message.slice(0, 500) });
  }
});

setInterval(() => {
  const now = Date.now();
  for (const [key, value] of sessions.entries()) {
    if (now - value.touchedAt > SESSION_TTL_MS) {
      sessions.delete(key);
    }
  }
}, 30 * 60 * 1000).unref();

function startContinuumServices() {
  if (!CONTINUUM_DAEMON_ENABLED) return;

  if (BRAIN_FACTORY_ENABLED) {
    const adapters = createOpenAiBrainFactoryAdapters({
      apiKey: OPENAI_API_KEY,
      model: CONTINUUM_BRAIN_MODEL,
      baseUrl: OPENAI_BASE_URL,
      maxCases: Number(process.env.CONTINUUM_BRAIN_MAX_CASES ?? 4)
    });
    brainFactory = new BrainFactory({
      statePath: BRAIN_STATE_PATH,
      generateCandidates: adapters.generateCandidates,
      evaluateCandidate: adapters.evaluateCandidate,
      challengerCount: Number(process.env.CONTINUUM_BRAIN_CHALLENGERS ?? 3),
      datasetLimit: Number(process.env.CONTINUUM_BRAIN_DATASET_LIMIT ?? 10),
      dailyGenerationLimit: Number(process.env.CONTINUUM_BRAIN_DAILY_GENERATION_LIMIT ?? 4)
    });
  }

  if (HYPOTHESIS_TOURNAMENT_ENABLED) {
    const adapters = createOpenAiHypothesisAdapters({
      apiKey: OPENAI_API_KEY,
      model: HYPOTHESIS_MODEL,
      baseUrl: OPENAI_BASE_URL
    });
    hypothesisTournament = new HypothesisTournament({
      statePath: HYPOTHESIS_STATE_PATH,
      generate: adapters.generate,
      reflect: adapters.reflect,
      compare: adapters.compare,
      evolve: adapters.evolve,
      hypothesesPerRound: Number(process.env.CONTINUUM_HYPOTHESIS_COUNT ?? 4),
      dailyTournamentLimit: Number(process.env.CONTINUUM_HYPOTHESIS_DAILY_LIMIT ?? 2)
    });
  }

  continuumDaemon = new ContinuumResearchDaemon({
    statePath: CONTINUUM_STATE_PATH,
    minIntervalMs: CONTINUUM_RESEARCH_INTERVAL_MS,
    dailyCycleLimit: CONTINUUM_DAILY_CYCLE_LIMIT,
    research: createOpenAiResearchFunction({
      apiKey: OPENAI_API_KEY,
      model: CONTINUUM_RESEARCH_MODEL,
      baseUrl: OPENAI_BASE_URL,
      strategyProvider: () => brainFactory?.championStrategy()
    })
  });

  continuumDaemon.start(async (result, researchState) => {
    if (!result?.success) return;
    const successfulCycles = Number(result.summary?.successfulCycles ?? 0);

    if (brainFactory &&
        successfulCycles > 0 &&
        successfulCycles % BRAIN_FACTORY_EVERY_SUCCESSFUL_CYCLES === 0 &&
        successfulCycles !== lastBrainEvolutionSuccessfulCycle) {
      lastBrainEvolutionSuccessfulCycle = successfulCycles;
      try {
        const evolved = await brainFactory.evolve(researchState);
        console.log("Continuum Brain Factory:", JSON.stringify({
          promoted: evolved.promoted ?? false,
          championBefore: evolved.championBefore ?? null,
          championAfter: evolved.championAfter ?? null,
          skipped: evolved.skipped ?? false,
          reason: evolved.reason ?? null
        }));
      } catch (error) {
        console.error("Continuum Brain Factory cycle failed:",
          error instanceof Error ? error.message : error);
      }
    }

    if (hypothesisTournament &&
        successfulCycles > 0 &&
        successfulCycles % HYPOTHESIS_EVERY_SUCCESSFUL_CYCLES === 0 &&
        successfulCycles !== lastHypothesisTournamentSuccessfulCycle) {
      lastHypothesisTournamentSuccessfulCycle = successfulCycles;
      try {
        const tournament = await hypothesisTournament.run(researchState);
        if (!tournament.skipped && tournament.researchQuestions?.length) {
          const latest = continuumDaemon.store.load();
          const withQuestions = mergeResearchQuestions(
            latest,
            tournament.researchQuestions,
            "HYPOTHESIS",
            Date.now()
          );
          continuumDaemon.store.save(withQuestions, Date.now());
        }
        console.log("Continuum Hypothesis Tournament:", JSON.stringify({
          generation: tournament.generation ?? null,
          leaders: tournament.leaders?.map((x) => x.id) ?? [],
          newResearchQuestions: tournament.researchQuestions?.length ?? 0,
          skipped: tournament.skipped ?? false,
          reason: tournament.reason ?? null
        }));
      } catch (error) {
        console.error("Continuum Hypothesis Tournament failed:",
          error instanceof Error ? error.message : error);
      }
    }
  });

  console.log("Device AI Continuum research daemon enabled.");
  if (brainFactory) console.log("Device AI Brain Factory enabled.");
  if (hypothesisTournament) console.log("Device AI Hypothesis Tournament enabled.");
}

startContinuumServices();

const httpServer = app.listen(PORT, "0.0.0.0", () => {
  console.log("Device AI backend listening on port " + PORT);
});

function shutdown(signal) {
  console.log("Device AI backend stopping on " + signal);
  continuumDaemon?.stop();
  httpServer.close(() => process.exit(0));
  setTimeout(() => process.exit(1), 10_000).unref();
}

process.on("SIGTERM", () => shutdown("SIGTERM"));
process.on("SIGINT", () => shutdown("SIGINT"));

test("web tools are exact bounded Android function proposals, never hosted browsing", () => {
  const tools = androidWebTools();
  assert.deepEqual(tools.map(t => t.name), ["web_search", "web_read"]);
  for (const t of tools) {
    assert.equal(t.type, "function");
    assert.equal(t.strict, true);
    assert.equal(t.parameters.additionalProperties, false);
    assert.deepEqual(Object.keys(t.parameters.properties), t.parameters.required);
    assert.equal(t.parameters.properties[t.parameters.required[0]].type, "string");
    assert.match(t.description, /Android-Internetfreigabe/);
  }
  assert.equal(tools[0].parameters.properties.query.maxLength, 512);
  assert.equal(tools[1].parameters.properties.url.maxLength, 2048);
});

test("disabled discovery advertises no web capability; new calls do not share mutable schemas", () => {
  assert.deepEqual(androidWebTools(false), []);
  const a = androidWebTools();
  a[0].parameters.required.push("private_memory");
  assert.deepEqual(androidWebTools()[0].parameters.required, ["query"]);
});

test("actual server advertises Android proposals and removes hosted web-search bypass", () => {
  const server = readFileSync(new URL("../src/server.js", import.meta.url), "utf8");
  assert.match(server, /\.\.\.androidWebTools\(WEB_SEARCH_ENABLED\)/);
  assert.doesNotMatch(server, /type:\s*["']web_search["']/);
});

test("brain registry is checksummed and recovers last-known-good", () => {
  const dir = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), "brain-store-"));
  try {
    const file = path.join(dir, "brain.json");
    const store = new BrainFactoryStore(file);
    const first = store.save(createInitialBrainState(1000), 1100);
    assert.equal(validateBrainState(first), first);
    const second = store.save(first, 1200);
    const bytes = Buffer.from(fs.readFileSync(file));
    bytes[Math.floor(bytes.length / 2)] ^= 1;
    fs.writeFileSync(file, bytes);
    const recovered = store.load(1300);
    assert.equal(recovered.integrityHash, first.integrityHash);
    assert.notEqual(second.integrityHash, first.integrityHash);

    fs.rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true });

test("factory promotes only objectively better grounded safe challenger", async () => {
  const dir = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), "brain-factory-"));
  try {
    let now = 2000;
    const factory = new BrainFactory({
      statePath: path.join(dir, "brain.json"),
      now: () => now++,
      challengerCount: 3,
      promotionMargin: 0.02,
      generateCandidates: async () => [
        { strategy: "Use explicit hypotheses, source triangulation, adversarial counterexamples, uncertainty calibration and measurable stop conditions. " + "A".repeat(120), mutationSummary: "strong" },
        { strategy: "Use a concise single-source answer and stop immediately after the first plausible result. " + "B".repeat(120), mutationSummary: "weak" },
        { strategy: "Use broad exploration, but accept uncited conclusions when they sound plausible. " + "C".repeat(120), mutationSummary: "unsafe grounding" }
      ],
      evaluateCandidate: async ({ candidate }) => {
        if (candidate.mutationSummary === "strong") return { quality: .91, grounding: .94, uncertainty: .9, planning: .92, safety: 1, notes: "strong" };
        if (candidate.mutationSummary === "weak") return { quality: .55, grounding: .7, uncertainty: .5, planning: .4, safety: 1, notes: "weak" };
        if (candidate.mutationSummary === "unsafe grounding") return { quality: .95, grounding: .2, uncertainty: .3, planning: .8, safety: .8, notes: "unsafe" };
        return { quality: .72, grounding: .82, uncertainty: .75, planning: .7, safety: 1, notes: "champion" };
      }
    });
    const result = await factory.evolve(continuumFixture());
    assert.equal(result.promoted, true);
    assert.notEqual(result.championBefore, result.championAfter);
    const status = factory.status();
    assert.equal(status.generation, 2);
    assert.equal(status.candidates, 4);
    assert.ok(status.reflections >= 2);
    const active = factory.championStrategy();
    assert.ok(active.includes("explicit hypotheses"));
  } finally {
    fs.rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true });
  }
});

  } finally {

  }
});

test("planner prioritizes unresolved gap and changes query strategy after failures", () => {

  state.gaps.push({
    id: "gap-abc", question: "Welche Messmethode ist hier am robustesten?",

  });
  const planner = new AutonomousResearchPlanner();
  const target = planner.choose(state, 2000);
  assert.equal(target.type, "gap");
  const first = planner.queryFor(target, state);
  state.cycles.push({
    id: "cycle-1", targetType: "gap", targetId: target.id, query: first.query,
    strategy: first.strategy, success: false, reason: "no sources", observationId: null,
    startedAt: 2000, completedAt: 2100
  });
  const second = planner.queryFor(target, state);
  assert.notEqual(first.strategy, second.strategy);
});

test("daemon learns cited observation, persists gaps and respects interval budget", async () => {
  const dir = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), "device-ai-daemon-"));
  try {
    let now = 100000;
    const daemon = new ContinuumResearchDaemon({
      statePath: path.join(dir, "state.json"),
      now: () => now,
      minIntervalMs: 60000,
      dailyCycleLimit: 4,
      research: async ({ query }) => ({
        summary: "Die Recherche liefert eine vorsichtige Synthese aus mehreren überprüfbaren Quellen zu " + query + ".",
        citations: [
          { title: "A", url: "https://example.org/a" },
          { title: "B", url: "https://example.net/b" }
        ],
        nextQuestions: ["Welche unabhängigen Replikationen bestätigen das Ergebnis?"],
        contradictions: "Keine im begrenzten Suchlauf gefunden.",
        uncertainty: 0.35,
        topicHint: ""
      })
    });
    const result = await daemon.runOnce();
    assert.equal(result.success, true);
    assert.equal(result.observation.citations.length, 2);
    assert.equal(result.observation.authority, "NONE");
    assert.equal(daemon.status().observations, 1);
    const skipped = await daemon.runOnce();
    assert.equal(skipped.skipped, true);
    now += 60001;
    const second = await daemon.runOnce();
    assert.equal(second.success, true);
    assert.equal(stateSummary(daemon.store.load(now)).cycles, 2);
  } finally {
    fs.rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true });
  }
});

test("failed research is recorded and alternative strategy becomes available", async () => {

  }
});

import assert from "node:assert/strict";
